title: Pentesting - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**
**Shift Timings: Rotational**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 6+ years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence security guidance, including OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework, or Google Secure AI Framework.
* Experience implementing large language model guardrails, safety controls, or agent sandboxing patterns.
* Certification in DevSecOps, cloud security, Kubernetes security, AI security, or generative AI, such as Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or AWS Certified AI Practitioner.

title: Senior Cloud and AI operation leader
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
KLA's IT group supports business growth and productivity by connecting people, process and technology around the world. We work to improve the technology that drives our business to thrive and focus on empowering employee use of technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enhances employee productivity, business analytics and process excellence.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Operations Leadership**

* Lead and manage global cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Develop and execute cloud operational strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of cloud platforms.
* Provide executive reporting on cloud health, service availability, operational metrics, and risks.
* Manage a globally distributed cloud operations team and follow-the-sun support model.

**Service Delivery & Support**

* Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 operational support for cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Establish and manage 24x7 on-call support processes.
* Drive major incident management and root cause analysis.
* Develop SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and operational dashboards.
* Ensure timely resolution of service requests, incidents, and problems.

**Cloud Governance & Security**- Partner with Information Security teams to enforce security standards, policies, and compliance requirements.
- Ensure cloud environments meet regulatory and audit requirements.

**Director of Engineering**

.

The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**How You Will Make an Impact**
**Engineering & Platform Leadership**

**ServiceNow, ITSM & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and engineering leadership for ServiceNow and associated enterprise ITSM capabilities, with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB development as it relates to those areas.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, eliminate process gaps, improve data quality, and reduce operational toil.
* Ensure ServiceNow capabilities evolve as engineered products rather than simply administrative workflows.
* Establish metrics demonstrating the effectiveness of ITSM capabilities and their impact on availability, reliability, engineering productivity, and operational outcomes.

**Observability, SRE & Availability**

* Define and evolve observability capabilities using technologies such as Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and related enterprise tooling.
* Improve telemetry, monitoring, alerting, event correlation, and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
* Drive adoption of engineering practices that move teams from reactive monitoring toward proactive observability and reliability management.
* Partner with SRE and application teams to establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs, availability measures, and service-health standards.
* Use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns and prioritize engineering investments.
* Connect observability, CMDB, Incident, and Problem data to improve identification and resolution of reliability issues.
* Expand the footprint of our Customer Journeys and align them to critical business services.

**Strategy & Data Platforms**

* Lead application development and production support for Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), including delivery execution and the long-term platform roadmap.
* Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of BI and analytics capabilities supporting critical business and operational decisions.
* Drive modernization of data architecture, tooling, and engineering practices.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to develop advanced analytics and data-driven operational insights.
* Create integrations with other operational solutions including agentic solutions.

**Customer Journey Availability**

* Provide leadership across modern data ecosystems and workflow/orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow.
* Lead and expand capabilities for measuring end-to-end availability across critical customer journeys.
* Establish visibility and accountability across application, infrastructure, platform, and business teams.
* Support 99.99% availability objectives for designated critical journeys through standardized measurement, governance, and engineering practices.
* Establish controls and processes supporting reliability, risk management, auditability, and consistent delivery of business outcomes.
* Use observability and operational data to proactively identify risks affecting customer experiences.

**Financial & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, attract, retain, and develop high-performing engineering talent.
* Lead effectively across globally distributed teams and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Significant experience leading enterprise engineering, platform engineering, SRE, production management, data, or technology operations organizations.
* Demonstrated experience providing leadership to senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow and enterprise ITSM/ITIL processes, particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
* Strong understanding of industry standards and established ITIL practices associated with Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management.
* Experience developing or overseeing CMDB capabilities that directly support Incident, Problem, and Change processes.
* Demonstrated experience participating in and influencing ServiceNow platform roadmaps through established governance, planning, and prioritization forums in a complex enterprise environment.
* Ability to influence platform direction across organizations where roadmap ownership, process ownership, engineering execution, and business priorities may reside with different teams.
* Experience with enterprise observability platforms such as Dynatrace and Splunk, including modern telemetry and monitoring practices.
* Strong background in application development, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and production engineering.
* Experience defining and executing large-scale technology and platform strategies.
* Experience operating business-critical systems in highly available and regulated environments.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, automation, and reliability engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to influence peers and leaders and align teams across complex global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) or comparable enterprise BI platforms.
* Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable data orchestration technologies.
* Experience with Site Reliability and Operations Engineering in a large-scale application support organization.
* Experience establishing enterprise observability strategies.

**Leadership Qualities**
Successful Directors in this role will demonstrate the ability to:
  
  

* Set a clear technology vision and convert strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Develop senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Create clear ownership and accountability while empowering individuals to make decisions.
* Balance delivery speed with reliability, security, technical debt, regulatory requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Communicate complex technical issues and tradeoffs effectively with both engineers and executives.
* Influence enterprise platform and process direction when decision-making is distributed across multiple organizations.
* Build consensus through established governance while being willing to constructively challenge priorities and approaches.
* Make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Create an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, automation, continuous improvement, and learning.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge teams without becoming the team's de facto principal engineer.

From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**S**

* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
* DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
* Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
* Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
* Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
* CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
* Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
* Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
* Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
* Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.
* Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce — Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates — defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration — capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments.
* Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting — using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar — for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments.
* Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.

**PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE:**
**E**

* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
* Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
* Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
* Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
* Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
* Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
* Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
* Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

**Experience Requirements**

* 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
* 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
* Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
* Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
* Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows — ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines

**Salesforce & Platform Certifications**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I (Required)
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (Required)
* Salesforce Certified DevOps Engineer (Required)

title: Data Infrastructure & Integration Engineer
description:
**About SkySpecs:**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding turbine blade health. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

Join a collaborative team of Product Managers, Software Engineers, Leads, and Developers dedicated to building and managing a state-of-the-art analytics and decision-support platform tailored for the renewable energy sector. Together, we deploy, operate, and maintain the essential software and infrastructure that seamlessly connects diverse customer data systems with Horizon CMS, our advanced drivetrain analytics platform.

**As a Data Infrastructure & Integration Engineer, you will:**

* Configure, deploy, and maintain tools and infrastructure that enable the flow of CMS,
* SCADA, and other data into our cloud-based platforms, including Horizon CMS
* Detect, track, and resolve data connectivity issues across the entire fleet of customer data system integrations
* Help maintain underlying AWS infrastructure for data connectivity
* Collaborate with service delivery teams to ensure high-quality, reliable data is available for their analysis and reporting
* Respond to data connectivity trouble tickets and work the issues to completion
* Work with the connectivity team to create and improve processes needed for increased scalability and efficiency

**Requirements of the job:**

* 3+ years of work experience in a technical engineering, operations, or analyst role
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Strong Unix/Linux command line skills
* A basic understanding of data protocols, networking concepts, and IT security practices
* Fluency in English and excellent communication skills
* Ability to work outside normal business hours, when needed, to support the global team

**Bonus Point:**

* Experience in the wind power industry, especially drivetrain condition monitoring
* Proficiency with AWS tools and services like S3, EC2, VPC, and CloudWatch
* Experience with data analysis tools and scripting, e.g., using Python, SQL
* Capability and willingness to use AI tools, such as advanced LLMs, to increase productivity
* Degree in Engineering, or an applicable technical degree from an accredited university

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
description:
**About Signant Health**
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.
  
  
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work-arounds and resolution of reported issues.
* Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run.
* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right-size servers and services.
* Migrate on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
**Essential:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.

**Desirable:**

* 5+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Platform Engineer II**
**Role Overview:**

The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 5+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

* 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.

title: Elastic Engineer
description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\_cat, \_cluster, \_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

Access and security
  
  

* Kibana spaces, RBAC, roles and role mapping (SAML, LDAP, AD)
* TLS and certificate management for the stack

Cloud, containers and networking
  
  

* AWS basics (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) and Azure basics
* VPC concepts: subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs
* Network connectivity options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, load balancers
* EKS and Kubernetes operations, including ECK
* Senior level: AWS architecture in depth, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail and cross-account logging

Automation and DevOps (Senior Engineer and Operations Lead)
  
  

* Hands-on Python for automation against Elastic APIs
* CI/CD setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Terraform and infrastructure as code; Git-based workflows
* A track record of automations delivered, e.g. upgrade automation, onboarding automation, health-check scripts

Operations practice (Operations roles; valued for all)
  
  

* Ticket handling within SLA in ServiceNow, Jira or similar
* Incident calls, Sev1 triage and escalation handling

title: Network Development Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
As an Network Development Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you are an experienced Builder. You will own the design and delivery of automation systems that transform capacity restoration from a manual, labor-intensive process into a scalable, self-service operation. You will architect solutions, lead technical projects end-to-end, mentor NDEs, and partner with service teams to integrate restoration automation into the broader tooling ecosystem. This role demands strong software engineering skills, deep networking knowledge, and the ability to drive results across organizational boundaries.
  
  
Technical strategy is defined; component design is not. You are trusted with autonomy and are expected to make pragmatic trade-off decisions at product and component levels, identify and eliminate patterns affecting reliability and availability, and define and simplify team processes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Automation & System Design
  
  

* Own design and delivery of automation systems that restore out-of-service capacity with minimal manual intervention.
* Develop end-to-end link automation frameworks that transform manual troubleshooting into automated, system-guided restoration workflows.
* Build and improve centralized device health validation services for border, backbone, and regional network layers.
* Design self-service frameworks and next-step engines for automated troubleshooting and remediation.
* Architect solutions that are scalable, secure, maintainable, and extensible across a growing multi-timezone team.

Metrics & Monitoring
  
  

* Create and maintain the metrics and monitoring infrastructure for CRT: capacity out-of-service dashboards, burndown tracking, TTR, restoration success rate, and SLA compliance.
* Build systems to track and optimize bandwidth utilization trends, available capacity vs. projected peak, and redundancy coverage.
* Design automation to improve in-team resolution percentage and reduce escalation to Operations and Engineering teams.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Lead technical projects end-to-end; drive engineering best practices for development, testing, deployment, and operational excellence.
* Mentor NDEs; actively participate in hiring and conducting technical assessments.
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams to integrate restoration automation into the broader ecosystem.
* Identify and proactively address architectural or process deficiencies affecting restoration performance, reliability, and scalability.

Operations
  
  

* Participate in on-call rotations and operational reviews for follow-the-sun coverage.
* Lead complex incident response for capacity events; drive root-cause analysis and remediation for systemic failures.

A day in the life
  
  

* Review the capacity out-of-service dashboard; triage restoration priorities by customer impact and network health blocking status.
* Design and implement scalable automation to systematically restore capacity at fleet level (e.g., end-to-end link lifecycle automation).
* Solve complex network problems applying correct technologies and best practices; lead design reviews and architecture discussions for restoration tooling.
* Identify patterns affecting reliability/availability and drive them out through automation improvements.
* Partner with service teams to integrate self-service automation capabilities into the broader tooling ecosystem.
* Mentor engineers on software engineering best practices and system design.
* Participate in hiring, interview processes, and technical assessments for the team.
* Contribute to long-term technical strategy and automation roadmap; hand off active restoration work to your counterpart in the next time zone.

**About The Team**
The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end-to-end restoration of out-of-service inter-metro and intra-metro network capacity.
  
  
CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time-to-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
  
  
We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow-the-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
  
  
**About Aws**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* - 5+ years of experience in network development engineering, software engineering for networking, or network automation.
* - Proficiency in Python or another scripting/programming language for building network automation tools and services.
* - Experience with routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS) in large-scale network environments.
* - Experience designing and implementing automation for network operations at scale.
* - Experience with workflow orchestration systems and service-oriented architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of network hardware and packet forwarding architectures
* Experience working in a large-scale networking environment
* Experience building end-to-end network automation (link lifecycle management, device provisioning, health validation).
* Experience with network design and selecting platforms for implementation at hyperscale.
* Experience with workflow orchestration engines and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with distributed systems concepts applied to networking at scale.
* Experience building automation for large-scale networks with no scheduled downtime.
* Familiarity with deployment automation tools, link testing services, and operational event monitoring systems.
* Experience with data analysis and mining for operational insights.
* CCNP, JNCIP, or equivalent networking certification.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Sr Staff Engineer, Virtual Platform Engineering
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

We are seeking an experienced Azure Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise Azure infrastructure and platform services. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on engineering and operational expertise, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, implement secure and resilient cloud solutions, and contribute to infrastructure design and continuous improvement.

* Troubleshoot infrastructure, connectivity, performance, security, and deployment issues.

* Good knowledge of Azure networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and governance.

* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, backup, disaster recovery, and incident management.
* Understanding of high availability, resilience, security best practices, and enterprise cloud operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

**Additional Expectations for Senior Azure Engineers**

* Independently lead technical design and solution discussions.
* Evaluate architectural alternatives and recommend secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
* Drive technical implementation decisions and resolve complex infrastructure issues.
* Mentor engineers and promote automation, operational excellence, and engineering best practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, and governance frameworks.
* Familiarity with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and compliance controls.
* Exposure to AKS, Azure API Management, or enterprise observability platforms.
* Relevant Microsoft Azure certifications are an advantage.

title: Cloud Developer AWS
description:
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent.
* Hands on AWS experience with ECS Fargate, Lambda, EC2, IAM, RDS, S3, and either EKS or ECS. Working knowledge of VPC and VPC endpoints.
* Terraform module consumption. Contribution to shared modules preferred.
* Python for automation, including boto3 and AWS SDK or REST API usage. Reusable, tested code, not glue scripts.
* GitLab for source control and CI/CD: pipeline authoring, merge reviews, and protected branch workflows.
* Experience pairing directly with application or development teams.
* Agile/Scrum experience with two week sprints.
* One AWS Associate certification (Solutions Architect Associate, Developer Associate, or SysOps Administrator Associate).

The CORE Engineer is a hands on cloud developer embedded with application teams across the full cloud lifecycle: initial migration, day two operations, and ongoing reliability improvements. The primary job is pair programming with cloud champions inside app teams, using the Terraform modules, pipelines, and platform services already provisioned by the Cloud Infra Engineering, Cloud Automation, and Cloud Platform teams.
  
  

* Pair programming with app teams to build their first cloud MVP on AWS, using enterprise Terraform modules and GitLab pipelines. Transfer knowledge; do not create dependency.
* Hands on AWS work across ECS Fargate, Lambda, EC2, IAM roles, RDS, S3, EKS, SNS and SQS, and API Gateway. Working knowledge of VPC and VPC endpoints is sufficient; the network foundation is owned by Cloud Platform and Security.
* Terraform: consume enterprise modules confidently, and contribute improvements back to Cloud Infra Engineering via merge requests when a pattern is missing.
* GitLab: author and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Trupipeline), run merge reviews, and onboard app teams onto the enterprise SDLC. GitLab is the primary source of record.
* Python automation with boto3 and AWS APIs: build reusable tools that wrap AWS services into simpler, safer, developer friendly workflows. Turning repeat manual tasks into a small Python utility is the default response, not the escalation.
* Reliability enablement: working knowledge of Resilience Hub, AWS Fault Injection Simulator, and Application Recovery Controller, OR the ability to automate them via boto3 so app teams can consume them without deep AWS expertise. Either path is acceptable; both is preferred.
* Labs and office hours: contribute to hands on labs, cover the daily office hours rotation, and convert repeat questions into docs or lab content.
* Dojo engagements: run dedicated 4 to 6 week engagements with app teams new to cloud, walking them through architecture, forecast, labs, and their first path to prod.
* Banking or financial services experience.
* Experience running or debugging containerized workloads in ECS Fargate or EKS in production.
* Exposure to any AWS reliability service, for example Resilience Hub, Fault Injection Simulator, backup and restore, or cross region DR.
* Basic AWS cost awareness: reading a cost report, understanding tagging for cost allocation.
* SQL sufficient to query a cloud inventory or cost dataset.
* Experience teaching, mentoring, or leading pair programming, brown bags, or workshops.
* Comfortable writing docs that reduce future tickets.

description:

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions.

maintaining robust database systems that support T-Mobile’s large-scale applications and analytics. This position drives the modernization of database platforms, adoption of cloud-native data technologies, and continuous improvement of performance, reliability, and automation across mission-critical systems. You will collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance database solutions that align with business and technical objectives. **What You’ll Do:**

* Design and implement enterprise-grade database architectures for transactional and analytical workloads.

* Drive adoption of cloud database platforms (e.g., AWS: RDS, Aurora, Dynamo DB, Elastic Cache, Redis Cache and Azure: SQL Database, Managed instances, Redis Cache).
* Implement observability, monitoring, and alerting for database performance and reliability.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and backup/recovery standards.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to deliver integrated data solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical design reviews.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Security Architecture & Design Controls
* Design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient AWS cloud architectures aligned with enterprise security standards and best practices.
* Define security controls for AWS environments, including account structures, landing zones, workload isolation, and security boundaries.
* Design and implement network segmentation using VPCs, subnets, security groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and other cloud-native security controls.
* Establish appropriate security controls for internet-facing, internal, and highly sensitive workloads.
* Design secure connectivity between AWS, on-premises data centers, and third-party environments.
* Implement encryption for data at rest and in transit using services and technologies such as AWS KMS, TLS/SSL, and certificate management.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new cloud workloads, migrations, application modernization, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Identify security risks in proposed architectures and provide practical recommendations to mitigate those risks.
* Develop and maintain cloud security reference architectures, security patterns, standards, and design guidelines.
* Ensure security controls are consistently applied across development, testing, and production environments.
* Identity & Access Management (IAM)
* Design and maintain robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls based on the principles of least privilege and zero trust.
* Define and manage IAM roles, policies, permission boundaries, service roles, and cross-account access.
* Implement and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and strong authentication mechanisms.
* Establish appropriate access controls for employees, administrators, applications, workloads, and third-party users.
* Implement secure privileged-access mechanisms for administrative and high-risk accounts.
* Integrate AWS environments with enterprise Identity Providers and Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms.
* Regularly review IAM permissions to identify excessive, unused, or inappropriate access.
* Identify and remediate risks such as overly permissive IAM policies, exposed credentials, inactive accounts, and inappropriate privilege escalation paths.
* Establish processes for joiner, mover, and leaver access management.
* Support periodic access reviews and provide evidence for security and compliance audits.
* Security Automation & DevSecOps
* Integrate security controls and automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement security testing across infrastructure, application, container, and cloud configurations.
* Use Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform to consistently deploy and manage cloud security controls.
* Implement automated checks for infrastructure misconfigurations, insecure configurations, and policy violations before deployment.
* Introduce policy-as-code and automated compliance validation where appropriate.
* Automate remediation of common cloud security misconfigurations and security findings.
* Work closely with DevOps and engineering teams to embed DevSecOps practices into the software development lifecycle.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules, security templates, policies, and automation frameworks.
* Ensure security controls are repeatable, auditable, version-controlled, and integrated into automated deployment processes.
* Continuously improve the organization's security posture through automation and standardization.

Key Attributes
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate security requirements into practical cloud architectures and technical controls.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work across architecture, engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and security teams.
* Strong ownership of security risks and remediation.
* Ability to balance security, business requirements, operational considerations, and delivery timelines.

**Job Description**
**Mactores**
is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
  
  
Legacy infrastructure doesn't retire itself. Someone has to build the pipelines, rehearse the cutover, and carry the release into production and that's this seat. As a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer, you serve our application and infrastructure modernization work: you own build and release cycles for customer projects, land migrations from legacy hardware to AWS, and make deployments boring in the best sense of the word.
  
  
Agents change what this job looks like day to day. Aedeon and automation handle the repetitive discovery, mapping, and validation work that used to eat engineer hours. That leaves you the parts that actually need a senior engineer: infrastructure architecture, risk tradeoffs, release judgment, and the operational standards the whole team ships against. You'll work client-facing, embedded with customer teams, and the delivery commitment is one you carry personally.
  
  
**What we are looking for?**

* 6+ Years of total Hands-On Experience in DevOps
* 4+ years with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) including modules, remote state, state management, imports and multi account providers.
* Experience in designing highly available and secure AWS architecture within strong understanding of RTO/RPO and DR Strategies.
* 4+ years in configuration management and systems engineering, supporting large-scale Agile environments.
* 4+ years of Linux or Windows administration.
* 4+ years working with Git, with a solid grasp of branching and merging strategies.
* 4+ years hands-on with AWS infrastructure and platform services.
* 2+ years with cloud automation tools such as Ansible or Chef.
* 2+ years with container orchestration, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS ECS, and Docker.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a drive to improve reliability and scalability.

**What you will do?**

* Automate infrastructure creation with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation — infrastructure as code, not tickets and toil.
* Own application configuration management and drive Infrastructure as Code through deployment tooling.
* Own the build and release cycle for customer projects, end to end.
* Share responsibility for deploying releases and for operations and maintenance work.
* Improve the operations infrastructure we ship with — Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools like Graphite and Grafana.
* Support the engineering team operationally and help migrate legacy infrastructure to the cloud — retiring the old systems, not just standing up new ones.
* Establish and enforce operational best practices, and hold releases to them.
* Help hire culturally aligned engineers and mentor them as they grow.
* Work with the founders on team strategy and long-term technical planning.
* Work across US Mountain Time business hours with globally distributed teams., and with customer SMEs, to keep the business logic honest through migration.

* Proven expertise in managing and maintaining Apache Airflow environments, including deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in object-oriented scripting languages, particularly Python.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and experience building processes supporting data transformation, dependency, and workload management.
* Experience supporting and working with multi-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Qualifications :**

* Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency and workload management

Experience supporting ISO27001, NIST, CIS Controls or similar security/compliance frameworks preferred. title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior engineer for execution systems delivering robust solutions that connect manufacturing operations with enterprise platforms through Azure DevOps GITHUB RDBMS and AVEVA PI Historian. Apply extensive experience to design implement and optimize hybrid day shift systems that enhance supply chain reliability operational visibility and data driven decision making while ensuring secure and scalable execution environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement execution system solutions that integrate Azure DevOps GITHUB RDBMS and AVEVA PI Historian to provide resilient data flows across manufacturing and supply chain operations
* Develop and optimize scalable data models within relational databases to ensure reliable storage retrieval and reporting of execution and process information for enterprise stakeholders
* Configure and maintain AVEVA PI Historian environments to capture high fidelity time series data from plant systems enabling advanced analysis of production performance and asset health
* Create and manage Azure DevOps pipelines that automate build test and deployment workflows for execution system components improving release reliability and reducing manual intervention
* Administer and enhance GITHUB based repositories by enforcing branching strategies and pull request practices that support clean version control and traceability of execution system code artifacts

* Optimize query performance and database configurations in RDBMS platforms to support timely reporting dashboards and analytics that guide tactical and strategic decisions in operations
* Develop and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions for execution systems using PI data and database metrics to detect anomalies early and support proactive maintenance and operational continuity
* Document system architectures integration patterns and configuration standards for execution platforms so that support teams and stakeholders can clearly understand dependencies and maintenance procedures
* Coordinate and perform system upgrades patches and configuration changes during day shifts in a controlled manner to minimize disruption while keeping execution environments secure and current
* Support validation and testing activities by preparing test data executing test cases and confirming that execution systems meet functional performance and compliance expectations before release to production
* Provide guidance and mentoring to peers on best practices in Azure DevOps GITHUB RDBMS and AVEVA PI Historian so that the broader team can consistently deliver high quality execution solutions

**Qualifications**

* Apply advanced knowledge of Azure DevOps to define pipeline stages artifact management and environment strategies that align with execution system lifecycle needs and organizational governance
* Use deep experience in GITHUB and related workflows to maintain clean repositories code reviews and collaboration models that support stable development of execution system applications and services
* Leverage strong RDBMS expertise including schema design indexing and query tuning to ensure that execution data structures support reporting integration and long term maintainability

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:

**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and maintain pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and help run them on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
* Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana).
