title: Production Support Systems Intern
description:
**About Vcheck**
Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.
  
  
We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Production Support Systems Intern supports the team that keeps our production systems stable and available. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will learn how incidents, monitoring alerts, and escalations are handled in a live environment—starting by observing and following runbooks, and gradually taking on more of the triage yourself. You will get hands-on exposure to our AWS-hosted Python/Django/FastAPI backend and React JS frontend, and learn to track incidents via JIRA Service Management while monitoring system health through Sentry and CloudWatch. This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend and structured mentorship, and it offers a clear path to a full-time Production Support Systems Engineer role.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Monitor Sentry and CloudWatch dashboards for errors and anomalies under the guidance of a senior engineer
* Perform first-level triage of alerts and follow documented runbooks for known issues
* Create and update JIRA Service Management tickets with clear, complete incident details
* Escalate issues to the on-call engineer or Tier 3 with accurate, well-structured summaries
* Prepare shift handoff reports and join the overlap with the wider team
* Read CloudWatch Logs to identify ECS task errors, AWS Batch job failures, and Lambda/API issues
* Assist with restarting failed ECS tasks and retrying Batch jobs, as directed by the senior engineer
* Run start-of-shift and end-of-shift environment health checks and confirm nightly batch jobs have completed
* Learn to tell frontend (React JS) issues from backend API failures using Sentry error traces
* Run basic PostgreSQL/RDS checks and flag slow queries or connection issues to the team
* Verify that nightly backup and data replication jobs completed, and report any failure promptly
* Observe and support scheduled maintenance and deployments, including post-deployment monitoring
* Write simple Python scripts to automate repetitive checks and parse logs
* Document incident summaries, resolution steps, and learnings; help update runbooks and SOPs in the knowledge base

**About You**
****Key requirements:****
We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
  
  

* We're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and driven to grow through ownership, attention to detail, and upstanding character. No prior production support experience is needed. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Foundational understanding of cloud concepts; exposure to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch, RDS) through coursework, projects, or certifications is a plus
* Basic proficiency in Python for scripting and log parsing
* Basic understanding of SQL/PostgreSQL and how web applications and REST APIs work

title: Pentesting - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**
**Shift Timings: Rotational**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 6+ years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence security guidance, including OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework, or Google Secure AI Framework.
* Experience implementing large language model guardrails, safety controls, or agent sandboxing patterns.
* Certification in DevSecOps, cloud security, Kubernetes security, AI security, or generative AI, such as Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or AWS Certified AI Practitioner.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*

title: Senior Software Engineer (Secrets Manager)
description:
**About Bitwarden**
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Secrets Manager team, you will build and operate the application stack that lets developers, DevOps, and cybersecurity teams centrally store, manage, and deploy sensitive credentials. This is a
**hands-on role**
. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code within core concepts of secrets, projects, machine accounts, and access tokens across the product suite.
  
  
Secrets Manager spans a .
***NET API, a Rust SDK core, and a TypeScript and Angular web client,***
with SDK bindings in eight further languages and integrations written in Go, C++, Java, PHP and Python. You should be comfortable moving between languages and learning new ones as the work demands, developing deep expertise as you go.
  
  
**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* End-to-End Delivery & Ownership: Own features from specification through production. Write the design, build it across the API, client, and SDK, test it, ship it, and stay with it once it is live.
* Engineering Standards and Automated Quality: Review your teammates' pull requests with care and invite the same scrutiny of your own. Pair on hard problems, share what you learn, and help newer engineers find their footing in a security-sensitive codebase.
* Decoupled Architecture and Service Boundaries: Maintain clean service boundaries and design resilient APIs so Secrets Manager can evolve independently of the core platform.
* Deep Technical Work & Codebase Health: Take on the hardest problems in the codebase. Contribute to performance, reliability, accessibility, architecture and maintainability.
* AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering, and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not.
* Operational Stewardship: Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production.
* Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, Security, and the other team's engineers to design and validate solutions before implementation begins.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

* Overall Experience: 5+ years building and operating production software, with a track record of owning substantial, technically demanding features end to end as an individual contributor.
* Technical Stack - Expertise:

+ Languages such as Rust, Go, and Python
+ Tooling such as Terraform, Ansible, and GitHub Actions
+ Containerized environments such as Kubernetes
+ Writing, consuming, and using SDKs / APIs

* Technical Stack - Experience:

+ C# / .NET
+ TypeScript / Angular
+ Entity Framework with implementations of Postgres, MySQL, and SQLite

* Technical Stack - Familiarity:

+ Languages such as C++, Java, PHP
+ WASM instruction format

* T-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards).
* Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat-modeling methodologies.
* AI-Assisted Development: Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day engineering, such as Claude Code, Copilot, or similar.
* Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.
* Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
  
  
**If you enjoy being hands-on, solving hard engineering problems, and having a genuine influence on how products are built, we'd love to hear from you.**

Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Support the full application and infrastructure stack to ensure the CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service remains highly available, secure, performant, and reliable.
* Design, implement, and maintain observability, monitoring, and synthetic testing to detect issues early and validate service behavior end-to-end.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide timely incident response through PagerDuty and related operational processes.
* Lead or support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.
* Define, track, and continuously improve SLOs/SLIs to align platform reliability with business expectations.
* Produce clear and actionable monthly operations reports summarizing service health, trends, incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Leverage Datadog to analyze logs, create and maintain monitoring metrics, and configure dashboards and alerts that support CloudOps activities and platform reliability.
* Analyze operational data and platform metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for automation or optimization.
* Design, build, and maintain automation and internal tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the CloudOps environment.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain application and platform layers of the service, ensuring changes are implemented safely and in accordance with standards.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders to review designs, provide feedback, and help shape scalable and resilient solutions.
* Review peer code and infrastructure changes to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance with team standards and best practices.
* Develop, test, and document automation and platform components, including runbooks and operational procedures, to support long-term maintainability and operational readiness.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms

+ Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

* Operations

+ Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
+ Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

* Public and Private Cloud

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

* Interaction & Communication

+ Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Athenian Tech is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to take hands-on ownership of core areas of our AI-driven threat intelligence platform. This live, production platform ingests threat data from a wide range of external sources, enriches and scores it, and delivers curated intelligence feeds to enterprise customers over industry standard protocols. You will work closely with senior technology leadership to own production stability and data quality while helping shape architecture and process as the platform scales.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own deep hands-on platform architecture, data pipeline, enrichment, scoring and delivery.

* Strong Linux command-line skills including managing services, cron, logs, and troubleshooting production servers.
* Hands-on database experience at production scale, ideally Elasticsearch, along with SQL basics; Redis or RabbitMQ exposure is a plus.

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
Job Req Number: 92432
  
  
Time Type: Full Time
  
  
Job Description: Database Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
Industry
  
  
  

* Industrial Technology and Automation: Logistics & Supply Chain

Employment Type
  
  
  

* Full-time

Are you ready to develop your career in a rapidly growing and successful global company acting in a fast-paced role? If you are someone looking for a position that challenges and inspire you in a successful international company, DSV is your place.
  
  
The DSV group, headquartered in Denmark, is one of the biggest transports and logistics companies in the world, with more than 75,000 dedicated employees, operating in more than 90 countries.
  
  
You will join a global and determined group driven forward by the desire to grow and will be part of a dynamic group, which is characterized by high level professionalization and constant improvement.
  
  
Who do we look for?
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
As a Database Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the architecture of our database systems. You will work closely with other IT professionals and departments to ensure our database infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. Additionally, you will participate in guard duty rotations to ensure 24/7 support and monitoring of our database systems.
  
  
  

* Infrastructure Design: Develop and implement database infrastructure strategies that support business goals and ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
* Architecture Development: Design and architect database solutions, including data modeling, schema design, and integration with other systems.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend new database technologies and tools to enhance our infrastructure.
* Automation: Implement automation for database deployment, management, and monitoring using tools like Ansible to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Virtualization: Utilize virtualization technologies such as VMware, OpenShift, and Kubernetes to manage and deploy containerized database applications.
* Vulnerability Management: Identify and address database vulnerabilities, ensuring timely application of patches and updates to maintain security and compliance.
* Security: Ensure database security by designing and implementing robust security measures, including access controls and encryption.
* Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and availability in case of failures.
* Collaboration: Work with development and operations teams to support database-related projects and initiatives.
* Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation of database architecture, configurations, and procedures.
* Guard Duty: Participate in guard duty rotations to provide 24/7 support and monitoring of database systems.

Qualifications:
  
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in database infrastructure engineering and architecture.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), data modeling, infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Ansible), and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, OpenShift, Kubernetes) Strong architecture skills are essential.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design and implement complex database solutions.
* Communication: Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle Certified Master, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a plus.

Location: Noida (India)
  
  
We offer you:
  
  
The opportunity to expand your experience in a truly international, world-class company whose philosophy is that your everyday work should be both varied and full of professional challenges, with wide opportunities for constant professional and personal development.
  
  
Additionally, we offer the following:
  
  
  

* Medical Insurance including family and Parents up to 10 Lakh INR per year
* 2.5 days earned leave per month which is 30 days in a calendar year & 10 days Sick Leave in a year
* Parking for 4-wheeler or 2-wheeler vehicle
* Personal Mobile and Internet expenses reimbursed per calendar month subject to maximum cap.

**DSV – Global Transport and Logistics**
DSV is a dynamic workplace that fosters inclusivity and diversity. We conduct our business with integrity, respecting different cultures and the dignity and rights of individuals. When you join DSV, you are working for one of the very best performing companies in the transport and logistics industry. You’ll join a talented team of approximately 75,000 employees in over 80 countries, working passionately to deliver great customer experiences and high-quality services. DSV aspires to lead the way towards a more sustainable future for our industry and are committed to trading on nature’s terms.
  
  
We promote collaboration and transparency and strive to attract, motivate and retain talented people in a culture of respect. If you are driven, talented and wish to be part of a progressive and versatile organisation, we’ll support you and your need to achieve your potential and forward your career.
  
  
Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitter.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**About The Team**
We build and operate Expedia Group's core CI infrastructure that powers engineering teams across multiple domains. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable build systems—spanning native, backend, platform, and service teams—enabling developers to ship high‑quality software with confidence.
  
  
A high performing and influential individual contributor who leads by example while continuing to mentor junior engineers, interfaces consistently with tech leadership in the local organization, leads complex and vaguely-defined projects, and stretches into team leadership skills based on current projects.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, implement, and operate native cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform services that enable rapid, reliable delivery of applications across multiple domains.
* Build, configure, and maintain automated deployment, monitoring, and observability solutions to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of critical services.
* Drive improvements in infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and environment standardization to increase reliability, reduce manual work, and improve developer productivity.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define system design, including low-level design, API integration patterns, and data flows that align with operational and security best practices.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.
* Lead incident response, problem management, and post-incident reviews, using data and metrics to drive continuous operational excellence across services and platforms.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Relevant technical degree or equivalent practical experience in software engineering, computer science, or a related field with a focus on infrastructure, systems, or DevOps.
* 9+ years of Extensive hands-on experience in native cloud environments operating production systems, including ownership of one or more services or platforms end to end.
* Demonstrated expertise in CI/CD tooling, infrastructure-as-code, and automation, including build, test, deployment, and environment provisioning workflows.
* Strong proficiency in system design, including low-level design of infrastructure components, API integration, networking, security controls, and data modeling for operational systems.
* Proven experience monitoring, scaling, and troubleshooting distributed systems in production using logs, metrics, and alerts to maintain reliability and performance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with implementing and tuning remote build caching (Gradle Enterprise, Bazel Remote Cache).
* Experience with tuning macOS build performance, concurrency, resource allocation, filesystem tuning, or virtualization.
* Strong AWS experience — compute, storage, networking, autoscaling.
* Experience with Terraform, packer, GitHub suite(GH Actions, workflows and runners)
* Experience driving large-scale CI improvements across multiple teams or orgs, having the ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives with minimal direction.
* Deep experience designing and operating complex, large-scale cloud-native platforms or multi-service environments with strong emphasis on resilience, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
* Track record of leading architecture and design for deployment pipelines, infrastructure platforms, and operational tooling, including defining standards and best practices across teams.
* Advanced expertise in observability, incident management, and reliability engineering, using data-driven approaches to improve SLIs/SLOs and reduce operational toil.
* Experience integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled or AI-assisted systems in production (such as intelligent monitoring, automated remediation, or optimization pipelines), including safely leveraging AI tooling to enhance DevOps workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of deployment automation, infrastructure optimization, or reliability engineering.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

You will also help implement cutting-edge tools to automate infrastructure and streamline processes.

title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
description:
**Position Title:**
DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
45078
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.
  
  
Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Platform Engineering & Reliability:**
Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.
  
  
**CI/CD & Release Engineering:**
Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.
  
  
**DevSecOps Adoption:**
Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance.
  
  
**Security by Design:**
Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
**Infrastructure as Code:**
Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.
  
  
**GitOps & Kubernetes:**
Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman.
  
  
**Toolchain Availability:**
Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows.
  
  
**Automated Governance:**
Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines.
  
  
**Observability & Self-Healing:**
Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience.
  
  
**Performance & Operations:**
Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Architecture:**
Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:**
Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.
  
  
**Documentation & Enablement:**
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.
  
  
**Automation Culture:**
Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.
  
  
**Required Skills And Experience**
Core Experience
  
  
**10+ years of relevant experience**
in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.
  
  
**Hands-on engineering experience**
designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks.
  
  
**Strong programming and scripting capability**
using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages.
  
  
**Proven operational discipline**
across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation.
  
  
**Strong communication and collaboration skills**
with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams.
  
  
**Technical Capabilities Required**
**Capability Area**
**Expected Experience**
**Cloud Platforms**
Microsoft Azure (Must); Google Cloud Platform (Nice to have).
  
  
**Source Control & CI/CD**
GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms.

Terraform, Terratest, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt, or equivalent tools.

Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, kubectl, Helm, Docker, Podman, or comparable technologies.

Argo CD, Flux CD, or equivalent GitOps tooling.

SonarQube, Snyk, Akido, Chaingaurd, SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, dependency scanning, secrets scanning, and quality gates.

Selenium, Tosca, automated functional/performance/security testing, and service virtualization tools.

Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine, RHEL; TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, SMTP, FTP, and cloud networking fundamentals.

GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding and engineering assistants, used within defined governance and security controls.

in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

in Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is required.

is preferred.

and with planning, estimation, and delivery in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies responsibly.

* Responsible AI adoption: AI-assisted engineering improves productivity without compromising security, governance, quality, or cost control.

Gurgaon

Full-Time

**Department:**

**About Axslogic**

Axslogic is a fintech analytics enterprise software company that helps financial institutions digitize their lending data analytics while they progress their overall digitization journey. The company's flagship product, Winnow™, creates a new early warning exception management paradigm to manage challenges and risks associated with lending businesses. Founded by domain experts, Axslogic provides cutting-edge business analytics solutions that enable better portfolio performance and improved profitability for financial institutions. The company is headquartered in Singapore, with offices in India and the UAE.

**Role Overview**

Axslogic is seeking an experienced and skilled
**Platform Engineering Manager**
to join our team and drive the automation, scalability, and security of our cloud-based infrastructure. The ideal candidate will lead efforts to build and maintain a robust cloud platform that supports our patented SaaS / Managed SaaS products providing Early Warning and Predictive Analytic capabilities to financial institutions. This role requires strong expertise in
**DevOps practices**
, deep
**hands-on experience with AWS**
, and a thorough understanding of
**IT security as it applies to DevOps and cloud infrastructure**
.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**

* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to support agile development practices
* Administer, monitor, and optimize AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, EKS, etc.)
* Ensure platform deployment in secure Tier III or above Data Centers that offer very high level of uptime (99.982%) with multiple telecom peers, 100% redundant capacity and compliance to ISO 27001:2013 standards
* Implement and manage disaster recovery strategies and facilities
* Automate infrastructure using IaC tools like Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
* Monitor systems performance, ensure high availability, and troubleshoot issues

**Security & Compliance**

* Define and enforce security best practices across development and deployment environments
* Implement data encryption mechanisms using asymmetric-symmetric key systems specific to each client
* Manage secure SFTP/FTPS servers and ETL processes that handle sensitive financial data
* Set up and maintain LDAP/Active Directory based authentication systems
* Conduct risk assessments and recommend enhancements to improve overall DevOps security posture
* Support compliance with ISO 27001:2013 standards

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of cloud engineers and DevOps specialists
* Collaborate with developers, QA, and security teams to ensure safe and secure deployments
* Work with product teams to understand application requirements and design infrastructure solutions
* Partner with data science teams to create infrastructure that supports analytics capabilities
* Stay current with AWS updates and security trends to proactively enhance systems

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering roles
* Strong expertise in
  **AWS cloud infrastructure management**
* Hands-on experience with
  **CI/CD tools**
  such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or similar
* Proficiency in
  **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
  tools: Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi
* Solid understanding of
  **IT security principles**
  , especially in DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, network security, vulnerability management)
* Experience with
  **containerization and orchestration**
  (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS)
* Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar
* Familiarity with log aggregation, monitoring, and alerting tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog)
* Experience with handling sensitive financial data and knowledge of related compliance requirements
* Experience with job control platforms like Airflow
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and managing complex infrastructure projects

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect)
* Experience with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA)
* Background in scripting development in Bash and Python
* Experience with GitOps practices
* Knowledge of IBM and Oracle platforms that support analytics solutions
* Understanding of financial services domain, particularly lending analytics
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures
* Engineering Graduate from a top-tier college

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on Winnow™, a cutting-edge patented SaaS platform that provides pre-programmed early warning capabilities and state-of-the-art reporting and analysis for financial institutions
* Support a robust solution with over 1500 Alert Thresholds, 250+ Reports with multi-variate segmentation over 60+ dimensions
* Build infrastructure for a platform that disrupts traditional manual processes in financial risk management
* Use cutting-edge cloud infrastructure tools and participate in advanced security implementations
* Help shape a secure and scalable DevOps culture within a fast-growing fintech company
* Work with a strong management team with significant domain expertise in Commercial Lending, Banking, and Consumer Financial Services
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Flexible working arrangements and a collaborative team environment
* Join a global team with offices in Singapore, India, and the UAE

**About Our Technology Stack**

Our Winnow SaaS platform is implemented using world-class platforms and requires expertise in maintaining a secure, high-performance cloud infrastructure. The platform handles sensitive financial data and powers analytics that help banks and financial institutions make critical business decisions. As Platform Engineering Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of this crucial infrastructure.

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

description:

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

The opportunity to establish a modern quality engineering culture, build automation capabilities from first principles, and materially improve the speed and confidence with which the organization ships software

The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.

Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.

Key Responsibilities

**Platform Engineering & Reliability:** Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.

**CI/CD & Release Engineering:** Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.

**Security by Design:** Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

**Infrastructure as Code:** Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

title: Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to join our centralized Patch Management team.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across Windows and Unix server environments. This role requires strong operating system administration skills, hands-on experience with vulnerability remediation, knowledge of third-party and open-source software vulnerabilities, and the ability to develop, test, and deploy automated remediation solutions.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and software vendors to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established remediation timelines while maintaining system stability, availability, and compliance with organizational security standards. Key Responsibilities
**Required Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Windows and Unix Operating System Administration
* Strong hands-on experience administering Windows Server and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Group Policy Objects (GPOs), shared file systems, user and access management, software installation, configuration, and system administration.
* Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, and patch installation issues.
* Understanding of server dependencies, system services, permissions, and configurations that may affect patch deployment and remediation.
* Experience supporting enterprise server environments and performing security updates with minimal operational disruption.
* Vulnerability Analysis and Third-Party Software Remediation
* Experience investigating vulnerabilities identified through Software Composition Analysis (SCA), software scanning, and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Ability to analyze vulnerability findings affecting operating systems, third-party applications, open-source components, and installed software.
* Knowledge of software installation paths, package dependencies, vulnerable libraries, application versions, and other factors required to determine the root cause of vulnerabilities.
* Ability to identify appropriate remediation options, including vendor patches, software upgrades, configuration changes, component replacement, or removal of vulnerable software.
* Experience coordinating with software vendors, opening support cases, reviewing release notes, validating remediation recommendations, and implementing tested solutions.
* Ability to develop remediation plans and coordinate with application and infrastructure owners to complete remediation within SLAs.
* Scripting, Automation, and BigFix
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, and other relevant automation technologies.
* Hands-on experience with BigFix or similar enterprise patch management platforms.
* Ability to develop, test, and maintain automation scripts for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, software upgrades, and compliance validation.
* Experience automating repetitive operational activities to improve remediation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Ability to troubleshoot failed deployments and automate post-remediation verification wherever feasible.
* Application Packaging and Software Deployment
* Knowledge of application packaging, software installation, configuration, and deployment processes is a plus.
* Experience preparing, testing, and deploying third-party and open-source software updates across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to analyze application installation requirements, dependencies, compatibility considerations, and potential operational impacts.
* Understanding of software versioning, package management, installation parameters, and silent installation techniques.
* Experience with BigFix or similar tools for software distribution and deployment is desirable.

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description:
Position Summary
  
  
As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will protect Litera’s systems, data, and customers from evolving cyber threats. By leading security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and continuous security improvements, you will help ensure a resilient and compliant security posture. Your work will support business continuity, safeguard enterprise assets, and strengthen trust internally and with customers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor, investigate, and respond to security threats and incidents across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Scope, design, and build automation to solve recurring security and compliance problems, reducing manual effort and improving consistency and scalability.
* Develop automated security controls and audits, such as validating security group membership and access against requirements, identifying access anomalies, and producing actionable findings.
* Build automated checks that evaluate internal systems and content against security criteria, including detecting exposed credentials, passwords, sensitive information, and other security or compliance conditions.
* Translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable technical solutions by defining the problem, identifying data sources, implementing detection or validation logic, validating results, and producing actionable output for remediation.
* Maintain and improve security automation as requirements, systems, and risks change.

* Implement and maintain security controls aligned with Zero Trust and security best practices.
* Partner with IT, DevOps, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to strengthen security posture.
* Support compliance initiatives, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, audit readiness, and policy management.
* Drive continuous improvement through security automation, measurable control validation, cloud security enhancements, and emerging technology adoption.
* Stay current on evolving cyber threats and recommend security improvements.

**Qualifications**
Must Haves:
  
  

* 5+ years of cybersecurity experience, including hands-on Security Operations Center (SOC) experience.
* Experience operating and investigating security events in cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience scoping and building automation to solve security or compliance problems using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar technologies.
* Ability to take a security requirement from problem definition through implementation, including identifying data sources, developing logic, validating results, handling exceptions, and producing actionable output.
* Experience automating security or compliance activities such as access and entitlement reviews, configuration validation, data discovery, control testing, or other repeatable processes.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

Education & Certifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred certifications include CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, Microsoft security certifications, or an AWS/Azure cloud security certification.

* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Experience integrating security tools and data sources through REST APIs, webhooks, or similar methods.
* Ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.
* Unyielding curiosity and a strong desire to get to the “why”.
* Challenges assumptions and brings fresh perspectives to problems.
* High adaptability and continuous learning mindset.
* Passion for promoting security awareness and best practices.

description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
