title: Vice President - Product Engineering
description:
**Role: Vice President — Product Engineering**
**Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore**
**About AppViewX:**
AppViewX is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry’s most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
  
  

* **We Do What We Say:**
  We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:**
  We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:**
  We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:**
  We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
  
  
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

**What We Require**
***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

**Why AppViewX?**
AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
  
  
AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

title: Microservices Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java-based microservices ecosystem. **Core Requirements**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large-scale eCommerce or digital-commerce platforms.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, and messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, SRE practices, resiliency, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of database technologies, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, security, and high-volume platform readiness.
* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.
* Act as the primary technical and delivery leader for customer and internal stakeholders, driving technical discussions, resolving escalations, influencing solution decisions, and building stakeholder confidence.
* Strong stakeholder communication, project planning, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a Solution Architect to architect and solution large-scale digital solutions built on the DIGIT platform, with a primary focus on Public Finance Management (PFM).

The role sits at the intersection of product, technology and government—translating complex business and policy requirements into scalable, reusable and implementation-ready solutions. You will work with government stakeholders, development partners, product and engineering teams, and implementation partners across the lifecycle from discovery and solution design through development, UAT, go-live and stabilisation.

The role also provides technical advisory to governments and development partners and contributes to the architecture and evolution of DIGIT Studio and shared DIGIT platform capabilities.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. PFM Solution Architecture & Product Solutioning**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for PFM products and digital solutions on DIGIT.
* Work with government, development partners, product and programme teams to understand business processes, user needs, data requirements and operational constraints.
* Translate requirements into scalable solution designs covering services, APIs, data models, workflows, integrations, security and auditability.
* Determine whether requirements should be addressed through existing DIGIT capabilities, configuration, product extensions, reusable components or new services.
* Define HLDs, solution blueprints and, where required, LLDs for complex components and integrations.
* Ensure solutions are modular, API-driven, configurable, reusable and interoperable, with minimal implementation-specific customisation.
* Identify key architectural risks, dependencies and trade-offs and document significant decisions through Architecture Decision Records.

**2. DIGIT Platform & Studio Architecture**

* Drive reuse of DIGIT core services and shared platform capabilities across Products and other solutions.
* Define and review patterns for service boundaries, APIs, workflows, data exchange, identity and access management, notifications, audit, persistence, search and external integrations.
* Ensure implementation-specific requirements are addressed through configuration or reusable extensions wherever possible.
* Contribute to the evolution of DIGIT Studio as a platform for configuring, composing and extending DIGIT-based applications.
* Review Studio architecture for extensibility, configurability, multi-tenancy, performance, accessibility, security and integration.
* Define how Studio-configured solutions interact with DIGIT core services and shared platform capabilities.
* Identify common capabilities that can become reusable platform components.
* Ensure architecture supports sustainable evolution, versioning and upgrades without platform fragmentation or tight coupling.

**3. Technical Advisory & Partner Governance**

* Act as a technical advisor to government departments, development partners and programme leadership during discovery, solution definition and implementation planning.
* Explain solution options, technical trade-offs, dependencies, integration requirements, security considerations and operational implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead technical workshops, solution walkthroughs, architecture reviews and technical discussions.
* Provide technical direction to internal engineering teams and implementation partners.
* Review partner architecture, solution designs, API contracts and key technical decisions, and provide architecture sign-off where required.
* Establish architecture checkpoints across design, development, UAT and production readiness.
* Ensure implementation partners adhere to agreed architecture, engineering, quality and production-readiness standards.
* Work with product and programme teams to identify technical dependencies, sequence delivery and define critical paths.

**4. Non-Functional Architecture, Security & Operations**

* Define and validate requirements for scalability, availability, performance, resilience, disaster recovery, observability, backup/restore and capacity planning.
* Define integration patterns covering retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, asynchronous processing, reconciliation and schema/version management.
* Ensure solutions incorporate appropriate security, privacy, access control and auditability requirements.
* Work with InfoSec, DevOps and engineering teams to identify and address architecture-level security and operational risks.
* Ensure solutions are designed for reliable operation in large-scale, multi-tenant and multi-instance production environments.

**5. Architecture Standards & Engineering Enablement**

* Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable patterns, solution templates, design guidelines and architecture checklists.
* Maintain Architecture Decision Records and architecture documentation required for consistent technical decision-making.
* Conduct architecture and engineering enablement sessions for internal teams and implementation partners.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads on architecture, solution design and engineering practices.
* Contribute to improving architecture and solutioning standards across eGov and the DIGIT ecosystem.
* Promote appropriate use of AI-assisted engineering and emerging technologies where they provide practical value, with appropriate quality, security, privacy and human-oversight guardrails.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 8–12 years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or technical leadership.
* Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale, distributed digital platforms or enterprise solutions.
* Experience translating complex business and process requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working directly with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working with government, public-sector, development-partner or multi-vendor ecosystems is highly preferable.
* Experience providing technical direction and mentoring to engineering teams and implementation partners.

**PFM / Domain Competency**

* Strong understanding of Public Finance Management processes and digital government finance systems is preferred.
* Ability to understand complex government processes and translate them into configurable and interoperable digital solutions.

**Technical Competency**

* Strong expertise in microservices, API-driven and distributed-system architecture.
* Strong understanding of Java/Spring Boot or similar enterprise back-end technologies, REST APIs and integration patterns.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases and data modelling.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability and production operations.
* Working knowledge of Git, Maven, Jenkins, YAML/JSON and OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Experience designing integrations with external, departmental and legacy systems.
* Understanding of multi-tenancy, configuration-driven platforms and platform engineering.
* Knowledge of Elasticsearch, Node.js and React.js or comparable technologies is an advantage.
* Exposure to Digital Public Infrastructure / Digital Public Goods is an advantage.
* Exposure to LLM APIs, RAG or agentic frameworks is an advantage.

**Architecture & Solutioning Skills**

* Ability to evaluate solution options and articulate trade-offs, assumptions, risks and dependencies.
* Strong understanding of reusability, extensibility, configuration-over-customisation and platform architecture.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, DevOps, release management and production-readiness practices.

**About Carrier**

**About The Role**
Builds and operates infrastructure and cloud environments to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. Manages services, costs, and architecture to support evolving business needs.
  
  
Job Description: Senior Cloud Architect - P5
  
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Cloud Architect sets and evolves the architectural direction for Carrier’s cloud platform across AWS, GCP, and Azure. This role works horizontally across our product portfolio to ensure we build solutions that are consistently secure, resilient, and cost effective. The architect defines reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails, then partners with Product Leads, Security, FinOps, and customer teams to put them into practice through Infrastructure as Code and automation. The result is a coherent, well-governed cloud foundation that product teams can build on with confidence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve reference architectures and design patterns across AWS, GCP, and Azure covering compute, storage, networking, identity, and data services that product teams reuse.
* Establish architectural standards and guardrails for security, resilience, and cost efficiency, and ensure they are applied consistently across the product portfolio.
* Translate architectural decisions into Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines so designs are repeatable, versioned, and easy to adopt.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction on design trade-offs, with a focus on security posture, reliability, and total cost of ownership.
* Partner with Security to embed controls into platform designs, including identity and access management, encryption, network segmentation, and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Partner with FinOps to design cost-aware architectures, set tagging and accountability standards, and build cost efficiency into solutions from the start rather than as an afterthought.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture leaders to establish architecture patterns and best practices across the Enterprise.
* Define standards for observability and operational readiness so that solutions are monitored, supportable, and resilient in production.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to product teams, mentoring engineers and guiding them in adopting standardized cloud patterns and best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with at least 6 years in a cloud architecture role designing solutions on AWS and/or GCP.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of core cloud services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and data, with the ability to design solutions that are secure, resilient, and cost effective.
* Proven experience defining reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails that multiple teams adopt and reuse.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and version control (GitHub), including how to structure code for reuse across teams.
* Deep expertise in cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code approaches to governance.
* Proven ability to document, communicate, and govern complex designs, and to influence technical direction across multiple teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting across multiple cloud providers in a large enterprise spanning multiple business units and geographies.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tooling, and a track record of building cost efficiency into architectural decisions.
* Exposure to cloud governance frameworks such as AWS Control Tower or GCP Organization Policies, and to policy-as-code tooling.
* Professional certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction across large enterprise organizations.

**Benefits**
We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.
  
  

* Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
* Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
* Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

**Our commitment to you**
Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

title: Field Architect
description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud-native applications, and large-scale data infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team to ensure customers are successful through technical discovery, architecture design, proof-of-value execution, production onboarding, performance validation, and long-term expansion. Success in this role requires deep technical curiosity, hands-on architecture skills, strong communication, and the ability to connect AIStor’s capabilities to the data-intensive workloads that matter most to our customers.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Technical Architecture and Discovery: Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, application requirements, data architecture, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Define scalable AIStor architectures that map directly to those requirements.
* AI and Analytics Workload Design: Define and validate AIStor architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics platforms, data lakehouse environments, high-performance data pipelines, large object workloads, and modern application data services.
* Object Storage and S3 Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in object storage, S3-compatible architectures, distributed systems, metadata, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large-scale namespace design.

Customer Engagement & Advisory
  
  

* Customer Technical Advisor: Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, including infrastructure, platform, analytics, AI, security, application, and operations teams. Guide customers toward informed architecture decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.
* Proof-of-Value Execution: Lead technical evaluations, system configurations, performance testing, interoperability validation, and proof-of-value engagements that demonstrate AIStor’s value in real customer environments.
* Customer Success Beyond the Win: Partner with Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers move from evaluation to production and from initial deployment to broader adoption across additional workloads, teams, and use cases.

Ecosystem, Enablement & Field Operations
  
  

* Cloud-Native and Kubernetes Guidance: Provide technical leadership on Kubernetes, containers, automation, and cloud-native deployment patterns, including hybrid cloud, private cloud, public cloud, and edge infrastructure models.
* Solution Integration and Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with technology partners, reseller partners, and customer teams to support complete solutions involving analytics engines, AI platforms, Kubernetes distributions, data protection tools, identity systems, observability platforms, and public cloud services.
* Technical Presentations and Enablement: Build and deliver compelling architecture presentations, whiteboard sessions, demonstrations, best practices, workshops, and technical enablement sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* RFP, RFI, and Technical Response Support: Contribute to or lead technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, security reviews, architecture questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.

Product Intelligence & Market Expertise
  
  

* Product and Engineering Feedback: Advocate for customer requirements internally by capturing field feedback, competitive insights, workload patterns, integration needs, and enhancement opportunities. Work with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and improve customer outcomes.
* Competitive and Market Expertise: Stay current on object storage, data lakehouse, AI infrastructure, analytics, Kubernetes, cloud, and competitive storage trends. Help internal teams and customers understand where AIStor is differentiated.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Strong background in enterprise storage, object storage, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or high-performance data-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of object storage concepts and S3-compatible architectures; experience with HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, security models, replication, data protection, and scale-out system design is highly valuable.
* 10+ years of experience in a senior customer-facing technical role such as Field Architect, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
* Hands-on experience with Linux, networking, storage systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern data center infrastructure.
* Experience designing or supporting AI, machine learning, analytics, data lakehouse, or large-scale data pipeline environments.
* Familiarity with ecosystem technologies such as Databricks, Starburst, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI and analytics frameworks is a strong plus.
* Experience with public cloud and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, or private cloud platforms.
* Ability to conduct technical discovery, design architectures, build demonstrations, guide proof-of-value execution, analyze performance, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Comfortable working with heterogeneous enterprise environments involving compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and application teams.
* Strong verbal, written, whiteboarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customers, partners, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Strong customer-success orientation, intellectual curiosity, sense of ownership, and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support customers, partners, field events, and internal team activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
  
  
You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

**About The Team**
The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**About The Role**
Aon is seeking a talented and driven Enterprise Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture team in India. This role puts you at the center of where impactful Enterprise Architecture is shaped — defining the patterns, standards, and decisions that govern how Aon builds and evolves its application landscape at scale, globally.
  
  
This is a hands-on, high-impact position for an opinionated technologist who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution. * Define and enforce non-functional requirements (performance, resilience, observability, security, scalability) as first-class architecture concerns embedded across the SDLC.
* Invent new enterprise patterns with a 10x mindset — challenge the status quo and push for transformational rather than incremental architectural improvements.
* Reconcile technical architecture with business architecture, bridging the gap between engineering capabilities and strategic objectives.

**Enablement & Evangelism**

* Help application teams adopt enterprise architecture patterns through hands-on guidance, reviews, and mentoring.

**Governance & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Support architecture governance processes — including architecture reviews, design approvals, and standards enforcement.
* Shape and improve innovation and architecture-related processes in partnership with technology leadership.
* Deliver on defined annual goals and objectives, including those set by the Enterprise Architecture leadership.
* Partner with engineering, product, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure cohesive end-to-end architecture.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.
  
  
The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.
  
  
You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Reliability: achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* Area of Specialisation
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices
* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**
Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
  
  
Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
  
  
Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
  
  
Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
  
  
Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
  
  
Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.
  
  
**Skills**
Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
As OneTrust scales its platform and expands globally, our infrastructure must keep pace — growing more automated, more resilient, and more self-service for the engineering teams that depend on it. Today, infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment work is distributed across the R&D organization without a single accountable owner driving strategy, standards, and automation maturity end to end.
  
  
We're looking for a Director, Infrastructure Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for the infrastructure our products run on — from cloud architecture and CI/CD pipelines to deployment automation and platform reliability. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the technical direction, build a high-performing team of DevOps and infrastructure automation engineers, and give every engineer at OneTrust faster, safer, more reliable ways to ship.
  
  
**Your Mission**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment automation across R&D, aligning investment with product and platform growth.
* Lead, hire, and develop a team of DevOps engineers, infrastructure automation engineers, and deployment engineers, building a strong bench of technical talent across US and India.
* Drive infrastructure-as-code (IaC) adoption and standards (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to make environment provisioning repeatable, auditable, and self-service for product engineering teams.
* Own CI/CD pipeline architecture and tooling, reducing deployment friction and time-to-production while improving release reliability and rollback safety.
* Set the strategy for multi-cloud/hybrid infrastructure management, container orchestration, and platform scalability to support current and future product growth.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to embed security guardrails, access controls, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO) directly into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
* Own infrastructure reliability and observability — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on-call practices — in partnership with Engineering and SRE stakeholders.
* Lead cost optimization efforts across cloud spend, right-sizing infrastructure investment against usage and business need.
* Act as the primary point of escalation and decision-maker for infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment-related incidents and cross-team dependencies.
* Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership to represent infrastructure needs in roadmap planning and major technical decisions.
* Evaluate and select tooling and vendor partnerships that support the team's automation-first, self-service infrastructure vision.

**You Are**

* A builder who thinks in systems — you see infrastructure as a product that serves internal customers, not just a cost center to keep the lights on.
* An automation-first leader who instinctively looks to eliminate manual, repeatable work and replace it with reliable, self-service tooling.
* A calm, decisive operator under pressure — comfortable owning incident response and making fast, well-reasoned calls when systems are down.
* A people leader who invests in growing engineers' technical depth and career paths, not just managing their day-to-day output.
* A pragmatic communicator who can translate deep technical tradeoffs into business terms for non-technical stakeholders and executives.
* Security- and compliance-minded by default, treating guardrails as part of good infrastructure design rather than a separate workstream.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, willing to make and revisit decisions as the organization and its infrastructure needs evolve.

**Your Experience Includes**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or cloud operations, including 4+ years in a people leadership role.
* Proven experience building and leading DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.
* Deep hands-on background with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
* Strong track record architecting and scaling CI/CD pipelines and release automation for enterprise-grade, high-availability software products.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, zero-downtime migrations).
* Working knowledge of security, compliance, and regulatory frameworks relevant to SaaS infrastructure (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Experience managing distributed or globally-located engineering teams (US/India or similar) preferred.
* Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Security, and Product leadership to align infrastructure strategy with business priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: AI Architect
description:
Why Choose Bottomline?
  
  
Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Location**
India
  
  
**Reports To**
**Level**
Individual Contributor / Architect (8+ years experience)
  
  
**Team**
Enterprise Data Services (EDS)
  
  
**Contract**
Permanent, Full-Time
  
  
**Line Relationship**
Data Architect
  
  
**About The Team**
Enterprise Data Services (EDS) is responsible for Bottomline's Enterprise Data Warehouse, Enterprise Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Data Governance, and strategic data platforms.
  
  
Our mission is to transform business operations, products, and decision-making through trusted data and AI-powered capabilities. Our technology strategy is centred around Snowflake and its native AI ecosystem, including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, Snowpark, and enterprise data products such as Customer Cube.
  
  
We operate at the intersection of Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Analytics, Governance, and Platform Engineering, building the foundations that enable the organisation to become truly AI-first.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Enterprise AI & Data Architect to define and lead the future-state architecture for Bottomline's Data, Analytics, AI, and Cloud Platforms.
  
  
This role combines AI Architecture, Enterprise Data Architecture, Data Engineering Architecture, and Cloud Platform Architecture to ensure the organisation can scale trusted data products, AI-native solutions, and business-critical analytics on a secure, governed, resilient, and cost-effective foundation.
  
  
The Enterprise AI & Data Architect will report directly to the Senior Director of AI & Data Services and work closely with the existing Data Architect through a dotted-line relationship. Together, these roles will define and govern the enterprise architecture strategy for data, analytics, AI, integration, and cloud platforms.
  
  
While the Data Architect focuses on information architecture, data modelling, governance, and enterprise data standards, the Enterprise AI & Data Architect will focus on AI architecture, platform architecture, data engineering standards, cloud infrastructure, and the technical enablement of enterprise-scale AI solutions.
  
  
This role is both strategic and hands-on, requiring the ability to define long-term architecture roadmaps whilst also guiding engineering teams through the delivery of complex initiatives.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Enterprise AI Strategy & Architecture**

* Support the enterprise AI architecture roadmap.
* Develop reference architectures for Generative AI, Agentic AI, Predictive AI, and AI-powered analytics.
* Establish standards and design patterns for Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, and Cortex Analyst.
* Define architecture principles for AI platforms, reusable AI services, and enterprise AI products.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to Bottomline.
* Create architectural blueprints that enable scalable and governed AI adoption across the organisation.

**Data Platform & Data Engineering Architecture**

* Define architecture standards for the Enterprise Data Warehouse and strategic data products.
* Design scalable, AI-ready data architectures that support analytics, machine learning, and enterprise reporting.
* Establish patterns for batch, streaming, CDC, event-driven, and real-time data integration.
* Define standards for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, deployment, and operational support.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure solutions are performant, scalable, maintainable, and cost-efficient.
* Guide architecture for Customer Cube and other strategic data products.
* Drive adoption of modern DataOps, DevOps, and platform engineering practices.

**Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture**

* Define cloud architecture patterns supporting Snowflake, AI workloads, data pipelines, and analytics services.
* Establish standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), platform automation, and deployment frameworks.
* Design scalable and resilient architectures capable of supporting enterprise AI workloads.
* Define standards for observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and platform health management.
* Support infrastructure modernisation and platform optimisation initiatives.
* Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams to ensure enterprise-grade operational practices.

**Resilience, Disaster Recovery & Operational Readiness**

* Define architectural standards for disaster recovery, backup, resilience, and business continuity.
* Ensure critical data and AI platforms have documented and tested recovery capabilities.
* Guide architecture decisions related to high availability and system resilience.
* Support audit, risk, compliance, and security initiatives through robust architectural controls.
* Define operational readiness requirements for production AI and data services.

**AI Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks.
* Define standards for model evaluation, monitoring, explainability, fairness, and risk management.
* Create architectural guardrails for AI development and deployment.
* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Governance teams to ensure regulatory alignment.
* Drive adoption of responsible AI principles across all AI initiatives.

**Architecture Leadership & Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Data Architect to develop a unified enterprise data and AI architecture strategy.
* Participate in architecture governance forums and design reviews.
* Define and maintain architecture standards across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Analytics, and Platform Engineering.
* Mentor engineers and architects on best practices and emerging technologies.
* Review and approve solution architectures for major strategic initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership.

**Business & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Translate business strategy into executable technology roadmaps.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support organisational AI adoption and transformation initiatives.

**Requirements**
**Must Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Data Architecture, AI Architecture, Cloud Architecture, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience designing large-scale enterprise data platforms and modern cloud architectures.
* Deep understanding of Data Engineering, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning ecosystems.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and Python.
* Experience designing scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise systems.
* Experience defining architecture standards, governance processes, and technology roadmaps.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional technology initiatives.

**Strong Preference**

* Deep experience with Snowflake and associated platform services.
* Experience with Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, and Snowpark.
* Experience with Neo4J/native graph databases.
* Experience building AI-ready enterprise data platforms.
* Knowledge of Generative AI architectures, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, vector search, semantic layers, evaluation frameworks, and LLMOps.
* Experience with AWS cloud architecture and platform engineering.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code and automated deployment frameworks.
* Strong understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, and Information Security.

**Nice to Have**

* Fintech, Payments, Banking, or B2B SaaS experience.
* Snowflake certification(s).
* Cloud Architecture certification(s).
* Experience presenting architecture strategy to Executive Leadership Teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise AI transformation programmes.
* Knowledge of Data Mesh, Lakehouse, or modern distributed data architecture patterns.

**Our Technology Stack**
**Data & AI Platform**
Snowflake; Cortex AI; Cortex Agents; Cortex Search; Cortex Analyst; Snowpark; Dynamic Tables; Enterprise Data Warehouse
  
  
**Cloud & Infrastructure**
AWS; Infrastructure as Code; CI/CD Pipelines; Platform Automation; Monitoring & Observability Tooling
  
  
**Engineering**
Python; SQL; Git; DataOps; DevOps
  
  
**Analytics**
Power BI; Streamlit; Enterprise Semantic Models
  
  
**Why This Role Is Different**

* Shape the future of Bottomline's enterprise AI and data ecosystem.
* Own architecture across AI, Data, Analytics, Cloud, and Platform Engineering.
* Influence strategic technology and investment decisions.
* Build reusable enterprise capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Operate at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution.
* Work directly with senior leadership on high-impact initiatives.
* Drive the adoption of trusted, governed, and scalable AI solutions across the organisation.

**Your First 90 Days**
**Days 1-30: Understand**

* Review the current data, AI, analytics, and platform architecture landscape.
* Meet key stakeholders across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and Business teams.
* Assess strategic programmes including Customer Cube and enterprise AI initiatives.
* Identify architecture opportunities, gaps, and risks.

**Days 30-60: Define**

* Develop the enterprise AI and data architecture roadmap.
* Publish initial architecture principles, standards, and governance processes.
* Define target-state architectures for strategic AI and data platforms.
* Establish architecture review and approval processes.

**Days 60-90: Enable**

* Launch architecture governance forums.
* Support delivery teams with reference architectures and reusable patterns.
* Define platform engineering, infrastructure, and observability standards.
* Deliver initial architecture blueprints for strategic programmes.
* Present the enterprise AI and data architecture roadmap to senior leadership.

**Success Measures**
**After 12 Months, Success Would Include**

* Enterprise AI and Data Architecture adopted across strategic initiatives.
* Standardised architecture and engineering standards implemented across Data and AI teams.
* Customer Cube established as a strategic enterprise data product.
* Increased delivery velocity through reusable architecture patterns and shared services.
* Reduced technical debt and improved platform maintainability.
* Improved Snowflake performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Fully governed AI development lifecycle with measurable quality controls.
* Mature disaster recovery and resilience capabilities across critical platforms.
* Strong collaboration between Data Architecture, Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams.
* Demonstrable business outcomes delivered through scalable, trusted, and AI-enabled solutions.

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

title: Network Engineering - Architecture Focus
description:
**Job Description**
Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: [Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end-to-end across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture & Strategy
  
  

* Own the end-to-end target-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security & Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro-segmentation, and identity-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI & Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site-to-site, and remote-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end-to-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud & Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch & Site Modernization
* Architect branch network modernization for our global manufacturing and distribution footprint, including SD-WAN and Zero Trust Branch patterns.
* Improve user experience, application access, and operational simplicity at sites by reducing dependence on centralized backhaul.
* Define site reference designs that scale across geographies and plant types. Leadership & Influence
* Mentor staff and senior engineers; raise the technical bar across the networking discipline.
* Partner with vendors and strategic technology partners on evaluations, proofs of concept, and roadmap alignment.
* Translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, business-relevant recommendations for senior leadership.
* Maintain authoritative network documentation — reference designs, topology diagrams, and standards — that the broader engineering organization can rely on. What you’ll need to be successful Must-haves
* 10+ years of network engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in an architecture role at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining enterprise reference architectures and standards adopted across a multi-site organization.
* Deep expertise across enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF), segmentation, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless.
* Strong network security architecture experience with platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass.
* Strong Azure networking experience, including VNet design, peering, private connectivity, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Experience with DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), IP schema design, and core service resiliency.
* Proven experience architecting Zero Trust Branch, micro-segmentation, or identity aware network access.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to work across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments in a global, distributed enterprise.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues clearly for both engineering and non-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement capabilities at the Director and VP level. Nice-to-haves
* Experience in manufacturing, CPG, or other industrial environments with significant OT/IT convergence considerations.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCDE, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or TOGAF.
* Experience leading vendor evaluations and architecture proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with network automation, infrastructure as code, and enterprise observability platforms. Our Total Rewards philosophy Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values. Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future — we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Travel: Up to 10–15%, as needed.

Location(s)
  
  
Ahmedabad - Venus Stratum GCC
  
  
**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes**
