title: Senior AI Data Architect / Solution Engineer - India based
description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!"**
**Description And Requirements**
CareerArc Code
  
  
CA-JY
  
  
**Hybrid**
BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior AI Data Architect / Solution Engineer to design the architecture that delivers trusted data at scale — and to build the AI products that put it directly in the hands of the business. This is a hands-on, senior role for someone who can set the technical blueprint, build the agents on top of it, and act as the bridge between business needs and technical reality.
  
  
You will work closely with the Director and Enterprise Architect, serve as technical lead and advisor to the team, and partner with the Senior AI Data Engineer to take designs from blueprint to production. Success is measured by the trust, scale, and adoption of the data and AI products that ship — and by the business outcomes they unlock.
  
  
**Here is how, through this role, you will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**

* Architecture for Scale (Primary Focus) — Design the reference architecture and delivery patterns that take governed data from the semantic layer to every downstream consumer — dashboards, applications, and AI agents — reliably and at scale, with the build-vs-buy calls and standards that let the platform grow without painful rework.
* AI Data Products & Agents — Architect and build the Data Agent, the natural-language interface that lets business users query governed data without writing SQL; design agentic workflows with orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.
* Semantic Foundation — Co-design the semantic layer (HoneyDew / DBT) — the metrics, dimensions, and governed business meaning that power both analytics and AI — ensuring agents query governed definitions, not raw tables.
* Technical Leadership — Serve as technical lead and trusted advisor; set patterns, run design reviews, and mentor engineers, partnering with the Data Engineer to take designs to production.
* Business Translation — Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements; own stakeholder relationships and move fluently between executive framing and engineering detail.
* Ownership & Execution — Take features and subsystems end-to-end, proactively identifying gaps and driving work forward even when requirements are incomplete or evolving.

**To ensure you're set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**

* 8+ years across data architecture and hands-on engineering, including production systems that held up under real enterprise use.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep, hands-on experience designing and building on Snowflake and DBT.
* Proven experience designing and building LLM / agentic solutions — RAG, function / tool calling, orchestration (LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph), prompt engineering, and evaluation / observability.
* Deep understanding of the semantic layer as the architectural bridge between source data and business meaning — and why it is foundational to trustworthy AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and influence architecture decisions across teams.
* Strong communication and the ability to lead through execution in a fast-moving environment.

**Broad Technical Exposure (depth Not Required In All Areas)**

* Cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* CI/CD and modern engineering practices for data and AI systems.
* Containerization and distributed systems (Docker, Kubernetes, microservices).

**Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills:**

* HoneyDew or other universal/headless semantic layers (HoneyDew, Cube, AtScale, dbt Semantic Layer).

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

title: Director of Platform Engineering
description:
**Who are Evotix?**
===================

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Role purpose**
----------------

The Director of Platform Engineering is the single accountable owner for the platform and data engineering capabilities used across every product domain in the business. The role consolidates Platform Engineering and Data Platform under one senior leader, and runs those capabilities as internal products with named service expectations, a published roadmap, and a regular review cadence with Domain Directors. This is a new role, created to separate architectural authority from operational delivery. The Chief Architect sets technical direction; this role owns the delivery, reliability, and adoption of the shared capabilities that direction depends on. The two roles are peers.

**Reporting and scope**
-----------------------

* **Direct reports:** Platform Engineering Manager, Data Platform Lead. Indirect organisation of approximately 15 engineers at steady state.
* **Internal customers:** Three product domains (360, Assure and Learn) plus internal engineering and operations teams.
* **Peer relationships:** Chief Architect, Domain Directors, Product Directors, Head of Business Technology

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Run shared capabilities as products.** Define service expectations, roadmaps, and adoption metrics for Platform Engineering and Data Platform. Be the single named owner for operational performance: incident response, SLOs, capacity, cost-to-serve, and roadmap delivery.

**Earn the trust of Domain Directors.** Treat domain teams as customers. Establish a regular review cadence with each Domain Director. Where a shared capability is not fit for a domain's needs, lead the work to fix it rather than defending the status quo.

**Partner with the Chief Architect.** Translate architectural direction (multi-tenancy, AI paved roads, Technology Radar) into deliverable platform capabilities on a documented timeline. Surface implementation realities that should inform the architectural roadmap.

**Manage cloud cost.** Own the FinOps practice for the platform estate. Drive unit cost down without compromising reliability and give domain teams the visibility they need to manage their own consumption.

**Build the team.** Coach, develop, and where needed recruit the sub-function leads. Build a team that can operate the function without the Director being the bottleneck for every decision.

**What success looks like at twelve months**
--------------------------------------------

* Platform Engineering and Data Platform operate under published service expectations, with a regular review cadence with each Domain Director.
* Incident response, SLO attainment, and cloud unit cost are tracked, reported, and trending in the right direction.
* Platform compliance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and IRAP is generated as a by-product of normal operations rather than as a separate audit project.
* The two sub-function leads are operating as a coherent leadership team with clear ownership of their domains.

**Essential experience**
------------------------

* Five or more years of engineering leadership, with at least three years owning a platform, infrastructure, or shared services function at director level or above.
* Demonstrated experience running engineering capabilities as internal products, including setting service expectations, managing roadmaps, and being accountable for adoption.
* Track record in a multi-product SaaS environment, with credible experience of the trade-offs between centralised platform investment and domain team autonomy.
* Direct accountability for AWS cloud infrastructure at scale, including FinOps practices and unit cost management.
* Experience as the engineering owner for at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent regulated compliance regime.
* Track record of building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at managerial level.

**Desirable experience**
------------------------

* Exposure to data platform engineering, including the operational realities of running analytics and data pipelines as a shared capability.
* Experience in EHS, GRC, or another regulated B2B SaaS domain.
* Experience leading a transition from federated to centralised shared services, including the change management involved.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Comfortable with productive friction.** Architecture and delivery are inherently in tension. You see that tension as where the work gets done, not as a problem to be eliminated.
* **Customer mindset toward internal teams.** You earn adoption by being genuinely useful, not by mandate. You would rather change a shared capability than win an argument about it.
* **Operationally credible.** You can be in the detail of an incident or a roadmap commitment when the situation requires it, without making yourself the bottleneck for normal operations.
* **Direct.** You give and receive feedback clearly, and you are willing to disagree with peers in the room rather than after the meeting.

**Why join Evotix?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
* **Time to Recharge:** Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing. (AMER/EMEA)
* **Financial Future:** Generous tiered 401k plan that increases over time. (AMER)
* **Support for You:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
* **Team Culture:** Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**  
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!  
  
*Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.*

title: Public Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a **Public Cloud Solutions Architect** at Kyndryl, you act as the trusted advisor who turns business goals into cloud architecture that actually ships. You work closely with client executives, enterprise architects, security and compliance teams, governance, delivery, and our hyperscaler partners to keep everyone aligned on one technical direction. You get involved early, helping shape the strategy and the migration and modernization roadmap, and you stay through delivery so the architecture goes live on time, on budget, and secure by design.

  
  

**What you will do**  
This is a senior, client-facing role. **To the client, you are the go-to expert on public cloud.** You run discovery and assessment workshops, build the business case and total cost of ownership, and translate requirements into well-architected solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Increasingly, that means designing for AI and agentic AI as well, from the data and platform foundations through to the workloads themselves.

  

You will decide what Kyndryl will deliver, design the landing zones, networking, identity, data, and application patterns behind it, and lead the implementation teams to a clean result.
  
  
The role goes beyond any single engagement. You will mentor other architects and consultants, build reference architectures and reusable accelerators, and help set our delivery standards and governance. You will also help set Kyndryl apart through newer capabilities such as agentic AI, automation, and modernization accelerators that improve delivery quality, speed, and the value clients see. Kyndryl works across all the major public cloud platforms, so you will use what you know, keep building on it, and know when to bring in specialist SMEs.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**  
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

* 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise IT solutions, including at least 4+ years focused on public cloud architecture
* Deep, hands-on solutions architecture experience on at least one major hyperscaler (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) and working knowledge of a second; multi-cloud experience strongly preferred
* A track record leading cloud migration and modernization programs, covering assessment and discovery, the 7 Rs (rehost, replatform, refactor, and so on), landing zone and well-architected design, and large-scale workload migration
* Strong command of core cloud domains: compute, storage, networking (VPC/VNet, hybrid connectivity, DNS, load balancing), identity and access management, and cloud security and governance
* Solid grasp of cloud-native and modernization patterns: containers and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), microservices, serverless, and application refactoring
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI and agentic AI solutions on cloud, including the underlying data and platform foundations, the AI/ML services across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, and how generative and agentic workloads change architecture, security, and cost
* Experience applying AI to the delivery itself, using AI-led approaches, automation, and agentic tooling to speed up assessment, migration, modernization, and quality assurance
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, Ansible) and with CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Practical understanding of security by design, cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and well-architected or cloud adoption frameworks
* Proven consulting skills: running client workshops, building business cases and TCO/ROI models, presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level, and guiding delivery teams as the lead architect
At least one current associate- or professional-level cloud certification (for example, AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect)  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Professional- or expert-tier and multi-cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience in a consulting, professional services, or systems integrator setting delivering cloud work for enterprise clients
* Familiarity with hybrid and on-premises-to-cloud platforms (VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, AWS Outposts, Azure Stack/Arc, Google Distributed Cloud)
* Deeper specialization in agentic AI, such as multi-agent systems, agent orchestration and governance (AgentOps), retrieval-augmented generation, and integrating large language models into enterprise workflows and platforms
* Experience mentoring architects and contributing reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards
* Industry or regulated-environment experience (financial services, public sector, healthcare), including data sovereignty and compliance considerations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. At **HPE Networking**, the Digital Experience & Automation (DEA) team is transforming how customers and partners engage with support and services through modern digital platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and data-driven experiences.

A cornerstone of this strategy is the HPE Networking Support Portal (HPE Networking | Enterprise), HPE Networking's primary digital support platform. The portal provides customers and partners with a unified experience for case management, online RMA processing, asset and contract management, entitlement visibility, license management, software downloads, technical documentation, notifications, AI-assisted support, and digital self-service capabilities.

We are focused on delivering intelligent, scalable, and self-service-first experiences that simplify customer journeys, improve operational efficiency, and drive measurable business value.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced **Digital Experience Architect** to define and evolve end-to-end customer and partner support experiences across HPE Networking's digital ecosystem.

As the domain architect for digital customer support portal, you will be responsible for customer journey design, workflow architecture, platform integration, and experience optimization. You will identify opportunities to simplify customer interactions, eliminate process redundancies, increase self-service adoption, and leverage AI, analytics, and automation to create seamless omnichannel experiences.

Working across portals, knowledge platforms, entitlement systems, identity services, analytics platforms, and AI-powered solutions, you will help shape the future of digital support for HPE Networking customers and partners.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design future-state workflows for case management, case lifecycle management, RMA, onboarding, entitlement management, licensing, asset visibility, software delivery, knowledge consumption, and support services.
* Develop service blueprints, capability maps, process architectures, and experience standards that align customer needs with business objectives.
* Identify friction points, process inefficiencies, and redundancies across customer and operational workflows, and define scalable solutions to address them.
* Architect omnichannel engagement models spanning portals, virtual assistants, chat, notifications, knowledge platforms, and assisted support channels.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled experiences including intelligent search, agentic AI, conversational AI, guided troubleshooting, digital assistants, and recommendation engines.
* Leverage customer insights, behavioral analytics, and operational metrics to improve digital adoption, self-service effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
* Partner with Support, Services, Engineering, UX, Knowledge Management, Security, and Business stakeholders to deliver integrated digital experiences.
* Support portal modernization, platform consolidation, and digital transformation initiatives.

**What You Need To Bring:**

* 10-15 years of experience in Digital Experience Architecture, Service Design, Customer Experience, Business Architecture, Support Transformation, or related disciplines.
* Proven experience designing and optimizing enterprise customer-facing support, services, or self-service experiences.
* Expertise in customer journey mapping, service blueprinting, workflow architecture, business process optimization, and digital transformation.
* Experience architecting, building, or modernizing enterprise customer portals, partner portals, and self-service ecosystems supporting capabilities such as case management, RMA, entitlement management, asset management, licensing, software delivery, technical documentation, notifications, and AI-assisted support.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, service delivery, knowledge management, onboarding, entitlement management, and digital engagement models.
* Experience leveraging analytics and customer insights to drive measurable experience improvements.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.

**Technical Expertise**

**Digital Experience Platforms**

* Enterprise customer portals, partner portals, self-service platforms, and omnichannel support ecosystems.
* Case Management, Case Lifecycle Management, Online RMA, Asset & Contract Management, Entitlement Management, License Management, Software Delivery, Technical Documentation, Customer Notifications, and Self-Service Experiences.
* Enterprise search, knowledge management, and content discovery platforms, including Coveo or similar solutions.

* Agentic AI, Generative AI, Conversational AI, Intelligent Search, Recommendation Engines, Guided Troubleshooting, Digital Assistants, and Personalized Support Experiences. The HPE Networking Support Portal includes AI-assisted support and virtual assistant capabilities.

**Cloud, Integration & Security**

* Understanding of AWS technologies including API Gateway, Lambda, ECS/EKS, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, Cognito, DynamoDB, Aurora, S3, CloudFront, OpenSearch, Bedrock, SageMaker, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* CRM and support ecosystems including Salesforce and Service Cloud.

description:

As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. **Job Description**

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

As a member of our GCC team, you will play a critical role in building our capabilities and contributing to a culture of curiosity and excellence. The Associate Domain Architect / Solutions Architect supports the evolution of Commercial technology capabilities by partnering with domain architect, business stakeholders, product owners, engineering teams, enterprise architects, and vendors to design scalable, compliant, and business-aligned solutions.

This role serves as a bridge between business strategy, domain architecture, and solution delivery, ensuring technology investments align with enterprise standards, capability roadmaps, and target-state architecture. The Associate Domain Architect contributes to architecture governance, technology planning, application portfolio management, and modernization initiatives across Commercial IT, Data & Analytics, and AI-enabled platforms.

Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

  

Key Responsibilities:

  

Architecture & Solution Delivery

* Design, document, and maintain solution architectures for business initiatives, technology programs, and platform enhancements.

* Translate business capabilities and requirements into scalable application, integration, data, and technology architectures.

* Develop and maintain current-state and future-state architecture artifacts, including capability models, system landscapes, integration diagrams, and target-state roadmaps.

* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, compliance requirements, and technology strategies.

* Participate in architecture reviews and provide recommendations to improve scalability, maintainability, interoperability, and business value.

Business, Domain & Portfolio Partnership

* Partner with Domain Architects, capability leads, product owners, and delivery teams to understand business objectives, strategic priorities, and technology needs.

* Support the development and execution of domain technology roadmaps and capability modernization plans.

* Maintain domain capability maps, application portfolios, and system inventories.

* Identify opportunities for application rationalization, cloud adoption, AI enablement, integration modernization, and portfolio optimization.

* Contribute to capability maturity assessments, technology evaluations, and strategic planning activities.

Architecture Governance & Technology Strategy

* Participate in architecture governance processes, including architecture assessments, solution reviews, and review board submissions.

* Support project teams in preparing architecture documentation and obtaining required approvals.

* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, quality, and regulatory standards throughout the solution lifecycle.

* Assist with risk identification, mitigation planning, and architectural decision-making.

* Evaluate emerging technologies, vendor solutions, and platform roadmaps to provide architecture recommendations aligned with business strategy and long-term sustainability.

  

Required Qualifications:

  

Education:

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Experience:

* 15+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Enterprise Applications, or related IT disciplines.

* Experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions across applications, integrations, cloud platforms, or data ecosystems.

* Experience documenting business capabilities, system architectures, technology roadmaps, and architectural decisions.

* Experience working within Agile and/or product-based delivery models.

Technical Skills

* Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-native architecture principles (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Knowledge of application, integration, API, event-driven, and data architecture patterns.

* Knowledge of security architecture (SSO, RBAC, Encryption at rest and in-transit etc)

Professional Skills:

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking capabilities.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Ability to influence decisions across business and technical teams without direct authority.

* Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical solution delivery.

  

Preferred Qualifications:

  

Domain & Industry Experience:

  

* Experience within Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Commercial Operations, Patient Services, Medical Affairs, or Data & Analytics organizations.

* Experience supporting Commercial business capabilities such as CRM, Sales Operations, Omnichannel Marketing, Content Management, Customer Engagement, Field Enablement

* Experience working with AI/ML, data platforms, customer data ecosystems, or emerging digital technologies.

title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer – Storage / Backup
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Storage/Backup builds and runs Storage and Backup Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as a Storage/Backup Engineer and/or Architect
* Deep understanding of Storage systems, data protection software and cloud native storage services undefined
* Understanding of modern storage and backup technologies (Caching Services, Object Storage, distributed storage, SDS, Continuous Data Protection, Storage-as-a-service, Backup-as-a-service) undefined
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.  

  

**Desirable:**

* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* undefined
* Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Storage and Backup Technologies (SAN, Netapp OnTap, Avamar)
* undefined
* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.
* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Backup Servers, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Object Storage, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Storage Services, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Oracle APEX Operations Technical Leader
description:
**Oracle APEX Operations Technical Leader**

**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**

**Join our team!**

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

**Partner with the best**

We operate at the heart of the digital transformation of our business. From Digital Engineering to enabling employee success, the Digital Technology team is driven to provide the best products and services. We collaborate with teams to solve complex technical challenges and design future innovations.

As a **Digital Technology Senior Specialist**, you will also be responsible for:

* Owning the operational health, reliability, security, performance, and lifecycle of a portfolio of enterprise Oracle APEX applications.
* Leading AppOps, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices and coordinating internal teams and suppliers across development, support, infrastructure, database, cloud, and cybersecurity.
* Leading incident management and major-incident response, including prioritization, service restoration, stakeholder communication, escalation, and post-incident review.
* Owning problem management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, knowledge management, and initiatives that reduce recurring incidents.
* Governing change and release management through impact and risk assessment, implementation planning, testing evidence, approvals, deployment coordination, rollback readiness, and post-implementation validation.
* Defining and monitoring service levels and operational KPIs, including availability, performance, incident volume, resolution time, change success, backlog, vulnerability remediation, and operational risk.
* Driving CI/CD, source control, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, and repeatable release practices for Oracle APEX solutions.
* Embedding security throughout the application lifecycle through secure coding, access controls, vulnerability management, dependency governance, security testing, and remediation tracking.
* Acting as the technical authority for Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle REST Data Services, integrations, and related cloud technologies.
* Leading complex troubleshooting, performance tuning, capacity planning, technology upgrades, and obsolescence remediation with minimum business disruption.
* Partnering with technical leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, service-management teams, and governance functions to prioritize operational improvements and technical investments.
* Mentoring engineers, setting clear technical and operational expectations, and fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and automation.
* Representing the application portfolio in change advisory boards, architecture reviews, service reviews, risk forums, audits, and cross-functional technology initiatives.

**Fuel your passion!**

To be successful in this role you will:

* Have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Have significant experience supporting and technically leading enterprise applications, including at least five years working with Oracle APEX and Oracle Database technologies.
* Have proven ownership of production application operations in a complex enterprise environment, including incident, problem, change, release, and service-level management.
* Demonstrate the ability to lead major incidents, coordinate cross-functional technical teams, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Have advanced proficiency in Oracle APEX, SQL, and PL/SQL, including application architecture, database object design, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and scalable solution design.
* Have strong knowledge of Oracle APEX security, including authentication, authorization, role-based access control, session protection, secure coding, data protection, and API security.
* Have experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment promotion, release governance, and rollback planning.
* Have practical DevSecOps experience, including vulnerability assessment, secure development controls, patching, dependency management, security remediation, and risk-based prioritization.
* Have experience establishing monitoring, logging, alerting, runbooks, service KPIs, operational dashboards, support models, and disaster-recovery procedures.
* Have experience integrating Oracle APEX applications with enterprise systems through REST APIs, SOAP services, Oracle REST Data Services, Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle API gateway or similar technologies.
* Have working knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or comparable cloud platforms and their application, database, identity, networking, monitoring, and security services.
* Have experience defining technical standards, conducting architecture and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and improving engineering and operational practices across an application portfolio.

* Demonstrate sound judgment in technology decisions through due diligence, risk assessment, business-impact evaluation, and lifecycle planning.
* Have strong analytical, leadership, collaboration, supplier-management, and stakeholder-communication skills, with fluency in English.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service-management experience is preferred.

**Work in a way that works for you**

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

**Working with us**

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. description:

**Description -**

We are looking for a **Senior data architect / Techno functional Integration specialist** who will be responsible for leading the integration architecture, design, development, and implementation of supply chain planning solutions, including Forecasting, supply planning, inventory optimization and available to promise. You will work closely with senior leadership, business stakeholders, and external partners to **align integration of IT strategy with the business goals and deliver innovative, scalable, secure, integrated solutions** . You will also collaborate with a team of highly talented IT professionals to create system, data and process architectural blueprints leveraging latest technologies ensuring adherence to enterprise standards. Exposure to AI tools is a must and direct experience building AI solutions for data management is preferred.

  

**Detailed job description / key responsibilities:**

  

* **Strategy and vision** : Define and execute data / integration strategy roadmap for supply chain planning, ensuring alignment with the business strategy and priorities.
* **Solution delivery** : Lead Data / Integration workstream for all supply chain planning programs with SAP Embedded BW / Integrated business planner (IBP) as the core platform, managing end-to-end project lifecycle, from scoping and planning to testing and deployment. **Strong techno functional knowledge of Master and transaction data needed for planning is MANDATORY** .
* Design integration strategies, data maps while minimizing data footprints across landscape.
* **Integration leadership** : Manage integration of SAP embedded BW / SAP business technology platform (BTP), cloud platform integration for data services (CI-DS) with other systems and applications, such as SAP S4 HANA, SAP IBP and related third-party tools.

* Manage a team of IT professionals, providing guidance, coaching, and feedback, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
* **Stakeholder management** : Establish and maintain effective relationships with senior leadership, business stakeholders, and external partners, acting as a trusted advisor and a key point of contact for IT-related matters.
Identify, evaluate, and recommend competitive and/or new alternative data integration technologies and products which further the enterprise application and data strategy.  

**Skills / Qualifications:**

  

* Extensive **domain knowledge of supply chain planning with deep technical expertise** and strong **knowledge of master and transaction data.**
* Minimum 15-18 years of IT experience, with at least **10 years in a techno functional leadership role and comprehensive understanding of AI tools / solutions, relevant to data management** .
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale and complex cross function IT projects, preferably in the supply chain planning domain.
* **Extensive experience with SAP embedded BW / BTP / CI-DS, including architecture, configuration, customization, integration, testing, and deployment** . Candidate must be ‘hands on’ for consideration.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Functional Safety Architect - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

Velaura is designing the compute silicon that powers robots, autonomous systems, and intelligent machines that operate in the physical world—where a fault in the chip can translate directly into unsafe behavior. As the Functional Safety Architect for our Physical AI System-on-Chip (SoC), you will own the functional safety architecture of our silicon: defining how our chips detect, contain, and respond to faults so that the systems they drive remain safe.

This is a foundational, cross-cutting role spanning silicon, firmware, platform software, and product teams. You will establish Velaura’s functional safety strategy and lifecycle from the earliest architecture phase through tape-out, qualification, and production, making the case, in hardware and in evidence, that Velaura silicon can be trusted in safety-critical Physical AI applications.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the SoC functional safety architecture: define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and the hardware/software fault-handling strategy across Velaura’s Physical AI silicon roadmap.
* Lead safety analyses—hazard analysis and risk assessment, DFMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and dependent-failure/common-cause analysis—and derive the quantitative safety metrics required by the target standard (SPFM, LFM, and PMHF for ISO 26262 ASIL; SFF, diagnostic coverage, HFT, and PFH/PFD for IEC 61508 SIL), including diagnostic-coverage targets for the SoC and its subsystems.
* Define safety mechanisms for compute, AI/NPU, memory, and interconnect including error detection and correction, lockstep, BIST, and safe-state handling, and specify the assumptions of use for the safety element out of context (SEooC).
* Partner with silicon design, firmware, safety, and platform software teams to embed safety requirements into the RTL, boot flow, and SDK, and to review implementations against the safety concept.
* Own the safety case and work products across the safety lifecycle, coordinating with assessors and customers to support certification and audits.
* Establish functional safety processes, standards, and design practices; mentor engineers and raise the safety-engineering bar across the organization.
* Manage the interface between functional safety and adjacent disciplines—cybersecurity, reliability, and SOTIF—so that safety concerns are addressed holistically.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 10+ years in functional safety or safety-critical hardware engineering, with significant experience taking silicon or embedded platforms through a full safety lifecycle.
* Deep expertise with functional safety standards across frameworks—ISO 26262 (including part 11 for semiconductors) up to ASIL D and IEC 61508 up to SIL 3—and their application to SoC development, including the architectural constraints, hardware metrics, and systematic-capability requirements each imposes.
* Hands-on experience leading safety analyses (HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA, DFA) and computing hardware architectural metrics (SPFM, LFM, PMHF).
* Strong command of hardware safety mechanisms—ECC, lockstep, BIST, redundancy, and safe-state design—and of the interface between RTL/silicon design, firmware, and low-level platform software.
* Proven ability to build and defend a safety case and to drive safety requirements across multi-disciplinary teams from architecture through production.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing technical direction and mentoring engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with functional safety for AI/ML accelerators or NPUs, and with SOTIF (ISO 21448) for autonomous and perception systems.
* Familiarity with robotics, automotive, industrial, or other safety-critical domains, and with adjacent standards such as ISO/SAE 21434 (cybersecurity) or IEC 61508 derivatives.
* Certification such as a recognized Functional Safety Engineer credential, and experience interfacing directly with certification bodies or assessors.
* Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth semiconductor or hardware company, building safety functions and processes from the ground up.
* Master’s or Ph.D in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company’s long-term success.

description:
**Role:** Manager, Infrastructure, Platform, & Cloud Engineering

**Location:** Bangalore

**Full/ Part-time:** Full Time

  

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**About the role:**

Builds and operates infrastructure and cloud environments to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. Manages services, costs, and architecture to support evolving business needs.

Job Description: Senior Cloud Architect - P5

### **Role Description**

The Senior Cloud Architect sets and evolves the architectural direction for Carrier’s cloud platform across AWS, GCP, and Azure. This role works horizontally across our product portfolio to ensure we build solutions that are consistently secure, resilient, and cost effective. The architect defines reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails, then partners with Product Leads, Security, FinOps, and customer teams to put them into practice through Infrastructure as Code and automation. The result is a coherent, well-governed cloud foundation that product teams can build on with confidence.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve reference architectures and design patterns across AWS, GCP, and Azure covering compute, storage, networking, identity, and data services that product teams reuse.
* Establish architectural standards and guardrails for security, resilience, and cost efficiency, and ensure they are applied consistently across the product portfolio.
* Translate architectural decisions into Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines so designs are repeatable, versioned, and easy to adopt.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction on design trade-offs, with a focus on security posture, reliability, and total cost of ownership.
* Partner with Security to embed controls into platform designs, including identity and access management, encryption, network segmentation, and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Partner with FinOps to design cost-aware architectures, set tagging and accountability standards, and build cost efficiency into solutions from the start rather than as an afterthought.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture leaders to establish architecture patterns and best practices across the Enterprise.
* Define standards for observability and operational readiness so that solutions are monitored, supportable, and resilient in production.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to product teams, mentoring engineers and guiding them in adopting standardized cloud patterns and best practices.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with at least 6 years in a cloud architecture role designing solutions on AWS and/or GCP.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of core cloud services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and data, with the ability to design solutions that are secure, resilient, and cost effective.
* Proven experience defining reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails that multiple teams adopt and reuse.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and version control (GitHub), including how to structure code for reuse across teams.
* Deep expertise in cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code approaches to governance.
* Proven ability to document, communicate, and govern complex designs, and to influence technical direction across multiple teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting across multiple cloud providers in a large enterprise spanning multiple business units and geographies.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tooling, and a track record of building cost efficiency into architectural decisions.
* Exposure to cloud governance frameworks such as AWS Control Tower or GCP Organization Policies, and to policy-as-code tooling.
* Professional certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction across large enterprise organizations.

**Benefits**

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

* Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
* Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
* Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

**Our commitment to you**

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. title: Security Architect
description:
**WirelessCar’s Journey**

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

**We are looking for** Security Architect with 15+ years’ experience to help us build secure, resilient and trusted connected services by making security an integral part of architecture and delivery.

As a Security Architect, you will help define, evolve and govern the security architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle - from early business and design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution.

You will work closely with development teams, solution architects, product stakeholders and cybersecurity colleagues to translate security requirements, risks and regulatory obligations into practical, scalable and cost-effective architectural decisions.

**Your Impact**

* Define and maintain security architecture for assigned systems, solutions and deliveries.
* Ensure security architecture aligns with WirelessCar security strategy, policies, standards, architectural principles and risk appetite.
* Translate security requirements, risks and relevant regulatory obligations into concrete architecture patterns, controls and design decisions. Communicate security decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Review and approve security-relevant architecture designs and changes within your assigned scope.
* Embed security-by-design and privacy-by-design throughout the system and solution lifecycle.
* Guide Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Product Owners and delivery stakeholders in secure architecture decisions.
* Lead or contribute to threat modelling, security risk assessments, architecture reviews and design validation activities.
* Identify, prioritize and escalate architecture risks and deviations, and coordinate practical remediation actions.
* Monitor emerging threats, technologies and architecture patterns relevant to WirelessCar products, platforms and the automotive industry.
* Initiate and lead proof-of-concepts and evaluations of new security technologies and architecture approaches.
* Contribute actively to a culture of continuous learning, shared standards and secure engineering.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders and manage their expectations and collaborate with solution architect, delivery manager in achieving the goals.

**We believe that you bring**  
You are a technically experienced and pragmatic security professional who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.

You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You can balance risk, cost, complexity and delivery needs, explain why a security decision makes sense, listen to different perspectives and help teams reach a good solution.

You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and architects, and you see security architecture as something developed together with delivery teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience in security architecture, system architecture or cybersecurity roles across cloud-based, distributed or platform-oriented environments.
* An understanding of security and compliance frameworks relevant to the role, such as UNECE R155 ISO/SAE27001; TISAX & ISO27001 etc.
* Experience communicating technical security concepts, decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working collaboratively across engineering, architecture, product, governance, risk, compliance and operations teams in complex development environments.
* Experience securing AWS and/or Azure cloud-native environments, including containers, Kubernetes, APIs, identity, network and data protection patterns.

  
**How You Work**

* You act with ownership, integrity and curiosity, balancing business enablement with robust security design.
* You take accountability for your architecture scope and make clear, risk-based decisions within established governance.

**Practical Information**

* Work Location: Bangalore,India.
* Standard working hours, with collaboration across globally distributed teams.
* Occasional travel may be required depending on delivery and customer needs.

At WirelessCar we believe in a Hybrid Remote work setup

**To join our journey**  
WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

* Our company language is English so please write your application in English.
