title: Senior Network Architect
description:
**Responsibilities**
--------------------

We are looking for an experienced Network Architect who can take ownership of designing and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise solutions. This role focuses on architecture, design, and technical leadership, working closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into practical and efficient technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design end-to-end enterprise network and infrastructure solutions across LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, Security and Wireless domains

* Develop clear and structured High-Level Designs (HLD) and Low-Level Designs (LLD)

* Lead network transformation, migration, integration, and modernization initiatives

* Ensure all designs align with organizational standards for scalability, performance, and security & Compliance standard

* Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle and guide engineering teams

**Profile required**
--------------------

Security & Multi-Vendor Expertise

* Design secure network architectures using multi-vendor technologies

* Work extensively with firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point)

* Implement proxy and secure web gateway solutions

* Design and support VPN solutions including remote access and site-to-site connectivity

* Hands-on experience with F5 and Citrix ADC (load balancing and traffic management)

* Apply security principles such as segmentation and Zero Trust where applicable

Collaboration & Technical Engagement

* Engage with stakeholders to understand and refine technical requirements

* Conduct design discussions, workshops, and architecture reviews

* Work closely with delivery and operations teams to ensure successful implementation

* Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical designs

Documentation & Governance

* Maintain high-quality architecture and design documentation

* Standardize design approaches and ensure governance compliance

* Prepare implementation plans and technical guidelines

* Keep documentation well-structured and easily accessible

Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Drive automation initiatives within the network domain

* Encourage adoption of Infrastructure-as-Code practices

* Improve provisioning and configuration processes through automation

* Explore new tools and technologies for operational efficiency

Required Experience & Skills

* 15+ years of experience in networking and infrastructure

* Proven track record in architect-level roles

* Strong exposure to real-world, production environments

* Deep expertise in Cisco Routing & Switching, SD-WAN, and ACI, Security

* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN design, and network protocols BGP & OSPF

Security & Infrastructure Knowledge

* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise security solutions

* Experience with AWS and/or Azure networking

* Understanding of hybrid cloud architectures

* Knowledge of core services like DNS, DHCP, and Active Directory

Design & Automation Capability

* Strong documentation skills including HLD and LLD

* Experience handling transformation and migration programs

* Basic to intermediate exposure to automation tools such as Python or Ansible

* Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs

Nice to Have

* Exposure to multi-vendor ecosystems such as Aruba or Juniper

* Experience in enterprise wireless design

* Understanding of modern security frameworks like SASE or Zero Trust

* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools

Certifications

* CCNP or CCIE (preferred)

* Firewall certifications (Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.)

* F5 or Citrix ADC certifications

* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure)

**Why join us**
---------------

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

**Business insight**
--------------------

At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious. Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating, and taking action are part of our DNA. If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!

Still hesitating?
  
You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.

We are committed to support accelerating our Group’s ESG strategy by implementing ESG principles in all our activities and policies. They are translated in our business activity (ESG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection.

**Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------

We are an **equal opportunities employer** and we are proud to make diversity a strength for our company. Societe Generale is committed to recognizing and **promoting all talents** , regardless of their beliefs, age, disability, parental status, ethnic origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, membership of a political, religious, trade union or minority organisation, or any other characteristic that could be subject to discrimination.

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Prompt engineering.
* Embeddings and semantic search.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Vector databases.
* Fine-tuning or adaptation of foundation models.
* AI agents and tool/function calling.
* LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Cloud & MLOps

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform

Knowledge of:

* Docker and containerization.
* CI/CD.
* Model deployment and monitoring.
* ML pipelines.
* MLOps practices.
* Kubernetes or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 5–10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on

experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.

* Proven experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions in real-world or

enterprise environments.

* Experience taking AI/ML models from experimentation/prototype stage through

production deployment is highly desirable.

* Candidates should demonstrate strong practical problem-solving ability rather than

purely academic or theoretical knowledge.

* Experience working in cross-functional or distributed technology teams is

preferred.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering,

Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

* Equivalent professional experience and strong technical expertise may also be

considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:

* Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
* Enterprise AI platforms.
* Azure AI / AWS AI / Google Cloud AI services.
* MLOps and production ML systems.
* NLP and conversational AI.
* Computer vision.
* AI-powered automation.
* Predictive analytics.
* Big Data technologies.
* API development and microservices.
* .NET/Java/Python-based enterprise application integration.
* Experience working with international clients or multinational organizations.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI

solutions.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multicultural team.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging AI technologies.
* Strong attention to quality, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Location & Mobility

**Work Location: Malaysia**

Candidate Source: India

Candidates currently based in India who are willing to relocate to Malaysia will be

considered.

International candidates with relevant experience and the ability to work from Malaysia

may also be considered based on project and employment requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working with multicultural and geographically

distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering capability.
* Experience solving complex real-world problems using AI/ML.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Good understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle.
* Practical experience with modern AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business

stakeholders.

Candidates with 5–10 years of experience who have progressed from hands-on AI/ML

development into senior-level technical ownership are especially encouraged to

apply.

Engagement Opportunity

The final role title, responsibilities, technology stack, and seniority will be aligned with the

candidate’s experience, technical specialization, and project requirements.

Potential positions may include:

* Senior AI/ML Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* AI Engineer
* Senior Data Scientist
* Applied AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* LLM Engineer
* AI/ML Technical Specialist
* AI/ML Architect

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Total years of experience.
* Relevant AI/ML experience.
* Current location in India.
* Current/expected compensation.
* Notice period/availability.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.
* Summary of key AI/ML projects handled.
* Details of relevant technical skills, frameworks, cloud platforms, and AI/ML

technologies.

* GitHub, portfolio, publications, or project links, where applicable.

Equal Opportunity

We encourage applications from qualified AI/ML professionals with diverse technical

backgrounds and industry experience. Selection will be based on relevant skills,

experience, technical capability, and suitability for the assigned project and role.

Pay: ₹409,194.83 - ₹1,694,864.16 per year

Work Location: Remote

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**Why Join Us**

* A unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a newly formed global healthcare innovator.
* High visibility to senior executives.
* Modernization initiatives underway (SAP S/4, cloud migration, data platform modernization, AI transformation).
* Ability to influence enterprise operating models and standards across a global organization.
Chance to mature an EA practice from the ground up.  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

The IT Enterprise Architect is a senior individual contributor role in the Global IT organization, based in India, with significant enterprise influence and visibility. This role serves as a visible change agent that drives business and technology innovation and alignment across Solventum’s global enterprise. The role is expected to operate as a strategic leader within the federated Enterprise Architecture team, drive technology asset management as a strategic imperative, own ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes and tooling, and help deliver a unified 3-year enterprise technology roadmap that reduces duplication, increases organizational transparency and agility, and accelerates business growth and transformation. Over time, this role may expand into formal people leadership as the Enterprise Architecture capability matures in India.

This role facilitates EA team activities including defining, documenting, and governing the enterprise IT architecture. The Enterprise Architect leads architecture consulting efforts to investigate and align technology solutions with business strategies, evaluates new and emerging technologies, creates architectural blueprints and target-state definitions, and assures technology solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned to long-term enterprise architecture direction. The Architect also leads through influence in Architecture Review Board activities that shape technology innovation, govern technology adoption globally, and drive consistent architecture definition across technology domains.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* **Architecture Governance:** Coordinate, create, publish, and measure adoption of architectural artifacts, including standards, policies, principles, reference architectures, and target-state definitions across technology domains and technology asset classes.

* **Architecture Reviews:** Facilitate Architecture Review Board activities ensuring responsive processes, rightsizing architecture reviews, and strengthening engagement of technical teams, business leaders, and program/project managers.

* **Technology Asset Management Leadership:** Lead technology asset management as a strategic imperative by establishing governance, lifecycle standards, CMDB data quality, ownership models, and decision processes that improve visibility, reduce risk, and enable rationalization across Solventum’s technology portfolio.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management Ownership:** Own and continuously improve ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes, data standards, workflows, reporting, and tooling adoption to ensure accurate application inventory, business capability alignment, lifecycle status, technology risk visibility, and actionable portfolio insights.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Technology Architecture Definition:** Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures for enterprise technology assets including applications, data and integrations, infrastructure, security systems, and shared platforms. Establish architecture patterns, principles, and roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy and create an integrated, scalable technology landscape.
* undefined
* **Technology Lifecycle Management:** Conduct research, assess and evangelize new technologies where appropriate, and drive lifecycle management for implemented technologies. Partner with business, product, platform, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams to guide modernization, standardization, consolidation, retirement, and investment decisions.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Delivery Leadership:** Lead architecture delivery through influence by coordinating architects, platform teams, and cross-functional stakeholders in the creation and publication of detailed architectural artifacts and technical solutions. As the capability matures, this role may expand to include formal people leadership responsibilities for architects or architecture delivery teams.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher AND ten (10) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

OR

* High School Diploma/GED AND fourteen (14) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following skills and experiences are also required:

* Enterprise Architecture experience, which includes business, application, data, technology, and security architecture domains, with demonstrated ability to define architecture direction and translate strategy into actionable roadmaps.

* Architecture experience managing architecture review boards, conducting architecture reviews, administering technology governance and portfolio management practices, and driving technology innovation and emerging and AI technology adoption.

* Agile and/or waterfall project management experience

* Experience with one or more of the following technologies or platforms: ServiceNow CMDB and Application Portfolio Management, SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce.com, SAP BTP/Datasphere, MuleSoft, Snowflake, AWS and Azure Cloud, Zscaler, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Copilot.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Technology Governance Expertise:** Proven ability to design and govern end-to-end target states, roadmaps, and capability models that align strategy to execution.

* **Technology Architecture and Asset Management Expertise:** Expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman), modeling standards, and modern architecture practices including cloud-native, event-driven, microservices, API-first, agentic operating models, and data-centric architectures.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow APM Process Ownership:** Experience managing technology lifecycles and architecture portfolios using platforms such as ServiceNow CMDB, Application Portfolio Management (APM), and related governance and observability solutions.
* undefined
* **Global Collaboration from India:** Ability to lead globally distributed architecture, platform, and business stakeholders from India, including working effectively across time zones, influencing teams without direct authority, and building credibility as a senior individual contributor.

* Written and verbal communication skills and ability to evangelize and translate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

* Problem solving and analytical abilities to assess current IT landscape, identify gaps, and develop optimal solutions.

* Leadership skills to influence decision-making, guide architecture delivery, mentor others, and demonstrate readiness to expand into formal people leadership as the organization’s architecture capability grows.

* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Relevant certifications (e.g. TOGAF, AWS/Azure Architect, CISSP/CCSP, ITIL).  



**Work location:** Remote or Hybrid, aligned to Solventum India business needs

**Travel:** May include up to 15%

**Relocation Assistance:** May be authorized, based on Solventum India policy and business needs

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.
* Production discipline — testing in a lab tenant first, ring-based release, blast-radius awareness, and the habit of asking "what does this do to 50,000 people" before pressing apply.
* Clear technical writing — runbooks, knowledge articles and design notes others can actually follow.
* Ownership — sees an item through to working in production and stays with it when it misbehaves afterwards.
* Curiosity and self-direction — reads release notes, tests in a lab, and brings improvement ideas to refinement unprompted.
* Collaboration — works well with product, architecture, security and the service desk; explains technical constraint without condescension.
* User empathy — remembers that a policy setting is somebody's Monday morning.

**Skills**

Access Control (AC), Agile Methodology, Cisco Routing, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Data Migration Testing, Microsoft Office 365, Operator Interfaces, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: SAP BW4HANA Solution Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Integrated reporting BI Delivery Lead

**Your role and responsibilities**

**Solution Architect – SAP BW/4HANA** is responsible for designing and governing end-to-end SAP BW/4HANA-based data warehousing, reporting, and planning solutions that support enterprise financial reporting, planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. This role owns the overall data and analytics architecture, ensuring scalable data models, efficient data flows, high system performance, and strong governance aligned with business and IT standards.

The architect partners closely with Finance (FP&A) and business stakeholders to translate functional reporting and planning requirements into optimized BW/4HANA data models, data flows, and analytics solutions, while providing technical leadership across data modeling, integration, performance optimization, and security. The role also drives architectural consistency, best practices, and adoption of modern SAP data and analytics capabilities across the landscape.

The Solution Architect ensures that BW/4HANA solutions are technically robust, business-aligned, future-ready, and seamlessly integrated with S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and other enterprise systems, while maintaining data integrity, compliance, and performance at scale.

The location of the role is in **Bangalore, India.**

The work model for the role is: Hybrid  
  
This role is contributing to the **Finance, Process, Data and Systems** in **Bengaluru, India** .  
  
You will be mainly accountable for:

* Architect and implement **advanced SAP BW/4HANA solutions**, including complex data models (ADSO, CompositeProviders, InfoObjects) to support enterprise reporting and planning scenarios such as allocations, currency translation, and forecasting.
* Own the **BW/4HANA data modeling strategy**, ensuring optimal layered architecture (LSA++), efficient data granularity, hierarchy design, and consistent master and transactional data across the landscape.Establish and enforce **enterprise data governance frameworks** within BW/4HANA, including data ownership, lifecycle management, auditability, and alignment with organizational standards.
* Lead **performance monitoring and optimization initiatives** across BW/4HANA and HANA database, utilizing tools such as workload monitoring, SQL trace, and HANA Studio to identify bottlenecks and ensure scalable, high-performing solutions.Optimize BW/4HANA data flows and reporting through **efficient data modeling, query design, HANA pushdown (AMDP/CDS), and transformation tuning**, ensuring fast data processing and high query performance.
* Define and implement robust **security and authorization concepts in BW/4HANA**, including analysis authorizations, role-based access, and data-level restrictions to meet compliance and segregation of duties requirements.Collaborate closely with **Finance, FP&A, and business stakeholders** to understand reporting and planning requirements, translating them into scalable BW/4HANA models and integrated SAC reporting/planning solutions.
* Provide **technical leadership and governance** to development teams, ensuring adherence to BW/4HANA architecture principles, modeling standards, naming conventions, and transport management processes. Review and guide solution designs to ensure **consistency, reusability, scalability, and alignment** with enterprise data and analytics architecture. Stay current with **SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA, and SAC innovations**, evaluating and adopting new capabilities to enhance performance, scalability, and overall business value.

**Qualifications for the role**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. SAP Analytics Cloud Planning and BW/4HANA certifications are preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in SAC Planning architecture and development. Proven track record of implementing large-scale planning models handling complex financial planning scenarios.
* In-depth knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA data modeling and integration techniques. Advanced skills in SAC Data Actions, Advanced Formulas, API-based data integrations, and predictive planning scenarios. Experience in financial planning processes (Budgeting, Forecasting, Rolling Forecasts) and a solid understanding of key financial metrics.
* Experience working on finance transformation programs involving SAC and enterprise-level ERP solutions.
* Strong focus on continuous learning and exploring emerging technologies in the planning and analytics space.

**More about us:**

By joining ABB as a SAP Analytics Cloud Architect, you will be instrumental in developing and maintaining a robust Planning platform that enhances financial transparency, and supports strategic decision-making across the organization.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
description:
**Req ID:** 395525
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
  
**Senior Solution Architecture Role | Primary Skill:** Finance | Secondary Skill: Controlling
  
Job Summary
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to serve as the senior subject matter expert and central solution authority for SAP Finance within NTT DATA. This role requires deep expertise in Financial Accounting, supported by strong working knowledge of Controlling, and will provide leadership across assessments, advisory engagements, implementations, conversions, and optimization programs.
  
The architect will work directly with CFOs, controllers, finance leaders, business process owners, enterprise architects, and SAP delivery teams. The individual will help clients understand finance processes and SAP capabilities, analyze complex requirements and pain points, answer solution questions, evaluate options, and define scalable SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions aligned with standard functionality and clean-core principles.
  
This is a client-facing and practice leadership role for a hands-on architect who can operate across business process advisory, solution design, delivery governance, presales support, and issue resolution. Manufacturing industry experience is required, together with experience in one or more additional industries.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
SAP Finance Solution Leadership
  

* Serve as the senior SAP Finance SME across SAP S/4HANA transformation, assessment, implementation, and advisory engagements.
* Own the Finance solution strategy and architecture across Greenfield, Brownfield, and Selective Data Transition programs.
* Lead end-to-end solution design for Record-to-Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, and Financial Reporting.
* Provide architecture-level oversight for Controlling and management accounting, ensuring full integration with the Finance solution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex Finance design, integration, data, reporting, and delivery issues.
* Establish reusable Finance architecture principles, design standards, and leading practices across client engagements.

Finance Solution Design and Architecture
  

* Lead solution architecture and detailed design for core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities, including:

o General Ledger, Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, currencies, and document splitting
  
o Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner, and payment processing
  
o Asset Accounting, bank accounting, tax, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany accounting
  
o Financial close, statutory and management reporting, embedded analytics, and SAP Fiori for Finance
  
o Credit, collections, dispute management, cash management, and Treasury integration
  

* Translate business, accounting, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Evaluate solution alternatives, articulate trade-offs, and provide clear recommendations to business and project leadership.
* Ensure alignment with SAP standard capabilities, S/4HANA simplifications, clean-core principles, and future-state enterprise architecture.
* Review and approve functional designs, configurations, reports, workflows, interfaces, conversion designs, and integration specifications.

Client Advisory and Finance Transformation
  

* Engage with CFOs, controllers, finance directors, process owners, and business users to understand current processes, business challenges, controls, and strategic priorities.
* Lead finance assessments, discovery sessions, Fit-to-Standard workshops, and future-state process design sessions.
* Help clients understand SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and explain complex solution concepts in clear business language.
* Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, stronger controls, and improved reporting.
* Develop finance transformation roadmaps, solution options, implementation strategies, business cases, and executive recommendations.
* Advise on finance operating models, shared services, close optimization, governance, chart of accounts harmonization, and organizational design.

S/4HANA Transformation and Delivery
  

* Assess the impact of S/4HANA simplifications on finance processes, configuration, reports, interfaces, controls, and custom developments.
* Guide decisions related to ledger and currency strategy, parallel accounting, document splitting, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, and financial reporting.
* Lead or advise on Finance data migration for balances, open items, assets, bank and tax data, cost objects, and historical data.
* Assess RICEFW requirements and challenge unnecessary customization to support a clean-core solution.
* Provide solution oversight through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Support test strategy, defect resolution, mock conversions, financial reconciliation, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

Integration and Cross-Functional Coordination
  

* Coordinate closely with MM, SD, PP, QM, EWM, PM, PS, HCM, Treasury, Group Reporting, planning, data, security, and technical teams.
* Ensure accurate and complete financial integration across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Plan-to-Produce, Project-to-Cash, Acquire-to-Retire, and Record-to-Report.
* Provide Finance leadership for account determination, valuation, settlement, allocations, intercompany processing, and reporting across integrated business processes.
* Collaborate with ABAP, integration, data, analytics, workflow, and Fiori teams on enhancements and interfaces.
* Ensure the Finance solution aligns with the broader SAP and non-SAP landscape and enterprise architecture.

Controlling and Manufacturing Finance Support
  

* Provide architecture-level guidance for Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ensure Controlling design is integrated with Financial Accounting and aligned with business reporting and performance management needs.
* Support manufacturing finance requirements such as inventory valuation, standard and actual costing, production variances, production order settlement, and profitability reporting.
* Partner with specialized Controlling consultants for detailed configuration or complex industry-specific scenarios.

Practice and Team Leadership
  

* Act as the central SAP Finance solution authority and trusted advisor within NTT DATA.
* Support client assessments, pre-sales activities, proposals, estimates, solution reviews, and executive presentations.
* Mentor Finance consultants, workstream leads, and architects and provide guidance on complex design and integration topics.
* Develop reusable assessment frameworks, solution standards, design principles, and leading-practice content.
* Work effectively within global onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models and manage multiple priorities across concurrent engagements.

Required Skills and Experience
  
**Primary Skill:** SAP Financial Accounting
  

* 20+ years of SAP experience with deep functional, advisory, and solution architecture expertise in SAP Finance.
* Strong hands-on and architecture experience in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, parallel ledgers and currencies, document splitting, tax, statutory reporting, and financial reporting.
* Deep understanding of S/4HANA Finance architecture, including Universal Journal, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, embedded analytics, financial close, and SAP Fiori.
* At least 3-5 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA transformation or implementation programs in a Finance Solution Architect, Finance Lead, or equivalent senior role.
* Experience designing Finance solutions across multiple legal entities, currencies, countries, and accounting standards.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, compliance, statutory requirements, and management reporting.

**Secondary Skill:** SAP Controlling
  

* Strong working knowledge of SAP Controlling and its integration with Financial Accounting.
* Experience with Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ability to provide architecture-level guidance for Controlling while partnering with specialized CO consultants for detailed design and configuration.
* Understanding of manufacturing cost flows, inventory valuation, production variances, actual costing, settlement, and profitability reporting.

Finance Transformation and Industry Knowledge
  

* Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, financial close, reporting, compliance, internal controls, and process governance.
* Significant industry experience in manufacturing, including discrete and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Experience in one or more industries such as Life Sciences, Automotive, Chemicals, Consumer Products, Retail, Utilities, Healthcare, or High Technology.
* Experience supporting global organizations with multiple legal entities, currencies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
* Ability to understand industry-specific finance requirements and translate them into practical SAP solutions.

Architecture, Advisory, and Leadership Skills
  

* Proven ability to assess complex finance requirements and develop practical, scalable solution recommendations.
* Experience leading assessments, Fit-to-Standard workshops, process harmonization, and future-state solution design.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, functional, and technical audiences.
* Strong understanding of Finance integration, data migration, reporting, security, controls, and custom development considerations.
* Proven experience leading SAP Finance teams in large, complex transformation programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive presence, decision facilitation, and issue-resolution skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification and experience with SAP Activate methodology.
* Experience with SAP Central Finance is highly desirable.
* Experience to Group Reporting, Advanced Financial Closing, SAP Analytics Cloud, Treasury, FSCM, or Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Experience with RISE with SAP, SAP Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM, and clean-core governance.
* Experience supporting presales, solution architecture reviews, assessments, proposals, and estimates.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent is an advantage.

Soft Skills
  

* Strong analytical, advisory, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to effectively engage with CxOs
* Ability to translate complex finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Confidence working with senior finance leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate as both a strategic architect and a hands-on solution advisor.
* Strong mentoring, coaching, collaboration, and client-service mindset.

Location and Work Model
  

* Location:
* Work model: Hybrid, onsite
* Travel may be required based on client and delivery needs.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. description:

title: Digital Product Owner
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------

As a Digital Product Owner for Product Compliance area, you will be involved in development and maintenance of products to manage Part (chemical composition & hazardous info) & Chemical Compliance (Chemical properties & human safety) information for AB Volvo product compliance needs. Your responsibility is to identify and define the solutions that will maximize the value delivered to stakeholders. All work is done in agile teams in iterative collaboration with developers. You are expected to contribute and act as role model in all activities required to achieve customer satisfaction.

We are seeking a candidate with passion, you will work closely with business representatives, product managers, architects, engineers, and operations to ensure that our platforms deliver measurable value and are ready for use in production. Your responsibilities will include:

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Strategy:** Define and evolve the product vision, roadmap, objectives, and success measures, aligned with business priorities.
* **Business Value & Prioritization**: Identify and prioritize business needs for reusable Agentic AI capabilities, balancing customer value, risks, technical dependencies, and capacity.
* **Backlog Ownership:** Own and refine the team backlog, ensuring clear priorities, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes.

title: Lead Specialist, Enterprise Architect - (AI Systems & Distributed Engineering)
description:
**Job Title: Advance Specialist ,Enterprise Architect**

**About the role:**

Seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to be part of the Enterprise Architecture team. This is not an "advisory" role — we require a practitioner who balances high-level strategic governance with deep-dive technical execution. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between traditional distributed and enterprise systems and the emerging frontier of Agentic AI, transforming how the enterprise leverages autonomous agents and LLM-driven workflows.

**Experience Level:** 12-15 Years **Location:** Bangalore or Chennai, India **Role Type:** Hands-on Enterprise Architect

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architectural Strategy & Blueprint Ownership**
* Own and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — current-state and target-state views across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers.
* Define and evangelize reference architectures and reusable patterns for agentic AI systems (agent orchestration, tool-calling, memory/state management, guardrails) so delivery teams don't reinvent foundational patterns per project.
* **AI Agent Ecosystems**
* Design and govern the architecture for multi-agent systems, including agent-to-agent communication protocols, orchestration frameworks, and tool/function-calling interfaces.
* Define standards for grounding, memory, retrieval, and context management across LLM-driven workflows.
* Establish human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths for autonomous agents operating on production data or systems.
* Evaluate and select frameworks/platforms for agent orchestration (e.g., orchestration engines, model routing, guardrail layers), balancing build vs. buy.
* **Modeling & Governance**
* Chair or actively participate in the Architecture Review Chapter; define review cadence, entry/exit criteria, and a clear exception-handling process for teams that need to move fast.
* Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and maintain a lightweight, non-bureaucratic approval workflow so governance catches drift without blocking delivery.
* Define non-negotiable guardrails for AI/agentic systems — data access boundaries, PII handling, human-in-the-loop requirements, and audit logging — that any new agent workflow must pass through review.
* Maintain enterprise modeling artifacts (capability maps, data flow diagrams, integration catalogs) as the single source of truth referenced during reviews.

**Required Technical Skills**

**AI**

* Hands-on experience with LLM application architecture: RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails.
* Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns and tool-use/function-calling architectures.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization (Kubernetes), and infra-as-code.
* Experience designing for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency at enterprise scale.

**Distributed & Enterprise Systems Integration**

* Strong background in distributed systems design (event-driven architecture, microservices, API gateways, messaging systems).
* Experience integrating legacy enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, core platforms) with modern cloud-native and AI-driven components.

**Data Architecture**

* Experience designing enterprise data architectures — data pipelines, data mesh/data fabric concepts, governance, and lineage.
* Ability to model and maintain the data-flow view that underpins the enterprise digital twin.

**Modeling & Governance Tooling**

* Practical experience with architecture modeling notations/tools (e.g., ArchiMate, C4 model, TOGAF-aligned frameworks) and running formal EA review processes.

**Qualifications**

* 12 - 15 years of progressive experience in software engineering and solution architecture.
* Demonstrated ability to strategise and develop PoC and add create practices around it.
* A portfolio of successful large-scale modernization or AI-transformation projects, ideally including experience participating in an EA governance process (ARB, ADRs) from scratch or maturing an existing one.
* Prior experience building or working with an enterprise digital twin or equivalent simulation/dependency-modeling capability is a strong plus.

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. **Role Overview**

We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

  

**What We Require**

***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

  

**Why AppViewX?**

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.
