title: Data & AI Architect
description:
Reporting to the Head of Data & AI and leading a small team of specialists, the role owns three things: Azure-based AI/BI and agentic offerings; Mivada's Responsible AI, data governance and AI assurance framework; and the Microsoft Data & AI partnership.
  
  
This role works alongside the Enterprise Architecture & Snowflake COE, the Solutioning & Databricks COE, Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement, and Client Engagement & Execution, and drives the governance, training and adoption program set out in Mivada's AI Strategy & Roll-Out Roadmap across the practice.
  
  
Team leadership and people management
  
  

* Lead and manage a team of 3–5 Azure AI/BI engineers and AI / data governance specialists, owning their performance, development and day-to-day workload allocation.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team members; act as the escalation point for technical, governance and client issues the team raises.
* Set goals and conduct regular performance reviews for direct reports; identify and act on development and career-progression needs.

Azure AI/BI and agentic solution design and delivery
  
  

* Design, build and productionise AI/BI and generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Foundry, including natural-language analytics (for example, Fabric data agents and Copilot in Power BI).
* Develop and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (for example, Foundry Agent Service, Copilot Studio or LangGraph-style supervisor/agent patterns) that connect governed enterprise data, models and knowledge sources to real business problems.
* Package proven patterns into named, reusable, sellable offerings with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead, contributing to the practice's goal of at least one client-facing AI-enabled capability.
* Hand over to Client Engagement delivery pods with clear designs, guardrails and runbooks, and provide technical assurance through delivery.

Data governance and trust
  
  

* Own the practice's data governance approach for AI and analytics: ownership and stewardship, classification, lineage, quality and cataloguing, using Microsoft Purview and, where relevant, Unity Catalog or Snowflake Horizon.
* Develop and deliver client-facing trust offerings such as AI governance operating models, data governance and AI-readiness assessments, and Copilot data-protection reviews.

Microsoft Data & AI partnership
  
  

* Own Mivada's Microsoft Data & AI partner relationship and partner-tier roadmap, including the Solutions Partner for Data & AI (Azure) designation and relevant specialisations.
* Lead Microsoft co-sell, joint go-to-market and partner-funded programs (for example, workshops, assessments and proofs of concept) together with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead.
* Build and maintain certified Microsoft Data & AI capability across the practice, including own hands-on delivery.
* Represent Mivada at Microsoft partner forums and build relationships with Microsoft partner development managers and solution specialists.

Internal AI enablement and capability uplift
  
  

* Build and maintain the reusable prompt/playbook library and templated workflows that move staff from ad hoc use (L1/L2) toward governed, team-level and client-facing use (L3+) on the practice's AI maturity scale.
* Recruit, train and coordinate the peer-coach network; deliver the role-based training tiers, including Responsible AI and AI literacy for all staff; track adoption, confidence and training completion each quarter.

Client and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Partner with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead on AI and governance pursuits, providing solution design, estimates and Responsible AI positions for proposals.
* Contribute Responsible AI and data-trust thought leadership, such as points of view, events and case studies, to build Mivada's reputation and visibility.
* Advise client executives and risk, privacy and compliance stakeholders on AI governance, guardrails and trade-offs in clear, non-technical terms.
* Keep current with the Azure, Fabric and Foundry roadmap and with AI regulation and standards; coach consultants in Azure AI delivery and Responsible AI practice.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a small technical team (line management, performance reviews, resourcing and capacity planning).
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Senior experience in data and AI engineering or consulting, with hands-on delivery on Microsoft Azure data and AI services (for example, Microsoft Fabric, Foundry, Azure OpenAI and Power BI).
* Practical experience building and productionising generative AI, natural-language analytics or agentic AI solutions.
* Experience designing or running enablement or training programs.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive, risk and compliance audiences.

**Desirable**

* HIGHLY DESIRABLE – Data, Agentic or AI certification across one or more of MS Azure, Databricks, Snowflake
* AI governance or data governance credentials (for example, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer or DAMA CDMP).
* Experience managing a Microsoft partner relationship, including designation or specialisation audits and co-sell.
* Prior consulting or professional services experience; experience running a champion network or community of practice.

**Benefits**
**WHY JOIN US**
Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:
  
  

* Developing you is a key focus - we help you craft your career
* Pioneers in Parental Leave benefits - we provide equality in our parental leave for all genders and parental types
* Doona Days - additional two days off for your mental health
* Fun is an everyday experience - we challenge you in a positive way so you enjoy your growth journey
* Competitive Compensation & Pay for Performance
* Opportunities to be more for yourself and others

**Who We Are**
At
**Mivada**
we believe that when you bring technology and the right people together, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
  
  
Mivada is a high-growth technology consultancy, headquartered in Australia, offering services to both high-growth, mid-sized and global blue chip clients. We run a hybrid model with the majority of our team onshore, as well as an offshore capability in India. We have the ability to support global businesses 24/7 365. Our flexible approach and strong reputation have led to repeat work and growth.
**Our clients are our advocates.**
**We believe cultural fit is as important as technical skills.**
We operate as a team, supporting and learning from each other and we genuinely care about our clients’ success. Our Leaders are accessible, humble, and sometimes pretty funny! We like to enjoy our time at work, which means we encourage each other to shoot for the moon!

title: CRM Solution/Data Architect (Senior Manager) – Pharma
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
Our CX Strategy & Digital Transformation team is building next-generation commercial, medical, and customer engagement capabilities powered by Salesforce, AI, Data Cloud, and advanced analytics. We are seeking a strategic and highly experienced architect who can design the future-state CRM and customer data ecosystem supporting scalable growth across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
  
  
The Senior Manager, CRM Solution & Data Architect will define and govern the enterprise CRM, customer data, integration, and engagement architecture. This role will serve as the primary architecture leader across Salesforce, Data Cloud, customer master data, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, and connected enterprise platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep Salesforce architecture expertise with strong data architecture, master data management, integration design, and pharmaceutical commercial process knowledge. The role will partner with business leaders, product owners, engineering teams, data teams, security, and external partners to deliver scalable, compliant, and business-aligned solutions.
  
  
**WORK SCHEDULE: This position requires full coverage of US Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) and is not a standard India daytime work schedule**
**Principal Responsibilities**
**CRM & Enterprise Solution Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end CRM architecture strategy supporting Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
* Establish future-state architecture roadmaps across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, Marketing Cloud, and emerging AI capabilities.
* Translate business strategy and product roadmaps into scalable solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation guardrails.
* Develop and govern architecture standards, reusable design patterns, platform principles, and technology blueprints across the CRM ecosystem.
* Evaluate new technologies and vendor capabilities against enterprise architecture, security, data, and business priorities.

**Data Architecture & Customer 360 Strategy**

* Lead customer data architecture across HCP, HCO, KOL, patient, account, territory, consent, affiliation, and engagement data domains.
* Define Customer 360 architecture leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud, enterprise customer master platforms, and third-party data sources.
* Design scalable canonical and platform data models supporting engagement, commercial effectiveness, reporting, analytics, and AI.
* Establish data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, survivorship, matching, and identity-resolution standards.
* Drive master data management alignment across CRM, ERP, enterprise data platforms, IQVIA, and commercial applications.

**Integration & Platform Architecture**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce and Snowflake, IQVIA, customer master, ERP, data warehouse, marketing automation, patient services, sales enablement, and analytics platforms.
* Define API-led, middleware, batch, event-driven, and real-time integration patterns based on business and technical requirements.
* Ensure integration architecture meets scalability, resiliency, performance, monitoring, supportability, and security expectations.
* Guide delivery teams on platform interoperability, interface contracts, error handling, observability, and enterprise integration standards.

**AI, Analytics & Data Cloud Enablement**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to define AI-enabled CRM, field productivity, customer engagement, and decision-support use cases.
* Lead architecture for Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein capabilities, predictive analytics, and customer intelligence initiatives.
* Ensure customer and engagement data is structured and governed to support segmentation, personalization, next best action, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish trusted, reusable datasets and reporting architecture.

**Governance, Compliance & Security**

* Define architecture governance covering design reviews, standards compliance, technology decisions, nonfunctional requirements, and release readiness.
* Ensure CRM and data solutions align with applicable pharmaceutical, privacy, security, and records-management requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA expectations.
* Establish security architecture standards for role-based access, classification, privacy, encryption, auditability, retention, and risk management.
* Lead architecture assessments for internal and vendor-delivered solutions, documenting decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation actions.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted architecture advisor to Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital, Data & Analytics, Security, and IT leadership.
* Lead discovery sessions, architecture workshops, solution reviews, roadmap planning, and executive-level design discussions.
* Mentor solution architects, developers, data engineers, administrators, and technical leads while raising architecture maturity.
* Provide thought leadership on CRM modernization, customer data strategy, AI adoption, and pharmaceutical engagement technologies.
* Oversee consulting partners and ensure internal team members participate throughout the design journey to build sustainable knowledge and ownership.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in CRM, enterprise architecture, data architecture, or solution architecture, including leadership at a senior manager or equivalent level.
* 10+ years of Salesforce platform architecture experience with ownership of complex, enterprise-scale solutions.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Veeva, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, and related capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of customer master data management, Customer 360, identity resolution, data governance, metadata management, and data quality.
* Experience architecting enterprise integrations using APIs, middleware, event-driven architecture, batch processing, and cloud-native patterns.
* Proven experience leading large-scale CRM transformation, platform modernization, data migration, and operating-model initiatives.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical processes including HCP/HCO engagement, Medical Affairs, patient services, KOL management, territory management, consent, compliance, and omnichannel engagement.
* Experience with healthcare and commercial data ecosystems, including IQVIA and customer reference data.
* Knowledge of Snowflake, Azure data services, enterprise data warehouses, analytics platforms, and modern data architecture patterns.
* Experience with Salesforce AI, Agentforce, Einstein, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities required
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, decision-making, and vendor leadership skills.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams and external consulting partners.

**Required Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Data Architect
* Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
* Salesforce Certified Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Architect
* Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified AI Specialist
* Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
* TOGAF certification preferred
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) preferred

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Work Mode**
: Hybrid work arrangement
  
  
***At AVEVA, we’re all about limitless possibilities. Are you?***
As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations & Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met.
  
  
As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals.
  
  
Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable.
  
  
The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions.
* Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions.
* Continually develop and improve DevOps processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting.
* Provide timely and effective response to incidents to minimize the impact on our customers and keep colleagues updated as required.
* Oversee relevant Cloud deployments to ensure successful implementation, track and report progress, resolve or escalate release issues.
* Proactively manage cloud environments to minimize service impacting issues, including infrastructure as code, certificates, storage, health status, backup status etc.
* Ensure new services meet required operational readiness standards before being accepted into operations.
* Ensure on-going compliance to security practices and policies.
* Provide subject matter expertise to business stakeholders as required.
* Maintain clear and accurate operational documentation.
* Stay current on security industry trends, tools and best practices.

**Essential Requirements**
The following list applies to Azure and/or AWS Platforms.
  
  

* Overall 7+ years of experience in Software Development with exposure to working on Cloud environments (AWS and/or Azure)
* Strong programming skills, e.g. C#, .NET Core or Java.
* Knowledge of PowerShell or Node JS or Python scripting.
* Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API, REST, microservices, serverless architecture.
* Knowledge of Cloud Authentication protocols such as OAuth, Identity Servers, OpenID Connect and SAML etc…
* Knowledge of Azure administration, Azure APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIO Management, Service Bus, Event Grids, Storage Accounts and Key Vaults and tools. Or, equivalent AWS experience.
* Knowledge and experience of operational support, software development and deployment methodologies and principles.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Attention to detail, diligent and tenacious.
* Excellent analysis and dissemination skills.
* High degree of personal motivation and ability to self-manage.
* Maintains and develops relevant industry and technology knowledge.

**Desired Skills And Competencies**

* Certifications in Azure and/or AWS.
* Hands-on experience working within an Information Security accredited framework e.g. ISO27001, 27017/18.
* Experience working in Agile software development such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

**R&D at AVEVA**
Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
  
  
Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering | Kubernetes Platform
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Software Engineering
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Are you passionate about leading teams that operate infrastructure at scale? Do you thrive on overseeing Kubernetes clusters and microservices? Here is an exciting opportunity for you!
  
  
Our team provides Kubernetes platform-as-a-service to other teams building microservices at Salesforce. Over the next year, we will expand our Kubernetes footprint by thousands of clusters, and you could play a pivotal role in this transformation. As a manager, you will guide your team in working with open-source technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo, and Spinnaker, shaping the future of these technologies while fostering a culture of innovation.
  
  
We manage one of the largest Kubernetes fleets in the industry and have been early adopters of this technology. Our mission is to empower service owners to focus on the unique value of their services, enhancing developer agility while reducing operational costs and complexity. The FKP team is critical to the company’s strategy to move to Hyperforce, providing the underlying infrastructure for key services such as Sales, Service, Commerce, Mulesoft, and Tableau.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As the FKP Manager, you will be responsible for leading the design and implementation of software for managing Kubernetes clusters at scale. Your role will involve:
  
  

* Overseeing the creation of design documents and facilitating presentations to stakeholders.
* Managing the integration and evaluation of open-source technologies into the FKP software stack.
* Leading and mentoring a team of engineers, ensuring high-quality deliverables and fostering professional growth.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align goals and strategies.

**Required Skills**

* A related technical degree required
* Proven track record leading software engineering teams with a distinguished track record on technically fast paced projects
* Experience leading large scale distributed systems, working with microservices and/or distributed architecture
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
* Ability to be flexible, proactive, comfortable working with minimal specifications
* Experience with short release cycles, the full software lifecycle, and experience working on a product that’s been released for public consumption
* Experience in hiring, mentoring and leading engineers
* Working experience of software engineering best practices including coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience with Agile development methodologies. Scrum Master experience required
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with one or more public cloud substrates e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP
* Experience with container orchestration systems Kubernetes, Docker
* Experience with open source projects like Kubernetes, Karpenter, Argo, Spinnaker, Terraform

Why Should You Join the FKP Team?
  
  

* Opportunity for Impact: Lead initiatives that significantly enhance our platform, positively impacting service teams across Salesforce.
* Innovative Technology: Work with and shape the future of growing open-source technologies like Kubernetes.
* Creative Freedom: Tackle complex issues at scale within distributed systems.
* Thought Leadership: Opportunity to write blogs and share the team’s success stories at conferences and open-source forums, such as:How Salesforce uses ArgoWorkflows for provisioning add-onsOperationalizing Kubernetes Sidecars in Production at SalesforceManaging Kubernetes Multitenant Clusters in Public Cloud at ScaleDeveloping a Synthetic Testing Framework for Continuous Monitoring of Kubernetes Mutating Webhooks

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Principal Engineer – Knowledge, Data & RAG Engineering- Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced Architect to lead enterprise architecture for knowledge and data engineering, RAG, and Graph RAG. Experience in Agentic AI, orchestration, testing, evaluation, and governance is desirable. Working with architecture, data, AI, security, risk, product, testing, and application teams, you will turn business strategy into practical architectures, standards, roadmaps, and delivery controls. You will bring strong architectural leadership and expertise in semantic technologies, modern data platforms, and retrieval systems.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
Enterprise AI depends on trusted, well-engineered, permission-aware, traceable, and continuously validated data and knowledge. This role establishes the architectural foundation that connects source systems, data pipelines, semantic models, knowledge graphs, retrieval services, models, agents, controls, testing, and business workflows. The Architect will reduce fragmented point solutions, promote reusable capabilities, guide investment decisions, and ensure that AI applications and agents retrieve reliable evidence, generate grounded responses, execute approved actions, and remain secure, observable, auditable, resilient, and compliant throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
  
  
We operate as one global team across the North America, EMEA, and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
Own the enterprise architecture for Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, Agentic AI, testing, and governance, aligning strategy, platforms, delivery, controls, and measurable outcomes.

description:

Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) is responsible for building and maintaining the critical finance technology applications that enable new business growth, ensure compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and provide deep analysis of Amazon's financial data. This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.
  
  
At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.
  
  
Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.

You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real-time analytics.
  
  
Cross-Functional and Senior Engineer Collaboration: You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, and accountants. You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. This experience will give you the opportunities and visibility to help build the required leadership skills to enhance your career.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices and using data to define and improve operational best practices.
  
  
Help drive the architecture and technology choices for FinTech accounting products.
  
  
Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon accounting needs.
  
  
Raise the bar on code quality, including security, readability, consistency, maintainability.
  
  
**About The Team**
At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Engineering Manager**

AI Agentic Platform – Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems.

As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering.

**Platform Capabilities You'll Own**

* **Industry-Specific ROI Measurement:**
  Build instrumentation, analytics, and reporting frameworks that quantify the business impact of AI agents across verticals such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, and telecom.
* **AI Agent Benchmarking:**
  Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success.
* **Agent Orchestration:**
  Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably.
* **Cross-Platform Agent Unification:**
  Architect a unified abstraction layer, connectors, and protocol adapters (MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants, LangGraph, etc.) so customers can manage agents across vendors and frameworks from a single pane of glass.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Hire, build, and lead a high-caliber engineering team across backend, AI/ML, and platform infrastructure
* Define and own the technical architecture for a multi-tenant, scalable AI agentic platform
* Drive the technical roadmap for orchestration, benchmarking, observability, and unification capabilities
* Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into shippable engineering outcomes
* Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment
* Lead architectural reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex distributed systems
* Build robust evaluation frameworks and ROI dashboards that customers and internal teams trust
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency at scale
* Mentor engineers, set growth paths, run performance reviews, and foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture
* Communicate progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native platforms
* Hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-powered products in production environments
* Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts including planning, tool use, memory, and multi-agent coordination
* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript
* Experience designing APIs, SDKs, and integration platforms used by enterprise customers
* Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining strong engineering talent
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Familiarity with emerging agent interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols
* Experience designing LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems (offline evals, A/B testing, golden datasets, judge models)
* Knowledge of observability for AI systems including tracing, telemetry, and cost/quality monitoring
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering at scale
* Background in building analytics, ROI dashboards, or business intelligence tooling for enterprise customers
* Domain experience in one or more verticals (BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, customer support, or sales)
* Familiarity with AI safety, guardrails, and responsible AI frameworks
* Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field

**Technical Stack & Tooling**

* **Languages:**
  Python, Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Java
* **AI/ML Frameworks:**
  LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs
* **Agent Protocols:**
  MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants API, function calling, tool use frameworks
* **Data & Storage:**
  PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant, Snowflake/BigQuery
* **Streaming & Messaging:**
  Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, gRPC
* **Cloud & Infra:**
  AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
* **Observability:**
  Datadog, OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana

**What We're Looking For**

* A builder-leader who can both architect deeply technical systems and grow a high-performing team
* Someone genuinely excited about agentic AI and the future of multi-agent enterprise systems
* A pragmatic decision-maker who can balance innovation, customer value, and engineering excellence
* A strong communicator who can simplify complex AI concepts for diverse audiences
* A coach and mentor who invests in people and builds inclusive, psychologically safe teams

**Why Join Us**

* Lead one of the most strategic AI initiatives at the company at the forefront of agentic AI
* Build a category-defining platform that unifies, benchmarks, and orchestrates AI agents across the enterprise
* Shape product and technical strategy alongside senior leadership
* Work with cutting-edge LLMs, agent frameworks, and evaluation tooling
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits
* Flexible work culture with strong investment in learning and development

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

description:

Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business goals. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
  
  
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
  
  
Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
  
  
Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
  
  
Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies patterns in blockers across business areas or a territory. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.
  
  
Practice Development
  
  
Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.
  
  
Trusted Advisor

title: Wireless Firmware Engineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Type

Full Time

Workspace

Hyderabad, India

**About the Role**
------------------

About the Role  
We are looking for a firmware engineer who understands radios as well as code. You will build firmware for long-range, low-power wireless devices and test tools, from radio drivers and protocol stacks to key storage, over-the-air updates and field validation. You will think in link budgets, timing and security, not just in registers.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on connected products where reliability in the field, power efficiency and security matter as much as features.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Radio and Protocol Firmware**

* Develop and maintain **LoRa and LoRaWAN** protocol stacks (1.0.x and 1.1): activation, device classes, receive windows, MAC commands, adaptive data rate and regional parameters.
* Apply **spread-spectrum and frequency-hopping radio concepts**, and bring up new radio chipsets and modes behind a clean driver interface.
* Implement robust **retry, acknowledgement and duplicate-handling strategies** for lossy and high-latency links.

#### **Link and RF Engineering**

* Perform **link-budget analysis** and interpret sensitivity, interference and range-test data.
* Account for **frequency stability and timing** (crystal and TCXO choice, drift, offset handling) in radio design and firmware.
* Run **field range and reliability trials**, and turn the results into firmware and configuration improvements.

#### **Security and Key Management**

* Implement AES-128 and AES-CMAC correctly, and manage keys in **protected storage or a secure element**.
* Design **secure device activation and key lifecycle**: provisioning, rotation, revocation, and safe persistence of counters across resets.
* Build **signed over-the-air updates** with a secure boot chain.

#### **Drivers, Gateways and Test**

* Write **SPI radio drivers** and work with gateway-side software (concentrator HALs, packet forwarders and bridges) and timing sources.
* Build **test infrastructure**: Python simulators, hardware-in-the-loop automation, power profiling and instrument-based RF validation.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Communications, Embedded Systems or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** of embedded C/C++ on ARM Cortex-M with an RTOS.
* Hands-on wireless protocol work (LoRa/LoRaWAN or a similar low-power wide-area technology), including field debugging.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Embedded Core**

* FreeRTOS or Zephyr, interrupt-driven design, low-power design with measured sleep currents.

#### **Radio and Protocols**

* LoRa PHY parameters (spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate), LoRaWAN MAC internals, modulation fundamentals, sensitivity and link-budget reasoning.

#### **Security**

* AES-CMAC and AES-CTR, key storage, secure boot, safe counter handling.

#### **Instruments and Tools**

* Spectrum analyser, power profiler, protocol sniffers, logic analyser, JTAG/SWD.

#### **Software Tooling**

* Python, Git and CI.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* SDR capture and analysis (IQ recordings, GNU Radio) and DSP fundamentals.
* GNSS and precise timing, or FPGA basics.
* Embedded Rust, and RF certification experience (WPC, ETSI, FCC).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Work on the radio-to-cloud path of real long-range IoT products, with test equipment and field trials, not just simulation. You will see your firmware tested against physics.

### **How to Apply**

Send your updated resume along with links to relevant projects, GitHub or portfolio work to **jobs@eurthtech.com**, or use the application form on this page.

**About the Company**
---------------------

About EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD  
EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD is a cutting-edge Electronics Product Design and Engineering firm specializing in embedded systems, IoT solutions, and high-performance hardware development. We provide end-to-end product development services—from PCB design, firmware development, and system architecture to manufacturing and scalable deployment.  
  
With deep expertise in embedded software, signal processing, AI-driven edge computing, RF communication, and ultra-low-power design, we build next-generation industrial automation, consumer electronics, and smart infrastructure solutions.  
  
Our Core Capabilities  
Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering – Architecting robust, real-time embedded solutions with RTOS, Linux, and MCU/SoC-based firmware.  
IoT & Wireless Technologies – Developing LoRa, BLE, Wi-Fi, UWB, and 5G-based connected solutions for industrial and smart city applications.  
Hardware & PCB Design – High-performance PCB layout, signal integrity optimization, and design for manufacturing (DFM/DFA).  
Product Prototyping & Manufacturing – Accelerating concept-to-market with rapid prototyping, design validation, and scalable production.  
AI & Edge Computing – Implementing real-time AI/ML on embedded devices for predictive analytics, automation, and security.  
Security & Cryptography – Integrating post-quantum cryptography, secure boot, and encrypted firmware updates.  
  
Our Industry Impact  
✅ IoT & Smart Devices – Powering the next wave of connected solutions for industrial automation, logistics, and smart infrastructure.  
✅ Medical & Wearable Tech – Designing low-power biomedical devices with precision sensor fusion and embedded intelligence.  
✅ Automotive & Industrial Automation – Developing AI-enhanced control systems, predictive maintenance tools, and real-time monitoring solutions.  
✅ Scalable Enterprise & B2B Solutions – Delivering custom embedded hardware and software tailored to OEMs, manufacturers, and system integrators.  
  
Our Vision  
We are committed to advancing technology and innovation in embedded product design. With a focus on scalability, security, and efficiency, we empower businesses with intelligent, connected, and future-ready solutions.  
  
We currently cater to B2B markets, offering customized embedded development services, with a roadmap to expand into direct-to-consumer (B2C) solutions.

What you will do

Architecture and roadmap

* + Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.

* + Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.

* + Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.

* + Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security

* + Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).

* + Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.

* + Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate

* + Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.

* + Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.

* + Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.

* + Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.

Work with others

* + Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.

* + Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.

* + Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring

Experience

* + 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.

* + You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.

* + You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical

* + AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.

* + Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.

* + Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.

* + Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.

* + Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.

* + Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working

* + You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.

* + You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.

* + You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)

* + AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional

* + Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

* + A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have

* + Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.

* + Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.

* + FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.

* + Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.

2.Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.

3.A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.

4.The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.

5.Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

  
**Skills**

AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Infrastructure Engineer II – eApps
description:

Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Support, maintain, and improve third-party Enterprise Applications infrastructure through platform operations, administration, automation, monitoring, and cross-team delivery.
* Own assigned operational activities with increasing independence while following approved standards and partnering with senior engineers on complex issues, platform improvements, and project delivery.
* Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve repeatability, reliability, and support efficiency.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Platform operations: Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.
* Administration and maintenance: Perform platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, service management, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.
* Web and application platforms: Administer and troubleshoot IIS, JBoss, and Apache, including application hosting, configuration, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, service restarts, and basic Java application troubleshooting.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Work with GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.
* Automation: Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.
* Observability and performance: Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.
* Incident and ITSM support: Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.
* Project delivery: Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.
* Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Collaboration: Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.
* Support Requirement: Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.
* GCP and infrastructure: Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.
* Middleware and platform administration: Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.
* Operating systems and databases: Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Monitoring and operations: Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.
* ITSM and collaboration: Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Core proficiency: Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.
* Project methodology: Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.
* Continuous improvement: Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.
* Professional behaviors: Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Design and coordinate the evolution of LR’s marketing and go-to-market (GTM) architecture, creating scalable, secure and commercially effective technology solutions.

**What You Bring**

* Experience with Account Engagement (formerly Pardot) or a comparable marketing automation platform.

* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, automation and event-driven concepts.
* Experience with UAT, release governance, documentation and technical acceptance.
* Knowledge of privacy, consent, permissions, access controls and security principles.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.

* Experience with AI-enabled workflows, Data Cloud, integration platforms or low-code technologies.

* Is keen to take accountability and ownership for delivering customer needs
* Is able to self-manage and prioritize tasks towards meeting goals
* Is effective at solving problems, trouble-shooting and making timely decisions
* Is motivated and willing to take initiative
* Communicates in a structured way and has ability to present technical ideas in user-friendly language
* Displays a team spirit, particularly in a multicultural environment
* Responds positively to learning opportunities and is comfortable stepping out of own comfort zone
