title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi-workstream delivery programs ($5M+/year in professional services revenue) end-to-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Kitchen design draughtsman
description:
**Kitchen Design Draughtsman – Commercial Projects**

**Company:** Shree Sukhsagar Hospitality Services (SSHS)  
**Experience:** 7 Years  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Design & Engineering  
**Industry:** Commercial Kitchen Design, Hospitality, Food & Beverage, and Commercial Projects

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Kitchen Design Draughtsman** with approximately 7 years of experience in commercial kitchen design and drafting. The candidate should have strong expertise in preparing detailed kitchen layout drawings, equipment layouts, working drawings, and technical drawings for commercial kitchens, restaurants, hotels, food courts, and other hospitality establishments.

The ideal candidate must be proficient in CAD software, understand commercial kitchen equipment specifications, and be capable of coordinating with architects, MEP consultants, project teams, and equipment vendors to ensure accurate and practical kitchen designs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare detailed commercial kitchen layout drawings for restaurants, hotels, cafeterias, food courts, cloud kitchens, and other hospitality projects.
* Develop kitchen equipment layouts, floor plans, elevations, sections, and detailed working drawings.
* Prepare equipment positioning plans considering workflow, food preparation areas, cooking zones, washing areas, storage, and service counters.
* Prepare detailed drawings for stainless steel (SS) kitchen equipment, worktables, exhaust hoods, sinks, racks, and custom-fabricated equipment.
* Coordinate kitchen layouts with architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, drainage, and fire-fighting drawings.
* Ensure appropriate space planning, circulation, operational efficiency, and accessibility in commercial kitchen layouts.
* Incorporate equipment dimensions, utility connection requirements, and technical specifications provided by vendors and consultants.
* Prepare equipment schedules, detailed drawings, and material specifications as required for project execution.
* Review drawings and incorporate revisions based on client requirements, site conditions, and consultant feedback.
* Coordinate with project managers, architects, MEP engineers, procurement teams, and site execution teams to resolve design-related issues.
* Conduct site visits and verify dimensions, existing services, and site conditions wherever required.
* Maintain drawing registers, revision histories, and updated drawing sets for approvals and execution.
* Ensure drawings are prepared in accordance with project specifications, applicable standards, and relevant food safety and kitchen hygiene requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, or a relevant technical discipline.
* Approximately **7 years of relevant experience in commercial kitchen design and drafting**.
* Proven experience in designing kitchens for hotels, restaurants, commercial food service facilities, or hospitality projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of Revit or other 3D modelling software will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of commercial kitchen equipment, stainless steel fabrication, and kitchen workflow planning.
* Knowledge of kitchen utility requirements, including plumbing, drainage, electrical connections, gas piping, and ventilation/exhaust systems.
* Ability to read and coordinate architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Strong attention to detail, drawing accuracy, and dimensional coordination.
* Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in large-scale commercial kitchen projects, hotel kitchens, institutional kitchens, food courts, and multi-outlet restaurant projects.
* Familiarity with commercial kitchen equipment specifications, equipment schedules, and fabrication drawings.
* Experience coordinating with kitchen equipment suppliers, fabricators, consultants, and site execution teams.
* Ability to work on multiple projects and meet design submission deadlines.

**Key Competencies**

* Commercial kitchen space planning
* Technical drafting and detailing
* Equipment layout and coordination
* AutoCAD drafting
* MEP services coordination
* Site measurement and drawing revisions
* Vendor and project team coordination

**Application Process**

Interested candidates may share their updated CV, highlighting their experience in commercial kitchen design, relevant project exposure, and software proficiency, at **hr.wsa@shreesukhsagar.in** or via WhatsApp at **8422898525**.

Ensures we do not diverge from approved patterns, technology standards, and compliance regulations. Delivers well-designed, testable, efficient code and/or infrastructure componentry. Excels within the DLC and can partner with business and infrastructure to collect/interpret requirements and present back in clearly defined flowcharts with all supporting documentation.
  
  
Defines and implements new automation and AI tooling, and evangelizes across the team.
  
  
Serve as the primary technical owner for key initiatives, driving technical strategy, patterns, and standards across platforms, services, and integrations.
  
  
Partner closely with product, business, and engineering teams to define requirements, shape roadmaps, and ensure solutions meet client and regulatory needs.
  
  
Evaluate and select technologies (cloud services, data platforms, integration frameworks, infrastructure components, applications), balancing performance, cost, scalability, and operational resilience.
  
  
Produce high-quality design artifacts (architecture diagrams, sequence flows, APIs, data models) and maintain clear, traceable documentation.
  
  
Knowledgeable of emerging technologies and associated services.
  
  
Implement reference implementations, prototypes, and proof-of-concepts to de-risk assumptions and accelerate decision-making.
  
  
Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code where appropriate; set engineering quality bars for reliability, observability, and performance.
  
  
Establish and enforce non-functional requirements (availability, latency, throughput, recoverability), and define SLOs/SLIs with robust monitoring and alerting
  
  
Champion security-by-design and privacy-by-default principles—threat modeling, secure coding, data protection, encryption, and compliance alignment.
  
  
Drive integration strategies for legacy and modern systems (APIs, event streaming, messaging, microservices), ensuring interoperability and data integrity.
  
  
Guide CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to streamline delivery, reduce risk, and improve release velocity.
  
  
Lead technical reviews (design, code, readiness) and provide constructive feedback to elevate engineering standards across teams.
  
  
Identify and remediate technical debt strategically—prioritize modernization efforts and build migration paths that minimize disruption.
  
  
Mentor and influence engineers without formal line management—uplift skills in architecture, design, testing, and operational excellence.
  
  
Expertise in architecting large-scale, distributed systems and producing high-fidelity design artifacts (diagrams, APIs, data models, migration plans). Proficiency in cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD with strong testing, observability, and SRE practices. Strong integration and data skills across APIs, event streaming (e.g., Kafka), and governance, with security-by-design, privacy-by-default, and alignment to regulatory/compliance requirements.
  
  
Subject matter expert in at least one of the tools/technologies used in the space.
  
  
Executive-ready communication and influence without line management—driving technical strategy, risk management, vendor due diligence, and cross-functional alignment to measurable outcomes
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
  
  
9-11 years of experience in software development or technology infrastructure engineering required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus. Job holder must have understanding interdependencies and business impact of future IT plans. S/he must have prior lead experience selecting and implementing vendor-specific methodologies and prior consulting experience with structured methodologies. Extensive experience with developing and supporting mainframe applications required. Job holder must have broad experience with multi-platform development tools and toolkits.

title: Teamhead Cloud Native Platform Engineering
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
The Teamhead Cloud Native Engineering leads a team of 4 engineers and reports directly to the Head of Cloud Native Platforms in Herzogenaurach. This role carries full responsibility for the team’s cloud engineering output, direction, and quality.
  
  
A Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and manages cloud landing zones to ensure they are scalable, reliable, and secure. They work with cloud service providers like Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure to deploy and optimize cloud resources
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:**

* Lead the design and implementation of complex cloud solutions on Azure and GCP following the architectural framework.
* Oversee and optimize the deployment and management of applications on our global cloud platforms.
* Manage and enhance the security, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure.
* Continuously monitor and strategically optimize resources for peak performance.
* Develop and enforce advanced security measures to safeguard data and applications.
* Design and implement automation strategies using tools like Terraform or Ansible.
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues in the cloud environment efficiently.
* Evaluate and oversee the impact of changes on existing cloud solutions and guiding team members through complex modifications.
* Create documentation of technical concepts that enhance team understanding and support strategic decision-making.
* Lead collaboration efforts with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless cloud integration.
* Mentor junior team members.

**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**

* Several years of experience in cloud engineering, with proven hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture principles including containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible for automated provisioning and configuration management.
* Solid knowledge of cloud security best practices, identity and access management, and data protection standards.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for continuous delivery and automated testing.
* Strong monitoring and observability skills using tools such as Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Grafana, or equivalent.
* Ability to lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to document complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences.
* Deep knowledge of Microsoft CAF / Google FAST / Landing zone principles

**Key Technologies:**

* Cloud Platforms: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible
* Containerisation & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins
* Monitoring & Observability: Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations
* Security: Azure Security Center, IAM, encryption, compliance frameworks
* Networking & Storage: VNet, VPC, load balancing, blob/object storage, managed databases
* Scripting & Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell

**Leadership Expectations:**
At PUMA, engineering leaders are expected to shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine technical excellence and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA’s culture.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking & Vision**

* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.
* Ability to define and drive OKRs

**Ownership & Accountability**

* Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a relentless focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Build, grow, and retain diverse, high-performing teams that can deliver effectively at scale.
* Foster a culture of open, two-way feeback (upwards and downwards)
* Create a culture of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where people can do their best work.
* Support learning, growth, and ongoing development while giving teams the autonomy and accountability to succeed.
* Recognise achievements, celebrate success, and nurture a culture where strong performance and enjoyment coexist.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Develop strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to deliver shared outcomes.
* Influence stakeholders at all levels through credibility, openness, and clear communication.
* Show confidence in decisions while staying receptive to challenge, feedback, and different viewpoints.
* Lead with a team-first approach, removing silos and encouraging collaboration across functions and regions.

**Innovation & Continuous Learning**

* Promote modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a mindset of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, continuous learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to uncover new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Make room for innovation while maintaining discipline in execution and delivery.
* Continuously elevate engineering excellence, operational maturity, and the consumer experience.

**Commercial & Consumer Mindset**

* Understand how technology decisions influence consumer experience and business results.
* Make decisions that strike the right balance between innovation, speed, quality, and commercial value.
* Keep a strong consumer-first perspective, ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful value.
* Apply sound judgment and confidence when turning business priorities into engineering outcomes.

**Building PUMA's Future**

* Serve as a visible culture champion and role model as PUMA continues to grow its Global Tech Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the chance to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others around a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Build an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all part of achieving success.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

description:

* be a hands-on engineering lead involved in analysis, design, design/code reviews, coding and release activities

* acquire functional knowledge of the business capability being digitized/re-engineered.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

title: FinOps Platform Engineer
description:

Responsible for defining, building and communicating a shared technical and architectural vision for a Product Team to help ensure the system or solution is fit for its intended purpose.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Defines, explores, and supports the implementation of enablers to evolve solution intent, working directly with Product teams to implement them; Guides enablers through planning and enablement, and work with customers and suppliers to help ensure fitness for purpose. Enables the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps - advocates for and steers the development and improvement of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, as well as helps architects to enable Release on Demand. Defines & implement subsystems and their interfaces, allocate responsibilities to subsystems, understands solution deployment, and communicates requirements for interactions with solution context, defines Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs). Participates in planning, definition, and high-level design of the solution and explore solution alternatives. Works with Product Owners to determine the capacity allocation for enablement work; Participates in Planning, Pre- and Post-PI Planning, System and Solution Reviews, and Inspect and Adapt Events. Delivers solution adhering to standards and leveraging re-use of components; Provides oversight and fosters Built-In Quality and Team and Technical Agility; Adopts new mindsets and habits in how people approach their work while supporting decentralized decision making. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-of-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Proactively seeks opportunities to enhance efficiency in the build and deploy processes, promote reusability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solutions by leveraging automation where possible. Create high-level and detail design of infrastructure, interfaces, extensions, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.
  
  
**Competencies**
Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
  
  
Agile Architecture - Designs the fundamental organization of a system embodied by its components, their relationships to each other and to the environment to guide its emergent design and evolution.
  
  
Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.
  
  
Business Architecture Design - Defines and creates business capability maps using standards, templates, tools and methodologies to provide a common understanding of key capabilities aligned to strategic objectives and tactical demands.
  
  
Continuous Delivery Pipeline - Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on-demand release of value to the end user.
  
  
Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset - Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization.
  
  
Regulatory Risk Compliance Management - Evaluates the design and effectiveness of controls against established industry frameworks and regulations to assess adherence with legal/regulatory requirements.
  
  
Release Planning - Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability.
  
  
System Solution Architecture - Creates solution designs and patterns using the Cummins Technical Reference Model (CTRM), CLEAN standards, and existing reference patterns to maintain alignment to Cummins standards.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Business or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
Google, AWS, Azure, Oracle, Docker, Kubernetes, Puppet, CompTIA, and other Cloud Development Certifications are preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
5+ years of relevant experience required. Experience in IT utilizing a broad knowledge base in fundamental IT skills, modern development and deployment practices, DevSecOps tooling and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) knowledge preferred. Hands on experience as an IT Architect preferred.
  
  
**Qualifications**

**5+ years of experience**
in cloud financial operations, this role supports end-to-end FinOps delivery—spanning budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, optimization strategies, and data-driven decision support. title: Principal Data Platform Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Principal Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is seeking a highly influential Principal Data Platform Architect to help define and deliver the next generation of enterprise data capabilities.
  
  
This role will lead the design and evolution of strategic platforms that simplify how external data is securely exchanged with Mastercard and enable product teams, consultants, and analysts to more easily discover, access, and leverage enterprise data. The successful candidate will help transform complex, fragmented data processes into scalable, self-service experiences that accelerate innovation and unlock greater value from Mastercard's data assets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define Enterprise Data Platform Strategy
  
  
Drive the technical vision and architecture for enterprise data onboarding, exchange, discovery, and consumption capabilities.
  
  
Develop roadmaps that balance immediate business needs with long-term platform scalability and reuse.
  
  
Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring data workflows across Mastercard.
  
  
Enable Frictionless Data Exchange
  
  
Design capabilities that streamline the secure onboarding, sharing, and management of external data.
  
  
Establish reusable patterns for data integration, governance, observability, lineage, and compliance.
  
  
Reduce reliance on bespoke solutions through automation and self-service capabilities.
  
  
Democratize Access to Data
  
  
Create intuitive ways for product teams, consultants, analysts, and AI-powered solutions to discover and utilize trusted enterprise data.
  
  
Enable self-service analytics and rapid solution development without requiring deep technical expertise.
  
  
Partner with governance and security teams to balance accessibility with appropriate controls.
  
  
Provide Technical Leadership
  
  
Serve as a technical authority across multiple engineering organizations.
  
  
Influence architecture and technology decisions without direct authority.
  
  
Establish engineering standards, best practices, and reference architectures.
  
  
Mentor engineers and architects across the organization.
  
  
Partner Across the Business
  
  
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Security, and business stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.
  
  
Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
Build alignment around platform investments and strategic priorities.
  
  
**All About You**
Extensive experience architecting and building large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise integration solutions across both on-premises and cloud environments, leveraging technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, NiFi, Hadoop/Cloudera, Databricks, and modern cloud-native data services.
  
  
Deep expertise in data engineering, data architecture, data integration, and cloud-native platforms.
  
  
Experience building reusable platforms that serve multiple products, teams, or business domains.
  
  
Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, security, metadata, and data quality practices.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across organizations.
  
  
Exceptional communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Proven track record of translating ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data ecosystems (Oracle, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.).
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technical Architect_D-3455
description:
We are seeking an experienced
**Solution Architect**
ready to define the architecture, set technical direction and govern robust enterprise solutions across our business application landscape at Allianz Technology. Experience in SAP SuccessFactors architecture, integration architecture, OpenText and the wider HR systems landscape is a strong plus.
  
  
**You will …**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for business applications, define the target architecture and roadmap, and align them with enterprise architecture and business strategy.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable designs covering application, data, integration and security aspects.
* Lead architecture and design decisions, run design reviews and ensure solutions comply with Allianz Technology architecture principles, standards and the Design Authority process.
* Design and govern integrations between applications and platforms, including APIs, middleware, file-based and event-driven interfaces.
* Define and govern the platform strategy, including high availability, disaster recovery, performance, capacity planning, upgrade paths and cloud (Azure/AWS) readiness.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for 3rd-level support and major incidents, lead root-cause analysis and drive long-term fixes together with vendors and internal teams.
* Steer the management of system updates, patches and enhancements, ensuring compliance with IT security and regulatory requirements.
* Embed data security, access control and compliance with GDPR and other relevant regulations by design in all solutions and integrations.
* Where relevant, contribute to the architecture of the HR application landscape, including SAP SuccessFactors, related integrations and content management solutions such as OpenText.
* Collaborate with IT leadership, business stakeholders, enterprise architects and external vendors, and advise them on technology choices, risks and trade-offs.
* Mentor and coach consultants and developers, set engineering and configuration best practices, and keep architecture documentation and knowledge material current.

**Your Skills**

* Around 12+ years of overall IT experience, including a minimum of 6+ years designing and architecting enterprise applications and solutions, with at least 3+ years in an architect or technical lead role.
* Solid experience in solution and enterprise architecture across application, data, integration and security domains, with a track record of leading implementations from design to go-live.
* Strong knowledge of integration architecture and patterns, including REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, event-driven and file-based interfaces, middleware and API management.
* Strong knowledge of architecture for security, high availability, disaster recovery and performance, including database design and Windows Server/Linux environments.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) and with planning migrations, upgrades and modernisation of enterprise platforms.
* Experience creating and presenting architecture artefacts (e.g. arc42, ADRs, solution designs) and working within architecture governance and design authority processes.
* Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL certification is a major plus) and experience using tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or Remedy.

title: Power Platform Architect - VOIS

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Power Platform Architect to provide technical leadership for the Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform ecosystem within Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will take ownership of the architecture, design, governance and delivery of AI-driven employee experiences, with an initial focus on AskHR, Vodafone’s global AI-powered HR assistant.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, SAP and Google Cloud technologies to build scalable, secure and enterprise-grade conversational solutions. They will play a key role in advancing conversation-led employee experiences, establishing reusable AI and automation patterns, and accelerating digital transformation across HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement and Legal functions.

Agent Architecture and AI Experience Design

Process Automation and Enterprise Integration

Hybrid AI and Multi-Cloud Architecture

* Support interoperability using industry-standard protocols including MCP and A2A

Governance, Security and Operational Excellence
  
  

* Own Power Platform governance, environment strategy, solutions management, CI/CD pipelines and release processes
* Establish and maintain DLP policies, Managed Environments and Centre of Excellence practices
* Embed security, privacy and responsible AI principles throughout the solution lifecycle
* Implement monitoring and analytics using Copilot Studio Analytics and Application Insights
* Ensure highly available, scalable and reliable solutions that support a global workforce

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to distributed development teams
* Define architecture standards, design principles and implementation best practices
* Conduct solution reviews, technical assessments and architecture governance activities
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, DevOps, SAP, Security and Enterprise Architecture teams
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft AI capabilities and make recommendations for adoption

Initial Focus Areas
  
  

* Take technical ownership of the Copilot Studio and Power Platform landscape supporting AskHR
* Remove technical delivery constraints across Microsoft Copilot and SAP-integrated solutions
* Define target-state architecture, standards and governance models
* Accelerate SAP-enabled employee journeys and validate hybrid knowledge architectures
* Support the evolution of AskHR into a fully conversation-led and agentic employee experience

**Who You Are**
Essential Skills and Experience
  
  

* Extensive experience in enterprise application architecture and integration, typically gained across complex, large-scale environments
* Significant hands-on experience as a Power Platform Architect or technical lead delivering production-grade solutions
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, including generative AI and agentic capabilities
* Strong experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Fx and Azure integration services
* Proven experience integrating SAP platforms and enterprise APIs
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity management and enterprise security practices
* Experience establishing and governing enterprise-scale Power Platform environments
* Practical understanding of generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering and solution evaluation
* Hands-on software development experience using technologies such as C#/.NET, TypeScript, Python and Power Fx
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, influence architectural decisions and mentor colleagues

**Desirable Skills And Experience**

* Experience with Google Cloud AI services, including Vertex AI, Agent Builder and Gemini
* Exposure to Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI services
* Microsoft certifications such as PL-600, PL-400, Copilot Studio or AI-related credentials
* Experience within HR, Finance, Supply Chain or Procurement domains

* Experience integrating ServiceNow or comparable IT service management platforms
* Experience delivering multilingual solutions across multiple regions and markets

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered employee experiences at global scale.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies across Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, SAP and Google Cloud ecosystems.Ability to influence enterprise architecture and AI strategy across multiple corporate functions.Work on high-visibility transformational programmes impacting employees globally.Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Product, Engineering, AI, Architecture and Business domains.Opportunity to establish reusable AI and automation capabilities that create lasting business impact.Continuous exposure to emerging AI, automation and cloud technologies.

Advanced agentic AI architecture and conversational experience design.Enterprise-scale Microsoft Copilot Studio implementation and governance practices.Hybrid AI architectures spanning Microsoft and Google Cloud platforms.Advanced SAP integration strategies within conversational AI ecosystems.Enterprise AI governance, responsible AI and security-by-design practices.Large-scale Power Platform ALM, DevOps and operational excellence frameworks.Cross-functional stakeholder management within global digital transformation programmes.

This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. * Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans.

* Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation.

* Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.

* Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

**Working with Us**

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*

title: System Architect
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The System Architect, based in Noida, will define the technical vision and target architecture for secure, scalable IAM platforms and AI-native engineering capabilities. The role combines deep systems architecture expertise with hands-on leadership in agentic AI, AI coding agents, and modern software delivery.
  
  
The architect will design identity capabilities for workforce, customer, partner, machine, workload, and AI-agent identities, covering authentication, authorization, governance, adaptive access, threat detection, and secure delegation.
  
  
The role will lead AI-native practices across architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, and operations. The successful candidate must use and govern AI coding agents in real engineering workflows and design agentic systems with bounded autonomy, traceability, and enterprise-grade quality, security, privacy, and compliance.
  
  
**Essential Functions / Key Areas Of Responsibility**

* Own the target architecture and roadmap for IAM and AI-enabled platforms, aligned with business strategy, Zero Trust, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
* Architect identity, lifecycle, credential, authorization, delegation, governance, audit, and threat-detection capabilities for human and non-human identities.
* Design agentic AI systems that plan, use tools, collaborate, and execute multi-step workflows within defined security and operational boundaries.
* Define guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, human approval, tool access, runtime isolation, context, observability, auditability, and safe failure.
* Lead AI-native engineering across requirements, architecture, coding, testing, reviews, documentation, deployment, and operations.
* Use AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and delivery automation.
* Govern AI-assisted development through approved-tool controls, data protection, output validation, secure review, provenance, and traceability.
* Translate business outcomes into reference architectures, decision records, quality attributes, service objectives, and implementation guardrails.
* Architect resilient cloud-native, distributed, event-driven, and API-first systems with strong production readiness and cost efficiency.
* Lead architecture reviews, threat modeling, technical discovery, proofs of concept, build-versus-buy analysis, and cross-functional decisions.
* Partner with product, engineering, security, data, operations, compliance, and legal teams to deliver secure, auditable, resilient solutions.
* Mentor architects and engineers and produce clear, reusable architecture guidance, threat models, diagrams, evaluations, and runbooks.

**Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language**

* 12+ years designing and delivering complex software platforms, with substantial architecture, technical leadership, and cross-functional delivery responsibility.
* 7+ years in IAM across customer or workforce identity, federation, SSO, MFA, password less access, lifecycle governance, privileged access, and fine-grained authorization.
* Minimum requirement: hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI solutions using planning, tool invocation, retrieval, context or memory, multi-step workflows and human or policy controls.
* Minimum requirement: hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, reviews, documentation, or delivery automation.
* Experience governing AI-generated code through human review, automated testing, security scanning, secrets and dependency checks, provenance, and auditability.
* Strong generative AI knowledge covering models, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, model and tool selection, evaluation, observability, cost, and responsible AI.
* Practical understanding of agent risks, including prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure tool use, data leakage, identity spoofing, supply-chain compromise, and unsafe actions.
* Strong experience with cloud-native, distributed, multi-tenant systems, APIs, asynchronous messaging, containers, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, and observability.
* Deep IAM knowledge, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkeys, PKI, workload identity, secrets, and policy-based authorization.
* Strong system-design fundamentals across domain and API design, resilience, consistency, scalability, performance, security, privacy, data architecture, and operations.
* Hands-on capability across modern programming ecosystems, quality engineering, threat modeling, technical specifications, architecture decisions, and reference implementations.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders, lead technical decisions, mentor engineers, and align product, engineering, security, and operations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting identity, authorization, delegation, and governance for AI agents and other non-human identities.
* Experience with secure agent-to-tool and agent-to-agent integration, including Model Context Protocol or equivalent approaches.
* Experience with specification-driven development, reusable AI workflows, and organization-wide AI-assisted engineering adoption.
* Experience evaluating, red-teaming, monitoring, and responding to incidents involving generative or agentic AI systems.
* Experience with AI-enabled identity or security capabilities, including adaptive access, behavioral analytics, threat detection, fraud, risk scoring, or identity proofing.
* Experience designing model-agnostic AI platforms, enterprise knowledge integration, reusable agents, and cost-aware model routing.
* Experience with software and AI supply-chain security, regulated platforms, or contributions to architecture communities, standards, publications, or open source.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

description:

• We are looking for a visionary technology leader responsible for driving the strategy, automation, and transformation of the enterprise IT operations landscape.

• This expanded role will oversee Service Improvement Initiatives and Adoption of AI‑Ops & autonomous operations to deliver a self‑healing, predictive, and highly automated IT environment.

• This leader is accountable for significantly reducing manual support dependencies by implementing AI‑driven automation frameworks that eliminate L1 support (100%) and reduce L2 support effort by at least 50%, while ensuring world‑class performance, reliability, and security across IT services.

Key Responsibilities
:

1. Strategic & Autonomous Operations Leadership

• Define and execute a long-term strategy for AI, autonomous operations, and AI driven service management.

• Build /Operationalize an enterprise-wide framework for Autonomous IT Operations (AIOps), ensuring seamless integration with infrastructure, cloud, and SRE functions.

• Lead the implementation of AI agents, decisioning engines, and self-healing automation across service operations.

• Lead & drive Continual Service Improvement Programs across critical inhouse & partner managed Apps & Infra for higher availability on IT Side.

2. Operational Excellence & Automation Transformation

• Achieve 100% elimination of L1 support through predictive automation, intelligent routing, and autonomous resolution workflows.

• Deliver 50% reduction in L2 support workload through AI based diagnostics, automated remediations, and knowledge orchestration.

• Oversee implementation of AI driven monitoring, anomaly detection, auto triaging, and automated incident remediation.

• Optimize IT operations through AIOps, observability platforms, and closed loop automation.

3. Innovation & Technology Modernization

• Lead modernization of CI/CD, IaC, and DevSecOps with embedded AI and smart orchestration.

• Build a center of excellence for autonomous operations and AI first service engineering.

4. Incident, Problem & Change Management Automation

• Deploy automated playbooks, AI guided root cause analysis, and recommendation engines.

• Implement self-service and conversational AI capabilities across ITSM platforms.

• Ensure proactive detection (MTTD < 5 minutes) and rapid recovery (MTTR < 1 hour) through automation.

5. Stakeholder & Vendor Engagement

• Communicate operational health, transformation progress, AI impact, and risk posture to senior leadership.

• Partner with cybersecurity, product, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure secure and compliant autonomous operations.

• Manage strategic vendor partnerships for AI, observability, infrastructure, and automation technologies.

• Drive enterprise-wide AI adoption by conducting workshops and training sessions on AI platforms, identifying high-value business use cases, and acting as the bridge between IT teams and AI engineering. The role will champion AI awareness, translate IT needs into AI solutions, and ensure successful adoption and value realization.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field (B.E./BTech preferred).

• 15+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, DevOps, and IT operations automation.

• Strong hands-on experience with AIOps platforms, Agentic AI models, and autonomous operations frameworks.

• Proven background in large scale IT modernization, observability, and reliability engineering.

• Expertise in cloud operations (AWS/Azure/OCI), Kubernetes, container orchestration etc.

• Deep understanding of AI/ML, automation platforms, scripting (Python/Shell), and integration pipelines.

• Experience with ITSM platforms, incident automation, and workflow orchestration.

• Strong leadership capabilities with experience in driving major automation transformations.

• Strong hands-on experience with AIOps platforms, Agentic AI models, and autonomous operations frameworks.

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
Job Req Number: 92432
  
  
Time Type: Full Time
  
  
Job Description: Database Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
Industry
  
  
  

* Industrial Technology and Automation: Logistics & Supply Chain

Employment Type
  
  
  

* Full-time

Are you ready to develop your career in a rapidly growing and successful global company acting in a fast-paced role? If you are someone looking for a position that challenges and inspire you in a successful international company, DSV is your place.
  
  
The DSV group, headquartered in Denmark, is one of the biggest transports and logistics companies in the world, with more than 75,000 dedicated employees, operating in more than 90 countries.
  
  
You will join a global and determined group driven forward by the desire to grow and will be part of a dynamic group, which is characterized by high level professionalization and constant improvement.
  
  
Who do we look for?
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
As a Database Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the architecture of our database systems. You will work closely with other IT professionals and departments to ensure our database infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. Additionally, you will participate in guard duty rotations to ensure 24/7 support and monitoring of our database systems.
  
  
  

* Infrastructure Design: Develop and implement database infrastructure strategies that support business goals and ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
* Architecture Development: Design and architect database solutions, including data modeling, schema design, and integration with other systems.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend new database technologies and tools to enhance our infrastructure.
* Automation: Implement automation for database deployment, management, and monitoring using tools like Ansible to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Virtualization: Utilize virtualization technologies such as VMware, OpenShift, and Kubernetes to manage and deploy containerized database applications.
* Vulnerability Management: Identify and address database vulnerabilities, ensuring timely application of patches and updates to maintain security and compliance.
* Security: Ensure database security by designing and implementing robust security measures, including access controls and encryption.
* Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and availability in case of failures.
* Collaboration: Work with development and operations teams to support database-related projects and initiatives.
* Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation of database architecture, configurations, and procedures.
* Guard Duty: Participate in guard duty rotations to provide 24/7 support and monitoring of database systems.

Qualifications:
  
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in database infrastructure engineering and architecture.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), data modeling, infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Ansible), and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, OpenShift, Kubernetes) Strong architecture skills are essential.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design and implement complex database solutions.
* Communication: Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle Certified Master, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a plus.

Location: Noida (India)
  
  
We offer you:
  
  
The opportunity to expand your experience in a truly international, world-class company whose philosophy is that your everyday work should be both varied and full of professional challenges, with wide opportunities for constant professional and personal development.
  
  
Additionally, we offer the following:
  
  
  

* Medical Insurance including family and Parents up to 10 Lakh INR per year
* 2.5 days earned leave per month which is 30 days in a calendar year & 10 days Sick Leave in a year
* Parking for 4-wheeler or 2-wheeler vehicle
* Personal Mobile and Internet expenses reimbursed per calendar month subject to maximum cap.

**DSV – Global Transport and Logistics**
DSV is a dynamic workplace that fosters inclusivity and diversity. We conduct our business with integrity, respecting different cultures and the dignity and rights of individuals. When you join DSV, you are working for one of the very best performing companies in the transport and logistics industry. You’ll join a talented team of approximately 75,000 employees in over 80 countries, working passionately to deliver great customer experiences and high-quality services. title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**
The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Backend Architecture and Hands-on Development: - Own the design and development of Ripik's backend platform built on Java 21+ and Spring Boot 4 x, including RESTful and gRPC APIs, microservices decomposition, event-driven pipelines, and integration layers that connect AI inference engines with factory-floor systems. - Architect for scale, reliability, and low latency: design services that handle high-throughput streams from industrial IoT sensors and vision cameras, process them through message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and persist results across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and time-series stores (TimescaleDB / InfluxDB). - Make key technology and design decisions: Spring Security and OAuth 2.0 / JWT for multi-tenant authentication, Spring Data for repository abstractions, Spring Cloud for service discovery and configuration, and Hibernate / JPA for ORM while keeping the codebase clean, testable, and well-documented. - Drive API design standards (OpenAPI / Swagger), enforce contract-first development, and ensure backend services expose well-versioned, idempotent, and backward-compatible interfaces consumed by the frontend and external integrations. - Champion production engineering: build observability into every service with structured logging (ELK/Loki), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger), metrics (Prometheus/Grafana), and own SLAs and incident response for the backend stack. Full-Stack Product Delivery: - Lead end-to-end product builds from the ground up, translate product requirements into technical architecture, break them into epics and stories, and ship complete features spanning backend APIs, database schemas, and frontend UIs. - Collaborate closely with frontend engineers building operator dashboards and configuration portals (React/Next.js, TypeScript) to review UI/UX implementation, ensure performant API integration, and maintain a cohesive full-stack development workflow. - Own the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes on AWS / Azure / GCP), automate testing (unit, integration, E2E), and enforce quality gates so that every merge to main is production-ready. - Coordinate with the AI/Data Science teams to integrate ML model outputs (computer vision inferences, LLM responses) into the platform, designing the serving layer, result-caching strategy, and feedback loops that connect model predictions with user-facing features. - Manage cloud infrastructure decisions across Ripik's multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises installations at customer factory sites, balancing cost, compliance, and latency requirements. Team Leadership and Scrum Management: - Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of backend and frontend engineers; set clear expectations, conduct regular 1:1s, drive career development, and foster a culture of ownership and technical excellence. - Run Scrum ceremonies end-to-end: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring the team delivers predictably while staying agile enough to respond to shifting priorities in a fast-moving start-up. - Conduct thorough code reviews and architecture reviews; enforce engineering best practices around testing (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers), code quality (SonarQube), and secure coding standards. - Hire and onboard strong engineers; raise the technical bar continuously through pairing, tech talks, design-document culture, and a bias toward building reusable, well-abstracted components. - Act as the primary engineering interface with Product, Design, AI, Field Engineering, and Customer - Success translating business needs into well-scoped engineering work and communicating trade-offs, timelines, and risks transparently to leadership. Requirements: - B. Tech / M. Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. - 6-10 years of total software engineering experience with a strong backend focus, of which at least 2 years in a tech lead, engineering lead, or engineering manager role. - Deep hands-on expertise in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot 3 x / 4 x, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, and Spring WebFlux (reactive)). Ability to write production-grade code, not just review it. - Strong experience designing and building microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, event-driven systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and database layers (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis). - Proven track record of building applications from the ground up, greenfield product development in a SaaS or product-company context, and taking features from whiteboard to production. - Experience leading and managing teams of both backend and frontend engineers, comfortable reviewing React/TypeScript code, guiding frontend architecture decisions, and maintaining full-stack delivery velocity. - Hands-on experience running Scrum / Agile processes: sprint planning, backlog management, velocity tracking, and retrospectives with a practical, outcome-driven approach (not ceremony for ceremony's sake). - Strong DevOps and deployment experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins), and at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure / GCP also valued). - Solid understanding of system design fundamentals: caching strategies, load balancing, rate limiting, database indexing, horizontal scaling, and high-availability patterns. - Experience in a high-growth start-up or similarly fast-paced environment where shipping speed, scrappiness, and wearing multiple hats are the norm. - Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical trade-offs to product and business stakeholders, write clear RFCs and design documents, and present to leadership. Company Summary We are building an AI platform to make manufacturing more competitive. We enable the shop-floor managers and plant teams to take better decisions via an AI-ML-based DIY platform where they can run analytics and get recommendations. Our mission is to make manufacturing operations more efficient, productive, and sustainable. We build deep tech solutions such as digital twin which are easy to use. Our solutions have helped clients improve their throughput, quality, yield, and energy efficiency. Our products deliver real value - moving KPIs that matter in manufacturing and industrial companies. title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms

+ Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

* Operations

+ Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
+ Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

* Public and Private Cloud

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

* Interaction & Communication

+ Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
