title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
****Overview:****
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
*.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “*
*name@cvent.com*
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.*
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud*
*.*
****In This Role, You Will:****
Cvent is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team in Gurugram, India to help build and maintain the platform behind our event and hospitality SaaS business. This is a high impact engineering role for a person who thrives at:
  
  

* solving complex platform challenges,
* partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent’s customers, and
* executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption

In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale.
  
  
****In This Role, You Will:****

* Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments.
* Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability.
* Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis.
* Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges.
* Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving.
* Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution.

****How You Will Spend Your Time****
This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is:
  
  

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
description:
**Position Title:**DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O

**Position Type:** Regular - Full-Time

**Requisition ID:** 45078

Role Overview

The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.

Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.

Key Responsibilities

**Platform Engineering & Reliability:** Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.

**CI/CD & Release Engineering:** Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.

**DevSecOps Adoption:** Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance.

**Security by Design:** Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

**Infrastructure as Code:** Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.

**GitOps & Kubernetes:** Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman.

**Toolchain Availability:** Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows.

**Automated Governance:** Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines.

**Observability & Self-Healing:** Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience.

**Performance & Operations:** Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure.

**Cross-Functional Architecture:** Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards.

**AI-Assisted Engineering:** Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.

**Documentation & Enablement:** Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.

**Automation Culture:** Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.

Required Skills and Experience

Core Experience

**10+ years of relevant experience** in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.

**Hands-on engineering experience** designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks.

**Strong programming and scripting capability** using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages.

**Proven operational discipline** across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation.

**Strong communication and collaboration skills** with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams.

Technical Capabilities Required

**Capability Area**

**Expected Experience**

**Cloud Platforms**

Microsoft Azure (Must); Google Cloud Platform (Nice to have).

**Source Control & CI/CD**

GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms.

**Infrastructure as Code & Configuration**

Terraform, Terratest, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt, or equivalent tools.

**Containers & Orchestration**

Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, kubectl, Helm, Docker, Podman, or comparable technologies.

**GitOps & Continuous Delivery**

Argo CD, Flux CD, or equivalent GitOps tooling.

**Application & Supply-Chain Security**

SonarQube, Snyk, Akido, Chaingaurd, SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, dependency scanning, secrets scanning, and quality gates.

**Artifact & Package Management**

JFrog Artifactory or equivalent artifact repositories.

**Observability**

Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or equivalent monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms.

**ITSM & Work Management**

ServiceNow, Jira, automated change integration, and auditable delivery workflows. Handson Experience of integrating DevOps tools chain and ServiceNow and Jira Integration

**Testing & Service Virtualization**

Selenium, Tosca, automated functional/performance/security testing, and service virtualization tools.

**Linux & Networking**

Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine, RHEL; TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, SMTP, FTP, and cloud networking fundamentals.

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding and engineering assistants, used within defined governance and security controls.

Qualifications

**Bachelor’s degree** in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

**Relevant public cloud certification** in Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is required.

**DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, or CNCF certification** is preferred.

**Experience with Agile and DevOps delivery methods** and with planning, estimation, and delivery in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

**Demonstrated learning agility** with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies responsibly.

Preferred Attributes

* Systems thinker who balances developer experience, security, reliability, governance, and cost.
* Self-starter who can operate with appropriate autonomy while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment.
* Pragmatic engineer who favors standards, reusable products, automation, and measurable outcomes over one-off solutions.
* Curious and adaptable, with a commitment to continuous learning and responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.

Key Outcomes

* **Secure delivery:** Security and compliance controls are consistently embedded and evidenced within delivery pipelines.
* **Reliable platforms:** DevSecOps services meet defined availability, performance, recovery, and support expectations.
* **Faster flow:** Standardized automation reduces manual effort and enables repeatable, lower-risk releases.
* **Developer enablement:** Product teams can adopt approved cloud and DevSecOps capabilities through clear, reusable patterns.
* **Operational excellence:** Observability, incident learning, self-healing, and continuous improvement reduce recurring issues and operational toil.
* **Responsible AI adoption:** AI-assisted engineering improves productivity without compromising security, governance, quality, or cost control.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1721633

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY GDS – EBS DBA / OCI Senior Position**

  

Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. To support this fast paced and evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Oracle E Business Suite (EBS) expertise combined with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and automation driven database practices to deliver secure, high performance, and resilient solutions for mission critical business applications.

As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Senior EBS DBA / OCI professional, supporting large scale Oracle EBS environments across on premises and cloud deployments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, including EBS migrations to OCI, database upgrades, high availability design, and performance optimization, while contributing to the development of next generation EBS and OCI platforms in a collaborative, international delivery environment.

  

**The opportunity**

  

We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Oracle Database, SQL Database and Cloud Infrastructure OCI/Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and high availability solutions for mission critical enterprise applications. This position provides the opportunity to collaborate with global stakeholders and supporting large scale cloud migration, database modernization, and operational excellence initiatives.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Overseeing Oracle EBS database administration and OCI implementation, and identifying opportunities for performance, scalability, and availability improvements.
* Accountable for ensuring database standards, cloud architecture guidelines, and operational processes are followed across on premise and OCI environments.
* Act as the first level technical escalation point for EBS database and OCI related issues for mission critical systems.
* Perform and support end to end database and application migrations from on premises environments to OCI, guiding teams through design, execution, and stabilization.
* Responsible for technical decision making, solution design, environment optimization, and supporting implementation activities for EBS and Oracle database workloads.
* Accountable for collaborating with Cloud Infrastructure teams, supporting instance provisioning, virtual network design, routing rules, security configurations, and database deployments.

  

**Strong understanding of:**

  

* Oracle Database upgrades (9i/10g/11g to 12c/18c/19c)
* SQL Server DBA experience (SQL Server 2008–2019/2022)
* OCI networking, security, and database services
* Production support and cross platform migrations on Cloud

  

**Execute end to end database migrations, including:**

* Virtual network design
* Routing rules
* Security configuration
* Compute instance creation
* Database deployment and configuration
* Responsible for ensuring database configurations, operational guidelines, and technical documentation are maintained and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support database upgrades, patching, maintenance, and performance tuning for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c) running on on prem and OCI platforms.
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
* Perform gap analysis against best practices and recommend improvements related to database performance, availability, security, and cloud architecture.
* Identify at risk environments or migration challenges and work with relevant teams to mitigate risks proactively.
* Perform technical reviews and identify corrective actions to improve database reliability and operational efficiency

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team-player and self-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Technical Proof of concept (POC).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

* 2-6 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed applications.
* Extensive experience working on at least one Public Cloud – Oracle/Azure/Google. Oracle Cloud is preferred .
* BTech / MTech / MCA / MBA
* Technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts and Architectural Design Sessions to define and design a complete solution using best practices on Oracle Cloud
* System administration experience (Linux, Solaris)

  

**Additionally, good to have**

  

* Certificated in Public Cloud – Oracle/AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Certified Architect Professional
* Technical – Experience in Designing, Developing, Deploying and/or Migrating mission critical business applications to Cloud environments including re-platform of such systems
* Expertise in architecting best technical solutions based on customer requirement
* Experience giving presentations to executive audiences and explaining the benefits of the platform and service solution over competitors

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

  

**What we look for**

  

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

  

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Role Summary
  
We are seeking a highly experienced Cybersecurity professional to lead Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Management, Security Risk Governance, and Security Infrastructure Operations across the enterprise. The candidate will be responsible for architecting, implementing, and optimizing Tenable Nessus, BitSight, and Infoblox solutions while driving enterprise-wide risk reduction initiatives, vulnerability remediation programs, DNS security, compliance efforts, and cybersecurity governance.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Lead the administration, engineering, and lifecycle management of Tenable Nessus, BitSight, and Infoblox platforms.
* Define and implement enterprise Vulnerability Management and Risk Management strategies aligned with security and compliance objectives.
* Manage large-scale vulnerability assessment programs across on-premises, cloud, network, server, endpoint, and application environments.
* Establish risk-based vulnerability prioritization methodologies and remediation governance processes.
* Drive vulnerability remediation programs by collaborating with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Network, and Security Operations teams.
* Develop executive-level dashboards, KPI/KRI metrics, risk scorecards, and remediation tracking reports.
* Oversee cyber risk exposure monitoring and external attack surface assessment using BitSight.
* Assess third-party security posture, cybersecurity ratings, and supplier risk metrics, and provide strategic recommendations to reduce business risk.
* Lead security posture reviews and risk assessments and provide recommendations to senior leadership.
* Architect, administer, and optimize Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management) infrastructure.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, performance, and security of enterprise DNS and IP management services.
* Implement DNS security controls, network visibility solutions, and operational best practices.
* Lead upgrades, migrations, patching, capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational enhancements for security platforms.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory assessments, compliance initiatives, and risk management programs.
* Develop operational standards, governance frameworks, SOPs, runbooks, and service improvement plans.
* Drive automation and process optimization initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational risks.
* Engage with vendors and stakeholders to define product roadmaps, resolve complex issues, and evaluate emerging technologies.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across vulnerability management and security infrastructure domains.

Required Skills
  
Security Platforms
  

* Tenable Nessus

**Job Location - Kolkata, Hyderabad**
**Position Overview**
The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
**owning, governing, and continuously improving the technical integration landscape**
supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides
**hands-on Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) expertise**
from day one, translating integration requirements into reliable, supportable, and scalable data flows across o9 and upstream or downstream enterprise systems.
  
  
This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

**Candidate Evidence Expected**
Candidates should be prepared to provide concrete examples from recent o9 engagements, including:
  
  

* Their exact role, duration, and ownership in each o9 project.
* INT3.0 interfaces designed or delivered, source and target systems, data volumes or cadence, and production responsibilities.
* Examples of complex incidents diagnosed and permanently resolved.
* Examples of integration design documents, runbooks, monitoring approaches, or error-management practices they created.
* Python solutions personally developed and the business or operational problem addressed.
* Current o9 certifications and evidence of relevant o9 training completion.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

title: Network Engineering - Architecture Focus
description:
**Job Description**
Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: [Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end-to-end across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture & Strategy
  
  

* Own the end-to-end target-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security & Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro-segmentation, and identity-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI & Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site-to-site, and remote-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end-to-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud & Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch & Site Modernization
* Architect branch network modernization for our global manufacturing and distribution footprint, including SD-WAN and Zero Trust Branch patterns.
* Improve user experience, application access, and operational simplicity at sites by reducing dependence on centralized backhaul.
* Define site reference designs that scale across geographies and plant types. Leadership & Influence
* Mentor staff and senior engineers; raise the technical bar across the networking discipline.
* Partner with vendors and strategic technology partners on evaluations, proofs of concept, and roadmap alignment.
* Translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, business-relevant recommendations for senior leadership.
* Maintain authoritative network documentation — reference designs, topology diagrams, and standards — that the broader engineering organization can rely on. What you’ll need to be successful Must-haves
* 10+ years of network engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in an architecture role at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining enterprise reference architectures and standards adopted across a multi-site organization.
* Deep expertise across enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF), segmentation, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless.
* Strong network security architecture experience with platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass.
* Strong Azure networking experience, including VNet design, peering, private connectivity, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Experience with DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), IP schema design, and core service resiliency.
* Proven experience architecting Zero Trust Branch, micro-segmentation, or identity aware network access.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to work across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments in a global, distributed enterprise.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues clearly for both engineering and non-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement capabilities at the Director and VP level. Nice-to-haves
* Experience in manufacturing, CPG, or other industrial environments with significant OT/IT convergence considerations.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCDE, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or TOGAF.
* Experience leading vendor evaluations and architecture proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with network automation, infrastructure as code, and enterprise observability platforms. Our Total Rewards philosophy Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values. Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future — we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Travel: Up to 10–15%, as needed.

title: Vice President - Product Engineering
description:
**Role: Vice President — Product Engineering**
**Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore**
**About AppViewX:**
AppViewX is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry’s most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
  
  

* **We Do What We Say:**
  We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:**
  We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:**
  We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:**
  We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
  
  
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

**What We Require**
***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

**Why AppViewX?**
AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
  
  
AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.

* Strong stakeholder communication, project planning, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Proven experience leading distributed engineering teams, including offshore teams, and owning complex delivery from estimation through deployment and production stabilization.
* Coordinate execution across cross-functional teams, product & platform teams, and external vendors or partners involved in the client engagement.

Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time-to-value on federal client engagements.

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.

* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.

title: NOC Engineer
description:
**Who we are**

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK.

**Purpose of the Role**
:

To ensure maximum possible service availability and performance. To maintain hardware and software in our production data centres. To provide support services across our technical teams.

**Role Dimensions**
: NOC Engineer. Member of the NOC team, reporting into the NOC Manager.

**Working Arrangements :**
Monday to Sunday Shifts 24x7 rotation (5 days on 2 days off)

1.30 PM to 9.30 PM IST, 09:30 PM to 05:30 AM IST, 05:30 AM to 1:30 PM IST

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Monitoring and initial response for all system and server related issues in our multi site infrastructure.
* Work closely with 2nd line engineers and designers.
* Troubleshooting and resolution of various system issues…
* Linux Servers (Ubuntu / Debian)
* Configuration management tools
* Monitoring solutions (Prometheus / Nagios)
* Kubernetes & Docker
* Cloud platforms
* Regular testing and patching of production systems.
* First responder for production outages/incidents.

**Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications and Experience:**

* Excellent Linux skills (3+ years)
* Has used some experience with automation tools; SaltStack, Terraform, Puppet, Chef or Ansible
* Experienced with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Nagios or Zabbix
* Version control systems, ideally git
* Any knowledge of container technology is a bonus, even if not in a professional capacity; docker, cri-o, kubernetes
* Ability to read and understand some scripting language; Bash, Python, Perl
* Solid knowledge of TCP/IP
* Basic understanding of routing and switching
* Virtualization tools; VmWare, Xen, Qemu

**Personality & Attitude:**

* Self-motivation, a sense of urgency and a good working ethic are a must to be successful in this environment.
* You have a positive approach and a great attitude - resilient and constructive approach to complex technical problem-solving.
* Excellent communicator, open, honest, transparent and inclusive in your communications.
* Commitment, you’re eager to learn, you never give up, and you find solutions where others see problems.
* You’re collaborative, both an active participant and listener. Respectful of others, communicate constructively and willingly lend a hand to help others when needed.

**What’s in it for you?**

* Performance based discretionary annual bonus
* LTIP (Long term incentive plan)
* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Annually)
* 10 declared holidays (Annually)
* 5 fully paid days of Selfie Time - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.

**AI Usage during the recruitment process**

Please read our
AI Usage in Recruitment policy
to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process.

**We believe in equal opportunities**

It takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and

experiences.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible.

If you have a disability or long-term condition and need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’ll do everything we can to support you and to enable you to bring your best self to our hiring process.

The Infrastructure Specialist will be responsible for providing day-to-day administration, maintenance and L2/L3 support for enterprise server environments at a large global client. * Automate routine administration tasks using Shell, PowerShell, Python or Ansible.

**Skills Required**

* 4+ years of hands-on administration of Linux (RHEL preferred) or Windows Server in a production environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for OS, performance, boot, network and storage issues.
* Experience with patch management and server hardening.
* Working knowledge of VMware vSphere or a public cloud platform (Azure or AWS).
* Scripting in Shell, PowerShell or Python for automation.
* Understanding of DNS, DHCP, LDAP or Active Directory, SSL certificates and basic networking.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, including incident, change and problem management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or an equivalent discipline.
* Preferred certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft Certified (Windows Server or Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, or AWS certifications.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, and support on-call requirements and weekend change windows when required.
* Ability to work from the client office from day one.

* Containers (Docker) and introductory knowledge of Kubernetes or OpenShift.
* Exposure to middleware such as Apache, Tomcat, WebSphere or WebLogic.
* Experience with backup tools such as Veritas NetBackup or Commvault.

title: Engineer, NOC
description:
**About Consilio**
Consilio's consulting and services teams assist legal departments of multinational corporations and their outside counsel in responding to legal matters, reducing legal spend, minimizing risk, and operating more efficiently. Across eDiscovery, document review, and legal consulting services, Consilio is committed to delivering service excellence globally and applying proven knowledge and technology to help clients solve challenges with lower cost, lower risk, and improved speed.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The NOC Engineer provides first-line operational monitoring and incident response for Consilio's global technology environment. The role monitors infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, applications, and supporting services; validates and triages alerts; executes approved runbooks; and coordinates timely escalation and communication to minimize service disruption. The NOC Engineer contributes to reliable 24x7 operations through disciplined ticket documentation, shift handoffs, monitoring improvement, and collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, and service management teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Continuously monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of infrastructure, network, server, storage, cloud, application, and environmental services using approved monitoring and observability platforms.
* Validate, correlate, prioritize, acknowledge, and triage alerts based on business impact, severity, service dependencies, and documented operating procedures.
* Perform first-level troubleshooting and approved remediation, including service or job restarts, basic connectivity checks, log review, health validation, and execution of established runbooks.
* Create and maintain accurate incident and service tickets, including timestamps, affected services, troubleshooting performed, evidence collected, actions taken, escalation details, and final resolution.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact incidents to the correct technical team, vendor, incident commander, or management contact in accordance with defined SLAs and escalation paths.
* Initiate or support major incident bridges, maintain a clear incident timeline, provide concise stakeholder updates, and ensure ownership remains clear through service restoration.
* Complete structured shift handoffs that identify active incidents, degraded services, pending follow-ups, maintenance activities, and operational risks.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal support teams to resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and platform issues.
* Support planned maintenance and change windows by completing readiness checks, monitoring service health, documenting checkpoints, validating recovery, and communicating exceptions.
* Maintain and improve operational documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, monitoring inventories, and service ownership records.
* Assist with monitoring onboarding for new or changed services by validating dashboards, thresholds, routing, dependencies, ownership, and actionable alert content.
* Review false positives, duplicate alerts, missed detections, stale monitors, and recurring noise; recommend threshold, routing, suppression, or runbook improvements to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute incident data and timelines to problem management and post-incident reviews; track assigned corrective actions and knowledge updates to completion.
* Monitor operational performance indicators such as service availability, alert volume, mean time to detect, mean time to acknowledge, mean time to resolve, SLA compliance, and repeat incidents.
* Follow approved access control, data handling, change management, incident management, security, and audit requirements, and promptly escalate suspected security events to the appropriate response team.
* Participate in rotational shifts, weekend or holiday coverage, after-hours maintenance, and on-call support as required by business needs.

**Operational Tools and Technologies**

* Monitoring and observability: Grafana, Prometheus, and Uptime Kuma or comparable platforms.
* Incident alerting and coordination: JSM (Jira service management) or comparable on-call and incident management tools.
* IT service management and documentation: ServiceNow or another ITSM platform; SharePoint or Confluence for knowledge management.
* Operating systems and infrastructure: Windows and Linux fundamentals; server, virtualization, storage, network, and cloud concepts.
* Automation and configuration: Working knowledge of Windows PowerShell; familiarity with YAML syntax, PromQL (Prometheus Query Language) and API-based integrations is desirable.
* Core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, latency, packet loss, and common connectivity diagnostics.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in NOC, infrastructure operations, Service Now, systems administration, network support, or another 24x7 technical support environment is preferred. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships, labs, or certifications may be considered.
* Foundational understanding of incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management practices.
* Ability to interpret alerts, dashboards, logs, system events, and basic performance or capacity indicators.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow technical procedures, recognize operational risk, and escalate with complete and accurate context.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise technical updates to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and time management in a high-volume environment with shifting priorities.
* Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work rotational shifts, weekends, holidays, and scheduled maintenance windows as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, event management, or incident response tools.
* Experience supporting network, Windows, Linux, virtualization, storage, cloud, or enterprise application environments.
* Experience with ITSM ticketing platforms, CMDB concepts, service mapping, and operational knowledge management.
* Experience using PowerShell or another scripting language to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* ITIL Foundation and (or) relevant monitoring-tool certification.
* Experience in a regulated, audited, legal technology, eDiscovery, or globally distributed services environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational ownership and accountability
* Analytical troubleshooting and sound judgment
* Calm, structured response during high-impact incidents
* Customer and service orientation
* Clear communication and active listening
* Collaboration across technical teams
* Documentation discipline and attention to detail
* Continuous improvement and learning agility

Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  
  
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect . Welcome diverse views . Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  
  
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC) . Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
  
  
Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

PC Vulnerability Remediation Support Services (Physical & Virtual Endpoints)
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking to engage focused exclusively on remediation of PC vulnerabilities across both physical and virtual Windows endpoints. The primary objective is to reduce the organization’s vulnerability exposure identified through Qualys vulnerability scanning by remediating vulnerable applications, configurations, and endpoint-related risks.
  
  
These resources will work closely with Endpoint Engineering, SCCM/MECM, Nexthink, Security, and application owners to identify, coordinate, remediate, and track vulnerabilities at scale.
  
  
Scope of Work
