**Activities Include:**

* Review and analyze Qualys vulnerability findings
* Identify vulnerable software, applications, browser plugins, and configurations
* Determine appropriate remediation methods including:
* Software removal
* Software patching/upgrading
* Configuration changes
* Registry modifications
* Application replacements where applicable
* Validate successful remediation after implementation
* Endpoint Remediation Execution

Small-Scale / Individual Remediation
  
  

* Remediate vulnerabilities directly on individual PCs when limited systems are impacted
* Troubleshoot application or remediation failures
* Coordinate directly with end users when required

Large-Scale / Enterprise Remediation
  
  
**When Vulnerabilities Impact Larger Groups Of Systems:**

* Partner with SCCM/MECM teams to deploy remediation packages
* Partner with Nexthink teams for targeting, visibility, automation, and remediation tracking
* Coordinate remediation campaigns across enterprise device populations
* Assist with deployment validation and remediation reporting
* Coordination & Communication

* Working directly with:
* Application owners
* Security teams
* Endpoint engineering teams
* Infrastructure support teams
* End users where needed
* Providing clear and professional communication via:
* Email
* Microsoft Teams
* Meetings/calls
* Coordinating remediation windows and validation activities
* Reporting & Progress Tracking

**Deliverables Include:**

* Weekly status updates including:
* Vulnerabilities remediated
* Systems remediated
* Current blockers/issues
* Planned work for upcoming week
* Monthly remediation metrics and trending
* Forecasting/projections for:
* Weekly remediation capacity
* Monthly remediation completion estimates
* Documentation of recurring remediation procedures and lessons learned

Required Skill Sets
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**

* Strong Windows PC support and engineering experience
* Deep understanding of Windows Operating Systems:
* Windows 10
* Windows 11
* Virtual desktop environments
* Experience with enterprise endpoint remediation
* Experience interpreting vulnerability scan results (Qualys preferred)
* Strong knowledge of:
* PC software installation/removal
* Application patching/upgrading
* Software troubleshooting
* Windows configuration management
* Experience with SCCM/MECM deployments and remediation coordination
* Experience working with Nexthink or similar endpoint analytics/remediation platforms
* Ability to research vulnerabilities and determine remediation strategies independently

**Preferred**

* Experience with:
* PowerShell scripting
* Application packaging
* Endpoint security tools
* Vulnerability management platforms
* VDI environments

Soft Skills & Professional Expectations
  
  
Communication Skills

* Strong written communication skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical users
* Ability to coordinate with application owners and support teams professionally

Work Style

* Strong understanding of distributed storage systems.

It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.
  
  
WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.
  
  
**Location: Hybrid**
(On-site in Bangalore 3 days; Remote 2 days)
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* As a Senior Designated Services Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring WEKA's Customer Success, contributing to our five-star Gartner reviews.
* You will work with cutting-edge technologies and top-tier customers, providing technical expertise and strengthening customer relationships.
* Collaborating closely with Account Teams, you will gain deep insight into customers' business requirements, technical needs, and system environments.
* Your role involves resolving technical issues, bridging gaps between customers and Engineering, and ensuring the highest level of service.

**As a Senior Designated Services Engineer, You’ll**

* Serve as the primary technical liaison between customers and Engineering to address feature gaps, reliability concerns, and documentation improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, escalating to Engineering when necessary.
* Provide feedback to Engineering to enhance product supportability, usability, and serviceability.
* Support pre-sales engineers, partners, and resellers with technical expertise.
* Proactively monitor WEKA systems using remote monitoring tools to identify and address potential issues.
* Own, track, and document customer issues via the ticketing system.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing through internal and customer-facing documentation (FAQs, KB articles).
* Manage multiple projects and support cases concurrently.
* Advocate for customer concerns and represent WEKA externally.
* Develop subject matter expertise in WEKA and customer technologies.
* Participate in on-call, follow-the-sun support rotations as needed.
* Availability for alternative work hours (nights, weekends, holidays) and potential regional/international travel.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, solving complex enterprise infrastructure issues.
* Ability to diagnose hardware failures, network congestion, and performance bottlenecks.
* Enterprise infrastructure L3 or higher support experience (Linux-based storage, networking, virtualization, cloud, etc.).
* Strong technical troubleshooting in multi-platform, distributed environments.
* Strong understanding of distributed storage systems.
* Expertise in Linux/Unix administration.
* Deep understanding of networking (Infiniband, Ethernet, DPDK, UCX), cloud computing, and distributed storage.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, and experience with automation scripting for system monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of POSIX, NFS, S3 protocols, log management, and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

**It's Nice If You Have**

* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Slack, and other collaboration tools.
* Experience collaborating between customer support and product development teams.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Containers, LXC, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP).
* Prior experience managing large-scale HPC clusters.
* Strong technical writing skills and a creative approach to problem-solving.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Information Systems Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**About Business Unit:**
At the core of all that Epsilon does is a team that sets the foundation of our IT infrastructure. The team drives innovation and efficiency through pioneering technology across Epsilon's platforms and business verticals. From being the first point of contact for infrastructure needs to final deployment, the team provides end-to-end solutions for our client-facing platforms. ETS supports all aspects of revenue-generating platforms for Epsilon and sets the architectural direction for our enterprise deployments. By adopting the newest technologies, such as Cloud, Automation, and Artificial Intelligence, the team is at the front of redefining our digital business and capturing new opportunities.
  
  
**Summary**
As an integral member of the Infrastructure Transition Team within our enterprise IT organization, you will provide comprehensive support and deliver end-to-end infrastructure services across cloud environments, operating systems, network, virtualization, and operational integrations.
  
  
You will actively engage in project activities including feasibility analysis, scoping, scheduling, and task management. The role will contribute to the end-to-end infrastructure lifecycle, including server provisioning, onboarding, configuration, integration, migration, operational readiness, and secure decommissioning. A key focus will be eliminating repetitive manual activities through scripting, Infrastructure as Code, orchestration, and reusable automation solutions.
  
  
This position requires close collaboration with Architecture, Operations, Security, IAM, Network, Cloud, Application, Project Management and Client teams to ensure that infrastructure solutions are technically sound, operationally ready, and aligned with measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments, with strong expertise in automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps practices, and operational excellence.
  
  
Clear and timely communication with users and management regarding the status of ongoing activities is vital to maintain transparency and ensure project success.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide engineering support for Windows and Linux platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure operations.
* Lead server lifecycle management, including onboarding, integration, migration, and decommissioning, using automation to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
* Drive infrastructure automation and DevOps adoption through reusable solutions, scripting, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted engineering tools (Microsoft Copilot, Cursor).
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Ansible, Python, Terraform, AWX, CloudFormation, and other tools across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Design and support hybrid-cloud solutions, enabling seamless modernization of legacy workloads and adoption of cloud-native services.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and platform issues, optimizing performance, resilience, and service availability.
* Communicate effectively with partners, providing insight into project status, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to enhance system scalability, security, and cost-effectiveness.
* Identify, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities while maintaining security and compliance standards.
* Manage and optimize multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure using automation, configuration management, and security standards.
* Define and enforce infrastructure management policies, procedures, and guidelines for both modern and legacy environments.
* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and technical documentation in Confluence to support knowledge sharing and operational consistency.

**Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering and technical delivery
* Strong hands-on experience supporting enterprise Windows and Linux environments.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, AWX) and scripting using Python (preferred), PowerShell, or Bash.
* Solid experience with AWS and Azure cloud platforms; exposure to Google Cloud is desirable.
* Experience managing server lifecycle operations, including provisioning, onboarding, migration, and decommissioning.
* Understanding of operating system fundamentals including user and kernel space, memory management, shared libraries, file and network IO, Windows registry, software distribution, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies to improve automation, code development, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Awareness of emerging infrastructure, cloud, automation, and AI technologies, with a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
* Experience with the project lifecycle of network integrations, infrastructure build, data center builds, and/or network hardware refresh.
* Good communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in Agile and multi-functional environments.
* Self-motivated team player with a continuous learning approach and passion for automation and innovation.

**Additional Information**
Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.
  
  
Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.
  
  
Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.

* Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* Flexibility: We’ve created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.
  
  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.
  
  
**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: Systems Engineer, Tech Foundations (Jira cloud)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.
  
  
Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Systems Engineer is a hands-on builder who moves fast, delivers with quality, and uses AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day work. In this role, you will configure, maintain, and continuously improve Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, and you will own end-to-end delivery of defined projects within the Jira Data Center deprecation and transition to Jira Cloud. You will work autonomously on projects that span several components and may not be fully defined, partnering with senior engineers and your manager to shape the details. You will spot where AI and automation can reduce toil and improve reliability for the teams we serve, then build those improvements. You bring solid platform knowledge, sound technical judgment within your domain, and the curiosity to grow toward senior-level scope.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Administer Jira Cloud Software (JSW), Jira Cloud Service Management (JSM), and associated Atlassian tooling; take ownership of assigned parts of the environment to improve reliability and quality, following established configuration standards and governance
* Design and implement Jira configurations including custom workflows, issue type hierarchies, permission schemes, notification schemes, screens, and field configurations aligned with Atlassian best practices, contributing independently to designs and seeking senior review where needed
* Deliver end-to-end migration workstreams within the Jira Data Center to Cloud program, such as migrating a set of projects or a configuration domain, coordinating with stakeholders on cutover readiness
* Configure Jira Service Management projects including SLAs, custom queues, JSM Forms, approval workflows, and security schemes to support internal service delivery teams
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting using native Jira Cloud tooling; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy, and legal reasons. Support and maintain Airbnb's custom Forge applications in partnership with supporting systems engineering teams
* Support Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, and license hygiene, and contribute to security posture improvements
* Partner with business stakeholders in requirements-gathering sessions, translate needs into configuration and automation solutions, and proactively highlight issues or risks in the work
* Configure Atlassian Rovo AI agents and automation rules; evaluate trade-offs between delivery speed and long-term sustainability, and apply AI responsibly and in context
* Write and maintain automation rules using Jira's native Automation engine and JavaScript; use the Jira REST API for integrations, data imports, and custom reporting
* Support testing cycles for platform changes and migrations; write and run test scripts, track defects, and ensure a rollback plan is in place before changes ship
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) for platform-focused workstreams
* Keep system configurations, runbooks, and knowledge base articles up to date to support operational continuity and self-service
* Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to Atlassian platform incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews
* Identify and reduce technical debt over time; provide constructive input in design and configuration reviews, and help teammates learn through specific examples and timely feedback
* Participate in hiring and onboarding, delivering clear and timely feedback on candidates

**Your Expertise**

* BE/B.Tech or relevant technical degree
* 3+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, including Jira Software and Jira Service Management (Jira Cloud) in enterprise environments
* Solid working knowledge of Jira workflow design, including post functions, validators, and conditions; strong command of JQL for filters, subscriptions, dashboards, and board configuration
* Hands-on experience contributing to Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud), including project configuration migration and data integrity validation
* Experience configuring Jira Cloud native tooling for reporting and planning
* Flexible to work in USA overlapping work hours
* Hands-on experience with the Jira REST API using tools like Postman (GET/PUT/POST) for data extraction, integration, and reporting; maintaining integration touchpoints with AtlassianCloud through service account creation & management
* Familiarity with integrating Atlassian tools with identity providers such as Okta and LDAP, and with user lifecycle and license management practices
* Exposure to Atlassian Rovo or other AI/ML capabilities in the Atlassian ecosystem, with an interest in applying AI thoughtfully and ethically
* Experience building Jira Automation rules; working knowledge of JavaScript and JSON for custom automation
* Working experience with Jira Service Management, including SLA configuration, JSM Forms, custom queues, and approval workflows
* Experience writing and executing test scripts and documenting defects for platform changes or migrations
* Familiarity with Agile practices; SAFe or Scrum certification is a plus
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical work to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to deliver autonomously in a remote-first, fast-moving environment and keep stakeholders informed of progress and blockers
* Familiarity with complementary enterprise tools such as Slack, Asana, Figma, Airtable, and Miro is an advantage

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

**EY GDS – EBS DBA / OCI Senior Position**
Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. To support this fast paced and evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Oracle E Business Suite (EBS) expertise combined with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and automation driven database practices to deliver secure, high performance, and resilient solutions for mission critical business applications.
  
  
As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Senior EBS DBA / OCI professional, supporting large scale Oracle EBS environments across on premises and cloud deployments. **The opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Oracle Database, SQL Database and Cloud Infrastructure OCI/Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and high availability solutions for mission critical enterprise applications. This position provides the opportunity to collaborate with global stakeholders and supporting large scale cloud migration, database modernization, and operational excellence initiatives.

* Virtual network design
* Routing rules
* Security configuration
* Compute instance creation
* Database deployment and configuration
* Responsible for ensuring database configurations, operational guidelines, and technical documentation are maintained and aligned with enterprise standards.

* Identify at risk environments or migration challenges and work with relevant teams to mitigate risks proactively.
* Perform technical reviews and identify corrective actions to improve database reliability and operational efficiency

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team-player and self-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Technical Proof of concept (POC).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-6 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed applications.

* Technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts and Architectural Design Sessions to define and design a complete solution using best practices on Oracle Cloud

* Technical – Experience in Designing, Developing, Deploying and/or Migrating mission critical business applications to Cloud environments including re-platform of such systems
* Expertise in architecting best technical solutions based on customer requirement
* Experience giving presentations to executive audiences and explaining the benefits of the platform and service solution over competitors

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

* Collaborate with application development teams to support testing, deployments, modernization initiatives, and production support for business-critical applications.
* Lead strategic initiatives including CICS TS upgrades, API enablement, modernization programs, hybrid cloud integration, DevOps adoption, and observability enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, System Automation, NetView, and OPS/MVS to improve operational efficiency and reliability.

Ensure compliance with operational, security, audit, and service delivery standards while driving continuous improvement across the CICS platform.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 8+ years of relevant hands-on experience in Mainframe CICS System Programming or CICS infrastructure support.
* Good working knowledge of IBM CICS Transaction Server, including CICS regions, system configuration, administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting CICS production environments, including incident resolution, service requests, planned changes, and system maintenance activities.
* Working knowledge of CICS installation, maintenance, upgrades, or migration activities.
* Experience or exposure to CICS-related IBM and third-party products and monitoring tools such as IBM OMEGAMON for CICS, BMC MainView, ASG TMON/CICS, CICS Performance Analyzer, Abend-AID, Xpediter/CICS, InterTest, SymDump, or similar products.
* Understanding of CICS integration with technologies such as IBM MQ, Db2, VSAM, and other Mainframe application components.
* Working knowledge of CICS performance monitoring, transaction analysis, region health monitoring, and basic performance troubleshooting.
Ability and willingness to participate in rotational on-call support, planned maintenance activities, and Disaster Recovery exercises as required.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Exposure to CICS Web Services, API enablement, Java integration, or other CICS modernization technologies.
* Experience supporting CICS maintenance using SMP/E and applying IBM PTFs, APAR fixes, or related maintenance.
* Exposure to CICSplex System Manager, CICSPlex SM, Workload Management, or multi-region CICS environments.
* Experience with CICS performance analysis, workload balancing, capacity monitoring, or tuning activities.
Ability to contribute effectively to projects, upgrades, migrations, maintenance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives as part of a broader technical team.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.

* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

title: Infrastructure Specialist – System Administration L2
description:
**Anovia (formerly Innovatia Technical Services)** is an industry-leading technology outsourcing support provider with expertise in the telecommunications industry. Operating for over 20 years, we specialize in workflow and knowledge processes, as well as technical support, helpdesk and multilingual support services. With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the world's most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

The Infrastructure Specialist will be responsible for providing day-to-day administration, maintenance and L2/L3 support for enterprise server environments at a large global client. The role ensures production systems remain secure, patched, monitored and available, resolves incidents within SLA, and automates routine tasks to improve reliability.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer, monitor and maintain Linux and/or Windows servers across physical, virtual and cloud environments.
* Provide L2/L3 support by troubleshooting operating system, performance, storage and connectivity issues, and resolving incidents within agreed SLAs.
* Plan and execute OS patching, upgrades and security hardening (for example, CIS benchmarks) in line with change management.
* Manage user accounts, access controls, file systems, volume groups and logical volumes.
* Build and manage virtual machines on VMware vSphere or the client's cloud platform.
* Automate routine administration tasks using Shell, PowerShell, Python or Ansible.
* Monitor system health and capacity with tools such as Splunk, Nagios or cloud-native monitoring, and act on alerts.
* Support backup and restore activities and participate in disaster recovery tests.
* Raise and update incidents, changes and problem records in ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM tool, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks and handover notes.

**Skills required**

* 4+ years of hands-on administration of Linux (RHEL preferred) or Windows Server in a production environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for OS, performance, boot, network and storage issues.
* Experience with patch management and server hardening.
* Working knowledge of VMware vSphere or a public cloud platform (Azure or AWS).
* Scripting in Shell, PowerShell or Python for automation.
* Understanding of DNS, DHCP, LDAP or Active Directory, SSL certificates and basic networking.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, including incident, change and problem management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or an equivalent discipline.
* Preferred certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft Certified (Windows Server or Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, or AWS certifications.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, and support on-call requirements and weekend change windows when required.
* Ability to work from the client office from day one.

**Good to have**

* Ansible or Terraform for configuration and infrastructure automation.
* Containers (Docker) and introductory knowledge of Kubernetes or OpenShift.
* Exposure to middleware such as Apache, Tomcat, WebSphere or WebLogic.
* Experience with backup tools such as Veritas NetBackup or Commvault.
* Exposure to IBM AIX or Power Systems.

**Benefits at Anovia**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance policy.
* Employee Wellness Program with a focus on mental health.
* Robust reward and recognition programs.
* Company incentive programs.
* Attractive leave policy, including Holiday Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Birthday Leave, Bereavement Leave and Paid Leave for personal time off.
* Ample growth and learning opportunities.
* Remote work opportunities, where applicable.
* Focus on work-life balance.
* Immigration Program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Anovia is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. **Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

  

  
* Strong ownership and accountability.
  
  
* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  
  
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, enterprise engineering environment.
  
  
* Passion for automation, engineering excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
* Ability to challenge existing approaches and introduce better engineering practices.
