title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role for an execution systems senior engineer focuses on designing implementing and optimizing industrial data solutions using AVEVA PI Historian to support manufacturing and supply chain operations enabling high availability of plant information improved decision making and sustainable efficiency gains across global sites while collaborating with cross functional teams in a day shift environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust AVEVA PI Historians that reliably capture real time plant data to support critical production and supply chain decision making across global manufacturing operations.
* Configure and maintain data collection interfaces and tags within AVEVA PI systems to ensure accurate high quality and timely acquisition of operational information from diverse industrial control assets.
* Develop and optimize PI Asset Framework models that clearly represent manufacturing assets process hierarchies and supply chain entities to enable meaningful analytics and standardized reporting.
* Create and maintain event frames and calculations in AVEVA PI environments to transform raw operational data into actionable performance indicators and insight for business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with operations manufacturing engineering and planning teams to understand data needs and translate them into scalable historian solutions aligned to enterprise standards.
* Implement and support data integration between AVEVA PI platforms and upstream or downstream systems such as MES ERP quality and planning tools to enable end to end process visibility.
* Define and enforce historian governance practices including naming conventions data retention strategies and security controls to ensure consistency and compliance across all installations.
* Troubleshoot complex AVEVA PI incidents and performance issues by conducting systematic root cause analysis and implementing durable corrective actions that minimize downtime.
* Develop comprehensive technical documentation covering system architecture configuration procedures operational runbooks and support guidelines to enable sustainable operations.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to enable advanced use cases such as production optimization demand planning and predictive quality based on PI data sets.
* Guide and mentor peers and junior team members on best practices for historian configuration data modeling and industrial connectivity to uplift overall team capability.
* Engage with business stakeholders in manufacturing and supply chain to prioritize enhancement backlogs and deliver incremental value through well planned historian improvements.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to ensure that AVEVA PI deployments follow corporate security baselines while maintaining high availability and performance.
* Drive continuous improvement of monitoring and alerting for PI systems so that potential capacity stability or data quality issues are proactively identified and resolved.
* Participate in hybrid work model ceremonies and cross site collaborations ensuring effective communication and smooth delivery while primarily operating in a day shift schedule.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in designing configuring and administering AVEVA PI Historian environments for complex industrial operations.
* Exhibit strong knowledge of PI components such as PI Server PI Asset Framework PI Vision and data interfaces with the ability to tailor solutions to varied plant contexts.
* Apply solid understanding of manufacturing processes and production workflows to design historian structures that accurately reflect real world operations and constraints.
* Utilize experience in supply chain or logistics domains to align data models and metrics with inventory fulfillment and planning objectives when applicable.
* Employ strong skills in industrial connectivity and automation concepts including OPC field devices and control systems to ensure reliable data collection into AVEVA PI.
* Demonstrate proficiency in scripting or query based configuration for calculations and analytics within PI environments to support advanced reporting and insight generation.
* Communicate complex technical topics in a clear concise manner to both technical and nontechnical partners enabling informed decisions and effective collaboration.
* Apply structured problem solving methods and incident management practices to resolve historian issues within defined service levels for critical manufacturing sites.
* Show experience working in hybrid global teams coordinating deliverables across locations and time zones while adhering to standard operating procedures and quality expectations.
* Maintain a continuous learning mindset by staying up to date on AVEVA PI capabilities industrial digital solutions and data governance practices that can benefit the organization.

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. description:

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents
  
  
**Job Description\***
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to join the Cyber Security Operations team. This role will be responsible for understanding the enterprise DLP strategy, policy enforcement, threat detection, investigation, and response activities across on-premises, cloud, and endpoint environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in DLP technologies, information protection, insider risk management, cloud security, and detection engineering. In addition, the candidate should have hands-on experience leveraging AI/ML-driven security analytics, automation, and orchestration capabilities to improve detection accuracy, reduce operational overhead, and strengthen the bank's overall data protection posture.
  
  
As a senior member of the team, you will provide technical leadership, guide junior analysts, drive strategic security initiatives, enhance monitoring capabilities, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure protection of sensitive data across the enterprise
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Data Loss Prevention & Information Protection
  
  

* Serve as the primary SME for enterprise DLP technologies, policies, controls, and monitoring capabilities.
* Design, implement, tune, and maintain DLP controls across endpoint, network, email, web, SaaS applications, and cloud environments.
* Lead investigations involving data exfiltration, insider threats, unauthorized disclosures, and policy violations.
* Develop and optimize detection use cases for sensitive data protection, insider risk monitoring, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Partner with business, technology, and risk teams to identify data protection risks and implement appropriate controls.
* Security Monitoring, Detection & Response
* Operate within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (Detect → Investigate → Respond → Improve).
* Conduct advanced investigations utilizing SIEM, EDR/XDR, DLP, Cloud Security, Identity Security, and Threat Intelligence platforms.
* Analyze logs, events, and telemetry from multiple security sources to determine attack scope, root cause, business impact, and remediation requirements.
* Lead security incident response activities involving DLP violations, cloud security incidents, insider threats, and data exposure events.
* Develop and continuously improve detection content aligned with MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Cloud Security (AWS & Azure)
* Design and monitor DLP and data protection controls across multi-cloud environments including AWS and Microsoft Azure.
* Support implementation and management of cloud-native security solutions, including:

+ AWS GuardDuty
+ AWS Macie
+ AWS Security Hub
+ AWS CloudTrail
+ Microsoft Defender for Cloud
+ Microsoft Purview Information Protection & DLP
+ Microsoft Sentinel
+ Azure Monitor and Azure Security Center

* Investigate cloud-based threats involving sensitive data exposure, excessive permissions, misconfigurations, and unauthorized access.
* Develop cloud security monitoring and detection use cases to enhance visibility and protection across cloud workloads and SaaS platforms.

AI/ML-Driven DLP & Security Analytics
  
  

* Leverage Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities to improve DLP effectiveness, classification accuracy, insider risk detection, and threat identification.
* Develop and implement behavioral analytics and anomaly detection models for identifying malicious or accidental data leakage.
* Utilize Generative AI and advanced analytics capabilities to enhance incident triage, threat enrichment, investigation workflows, and response effectiveness.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into DLP monitoring, detection, and response processes.
* Measure and drive improvements in detection quality, false-positive reduction, and operational efficiency through AI-driven capabilities.

Security Automation & Orchestration
  
  

* Design and enhance automated response workflows using SOAR platforms.
* Develop scripting and API-based integrations to automate repetitive response and remediation tasks.
* Improve operational effectiveness by reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).
* Maintain automated playbooks and response mechanisms supporting DLP, cybersecurity, and cloud security operations.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior analysts and operational teams.
* Drive security process improvements and operational maturity initiatives.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting related to DLP effectiveness, incident response, and cloud security posture.
* Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and executive-level stakeholders.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
  
  
**Certifications If Any:**
CEH, Cloud Certifications, Security+, CCNA or any equivalent
  
  
**Experience Range\***
8-10+Years
  
  
**Foundational Skills\***

* 10 + years of experience in Information Security, Security Operations, DLP Operations, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, or related cybersecurity functions.
* Deep expertise in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and controls.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of:
* Microsoft Purview DLP
* Symantec DLP
* Forcepoint DLP
* Palo Alto Enterprise DLP
* Digital Guardian
* Strong understanding of data classification, information protection, insider risk, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience investigating and responding to DLP incidents across endpoint, network, email, cloud, and SaaS environments.
* Strong experience with SIEM and Security Analytics platforms:
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Splunk
* QRadar
* Elastic
* Proficiency in: KQL ,SQL ,Python and PowerShell
* Experience with SOAR platforms, automation, orchestration, and API integrations.
* Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and cyber adversary TTPs.
* Extensive hands-on experience securing and monitoring AWS and Azure environments.
* Experience with cloud-native security tools including AWS Macie, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience leveraging AI/ML capabilities for security analytics, user behavior analytics (UBA), anomaly detection, insider threat detection, or predictive risk analysis.
* Demonstrated track record of reducing alert noise, improving detection coverage, improving MTTR, and enhancing operational effectiveness.
* Promotes awareness of current and emerging cybersecurity threats and advises on potential information security exposure
* Assesses and mitigates cyber security risks related to application, network, infrastructure, and public cloud
* Interprets the information security requirements outlined in policies, standards, and procedures and reinforces requirements through education and awareness
* Supports teammates who serve as “security ambassadors” in order to help partners drive strategic and innovative risk mitigation priorities and navigate the GIS organization

**Desired Skills\***

* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels

description:
Position Description  
Company Profile:  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. Job Title: AS400 Admin/iSeries Support - Lead  
Position: SSE/LA  
Experience: 6-9 years  
Category: Infrastructure/Admin  
Positions open: 4  
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST  
Main location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad  
Position ID: J0926-1800  
Employment Type: Full Time  
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience  
  
Job Summary  
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years  
  
Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.  
  
Key skills :  
Backup strategies, disaster  
Recovery plans  
Performance tuning,  
Capacity/resource planning  
Data Restoration  
System Upgrades  
  
  
Required Qualifications  
  
. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.  
. Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.  
. Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).  
  
  
Required Technical Skills  
  
. Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.  
. OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.  
. Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.  
. High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.  
. Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.  
. Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.  
. Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.  
. Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.  
. Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
. IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.  
. Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).  
. Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).  
. Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.  
. ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.  
  
  
Key Competencies  
  
. Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.  
. Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.  
. Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.  
. Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

title: ZScaler Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Zscaler administrator you are responsible for managing and configuring Zscaler security services, including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), to ensure secure network access for users by implementing and maintaining policies like URL filtering, threat prevention, and access controls, while also monitoring for security incidents and collaborating with network and security teams to optimize the Zscaler platform within an organization's infrastructure; essentially acting as the primary point of contact for all Zscaler related operations and troubleshooting.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Manage user and machines access to ZPA
* Manage IdP configurations/ Administrators/ Configure App Connectors
* Maintain User Portal and Browser Access to applications
* Maintain ZPA policies (Access, Timeout, Client Forwarding, Isolation)
* Manage ZIA authentication settings/ IdP configurations/ Administrators
* Maintain hosted pac files/ URL categories/ Certificates
* Configure and maintain SSL Inspection policies
* Configure and maintain URL & Cloud App Control policies
* Configure and maintain File Type Control policies
* Manage ZDX “Standard”
Support Mobile Connector Portal  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**  
  

* 6+ years of experience focused on network support, configuration, and implementation
* 6+ years of experience in core switching, routing, MPLS, and firewalls
* Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains
* Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision

  
**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**  
  

* Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) deployment and data center experience
* Experience with design and implementing Software Defined Network (SDN) and large complex networks
* Experience with protocols and technologies such as, BDP, OSPF, MP-FBP EVPN, VXLAN, or VPC

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. title: Configuration Analyst
description:
The Device42 & CMDB Administrator will be responsible for administering and maintaining the Device42 discovery and asset management platform, ensuring accurate infrastructure inventory, CMDB data quality, and configuration item (CI) lifecycle management. The role will oversee infrastructure discovery, data reconciliation, CI relationships, and integration with ServiceNow CMDB, working closely with NOC, infrastructure, application, and client teams to maintain reliable and up-to-date configuration data.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Device42 Upgrades & Patch Management:**
  Plan, coordinate, and execute Device42 platform upgrades, patches, and version updates in accordance with vendor recommendations and approved change management procedures.
* **Upgrade Planning & Validation:**
  Assess upgrade prerequisites, compatibility, dependencies, backup requirements, and potential operational impact before implementation.
* **Pre- and Post-Upgrade Validation:**
  Validate platform availability, discovery jobs, integrations, credentials, data collection, and CMDB synchronization after upgrades.
* Rollback & Recovery: Maintain upgrade rollback and recovery procedures to minimize service disruption.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with Device42 support for upgrade planning, known issues, troubleshooting, and post-upgrade defects.
* **Upgrade Documentation:**
  Maintain upgrade records, implementation plans, test results, approvals, and technical documentation.
* **Device42 Administration:**
  Administer and maintain the Device42 platform, discovery configurations, credentials, schedules, and data collection processes.
* **Infrastructure Discovery:**
  Configure and manage discovery of network devices, physical and virtual servers, clusters, firewalls, and other supported infrastructure.
* **CMDB Administration:**
  Maintain CMDB data quality, completeness, accuracy, and consistency across configuration items and their relationships.
* **ServiceNow CMDB Management:**
  Support CI lifecycle management, data synchronization, reconciliation, identification of duplicates, and validation of CI attributes in ServiceNow CMDB.
* **Asset Lifecycle Management:**
  Identify and track newly discovered, modified, retired, and decommissioned infrastructure assets.
* **Data Reconciliation:**
  Reconcile Device42 data against ServiceNow CMDB and approved sources such as SolarWinds and SCCM; investigate discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.
* **CI Relationship Management:**
  Maintain and validate relationships between infrastructure components, applications, and dependencies wherever supported.
* **Data Quality Management:**
  Identify duplicate, stale, incomplete, and inconsistent records and implement corrective measures.
* **Discovery Troubleshooting:**
  Investigate failed discovery jobs, credential issues, connectivity problems, and missing or inaccurate asset information.
* **Integration Management:**
  Monitor and troubleshoot data exchange between Device42 and ServiceNow CMDB, where integrations are configured.
* **Governance & Compliance:**
  Establish and maintain discovery standards, CI data standards, reconciliation procedures, and CMDB maintenance processes.
* **Reporting & Dashboards:**
  Publish reports on discovery coverage, CI completeness, reconciliation status, data quality, asset lifecycle changes, and outstanding discrepancies.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Work with NOC, Network, Server, Application, Security, and ServiceNow teams to validate infrastructure information and resolve data gaps.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Identify opportunities to improve discovery coverage, CMDB accuracy, automation, data synchronization, and asset management processes.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Engage Device42 support for product-related issues and coordinate resolution of platform defects or discovery limitations.
* **Documentation:**
  Maintain technical documentation, discovery procedures, data standards, integration workflows, and operational runbooks.

**Required Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering Device42 or a similar infrastructure discovery and asset management platform.
* Strong understanding of CMDB concepts, configuration items, CI relationships, and asset lifecycle management.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB administration, data maintenance, and reconciliation.
* Experience with infrastructure discovery across network devices, physical servers, virtual machines, and clusters.
* Knowledge of discovery protocols and methods, including SNMP, WMI/WinRM, SSH, and relevant credential management.
* Experience with CI identification, duplicate management, data normalization, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of integrations and data synchronization between discovery tools and CMDB platforms.
* Ability to analyze discovery results, investigate data discrepancies, and drive corrective actions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Experience preparing CMDB health, asset inventory, discovery coverage, and data quality reports.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Device42 administration or implementation experience.
* ServiceNow CMDB, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), and Discovery knowledge.
* Experience with SolarWinds, SCCM, or other infrastructure inventory and monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation for data validation or synchronization.
* Knowledge of application dependency mapping and infrastructure relationship management.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale or healthcare infrastructure environments.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent knowledge of IT Service Management practices.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Device42 discovery coverage and successful discovery job rate.
* CMDB completeness, accuracy, and data consistency.
* Reduction in duplicate, stale, and incomplete CIs.
* Timely identification and processing of new, changed, and retired assets.
* Reconciliation discrepancy resolution rate.
* Accuracy of CI relationships and dependency mapping.
* Timely resolution of discovery and integration failures.
* Compliance with agreed reporting and data maintenance schedules.

**Responsibilities**

title: Elastic Engineer
description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\_cat, \_cluster, \_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

title: Sr. Service Operations Engineer
description:
Lead Support Operations Engineer
  
  
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology & Ancillary Clinical Systems**
**About The Role**
Providence Global Center is seeking an experienced Lead Support Operations Engineer to lead reliable, secure and efficient support for
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and other ancillary clinical applications**
. The role combines hands-on L2/L3 technical ownership with operational leadership, service governance, major-incident coordination, problem management, change oversight and team capability development. The engineer will partner with clinical stakeholders, product teams, infrastructure teams, vendors and senior engineers to maintain application availability, protect patient-care workflows and drive continual service improvement across on-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
  
  
**Role Outcomes The Role Is Accountable For**

* Stable and resilient clinical application services with effective monitoring, incident response and recovery.
* Consistent SLA performance, clear operational ownership and timely stakeholder communication.
* Reduced recurring incidents through root cause analysis, problem elimination, automation and knowledge reuse.
* Controlled delivery of patches, upgrades, interface changes and production deployments.
* Strong team readiness through work allocation, technical coaching, documentation and succession coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Service Operations Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day support operations across Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and ancillary clinical applications.
* Provide technical direction for L2/L3 incidents, complex service requests, application defects and workflow disruptions.
* Prioritise work based on clinical impact, urgency, risk and agreed service levels; coordinate workload across the support team.
* Maintain operational readiness, support coverage, escalation paths, runbooks and handover practices.
* Review service performance, ageing work, repeat incidents, backlog, availability risks and improvement actions with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Clinical Workflow & Application Support**

* Support end-to-end clinical workflows, including laboratory order-to-result processes, medication-management workflows, imaging order-to-report processes and associated ancillary-service workflows.
* Translate clinical and operational impact into clear technical investigation, restoration and follow-up actions.
* Partner with clinical SMEs and business stakeholders to validate workflow behaviour, configuration changes and recovery outcomes.
* Ensure support decisions consider patient-care continuity, data integrity, operational safety and downstream system dependencies.

**3. Integrations, Interfaces & Data Exchange**

* Lead troubleshooting of integrations among clinical applications, medical devices or instruments, middleware, interface engines, EHR platforms and downstream systems.
* Investigate HL7 message failures, queue backlogs, interface interruptions, data mismatches and mapping issues using logs and monitoring tools.
* Support clinical terminology, coding and mapping where applicable, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Coordinate with interface, infrastructure, network, database, security, vendor and application teams to restore and stabilise services.

**4. Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management**

* Own or coordinate high-impact incidents from triage through service restoration, validation, communication and closure.
* Provide concise technical updates, impact statements, recovery status and decision points during major incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant issues and track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify opportunities to automate, correct or eliminate repeat work and reduce avoidable support demand.

**5. Change, Release & Environment Management**

* Assess operational readiness and risk for application changes, patches, upgrades, cloud migrations and integration releases.
* Coordinate implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, support coverage and post-deployment verification.
* Support environment health, configuration consistency and production-readiness checks across on-premises and Azure Cloud services.
* Ensure changes follow applicable ITIL, security, compliance and change-management controls.

**6. Monitoring, Reliability & Continual Improvement**

* Strengthen proactive monitoring, alert quality, service dashboards and early-warning indicators for critical clinical applications.
* Analyse incident trends, recurring failure patterns and operational bottlenecks; recommend measurable improvements.
* Promote automation, self-service, standardisation and knowledge-centred support to improve reliability and team efficiency.
* Contribute to service continuity, disaster recovery testing and operational resilience activities.

**7. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Coach support engineers on technical troubleshooting, clinical workflows, incident ownership, documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Delegate work with clear accountability; review technical quality and support the team during complex escalations.
* Build cross-training and backup coverage across supported applications and domain workflows.
* Work closely with SMEs, product owners, developers, vendors and cross-functional teams across geographies.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, known-error records, support models and troubleshooting guides.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of application support or service operations experience, including ownership of complex or business-critical applications.
* Strong experience supporting one or more clinical domains such as Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology or ancillary clinical systems, with the ability to build cross-domain knowledge.
* Demonstrated L2/L3 troubleshooting experience across applications, interfaces, middleware, logs, infrastructure dependencies and data flows.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging, interface support and integrations among clinical applications, devices or instruments, middleware and EHR systems.
* Understanding of clinical terminology, coding or mapping standards where relevant, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Experience with incident, major incident, problem, change and release management in an ITIL-aligned environment.
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and on-premises application environments, including monitoring, availability and operational support concepts.
* Experience leading technical investigations, coordinating cross-functional teams and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, documentation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, distribute work, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a 24x7 support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple clinical application domains or enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with interface engines, clinical middleware, medical-device integrations, PACS/RIS, pharmacy platforms or LIS/LIMS solutions.
* Experience with scripting, workflow automation, observability tools or service-management reporting.
* Participation in application upgrades, cloud migrations, disaster-recovery exercises or major clinical go-lives.
* ITIL, Azure, healthcare interoperability or relevant vendor/product certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams and external vendors in a regulated healthcare environment.

**Core Competencies**
**Technical & Domain**
**Operational Leadership**
**Ways of Working**

* Clinical application support
* HL7 and integration troubleshooting
* Cloud and on-premises operations
* Monitoring and reliability
* Major-incident coordination
* Problem elimination
* Change and release oversight
* Risk-based prioritisation
* Clinical stakeholder partnership
* Coaching and delegation
* Clear executive communication
* Knowledge sharing and collaboration

**Success Measures**

* Service availability, SLA achievement and timely restoration of clinically significant incidents.
* Reduction in repeat incidents, ageing backlog and avoidable support demand.
* Quality and completion of root cause, corrective action, change validation and operational-readiness activities.
* Improved monitoring coverage, documentation quality, automation adoption and cross-training readiness.
* Stakeholder confidence in service ownership, communication and operational follow-through.

**Note:**
The 8-12 year experience range is recommended to reflect the expanded lead-level scope and should be aligned with the organisation's approved job architecture before publication. Product-specific requirements may be added based on the final application portfolio.

In this role, you will bridge traditional networking and modern platform/DevOps needs, ensuring our distributed applications, cloud services, and internal systems operate with ultra-low latency, high resilience, and maximum efficiency.
  
  
You will also act as the technical subject matter expert for network data paths, traffic management, and performance diagnostics by interacting with cross-functional team engineers, architects, internal and vendor partners to evangelize and provide NextGEN network technology solutions to;
  
  

* Maximize the business value from Sanofi’s Digital Technology and Solutions investments.
* Unleash innovation for our organization, employees, and customers.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Platform Automation Engineering

+ With expertise across routing, switching, WAN, data center, and cloud networking, automation of network provisioning, configuration, validation, compliance, monitoring, and remediation.
+ Design and develop scalable, reusable automation frameworks and services.
+ Automate complex multi-vendor network environments across LAN, WAN, data center, SD-WAN, and cloud.
+ Develop automated workflows for network changes, incident remediation, and lifecycle management.
+ Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual network operations.
+ Develop API-driven workflows and automation services.
+ Establish automation standards, design patterns, coding practices, and reusable modules.
+ Monitor Connectivity platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and automate routine tasks.
+ Maintain CI/CD pipelines, security, and data protection for platform systems.

* Platform Performance Engineering

+ Develop automated network health and compliance checks.
+ Integrate telemetry, monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms into automation workflows.
+ Build event-driven automation and automated remediation capabilities.
+ Leverage AI/ML and AIOps capabilities to improve network troubleshooting and operational efficiency.
+ Evaluate opportunities for predictive analytics and intelligent network operations.
+ Monitoring and analyzing network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement performance tuning strategies
+ Drive Automation & Continuous improvement of Network platform solutioning, specification & design, systems integration, platform lifecycle management, standards, and documentation.
+ Drive process improvements that integrate automation and monitor effectiveness to improve efficiency & service delivery.
+ Conduct regular audits, performance tests, generate reports, and track KPIs for network health to manage resource allocation within the network to meet platform demand.

**About You**

* Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

+ Technology leadership skills along with strong Interpersonal & Problem-Solving skills.
+ An enthusiasm for staying up to date with the very latest updates with Network technology solutions.
+ Ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
+ Strong software engineering mindset.
+ Ability to influence engineering decisions.
+ Strong written and verbal communication.
+ Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
+ Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, security, and scalability.
+ Technical Skills

+ 7+ years of experience in network engineering, with substantial experience in network automation.
+ Strong enterprise networking background with expertise in routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN, and network security.
+ Advanced Python programming experience.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, Git, JSON, and YAML.
+ Experience developing production-grade automation frameworks.
+ Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.
+ Experience working with multi-vendor network environments.
+ Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management.
+ Networking in cloud computing experience (Azure, AWS, & GCP)
+ Familiarity and understanding of tunnelling protocols (vxLAN, GRE, IPSec)
+ Working knowledge of DNS, Tacacs, Radius, DHCP, NetFlow, Syslog, etc.
+ Exposure to SCADA modelled Network and concepts.
+ Vendor (technical) management experience
+ Occasional work outside business hours

title: Oracle Cloud Infra Admin-Oracle and SQL Database Administrator-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – EBS DBA / OCI Senior Position**
Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. To support this fast paced and evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Oracle E Business Suite (EBS) expertise combined with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and automation driven database practices to deliver secure, high performance, and resilient solutions for mission critical business applications.
  
  
As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Senior EBS DBA / OCI professional, supporting large scale Oracle EBS environments across on premises and cloud deployments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, including EBS migrations to OCI, database upgrades, high availability design, and performance optimization, while contributing to the development of next generation EBS and OCI platforms in a collaborative, international delivery environment.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Oracle Database, SQL Database and Cloud Infrastructure OCI/Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and high availability solutions for mission critical enterprise applications. This position provides the opportunity to collaborate with global stakeholders and supporting large scale cloud migration, database modernization, and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Overseeing Oracle EBS database administration and OCI implementation, and identifying opportunities for performance, scalability, and availability improvements.
* Accountable for ensuring database standards, cloud architecture guidelines, and operational processes are followed across on premise and OCI environments.
* Act as the first level technical escalation point for EBS database and OCI related issues for mission critical systems.
* Perform and support end to end database and application migrations from on premises environments to OCI, guiding teams through design, execution, and stabilization.
* Responsible for technical decision making, solution design, environment optimization, and supporting implementation activities for EBS and Oracle database workloads.
* Accountable for collaborating with Cloud Infrastructure teams, supporting instance provisioning, virtual network design, routing rules, security configurations, and database deployments.

**Strong understanding of:**

* Oracle Database upgrades (9i/10g/11g to 12c/18c/19c)
* SQL Server DBA experience (SQL Server 2008–2019/2022)
* OCI networking, security, and database services
* Production support and cross platform migrations on Cloud

**Execute end to end database migrations, including:**

* Virtual network design
* Routing rules
* Security configuration
* Compute instance creation
* Database deployment and configuration
* Responsible for ensuring database configurations, operational guidelines, and technical documentation are maintained and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support database upgrades, patching, maintenance, and performance tuning for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c) running on on prem and OCI platforms.
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
* Perform gap analysis against best practices and recommend improvements related to database performance, availability, security, and cloud architecture.
* Identify at risk environments or migration challenges and work with relevant teams to mitigate risks proactively.
* Perform technical reviews and identify corrective actions to improve database reliability and operational efficiency

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team-player and self-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Technical Proof of concept (POC).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-6 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed applications.
* Extensive experience working on at least one Public Cloud – Oracle/Azure/Google. Oracle Cloud is preferred .
* BTech / MTech / MCA / MBA
* Technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts and Architectural Design Sessions to define and design a complete solution using best practices on Oracle Cloud
* System administration experience (Linux, Solaris)

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Certificated in Public Cloud – Oracle/AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Certified Architect Professional
* Technical – Experience in Designing, Developing, Deploying and/or Migrating mission critical business applications to Cloud environments including re-platform of such systems
* Expertise in architecting best technical solutions based on customer requirement
* Experience giving presentations to executive audiences and explaining the benefits of the platform and service solution over competitors

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Senior Manager (PL) partners with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data engineering, risk management, compliance to align analytics platform investments with business strategy. **Infrastructure Operations & Service Reliability**
- Lead the daily operation, monitoring, maintenance, and reliability of enterprise infrastructure services, including cloud platforms, servers, storage, network services, identity systems, endpoint platforms, backup/recovery, and collaboration infrastructure. Ensure incidents, problems, changes, capacity needs, maintenance windows, and recurring operational risks are managed in a timely and controlled manner.
  
  
**Infrastructure Projects, Modernization & Continuous Improvement**
- Plan and lead infrastructure initiatives such as cloud and network modernization, identity and access improvements, endpoint platform enhancements, server lifecycle programs, automation, monitoring improvements, disaster recovery readiness, and office or project technology deployments. Translate business and technology needs into practical execution plans, standards, documentation, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Security, Compliance & Risk Management - Partner with IT Security and Compliance to ensure infrastructure services align with internal policies, ISO27001 controls, vulnerability remediation expectations, audit evidence requirements, secure configuration standards, privileged access practices, and data protection needs. Support technical risk assessments, remediation tracking, and control improvement activities.
  
  
**Team Leadership, Coaching & Escalation Management -**
Manage, mentor, and develop infrastructure engineers, administrators, analysts, and/or external partners. Provide clear priorities, technical guidance, performance feedback, workload direction, and career development support. Serve as the senior escalation point for high-impact technical issues, service interruptions, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional troubleshooting.
  
  
**Vendor, Budget & Lifecycle Management -**
Manage vendor relationships, managed service providers, contracts, renewals, infrastructure purchasing, asset lifecycle planning, licensing coordination, budget inputs, and cost optimization opportunities. Evaluate solutions and service providers to ensure technical fit, reliability, security, scalability, and business value.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Other Duties as Assigned -**
Collaborate with business leaders, regional IT teams, project teams, Support, Applications, Security, and PMO stakeholders to align infrastructure priorities with organizational needs. Maintain governance practices, technical documentation, service reporting, standards, roadmaps, and communications. Perform other related duties as assigned.
  
  
**Qualifications & Requirements**
Master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline required; equivalent combination of education, certifications, and progressive experience may be considered. 8-12 years of progressive infrastructure, systems engineering, cloud, network, or enterprise IT operations experience required, including 3-5 years of supervisory, technical leadership, or people management experience. Strong hands-on background with Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Intune, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Windows Server, VMware/vSphere, enterprise networking, endpoint management, backup/recovery technologies, monitoring platforms, scripting/automation, and hybrid cloud environments. Demonstrated experience leading incident/problem/change processes, infrastructure projects, lifecycle programs, disaster recovery planning, vendor coordination, documentation, and service improvement initiatives. Experience working with ITIL-based service management practices required; ITIL v4 Foundation preferred. Experience supporting ISO27001, NIST, CIS Controls or similar security/compliance frameworks preferred. Relevant Microsoft, Azure, networking, security, virtualization, or cloud certifications strongly preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical priorities, risks, and recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  
  
**About Us**
IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in technical consulting, architecture, engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, qualification, and validation services for technically complex facilities. Integration is how we think and work. It requires the ability to unite existing and emerging technologies into a process that reliably delivers products and accelerates speed to market. description:

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
  
  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life
  
  
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
  
  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines

**IT Application Support**
**Role Overview**
As an
**IT Application Support**
specialist, you serve as the Level II Support bridge connecting end-users, IT Service Desk (L1), and core technical teams (Developers, DBAs, ETL Data Engineers, and Workforce Management). You will solve complex application challenges, monitor SQL database jobs, modify SQL scripts, collaborate on outage escalations, and propose continuous system enhancements. This role supports round-the-clock global operations and requires flexibility for a
**24/7 rotating shift schedule**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* L2 Escalation & Support: Serve as the primary L2 escalation point for internal and cloud corporate applications (HCM, Financials, Recruiting, Payroll, Leave Accruals) using ServiceNow and Jira.
* Dev, DBA & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with L3 Developers, DBAs, ETL Data Engineers, and Workforce Management (WFM) to investigate system issues, monitor data feeds, execute/verify stored procedures, modify SQL scripts, and resolve incidents.
* ETL & WFM Integrations: Partner with ETL teams to troubleshoot data pipelines and reporting workflows. Collaborate with WFM teams on shift/leave accrual syncs, timekeeping integrations, and automated feed files.
* Database Operations & Job Monitoring: Actively check SQL Server job executions, inspect automated tasks/feedfiles, and modify SQL scripts to resolve data sync errors or backend issues.
* Outage & Incident Management: Partner directly with Incident Management (NOC IM) during production outages. Participate in comms bridges, provide regular escalation updates (every 30 mins to 4 hours based on severity), and draft Initial Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documents.
* L1 Support Enablement: Conduct regular sync calls and coaching sessions for Level 1 Service Desk reps to improve initial troubleshooting, intake requirements, and ticket escalation quality.
* Continuous Improvement: Track recurring issue trends and propose continuous improvement (CI) application enhancements to Business Analysts and Product teams.
* Knowledge Base & Documentation: Author and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles and SOPs in ServiceNow to empower L1 teams and end-users to resolve common issues independently.

**Technical Competencies**

* ETL & WFM Data Integrations: Understanding of ETL pipeline workflows, data transformation, and system integration with WFM platforms and timekeeping tools.
* SQL & Database Support: Direct experience inspecting SQL Server environments, checking job executions, modifying SQL scripts, executing/verifying stored procedures, and performing data fixes.
* Debugging & Dev Collaboration: Technical capability to collaborate with L3 developers in investigating backend code errors, debugging system logs, and verifying technical hotfixes.
* Incident Response: Experience collaborating with Incident Management teams during outages, participating in comms bridges, sending stakeholder notifications, and drafting RCA reports.
* Ticketing & Tooling: Hands-on experience using ServiceNow (Incident/Service Request Management) and Jira (Bug Tracking/Dev Escalations).

**Requirements**

* Shift Flexibility: Must be amenable to working on a 24x7 rotating shift schedule (including nights, weekends, and holidays).
* Experience: 1-2 years in IT application support, IT service desk, or product support utilizing enterprise ITSM tools like ServiceNow and Jira.
* Cross-Team Experience: Hands-on experience collaborating with ETL engineers, WFM teams, Devs, DBAs, and NOC/IM outage teams.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Proven ability to run/modify SQL scripts, check database jobs, execute/verify stored procedures, research root causes, and resolve backend incidents.
* Communication & Mindset: Strong technical communication skills to articulate issues clearly across all technical and non-technical stakeholders, paired with a proactive drive to improve support workflows.
