title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.
* 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
As a Data Center Technician, you'll deploy and maintain Google's advanced Data Center Server and Network Infrastructure by installing, configuring, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing hardware and server software. You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, bridges, and switches. You will participate in or lead local project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.
  
  
In this role, your duties range from the physical deployment of data center related technology to working closely with various stakeholders. It will fall on you to ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of data centers.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g., machine learning platforms, network architecture).
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.
* Execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
* Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, escalate and resolve defined problems.

**Position**

IT Engineer / IT Systems Administrator

**Department**

Information Technology

**Reports To**

Head – IT

**Location**

Delhi Office

**Experience**

3–7 Years

**Employment Type**

Full Time

**2. Job Purpose**

The IT Engineer will be responsible for the **day-to-day management, availability, security and support of the company's IT infrastructure and business applications**.

The role will manage **systems, networks, servers, user accounts, access rights, security, backups, IT assets and end-user support**, while also providing first-level support and coordination for the company's **ERP system**.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. IT Infrastructure, System & Network Administration**

· Manage and maintain desktops, laptops, servers, printers, storage and other IT equipment.

· Install, configure and maintain operating systems and business applications.

· Maintain IT asset, software licence, warranty and support records.

· Manage LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, Internet and VPN connectivity.

· Configure and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, DNS, DHCP and IP addressing.

**B. User & Access Management**

· Create, modify and disable user accounts and system access.

· Control access to network folders, email, ERP and applications based on approved roles & authorization.

**C. ERP Support & Administration**

· Act as the internal IT coordinator for the ERP; administer users, roles and access permissions.

· Coordinate with the ERP implementation/support partner for issues, configuration, reports, integrations and upgrades.

· **Knowledge of Odoo ERP or another manufacturing ERP is preferred.**

**D. Manufacturing & Engineering Systems**

· Provide IT support to Engineering, Production, Stores, Maintenance and Quality.

· Coordinate IT requirements for **CAD, PDM/PLM, document management and other engineering applications**, where applicable.

· Support integration and connectivity between ERP and other business/engineering systems.

**E. Security & Backup**

· Implement and monitor basic IT security controls.

· Ensure regular backup of critical ERP, engineering and business data.

· Maintain basic disaster recovery procedures.

· Promote employee awareness of phishing, passwords, malware and data security.

**4. Required Technical Skills**

**Essential**

* Windows desktop and server administration.
* LAN/WAN and network troubleshooting.
* IT asset management
* User account and access management.
* Hardware and software troubleshooting.

**ERP & other Skills**

* Understanding of ERP concepts and business processes.
* ERP user and role administration.
* Ability to coordinate with ERP implementation/support partners.

· CAD/PDM/PLM systems.

* **Odoo ERP experience is an advantage.**

**5. Educational Qualification & Experience**

**Qualification:**

· Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics or equivalent.

**Experience:**

· 3–7 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, system administration and user support.

· Should be capable of working independently and managing day-to-day IT operations.

· Experience supporting **50–100 users** preferred.

· Experience in a **manufacturing organization** is an advantage.

**6. Key Competencies**

· Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

· Good understanding of IT infrastructure and networking.

· User and access management discipline.

· ERP/application support capability.

· Good communication and vendor coordination skills.

· Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.

**7. Overall Responsibility**

The IT Engineer will be the **primary operational IT support resource** for the organization and will ensure that the company's IT infrastructure, network, user access, cybersecurity, backups and ERP environment remain reliable and secure.

The position is expected to work as a **hands-on IT professional and internal system coordinator**, while engaging external specialists/vendors for advanced ERP, cybersecurity, infrastructure or application requirements.

**Key focus areas:**

**IT Infrastructure → Networking → User Access → Cybersecurity → ERP Support → Manufacturing/Engineering Systems → Vendor Management**

Pay: ₹30,800.00 - ₹44,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior SaaS Tech Lead
description:

Job Description: Active Directory & PKI (Certificate Management) Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary -**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Active Directory & PKI Engineer to manage and support the organization's On-Premises Active Directory (AD), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), and Certificate Management infrastructure. The role is responsible for maintaining AD services, managing the certificate lifecycle, administering PKI components, remediating security vulnerabilities, and ensuring the availability, security, and compliance of identity and certificate services.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Active Directory Administration, PKI/Certificate Management, Windows Server Infrastructure, DNS, Group Policy, and IT Service Management processes.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities -
  
  
Active Directory Administration
  
  

* Administer and maintain On-Premises Active Directory infrastructure.
* Manage Active Directory users, groups, organizational units (OUs), and delegation models.
* Support and maintain Domain Controllers across multiple environments.
* Administer Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and troubleshoot Group Policy-related issues.
* Manage AD replication, site topology, DNS integration, and authentication services.
* Perform health checks and proactive monitoring of Active Directory services.
* Support Azure AD / Entra ID Connect synchronization and related services.
* Troubleshoot Active Directory, DNS, authentication, Kerberos, LDAP, and replication issues.

PKI & Certificate Services Administration-
  
  

* Manage Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
* Administer and maintain the enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
* Manage Certificate Authorities (CA), subordinate CAs, and certificate-related services.
* Ensure high availability and operational health of PKI infrastructure.
* Perform PKI component and service certificate renewals.

Certificate Lifecycle Management-
  
  

* Manage the end-to-end certificate lifecycle, including:
* Certificate issuance
* Renewal
* Revocation
* Replacement
* Expiry management
* Process certificate requests and approvals.
* Troubleshoot certificate enrollment and authentication issues.
* Ensure timely renewal of certificates to prevent service impact.

Certificate Template Management-
  
  

* Create, modify, and maintain Certificate Authority (CA) templates.
* Manage certificate enrollment and auto-enrollment policies.
* Support certificate template design and implementation based on business and security requirements.
* Ensure compliance with PKI standards and security policies.

Security & Vulnerability Management-
  
  

* Remediate vulnerabilities identified on:
* Domain Controllers
* Azure AD / Entra ID Connect Servers
* DNS Servers
* Certificate Servers
* Perform AD and PKI security hardening activities.
* Support security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities.
* Implement industry best practices for identity and certificate security.

Incident, Change & Problem Management-
  
  

* Manage Incident, Change Request (CR), Service Request, and Problem Management activities.
* Process operational alerts and support requests within SLA targets.
* Perform queue management and ticket prioritization.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, security, and application teams during incident resolution and change implementations.

Monitoring & Operational Support-
  
  

* Monitor Active Directory and PKI infrastructure health.
* Provide Event ID analysis and troubleshooting support to monitoring teams.
* Respond to service degradation and infrastructure alerts.
* Support end users and application teams for authentication and certificate-related issues.

Reporting & Service Improvement-
  
  

* Generate weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Track service metrics, incidents, vulnerabilities, and certificate renewals.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend improvements.
* Participate in continuous service improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Management-
  
  

* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, technical documents, and operational procedures.
* Ensure Active Directory and PKI configurations are properly documented.
* Develop knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Support knowledge transfer and operational readiness activities.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
Active Directory Skills-
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with:
* Microsoft Active Directory (On-Premises)
* Domain Controllers
* Group Policy (GPO)
* DNS
* LDAP
* Kerberos Authentication
* AD Replication
* Organizational Units (OU)
* Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID Connect
* Experience managing large-scale enterprise Active Directory environments.

PKI & Certificate Management Skills-
  
  

* Strong experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
* Expertise in Enterprise PKI Administration.
* Experience managing Certificate Authority (CA) infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of SSL/TLS certificates and certificate lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with certificate template creation and management.
* Knowledge of certificate enrollment, auto-enrollment, and certificate renewal processes.

IT Service Management-
  
  

* Experience in Incident, Service Request, Change, and Problem Management.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and service delivery frameworks.
* Experience managing operational support queues and SLA-based environments.

**Preferred Skills-**

* PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Cybersecurity and Identity & Access Management concepts.
* Experience with vulnerability management and security remediation.
* Exposure to Microsoft Entra ID, Hybrid Identity, and Windows Server Administration.
* Experience supporting compliance and audit activities.

Job Description: Senior Venafi PKI Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary-**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Venafi PKI Engineer to lead the administration, automation, governance, and lifecycle management of enterprise digital certificates using the Venafi Platform. The role will be responsible for maintaining a Zero-Touch PKI framework, ensuring automated certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, and compliance across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Venafi TLS Protect, Enterprise PKI, Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certificate lifecycle automation, machine identity management, and security governance. This role will work closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, Application, and Network teams to secure machine identities and eliminate certificate-related outages through automation.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Venafi Platform Administration-
  
  

* Administer, configure, and maintain the Venafi platform across enterprise environments.
* Manage Venafi TLS Protect, Trust Protection Platform (TPP), and machine identity management solutions.
* Ensure platform availability, performance, scalability, and operational stability.
* Perform platform upgrades, patch management, and health monitoring activities.
* Manage Venafi administrative functions, policies, workflows, and RBAC controls.

Zero-Touch Certificate Lifecycle Management-
  
  

* Support and Maintenance of Zero-Touch certificate lifecycle management processes.
* Automate certificate discovery, enrollment, issuance, renewal, installation, and revocation.
* Ensure proactive replacement of expiring certificates with minimal manual intervention.
* Manage certificate inventories across enterprise applications, servers, databases, load balancers, and cloud workloads.
* Eliminate certificate-related service outages through automation and governance controls.

Enterprise PKI Management
  
  

* Integrate and manage enterprise PKI environments including:
* Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS)
* Public Certificate Authorities
* Internal Certificate Authorities
* Cloud-based Certificate Services
* Manage root CA and subordinate CA integrations.
* Maintain certificate trust chains and PKI security standards.
* Provide technical oversight for certificate authority architecture and governance.

Machine Identity Management
  
  

* Manage machine identities across:
* Windows Servers
* Linux Servers
* Cloud Platforms
* Containers
* Kubernetes Clusters
* Network Devices
* Load Balancers
* Web Servers
* Establish and maintain enterprise machine identity governance practices.
* Discovery and monitoring of unmanaged certificates.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce certificate security policies and governance standards.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Perform certificate risk assessments and remediation activities.
* Identify weak, expired, or non-compliant certificates and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and PKI best practices.

Integration & Automation
  
  

* Integrate Venafi with:
* Active Directory
* ServiceNow
* CyberArk/BeyondTrust
* SIEM Platforms
* DevOps Pipelines
* Cloud Security Platforms
* Kubernetes and Container Platforms
* Develop and maintain automation using:
* PowerShell
* REST APIs
* Python
* Venafi SDKs
* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code and certificate automation initiatives.

Incident, Change & Problem Management
  
  

* Manage critical incidents related to certificate services and PKI infrastructure.
* Support Change, Incident, Service Request, and Problem Management processes.
* Conduct root cause analysis on certificate-related outages.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues within agreed SLAs.

Monitoring & Operational Support
  
  

* Perform daily platform health checks.
* Monitor certificate expiry alerts, policy violations, and platform alarms.
* Manage dashboards, reporting, and operational metrics.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, cloud, and application teams during incident resolution.

Reporting & Governance
  
  

* Prepare executive and operational reports covering:
* Certificate inventory
* Compliance status
* Expiring certificates
* Platform utilization
* Risk exposure
* Service performance
* Present PKI governance metrics to security leadership and stakeholders.
* Develop PKI roadmaps and automation strategies.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement-
  
  

* Maintain architecture documents, SOPs, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Lead service improvement and certificate automation initiatives.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend platform enhancements.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to junior engineers.

Core Technical Skills-
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Venafi TLS Protect / Trust Protection Platform (TPP).

* Extensive experience with:
* Enterprise PKI
* Certificate Authorities (CA)
* SSL/TLS Certificates
* Machine Identity Management
* Certificate Automation

Infrastructure & Security-

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

title: Saviynt IAM Professionals
description:
**Company Description**
eSec Forte® Technologies is a CMMI Level 3 certified global consulting and IT security services organization, specializing in areas such as cloud security, secure access management, cyber forensics, malware detection, and penetration testing. The company is CERT-INDIA empaneled to provide information security auditing services and serves as a PCI DSS QSA, authorized to validate adherence to PCI security standards. eSec Forte® is the OEM of NXSAM, a next-generation security audit and management platform that tracks vulnerability lifecycles across networks, applications, cloud environments, and third-party vendors. The organization partners with leading security technology providers, including CATO Networks, Palo Alto Networks, Tenable, Delinea, and others, to offer comprehensive information security solutions. eSec Forte® has also developed “Crackbox,” a high-performance hardware solution for password processing and related security tasks.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for Saviynt IAM Professionals based in Gurugram. The role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using Saviynt, including role engineering, access policies, and governance workflows. The professional will configure integrations with directories, applications, and cloud platforms; manage onboarding and offboarding processes; and support access reviews and compliance reporting. Daily responsibilities include troubleshooting IAM issues, optimizing Saviynt configurations, collaborating with security and infrastructure teams, and contributing to documentation and best practices. The role also includes participation in security audits, risk assessments related to identity and access, and continuous improvement of IAM controls aligned with organizational security objectives.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Saviynt expertise, including IAM configuration, role-based access control, access governance, and workflow management.
* Candidates should possess skills in identity lifecycle management, user provisioning/deprovisioning, directory services (e.g., AD/LDAP), and integration with enterprise and cloud applications.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of information security fundamentals, including access control models, least privilege, compliance frameworks (PCI DSS, ISO 27001), and audit requirements.
* Candidates should possess abilities in troubleshooting, incident analysis, and performance optimization of IAM solutions in complex environments.
* Candidates should possess strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams, document technical processes, and support end users.
* Relevant experience with other IAM tools or security platforms, scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python), and familiarity with security operations will be beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, along with prior experience in IAM or security engineering, is preferred.

description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Infrastructure Engineering
  
  
**About Your Role**
As a Load Balancer Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain load balancing and traffic management solutions that support secure, scalable, and highly available network services. You will partner with network, security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver resilient solutions across data center and cloud environments. Your work will help improve application availability, strengthen enterprise network performance, and support secure infrastructure modernization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain load balancing infrastructure using F5 BIG-IP, Citrix NetScaler, Avi Networks, or similar application delivery controller (ADC) platforms.

* Analyze network and application traffic flows, including Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) behavior and packet inspection, to resolve issues and improve service availability.

* Identify, assess, and recommend new technologies, protocols, and solutions that improve network efficiency, resiliency, and operational effectiveness.
* Develop testing, backup, and disaster recovery processes for load balancing and telecommunications infrastructure to minimize malfunctions and service disruption.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and support for complex load balancing issues and collaborate with internal teams to resolve engineering and deployment challenges.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

* 6+ years of experience in network engineering, load balancing engineering, application delivery, or related infrastructure roles supporting enterprise environments.

**About Axslogic**

Axslogic is a fintech analytics enterprise software company that helps financial institutions digitize their lending data analytics while they progress their overall digitization journey. The company's flagship product, Winnow™, creates a new early warning exception management paradigm to manage challenges and risks associated with lending businesses. Founded by domain experts, Axslogic provides cutting-edge business analytics solutions that enable better portfolio performance and improved profitability for financial institutions. The company is headquartered in Singapore, with offices in India and the UAE.

**Role Overview**

Axslogic is seeking an experienced and skilled
**Platform Engineering Manager**
to join our team and drive the automation, scalability, and security of our cloud-based infrastructure. The ideal candidate will lead efforts to build and maintain a robust cloud platform that supports our patented SaaS / Managed SaaS products providing Early Warning and Predictive Analytic capabilities to financial institutions. This role requires strong expertise in
**DevOps practices**
, deep
**hands-on experience with AWS**
, and a thorough understanding of
**IT security as it applies to DevOps and cloud infrastructure**
.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**

* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to support agile development practices
* Administer, monitor, and optimize AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, EKS, etc.)

* Monitor systems performance, ensure high availability, and troubleshoot issues

**Security & Compliance**

* Define and enforce security best practices across development and deployment environments

* Manage secure SFTP/FTPS servers and ETL processes that handle sensitive financial data
* Set up and maintain LDAP/Active Directory based authentication systems
* Conduct risk assessments and recommend enhancements to improve overall DevOps security posture
* Support compliance with ISO 27001:2013 standards

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of cloud engineers and DevOps specialists
* Collaborate with developers, QA, and security teams to ensure safe and secure deployments
* Work with product teams to understand application requirements and design infrastructure solutions
* Partner with data science teams to create infrastructure that supports analytics capabilities
* Stay current with AWS updates and security trends to proactively enhance systems

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering roles
* Strong expertise in
  **AWS cloud infrastructure management**
* Hands-on experience with
  **CI/CD tools**
  such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or similar
* Proficiency in
  **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
  tools: Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi
* Solid understanding of
  **IT security principles**
  , especially in DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, network security, vulnerability management)
* Experience with
  **containerization and orchestration**
  (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS)
* Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar
* Familiarity with log aggregation, monitoring, and alerting tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog)
* Experience with handling sensitive financial data and knowledge of related compliance requirements
* Experience with job control platforms like Airflow
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and managing complex infrastructure projects

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect)
* Experience with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA)
* Background in scripting development in Bash and Python
* Experience with GitOps practices
* Knowledge of IBM and Oracle platforms that support analytics solutions
* Understanding of financial services domain, particularly lending analytics
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures
* Engineering Graduate from a top-tier college

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on Winnow™, a cutting-edge patented SaaS platform that provides pre-programmed early warning capabilities and state-of-the-art reporting and analysis for financial institutions
* Support a robust solution with over 1500 Alert Thresholds, 250+ Reports with multi-variate segmentation over 60+ dimensions
* Build infrastructure for a platform that disrupts traditional manual processes in financial risk management
* Use cutting-edge cloud infrastructure tools and participate in advanced security implementations
* Help shape a secure and scalable DevOps culture within a fast-growing fintech company
* Work with a strong management team with significant domain expertise in Commercial Lending, Banking, and Consumer Financial Services
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Flexible working arrangements and a collaborative team environment
* Join a global team with offices in Singapore, India, and the UAE

**About Our Technology Stack**

Our Winnow SaaS platform is implemented using world-class platforms and requires expertise in maintaining a secure, high-performance cloud infrastructure. The platform handles sensitive financial data and powers analytics that help banks and financial institutions make critical business decisions. As Platform Engineering Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of this crucial infrastructure.

title: Cloud Ops Engineer
description:
**The Team**
The Mobility Division within S&P Global uses technology and data science to deliver insights, forecasts, and advisory services across the automotive value chain. The Cloud Operations team enables these products by running a reliable, well-governed cloud foundation—working in a collaborative culture focused on shared learning, operational rigor, and continuous improvement across a multi-account environment.
  
  
**The Impact**
This role is the operations owner for cloud governance and compliance at scale. You’ll keep cloud environments “day-1/day-2 ready” through strong account lifecycle management, guardrails, patch/vulnerability workflows, and audit-ready evidence. You’ll partner with Security/Risk (as stakeholders) and with Platform/App teams (as executors/owners) to ensure standards are implemented without slowing delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and improve core cloud operations capabilities: account vending, guardrails, compliance evidence, and vulnerability/patch hygiene
* Work cross-functionally with Platform Engineering, application teams, IAM, Risk/GRC, and Audit in a global environment
* Drive automation (policy-as-code / IaC / scripting) to reduce toil and improve consistency
* Gain exposure to multi-cloud operations (AWS/Azure/GCP) where applicable, while building durable governance patterns

**Required Skills**

* 3-6 years in cloud operations / platform engineering / cloud governance (operations-first, not a security analyst role)
* Hands-on experience running multi-account / multi-subscription environments: provisioning, inventory/metadata, tagging standards, baseline logging/monitoring, and decommissioning
* Strong cloud governance + guardrails experience (OU/org structures, inherited controls, policy change management, exception handling)
* Operational experience with policy-as-code (e.g., Cloud Custodian): deploying policies, tuning, handling exceptions/rollbacks, producing metrics/evidence
* Practical vulnerability + patch operations: using tools like Tenable, triaging findings, routing to owners, tracking SLAs, reporting aging, maintaining coverage/data quality
* Automation skills (Python/Bash/PowerShell) and familiarity with IaC concepts (Terraform/CloudFormation-style)
* Strong operational discipline: runbooks, change management, incident support, stakeholder communication, audit evidence handling

**Nice to have**

* Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and comfort standardizing controls across platforms

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
****Overview:****
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
*.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “*
*name@cvent.com*
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.*
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud*
*.*
****In This Role, You Will:****
Cvent is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team in Gurugram, India to help build and maintain the platform behind our event and hospitality SaaS business. This is a high impact engineering role for a person who thrives at:
  
  

* solving complex platform challenges,
* partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent’s customers, and
* executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption

In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale.
  
  
****In This Role, You Will:****

* Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments.
* Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability.
* Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis.
* Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges.
* Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving.
* Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution.

****How You Will Spend Your Time****
This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is:
  
  

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

title: Senior IAM Engineer
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.
  
  
What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment.
  
  
**Role Description**

* The Senior IAM Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating identity and access management solutions that support both internal users and customer-facing platforms.
* This role combines deep IAM expertise with a strong engineering mindset. You will work across IAM infrastructure, authentication platforms, and supporting services to build secure, scalable, and reliable identity solutions. The role requires hands-on engineering capability combined with platform ownership, ensuring IAM services are secure, reliable, and continuously improved through automation and DevOps practices.
* You will work closely with Engineering, Platform, and Information Security teams to integrate IAM capabilities into new and existing systems. This includes enabling modern authentication and authorisation patterns and ensuring IAM platforms are deployed and operated according to DevOps and cloud best practices.
* The role has broad technical scope. As well as building and improving IAM capabilities, you will help support and evolve the IAM platform itself, working with modern cloud infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrate responsible and effective use of GenAI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to improve engineering productivity and quality.
* Success in this role is measured by the reliability and security of IAM services, the quality of integrations with engineering teams, and the ability to continuously improve identity capabilities that support the bank’s growth.

**Principal Accountabilities**
**IAM Platform Engineering**

* Design, implement, and maintain secure IAM solutions supporting both Customer IAM and Workforce IAM.
* Configure and operate IAM platforms within the Ping Identity suite, particularly PingDirectory and PingFederate.
* Develop and maintain authentication and authorisation integrations across internal systems and customer-facing platforms.
* Ensure IAM solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with modern engineering practices.
* Ensure IAM services meet high availability, resilience, and security standards required for critical banking systems.

**Identity Architecture & Integration**

* Work with engineering teams to integrate IAM capabilities into applications and services.
* Implement and support modern authentication protocols including SAML, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
* Contribute to identity architecture decisions and ensure solutions align with security, compliance, and platform standards.
* Help define patterns for secure identity integration across services and platforms.
* Design and support API-driven identity integrations across internal services and external platforms.

**DevOps & Platform Support**

* Build and operate IAM platforms using DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices, enabling automated deployment, configuration, and scaling.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain visibility and operational health of IAM systems.
* Participate in incident response and troubleshooting for IAM-related issues, providing Tier-3 support where necessary.
* Continuously improve the automation, deployment, and operational management of IAM infrastructure.

**Identity Governance & Security**

* Work with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to support identity governance and access control processes.
* Contribute to IAM standards, policies, and best practices across the organisation.
* Support initiatives related to access controls, identity lifecycle management, and audit requirements.
* Help ensure identity solutions align with regulatory expectations and internal security frameworks.

**Collaboration & Enablement**

* Partner with Engineering, Platform, and Product teams to ensure IAM capabilities support new systems and services.
* Provide guidance and education to teams integrating with IAM platforms.
* Document architecture, integrations, and operational procedures to ensure knowledge sharing across teams.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of IAM tooling, processes, and engineering practices.

**Core Experience**
**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* Strong experience working in Identity and Access Management, including both Customer IAM and Workforce IAM.
* Strong hands-on experience with the Ping Identity platform, particularly PingDirectory and PingFederate, including configuration, integration, and operational support in production environments.
* Experience integrating IAM capabilities into distributed systems, enterprise applications, and customer-facing digital platforms.
* Strong understanding of authentication and authorisation standards, including SAML, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
* Experience working with Active Directory and Azure Active Directory or comparable identity platforms.

**Engineering & Technical Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an engineering-led approach to troubleshooting and system design.
* Experience integrating IAM platforms with applications and services.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and operational support for critical systems.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, platform, security, and product teams.
* Ability to explain identity concepts and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a high-growth engineering environment with evolving platforms and requirements.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience with PingOne MFA or other modern multi-factor authentication platforms.
* Exposure to Privileged Access Management (PAM) technologies.
* Experience working in regulated environments, particularly financial services.
* Experience contributing to secure system design and threat modelling.

**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
  
  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Diversity**

title: Senior Network Engineer (IT Delivery & Presales)
description:
Kolkata | Full Time, Permanent

Department: IT Infrastructure, Presales & Project Delivery

Experience: 5 to 10 years

Industry: IT Services and System Integration

**About the Role**

Emdee is a 20+ year old system integrator delivering IT infrastructure, software, security and surveillance, IT-enabled services, and manpower solutions primarily to government and public sector clients. It is headquartered in Kolkata and has presence in multiple states.

This role owns the technical correctness of everything we design and install, and supports sales as a technical voice in the bid cycle. You will design IT architecture, build BOQs, and see each design through to a commissioned site, supervising deployments across locations and taking direct charge of the complex ones. On the presales side, you will work alongside sales and business development on technical bids and client presentations. Prior presales/BD experience is prefered as you'd need to engage clients with technical sales.

**Note**

- if your experience entirely entails internal IT ops/admin for an organisation (eg, IT manager, IT admin, IT head), and not customer facing IT delivery (client project execution, field work, presales etc), then this role is not for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Solution Design and BOQ:

* Understand and engage with technical nuances, IT assets and solution architectures of government and enterprise projects.
* Plan and execute site surveys, requirement gathering and client engagement to then design IT infrastructure from floor plans, drawings, requirements and survey data
* Build and validate technical BOQs covering make and model selection, quantities across sites, passive and accessory items, and installation and service lines, working with procurement and OEMs on specifications, technical compliance and budgetary pricing

2. Execution and Delivery:

* Supervise deployment across project sites and take direct charge of complex or critical installations, leading team of junior network engineers and setting the execution standard for the field team.
* Own commissioning where technical depth is required across networking, end-user compute, surveillance and biometrics, servers and storage, accessories and peripherals, signages/displays, AV/VC and smart classroom systems, and resolve faults escalated by field engineers
* Coordinate site readiness, material accountability, and installation sequencing with the delivery and procurement teams. Drive acceptance testing, snag closure, client handover, and as-built documentation to a standard that stands up to departmental inspection

3. Presales and Bid support:

* Engage existing and prospective government/enterprise stakeholders for business development, opportunity farming and technically-grounded pitches and proposals.
* Build working relationships with clients, OEMs, and channel partners, to generate sales pipeline.
* Work with sales and business development to review government and public sector opportunities (tenders, RFPs, EOIs, GeM bids), and be the technical authority.
* Join requirement discovery, site visits, and pre-bid meetings, and help shape the solution to the client's need and the tender's evaluation criteria and prepare the technical content of bids
* Support presentations, demos, and proofs of concept for clients and evaluation committees, and help address technical queries during evaluation

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline
* 6 to 10 years in IT infrastructure and network engineering, with demonstrated experience designing and executing multi-site deployments
* Experience with a system integrator, IT OEM, or infrastructure services company. Government and PSU project experience preferred
* Good communication skills and prior experience in technical sales / presales / business development or equivalent exposure to client facing engagements
* Ability to design infrastructure from floor plans, drawings, and survey data: topology, device placement, cable routing, IP schema, PoE and power budgeting, and storage and bandwidth sizing
* Proven ability to build and validate technical BOQs, including make and model selection, quantity derivation across sites, and passive and accessory items
* Strong hands-on depth across active and passive networking: managed and PoE switching, routing, VLANs, DHCP and DNS, firewalls and VPN, wireless, structured cabling, fibre and UTP, patch panels, racks, and cable management
* Practical experience across IP surveillance and NVR systems, biometric devices, servers and storage, UPS and power, endpoints and peripherals, and AV, video conferencing and smart classroom systems
* Working familiarity with OEM ecosystems across networking, surveillance, compute, and power, including product fitment, specification and budgetary price discovery, support escalation, and warranty processes
* Experience supervising field engineers and vendors on site, with accountability for installation quality and schedule
* Ability to read tender specifications and respond on technical compliance
* Documentation discipline: topology drawings, as-built records, IP and asset registers, and handover documents
* Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent are an advantage
* Based in Kolkata or willing to relocate. Travel to project sites across states is a requirement of this role

description:

* Optimize alerting rules in Zenoss to reduce noise and ensure that only actionable and prioritized events are routed into ServiceNow ITSM queues
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to understand integration requirements and translate them into stable technical solutions using ServiceNow and Zenoss capabilities
* Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for integration designs configuration baselines runbooks and operational procedures to support ongoing maintenance

* Enhance automation workflows to support Finance and Accounting processes by enabling faster incident resolution and improved service reporting for financial systems
* Perform impact analysis and regression testing for integration changes to safeguard production environments and maintain high platform reliability in the hybrid work model
* Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to ensure that integration configurations adhere to enterprise governance policies and audit requirements
* Mentor junior team members on best practices in tool integration event management and configuration management to strengthen overall team capability
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve monitoring coverage workflow efficiency and user experience through incremental enhancements in ServiceNow ITSM and Zenoss solutions

**Qualifications**

* Apply professional experience of six to ten years in enterprise tool integration with a primary focus on ServiceNow ITSM and large scale monitoring platforms
* Demonstrate hands on expertise in configuring ServiceNow ITSM processes including incident problem change and request management to support global operations
* Utilize advanced knowledge of Zenoss Cloud to design service models configure event classes and build dashboards tailored to critical infrastructure components
* Leverage practical experience with Zenoss to implement reliable monitoring of applications databases and network elements with accurate thresholds and event lifecycles
* Employ understanding of Finance and Accounting domain processes as a valuable asset to tailor monitoring and incident workflows for financial applications and related services
* Operate efficiently within a hybrid work model by using collaboration tools clear documentation and structured handover practices to coordinate with distributed teams
* Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders to explain integration changes articulate risks and propose mitigation options that protect business outcomes

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and ITSM Implementation Specialist or equivalent monitoring platform certification

title: Manager - Voice Application (FreeSwitch-Asterisk)
description:
**Job Purpose**

We are seeking a skilled VoIP Engineer with hands-on experience in Asterisk, FusionPBX, FreeSwitch, ViCIdial, SBC configuration, and hosted contact centre environments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring, delivering, and maintaining SIP trunking, contact centre, and PBX/telephony systems from both application and backend perspective.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Contact Centre & PBX Administration**

* Configure and manage users, campaigns, and leads in a hosted contact centre platform.
* Create and deploy IVR menus and call flow configurations, including audio prompts and routing logic.
* Customize and manage disposition codes, call outcomes, and agent workflows.
* Monitor and maintain contact centre platform performance and availability.

**SIP Trunking & SBC Configuration**

* Configure and maintain SIP trunks between Asterisk, SBCs, and third-party PBXs.
* Perform integration of SBCs with other VoIP systems (e.g., EPBX, CUCM, or hosted PBX platforms/dialler).
* Troubleshoot and debug call flow, SIP signalling, and VoIP-related customer issues.
* Monitor and ensure call quality using knowledge of VoIP protocols and network fundamentals.

**Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution**

* Diagnose and resolve VoIP call quality issues including jitter, latency, packet loss, and codec mismatches.
* Troubleshoot SIP signalling, RTP media path, and authentication failures.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on recurring VoIP incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Coordinate with carriers and third-party vendors for SIP trunk and interconnect issue resolution.

**Qualification & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or equivalent field.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of practical experience with Asterisk / FusionPBX / FreeSwitch / VICIdial or other telephony platforms.
* **Certifications (if any):**
  CCNA-Voice or CCNP-Collaboration preferred; Relevant certifications in VoIP, Asterisk, or networking are a plus.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Technical Skills:**
  Asterisk, FusionPBX, FreeSwitch, ViCIdial; Oracle SBC / Session Border Controllers; SIP, RTP, SRTP, WebRTC, TCP/IP, UDP; Linux CLI; IVR design and deployment; Hosted Contact Centre platforms.
* **Functional Skills:**
  SIP trunk configuration and management; Call flow design; Contact centre administration; VoIP troubleshooting; Integration with EPBX and CUCM.
* **Behavioral Competencies:**
  Analytical and systematic problem-solving; Ability to work independently and under pressure; Good documentation skills; Strong coordination with cross-functional and vendor teams.

title: IT Service Desk Specialist 3
description:
Make a meaningful impact on global healthcare — and grow your career while doing it. At ProductLife Group, you’ll join an innovative, forward‑thinking team operating across the world to shape the future of life sciences through expertise, collaboration, and purpose‑driven work.
  
  
‎‎
  
  
**Job Description**
The IT Service Desk Specialist is responsible for providing first-level IT support to end users, ensuring the timely and effective management and resolution of service requests and incidents.
  
  
The role involves the analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of tickets within the assigned scope, as well as the appropriate escalation of issues requiring specialized expertise. When necessary, the Service Desk Specialist collaborates with internal technical teams, subject matter experts and software vendors to investigate and resolve more complex issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and monitor incidents and service requests through the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform.
* Analyze, troubleshoot and resolve user issues within the scope of the Service Desk.
* Ensure accurate and timely ticket documentation, including troubleshooting activities, resolution and relevant communications.
* Prioritize and manage tickets according to their urgency, impact and applicable Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate internal expert teams or external software vendors.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and software vendors during the investigation and resolution of technical issues.
* Follow up on escalated tickets to ensure timely resolution and effective communication with the end user.
* Provide clear and professional communication to users throughout the incident/request lifecycle.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of knowledge articles, FAQs and troubleshooting documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and continuous improvement activities.
* Follow company IT policies, procedures and security requirements, with particular attention to the regulatory and compliance context of the Life Sciences industry.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Previous experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk or IT Support role.
* Good understanding of IT support and troubleshooting processes.
* Experience working with ticketing / ITSM tools.
* Experience with RxLogix is a plus
* Ability to analyze issues, identify possible causes and determine appropriate resolution or escalation paths.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-service orientation.
* Ability to work effectively with technical teams, subject matter experts and external software vendors.
* Ability to manage multiple tickets and priorities in a structured manner.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Experience in a regulated environment, preferably within the Life Sciences industry, is considered a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Problem-solving and analytical mindset.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Customer-oriented approach.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve processes and knowledge.

**Working Hours & Service Coverage**
The role is part of a global Service Desk operating on a 24x7 basis to ensure continuous service coverage. The successful candidate, based in India, may be required to work on a shift-based schedule, including:
  
  

* 00:00–08:00
* 08:00–17:00
* Weekend shifts, as required to ensure continuous 24x7 service coverage.

Shift assignments will be planned according to business and service requirements.
  
  
‎
  
  
Ready to take the next step? Apply today and join a global, innovative team that’s shaping the future of life sciences and empowering people to make a real impact in healthcare.
