title: CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems - CTI MD Tech (LRL)
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
LRL takes potential marketable products from Research through product registration and approval, enabling MDU's business needs of the future through information and technology solutions. Within this portfolio, Clinical Supply & Delivery (CS&D) owns the systems and platforms that move investigational drug product — from packaging and labeling through distribution and fulfillment — to clinical trial sites, reliably, compliantly, and on time for trial execution. The CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems is a senior individual contributor who owns hands-on technical delivery for these platforms — designing, building, and directly implementing integration patterns, data pipelines, and platform components that translate portfolio direction and roadmap decisions into production systems.
  
  
**Path/Level:**
R4 (CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems)
  
  
This role is structured as roughly 75% hands-on technical execution — architecting and directly implementing platform components, data pipelines, and integrations — and 25% technical leadership, mentorship, and design guidance for R2/R3 engineers. This is a senior individual-contributor position: candidates should bring sustained, current hands-on engineering depth alongside strong architectural judgment, and should expect to remain an active technical contributor throughout the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Hands-On Engineering & Implementation (75%)**

* Platform Build & Implementation — design, build, and directly implement production components for CS&D's clinical supply chain systems — integration layers, data pipelines, APIs/microservices, and cloud infrastructure — including critical or complex components, in close collaboration with R2/R3 engineers.
* Data Platform Engineering — build and maintain cloud-native data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and data lake/lakehouse solutions across AWS and Databricks/Delta Lake; make and implement database architecture decisions — relational vs. NoSQL vs. NewSQL selection, schema design, partitioning/sharding, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Integration & API Engineering — build API and microservices integration patterns for data access and cross-system integration; implement monitoring, alerting, and observability for data pipelines; diagnose and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
* AI/Agentic System Build — design and build agentic workflows, LLM integration and orchestration, RAG and vector-store implementations, and AI governance/guardrails; develop and validate proofs-of-concept ahead of production adoption.
* Governance, Risk & GxP/GCP Compliance Implementation — implement audit-readiness, security, and change-control practices in code and infrastructure; produce architecture documentation supporting audit, inspection, and CSV readiness.
* Business & Product Partnership — partner with architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into technical solutions; validate technical feasibility through hands-on spikes and prototypes.

**Technical Leadership & Architecture Guidance (25%)**

* Architecture Direction — provide design direction and integration patterns for R2/R3 engineering teams, informed by direct, current experience building comparable systems.
* Code & Design Reviews / Mentorship — conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor engineers through pairing, technical guidance, and shared problem-solving; champion engineering excellence and consistent design standards.
* Decision-Making (Implementation-Scoped) — hold design and integration decision authority for the systems owned; approve implementation-level architecture and integration patterns used by R2/R3 teams; escalate — rather than unilaterally resolve — platform-architecture, investment-level, or cross-portfolio risks to CS&D architecture leadership.
* India-Based Technical Leadership — represent CS&D engineering in relevant technical forums; build shared ownership and accountability between the India team and global stakeholders; strengthen India's role as a technical design and engineering center for the platforms owned.
* Talent Development — contribute to hiring and technical talent planning for the engineering teams, including evaluation of candidates' technical depth.

**Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas**
Cloud-Native Data Platform Architecture (AWS: S3, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, DMS, Lambda, EMR, Athena, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudFormation, CDK, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch)
  
  

* Data Lake / Data Warehouse / Lakehouse Design
* Databricks / Delta Lake
* Database Architecture & Design (relational and NoSQL, indexing, partitioning/sharding strategy)
* Agentic/AI System Design & Build (LLM orchestration frameworks, RAG, vector databases, LLMOps and AI observability)
* Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4 model)
* CI/CD & DevOps (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
* Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK)
* API & Microservices Design
* SQL & Dimensional Data Modelling (Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
* Monitoring, Alerting & Observability
* Streaming Platforms (Kafka, Confluent, AWS MSK)
* Security & Compliance Architecture (GxP, GCP, CSV)
* Cost Optimization (FinOps) & Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity Design
* Front-End & Back-End Development

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 12+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data platform roles, with a sustained, current track record of designing and implementing production systems.
* Strong AWS expertise with hands-on experience across: Data Storage & Warehousing (S3, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB); Data Processing & Integration (Glue, DMS, Lambda, EMR, Athena); API & Orchestration (API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge); Infrastructure (CloudFormation, CDK, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch).
* Strong SQL and data modelling expertise (dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas) across Redshift, Oracle, and SQL Server platforms.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines for data platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK).
* Current, hands-on coding proficiency across front-end, back-end, and AWS cloud development, with the ability to build, debug, and deliver production systems directly.
* Ability to speak in specific, concrete detail about systems designed, technical trade-offs made, and outcomes delivered.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions through hands-on pairing and code review, without requiring a formal people-manager structure.

**Additional Qualifications / Competencies**

* Experience in regulated industries (healthcare/pharma, finance, government) with compliance requirements.
* Experience with clinical data, life sciences, or statistical computing domains.

title: Public Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a **Public Cloud Solutions Architect** at Kyndryl, you act as the trusted advisor who turns business goals into cloud architecture that actually ships. You work closely with client executives, enterprise architects, security and compliance teams, governance, delivery, and our hyperscaler partners to keep everyone aligned on one technical direction. You get involved early, helping shape the strategy and the migration and modernization roadmap, and you stay through delivery so the architecture goes live on time, on budget, and secure by design.

  
  

**What you will do**  
This is a senior, client-facing role. **To the client, you are the go-to expert on public cloud.** You run discovery and assessment workshops, build the business case and total cost of ownership, and translate requirements into well-architected solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Increasingly, that means designing for AI and agentic AI as well, from the data and platform foundations through to the workloads themselves.

  

You will decide what Kyndryl will deliver, design the landing zones, networking, identity, data, and application patterns behind it, and lead the implementation teams to a clean result.
  
  
The role goes beyond any single engagement. You will mentor other architects and consultants, build reference architectures and reusable accelerators, and help set our delivery standards and governance. You will also help set Kyndryl apart through newer capabilities such as agentic AI, automation, and modernization accelerators that improve delivery quality, speed, and the value clients see. Kyndryl works across all the major public cloud platforms, so you will use what you know, keep building on it, and know when to bring in specialist SMEs.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**  
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

* 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise IT solutions, including at least 4+ years focused on public cloud architecture
* Deep, hands-on solutions architecture experience on at least one major hyperscaler (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) and working knowledge of a second; multi-cloud experience strongly preferred
* A track record leading cloud migration and modernization programs, covering assessment and discovery, the 7 Rs (rehost, replatform, refactor, and so on), landing zone and well-architected design, and large-scale workload migration
* Strong command of core cloud domains: compute, storage, networking (VPC/VNet, hybrid connectivity, DNS, load balancing), identity and access management, and cloud security and governance
* Solid grasp of cloud-native and modernization patterns: containers and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), microservices, serverless, and application refactoring
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI and agentic AI solutions on cloud, including the underlying data and platform foundations, the AI/ML services across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, and how generative and agentic workloads change architecture, security, and cost
* Experience applying AI to the delivery itself, using AI-led approaches, automation, and agentic tooling to speed up assessment, migration, modernization, and quality assurance
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, Ansible) and with CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Practical understanding of security by design, cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and well-architected or cloud adoption frameworks
* Proven consulting skills: running client workshops, building business cases and TCO/ROI models, presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level, and guiding delivery teams as the lead architect
At least one current associate- or professional-level cloud certification (for example, AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect)  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Professional- or expert-tier and multi-cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience in a consulting, professional services, or systems integrator setting delivering cloud work for enterprise clients
* Familiarity with hybrid and on-premises-to-cloud platforms (VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, AWS Outposts, Azure Stack/Arc, Google Distributed Cloud)
* Deeper specialization in agentic AI, such as multi-agent systems, agent orchestration and governance (AgentOps), retrieval-augmented generation, and integrating large language models into enterprise workflows and platforms
* Experience mentoring architects and contributing reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards
* Industry or regulated-environment experience (financial services, public sector, healthcare), including data sovereignty and compliance considerations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

title: Oracle Lead Database SRE
description:
**Role Overview**

The Lead Database SRE is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and automation of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business applications. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE and DevOps principles to ensure highly available, performant, and resilient database services.

The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices.

This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Reliability, Operations & Support**

Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications.

Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions.

Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required.

Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews.

Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention.

Database Engineering & Administration

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.
* Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.
* Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.
* Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.
* Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.
* Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering
* Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.
* Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.
* Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.
* Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.
* Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering
* Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).
* Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.
* Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.
* Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.
* Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration
* Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.
* Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.
* Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.
* Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture
* Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).
* Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.
* Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.
* Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).
* Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning
* Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.
* Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.
* Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.
* Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.
* Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture
* Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.
* Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.
* Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.
* Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.
* Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship
* Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).
* Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.
* Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.
* Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

Key skills :
  
  
Backup strategies, disaster
  
  
Recovery plans
  
  
Performance tuning,
  
  
Capacity/resource planning
  
  
Data Restoration
  
  
System Upgrades
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.
* Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).

**Required Technical Skills**

* Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.
* OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.
* Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.
* High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.
* Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.
* Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.
* Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.
* Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.
* Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Job Description: Associate Architect**

**Role Title:**
Associate Architect

**Department:**
Intelligent Automation

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Level:**
Mid-to-Senior Level (7 to 12 years)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-performing
**Software Engineer transitioning into Architecture (Aspirant Architect)**
. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between hands-on code execution and high-level architectural design.

You will work directly alongside Principal Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineering Managers to architect, evaluate, and scale distributed systems on modern cloud platforms. This role is built for a senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep cloud and distributed systems experience, and a passion for system design, data modeling, and technical leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Design & Technical Leadership**

* Assist in drafting architectural blueprints, tech stack evaluation documents, and Architecture Decision
* Perform trade-off analyses balancing performance, maintainability, security, scalability, and operational costs across cloud services and codebases.
* Help define and enforce coding standards, API specifications (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and design patterns across delivery teams.

**2. Hands-on Engineering & Prototyping**

* Write production-ready, highly maintainable code (primarily using
  **Python**
  or equivalent modern languages).
* Build Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to test emerging technologies, validate architectural hypotheses, and bench-test performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot complex, non-deterministic bugs and failure modes in distributed production environments.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Integration**

* Architect resilient, highly available cloud applications on
  **AWS**
  or
  **Azure**
  using microservices, serverless, and containerized topologies.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and deployment strategies (Canary, Blue/Green).
* Integrate full-stack observability (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) into software architecture from inception.

**4. Data Modeling & System Design**

* Design efficient relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) schemas optimized for read/write access patterns, storage efficiency, and data integrity.
* Implement event-driven and streaming architectures using message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Event Grid).

**5. SDLC Execution & Engineering Mentorship**

* Champion the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from threat modeling and capacity planning to post-launch monitoring.
* Conduct high-impact code and design reviews, mentoring mid-level and junior engineers on clean architecture, principles, and system resilience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Software Development:**
  7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python**
  or similar languages (Go, Java, C#).
* **Distributed Computing:**
  Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems. Strong understanding algorithms, caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), load balancing, and fault-tolerance patterns (Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads).
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  3+ years of building and deploying production workloads on
  **AWS**
  (e.g., EKS/ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, S3) or
  **Azure**
  (e.g., AKS, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL).
* **Data Modeling:**
  Proficiency in designing data schemas) and database migrations, and query optimization.
* **DevOps & IaC:**
  Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep), and automated pipeline tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* **Full SDLC Mastery:**
  Practical exposure to complete software life cycles, agile methodologies, secure coding practices (OWASP top 10), and automated testing frameworks (Unit, Integration, E2E).

**Behavioral & Aspirant Attributes**

* **Architecture Mindset:**
  Strong grasp of software design philosophies (Domain-Driven Design, SOLID principles, 12-Factor App methodology, Clean Architecture).
* **Communication:**
  Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and write concise technical documentation.
* **Continuous Learner:**
  Eagerness to evolve from feature implementation to enterprise-wide system strategy.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional) or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with data engineering pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or similar).

title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

  

  
* Strong ownership and accountability.
  
  
* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  
  
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, enterprise engineering environment.
  
  
* Passion for automation, engineering excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
* Ability to challenge existing approaches and introduce better engineering practices.

title: Admin & Event Coordinator
description:
**Position Title:** Admin & Event Coordinator

**Location:** Madipakkam

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Working days:** Monday - Saturday

**Working Timings:** 9.00AM- 6.00PM

**Experience:** 1–2 Years

**Required Qualification:** Master of Social Work (MSW)

About the Role

We are seeking an energetic, empathetic, and organized **Admin & Event Coordinator** to join our Chess Academy. This role uniquely blends core administrative responsibilities with community and school outreach.

Leveraging an MSW background, the ideal candidate will effectively build relationships with school administrators, parents, and students while organizing chess events, workshops, and inter-school tournaments.

Key Responsibilities1. Academy Administration & Operations

* Manage daily office and front-desk operations at the Chess Academy.
* Handle inquiries (walk-in, phone, email) from prospective students and parents.
* Manage student enrollments, fee collection, attendance records, and database management.
* Coordinate coach schedules, training sessions, and classroom setups.
* Maintain inventory for chess sets, clock timers, learning materials, and office supplies.

2. School Outreach & Event Planning

* Serve as the primary liaison between the Chess Academy and partner/prospective schools.
* Plan, schedule, and execute chess workshops, awareness sessions, and inter-school tournaments.
* Visit schools regularly to oversee chess program implementation, build relationships with school authorities, and gather feedback.
* Manage event logistics end-to-end: venue booking, equipment distribution, certificates, trophies, sound/media, and refreshments.
* Coordinate student registration, referee schedules, and parent communication for all internal and external events.

3. Student & Parent Engagement (MSW Focus)

* Apply social work principles to foster a safe, positive, and inclusive learning environment for young players.
* Communicate effectively with parents regarding student progress, behavioral feedback, and tournament guidance.
* Handle grievances or concerns professionally and empathetically.

Qualifications & Skills

* **Education:** Master of Social Work (MSW) or equivalent degree in Social Sciences/Humanities.
* **Experience:** 1–2 years of experience in administration, event coordination, or community outreach (experience in educational institutes or academies is a plus).
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and local languages.
* **Interpersonal Skills:** Strong ability to connect with children, parents, school principals, and staff.
* **Organizational Skills:** Exceptional multitasking, event management, and time-management abilities.
* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic digital management tools.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel locally to schools and event locations as needed.

Preferred Attributes

* Basic interest in or knowledge of Chess (not mandatory, but advantageous).
* Strong problem-solving mindset and adaptability in high-energy environments.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Oracle PL/SQL, DBA performance tuning, AWR, ADDM report, Oracle query running, DBA and Oracle package understanding, Generate SQL advisory reports, Oracle, Hive, Impala & HBASE, Writing complex SQLs, PL/SQL procedures, function, packages, Views, Triggers, Synonyms etc., AWR, ADDM, Advisory reports , Linux scripting.

title: Manager, Systems Engineering
description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Role Description**
This role offers the opportunity to engineer sophisticated analytics and automation solutions that solve meaningful business problems across multiple teams. You will combine hands-on Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps, Power Automate, data-modeling, and SQL expertise to deliver reliable end-to-end products. You will independently lead defined workstreams, collaborate with stakeholders, and influence solution design within established enterprise architecture and governance standards.
  
  
The position provides exposure to platform modernization, self-service analytics, application development, workflow automation, and reporting migration initiatives. You will also expand your leadership capabilities by mentoring developers, coordinating delivery activities, and acting as a technical point of contact for assigned solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead defined BI engineering and Power Platform workstreams from requirements analysis through design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
* Design and develop complex Power BI reports, semantic models, Tableau dashboards, Power Apps applications, and Power Automate workflows that address business and operational needs.
* Analyze business requirements, source-system structures, SQL logic, data relationships, and reporting dependencies to recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Develop and optimize advanced SQL queries, views, stored procedures, transformations, and reusable data structures supporting reporting and analytical applications.
* Coordinate delivery with business analysts, product owners, data engineers, platform administrators, architects, and quality-assurance partners.
* Apply enterprise standards for data governance, security, access management, source control, deployment, documentation, testing, performance, and operational readiness.
* Support modernization initiatives involving Tableau-to-Power BI migration, dashboard rationalization, semantic-model development, and replacement of manual processes with automated workflows.
* Manage assigned operational tasks, including incident investigation, production troubleshooting, enhancement prioritization, dependency management, and stakeholder communications
* Conduct solution-design reviews, SQL reviews, dashboard usability assessments, performance analysis, and reconciliation testing.
* Mentor less-experienced developers, share technical knowledge, and provide constructive guidance on development practices and solution quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-7+ years of progressive experience developing and leading delivery of Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps, and Power Automate solutions.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: System Administrator
description:
Winsupply is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Systems & Security Administrator (L2) with 2 to 4 years of experience to support our hybrid enterprise infrastructure and frontline security operations. In this role, you will safeguard core digital assets across multi-regional environments—monitoring endpoint and web application security events, deploying critical system patches, and responding to operational incidents. Alongside security monitoring, you will play a key role in maintaining system uptime, verifying data backups, and supporting database and network health. This is an excellent opportunity for a technical professional looking to expand their expertise across both enterprise systems administration and frontline SecOps within a collaborative global team.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our technical operations, ensuring high availability across servers, networks, and databases while executing critical backup routines and disaster recovery procedures. In addition, you will act as the frontline responder for security alerts (EDR/XDR and SIEM), vulnerability patching, and off-hours operational disruptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.Database Maintenance & Monitoring**

* Monitor relational database health, CPU utilization, disk space, memory utilization, connection pool limits, and blocking locks (e.g., DB2, SQL Server, MariaDB, or MongoDB).
* Track replication status, high-availability cluster health, and alert on replication lag or database service interruptions.
* Perform operational maintenance tasks including checking table bloat, space allocation, and executing standard service restart playbooks during scheduled off-hours.

**2.Backup, Disaster Recovery & Storage Management**

* Oversee and verify automated daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules across enterprise systems, databases, and cloud/on-premise storage.
* Actively investigate backup failures, resolve storage capacity bottlenecks, and re-trigger failed backup jobs.
* Participate in scheduled Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and execute routine restoration validations to ensure Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are strictly maintained.

**3.Network & Operating System Administration**

* Administer Windows Server and Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) environments, including user access, OS patching, disk space management, and system services.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including DNS resolution failures, DHCP scopes, routing issues, and VPN tunnel drops.
* Verify firewall traffic rules, monitor reverse proxy/load balancer health checks, and manage SSL/TLS certificate renewals to prevent service outages.

**4.Endpoint & Web Application Security Monitoring**

* Monitor enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Defender for Endpoint).
* Triage high-severity alerts, including
  **WildFire Malware**
  sandbox verifications,
  **Local Analysis Malware**
  , and suspicious process executions.
* Execute frontline containment procedures, including host network isolation and account lockdowns following established security playbooks.
* Monitor Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and API gateways for abnormal traffic spikes, suspicious request patterns, and Layer 7 anomalies.

**5.Vulnerability & System Patch Management**

* Track infrastructure and endpoint vulnerabilities across Linux, Windows, and third-party software.
* Plan, test, and deploy monthly OS patches, kernel updates, and critical security hotfixes during approved off-hours maintenance windows.
* Coordinate patch rollbacks and mitigation steps if updates conflict with production databases or application dependencies.

**6.Incident Response & SIEM Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary responder for off-hours system outages, database alerts, network interruptions, and high-priority security incidents.
* Monitor enterprise SIEM queues (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) for suspicious authentication attempts, brute-force patterns, and privilege escalation.
* Facilitate swift triage, coordinate with upstream engineering/DBA leads when needed, and lead post-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reporting.

**7.Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, and shift handover records.
* Track and report on key operational SLAs, including backup success rates, patch compliance percentages, and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

**Candidate Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Support, or an integrated SysAdmin / SecOps role.
* **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **OS & Networking:**
  Proficient in Linux and Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, TCP/IP troubleshooting, and basic firewall configurations.
* **Database & Backups:**
  Hands-on experience checking database services and locks, combined with practical exposure to enterprise backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, AWS Backup, native DB dumps).
* **Security Tools:**
  Practical familiarity with EDR/XDR consoles (Palo Alto Cortex XDR preferred) and SIEM alert monitoring.
* **Scripting (Advantageous):**
  Working knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, or Python to automate basic health checks and log reviews.
* **Work Style:**
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset under incident conditions.
* **Flexibility:**
  Willingness to work in rotational shifts and participate in scheduled off-hours/weekend on-call rotations.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Associate or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, or (ISC)² SSCP are preferred.
* Familiarity with web application security concepts and common vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* Basic scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and log processing are a plus.
* Experience operating within a SIEM or Security Operations Center (SOC) environment is advantageous.
