title: Manager - Salesforce Administration and Business Analysis - Pharma
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
At Azurity, our Customer Experience (CX) and Digital Transformation team is expanding as we continue to invest in next-generation CRM, AI, analytics, and customer engagement capabilities. We are building a modern, data-driven commercial ecosystem powered by Salesforce, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, AI, and omnichannel engagement technologies that support our growth across Commercial, Medical Affairs, and Patient Services.
  
  
We are seeking dynamic, highly motivated, and hands-on professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace change, and are passionate about solving business challenges through technology. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping the future of our CRM and customer engagement capabilities while working alongside cross-functional teams across the organization.
  
  
The Manager - Salesforce Administration & Business Analysis serves as a senior member of the CRM team, responsible for Salesforce platform administration, business stakeholder support, and driving continuous improvement of CRM processes and capabilities. This role combines Salesforce administration, business analysis, solution design, user adoption, data management, and cross-functional collaboration responsibilities to help maximize the value of the CRM platform across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Patient Services, and other business functions.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of technical, analytical, and stakeholder management skills and serves as a key partner in translating business needs into scalable, compliant, and impactful CRM solutions. This individual will work closely with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Data & Analytics, Compliance, and IT teams to support the continued evolution of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics (CRMA), and related commercial technologies
  
  
**WORK SCHEDULE: This position requires full coverage of US Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) and is not a standard India daytime work schedule**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Salesforce Administration & Platform Support
* Administer and support the Salesforce platform, including user setup, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and security controls.
* Configure and maintain objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, flows, approval processes, and Lightning applications.
* Provide day-to-day platform support, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate resolution with technical teams and vendors.
* Support release planning, testing, deployment coordination, and change management activities.
* Monitor platform adoption, system performance, and overall platform health.
* Maintain documentation related to configuration, business processes, governance controls, and support procedures.

**Business Analysis & Solution Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, requirements, and operational challenges.
* Lead requirements gathering sessions, workshops, process reviews, and stakeholder interviews.
* Document business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement.
* Collaborate with CRM Architects, Developers, Product Owners, and external partners to design and implement solutions.
* Support and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and validation of business requirements.

**Commercial Operations Support**

* Support CRM capabilities related to customer engagement, territory management, call reporting, targeting, account planning, and field force effectiveness.
* Partner with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Medical Affairs, and Marketing teams to optimize CRM processes and user experience.
* Support omnichannel engagement initiatives and HCP/HCO engagement activities.
* Assist in evaluating and prioritizing CRM enhancements aligned with business priorities.

**Reporting, Analytics & Data Management**

* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics supporting business and leadership decision-making.
* Support CRM data governance, quality monitoring, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Perform data mapping, transformation, migration, and validation activities during system enhancements and implementation projects.
* Partner with Data & Analytics teams to support Customer 360, reporting, and data management initiatives.

**Integrations & Ecosystem Support**

* Support integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms including IQVIA, Pitcher, Data Cloud, Snowflake, Marketing technologies, MDM, and reporting solutions.
* Assist with troubleshooting integration issues and validating end-to-end business processes.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure successful delivery of integrated solutions across the CRM ecosystem.

**Training, Adoption & Governance**

* Develop and deliver end-user training, documentation, job aids, and adoption materials.
* Support change management and user adoption initiatives to maximize business value from CRM investments.
* Participate in CRM governance processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure solutions and business processes align with pharmaceutical industry compliance requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, and applicable regulatory standards.

**Qualifications**

* 7-10+ years of experience supporting Salesforce CRM platforms with hands-on Salesforce Administration and Business Analysis responsibilities.
* Salesforce Administrator Certification required. Also Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Salesforce Business Analyst, Sales Cloud Consultant, Data Cloud Consultant, or Life Sciences Cloud certifications.
* Strong experience supporting Salesforce Sales Cloud, Veeva, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics (CRMA), Experience Cloud, or similar CRM technologies.
* Proven experience gathering requirements, facilitating workshops, documenting business processes, and supporting solution delivery initiatives.
* Experience supporting pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.
* Understanding of HCP/HCO engagement, territory management, CRM compliance, field force operations, and commercial processes.
* Experience working with CRM integrations, data management, and reporting solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile delivery and cross-functional team environments

**Required Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator
* Salesforce Certified Business Analyst
* Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce AI Associate
* Salesforce Platform App Builder
* Salesforce Experience Cloud Consultant
* CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Data Engineer
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard powers the global economy by enabling secure, seamless, and intelligent payments across the world. Behind every transaction is a sophisticated technology ecosystem that processes billions of payment events with speed, resilience, and precision.
  
  
As a Lead Data Engineer within the Data Collection & Engineering (DC&E) organisation, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling Mastercard's next-generation data platforms and analytical ecosystems. You will develop high-performance, cloud-enabled data pipelines that power Mastercard's enterprise data warehouse and lakehouse environments, enabling advanced analytics, business intelligence, regulatory reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organisation.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to solve large-scale data engineering challenges, work with cutting-edge big data technologies, and contribute to a modern cloud transformation programme supporting global payment processing platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Engineering & Development
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, secure, scalable, and resilient data pipelines using Apache Spark, Java/Scala across Hadoop and cloud-native object storage platforms.
* Build and maintain batch and near real-time data processing frameworks capable of supporting petabyte-scale workloads.
* Develop reusable engineering components and frameworks that accelerate data product delivery while maintaining enterprise standards.

Architecture & Platform Engineering
  
  

* Design and implement a "build once, run anywhere" architecture supporting seamless deployment across on-premises and public cloud environments without code changes.
* Implement data lineage, metadata management, data cataloguing, data quality controls, and observability capabilities across the data ecosystem.
* Collaborate with architects and platform teams to establish scalable design patterns and engineering best practices.

Cloud Modernisation
  
  

* Contribute to migration initiatives moving legacy ETL and data warehouse workloads from on-premises environments to cloud-native architectures.
* Leverage cloud services such as Amazon S3, EMR, Glue, and related data services to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Drive adoption of modern lakehouse and distributed compute architectures.

Delivery & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead end-to-end development activities including requirement analysis, solution design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers through code reviews, technical coaching, and engineering best practices.
* Partner with product owners, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within committed timelines.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform root cause analysis to identify and implement long-term remediation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with Mastercard's engineering, security, quality assurance, and operational governance standards.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve performance, automation, monitoring, and process efficiency.

Innovation
  
  

* Evaluate emerging data technologies and conduct proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to determine their applicability within Mastercard's data ecosystem.
* Contribute to engineering innovation and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

**Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  

* 10-12 years of experience delivering enterprise-scale Data Warehouse, Data Lake, or Data Lakehouse solutions.
* Proven experience implementing multiple end-to-end data engineering projects within large-scale distributed computing environments.
* Hands-on experience migrating ETL and analytics workloads from on-premises platforms to cloud-native environments.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong development experience using:Apache Spark, Scala or Java, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, Object Storage platforms
* Experience building orchestration and workflow solutions using: Apache Airflow/ Apache NiFi and Similar enterprise scheduling frameworks
* Strong SQL expertise and experience with Relational and NoSQL database technologies: Oracle/ SQL Server, Cassandra, Dynamo DB etc.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably AWS: Amazon S3, EMR, AWS Glue, Cloud-native data services

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience operating within Agile delivery environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate within geographically distributed and matrix-based teams.
* Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus.
* Ability to learn emerging technologies quickly and apply them effectively to business challenges.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Business Development Officer – Healthcare & Medical Education (CPD Courses)
description:
Job Title: Business Development Officer – Healthcare & Medical Education (CPD Courses)

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office + Field Visits  
**Department:** Business Development & Institutional Sales  
**Experience Required:** 2–5 Years  
**Industry Preference:** Healthcare, Medical Education, Pharmaceutical Sales, Medical Training, or Institutional Business Development  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Salary:** Competitive salary based on experience + Performance-Based Incentives

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced **Business Development Officer (BDO)** with a strong background in the medical and healthcare industry to drive business growth for our Continuing Professional Development (CPD) courses.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience in business development, institutional sales, healthcare partnerships, or medical education, with a proven ability to generate business from hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, and other healthcare-related institutions.

This is a field-oriented business development role that requires regular visits to healthcare institutions, building relationships with key decision-makers, promoting our CPD training programmes, developing institutional partnerships, and converting business opportunities into confirmed enrolments and revenue.

**We are specifically looking for someone who knows how to bring business to the company, has experience in the medical sector, and can independently develop new institutional accounts.**

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Revenue Generation

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for CPD courses and healthcare-related training programmes.
* Generate qualified leads and convert them into paying institutional clients and course enrolments.
* Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Build a strong pipeline of hospitals, clinics, colleges, and healthcare institutions.
* Negotiate commercial terms, training packages, and institutional enrolment opportunities.
* Take ownership of the complete business development cycle, from prospecting to deal closure.

2. Hospital & Healthcare Institution Visits

* Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres, healthcare groups, and other medical institutions.
* Meet hospital administrators, medical superintendents, HR managers, training coordinators, nursing superintendents, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Present CPD courses and explain their relevance to doctors, nurses, pharmacists, nutrition professionals, and other healthcare practitioners.
* Explore opportunities for institutional training programmes, bulk enrolments, staff development initiatives, and recurring training partnerships.
* Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospective and existing institutional clients to convert opportunities into business.

3. Medical College & Educational Institution Partnerships

* Develop business relationships with:
* MBBS colleges and medical schools
* Nursing colleges and nursing schools
* B.Sc. Nutrition and Dietetics colleges
* Pharmacy colleges
* Allied health sciences and paramedical institutions
* Healthcare training institutes and professional associations
* Visit college management teams, principals, deans, heads of departments, placement officers, and faculty coordinators.
* Promote CPD courses to relevant institutions and identify suitable opportunities for student, faculty, and professional enrolments, where applicable.
* Arrange institutional presentations, meetings, seminars, orientation sessions, and course awareness activities.
* Establish long-term partnerships with colleges and healthcare institutions to generate repeat business.

4. Institutional Sales & Partnership Development

* Pitch CPD programmes to hospitals, colleges, clinics, and healthcare organisations.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, and partnership offers for prospective clients.
* Explore bulk enrolment models, corporate training opportunities, institutional tie-ups, and customised training arrangements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to organise course demonstrations, information sessions, and enrolment drives.
* Identify new market segments and geographical areas for expanding the company's healthcare education business.

5. Lead Management & Client Relationship Management

* Maintain an updated database of prospects, institutional contacts, meetings, and sales opportunities.
* Track leads, follow-ups, proposals, negotiations, enrolments, and revenue generated.
* Use CRM tools or structured reporting systems to manage the sales pipeline.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat enrolments and referrals.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic business development reports to management.

6. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Research hospitals, medical colleges, nursing institutions, pharmacy colleges, and other potential clients.
* Identify institutions with suitable training requirements and potential demand for CPD courses.
* Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and institutional training needs.
* Provide feedback to management regarding customer expectations, pricing opportunities, and potential new programmes.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare Management, Nursing, or a related discipline is preferred.
* **Minimum 2 years of relevant experience** in healthcare business development, pharmaceutical sales, medical education sales, institutional sales, or healthcare partnership development.
* Prior experience generating revenue or bringing business to a company within the medical or healthcare sector is essential.
* Experience dealing with hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, or healthcare institutions is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to identify prospects, meet decision-makers, develop relationships, negotiate, and close deals.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly for institutional visits and business meetings.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and achieve assigned business targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate may have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Pharmaceutical or medical product sales with strong institutional contacts.
* Hospital business development or corporate healthcare sales.
* Medical education, healthcare training, or CPD programme sales.
* Business development for nursing, pharmacy, allied health sciences, or medical colleges.
* Institutional partnerships, academic collaborations, or healthcare training contracts.
* Selling professional training programmes, certification courses, or educational services to healthcare organisations.

**Candidates with an existing network of hospital administrators, doctors, nursing college management, pharmacy college management, or medical education professionals will have an advantage.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against clearly defined business development objectives, including:

* Number of new hospitals, clinics, and educational institutions approached.
* Number of qualified leads and decision-maker meetings generated.
* Number of institutional partnerships established.
* Number of proposals submitted and deals successfully closed.
* CPD course enrolments generated through institutional channels.
* Monthly and quarterly revenue achieved against assigned targets.
* Conversion rate from qualified leads to confirmed business.
* Quality of client relationships, follow-up discipline, and repeat business.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and industry knowledge.
* Performance-based incentives linked to business generated.
* Opportunity to develop a strong network across the healthcare and medical education sectors.
* A growth-oriented role with direct responsibility for institutional partnerships and revenue generation.
* Opportunity to contribute to professional development and continuing education within the healthcare sector.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance and business impact.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who have relevant healthcare industry experience and a proven track record in business development are encouraged to apply.

Please highlight the following in your application:

* Previous healthcare or medical industry experience.
* Hospitals, clinics, colleges, or institutions handled.
* Experience in institutional sales and partnership development.
* Examples of business generated, sales targets achieved, or major accounts acquired.
* Current location, notice period, and expected salary.

**Important:** This is a business development and revenue-generation position, not a purely administrative or telecalling role. Candidates must be comfortable with field visits, institutional meetings, client relationship management, and achieving sales targets.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Manager, CRM
description:
**About the Company**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

BDO India is seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven Assistant Manager – CRM Data Management & Operations to oversee the integrity, quality, and governance of customer and business development data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).

The role will be responsible for driving CRM data quality initiatives, managing stakeholder data requests, ensuring compliance with Master Data Management (MDM) standards, supporting user onboarding and access management, and partnering with internal teams to continuously improve CRM processes and data governance practices.

This position requires strong analytical capabilities, hands-on CRM administration experience, stakeholder management skills, and a proactive approach to driving operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**CRM Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Ensure the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of CRM data across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, and Orders.
* Conduct regular audits of CRM records against defined MDM standards and implement corrective actions to address data quality gaps.
* Lead data cleansing, de-duplication, validation, and enrichment initiatives to improve overall CRM data health.
* Maintain and monitor CRM data quality scorecards, identifying trends, risks, and areas requiring remediation.
* Track compliance with CRM data entry standards across business units and prepare periodic management reports.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen governance controls.
* Maintain documentation including data dictionaries, governance guidelines, audit logs, and process documentation.

**CRM Operations & Data Request Management**

* Manage the firm's CRM Data Request Management process, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of stakeholder requests.
* Review and approve account creation requests in line with established governance protocols.
* Facilitate backend creation and maintenance of Accounts, Contacts, and Leads within D365.
* Ensure adherence to defined service levels for all requests:
* Standard Requests – Within 3 business days
* Priority Requests – Within 1 business day
* Monitor request queues, maintain tracking logs, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Analyze request patterns and identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and enhance self-service capabilities.
* Develop and maintain reusable reports, dashboards, and data assets to support business development and leadership requirements.

**Stakeholder & User Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for CRM-related data queries and support requests from Partners, Directors, and business teams.
* Support onboarding and offboarding of CRM users, ensuring appropriate role-based access and security controls.
* Collaborate with the Digital Office and relevant teams on data migration activities, system enhancements, configuration updates, and process improvements.
* Conduct user awareness sessions and promote adherence to CRM data governance standards and best practices.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports on data quality metrics, request turnaround times, compliance levels, and governance KPIs.
* Support the CRM Governance Lead in implementing data quality initiatives and governance frameworks.
* Identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness and user experience.
* Participate in CRM enhancement projects and contribute to the evolution of data governance capabilities within the firm.

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in CRM Operations, Data Management, Data Governance, or CRM Administration.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (preferred) or similar CRM platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM data management, data quality, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI.
* Experience in data cleansing, de-duplication, reporting, and maintaining data integrity across large datasets.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to data accuracy and governance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined SLAs.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

title: Principal Data Consultant
description:

Data Platform / Trading Technology

We are seeking a
**Principal Data Engineer**
to design and build a next-generation proprietary data platform from the ground up at a global leading trading firm. You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery.
* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
**Hiring: SAP Data Migration Consultant – S/4HANA Finance & Alteryx**

**Industry:**
IT Services & Consulting

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Budget:**
Up to ₹25 LPA

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Locations:**
Multiple locations across India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Data Migration Consultant specializing in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Alteryx**
to support end-to-end financial data migration initiatives for enterprise SAP transformation projects.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in SAP data migration, financial data profiling and cleansing, source-to-target mapping, transformation, SAP S/4HANA migration tools, and financial reconciliation. Strong expertise in Alteryx Designer is essential for building scalable, reusable workflows that ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and auditability throughout the migration lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work closely with SAP Finance functional consultants, business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, and project management teams to plan and execute migration activities from initial assessment through mock migrations, cutover, reconciliation, and post-migration validation.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**1. SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration**

* Lead and execute end-to-end data migration activities for SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations and transformation projects.
* Define migration scope, data objects, migration strategy, timelines, dependencies, and execution plans.
* Coordinate data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation activities.
* Participate in migration workshops with Finance, SAP functional, business, and technical teams.
* Execute mock migration cycles, identify defects, resolve data issues, and support cutover and go-live activities.
* Ensure migrated financial data meets business requirements, data quality standards, and audit expectations.

**2. Finance Data Objects and Mapping**

* Perform source-to-target field-level mapping for SAP S/4HANA Finance data objects.
* Work with financial master data and transactional data, including:
* General Ledger (GL) and Chart of Accounts (CoA)
* Profit Centers and Cost Centers
* Business Partners (BP) and Customer/Vendor Integration (CVI)
* Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP)
* Fixed Assets and Asset Accounting
* Tax-related master data
* Bank master data and related financial information
* Analyze source-system structures, target-system requirements, mapping rules, transformation logic, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with SAP Finance functional teams to resolve mapping gaps, data inconsistencies, and business-rule exceptions.
* Understand relevant SAP data structures and tables, including ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, SKA1, SKB1, LFA1, LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.

**3. Alteryx Data Profiling, Cleansing and Transformation**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize Alteryx Designer workflows for large-scale data migration activities.
* Perform data profiling, parsing, cleansing, standardization, validation, deduplication, fuzzy matching, joins, pivots, and transformation.
* Build reusable and parameterized workflows, macros, and mapping tables to support repeatable migration cycles.
* Implement data quality rules, exception handling, reference-data management, and validation checks.
* Identify missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, invalid master data, and other migration risks.
* Optimize workflow performance and implement appropriate logging, traceability, and data lineage practices.
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to improve data quality before loading data into SAP S/4HANA.

**4. SAP Migration Cockpit and Data Loading**

* Execute data loads using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, including staging-table or direct-transfer approaches where applicable.
* Understand migration object templates, source structures, mapping requirements, dependencies, and load sequencing.
* Prepare and validate migration files or staging data before loading.
* Monitor migration execution, analyze error logs, troubleshoot failed records, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Reprocess corrected records and validate successful loading into the target SAP environment.
* Support mock loads, dress rehearsals, production cutover, and post-go-live data validation.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to resolve loading errors and migration object issues.

**5. Financial Reconciliation and Data Validation**

* Perform pre-migration and post-migration reconciliation to confirm the accuracy and completeness of migrated financial data.
* Reconcile trial balances, General Ledger balances, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, fixed assets, and bank-related data.
* Validate record counts, financial balances, debit/credit totals, opening balances, and key control totals.
* Investigate reconciliation differences and coordinate corrective actions with Finance and SAP teams.
* Prepare reconciliation reports, migration sign-off documentation, issue logs, and audit-ready evidence.
* Ensure migration results meet agreed acceptance criteria and financial control requirements.

**6. Migration Planning, Cutover and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Develop migration plans, mock-cycle schedules, cutover checklists, issue trackers, and reconciliation templates.
* Coordinate migration dependencies across Finance, SAP functional, technical, data, and business teams.
* Track migration progress, data quality metrics, defects, risks, and outstanding dependencies.
* Support go/no-go assessments, cutover rehearsals, production migration, and stabilization activities.
* Maintain clear documentation of mapping rules, transformation logic, data quality findings, load results, and reconciliation outcomes.
* Communicate migration status, risks, and remediation plans to project stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills :**

**SAP S/4HANA Finance**

* Hands-on experience in SAP data migration, preferably for SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* Strong understanding of Finance master data and transactional data migration.
* Knowledge of GL, CoA, Profit Centers, Cost Centers, Business Partners/CVI, AR/AP, Asset Accounting, Tax, and Bank Master data.
* Familiarity with SAP tables such as ACDOCA, BKPF/BSEG, SKA1/SKB1, LFA1/LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.
* Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, migration objects, load sequencing, error resolution, and reconciliation.

**Alteryx Designer**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in Alteryx Designer for data preparation and migration.
* Experience building reusable workflows and macros.
* Proficiency in data profiling, cleansing, joins, parsing, deduplication, fuzzy matching, regular expressions, and pivoting.
* Understanding of data quality rules, mapping tables, reference data, logging, lineage, and workflow optimization.

**Data and Reconciliation**

* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills for mapping, reconciliation, data validation, and reporting.
* Ability to investigate data discrepancies, resolve migration defects, and maintain accurate documentation.

**Experience and Qualifications :**

* 5–8 years of relevant SAP data migration experience.
* Experience delivering 1–2 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Finance migration projects.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in migration planning, data mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and cutover.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Good to Have :**

* Experience with SAP BODS, SAP MDG, or SAP CPI.
* Exposure to Alteryx Server and enterprise workflow management.
* Basic knowledge of SAP Ariba supplier and purchase-order data.
* Experience with SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migration or multi-system consolidation.
* Familiarity with data governance, financial controls, and audit documentation.

**Work Locations:**

Hybrid opportunities are available across the following Indian locations, subject to project requirements and team allocation:

* **Maharashtra:**
  Navi Mumbai (Mahape), Mumbai (One BKC, Andheri East), Pune (Hinjawadi, Baner), Nagpur (MIHAN SEZ)
* **Tamil Nadu:**
  Chennai (SIPCOT IT Park, Pallavaram, Ascendas IT Park), Coimbatore (Vetrivel Tower, India Land Tech Park)
* **Karnataka:**
  Bengaluru (Prestige Shanthiniketan, North Square, BCIT SEZ), Mangalore
* **Uttar Pradesh:**
  Noida (Sector 135)
* **Telangana:**
  Hyderabad (Prestige Sky Tech)
* **Gujarat:**
  Ahmedabad (Privilon), Gandhinagar (GIFT City)
* **Madhya Pradesh:**
  Bhopal (Maple High Street)
* **Uttarakhand:**
  Dehradun (Doon IT Park)

Interested?

If interested, please apply through the job posting below or email your resume to hr@stafingo.com for immediate consideration.

We look forward to connecting with experienced SAP Data Migration professionals who can deliver reliable, accurate, and audit-ready S/4HANA Finance migration outcomes.

Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Support, maintain, and improve third-party Enterprise Applications infrastructure through platform operations, administration, automation, monitoring, and cross-team delivery.
* Own assigned operational activities with increasing independence while following approved standards and partnering with senior engineers on complex issues, platform improvements, and project delivery.
* Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve repeatability, reliability, and support efficiency.
* Work closely with senior team members, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors to deliver stable services and build technical capability across E-Apps operations.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Platform operations: Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.
* Administration and maintenance: Perform platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, service management, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.

* Automation: Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.
* Observability and performance: Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.
* Incident and ITSM support: Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.
* Project delivery: Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.
* Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Collaboration: Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.
* Support Requirement: Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.
* GCP and infrastructure: Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.
* Middleware and platform administration: Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.
* Operating systems and databases: Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Monitoring and operations: Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.
* ITSM and collaboration: Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Core proficiency: Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.
* Project methodology: Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.
* Continuous improvement: Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.
* Professional behaviors: Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:

We are seeking a highly experienced SQL Server Database Architect to lead the architecture, governance, modernization, and operational excellence of enterprise SQL Server platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, database security, and operational resilience.

* Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architecture for SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and decision frameworks for SQL Server platforms.
* Establish standards for clustering, Always On Availability Groups, backup, recovery, monitoring, encryption, and privileged access management.
* Develop lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernization, consolidation, and database migration roadmaps.
* Act as the technical design authority for enterprise database solutions.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, resilience, data governance, and service management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform modernization initiatives.
* Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions aligned to business requirements.
* Lead recovery planning, failover testing, restore validation, and resilience assessments.
* Define standards for indexing strategies, query optimization, workload management, and database performance tuning.
* Establish performance baselines, capacity models, and forecasting processes.
* Lead technical response during critical incidents and major platform outages.
* Drive root-cause analysis and implement long-term engineering improvements.
* Define database security architectures and governance standards.
* Implement controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, patching, hardening, secrets management, and service accounts.
* Partner with cybersecurity, audit, risk, and compliance teams to address control requirements and audit findings.
* Ensure database platforms comply with relevant regulatory and operational resilience requirements.
* Support data protection, retention, governance, and compliance initiatives across the organization.

* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools.

* 12 to 17 years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Architecture roles.

* Proven expertise in designing and implementing Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).

title: Default Job Template
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer II is a senior technical person who partners with government
  
  
customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product
  
  
configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database
  
  
expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the

most complex government implementations across the United States
  
  

* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data,

resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
  
  

* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and

migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder

like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the
  
  
deployment and integration process
  
  

* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to

simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
  
  

* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their

configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
  
  

* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable

tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
  
  

* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and

channel field feedback into the product roadmap
  
  
**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical

consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data

transformation, and reconciliation
  
  

* 2+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts

and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
  
  

* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or

provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
  
  

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on

data and configuration for accuracy
  
  

* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving

customer needs
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Sr Pharmacovigilance Data Migration Consultant – Oracle Argus Safety
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
* Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
* Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
* Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
* Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
* Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
* Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.

* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.

**GCP Architect**

* Experience in GCP Dataflow, BigQuery, Dataproc, Datalab, Dataprep, Pub/Sub and Genomics
* Experience with core Data Science techniques such as regression, classification or clustering, and experience with deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Torch, Caffe, Theano, etc).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem

* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements and environments (such as Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements.

title: Production Support Systems Intern
description:
**About Vcheck**
Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.
  
  
We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Production Support Systems Intern supports the team that keeps our production systems stable and available. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will learn how incidents, monitoring alerts, and escalations are handled in a live environment—starting by observing and following runbooks, and gradually taking on more of the triage yourself. You will get hands-on exposure to our AWS-hosted Python/Django/FastAPI backend and React JS frontend, and learn to track incidents via JIRA Service Management while monitoring system health through Sentry and CloudWatch. This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend and structured mentorship, and it offers a clear path to a full-time Production Support Systems Engineer role.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Monitor Sentry and CloudWatch dashboards for errors and anomalies under the guidance of a senior engineer
* Perform first-level triage of alerts and follow documented runbooks for known issues
* Create and update JIRA Service Management tickets with clear, complete incident details
* Escalate issues to the on-call engineer or Tier 3 with accurate, well-structured summaries
* Prepare shift handoff reports and join the overlap with the wider team
* Read CloudWatch Logs to identify ECS task errors, AWS Batch job failures, and Lambda/API issues
* Assist with restarting failed ECS tasks and retrying Batch jobs, as directed by the senior engineer
* Run start-of-shift and end-of-shift environment health checks and confirm nightly batch jobs have completed
* Learn to tell frontend (React JS) issues from backend API failures using Sentry error traces
* Run basic PostgreSQL/RDS checks and flag slow queries or connection issues to the team
* Verify that nightly backup and data replication jobs completed, and report any failure promptly
* Observe and support scheduled maintenance and deployments, including post-deployment monitoring
* Write simple Python scripts to automate repetitive checks and parse logs
* Document incident summaries, resolution steps, and learnings; help update runbooks and SOPs in the knowledge base

**About You**
****Key requirements:****
We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
  
  

* We're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and driven to grow through ownership, attention to detail, and upstanding character. No prior production support experience is needed. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Foundational understanding of cloud concepts; exposure to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch, RDS) through coursework, projects, or certifications is a plus
* Basic proficiency in Python for scripting and log parsing
* Basic understanding of SQL/PostgreSQL and how web applications and REST APIs work
* Familiarity with Linux command line and Git fundamentals
* Awareness of Docker and containers is a plus; exposure to Django, FastAPI, or React JS is a plus
* Curiosity about monitoring and incident management tools such as Sentry, JIRA, or similar; prior use is a plus
* Calm, methodical, and attentive to detail when things go wrong
* Strong written communication skills for incident notes and shift handoffs
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and ask for help or escalate when unsure
* Prior internship, academic project, or hands-on lab experience in IT support, DevOps, or NOC environments is a plus
* AWS Cloud Practitioner or ITIL Foundation certification (or willingness to pursue one) is a plus

****Why us?****
You Will Be Joining a Cutting-edge Company, Where You Will Tackle Complex Challenges And Work With The Very Best In The Industry. In Addition, We Offer
  
  

* Competitive compensation package, including equity
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage for you & your loved ones
* 401k plan with a 4% employer match
* Flexible vacation policy, encouraging you to take the time you need
* Annual wellness allowance to support your health and well-being
* Quarterly team events to keep us connected in a hybrid environment
* Playing a vital role in shaping our company's future
* A fun and collaborative work environment where you'll be supported by a team of dedicated and collaborative colleagues

Please be aware that Vcheck uses AI-powered note-taking, interview recording, and transcription tools to ensure accuracy and efficiency during our talent acquisition processes. By participating in the application and interview stages, you acknowledge and consent to the use of these technologies.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining the migration strategy, managing end-to-end migration activities, ensuring data quality, and delivering successful migration from legacy HR and payroll systems into SAP SuccessFactors and SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
The role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and extensive experience in SAP data migration methodologies, reconciliation, testing, and cutover planning.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end SAP Data Migration workstream.
* Facilitate workshops on Data migration requirements and align with client data requirements.
* Define and implement the Data Migration Strategy, Data Quality Strategy, and Migration Approach.
* Analyse legacy HR and Payroll data and map it to SAP SuccessFactors target objects.
* Define migration objects, transformation rules, validation criteria, and reconciliation processes.
* Manage data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Coordinate business users for data collection, validation, and sign-off. Coordinate with integration teams to validate migrated data across downstream and upstream systems.
* Plan and execute mock migrations, dress rehearsals, production migration, and cutover.
* Maintain migration governance, data load ownership, approval processes, audit trails and sign-off processes.
* Support SIT, UAT, Payroll Parallel Runs, cutover planning, Go-Live, and Hypercare.
* Support and align with SAP SuccessFactors releases and update with needed migration tools and deliver data migration.
* Produce migration documentation, runbooks, post load reconciliation reports, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Work closely with Functional Consultants, Integration Teams, Technical Teams, and Business SMEs.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of SAP Data Migration experience.

Strong experience with:
**Preferred Experience:**

* SAP SuccessFactors Data loads
* SAP Migration Cockpit
* SAP Data Services (BODS)
* SAP LSMW
* SQL
* ETL tools
* Experience migrating HR, Payroll, Organisation Management, Foundation Objects, Employee Master Data, and historical data.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Cutover Planning.
* Experience in Data validation and reconciliation techniques, Audit and Compliance controls. Familiar with GDPR and Data privacy regulations
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Previous experience delivering SAP SuccessFactors migration or implementation programmes is highly preferred.
  
  
Experience with SAP Employee Central, Employee Central Payroll, and SAP S/4HANA migration projects.
  
  
Experience working in Agile and SAP Activate delivery environments.

SAP Data Services Certification
  
  
SAP Activate Certification

title: Senior SQL Developer
description:
**Position: Senior SQL Server Developer / Consultant**

**Focus:**
Hands-on T-SQL Development + Live Production Performance Troubleshooting

**Experience:**
8+ Years

**Location:**
Hinjewadi, Pune

**Work Hours:**
2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred / As soon as available

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly reliable Senior SQL Server Developer to serve as the
**Primary Production SQL Owner**
for our healthcare SaaS platform running on AWS RDS for SQL Server.

This is a hands-on role requiring:

1. Designing, writing, and optimizing complex T-SQL stored procedures for critical business workflows.
2. Diagnosing live production performance issues in real time, including blocking, high CPU, memory pressure, and slow queries in a busy OLTP system while US customers are online.

**Key Responsibilities – SQL Development**

* Design, write, debug, and maintain complex T-SQL stored procedures for critical business workflows.
* Deliver new database logic and enhancements in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Refactor and optimize stored procedures through query rewrites, execution plan analysis, indexing, statistics, and parameter sniffing fixes.
* Perform controlled, well-documented production data fixes and investigate data discrepancies.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 8+ years of hands-on Microsoft SQL Server development experience with high-volume OLTP/transactional databases (not data warehouse/BI).
* Expert-level T-SQL skills, including complex stored procedures, functions, transactions, error handling, and writing new logic—not just reviewing code.
* Proven real-time production troubleshooting skills: blocking chains, wait statistics (sys.dm\_os\_wait\_stats), deadlocks, and lock contention.
* Experience diagnosing high CPU, high memory utilization, and slow query incidents using DMVs, Query Store, and execution plans.
* Strong indexing strategy skills, including diagnosing and mitigating parameter sniffing.
* Proven experience performing safe, audited production data fixes in live transactional environments.
* Strong production support and incident response experience.
* Experience working US shifts or in a global support environment.
* Strong hands-on T-SQL development is mandatory, along with the ability to diagnose live production incidents in real time.
