title: Data Engineer + Instructor
description:
**About Newton School of Technology:**
NST is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a four-year B.Tech programme in Computer Science and AI, emphasising hands-on learning, industry integration, and real-world problem-solving.

With industry-focused projects, practical learning opportunities, and exposure to emerging technologies, NST aims to prepare students for advanced technology careers. Its faculty brings together academic expertise and industry experience to create an engaging, outcome-driven learning environment.

**About the Role:**
We are looking for an experienced
**Data Engineer & Data Visualisation Instructor**
to join our academic team in Pune.

This role combines technical expertise with teaching, mentoring, and curriculum development. The ideal candidate will have strong practical knowledge of databases, SQL, data engineering, and data visualisation, along with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into engaging, hands-on learning experiences.

You will design and deliver industry-relevant courses, mentor students through practical assignments and capstone projects, and help develop the next generation of data professionals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Curriculum Development**

* Design and develop course content, lesson plans, lab exercises, and assessments covering DBMS, data engineering, and data visualisation.
* Develop practical assignments and projects aligned with industry practices and current technologies.
* Continuously update curriculum content to reflect emerging trends in databases, business intelligence, analytics, and cloud technologies.

**2. Teaching and Training**

* Deliver lectures, workshops, and hands-on sessions on database management systems, SQL, data modelling, and database design.
* Teach relational database concepts, normalisation, indexing, query optimisation, transactions, and database security.
* Train students in Python, data processing, ETL/ELT concepts, and introductory data pipeline development.
* Teach data visualisation and reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or equivalent tools.
* Introduce students to data warehousing, cloud databases, and relevant industry use cases.

**3. Practical Projects and Industry Application**

* Design real-world projects involving data collection, transformation, analysis, and visualisation.
* Develop capstone projects that integrate data engineering, business intelligence, and, where relevant, AI/ML applications.
* Incorporate industry scenarios and datasets to help students develop practical problem-solving skills.
* Guide students in building portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their technical capabilities.

**4. Student Assessment and Mentorship**

* Develop quizzes, assignments, coding exercises, and project-based assessments.
* Evaluate student performance and provide actionable feedback.
* Mentor students in debugging, troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and technical problem-solving.
* Support students in building career-ready skills and preparing for data engineering, database, and analytics roles.

**5. Industry Collaboration**

* Stay updated on industry tools, technologies, and best practices.
* Conduct technical workshops, guest sessions, hackathons, and project demonstrations.
* Collaborate with other faculty members to integrate data concepts into multidisciplinary projects.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of teaching methodologies and learning outcomes.

**Qualifications and Experience :**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field or Phd in computer science
* **Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience**
  in data engineering, database development, BI/data analytics, or related technical roles.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly and mentor others.
* Prior teaching, training, mentoring, or technical enablement experience is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one major relational database, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Good understanding of database design, data modelling, normalisation, indexing, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
* Working knowledge of Python for data processing and automation.
* Practical experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT workflows, data pipelines, and data warehousing concepts.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB is an advantage.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms and services, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A hands-on technology professional who enjoys teaching and mentoring.
* Someone who can bridge the gap between theoretical concepts and real-world industry applications.
* A candidate who can build engaging learning experiences and guide students through practical projects.
* A collaborative individual who is passionate about developing future-ready technology talent.

title: Python Backend Engineer
description:
We are hiring multiple experienced Python Backend Engineer with 4-10 years of software development experience to design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems and enterprise applications for one of our clients in Pune.
  
  
The role focuses on developing robust APIs and services, integrating enterprise systems, and working closely with engineering and business teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software. It suits a hands-on engineer with strong Python fundamentals and practical experience building production-grade backend services.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python.
* Build and integrate RESTful APIs and work with JSON-based data structures.
* Develop services using frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data access layers (SQL and NoSQL).
* Integrate with enterprise systems, third-party services, and message queues.
* Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.
* Develop, debug, test, and optimize backend components and integrations.
* Write unit and integration tests and maintain high code coverage.
* Troubleshoot application issues across services, databases, and infrastructure.
* Work closely with architects, frontend developers, QA, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
* Follow coding standards and engineering best practices, and participate in code reviews.
* Work within Agile methodologies, contributing to sprint planning, development, testing, and retrospectives.
* Continuously learn and apply new technologies to solve business problems.
* Take ownership of assigned work and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

**Required Skills**

* 4-10 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python (mandatory).
* Experience with at least one Python web framework (Django, Flask, or FastAPI).
* Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with JSON.
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and SQL.
* Understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, and enterprise software principles.
* Experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Strong focus on code quality, reliability, and maintainability.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience with asynchronous programming and task queues (Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and API design.
* Exposure to Java or JavaScript/React is a plus.
* Experience with testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise application environments.
* Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams is an added advantage.

Education
  
  
B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Role: Python Backend Engineer

* Employment Type: Full Time
* Location: Pune
* Industry: Enterprise Technology

* Candidates with approximately 8 years of experience can be considered in the range of ₹35-40 Lakhs for exceptionally strong profiles.
* For exceptional candidates, compensation can be decided based on technical expertise, relevant experience, interview performance, and overall fit.

**Data Engineer**
to join our Mobile Advertising Platform engineering team. In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering
**Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real-time analytics**
. You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing
**billions of mobile advertising events**
every day, including
**ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in-app events, and auction logs**
. You'll leverage modern Big Data technologies, cloud platforms, and Generative AI to build intelligent analytics and automation solutions.
  
  
You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next-generation Mobile AdTech products.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of mobile advertising events with low latency and high availability.
* Design and build ultra-low-latency, high-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — ad request → impression → click → install → in-app conversion event — including OpenRTB bid request/response logging, auction analytics, and win-rate/bid-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hadoop, and Snowflake on AWS.
* Architect real-time campaign pacing and budget delivery systems, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds.
* Architect and implement real-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in-app events.
* Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics.
* Design large-scale Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules-based and ML-driven detection across billions of daily events.
* Develop backend services (Java, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. Design and develop GenAI-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks.
* Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience.
* Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices.

**We'd Love For You To Have**

* 1–5+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering.
* Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles.
* Hands-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases.
* Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS.
* Experience designing and optimizing large-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS. Strong understanding of real-time event processing, distributed data systems, and data warehouse architectures. Familiarity with distributed query engines, modern data lake technologies, and high-performance analytical databases (e.g., Trino, Presto, ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi) is an added advantage.
* Experience processing high-volume streaming data using Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams, or similar technologies.
* Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT design, and distributed computing concepts.

**Mobile AdTech Experience**

* Experience working with Mobile AdTech platforms or digital advertising ecosystems is highly preferred, including knowledge of: Direct experience with Real-Time Bidding (RTB), OpenRTB protocol, and Mobile DSP/SSP/Ad Exchange architecture.
* Familiarity with mobile SDK event tracking (impressions, clicks, installs, in-app events) and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations.
* Understanding of attribution methodologies (click-through, view-through, multi-touch based attribution).
* Knowledge of mobile identity solutions (IDFA, GAID, IDFV) and the privacy landscape driving their deprecation.
* Experience with campaign pacing, bid optimization, and budget delivery algorithms.
* Background in ad fraud/IVT detection — click spam, install fraud, SDK spoofing.

**Generative AI Experience**

* Experience building production-grade GenAI applications including: LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, etc.)
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks
* Prompt engineering and prompt optimization
* AI evaluation and observability
* AI agents and workflow automation

**Additional Preferred Skills**

* Experience building scalable, production-grade AI or data platforms.
* Strong SQL optimization and query performance tuning skills.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application development.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or AWS.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed environments.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve stretch goals in a fast-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

**Qualification**
Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

**About Cencora**

**Job Details**

SAP Basis Administrator

POSITION SUMMARY:

SAP Systems Administrators are responsible for maintaining the ongoing reliability, performance, management and support of the SAP systems environment. SAP environments may include but are not limited to: Administration, Sales, Distribution, etc. Responsibilities include managing applications and systems, responding to problems and planning for growth. SAP Systems Administrators understand the technical infrastructure standards and requirements for the integration of specific SAP modules. This may include migration tasks such as change request review, software build coordination, release documentation, production issue resolution and tracking report distribution. They also understand the business implications of application and system problems allowing them to appropriately set severity levels when problems do occur. SAP Systems Administrators monitor the performance of system applications. Individuals execute contingency plans in case of system outages, troubleshoot a wide variety of technical problems and provide Level II support to the Help Desk. In addition, these roles participate in projects to implement SAP services such as initial installation, as well as subsequent installations of updates and patches.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Follows manager in projects and is responsible for deliverables.
* Works on multiple, high to highly complex projects.
* Maintains SAP systems and applications, supporting and training users for SAP system(s) and applications usage.
* Supports integration of changes in test, pre-production and production environments.

* Works on the installation of upgrades and patches for the enterprise SAP system.

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

* Requires skills in multiple technical environments and knowledge of a specific business area.

* Extensive knowledge of troubleshooting complex SAP performance problems.

.

We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.

title: Integration Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
Freight Tiger is looking for an Integration Lead to own end-to-end customer integration delivery between the Freight Tiger platform and customer ERP, SAP and Third party systems. The role combines technical integration expertise, solution design, customer engagement and delivery ownership. The person will work with customer IT/SAP teams, Integration Solution Engineers, Product, Engineering and DevOps to take integrations from requirements to production. This can be a strong IC or a team-lead role, depending on experience. The person should be comfortable designing solutions, guiding engineers, managing delivery and resolving production issues.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
***Customer & Solution Ownership***

* Own customer integration requirements and act as the primary technical integration contact.
* Lead requirement and solution-design discussions with customer IT/SAP teams.
* Understand business flows and translate them into practical integration solutions.
* Define integration architecture, interfaces, data mappings and dependencies.
* Identify risks, effort and technical constraints early.

***Integration Delivery***

* Drive integrations end-to-end: Design → Development → SIT/UAT → Go-Live → Hypercare.
* Guide Integration Solution Engineers and review their technical implementation.
* Work hands-on with Dell Boomi or other similar integration platform, APIs and data transformations when required.
* Ensure appropriate security, error handling, retry and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Product, DevOps and external implementation partners.

***Delivery & Production***

* Own delivery plans, milestones, dependencies and customer commitments.
* Proactively identify and resolve delivery blockers and risks.
* Support customer go-lives and production troubleshooting.
* Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of integration issues.
* Maintain key integration documentation and reusable implementation patterns.

***Team Contribution***

* Mentor and provide technical direction to Integration Solution Engineers.
* Contribute to integration standards, reusable patterns and improved delivery practices.
* People management experience is an added advantage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, API integration or technical delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with Dell Boomi AtomSphere or a similar integration platform.
* Good experience with REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, JSON/XML and data transformation.
* Practical experience with SAP ECC/S4HANA integrations, preferably IDoc, RFC/JCo or OData.
* Understanding of authentication, certificates, networking and cloud connectivity.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across application, middleware and integration layers.
* Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management.
* Proven ability to manage multiple integration deliveries independently.
* Experience guiding or mentoring engineers is preferred.

***Architectural Knowledge***

* Enterprise integration and API patterns
* Synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven integration
* Data mapping, transformation and validation
* Error handling, retry, idempotency and reconciliation
* Integration security and connectivity
* Basic distributed systems and microservices concepts
* Integration monitoring and production reliability

title: Manager Data Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Data Engineering**
Publicis Sapient is seeking a Manager – Data Engineering to join our high-performing engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable, cloud native data engineering solutions, partnering with clients and cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges. You will provide technical leadership, drive architecture decisions, mentor engineering teams, and ensure the successful implementation of modern data platforms that power analytics, AI, and digital transformation initiatives. As a Manager, you will combine deep technical expertise in big data and cloud technologies with strong consulting, stakeholder management, and people leadership capabilities to enable clients to unlock value from enterprise-scale data ecosystems.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Lead the design, architecture, and delivery of large-scale data engineering solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Drive end-to-end data platform implementations encompassing data ingestion, transformation, storage, processing, governance, and consumption.
* Architect batch and real-time data pipelines leveraging modern big data frameworks and cloud-native services.
* Provide technical leadership and hands-on guidance to engineering teams, ensuring solution quality, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and solution governance activities.
* Establish best practices in data engineering, including coding standards, performance optimization, security, and reliability.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, product teams, and clients to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Mentor and develop engineering talent, contributing to hiring, capability building, and technical community initiatives.
* Drive cloud transformation programs utilizing AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms.
* Promote innovation, thought leadership, and adoption of emerging technologies including GenAI-enabled data engineering solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* 8+ years of IT experience, with 5+ years in data engineering, big data, or related technologies.
* Proven experience leading the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data engineering solutions.
* Strong hands-on expertise in at least one cloud platform (Azure as Primary; along with AWS/GCP experience).
* Advanced programming expertise in Python (Scala as secondary).
* Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, Storm, or Hadoop ecosystem technologies.
* Expertise in data ingestion and streaming frameworks including Kafka, NiFi, Pulsar, Pub/Sub, or similar platforms.
* Experience building batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based data architecture patterns and modern data platform design.
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Oozie, Control-M, or equivalent scheduling frameworks.
* Working knowledge of NoSQL and MPP platforms including MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase, BigQuery, Redshift, Athena, Presto, or Impala.
* Strong understanding of data security, IAM, encryption, privacy, governance, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with monitoring, observability, and operational management of large scale data platforms.
* Hands-on experience with performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines and distributed computing workloads.

**Leadership & Consulting Responsibilities**

* Lead engineering teams in delivering high-quality, scalable solutions across multiple engagements.
* Partner with clients to define technology strategies and recommend optimal data platform solutions.
* Facilitate technical workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder alignment sessions.
* Drive agile delivery practices and ensure successful program execution.
* Provide mentorship and career development support for engineers and technical leads.
* Contribute to organizational capability-building initiatives and recruitment efforts.
* Champion innovation, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices across programs.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Experience with data governance platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Data Catalog, Lineage, and Metadata Management solutions.
* Knowledge of relational, NoSQL, columnar, and MPP database technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated cloud deployment practices.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and modern data warehouse architectures.
* Experience implementing cloud-native lakehouse architectures and modern data mesh concepts.
* Thought leadership contributions including blogs, whitepapers, technical talks, hackathons, or conference presentations.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, or big data certifications.
* Exposure to Generative AI, AI/ML data platforms, and modern analytics ecosystems.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence technical and business decision-making.
* Self-driven with strong ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working in global, distributed, and cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Data Operations Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience understanding complex data structures, schemas, and migration requirements, combined with proficiency in extract, transform, and load processes across enterprise environments.
* 3-7 years’ experience required for this role. Proficiency in SQL for data querying, manipulation, and validation, with experience mapping data fields between source and target systems to meet business rules and technical requirements.
* Knowledge of data validation techniques, data quality assurance best practices, and data governance principles, including documentation of business rules, standard operating procedures, and data lineage.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, and hands-on experience with reporting and automation tools including Power Automate, Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks; experience with master data management tools such as Collibra or DBeaver preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong problem-solving ability; capable of collaborating across business users, data stewards, and technical teams while clearly explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's / postgraduation degree in finance or Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field required

**Responsibilities**

* Supports enterprise-wide data migration initiatives by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data as it transitions across systems.
* Analyzes data structures and identifies migration requirements, collecting, cleaning, and validating datasets from multiple source systems
* Documents business rules for data quality checks and applies validation and quality assurance techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency throughout the migration lifecycle
* Maps data fields from source to target systems and transforms data to align with new system requirements and business rules
* Executes data migration processes including extraction, transformation, and loading, monitoring migration progress and troubleshooting issues in real time
* Identifies and resolves data discrepancies, errors, and anomalies, collaborating with technical teams to implement corrective actions
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and visualizations to highlight key trends and document data quality issues for stakeholder review
* Works closely with business users, data stewards, and technical teams to gather requirements, communicate progress, and facilitate cross-functional alignment to ensure a smooth migration transition
* Creates and maintains comprehensive documentation including migration plans, data mappings, validation rules, standard operating procedures, and post-migration reports to support governance and audit readiness

**About The Team**
Our Ratings Operations and Controls (ROC) team is responsible for supporting the data management, quality, and operational processes that underpin Moody's global ratings and research activities. We contribute to Moody's by ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and consistency across critical systems, enabling seamless data transitions that support business continuity and analytical integrity, and driving operational efficiency through technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in enterprise data migration, digital transformation, and process innovation across our Gurgaon operations.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
  
  
For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page
  
  
Please note: STP categories are assigned by the hiring teams and are subject to change over the course of an employee’s tenure with Moody’s.

title: Reliability Engineer II
description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.
  
  
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
  
  
Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
  
  
At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best
  
  
At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Supporting and maintaining Tower’s next-generation Post Trade systems, including monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on the status, performance, and overall health of production environments
* Collaborating with trade support teams, developers, and end users across multiple regions to understand business requirements, provide technical expertise, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure timely resolution
* Diagnosing and troubleshooting bugs and technical issues across existing production platforms, while documenting production incidents, interventions, and corrective actions taken
* Leading and contributing to system migrations and the automation of support activities to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability
* Designing and implementing enhancements to support systems that improve reliability and enable self-correction, while supporting the integration of new execution venues, trading products, and data vendors
* Defining and implementing certification criteria for system enhancements and new products before production release, ensuring their integration into testing and deployment processes

**Qualifications**

* At least 2–6 years of experience working in a fast-paced, global team environment, including diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues
* Experience supporting enterprise applications using Java, Python, Linux shell scripting, and job schedulers, with strong proficiency in Java and Python required
* Experience working with SQL databases, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB and Elasticsearch
* A background in electronic trading, with a thorough understanding of financial instruments, including equities, commodities, credit, interest rates, foreign exchange, cryptocurrencies, futures, forwards, and options, is a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams

**Benefits**
Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
  
  
At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
  
  
Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
Athenian Tech is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to take hands-on ownership of core areas of our AI-driven threat intelligence platform. This live, production platform ingests threat data from a wide range of external sources, enriches and scores it, and delivers curated intelligence feeds to enterprise customers over industry standard protocols. You will work closely with senior technology leadership to own production stability and data quality while helping shape architecture and process as the platform scales.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own deep hands-on platform architecture, data pipeline, enrichment, scoring and delivery.
* Ensure production reliability across production, UAT and local environments, owning monitoring, alerting, healthchecks, and acting as the escalation point for incidents.
* Maintain daily data quality of the intelligence feed including data provenance, scoring integrity, and false positive control.
* Enforce strict change management discipline including testing, rollback plans, and verification of every change.
* Evaluate and onboard new data sources into the platform (feed lifecycle management).
* Handle technical aspects of customer onboarding including access scoping, feed configuration, and integration support with enterprise SIEM and SOAR platforms.
* Keep runbooks and documentation current, and assist in interviewing and building the engineering team.
* Drive the engineering backlog, delivery cadence, and production readiness work.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline with strong fundamentals in operating systems, networking, and data structures.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in backend, platform, or security engineering with hands-on responsibility for a production system.
* Strong proficiency in Python as the primary language for platform and automation work.
* Strong Linux command-line skills including managing services, cron, logs, and troubleshooting production servers.
* Hands-on database experience at production scale, ideally Elasticsearch, along with SQL basics; Redis or RabbitMQ exposure is a plus.
* Strong AWS experience with EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, and running self-hosted workloads with Docker.
* Strong reasoning and debugging ability, with clear written communication skills for runbooks and customer documentation.

title: OneStream IT Specialist
description:

391195
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a OneStream IT Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description**
: OneStream IT Specialist with Financial Services Domain Knowledge
  
  
**Role Overview**
This position combines IT expertise in the OneStream platform with deep knowledge of financial services processes to deliver, enhance, and operate enterprise finance solutions. The candidate will act as a bridge between finance, IT, and business stakeholders, ensuring that financial consolidation, planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics processes are optimized
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the design and architecture of OneStream solutions from Finance IT side, ensuring best practices are followed by vendor team.
  
  
Translate business needs into functional requirements technical design documentation, including requirements and RTM., user stories, process maps, solution designs, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Define solution structure, including system integrations, data flows, and financial reporting.
  
  
Provide design input for customized workflows, calculations, and financial models.
  
  
Support OneStream capabilities for financial close, consolidation, planning, forecasting, management reporting, and analytics
  
  
Oversee OneStream implementation, including configuration, testing, and deployment.
  
  
Lead data migration and integration with ERP and financial systems.
  
  
Serve as the primary Finance IT contact, providing expert guidance and support throughout the implementation.
  
  
Provide training to user community on OneStream functionality and best practices.
  
  
Mentor cross-functional teams, offering architectural guidance to ensure successful application development.
  
  
Develop test plans/cases, coordinate UAT, and validate solutions meet business and control requirements

title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Support the full application and infrastructure stack to ensure the CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service remains highly available, secure, performant, and reliable.
* Design, implement, and maintain observability, monitoring, and synthetic testing to detect issues early and validate service behavior end-to-end.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide timely incident response through PagerDuty and related operational processes.
* Lead or support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.
* Define, track, and continuously improve SLOs/SLIs to align platform reliability with business expectations.
* Produce clear and actionable monthly operations reports summarizing service health, trends, incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Leverage Datadog to analyze logs, create and maintain monitoring metrics, and configure dashboards and alerts that support CloudOps activities and platform reliability.
* Analyze operational data and platform metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for automation or optimization.
* Design, build, and maintain automation and internal tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the CloudOps environment.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain application and platform layers of the service, ensuring changes are implemented safely and in accordance with standards.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders to review designs, provide feedback, and help shape scalable and resilient solutions.
* Review peer code and infrastructure changes to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance with team standards and best practices.
* Develop, test, and document automation and platform components, including runbooks and operational procedures, to support long-term maintainability and operational readiness.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms

+ Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

* Operations

+ Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
+ Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

* Public and Private Cloud

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

* Interaction & Communication

+ Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Node.js Developer
description:
We’re seeking highly skilled and motivated Node.js developers across multiple levels to join our dynamic team. As a key member, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining the backend systems of our platform, utilizing Node.js and an array of related technologies.

**Roles And Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop robust backend systems and APIs using Node.js, leveraging its asynchronous, event-driven nature to ensure optimal performance and scalability.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers, designers, and product managers, to seamlessly integrate frontend and backend components, ensuring a cohesive and immersive user experience.
* Implement scalable data storage solutions using databases such as MySQL and MongoDB, optimizing database schema and queries for efficiency and performance.
* Architect and implement event-driven architectures using message brokers like Kafka and SQS (Simple Queue Service), enabling real-time processing of events and asynchronous communication between microservices.

* Write clean, maintainable code following industry best practices and coding standards, conduct thorough testing to identify and fix bugs, and document technical specifications to facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of learning, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Proficiency in Node.js and other server-side technologies, microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and databases like MySQL and MongoDB.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud), version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working with event-driven architecture and message brokers such as Kafka and SQS, preferably in the context of gaming or real-time applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders.
* A proactive mindset with a passion for learning and staying updated with the latest advancements in backend development and technology.

**Job description**

Requisition ID: 1713055

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY GDS CONSULTING – SAP BASIS MANAGER**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

As a SAP BASIS Manager, you will be at the forefront of managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This role offers you the chance to lead the administration, maintenance, and performance tuning of our SAP systems, ensuring stability, security, and high availability.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with functional teams, IT, and business stakeholders to enhance SAP system landscapes, implement best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Your expertise will be essential in addressing complex technical issues, managing system upgrades, patches, and ensuring compliance with IT policies and regulatory requirements.

In this position, you will also play a key role in mentoring and leading a team of BASIS administrators, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing, skill development, and innovation. You will be part of a dynamic team that values technical excellence and is committed to delivering exceptional SAP services to support business objectives.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Performance monitoring and tuning, issue diagnosis, root‑cause analysis, and resolution.
* SAP administration on UNIX & Windows environments.
* System copy/refresh planning and execution.
* Administration of ABAP + Java dual‑stack systems.
* Add‑on installation, Support Pack updates, and post‑implementation troubleshooting.
* Kernel upgrades and patching.
* Client copies, export/import operations.
* TMS administration, transport configuration, and troubleshooting transport errors.
* SAP system monitoring, log analysis, workload analysis, and early‑watch checks.
* SAP parameter optimization, operation mode setup, logon group configuration.
* SAP authorization knowledge: role analysis, creation, and troubleshooting access issues.
* Spool administration and troubleshooting print/spool issues.
* OSS Note implementation and correction deployments.
* Experience with Single Sign‑On, certificates, SNC, Web Dispatcher routing & load balancing.
* Strong experience managing SAP on public and private clouds.
* Hands‑on experience working with Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud platforms.
* Experience in SAP user provisioning, role assignments, and troubleshooting authorization conflicts.
* Understanding of OS/DB migration and heterogeneous migration concepts.
* Familiarity with SAP connectivity components such as Gateway, Web Dispatcher, RFCs, Cloud Connector, etc.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Should have 9 to 10 years of experience in the SAP Basis domain with strong leadership responsibilities.
* Solid hands‑on experience in SAP system administration including installation, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of SAP architecture, transport management (CTS, CTS+), kernel upgrades, client strategies, and system refresh processes.
* Expertise in SAP HANA administration (performance tuning, monitoring, backup/recovery, memory optimization, and troubleshooting).
* Experience managing SAP landscapes such as S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway.
* Strong knowledge of SAP BTP, integration services, and administration fundamentals.
* Experience managing RISE with SAP environments and cloud operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills ensuring structured, compliant, and audit‑ready system documentation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills with experience working with senior leadership.
* In‑depth expertise in Solution Manager functionalities including CHARM, EWA, Monitoring, System Recommendations, and Change Control Management.
* Experience using Signavio for business process modeling and process governance.
* Experience with LeanIX for enterprise architecture management, application portfolio mapping, and landscape documentation.
* Manage SAP High Availability (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
* Optimize HANA database performance, backup, and restore strategies.
* Knowledge of Linux, Windows, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Familiarity with SAP security, patching, and encryption methodologies.
* Performance Optimization & System Security:
  + Analyse and improve SAP system performance, load balancing, and scalability.
  + Optimize memory management, SAP buffers, work processes, and background jobs.
  + Conduct security audits, role-based access control (RBAC), and risk assessments.
  + Ensure SAP systems comply with GDPR, SOX, ISO, and industry regulations.

* Cloud & Infrastructure Management:
  + Support SAP Cloud deployments (SAP BTP, Azure, AWS, GCP, or private cloud).
  + Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for SAP automation using Ansible/Terraform.
  Manage hybrid cloud integrations and connectivity between on-prem & cloud SAP environments
* Soft Skills:
  + Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  + Ability to work under pressure in a high-availability production environment.
  + Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  + Leadership experience in guiding SAP Basis teams and collaborating with cross-functional teams

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VM management, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, operations, and change control.
* Experience in SAP Data Archiving (OpenText, ILM).

  

**Certifications:**

* SAP Technology Associate (SAP Basis, HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud).
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**Benefits**: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.

* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
