title: Senior Security Engineer - Customer Engineering
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to sit at the intersection of our
**Security Research Engineering**
team and our
**customers worldwide**
. This is a deeply technical, hands-on, detection-focused role for someone who understands how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually work — and can prove, in real customer traffic, whether a detection is firing correctly.
  
  
This is a
**high-impact role.**
The value customers realize from the entire platform depends on the outcomes this team produces: whether our detections fire correctly, whether the threats that matter get surfaced, and whether customers trust what we tell them. You'll be the technical authority who validates the detections our researchers build (ModSecurity/WAF rules, API security signatures, AI security detections, OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 / LLM Top 10 coverage), separates true positives from noise, hunts across global customer environments for business logic abuse and fraud, and closes the loop back to Research and Product to sharpen detection efficacy.
  
  
You'll bring a deep understanding of the security landscape — the threat models, attacker techniques, and rapidly evolving AI security frontier — and you'll express that understanding through code: scripting, automating threat hunts, and using AI itself as a force multiplier in your investigations.
  
  
Day to day, you'll work hand in hand with customers' own security teams to operationalize the
**Traceable by Harness Protection module**
and then stay engaged as an
**extended SOC and red team**
— continuously improving their security posture rather than handing off at go-live.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Operationalize the Protection module. Work directly with customers' security teams to stand up and tune the Traceable by Harness Protection module in their environment, from initial rollout through steady-state enforcement.
* Be their extended SOC and red team. Engage continuously — not as a one-off deployment — acting as an extension of the customer's SOC to monitor and hunt, and as a red team to probe their defenses, steadily improving their overall security posture.
* Evaluate detections built by Security Research Engineering. Review and pressure-test ModSecurity (ModSec) rulesets, API security detections, AI Security detections, and OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Top 10 / OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage for accuracy, coverage gaps, and false-positive rates before and after they reach customers.
* Validate true positives in production traffic. Partner directly with customer security teams to triage platform alerts, confirm genuine true positives, distinguish them from false positives and benign anomalies, and document the reasoning behind each verdict.
* Automate the hunt. Build scripts, tooling, and automated workflows — increasingly AI-assisted — that scale threat hunting across many customers at once, rather than investigating one alert at a time by hand.
* Run threat hunting engagements globally. Proactively hunt across the API traffic of Harness customers worldwide for business logic abuse (BOLA/BFLA, parameter tampering, workflow abuse), account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and fraud patterns that signature-based detection alone won't catch.
* Black-box test the platform and customer APIs. Attack detections and API endpoints the way a real adversary would — validating coverage, finding blind spots, and generating the adversarial traffic needed to confirm detections actually fire.
* Own the detection feedback loop. Turn field findings into concrete, prioritized input for Security Research Engineering and Product — new rule ideas, tuning recommendations, catalog/detection integration gaps, and coverage improvements.
* Reproduce and investigate incidents. Lead deep-dive investigations into anomalous API behavior, trace root cause (including upstream CDN/WAF/gateway layers), and produce clear RCA documentation and findings for both technical and executive audiences.
* Weed out false positives and report on what matters (critical). Aggressively filter noise so customers aren't chasing false alarms, and deliver clear reports that surface genuine threat insights — helping customer teams focus their limited attention on the true incidents that actually require action. This signal-over-noise discipline is central to the value customers get from the platform.
* Reduce customer noise at the source. Tune detections to each customer's API catalog, business context, and legitimate integration patterns so false positives are suppressed before they ever reach an analyst.
* Be a trusted technical advisor. Translate detection logic and threat findings into language customer security leaders can act on, and help them mature their API and AI security posture.

What You Bring
  
  
**Required**

* 4–6 years in security engineering, detection engineering, threat hunting, penetration testing, incident response, or a closely related discipline.
* A deep, current understanding of the security landscape — threat models, attacker techniques, and how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually play out.
* Ability to code and automate. You write your own tooling to scale threat hunting — this is not a point-and-click role.
* Ability to use AI for threat hunting. You actively leverage LLMs and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate investigation, triage, and hunt automation.
* Black-box penetration testing ability — you can attack an API or a detection with no prior knowledge and reason about what an adversary would do.
* Comfort working directly with enterprise customers globally — you can lead a technical conversation, defend a verdict, and write findings that stand up to scrutiny.

Core Technical Requirements
  
  
This is a core technical role. We expect real depth — not surface familiarity — across most of the following:
  
  

* Security frameworks & threat models: OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP LLM (GenAI) Top 10; MITRE ATT&CK, and MITRE ATLAS for AI/ML threats.
* API security: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC; authentication and authorization flows (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, session handling); and the full range of API attack techniques (BOLA/BFLA, mass assignment, injection, SSRF, rate-limit and workflow abuse).
* AI / LLM security: prompt injection, sensitive-information disclosure, improper output handling, excessive agency, and abuse of AI-driven or agentic API endpoints — and how to detect them.
* Detection & WAF engineering: hands-on with WAF / ModSecurity rule logic — reading, writing, tuning, and reasoning about false-positive / false-negative tradeoffs.
* Offensive testing & tooling: black-box testing of APIs and detections using tools such as Burp Suite, Postman, and OWASP ZAP; generating adversarial traffic to confirm detections fire.
* Scripting & automation: Python (or equivalent) to build investigation tooling and automated, increasingly AI-assisted hunt workflows; comfort querying large volumes of traffic and telemetry.
* Threat hunting & fraud analysis: distinguishing business logic abuse and fraud from legitimate traffic — account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and payment fraud.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with CDN, gateway, and upstream traffic architectures (Akamai, Cloudflare, and similar) and how they interact with detection at the edge.
* Prior experience in a customer-facing security engineering, SOC, or professional services role.
* Certifications (a plus, not required). Because this role centers on API and AI security, the most relevant credentials are:

+ API security: Certified API Pentester (C-APIPen), APIsec University ASCP, or PortSwigger Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP).
+ AI / LLM security: a hands-on AI security certification such as CAISP (Certified AI Security Professional) or equivalent.
+ Offensive / web depth: OSWE, GWAPT, or OSCP.
+ Note: AI-security certifications are still maturing, so demonstrated hands-on ability weighs more heavily than any specific badge.

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
  
  
At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/
  
  
**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
  
  
Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
  
  
If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Senior Analyst, Facility and Security Technology
description:

Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a distributor of pharmaceuticals, a global manufacturer and distributor of medical and laboratory products, and a provider of performance and data solutions for healthcare facilities.
  
  
We are a crucial link between the clinical and operational sides of healthcare, delivering end‑to‑end solutions and data‑driving insights that advance healthcare and improve lives every day. With deep partnerships, diverse perspectives and innovative digital solutions, we build connections across the continuum of care.
  
  
With more than 50 years of experience, we seize the opportunity to address healthcare's most complicated challenges — now, and in the future.

Amazon is seeking a Risk Manager assist with identity verification and fraud mitigation for daily freight movements flowing into and out of our North American fulfillment centers and our associated fulfillment network. This is an exciting opportunity to join a new team in a huge growth area for Amazon.
  
  
This role requires the leader to independently own delivery of their goals on investigations, vulnerabilities and other program level deliverables. We are looking for a motivated and capable Analytic, Operations, Metrics, and Process Improvement Manager, with Program or Project management experience. You will work on threats that requires ongoing deep dive to identify the vulnerabilities. As a domain subject matter expert, you will partner with Investigators, Program/Product Managers within RPT, and stakeholders within Amazon to drive medium complexity risk identification and mitigation initiatives, where the business problem and solution may not be well defined. This is a highly visible and impacting role within the group, as well as across the department. You are expected to deliver independently with occasional guidance on (a) strategic intelligence programs to detect threats from multiple channels, (b) scaling mitigation initiatives like Carrier/Driver level enforcements, and (c) understand the risk tolerance levels and make recommendations to partner teams based on data.
  
  
Knowledge of SQL and Open Source Intelligence/ Investigations (OSINT) is a MUST FOR THIS ROLE.

* Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends

* Partner with cross functional teams across Amazon for collaboration on fraud risks and investigations.
* Apply risk management best practices to mitigate issues, identify operational inefficiencies and improve processes.

A day in the life
  
  

* Constantly monitor metrics, industry trends and social media chatter to identify deviations, and spot emerging frauds/ MOs that are adopted by bad actors

* Partner with multiple fraud/abuse teams to learn and implement industry wide best practices and other identity verification mechanisms
* Manage metrics, prepare WBR callouts and Sr. leadership review summaries

* Experience working on OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) investigations and drafting finished intelligence summaries for Sr. Leadership review

* 3+ years of program or project management experience

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands-on” role: you will write security-centric code, conduct deep-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
  
  
Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
  
  
Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
  
  
Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  
  
Identity/Auth: Expert-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 10+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
  
  
Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
  
  
Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  
  
Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non-technical leadership.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Secure Architecture & Threat Modeling

Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
  
  
Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
  
  
Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
  
  
  

* Offensive Security & Exploitation

In-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
  
  
Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
  
  
Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high-severity fixes.
  
  
  

* Secure Coding & SDLC Integration

Secure Code Review: Review high-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
  
  
Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

**Job Summary -**

The IAM / IDM Manager will own the organizations Identity and Access Management program end-to-end, including Identity Provider (IdP) administration, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, directory services, and the joiner-mover-leaver access lifecycle. The individual will work closely with IT infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure secure, compliant, and well-governed identity architecture, while supporting the organizations broader

Zero Trust and network security initiatives. The role also involves evaluating and managing IAM/IDM platforms and vendors to balance cost, security, and scalability.

1. Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

2. Proven experience (69 years) in Identity and Access Management

(IAM/IDM), access governance, or a related security role.

3. Hands-on experience administering cloud-based Identity Providers such as JumpCloud, Okta, or Azure AD; exposure to open-source identity platforms (Keycloak) preferred.

4. Strong understanding of SSO, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, MFA, and

LDAP/directory services.

5. Experience managing identity in cloud-first, directory-as-a-service environments (without traditional Active Directory) is an advantage.

6. Working knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles.

7. Experience with Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle automation and

periodic access certification/review processes.

8. Understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks.

9. Relevant certifications preferred: CISSP, CISA, CIAM, or vendor-specific IAM certifications.

10. Strong analytical and vendor evaluation skills, including experience running IAM tool POCs and RFPs.

11. Excellent stakeholder management, documentation, and communication skills

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Identity Provider (IdP) & SSO Management:

* Administer and manage the organizations Identity Provider platform(s) for endpoint and application authentication

across Windows and macOS environments.

* Own the roadmap for IdP evaluation, migration, and vendor management (e.g., JumpCloud, Zoho Directory,

Keycloak, OpenIDM).

* Configure and maintain SSO integrations across enterprise SaaS and business applications.

2. Access Lifecycle & Governance:

* Manage end-to-end Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes to ensure timely provisioning and de-provisioning of access.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and certifications to ensure least-privilege access across systems.
* Define and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models and access policies.

3. Authentication & Zero Trust Enablement:

* Drive enterprise-wide MFA adoption and enforcement.
* Collaborate with the network security team to align IAM architecture with the organizations Zero Trust Network

Access (ZTNA) initiatives.

* Support integration of IAM controls with endpoint and network security tooling.

4. Privileged Access Management:

* Implement and manage PAM controls for privileged/admin accounts across servers, network devices, and applications.
* Monitor and audit privileged session activity and enforce just-in-time access where applicable.

5. Compliance & Risk Management:

* Ensure IAM processes and controls align with ISO 27001, HIPAA, and Indias DPDP Act requirements.
* Support internal and external audits with IAM evidence, access logs, and compliance reports.
* Identify and remediate identity-related risks and control gaps.

6. Vendor Evaluation & Cost Optimization:

* Run POCs and RFPs for IAM/IDM tools and platforms, evaluating cost, security, and scalability tradeoffs.
* Manage vendor relationships and contract renewals for identity platforms.

7. Reporting and Analytics:

* Generate periodic reports on access compliance, identity risk posture, and IAM program metrics for leadership.
* Recommend process improvements based on identity analytics and audit findings.

title: GRC Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

R360 (Reward360 Global Services) operates one of the denser multi-framework compliance stacks in the Indian BFSI-adjacent fintech space, maintaining concurrent conformance to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 20000-1, SOC 2 (Type I/II), India's DPDP Act 2023, and PCI DSS v4.0.1 in addition to bank-specific vendor security requirements from clients including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank. As GRC Analyst, you will own control implementation, evidence collection, risk register maintenance, and audit coordination across this stack, working closely with AppSec, DevOps/Infra, and client-facing InfoSec teams to keep certifications live and the organization continuously audit-ready.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. ISMS Ownership & Certification Maintenance (ISO/IEC 27001:2022)

* Maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA), risk treatment plan, and control implementation evidence.
* Support internal audits, management review meetings, and surveillance/recertification audits with external certification bodies.

2. Privacy Management (ISO/IEC 27701 + DPDP Act 2023)

* Maintain the Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) extension to the ISMS.
* Maintain Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), consent-flow mapping, and data-principal-rights handling against DPDP Act 2023 obligations (consent manager touchpoints, breach notification timelines, Data Fiduciary/Processor duties).
* Support Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new features, products, and vendors handling personal data.

3. IT Service Management (ISO/IEC 20000-1)

* Maintain ITSM process documentation — incident, problem, change, capacity, and service level management — aligned to ISO/IEC 20000-1 requirements.
* Coordinate with DevOps/Infra on service management metrics and supporting audit evidence.

4. SOC 2 Readiness & Audit Support

* Maintain Trust Services Criteria control matrices (security, availability, confidentiality, and processing integrity /privacy where applicable).
* Coordinate auditor evidence requests across SOC 2 Type I (point-in-time) and Type II (operating effectiveness over a review period) engagements.

5. PCI DSS v4.0.1 Compliance

* Maintain Attestation of Compliance (AoC) / Report on Compliance (RoC) documentation and BAU evidence (Requirements 1–12).
* Track compensating controls, quarterly ASV scan remediation, and annual penetration test finding closurealongside the AppSec team.

6. Risk & Third-Party Risk Management

title: Data Management & Governance Program Lead
description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Role summary**

**Job title**

Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**

Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Reports to**

Engagement Director - Capvirge; works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**

Project Manager, Project Coordinator, Data Governance Analyst, Data Quality & Lineage Analyst, Business Analyst, Power BI Developers and Snowflake Data Engineer (with the client EDO team)

**Experience**

12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

The role also oversees delivery of the **16 tactical dashboards** (Power BI on Snowflake), from BRD and build to UAT sign-off, Production and BAU.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.

* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.

* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.

* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.

* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.

* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.

* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Team the role leads**

**Role**

**Focus**

**Project Manager**

Programme plan, RAID log, action tracker and status reporting

**Project Coordinator**

Meetings, follow-ups, minutes and document control

**Data Governance Analyst**

Data Owners and Stewards, business glossary, policies and standards (D2)

**Data Quality & Lineage Analyst**

Data inventory, quality rules, monitoring and lineage (D3)

**Business Analyst (insurance)**

BRDs, KPI definitions and dashboard requirements (D1, D5)

**Power BI Developers**

Build, UAT and BAU support for the 16 dashboards

**Snowflake Data Engineer**

Data models, pipelines and platform remediation (D4)

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.

* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.

* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.

* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.

* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.

* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.

* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.

* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Technical and domain skills**

**Area**

**Must have**

**Good to have**

**Data governance**

DAMA-DMBOK, federated operating models, RACI and decision rights, data classification

DCAM, data catalogue tools

**KPIs and metrics**

KPI trees, SMART definitions, certification and change control

Management scorecards and target setting

**Data quality and lineage**

Critical data elements, quality dimensions, rules and thresholds, issue management, column lineage

Automated quality checks in pipelines (Airflow), logical data models

**Data platforms**

Snowflake, AWS (S3), Power BI; environments, access control, cost (FinOps)

AWS Well-Architected, TOGAF, privileged access (CyberArk)

**Analytics**

Dashboard delivery lifecycle (BRD, UAT, hypercare), semantic models, shared data sets

Customer journey and funnel analytics

**AI readiness**

Use-case scoring; Predictive, Generative and Agentic AI concepts; responsible AI

NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001

**Insurance domain**

Life and ILP products, persistency, APE, claims, IFRS 17 and statutory reporting, bancassurance and digital partners

Group insurance

**Regulation (Philippines)**

Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), Insurance Commission requirements, RA 11765 consumer protection

AML (RA 9160)

**Delivery and service**

Programme planning, RAID, gates, change control; BAU service design, SOPs, incident and change processes

ITIL, ADKAR change management

**Behavioural competencies**

* **Executive influence:** gets decisions and sign-offs from senior leaders and busy business owners, and keeps approvals moving.

* **Plain-language communication:** turns frameworks into short material executives can read and act on.

* **Facilitation:** runs workshops where departments disagree, and brings them to one agreed definition.

* **Pragmatism:** balances good-practice governance with what a small team can actually run.

* **Ownership:** works without close supervision, and tracks commitments to closure.

* **Coaching:** builds capability in client teams so they can run the work after handover.

**Preferred certifications**

None is mandatory; proven delivery counts for more.

* CDMP (DAMA) or DCAM: data management

* PMP or PRINCE2: programme delivery

* SnowPro Core, or Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst: platforms

* ITIL 4 Foundation: BAU services

* An AI governance certification (for example IAPP AIGP): responsible AI

Work Location: In person

title: GRC Intern
description:
About the Role

R360 maintains concurrent conformance to six major compliance frameworks ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 20000-1, SOC 2, India's DPDP Act 2023, and PCI DSS v4.0.1 across a banking-linked platform serving HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank. This paid internship gives you structured, mentored exposure to real audit cycles, evidence collection, and control-testing work across all six frameworks a depth of multi-framework exposure that is uncommon at entry level, under the direct supervision of senior GRC analysts.

Key Responsibilities (Under Supervision)

* Assist in evidence collection for ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 20000-1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and DPDP Act compliance activities.
* Support risk register updates and control-testing sample pulls.
* Assist with policy and procedure documentation reviews and version control.
* Support first-draft responses to vendor/client security questionnaires, reviewed by a senior GRC analyst before submission.
* Assist with audit logistics scheduling, evidence repository organisation, and auditor request tracking.
* Learn ROPA and DPIA basics under supervision as part of DPDP Act 2023 compliance work.
* Support security awareness training tracking and completion reporting.
* Assist with PCCB documentation review to flag compliance-relevant changes.

Learning Outcomes

* Real-world exposure to six concurrent compliance frameworks inside a live BFSI-adjacent environment.
* Understanding of the full audit lifecycle preparation, evidence collection, auditor coordination, and closure.
* Foundational GRC skills that map directly to a GRC Analyst career path.

Eligibility

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Information Security, IT, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of information security and/or data privacy concepts; relevant coursework or in-progress certifications are a plus.
* Detail-oriented with strong written English for documentation-heavy work.
* GRC — Governance, Risk & Compliance Hiring
* Genuine interest in a compliance/audit career path (as distinct from a purely technical/offensive-security track).

Preferred (Not Mandatory)

* ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation certificate, or actively pursuing one.
* Exposure to privacy law coursework (DPDP Act 2023, GDPR) is a plus.
* Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and, ideally, some exposure to a GRC tool (ServiceNow GRC, OneTrust, Vanta, or similar).

Program Structure

1. Month 1–2 Foundations

Framework overview across ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 20000-1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and DPDP Act 2023; shadowing GRC analysts; tool walk throughs.

2. Month 3–4 Guided Evidence Collection

Hands-on evidence collection and control-testing support, with mandatory senior review before submission.

3. Month 5–6 Supervised Independence

Independent ownership of low-risk documentation/evidence tasks (reviewed); capstone project — build one control-mapping matrix or mini gap-analysis across two frameworks.

title: GRC Security Analyst
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Governance**

* Assist in the development, review, and maintenance of information security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines in line with frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
* Support periodic policy review cycles, ensuring documentation is kept current, version-controlled, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute to security awareness initiatives by preparing training materials, tracking completion rates, and maintaining associated records.
* Maintain governance trackers and document repositories, ensuring accuracy and completeness at all times.
* Support the preparation of governance reports, dashboards, and meeting packs for internal and client stakeholders.

**Risk Management**

* Support the conduct of information security risk assessments under the guidance of senior team members, contributing to the identification and evaluation of threats, vulnerabilities, and business impacts.
* Maintain and update the risk register, ensuring risks are accurately documented, assigned, and tracked through treatment to closure.
* Assist with third-party and vendor risk assessments by gathering required information, reviewing responses, and documenting findings.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery documentation, review cycles, and testing activities.
* Help prepare risk reports and escalate identified risks to senior analysts or management as appropriate.

**Compliance**

* Support compliance activities against applicable frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and client-specific requirements.
* Assist in the planning and coordination of internal and external audits — gathering evidence, preparing documentation packages, and tracking audit findings through to remediation.
* Conduct periodic compliance checks and control walkthroughs to verify that controls are in place and operating as expected.
* Maintain compliance calendars and support the team in meeting regulatory deadlines, audit schedules, and periodic review obligations.
* Track and follow up on corrective action plans arising from audit findings, ensuring timely closure and accurate record-keeping.

**Security Control Assessment**

* Assist in conducting periodic assessments of security controls across people, process, and technology dimensions.
* Document control observations, gaps, and weaknesses identified during assessments and support the preparation of remediation recommendations.
* Coordinate with technical and operational teams to gather evidence of control effectiveness and maintain supporting records for audit readiness.

**Reporting & Metrics**

* Maintain and update GRC dashboards, trackers, and metrics on a regular basis, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Prepare routine GRC reports, meeting packs, and status updates for review by senior analysts or management before distribution to clients.
* Track and report on KPIs including policy compliance rates, open risk items, audit finding closure timelines, and training completion rates.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support client-facing GRC activities including governance meetings, monthly business reviews, and audit sessions under the guidance of senior team members.
* Respond to client queries on policy, compliance, and risk matters accurately and in a timely manner, escalating complex queries where appropriate.
* Maintain a professional and collaborative relationship with client security and compliance contacts.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and flag opportunities to improve GRC processes, templates, and documentation practices.
* Stay current with developments in security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, and share relevant updates with the team.
* Support the adoption of GRC tools and contribute to improving data quality and workflow efficiency within those platforms.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

* 2–4 years of experience in information security with exposure to governance, risk, and/or compliance functions.
* Working knowledge of at least one or two information security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or PCI-DSS.
* Basic understanding of risk assessment methodologies and the ability to identify and document security risks with guidance.
* Familiarity with audit processes — evidence gathering, control walkthroughs, and finding documentation.
* Ability to contribute to the development and review of security policies and procedures.
* Good analytical skills with attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation and tracking.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for report preparation, tracker maintenance, and presentation development.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey security and compliance information clearly.
* Exposure to GRC platforms or ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, RSA Archer, or equivalent is an advantage.
* Experience in a managed security services or client-facing environment is a plus.
    
    
  **Preferred Certifications**
* CompTIA Security+
* ISO 27001 Foundation or Internal Auditor
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) — Associate level
* CISM or CISSP — Foundation / Associate level
* Any vendor-specific GRC tool certification is a plus

Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.

* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.

* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.

* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.

* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.

* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.

* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.

* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.

* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.

* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.

* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.

* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.
  

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.

* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.

* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.

* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.

* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.

* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.

* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.

* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer

* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.

* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.
  

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to shape the future of Financial Crime technology at LSEG, leading critical transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen controls and support global regulatory obligations.

You will have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence strategic decisions and drive delivery of solutions that create meaningful business impact across the organisation.

  
  
  
  

**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

Manager

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our advisor-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our consumer business provides digital solutions for customers to better spend, borrow, invest, and save. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design.

  

**Goldman Sachs Private Bank**

Goldman Sachs Private Bank provides competitive borrowing and cash management solutions from Goldman Sachs Bank USA that are strategically integrated with our client’s wealth management goals. Our experienced team partners with PWAs to advise clients on new loans, refinancing and restructuring of existing loans along with overall liability management. Our lenders and mortgage specialists provide a wide range of creative borrowing solutions against asset classes ranging from marketable securities and alternative investments, residential and commercial real estate to more tailored solutions against private assets such as aviation, fine art or vineyards. All team members are employees of Goldman Sachs Bank, USA

  

**Private Lending Underwriting**

Private Lending Underwriting (PLU), based in Bengaluru, is primarily responsible for the underwriting of loans to GS Private Wealth Management (PWM) clients. In this capacity, PLU assesses, underwrites, documents, and monitors the credit and business risks incurred in loan transactions. The underwriting process includes a thorough analysis of the borrower’s financial condition, assessment of any collateral securing the loan, identification of risks and mitigants, among other items. Types of loans underwritten include commercial real estate, GS and third-party private equity/hedge funds (including co-invest facilities), aircraft, fine art, hobby properties, private company stock, yachts, marketable securities, etc.
  
PLU also ensures that the underwriting standards approved by the bank are adhered to in the loan approval process, with exceptions appropriately mitigated and documented. In addition, PLU participates in various business-related initiatives, such as new product development and systems/operational enhancements.
  
Private Lending is a part of GS Private Bank (PB), which is a business initiative of Goldman Sachs. PLU employees are employees of Goldman Sachs Bank USA.

**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

* Evaluate all risk and economic implications of transactions, using strong analytical and technical skills
* Work closely with the Regional Lending and Underwriting Team to conduct periodical review of client’s financial position & collateral performance and assess if they remain within acceptable risk parameters for the Bank
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the product suite offered in Private Lending. Ensure consistency in the underwriting and review process and with the standards prescribed in the Product Lending Guides
* Document the loan structure and analysis for credit approval and file documentation purposes
* Ensure that loan documentation is consistent with the approved terms and that appropriate risk ratings are assigned to each loan transaction
* Confirm compliance with all covenant and collateral monitoring procedures
* Ensure that loan approvals and policy exceptions are documented appropriately and that credit files are maintained in a satisfactory manner
* Interact with banking regulators on an as needed basis. Provide other support of GS Bank USA’s loan portfolio as requested
* Foster strong communication with Regional Underwriting and Private Lending teams, Credit Risk Management, PWM teams, clients and GS Bank USA personnel
  

**Basic and Preferred Qualification**

* CA Fresher or experienced
* CPA or CFA a plus
* 1-3 years of work experience in a financial field (mortgage or insurance underwriting is not relevant for this role)
* Relevant work experience in commercial banking and/or private banking underwriting or credit roles
* Key skills include detailed knowledge of financial accounting, analysis, and modeling
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
* Strong project management, multi-tasking, and work organization skills
* Flexible, personable, confident, and self-motivated while focusing on being a team player
* Desire to be part of a dynamic and growing business
* No licensing required for this role

title: Lead Specialist,Network Operations
description:
**Job Title: Lead Specialist, Network Engineer**

  
  

**About the role:**

  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to join our team as we continue to modernize and evolve our global network infrastructure. Built on a strong and well-managed Cisco Meraki foundation, we are actively expanding our Zero Trust architecture and cloud security capabilities through Zscaler.

  
  

As a Network Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our network by helping to drive initiatives that improve connectivity, security, resiliency, and operational efficiency across the organization. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern enterprise networking technologies, participate in large-scale infrastructure projects, and help guide the transition toward cloud-delivered security and Zero Trust networking.

  
  

This role offers a unique blend of day-to-day operational support, network architecture, project delivery, and next-generation security technologies. If you're passionate about networking, security, automation, and solving complex technical challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

  
  

**Position Summary**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and support enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of Cisco and Meraki networking technologies, cloud security platforms, routing and switching, and end-user connectivity troubleshooting. This role requires hands-on experience with network design, deployment, and operational support, as well as the ability to travel to company locations as needed.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* Design, implement, and support enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, and security infrastructure.
  
  
* Manage and support Cisco Meraki environments, including:
  
  
* Meraki Wireless Access Points
  
  
* Meraki MS Switching
  
  
* Meraki MX Security Appliances
  
  
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco networking equipment, including:
  
  
* Cisco Routers
  
  
* Cisco Catalyst Switches
  
  
* Cisco ASA Firewalls
  
  
* Administer and support Zscaler cloud security solutions, including:
  
  
* Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
  
  
* Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
  
  
* Zero Trust Branch (ZTB)
  
  
* Zscaler Branch Architecture (ZBA)
  
  
* Implement and support Zero Trust networking architectures and secure access solutions for branch offices and remote users.
  
  
* Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot routing protocols, including:
  
  
* BGP
  
  
* EIGRP
  
  
* OSPF
  
  
* Perform network capacity planning, architecture reviews, and infrastructure design.
  
  
* Lead network installations, upgrades, migrations, and refresh projects.
  
  
* Troubleshoot network, wireless, routing, switching, VPN, and security-related issues.
  
  
* Diagnose and resolve connectivity and performance issues affecting:
  
  
* Windows clients
  
  
* macOS clients
  
  
* Coordinate network equipment procurement, asset lifecycle management, and vendor engagement.
  
  
* Work with service providers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver network solutions.
  
  
* Create and maintain network diagrams, standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation.
  
  
* Participate in network incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
  
  
* Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations that improve network performance, security, and operational efficiency.
  
  
* Support automation initiatives and continuously improve operational processes.
  
  
* Provide after-hours support and participate in an on-call rotation as required.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
  
  
* 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Cisco Meraki solutions, including wireless, switching, and MX security appliances.
  
  
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco routers, switches, and ASA firewalls.
  
  
* Experience administering Zscaler security platforms, including ZIA, ZPA, ZTB, and ZBA.
  
  
* Strong understanding of:
  
  
* TCP/IP
  
  
* DNS
  
  
* DHCP
  
  
* VLANs
  
  
* VPNs
  
  
* Network Security
  
  
* Wireless Networking
  
  
* Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting:
  
  
* BGP
  
  
* EIGRP
  
  
* OSPF
  
  
* Experience troubleshooting network-related issues on both Windows and macOS endpoints.
  
  
* Experience with network architecture, deployment, and operational support.
  
  
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent certification.
  
  
* Cisco Meraki CMNA, ECMS, or related certifications.
  
  
* Zscaler certifications or experience with Zero Trust architectures.
  
  
* Experience with network automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar tools.
  
  
* Experience supporting cloud networking environments such as AWS or Azure.
  
  
* Familiarity with network monitoring, performance management, and troubleshooting tools.
  
  
* Experience supporting global or multi-site enterprise environments.
  
  
* Experience participating in network modernization and transformation initiatives.
  

  

**Travel Requirements**

  

  
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
  
  
* Travel may be required for:
  
  
* Network installations
  
  
* Site surveys
  
  
* Infrastructure upgrades
  
  
* Project deployments
  
  
* Troubleshooting and operational support
  
  
* Estimated travel requirement: 10-25%.
  

  

**What You'll Work On**

  
  

As part of our team, you'll help drive initiatives including:

  

  
* Expansion of our Zscaler-based Zero Trust architecture.
  
  
* Branch modernization leveraging Zero Trust Branch technologies.
  
  
* Global wireless, switching, and security refresh projects.
  
  
* Network automation and operational efficiency improvements.
  
  
* Cloud security and secure access transformation initiatives.
  
  
* Standardization and modernization of enterprise network services worldwide.
  

  

This is an opportunity to directly influence the future direction of our network and security architecture while working with industry-leading technologies in a collaborative, global environment.

  
  

**Technical Skills Summary**

  
  

**Networking**

  

  
* Cisco Meraki Wireless
  
  
* Cisco Meraki Switching
  
  
* Cisco Meraki MX Security Appliances
  
  
* Cisco Routers
  
  
* Cisco Catalyst Switches
  
  
* Cisco ASA Firewalls
  
  
* LAN/WAN Technologies
  
  
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
  
  
* VLANs and VPNs
  

  

**Routing**

  

  
* BGP
  
  
* EIGRP
  
  
* OSPF
  

  

**Security**

  

  
* Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
  
  
* Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
  
  
* Zero Trust Branch (ZTB)
  
  
* Zscaler Branch Architecture (ZBA)
  
  
* Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
  
  
* Firewall and Security Policy Management
  

  

**End User Support**

  

  
* Windows Network Troubleshooting
  
  
* macOS Network Troubleshooting
  

  

**Infrastructure**

  

  
* Network Design
  
  
* Network Procurement and Equipment Ordering
  
  
* Network Installation and Deployment
  
  
* Network Documentation
  
  
* Vendor and Carrier Management
  
  
* Network Lifecycle Management
  

  

**Automation & Operations**

  

  
* Network Automation
  
  
* Python, PowerShell, APIs
  
  
* Monitoring and Performance Analysis
  
  
* Incident and Problem Management
  

  

This version presents the role as more than a support position. It highlights the opportunity to be part of a strategic transformation from a traditional network model to a modern Meraki and Zscaler-based Zero Trust architecture, which tends to attract stronger senior-level candidates.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer

title: Cybersecurity Services Analyst
description:
The Connected Vehicle Ecosystem Cybersecurity team is directly engaged in securing end-to-end connected vehicle features. This role will provide senior technical leadership for the development and delivery of secure, globally connected vehicle applications and capabilities, with emphasis on identity and access management, cloud and mobile security, threat modeling, penetration testing, DevSecOps, cryptographic controls, and emerging AI security.
  
  

* Provide senior-level cybersecurity expertise for connected vehicle and mobility products, services, applications, and supporting platforms, using threat intelligence and data analysis to guide risk-based decisions.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture and design reviews, attack-path analysis, and security assessments across cloud, mobile, in-vehicle, API, and identity-dependent solutions, including REST and event-driven API attack surfaces.
* Define, publish, and continuously improve security specifications, patterns, standards, and policies for connected vehicle products and features.
* Establish and govern API security requirements covering authentication, authorization, token and credential handling, input validation, rate limiting, data protection, logging, inventory, versioning, and secure retirement.
* Operate security governance processes for findings and exceptions, including intake, triage, risk classification, control-owner assignment, remediation tracking, risk acceptance, escalation, metrics, and closure evidence.
* Manage the penetration and API security testing lifecycle, including scope definition, test coordination, authentication and authorization testing, findings review, risk prioritization, remediation guidance, and validation of high-impact fixes.
* Partner with product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to translate vulnerabilities and technical findings into clear business risk and practical control recommendations.
* Drive security integration into DevSecOps and software delivery pipelines through automated scanning, security gates, compliance checks, and actionable feedback for engineering teams.
* Guide identity and access management designs, including multifactor authentication, authorization, federation, token usage, service-to-service trust, and least-privilege access.
* Provide technical direction for cryptographic controls, including encryption, certificate management, keys, tokens, and mutual TLS across multi-platform environments.
* Lead vulnerability and cybersecurity incident triage, validate severity and exploitability, identify ownership, coordinate remediation, manage exceptions, and track issues through risk acceptance or verified closure.
* Serve as a cybersecurity point of contact and consultant for complex security research, product evaluations, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Conduct security assessments for GenAI, large language models, AI agents, and machine learning platforms, including AI threat modeling, red teaming, adversarial testing, guardrails, RAG security, identity protections, monitoring, and governance.
* Work independently, take ownership of deliverables, mentor less-experienced team members, and communicate decisions, risks, and progress to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, software engineering, or a closely related technical role.
* 5+ years of combined experience with cloud applications, mobile applications, APIs, identity platforms, or distributed software systems.
* Hands-on experience leading threat modeling, security architecture reviews, vulnerability analysis, or penetration testing activities.
* Hands-on experience with API security testing and vulnerability triage, including assessment of authentication, authorization, data exposure, input handling, and business-logic risks.
* Working knowledge of secure software development practices and the ability to partner effectively with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Experience communicating technical security risks and remediation recommendations to engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of identity and access management, including MFA, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, authorization tokens, identity federation, and service identities.
* Practical expertise with cryptography and transport security, including encryption, certificates, key management, digital signatures, and mutual TLS.
* Experience securing applications and services operating in multi-cloud environments, particularly Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of one or more relevant development technologies, such as Java, Python, React, Swift, Kotlin, XML, REST APIs, and network sockets.
* Experience with API security testing and automation, including REST API assessment, authentication and authorization validation, negative testing, fuzzing, secure code review, and penetration testing.
* Experience governing security findings, policy exceptions, risk acceptances, remediation commitments, security metrics, and evidence-based closure across multiple engineering teams.
* Experience implementing or governing automated security testing within CI/CD, DevSecOps, or MLOps pipelines.
* Knowledge of connected vehicle, automotive, IoT, telematics, mobility, or other cyber-physical ecosystems.
* Experience assessing GenAI, LLM, AI-agent, RAG, or machine-learning solutions and defining security controls for their deployment.
* Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, OSCP, CEH, or cloud security certifications are advantageous.

**Core Competencies**

* Technical leadership and sound security judgment in ambiguous, cross-domain environments.
* Risk-based prioritization and the ability to balance security, customer experience, delivery, and operational needs.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise executive-level risk framing.
* Collaboration across global, cross-functional, and culturally diverse teams.
* Ownership, initiative, structured problem solving, and continuous learning.
