description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\_cat, \_cluster, \_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

Access and security
  
  

* Kibana spaces, RBAC, roles and role mapping (SAML, LDAP, AD)
* TLS and certificate management for the stack

Cloud, containers and networking
  
  

* AWS basics (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) and Azure basics
* VPC concepts: subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs
* Network connectivity options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, load balancers
* EKS and Kubernetes operations, including ECK
* Senior level: AWS architecture in depth, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail and cross-account logging

Automation and DevOps (Senior Engineer and Operations Lead)
  
  

* Hands-on Python for automation against Elastic APIs
* CI/CD setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Terraform and infrastructure as code; Git-based workflows
* A track record of automations delivered, e.g. upgrade automation, onboarding automation, health-check scripts

Operations practice (Operations roles; valued for all)
  
  

* Ticket handling within SLA in ServiceNow, Jira or similar
* Incident calls, Sev1 triage and escalation handling
* RCA findings and write-ups; runbook and knowledge-base upkeep
* ITIL incident, problem and change processes
* Willingness to work 24×7 rotational shifts from office

Good to have
  
  

* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Observability Engineer
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional); HashiCorp Terraform Associate; ITIL v4 Foundation
* Exposure to Elastic Security (SIEM) and detection rules
* Azure log sources and networking (Event Hub, Azure Monitor)
* Linux administration and shell scripting

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
* Clear written and spoken communication for tickets, RCAs and stakeholder updates

title: Email Security
description:
We are looking for an experienced Email Operations & Trust & Safety Analyst to monitor, investigate, and mitigate email-related security threats, spam, phishing, and abuse. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Splunk, email security operations, log analysis, and email authentication protocols.

The role involves identifying suspicious email activity, investigating security incidents, maintaining email security standards, and ensuring timely resolution of incidents in a 24×7 operational environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor inbound and outbound email traffic to identify spam, phishing, spoofing, malware, and suspicious activities.

- Analyze email and security logs using Splunk to detect anomalies, investigate incidents, and identify threat patterns.

- Perform email header analysis to investigate message origins, routing paths, and authentication failures.

- Investigate email abuse, suspicious domains, malicious IP addresses, and compromised accounts.

- Support incident mitigation activities, including blocking malicious IPs/domains, quarantining suspicious emails, and updating blocklists, as per established SOPs.

- Troubleshoot email delivery issues, false positives, and email authentication failures.

- Work with email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, to help prevent email spoofing and protect domain reputation.

- Document investigation findings, maintain incident records, and escalate critical issues to the relevant teams.

- Ensure adherence to SLAs, quality standards, security policies, and operational procedures.

- Collaborate with internal security, engineering, and operations teams to resolve email security incidents.

## Required Skills and Qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Email Operations, Email Security, Trust & Safety, Abuse Desk, or Security Operations Center (SOC).

- Hands-on experience with \*\*Splunk\*\* for log analysis, searching, monitoring, and investigating security events.

- Strong understanding of email protocols, including SMTP, and end-to-end email flow.

- Working knowledge of email authentication mechanisms: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

- Experience in identifying and investigating spam, phishing, spoofing, malicious domains, and email abuse.

- Knowledge of email header analysis and security incident investigation.

- Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills for incident documentation and escalation.

- Willingness to work in 24×7 rotational shifts.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with email security platforms, SIEM tools, or threat monitoring solutions.

- Exposure to Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast, or similar email security tools.

- Understanding of sender reputation, email deliverability, and domain security.

- Experience working with incident management systems and documented SOPs.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Timely response and resolution of email security incidents within defined SLAs.

- Accuracy in identifying and classifying email threats.

- Quality and completeness of incident documentation.

- Compliance with security procedures and operational standards.

- Effective escalation and resolution of security-related issues.

Important Information

Candidates should have relevant hands-on experience in email security operations and Splunk-based log analysis. General IT support experience without relevant email security or investigation exposure may not be suitable for this role.

Pay: ₹750,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Team Leadership, Coaching & Escalation Management -**
Manage, mentor, and develop infrastructure engineers, administrators, analysts, and/or external partners. Provide clear priorities, technical guidance, performance feedback, workload direction, and career development support. Serve as the senior escalation point for high-impact technical issues, service interruptions, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional troubleshooting.
  
  
**Vendor, Budget & Lifecycle Management -**
Manage vendor relationships, managed service providers, contracts, renewals, infrastructure purchasing, asset lifecycle planning, licensing coordination, budget inputs, and cost optimization opportunities. Evaluate solutions and service providers to ensure technical fit, reliability, security, scalability, and business value.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Other Duties as Assigned -**
Collaborate with business leaders, regional IT teams, project teams, Support, Applications, Security, and PMO stakeholders to align infrastructure priorities with organizational needs. Master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline required; equivalent combination of education, certifications, and progressive experience may be considered. 8-12 years of progressive infrastructure, systems engineering, cloud, network, or enterprise IT operations experience required, including 3-5 years of supervisory, technical leadership, or people management experience. Strong hands-on background with Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Intune, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Windows Server, VMware/vSphere, enterprise networking, endpoint management, backup/recovery technologies, monitoring platforms, scripting/automation, and hybrid cloud environments. Demonstrated experience leading incident/problem/change processes, infrastructure projects, lifecycle programs, disaster recovery planning, vendor coordination, documentation, and service improvement initiatives. Experience working with ITIL-based service management practices required; ITIL v4 Foundation preferred. Experience supporting ISO27001, NIST, CIS Controls or similar security/compliance frameworks preferred. Relevant Microsoft, Azure, networking, security, virtualization, or cloud certifications strongly preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical priorities, risks, and recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  
  
**About Us**
IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in technical consulting, architecture, engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, qualification, and validation services for technically complex facilities. title: Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**Join Tsaaro as a Cyber GRC & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Consultant**
**Drive Cyber Resilience. Build Trust. Deliver Impact.**
Are you passionate about helping organizations strengthen their cyber governance, manage third-party risks, and achieve compliance with global security standards?
  
  
At Tsaaro, we go beyond compliance, we help organizations build resilient governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) programs that enable secure business growth. We are looking for a Cyber GRC & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Consultant who thrives in consulting environments, enjoys solving complex security challenges, and can deliver practical, risk-based solutions to clients.
  
  
**About Tsaaro**
At Tsaaro, privacy and cybersecurity are at the heart of everything we do. Our team of privacy consultants and cybersecurity specialists collaborates to help organizations build robust governance frameworks, strengthen security programs, and manage evolving cyber risks.
  
  
Our consulting approach focuses on delivering practical, business-aligned solutions that help clients strengthen security posture, manage vendor risks, achieve compliance, and build long-term resilience.
  
  
**Your Role: Cyber GRC & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Consultant**
As a Consultant, you will work closely with clients to establish governance frameworks, assess cyber risks, conduct third-party risk assessments, and support compliance initiatives across multiple regulatory and industry standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct end-to-end Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments across vendors, suppliers, and service providers.
* Perform vendor security reviews, due diligence assessments, and security questionnaires.
* Evaluate third-party cybersecurity controls and identify risks, gaps, and mitigation strategies.
* Develop and implement Third-Party Risk Management frameworks, policies, and procedures.
* Support clients in implementing Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) programs aligned with business objectives.
* Perform cyber risk assessments, control maturity assessments, and compliance gap analyses.
* Assist clients in implementing and maintaining ISO 27001, ISO 27701, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and other security frameworks.
* Support audit readiness initiatives including internal audits, control testing, and evidence collection.
* Develop risk registers, risk treatment plans, and executive reports.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve governance processes and strengthen organizational cyber resilience.
* Contribute to cybersecurity consulting engagements involving policy development, control implementation, and regulatory compliance.
* Provide recommendations for continuous improvement in vendor risk governance and cybersecurity practices.

**Requirements**

* 2–4+ years of experience in Cyber GRC, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), Information Security, or Cybersecurity Consulting.
* Strong understanding of Third-Party Risk Management methodologies and vendor risk assessment processes.
* Hands-on experience conducting vendor security assessments and reviewing security controls.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 27701, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or similar security frameworks.
* Familiarity with governance, risk management, compliance processes, and cybersecurity regulations.
* Experience with risk assessments, audit support, policy development, and control implementation.
* Excellent analytical, documentation, stakeholder management, and client communication skills.
* Professional certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CRISC, CISA, CISM, Security+, or similar are preferred.
* A collaborative, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple client engagements.

**Benefits**
**Why Join Tsaaro?**

* Work with one of India's fastest-growing privacy and cybersecurity consulting firms.
* Gain exposure to global clients across diverse industries.
* Work on strategic Cyber GRC and Third-Party Risk Management engagements.
* Accelerate your career with mentorship and leadership opportunities.
* Hybrid work flexibility.
* Continuous learning support through certifications and professional development programs.

**From the Tsaaro Team**
*"At Tsaaro, we believe cybersecurity is built on strong governance, informed risk decisions, and trusted partnerships. If you're excited about helping organizations strengthen their cyber resilience while working on meaningful consulting engagements, we'd love to have you on our team."*
**Ready to Advance Your Cyber GRC Career?**
Apply now and become part of Tsaaro's mission to build secure, resilient, and compliant organizations.

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

**Process Overview\***

Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents

**Job Description\***

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to join the Cyber Security Operations team. This role will be responsible for understanding the enterprise DLP strategy, policy enforcement, threat detection, investigation, and response activities across on-premises, cloud, and endpoint environments.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in DLP technologies, information protection, insider risk management, cloud security, and detection engineering. In addition, the candidate should have hands-on experience leveraging AI/ML-driven security analytics, automation, and orchestration capabilities to improve detection accuracy, reduce operational overhead, and strengthen the bank's overall data protection posture.

As a senior member of the team, you will provide technical leadership, guide junior analysts, drive strategic security initiatives, enhance monitoring capabilities, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure protection of sensitive data across the enterprise

**Responsibilities\***

Data Loss Prevention & Information Protection

* Serve as the primary SME for enterprise DLP technologies, policies, controls, and monitoring capabilities.
* Design, implement, tune, and maintain DLP controls across endpoint, network, email, web, SaaS applications, and cloud environments.
* Lead investigations involving data exfiltration, insider threats, unauthorized disclosures, and policy violations.
* Develop and optimize detection use cases for sensitive data protection, insider risk monitoring, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Partner with business, technology, and risk teams to identify data protection risks and implement appropriate controls.
* Security Monitoring, Detection & Response
Operate within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (Detect Investigate Respond* Improve).
* Conduct advanced investigations utilizing SIEM, EDR/XDR, DLP, Cloud Security, Identity Security, and Threat Intelligence platforms.
* Analyze logs, events, and telemetry from multiple security sources to determine attack scope, root cause, business impact, and remediation requirements.
* Lead security incident response activities involving DLP violations, cloud security incidents, insider threats, and data exposure events.
* Develop and continuously improve detection content aligned with MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Cloud Security (AWS & Azure)
* Design and monitor DLP and data protection controls across multi-cloud environments including AWS and Microsoft Azure.
* Support implementation and management of cloud-native security solutions, including:
  + AWS GuardDuty
  + AWS Macie
  + AWS Security Hub
  + AWS CloudTrail
  + Microsoft Defender for Cloud
  + Microsoft Purview Information Protection & DLP
  + Microsoft Sentinel
  + Azure Monitor and Azure Security Center
* Investigate cloud-based threats involving sensitive data exposure, excessive permissions, misconfigurations, and unauthorized access.
* Develop cloud security monitoring and detection use cases to enhance visibility and protection across cloud workloads and SaaS platforms.

AI/ML-Driven DLP & Security Analytics

* Leverage Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities to improve DLP effectiveness, classification accuracy, insider risk detection, and threat identification.
* Develop and implement behavioral analytics and anomaly detection models for identifying malicious or accidental data leakage.
* Utilize Generative AI and advanced analytics capabilities to enhance incident triage, threat enrichment, investigation workflows, and response effectiveness.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into DLP monitoring, detection, and response processes.
* Measure and drive improvements in detection quality, false-positive reduction, and operational efficiency through AI-driven capabilities.

Security Automation & Orchestration

* Design and enhance automated response workflows using SOAR platforms.
* Develop scripting and API-based integrations to automate repetitive response and remediation tasks.
* Improve operational effectiveness by reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).
* Maintain automated playbooks and response mechanisms supporting DLP, cybersecurity, and cloud security operations.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior analysts and operational teams.
* Drive security process improvements and operational maturity initiatives.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting related to DLP effectiveness, incident response, and cloud security posture.
* Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and executive-level stakeholders.

**Requirements\***

**Education\*** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)

**Certifications If Any:** CEH, Cloud Certifications, Security+, CCNA or any equivalent

**Experience Range\*** 8-10+Years

**Foundational Skills\***

* 10 + years of experience in Information Security, Security Operations, DLP Operations, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, or related cybersecurity functions.
* Deep expertise in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and controls.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of:
* Microsoft Purview DLP
* Symantec DLP
* Forcepoint DLP
* Palo Alto Enterprise DLP
* Digital Guardian
* Strong understanding of data classification, information protection, insider risk, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience investigating and responding to DLP incidents across endpoint, network, email, cloud, and SaaS environments.
* Strong experience with SIEM and Security Analytics platforms:
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Splunk
* QRadar
* Elastic
* Proficiency in: KQL ,SQL ,Python and PowerShell
* Experience with SOAR platforms, automation, orchestration, and API integrations.
* Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and cyber adversary TTPs.
* Extensive hands-on experience securing and monitoring AWS and Azure environments.
* Experience with cloud-native security tools including AWS Macie, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience leveraging AI/ML capabilities for security analytics, user behavior analytics (UBA), anomaly detection, insider threat detection, or predictive risk analysis.
* Demonstrated track record of reducing alert noise, improving detection coverage, improving MTTR, and enhancing operational effectiveness.
* Promotes awareness of current and emerging cybersecurity threats and advises on potential information security exposure
* Assesses and mitigates cyber security risks related to application, network, infrastructure, and public cloud
* Interprets the information security requirements outlined in policies, standards, and procedures and reinforces requirements through education and awareness
* Supports teammates who serve as “security ambassadors” in order to help partners drive strategic and innovative risk mitigation priorities and navigate the GIS organization

**Desired Skills\***

* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels
* Experience implementing AI-driven DLP and Insider Risk Management programs.
* Experience with User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA).
* Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI security controls, and AI governance frameworks.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM).
* Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leading geographically distributed cybersecurity teams.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale digital transformation and cloud migration initiatives.

**Work Timings\*** 11:30am to 08:30pm IST

title: Technology Audit - Officer
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
The Technology Auditor position will be part of Corporate Audit’s Integrated Audit team, which is responsible for engagements that focus on business risk and related application technology. Team members work with business auditors to understand business risks and related application controls such as interface controls, logical access controls, and input/processing/output controls. The main objective of an integrated audit is to provide management with independent, objective assurance regarding the design and operating effectiveness of the system of internal controls to mitigate both business and IT-related risks. The audit follows a collaborative approach, with business and IT audit members jointly conducting the majority of internal and client-facing planning, control assessment, testing, and reporting activities.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, the firm rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. The regulators rely upon us to provide assurance that the bank operates in a manner that is compliant with key banking regulations to properly manage risks to the company and the global financial systems. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role, you will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For****

* Successfully participate in the planning, execution and completion of audits following a risk-based methodology in line with Division and Industry Standards as well as regulatory requirements.
* Support recommendations for internal control improvements and preparation of audit reports providing clear messages on key risks and key audit issues.
* Participate in the planning, assessment, testing and reporting phases of audits covering integrated IT audits with application controls, configuration, automated and reporting controls.
* Perform independent and objective assessments of risks and controls to improve risk management practices and assess controls for compliance with laws, regulations, company policies and business needs.
* Prepare or review documentation of audit work in adherence with the division’s risk-based audit methodology and industry standards
* Establish strong relationships within the Corporate Audit function.
* Develop a good understanding and knowledge base of the company’s operations and establish effective business relationships within the company
* Gain and apply a thorough understanding of audits and assigned functions, including utilization of technology and active usage of Data Analytics.
* Demonstrate, maintain and expand your knowledge of financial and operational internal control methodologies and terminologies (e.g. COSO, COBIT), industry standards, audit industry best practices, regulatory expectations, and risk management practices.

****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* High degree of professionalism, professional curiosity and skepticism, organizational, analytical and project management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal, presentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently in an international team across multiple locations with global stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to financial institutions and proven ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements.

title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Job Title: Linux Administrator (AWS Cloud Migration)**

**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid)**

**Shift Time: 2PM-11PM IST / 3PM-12AM IST**

**Key responsibilities**

**Discovery and planning**

* Inventory on-prem Linux servers (RHEL), applications, dependencies, storage and network flows using tools such as AWS Application Discovery Service or Migration Evaluator.
* Classify workloads by migration strategy (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire) and group them into migration waves.
* Define target-state designs: instance sizing, OS versions, EBS/EFS/FSx storage, VPC placement and security groups.

**Migration execution**

* Migrate servers with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), plus rsync, LVM snapshots or image-based methods where needed.
* Move file shares and data using AWS DataSync, Snowball or S3 transfer as appropriate.
* Upgrade or re-platform legacy OS versions (e.g., RHEL ) during migration.
* Plan and run cutovers, including DNS changes, rollback plans and post-migration validation with application owners.

**AWS Linux operations**

* Build, patch and maintain Linux on EC2 using AMIs, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command) and Auto Scaling.
* Manage users, sudo, SSH keys and directory integration (Active Directory / SSSD / AWS Managed Microsoft AD).
* Monitor health and performance with CloudWatch metrics, logs and alarms; tune kernel, memory, disk I/O and network settings.
* Set up backup and DR with AWS Backup, EBS snapshots and cross-region copies; test restores.

**Automation and infrastructure as code**

* Provision infrastructure with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate configuration and builds with Ansible, Bash and Python; build golden AMIs with EC2 Image Builder or Packer.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or CodePipeline) for infrastructure changes.

**Security and compliance**

* Apply CIS benchmarks and OS hardening; manage IAM roles and instance profiles on least privilege.
* Encrypt data at rest and in transit (KMS, TLS); manage secrets with Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.
* Support audits with evidence from CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub and Inspector.

**Hypercare and handover**

* Provide post-cutover support, resolve incidents and drive root-cause analysis.
* Write runbooks, architecture diagrams and SOPs; hand over to steady-state operations teams.
* Track cost and right-size instances using Cost Explorer and Compute Optimizer.

**Required qualifications**

* 6+ years administering enterprise Linux (RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) in production.
* 2+ years hands-on with AWS: EC2, VPC, EBS, EFS, S3, IAM, Route 53, ELB, CloudWatch and Systems Manager.
* Completed at least one on-prem to AWS migration, including server rehost with AWS MGN or an equivalent tool.
* Strong troubleshooting across boot, kernel, filesystems (LVM, XFS, ext4), networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalld/iptables) and performance.
* Scripting in Bash and Python; configuration management with Ansible.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of VMware or other on-prem virtualization as a migration source.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and change management (ITIL, ServiceNow or Jira).

**Preferred qualifications**

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Solutions Architect – Associate (Professional level a plus).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Engineer (RHCE).
* Familiarity with the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and the Well-Architected Framework.
* Exposure to containers (Docker, Amazon ECS or EKS) and serverless services.
* Experience migrating databases or middleware hosted on Linux (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Tomcat, JBoss, Apache, NGINX).
* Hybrid connectivity: Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway.
* Background in regulated environments (financial services, SOX, PCI DSS).
* Deliver runbooks and a clean handover to operations.

**Employee Benefits:**

* *Group Medical Insurance*
* *Cab facility*
* *Meals/snacks*

**Description**
The Lead Information Security Officer is a senior Information Security practitioner and people leader responsible for directing the day-to-day work and development of the global Information Security team.
  
  
Based in the Pune GCC centre and reporting to the Group Head of Cyber, the role will retain the core governance, risk, compliance, awareness and advisory responsibilities of the Group Information Security Officer while providing clear leadership, prioritisation, quality oversight and escalation support for the wider team. The role will help the business achieve its objectives safely through appropriate and proportionate controls, policies, standards and risk management practices, supported by clear executive and Board-level reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide line management, coaching, objective setting, performance support and professional development for the whole Information Security team, including colleagues working across locations and time zones.
* Plan, prioritise and allocate team activity, monitor delivery against agreed objectives and ensure consistent quality, service and governance standards.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Information Security risks, issues and incidents, escalating material matters to the Group Head of Cyber and supporting out-of-hours response where required.
* Lead the development, review and implementation of Information Security governance processes, policies, standards and control requirements in response to business change, emerging threats, legislation and regulation.
* Lead the Information Security risk management approach, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, recorded, treated, monitored and reported across the Group.
* Lead complex information security and third-party risk assessments, balancing technical, physical, procedural and people controls with business needs and risk appetite
* Lead the production of Information Security requirements for suppliers, business initiatives and compliance activities, working with the wider Governance, Risk and Compliance function to ensure risks are appropriately managed.
* Lead the Information Security training and awareness programme, ensuring colleagues understand their security responsibilities and how their work supports organisational objectives.
* Provide pragmatic Information Security advice and challenge to senior stakeholders, programmes, projects and operational teams, enabling secure business decisions.
* Own the production and quality assurance of monthly Information Security risk dashboards, KPI and KRI reporting, and executive and Board-level updates.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and customer assurance activities, ensuring evidence, remediation actions and responses are complete, accurate and timely.
* Support security incident response, lessons learned and control improvement activities, coordinating Information Security input with Cyber Security, Privacy, Data Governance, Technology and business teams.
* Promote effective collaboration across Cyber Security, Information Assurance, Privacy, Data Governance and the wider GRC function to maintain a cohesive approach to security risk management.
* Deputise for the Group Head of Cyber on Information Security matters where required.

**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**

* Minimum 10 years’ experience across Information Security, cyber security, governance, risk or compliance roles within large or complex organisations.
* Demonstrable experience leading and developing geographically distributed teams, including effective remote line management.
* Significant experience implementing and maintaining global Information Security and cyber risk frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Risk Management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Experience working in regulated sectors and engaging with senior management, auditors, regulators, customers and third parties.
* Strong working knowledge of Information Security governance, risk management, control design, policy management, security awareness and third-party assurance.
* Ability to translate complex security, regulatory and risk matters into clear, proportionate and actionable business advice.
* Excellent leadership, coaching, delegation, workload planning and team development capability.
* Ability to lead complex risk assessments and provide credible challenge to senior stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of global security regulations, recognised security frameworks and industry good practice.
* Experience producing meaningful executive and Board-level dashboards, metrics and risk reporting.
* Security incident response experience and an understanding of the interaction between governance, operational security and technology controls.
* Strong stakeholder and supplier relationship management skills across global and multicultural environments.
* Commercial awareness and the judgement to balance business enablement with appropriate protection of information and services.
* Excellent written and verbal communicator, able to adapt style for technical, non-technical and executive audiences.
* Proven people leader with a collaborative, service-led and accountable approach.
* Confident decision-maker who can prioritise competing demands and operate effectively under pressure.
* Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Pragmatic and proportionate risk mindset, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
* Experience working within highly regulated businesses.
* Flexible approach to working hours to support a global team and material security incidents when required.
* Commitment to continuous professional development and sharing good practice across the team.
* One or more relevant professional certifications, such as CISM, CISSP, CRISC or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, is highly desirable.
* Active membership of a recognised professional body, or equivalent evidence of continuing professional development, is desirable.

description:

* Drive secure access practices, access reviews, audit readiness, and lifecycle governance.

* Structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership.

* Scripting experience for macOS and Windows automation (e.g., Bash, zsh, Python, or PowerShell).
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading service or process improvement initiatives.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable automation and self-service outcomes.

**Global Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Staff**
The Okta Operations Staff is responsible for the management and operational integrity of the Okta Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform within the organization. This role involves ensuring the secure and efficient operation of Okta services, including user lifecycle management, application integration, access policies, and multi-factor authentication. The analyst will work closely with IT, security, and business teams to support and enhance the identity management infrastructure
  
  
**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**

* Provide L2 support for Okta-related issues, including troubleshooting user access problems, application integration issues, and system outages.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the Okta environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor Okta system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of Okta policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of Okta configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.

title: Senior Platform Architect-1
description:
**Our Purpose**

**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect-1
  
  
**Overview**
Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
  
  
This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
  
  
This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
  
  
Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
  
  
Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
  
  
Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
  
  
Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
  
  
Role
  
  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

**All About You**

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high-energy, proactive, detail-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

**Skills/Abilities**

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on-the-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: SLP Specialist, INSLP
description:
**Description**
INSLP (Security & Loss Prevention) is hiring an SLP Specialist to support growth of the “SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program” and help preventing losses via identification of abusive entity. The program is aimed at identifying and eliminating Concessions Abuse while preserving customer trust.
  
  
The primary objective of the SLP Specialist is to provide security services, investigation and asset protection in designated area of responsibility, assist in mitigating product loss, and maintain customer satisfaction in accordance with INSLP guidelines and policies. The role is cross-functional and requires deep collaboration and influencing ability with stakeholders from business and corporate functions. SLP Specialist's day-to-day activities involve planning, organizing, coordinating, implementing and executing process and procedures laid down by the organization and the SLP function.
  
  
As a part of the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse program, the SLP Specialist is required to deep dive into the Concessions request raised by customer, and conduct end-to-end investigation across customer, DA/network and seller to identify the abusive entity. SLP has outlined frameworks for investigation, and the SLP Specialist is bound to adhere to the investigation guidelines. Along with primarily supporting on Concessions investigations, the SLP Specialist will be required to provide on-ground intel useful in uncovering abuse MOs. In order to ensure network integrity, the SLP Specialist will be required to conduct risk assessment and process audit for the respective sites and work in accordance with the security policies and guidelines.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Security Operation
  
  

* Implementation and follow-up of Loss Prevention Plan in MDR Concessions

Audits and Compliance
  
  

* Conducting SLP audits and implementing SOPs
* Surprise check and reports at LM (Last Mile) stations
* Keeping the plans and SOPs updated
* Periodical check of documentation
* Adhering to SLAs defined for the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program

Process Improvement and Loss Prevention
  
  

* Process review, gap analysis and implementation of necessary improvements
* Weekly, monthly and quarterly assessments
* Loss prevention reporting
* Working on feedbacks received from internal and external stakeholders
* Follow up and completion of CAPA
* Recommending loss prevention initiatives based on on-ground intel

Loss Prevention Analysis and Investigation
  
  

* Work closely with the SLP and CS teams to analyze the loss trends in MDR Concessions
* Weekly loss trend analysis, identifying defects / abusive entities and working towards loss reduction
* Conduct investigations by working closely with CS and support functions in SLP and Ops
* Meeting the weekly investigation targets and submitting investigation reports
* Sharing RCAs and PTG initiatives on shrink and unmet goals

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Knowledge of Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Learning & Development and course facilitation or an equivalent professional qualification

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Tech Consultant - Qlik Cloud Administrator
description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:**
395026
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Tech Consultant - Qlik Cloud Administrator to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Title:**
Tech Consultant – Qlik Cloud Administrator
  
  
**Overall Experience:**
7–10 Years
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Qlik Cloud Administrator**
with strong hands-on expertise in
**Qlik Cloud tenant administration, platform management, security, user access, monitoring, and governance**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for the administration and operational management of enterprise Qlik Cloud environments, ensuring platform availability, security, performance, and compliance. The role requires close collaboration with BI developers, Data Engineers, infrastructure, security, and business teams to provide a stable and well-governed analytics platform.
  
  
**Day To Day Job Duties**

* Administer and manage enterprise Qlik Cloud tenants and associated platform services.
* Manage users, groups, roles, permissions, spaces, and access controls within Qlik Cloud.
* Configure and maintain Qlik Cloud tenant settings, security policies, and governance standards.
* Manage Shared, Managed, and Personal Spaces and associated access permissions.
* Monitor platform health, utilization, application activity, and operational performance.
* Manage application publishing, reload schedules, tasks, and data refresh processes.
* Troubleshoot Qlik Cloud application, reload, connectivity, authentication, and access-related issues.
* Configure and maintain connections between Qlik Cloud and enterprise data sources.
* Support identity and authentication integrations, including SSO and enterprise identity providers.
* Monitor licenses, user allocations, capacity, and platform consumption.
* Support Qlik application deployments and promotion across development, testing, and production environments.
* Collaborate with Qlik Developers and Data Engineering teams to troubleshoot data connectivity and platform issues.
* Maintain platform documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Support platform upgrades, changes, security reviews, audits, and compliance activities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement of Qlik Cloud administration and operational processes.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Qlik platform administration, or enterprise analytics environments.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Qlik Sense/Qlik platform administration and support.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Qlik Cloud Tenant Administration, security, user/access management, and platform operations.
* 3+ years of experience with Qlik application deployments, data connections, reload management, monitoring, and production support.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Platform: Qlik Cloud, Qlik Sense
* Administration: Tenant Administration, User & Role Management, Space Management
* Security: Access Control, SSO, Identity Management, Permissions
* Operations: Monitoring, Reload Management, Scheduling, Troubleshooting
* Governance: Platform Governance, Audit, Security & Compliance
* Data Connectivity: SQL Databases, Cloud/Data Platform Connections
* Development Support: Application Publishing, Deployment & Environment Management
* Automation: Qlik APIs/Scripting and administrative automation
* Support: Incident Management, RCA, Problem & Change Management

**Nice to Have**

* Experience migrating Qlik Sense Enterprise on Windows to Qlik Cloud.
* Experience with Qlik Application Automation.
* Knowledge of Qlik Cloud APIs and administrative automation.
* Experience with Section Access and enterprise security models.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), SAML, OAuth, or other identity technologies.
* Knowledge of Qlik data gateways and hybrid/cloud data connectivity.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or other modern data platforms.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ITSM tools.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments and handling critical incidents.
* Understanding of ITIL, change management, and release management processes.
* Qlik certification is preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Cyber Security Trainer
description:
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Cyber Security Trainer to deliver industry-oriented training in CEH, WAPT, SOC, and CHFI. The candidate should have strong technical expertise, practical lab experience, and the ability to train students and working professionals using real-world scenarios and hands-on exercises.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver theoretical and practical training in CEH, WAPT, SOC, and CHFI.
* Conduct hands-on sessions using industry-standard cybersecurity tools and lab environments.
* Demonstrate ethical hacking techniques, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing methodologies.
* Train students in Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, SIEM tools, threat detection, and incident response.
* Teach digital forensics, evidence collection, malware analysis fundamentals, and cybercrime investigation techniques.
* Develop training materials, practical assignments, projects, and lab exercises.
* Conduct assessments, evaluate student performance, and provide technical guidance.
* Prepare students for cybersecurity certifications, technical interviews, and industry requirements.
* Stay updated with emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies.

**Technical Skills Required**

* CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker
* Ethical hacking methodologies and penetration testing fundamentals
* Network scanning, enumeration, and vulnerability assessment
* Tools: Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, Burp Suite
* Web application and network security fundamentals
* WAPT – Web Application Penetration Testing
* OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
* SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, and authentication flaws
* Manual and automated web application testing
* Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap
* Vulnerability identification, exploitation in authorized labs, and report writing
* SOC – Security Operations Center
* Security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response
* SIEM tools such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or QRadar
* Log analysis, alert triage, and threat hunting
* MITRE ATT&CK framework and security incident handling
* Basic malware analysis and endpoint security monitoring
* CHFI – Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator
* Digital forensics and cybercrime investigation
* Disk, file system, and memory forensics fundamentals
* Evidence acquisition, preservation, and chain of custody
* Log analysis and forensic reporting
* Tools such as Autopsy, FTK, and Wireshark

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on knowledge of cybersecurity tools and technologies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.
* Ability to explain complex security concepts through practical demonstrations.
* Experience in conducting lab sessions and real-world scenario-based exercises.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CEH, CHFI, Security+, or other recognized cybersecurity credentials.
* Experience in cybersecurity training, penetration testing, SOC operations, or digital forensics.
* Practical experience with enterprise security tools and security lab environments.

**Interested candidates can share their CV at: careers@sevenmentor.com**

title: Cloud Monitoring Administrator
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**What you'll do:**
**Cloud Monitoring Administrator**
in the
**Enterprise**
will…
  
  
We are hiring an Associate to administer our SolarWinds platform and monitor Windows, Linux, network and application infrastructure. You will build and tune monitoring, act first on alerts, and log in to servers to investigate and resolve issues before they affect users.
  
  
**SolarWinds administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade and maintain SolarWinds Orion / Hybrid Cloud Observability modules (NPM, SAM, SCM, NTA, NCM, WPM, Log Analyzer).
* Add and manage nodes, interfaces, volumes and application templates; discover new devices via Network Sonar.
* Create and tune alerts, thresholds, dependencies and escalation rules to reduce noise and false positives.
* Build custom dashboards, views and scheduled reports for operations and management.
* Manage polling engines, agents (agent-based and agentless), WMI/SNMP credentials and platform health.
* Perform routine maintenance: database cleanup, license tracking, certificate and service checks, backups.

**Infrastructure monitoring**

* Monitor Windows and Linux servers for CPU, memory, disk, services, processes and event logs.
* Monitor applications such as IIS, SQL Server, Apache/Tomcat, Active Directory, Exchange and custom services.
* Monitor network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless controllers) for availability, interface utilization, bandwidth, errors and latency.
* Respond to alerts 24x7 in shifts, triage incidents, and escalate to L2/L3 or application teams with clear diagnostics.
* Onboard new servers and applications into monitoring as per the change process.

**Hands-on server work**

* Log in to Windows servers (RDP) and Linux servers (SSH) to validate alerts and perform first-level troubleshooting.
* Check and restart services, review logs, clear disk space, and verify connectivity (ping, traceroute, telnet, nslookup).
* Install and troubleshoot SolarWinds agents, SNMP and WMI configuration on servers.

**Process and documentation**

* Create and update tickets in ITSM tools (ServiceNow or Jira) within SLA.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks and monitoring inventory; share shift handovers and daily health reports.
* Support audits, patching windows and maintenance mode scheduling.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience as a SolarWinds administrator.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools, such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SCOM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk or Grafana/Prometheus.
* Proven experience monitoring Windows servers, Linux servers, network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) and business applications.
* Hands-on server experience: has logged in to servers via RDP and SSH and performed basic tasks independently.
* Basic Windows Server administration: services, Event Viewer, Task Manager, disk management, IIS basics, user and permission checks.
* Basic Linux administration: common commands (top, df, du, free, ps, grep, systemctl, journalctl), file permissions and log navigation.
* Understanding of SNMP, WMI, ICMP and agent-based polling, plus networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls).
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, change and problem processes and an ITSM ticketing tool.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends when rostered.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
  
  
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
  
  
To complete your application:
  
  
Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.
  
  
NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.
  
  
Find Out More At:
  
  
www.zs.com

title: Senior Platform Architect-2
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect-2
  
  
**Overview**
Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
  
  
This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
  
  
This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
  
  
Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
  
  
Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
  
  
Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
  
  
Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
  
  
Role
  
  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

**All About You**

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high-energy, proactive, detail-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

**Skills/Abilities**

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on-the-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Finance
description:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.

With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.

### **About the role**

Perforce Software is looking to build a finance production team in India to run recurring finance work: commissions, expense reporting, and central finance reporting. The Center Leader is the first hire and would be the on-site owner of that team. There may be an opportunity to scale a team, set up how it works, and lead global processes in a controlled, well-documented way.

### **What you will do:**

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*
