title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!  
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

**Cybersecurity Analyst**

**Location:** Remote – Anywhere in India

**Work Schedule:** Monday to Friday

**Work Arrangement:** Fully Remote

**Experience:** 5-8 Years

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Information Security Analyst with 3–5 years of experience across security operations, vulnerability management, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with security monitoring tools, incident response, and security frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II and NIST CSF.

This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates based anywhere in India, with a Monday-to-Friday work schedule. The role involves strengthening the organization's security posture, supporting compliance initiatives, identifying and mitigating security risks, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement effective security practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Security Operations & Tooling**

* Monitor, tune, and triage security alerts across SIEM platforms, escalating confirmed incidents in accordance with established procedures and runbooks.
* Manage the vulnerability management lifecycle, including scanning, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and management reporting.
* Support endpoint security, email security, and network monitoring tools, identifying security gaps and recommending configuration improvements.
* Conduct periodic threat-hunting activities and contribute to the development and enhancement of detection rules and incident response playbooks.
* Participate in incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews.

**2. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)**

* Support ongoing SOC 2 Type II compliance activities, including evidence collection, control testing, documentation, and coordination with external auditors.
* Assist with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF) assessments by mapping existing controls to framework requirements, identifying gaps, and supporting remediation efforts.
* Maintain and update information security policies, standards, and procedures in collaboration with senior team members.
* Conduct periodic security risk assessments and document findings in the organization's risk register.
* Track identified risks, control deficiencies, and remediation actions through to closure.

**3. Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate with IT, Engineering, and business stakeholders to integrate security best practices into day-to-day operations.
* Support security awareness initiatives and provide guidance to employees on information security policies and practices.
* Prepare clear and concise reports on security metrics, vulnerability status, risk remediation, and compliance posture for management.
* Communicate technical findings, security risks, and recommended corrective actions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of experience in information security, with exposure to both technical security operations and compliance functions.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent solutions.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management tools such as Tenable Nessus, Tenable.io, or Qualys.
* Understanding of SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Familiarity with common cyberattack techniques, threat detection methods, and defensive security controls. Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, CEH, CISM, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 audits from preparation and evidence collection through audit completion.
* Scripting or automation experience using Python or PowerShell for security tooling, analysis, and reporting.
* Exposure to cloud security environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, ServiceNow GRC, Drata, or Vanta.

title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Support the full application and infrastructure stack to ensure the CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service remains highly available, secure, performant, and reliable.
* Design, implement, and maintain observability, monitoring, and synthetic testing to detect issues early and validate service behavior end-to-end.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide timely incident response through PagerDuty and related operational processes.
* Lead or support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.
* Define, track, and continuously improve SLOs/SLIs to align platform reliability with business expectations.
* Produce clear and actionable monthly operations reports summarizing service health, trends, incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Leverage Datadog to analyze logs, create and maintain monitoring metrics, and configure dashboards and alerts that support CloudOps activities and platform reliability.
* Analyze operational data and platform metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for automation or optimization.
* Design, build, and maintain automation and internal tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the CloudOps environment.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain application and platform layers of the service, ensuring changes are implemented safely and in accordance with standards.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders to review designs, provide feedback, and help shape scalable and resilient solutions.
* Review peer code and infrastructure changes to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance with team standards and best practices.
* Develop, test, and document automation and platform components, including runbooks and operational procedures, to support long-term maintainability and operational readiness.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms

+ Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
+ Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
+ Experience with orchestration toolsets.

* Operations

+ Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
+ Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
+ Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
+ Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

* Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture

+ Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
+ Experience with security-relevant protocols

* OS

+ Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

* Security

+ Conscious of security concerns
+ Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

* Automation

+ Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
+ Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
+ Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

* Public and Private Cloud

+ Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
+ Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

* Interaction & Communication

+ Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
+ Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
+ Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands-on” role: you will write security-centric code, conduct deep-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
  
  
Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
  
  
Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
  
  
Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  
  
Identity/Auth: Expert-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 10+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
  
  
Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
  
  
Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  
  
Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non-technical leadership.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Secure Architecture & Threat Modeling

Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
  
  
Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
  
  
Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
  
  
  

* Offensive Security & Exploitation

In-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
  
  
Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
  
  
Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high-severity fixes.
  
  
  

* Secure Coding & SDLC Integration

Secure Code Review: Review high-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
  
  
Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

Job Description: Active Directory & PKI (Certificate Management) Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary -**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Active Directory & PKI Engineer to manage and support the organization's On-Premises Active Directory (AD), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), and Certificate Management infrastructure. The role is responsible for maintaining AD services, managing the certificate lifecycle, administering PKI components, remediating security vulnerabilities, and ensuring the availability, security, and compliance of identity and certificate services.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Active Directory Administration, PKI/Certificate Management, Windows Server Infrastructure, DNS, Group Policy, and IT Service Management processes.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Active Directory Administration
  
  

* Administer and maintain On-Premises Active Directory infrastructure.
* Manage Active Directory users, groups, organizational units (OUs), and delegation models.
* Support and maintain Domain Controllers across multiple environments.
* Administer Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and troubleshoot Group Policy-related issues.
* Manage AD replication, site topology, DNS integration, and authentication services.
* Perform health checks and proactive monitoring of Active Directory services.
* Support Azure AD / Entra ID Connect synchronization and related services.
* Troubleshoot Active Directory, DNS, authentication, Kerberos, LDAP, and replication issues.

PKI & Certificate Services Administration-
  
  

* Manage Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
* Administer and maintain the enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
* Manage Certificate Authorities (CA), subordinate CAs, and certificate-related services.
* Ensure high availability and operational health of PKI infrastructure.
* Perform PKI component and service certificate renewals.

Certificate Lifecycle Management-
  
  

* Manage the end-to-end certificate lifecycle, including:
* Certificate issuance
* Renewal
* Revocation
* Replacement
* Expiry management
* Process certificate requests and approvals.
* Troubleshoot certificate enrollment and authentication issues.
* Ensure timely renewal of certificates to prevent service impact.

Certificate Template Management-
  
  

* Create, modify, and maintain Certificate Authority (CA) templates.
* Manage certificate enrollment and auto-enrollment policies.
* Support certificate template design and implementation based on business and security requirements.
* Ensure compliance with PKI standards and security policies.

Security & Vulnerability Management-
  
  

* Remediate vulnerabilities identified on:
* Domain Controllers
* Azure AD / Entra ID Connect Servers
* DNS Servers
* Certificate Servers
* Perform AD and PKI security hardening activities.
* Support security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities.
* Implement industry best practices for identity and certificate security.

Incident, Change & Problem Management-
  
  

* Manage Incident, Change Request (CR), Service Request, and Problem Management activities.
* Process operational alerts and support requests within SLA targets.
* Perform queue management and ticket prioritization.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, security, and application teams during incident resolution and change implementations.

Monitoring & Operational Support-
  
  

* Monitor Active Directory and PKI infrastructure health.
* Provide Event ID analysis and troubleshooting support to monitoring teams.
* Respond to service degradation and infrastructure alerts.
* Support end users and application teams for authentication and certificate-related issues.

Reporting & Service Improvement-
  
  

* Generate weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Track service metrics, incidents, vulnerabilities, and certificate renewals.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend improvements.
* Participate in continuous service improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Management-
  
  

* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, technical documents, and operational procedures.
* Ensure Active Directory and PKI configurations are properly documented.
* Develop knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Support knowledge transfer and operational readiness activities.

**Staff – AI Third Party Risk Analyst (Third Party Security Assessment)**
**Experience: 1–4 Years**
**Role Summary**
The AI Third Party Risk Analyst is an entry-level role responsible for supporting the execution of Third-Party Security Assessments (TPSA) and Vendor Due Diligence processes. The analyst works within the Cyber Risk and Compliance team, applying foundational knowledge of third-party risk management (TPRM) frameworks, supply chain security principles, AI security for third parties and use of AI-enabled tools for Third Party Security Assessment. This role provides exposure to third party risk management lifecycle, onboarding assessment, and AI-assisted assessment & monitoring capabilities while building core competencies in cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and data-driven risk evaluation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end Third-Party Security Assessment (TPSA) activities including vendor intake, initial risk screening, assessor evaluation against industry specific standards/regulations and documentation of assessment findings.
* Assist in conducting vendor due diligence reviews by collecting, reviewing, and validating vendor-provided security evidence and questionnaire responses.
* Evaluate AI security practices of third parties wherever applicable.
* Participate in the risk assessment lifecycle from vendor onboarding through ongoing monitoring, escalation, and offboarding.
* Maintain and update TPRM risk registers, risk logs, and vendor risk profiles in GRC tools or risk management platforms.
* Support supply chain risk identification activities by flagging vendors with elevated exposure across IT, cloud, and operational domains.

* Use and implement AI-enabled solutions for automated questionnaire/evidence analysis, gap identification, issue description and identification of risk treatment plans to accelerate risk evaluation.
* Track vendor remediation progress against identified control gaps and support follow-up activities.
* Maintain compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2 and more), and sector-specific requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of TPRM workflows, templates, and assessment methodologies.

**Education / Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technology, Business, Risk Management, or related discipline.
* Relevant certifications are advantageous (e.g., CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 , ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, other TPRM certifications).

**AI & Cyber Certifications**
**Cyber Security Certifications (Required / Advantageous):**

* CompTIA Security+ – Foundational cybersecurity knowledge covering threats, vulnerabilities, and risk management.

**AI & Data Certifications:**

* Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) – Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts on cloud platforms.
* Google Cloud Digital Leader – Awareness of AI and cloud services applicable to risk assessment contexts.
* IBM AI Foundations for Business – Introduction to AI concepts including machine learning and automation.
* Coursera / edX AI for Everyone (Andrew Ng) – Broad awareness of AI applications in business and risk management.

**Skills & Experience**
**Required Skills:**

* 0–4 years of experience in cyber risk, third-party risk, information security, or related field.
* Basic understanding of Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) frameworks and vendor assessment processes.
* Familiarity with risk assessment lifecycle stages: identification, evaluation, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, and CIS Controls.
* Knowledge of AI governance standards as ISO 42001. Understanding of AI security, especially in context of third-party security.
* Understanding of supply chain risk concepts including vendor tiering and dependency mapping.
* Ability to review and validate vendor security questionnaires (e.g., SIG, CAIQ, custom questionnaires).
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for risk tracking and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and written communication skills.

**Good to Have Skills (including AI):**

* Exposure to GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, ProcessUnity) for risk tracking.
* Awareness of AI-enabled risk scoring tools and automated vendor intelligence platforms (e.g., BitSight, Security Scorecard, RiskRecon).
* Basic understanding of predictive modelling concepts applied to vendor risk prioritization.
* Familiarity with AI-driven questionnaire automation and NLP-based document analysis tools.
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as Excel Power Query, Power BI, or similar for risk dashboards.
* Interest in emerging AI technologies including machine learning applications in cyber risk management.
* Awareness of Graph AI concepts for mapping vendor relationships and supply chain dependencies.

**AI Tools Skillset**
**Vendor Risk & Scoring Tools:**

* BitSight / Security Scorecard / RiskRecon – Awareness and basic navigation for vendor cyber ratings and continuous monitoring signals.
* GRC Tools – Familiarity with vendor risk management workflow tools for questionnaire tracking and risk registers.

**GRC & Automation Platforms:**

* ServiceNow GRC – Basic usage for risk logging, vendor profiles, and assessment task management.
* Microsoft Power Automate – Introductory exposure to workflow automation for risk data collection and notifications.

**Data Analytics & Reporting:**

* Microsoft Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables) – Risk data aggregation, vendor scoring worksheets, and basic dashboard creation.
* Microsoft Power BI – Consuming pre-built risk dashboards and understanding risk KPIs.

**AI Awareness Tools:**

* ChatGPT / Microsoft Copilot – Basic use for summarizing vendor documentation, drafting risk findings, and accelerating report writing.
* Bing AI / Google Gemini – Research assistance for vendor background checks and regulatory lookups.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Deliver assigned modules with quality and timeliness.
* Collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrate learning agility in AI and cyber risk domains.
* Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives.
* Show curiosity and proactively develop skills in AI-enabled risk management.
* Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive vendor information.

description:

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.

**Observability & Self-Healing:**
Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience.
  
  
**Performance & Operations:**
Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Architecture:**
Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:**
Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.
  
  
**Documentation & Enablement:**
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.
  
  
**Automation Culture:**
Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.

in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.

designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks.

across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation.

title: Industrial Cybersecurity Expert
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
  
  
As an
**Industrial Cybersecurity Expert (f/m/d)**
, you will play a key role in strengthening cybersecurity across manufacturing and operational technology (OT) environments. Working within a global network of factories, engineering teams, and cybersecurity professionals, you will provide expert guidance on securing manufacturing infrastructure, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity standards, and driving the implementation of secure-by-design principles across industrial systems.
  
  
You will collaborate with stakeholders from multiple countries, support cybersecurity initiatives within production environments, and help shape secure IT/OT architectures that enable reliable and resilient manufacturing operations.
  
  
How You’ll Make an Impact
  
  

* Define and drive secure manufacturing principles across IT and OT environments.
* Support the development and implementation of secure manufacturing infrastructure and connected factory solutions.
* Translate corporate IT/OT governance policies, security controls, and standards into practical implementation measures for manufacturing environments.
* Identify and define cybersecurity requirements and demands from factory and production stakeholders.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee configuration baselines and hardening guidelines for Siemens Energy products, third-party components, and manufacturing equipment.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders including Grid Technology Industrial Cybersecurity (GT ICS), Siemens Energy Cybersecurity & IT organizations, Digitalization GPO, and other relevant functions to ensure adequate protection of manufacturing, production, and engineering environments.
* Guide engineering, manufacturing, and project teams on cybersecurity best practices throughout development and operational lifecycles.
* Review and contribute to technical documentation including requirements specifications, architecture and design documents, implementation guidelines, testing procedures, and user documentation.
* Support risk assessments, threat analyses, vulnerability management, and incident handling activities related to manufacturing environments.
* Act as a trusted advisor to project teams and factory organizations on industrial cybersecurity matters.

What You Bring
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent professional experience in Industrial Cybersecurity, IT Security, or Operational Technology Security will also be considered.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong understanding of manufacturing infrastructure and IT/OT security technologies.
* Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Connected Factory concepts, industrial control systems, sensors, and OT hardware.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity architectures, risk management frameworks, and threat modeling methodologies.
* Experience conducting Threat and Risk Assessments (TRA) and applying risk-based security approaches.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management and cybersecurity incident response processes.
* Understanding of international standards, regulations, and legal requirements related to IT and OT security.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, including shopfloor personnel.
* Solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivering business value.
* Experience working in global and multicultural environments.

Siemens Energy offers an industry-leading portfolio covering HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high-voltage equipment, transformers, and digital grid technologies that support the energy systems of the future.
  
  
Who is Siemens Energy?

title: Senior IAM Engineer
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.
  
  
What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment.
  
  
**Role Description**

You will work across IAM infrastructure, authentication platforms, and supporting services to build secure, scalable, and reliable identity solutions. The role requires hands-on engineering capability combined with platform ownership, ensuring IAM services are secure, reliable, and continuously improved through automation and DevOps practices.

**Principal Accountabilities**
**IAM Platform Engineering**

* Design, implement, and maintain secure IAM solutions supporting both Customer IAM and Workforce IAM.

* Develop and maintain authentication and authorisation integrations across internal systems and customer-facing platforms.
* Ensure IAM solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with modern engineering practices.

**Identity Architecture & Integration**

* Design and support API-driven identity integrations across internal services and external platforms.

**DevOps & Platform Support**

* Build and operate IAM platforms using DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices, enabling automated deployment, configuration, and scaling.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain visibility and operational health of IAM systems.
* Participate in incident response and troubleshooting for IAM-related issues, providing Tier-3 support where necessary.
* Continuously improve the automation, deployment, and operational management of IAM infrastructure.

**Identity Governance & Security**

* Work with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to support identity governance and access control processes.
* Contribute to IAM standards, policies, and best practices across the organisation.
* Support initiatives related to access controls, identity lifecycle management, and audit requirements.
* Help ensure identity solutions align with regulatory expectations and internal security frameworks.

**Collaboration & Enablement**

* Partner with Engineering, Platform, and Product teams to ensure IAM capabilities support new systems and services.
* Provide guidance and education to teams integrating with IAM platforms.
* Document architecture, integrations, and operational procedures to ensure knowledge sharing across teams.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of IAM tooling, processes, and engineering practices.

**Core Experience**
**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* Strong experience working in Identity and Access Management, including both Customer IAM and Workforce IAM.
* Strong hands-on experience with the Ping Identity platform, particularly PingDirectory and PingFederate, including configuration, integration, and operational support in production environments.
* Experience integrating IAM capabilities into distributed systems, enterprise applications, and customer-facing digital platforms.
* Strong understanding of authentication and authorisation standards, including SAML, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
* Experience working with Active Directory and Azure Active Directory or comparable identity platforms.

**Engineering & Technical Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an engineering-led approach to troubleshooting and system design.
* Experience integrating IAM platforms with applications and services.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and operational support for critical systems.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, platform, security, and product teams.
* Ability to explain identity concepts and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a high-growth engineering environment with evolving platforms and requirements.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience with PingOne MFA or other modern multi-factor authentication platforms.
* Exposure to Privileged Access Management (PAM) technologies.
* Experience working in regulated environments, particularly financial services.
* Experience contributing to secure system design and threat modelling.

**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

title: Cloud Ops Engineer
description:

The Mobility Division within S&P Global uses technology and data science to deliver insights, forecasts, and advisory services across the automotive value chain. title: Risk & Loss Prevention - Manager
description:
**Role:**
Risk and Loss Prevention
  
  
**Level:**
Manager
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Vice President – Risk and Loss Prevention
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon
  
  
**About The Function**
The Risk & Loss Prevention function at MakeMyTrip protects customer and company value by identifying risks, strengthening controls, and preventing avoidable losses. The team works closely with business, finance, product, and technology teams to address emerging issues and support sound decisions.
  
  
**About The Role**
The incumbent will conduct risk-based assessments of end-to-end business processes across the MakeMyTrip Group. The role involves identifying financial, operational, and fraud risks; evaluating whether controls are well designed and working effectively; quantifying potential exposure where feasible; and recommending practical improvements.
  
  
The scope covers customer funds and benefits, gift cards and wallets, discounts and vouchers, B2B businesses, air and hotel operations, payments and reconciliations, supplier onboarding, claims, refunds, financial reporting, and application access and change controls.
  
  
**What Will You Be Doing**
**Risk-Based Process Assessments**

* Plan and conduct risk-based walkthroughs of end-to-end business processes.
* Identify financial, operational, and fraud risks across customer, supplier, and internal journeys.
* Maintain risk-control matrices and document process flows, controls, and supporting evidence.

**Control Testing and Exposure Assessment**

* Assess the design and operating effectiveness of preventive and detective controls.
* Review controls related to reconciliations, refunds, settlements, customer benefits, discounts, and financial reporting.
* Identify control gaps and potential financial leakage, validating and quantifying exposure where feasible.
* Assess relevant ICFR/SOX coverage, application access controls, and change controls.

**Findings, Remediation, and Reporting**

* Analyse root causes and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
* Agree on remediation plans with process owners and track closure against supporting evidence.
* Present assessment results and exposure estimates to Risk & Loss Prevention leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with business, finance, product, and technology teams to validate findings.
* Partner with stakeholders to strengthen controls while considering the customer journey.

**Qualification & Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in risk assessment, internal controls, process assurance, internal audit, or operational risk.
* CA, CIA, CISA, MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification.
* Strong understanding of business processes, financial controls, reconciliations, refunds, settlements, and accounting.
* Experience conducting process walkthroughs, developing risk-control matrices, testing controls, analysing root causes, and tracking remediation.

description:
Blink Charging Co. (Nasdaq: BLNK) is a leading owner, operator, and provider of electric vehicle (EV) charging equipment and networked EV charging services. We're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles by deploying thousands of charging stations across the United States and around the world.

**What We Do:**

Blink offers both residential and commercial EV charging equipment and connectivity to the Blink Network—a comprehensive cloud-based software that operates, manages, and tracks our EV charging stations and payment processing. Our charging solutions serve a diverse range of customers including multi-family residential and commercial properties, airports, colleges, municipalities, parking garages, shopping malls, retail parking, and more.

**Why Blink:**

* **Industry Leader:** We're at the forefront of the EV charging revolution, building critical infrastructure for a sustainable future
* **Innovation-Driven:** We continuously develop cutting-edge technology to improve the EV charging experience
* **Growth Opportunity:** Join a rapidly expanding company in one of the world's fastest-growing industries
* **Mission That Matters:** Every day, we're helping reduce carbon emissions and create a cleaner planet

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Enterprise Applications Support Specialist serves as a primary technical enabler and troubleshooter across Blink Charging’s enterprise applications ecosystem. The role supports NetSuite and Salesforce as primary platforms, with additional support for Ramp, Jira, and Confluence. This position partners with Enterprise Application Leads to deliver enhancements, train users, resolve issues, support releases, and maintain reliable day-to-day operations.

**Here’s What You’ll Do**
=========================

**Feature Enablement and Implementation**
-----------------------------------------

* Partner with Application Leads to design, test, and implement new features and enhancements.
* Develop user materials, deliver training, and support adoption of new capabilities and processes.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing and conduct thorough sandbox validation before production rollout.
* Support cutover, data migration, go-live, and post-implementation activities.
* Create and maintain implementation documentation, guides, FAQs, and knowledge content in Confluence.
* Gather user feedback and communicate improvement opportunities to Application Leads.

**Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution**
----------------------------------------

* Diagnose and resolve application, configuration, permission, data, workflow, and integration issues across supported systems.
* Perform root cause analysis and document clear findings, resolutions, and prevention recommendations.
* Troubleshoot cross-platform integration failures, including NetSuite-to-Salesforce and Ramp-to-NetSuite data flows.
* Escalate complex issues with complete analysis, evidence, business impact, and recommended next steps.
* Monitor logs, performance, data syncs, and system health to identify issues before they affect users.

**System Maintenance and Operational Support**
----------------------------------------------

* Manage routine administration, including user access, roles, permissions, onboarding, and offboarding.
* Perform recurring maintenance, data cleanup, report updates, documentation, and runbook upkeep.
* Audit access controls and support adherence to data governance and security policies.
* Monitor integrations and support critical business cycles such as month-end close, quarterly reporting, and annual reconciliation.
* Track application performance and adoption indicators and recommend practical improvements.

**Cross-Application Collaboration and Discovery**
-------------------------------------------------

* Support enterprise application integrations and data flows across the technology ecosystem.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements based on user feedback, issue patterns, and operational observations.
* Share knowledge with support and delivery teams and contribute to a reusable knowledge base.

**What You Bring to the Table**
===============================

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* 4-6+ years in enterprise application support, administration, or technical analyst roles.
* Hands-on support experience with at least two enterprise applications, including ERP, CRM, or related business systems.
* Experience with configuration, workflows, custom fields, permissions, user administration, testing, and release support.
* Basic to intermediate SQL and data querying skills, with the ability to interpret logs and error messages.
* Experience using ticketing, documentation, and knowledge management tools.
* Understanding of application integrations, role-based security, data flows, and common business processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and expense management.

**Application Knowledge**
-------------------------

* Primary platforms: NetSuite financials, order management, fixed assets, multi-subsidiary management, and workflows; Salesforce Sales Cloud, customer and opportunity management, integrations, and reporting.
* Secondary platforms: Ramp expense and approval workflows; Jira project and issue tracking; Confluence documentation and knowledge management.
* Ability to learn new application features independently and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Proactive ownership and self-directed learning
* Methodical troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences
* Patience, professionalism, and service orientation
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation
* Prioritization across concurrent incidents, requests, and projects
* Collaboration with Application Leads and business teams

**Work Location**

India (fully remote or hybrid)

**Employment Type**

Full-time

**Level**

Mid-Level (4-6+ years in enterprise application support or administration)

**Working Hours**

Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus
* Comprehensive benefits, including health and retirement programs
* Opportunity to work with a global team on high-impact enterprise technology initiatives
* Professional development and support

title: Head - GRC
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an experienced governance, risk and compliance leader to serve as Head of GRC, based in the United States or in Noida, India. The role reports to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), who leads apexanalytix's global engineering, product and hosted IT organizations. As a member of the CPTO's leadership team, the Head of GRC owns the company's control framework, its ISO 27001, SOC 1 and SOC 2 programs, and its enterprise and third-party risk management, and gives independent assurance that the controls run across the organization work as intended.

The role is deliberately independent of the controls it tests. Security Operations, the datacenter, production environments and corporate IT sit with the VP Technology Operations. Product identity and security tooling in the delivery pipeline sit with the Platform team. GRC sets the standards these teams work to, tests whether their controls work, and reports the results directly to the CPTO.

Today the GRC team also runs security operations. Under the new organization design, Security Operations moves to Technology Operations. The Head of GRC leads that handover and then builds GRC into a focused, independent assurance function.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO, the executive team and, as needed, the Board or Audit Committee on the company's risk position, compliance obligations and the state of its controls.
* Gives product and engineering leaders an early, clear view of the compliance and risk impact of new products, AI capabilities, architecture changes and acquisitions.
* Acts as the senior voice of security and compliance assurance toward enterprise customers, auditors and regulators.
* Works with Legal, Privacy and Finance to turn regulatory and contractual obligations into practical control requirements.

**The Work -**

***Governance and compliance***

* **Strategy and governance.** Defines and runs a multi-year GRC strategy and roadmap. Chairs the company's risk and compliance forums and reports regularly to the CPTO and the executive team.
* **Policy framework.** Owns security policy and standards, including annual review, exceptions and employee attestation.
* **Certifications and audits.** Leads the ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II programs and any further attestations the market requires. Manages external auditors and owns audit scope, evidence coordination, findings and remediation tracking.
* **Control framework.** Maintains a single control framework mapped across NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and CIS, so each control is tested once and used to meet many requirements.
* **Regulatory obligations.** Tracks obligations across the jurisdictions the company operates in, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, DORA, NIS2, the EU AI Act, India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) and CERT-In incident reporting rules.

***Risk and assurance***

* **Independent control testing.** Sets control requirements and tests how well controls work across Security Operations, Technology Operations, corporate IT, Platform and the product trios. Runs periodic access reviews and segregation-of-duties checks.
* **Vulnerability and risk reporting.** Monitors vulnerability management and patching against agreed SLAs and escalates breaches directly to the CPTO. Defines and reports key risk indicators for security, availability and access.
* **Enterprise risk management.** Runs the enterprise and information security risk program: risk identification and assessment, the risk register, treatment plans and named risk owners.
* **Incident and resilience oversight.** Reviews security incidents after they close to check whether controls worked and notification obligations were met. Sets business continuity and disaster recovery requirements and confirms that the plans owned by Technology Operations are tested.
* **Third-party risk.** Owns third-party risk management for subprocessors, cloud providers and critical suppliers, from due diligence through ongoing monitoring, using apexanalytix's own supplier risk capabilities where appropriate.
* **AI governance.** Works with the Head of AI & Data to set governance for models and agents, including risk assessment, guardrails and audit scope.

***Customer trust***

* **Customer assurance.** Oversees responses to security questionnaires, RFP security sections, due diligence requests and customer audits. Maintains a trust center and a standard documentation package that shortens sales cycles.
* **Contract support.** Advises Sales, Legal and Customer Success on security and compliance commitments in contracts, data processing agreements and SLAs.

***Team leadership***

* **Team.** Builds, leads and develops the GRC team, with coverage across the US and Noida sites so auditors, customers and internal teams in both time zones have a local point of contact.
* **Tooling and automation.** Owns GRC tooling and drives automated control monitoring and evidence collection.
* **Budget.** Owns GRC budget planning and vendor management.
* **Awareness.** Runs the security awareness and policy training program.
* **Site relationship.** If based in Noida, has a dotted line to the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC for site matters, while reporting to the CPTO for all GRC work.

**First-Year Priorities**

* Complete the handover of Security Operations to Technology Operations, including tools, on-call duties and in-flight audit evidence, with no disruption to certifications.
* Publish a GRC charter, agreed with the CPTO, that sets out GRC's independence and decision rights alongside Technology Operations, Security Operations and the product trios.
* Deliver the next ISO 27001, SOC 1 and SOC 2 cycles on time with no significant exceptions.
* Stand up a single control framework and a current risk register with a named owner for every top risk.
* Agree vulnerability SLAs and key risk indicators with Technology Operations and report them to the CPTO each month.
* Confirm GRC coverage of the Noida site, including India obligations under the DPDP Act and CERT-In rules.
* Cut turnaround time for customer security reviews and launch a trust center.
* Set a baseline for the share of controls monitored automatically, and show measurable improvement against it.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in governance, risk and compliance, IT audit or information security, including 5+ years leading a team.
* A proven record of leading ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs in an enterprise SaaS company. Experience with SOC 1 and SOX IT general controls is a strong plus.
* Deep knowledge of control frameworks (NIST, ISO, SOC, CIS) and of global privacy regulation.
* Enough security operations knowledge to credibly test and challenge detection, response, vulnerability management and access controls.
* Experience building or scaling an enterprise risk program and presenting risk to executives and Boards.
* Experience running GRC across US and India delivery centers, including familiarity with the DPDP Act and CERT-In requirements.
* Strong influencing skills, including holding operational teams to account without direct authority over them.
* Experience with AI governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 is a plus.
* Experience with B2B enterprise software, ideally in fintech, procure-to-pay, payments or data services, is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills, including turning technical risk into business terms, and willingness to work across US Eastern and India business hours.

**Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis)**

* An undergraduate degree in information systems, computer science, accounting, business or a related field is required; equivalent professional experience will be considered. Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Implementer, or CIPP/E are strongly preferred.

**Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment**

* An apexanalytix office in the United States or the Global Capability Center in Noida, India, with hybrid working.
* Regular overlap with US Eastern business hours for executive, Board and audit commitments, and with India business hours for the Noida teams.
* Travel required: up to 20%, including travel between the US and Noida sites for audits and leadership meetings.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Vice President, Engineering
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner.

**Quick Take -**

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals.
* Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well.
* Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders.

**The Work -**

***Engineering for the customer journeys***

* **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery.
* **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each.
* **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product.

***Partnership with Data & Intelligence***

* **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations.
* **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models.
* **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards.

***Delivery and engineering excellence***

* **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions.
* **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root.
* **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development.
* **Production ownership.** Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations.
* **Architecture and standards.** Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately.

***Leadership and management***

* **Organization.** Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them.
* **Global teams.** Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices.
* **Talent.** Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer.
* **Budget and reporting.** Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run.

**First-Year Priorities**

* Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them.
* Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios.
* Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards.
* Assign a lead team for each supplier–buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow.
* Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it.
* Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations.
* Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track.

**Required Skills**

* 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS.
* A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems.
* Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale.
* Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery.
* Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development.
* Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures.
* A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers.
* Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones.
* Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001).
* Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

**Preferred Skills**

* Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech.
* Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Azure Cloud Architect
description:
**Job Title:** Azure Cloud Architect  
**Organization:** NEC Corporation India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Noida India

**Experience:** 10–15 years

**Reporting Relationship:** Staff-Aug  
**Employment Type:** Contractual

**Other:** Open for short-term/long-term travel to Japan

**Role Overview:**

The ideal candidate will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of Azure based cloud solutions, with an emphasis on best practice Azure cloud security.

This role requires more than just following instructions — have excellent experience in upper stream engagement phases (Proposal, Requirement, Design) with Japanese language capability. We need someone who proactively identifies issues, understands the "why" behind the request, and takes ownership of designing and implementing solutions. Flexibility beyond assigned roles is key in our culture.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and development of high quality, scalable and performance focused software based on .Net/J2EE.
* Lead and design experience of Azure architecture including Kubernetes.
* Develop and maintain an Azure based cloud solution, with an emphasis on best practice Azure cloud security.
* Produce technical specifications and software designs based on high level product requirements.
* Able to Take Azure Infra design and manage full responsibility and able to mentor team working on Azure Services.
* Work collaboratively with Business Analysts and Product Owners to ensure that functional requirements are met.

* Identify risks associated with software development projects and recommend means of mitigating these risks.

* Proven expertise in cloud-to-cloud migration projects (e.g., AWS to Azure, GCP to Azure).
* Experience in architecting scalable, secure, and high-availability solutions on Azure.
* Have excellent experience in upper stream phases (Proposal, Requirement, Design).
* Experience with DevOps Orchestration/Configuration/Continuous Integration Management technologies.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools like Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions.
* Experience working in hybrid/multi-cloud environments.
* Preferred to have Japanese language capability.
* 10–15 years in data architecture, engineering, and warehousing.

**Professional Skills:**

* Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills to convey complex analyses to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight timelines.
* Proactive, innovative, and collaborative attitude with a passion for continuous learning.
* Experience working with cross functional teams and risk management teams.

**Good to have:**

* Experience working with non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in or with Japanese-oriented companies or clients.
* Microsoft Certification: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.

Cloud or data architecture certifications preferred.

Pay: ₹160,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Noida, Uttar Pradesh

title: Technical Specialist - Visualization
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================

Job Type: PermanentApplication Deadline: 24 October 2026

**Job Description**

**Title** **Technical Specialist - Visualization**

**Department** People Data Platforms & Solutions Team

**Location**Gurgaon, India

**Reports To**Manager - People Analytics

**Level** Grade-4

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

**About your team**

People Data Platforms & Solutions Team aims to build a trusted, secure, and scalable People Data Platform that delivers governed and reliable workforce data to enable informed decision-making, actionable insights, regulatory compliance, support AI capabilities and business growth. The team provides **high-quality, reliable enterprise wide analytical solutions and insights** to empower CPO stakeholders to make informed and impactful business decisions.

**About your Role**

This role is for a **Technical Specialist** who can understand functional, technical requirements and has the ability to understand the implications associated with the chosen technical strategy well aligned with the business context. The successful candidate would carry out reporting/visualization development/enhancement and work with a high performing team in an individual contributor role to imlement BI and Analytical solutions. The successful candidate will be expected to interact with all levels of the business and technical community.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the end-to-end Business Intelligence and Analytics ecosystem, including **dashboard development, workspace administration, governance, security, deployments, and ongoing platform support**.
* Lead the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise-scale dashboards, reports, scorecards, and self-service analytics solutions using **Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service**.
* Design dashboard wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and reporting frameworks to ensure intuitive user experience, stakeholder alignment, and effective data storytelling.
* Design and implement scalable semantic models using dimensional modeling techniques, ensuring consistency, maintainability, and optimal performance.
* Perform advanced data extraction, transformation, and preparation using **Power Query (M Language)** and collaborate with Data Engineering teams to build robust and scalable data solutions.
* Design, develop, and support end-to-end analytics data pipelines utilizing **Snowflake, SQL, Python, and Power BI** to enable reliable and scalable reporting solutions.
* Manage and govern **Power BI Workspaces, Apps, Semantic Models, Dataflows, Gateways, and Deployment Pipelines** across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement and manage enterprise-grade security frameworks including **Row-Level Security (RLS), Object-Level Security (OLS), workspace access management, data privacy, compliance requirements, and governance controls**.
* Monitor and optimize dashboard, dataset, and semantic model performance using model optimization, DAX tuning, aggregation strategies, refresh optimization, and capacity management best practices.
* Identify opportunities to leverage **Power Platform capabilities (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI)** to streamline business processes, automate workflows, and deliver integrated analytics-driven solutions.
* Conduct code reviews, establish development best practices, and mentor junior developers and analysts to improve overall team capability and delivery quality.
* Take full ownership and accountability for BI deliverables, platform stability, stakeholder satisfaction, and successful execution of enterprise analytics initiatives.

**About you**

**Essential Skills are:**

* **8+ years of experience** in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Warehousing, Data Visualization, and Enterprise Reporting solutions.
* Minimum **4-6 years of hands-on experience with Power BI**, delivering enterprise-scale reporting and analytics solutions.
* Proven experience leading end-to-end BI implementations, including requirements gathering, solution design, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Advanced proficiency in **Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query (M), and data modeling**.
* Strong understanding of **dashboard design, UX/UI principles, wireframing, prototyping, and data storytelling**.
* Hands-on experience administering **Power BI Service**, including Workspaces, Apps, Semantic Models, Dataflows, Gateways, Deployment Pipelines, Capacity, and Refresh Management.
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate**.
* Experience implementing BI security and governance controls, including **RLS, OLS, workspace security, data privacy, compliance, and access management.**
* Expertise in dashboard, dataset, and semantic model performance optimization using DAX tuning, model optimization, aggregations, Performance Analyzer, and refresh optimization techniques.
* Experience establishing BI **governance frameworks, development standards, release management processes, and reporting lifecycle best practices**.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and documentation skills.

**Feel rewarded**

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
