* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

**All About You**

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high-energy, proactive, detail-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

**Skills/Abilities**

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on-the-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager, Application Security
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Summary**
OpenGov is seeking an experienced Manager of Application Security to lead our growing AppSec team. This role blends technical expertise with people leadership, driving a secure-by-design culture across our engineering organization while mentoring and empowering a high-performing team.
  
  
You will oversee the strategy and execution of application security initiatives, embedding industry-leading standards such as OWASP into our development lifecycle. The ideal candidate is collaborative, approachable, and an excellent communicator, capable of building trust with engineers, product leaders, and executives alike.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor the Application Security team to drive engagement, growth, and technical excellence.
* Build and execute the organization’s application security roadmap to strengthen the security posture of all product suites and APIs.
* Champion secure development practices by embedding OWASP ASVS and OWASP Top 10 guidance into coding standards, architecture reviews, and threat modeling.
* Oversee the selection, deployment, and integration of AppSec tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA, ASPM) into CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product to ensure secure coding, design reviews, and vulnerability management processes are followed.
* Report on risk metrics, remediation progress, and program effectiveness to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and fun team culture that inspires innovation and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the AppSec subject-matter expert for internal audits, customer reviews, and compliance (SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, etc.).

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of combined experience in Application Security, Software Engineering, or related fields; 3+ years leading or managing security teams.
* Deep understanding of OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, and secure software development practices.
* Hands-on experience with modern AppSec tools and frameworks (SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, ASPM).
* Proven ability to build and motivate high-performing teams, with strong mentoring and coaching skills.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a SaaS or cloud-native software company.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and security automation.
* Knowledge of compliance and regulatory frameworks relevant to software companies (SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, etc.).
* Certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, OSWE, or similar AppSec credentials.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands-on” role: you will write security-centric code, conduct deep-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
  
  
Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
  
  
Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
  
  
Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  
  
Identity/Auth: Expert-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 10+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
  
  
Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
  
  
Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  
  
Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non-technical leadership.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Secure Architecture & Threat Modeling

Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
  
  
Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
  
  
Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
  
  
  

* Offensive Security & Exploitation

In-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
  
  
Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
  
  
Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high-severity fixes.
  
  
  

* Secure Coding & SDLC Integration

Secure Code Review: Review high-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
  
  
Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**

title: Penetration Tester
description:
**Penetration Tester (Associate)**
----------------------------------

**Location:** Gurugram / Remote

**Experience:** 0-3 Years

**Compensation:** ₹3,00,000 Per Annum

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

### **About the Role**

OculusIT is looking for a highly motivated and passionate Associate Penetration Tester who is eager to build a career in offensive security. This role is designed for early-career cybersecurity professionals who possess a strong technical foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn advanced penetration testing techniques under the guidance of senior team members.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Assist senior pentesters in security assessment engagements.
* Participate in internal and external vulnerability assessments.
* Perform reconnaissance and enumeration activities.
* Execute basic penetration testing tasks under supervision.
* Support web application and network security testing activities.
* Assist in vulnerability validation and evidence collection.
* Develop technical documentation and assessment notes.
* Participate in security research and proof-of-concept testing.
* Learn and apply offensive security methodologies.
* Support report generation and remediation verification activities.

### **Required Knowledge**

Candidates should demonstrate understanding of:

* Networking Fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* HTTP/HTTPS
* Operating System Concepts
* Windows Security
* Linux Administration
* Authentication Mechanisms
* Common Cyber Attack Vectors
* OWASP Top 10
* Basic Active Directory Concepts
* Vulnerability Assessment Methodologies

### **Desired Skills**

Exposure to any of the following is preferred:

* Kali Linux
* Burp Suite
* Nmap
* Nessus
* Wireshark
* Metasploit
* OWASP ZAP
* GitHub Security Projects
* Hack The Box
* TryHackMe
* PortSwigger Academy

### **Certifications Preferred**

Any of the following certifications will be advantageous:

* Security+
* CEH
* eJPT
* SC-900
* Google Cybersecurity Certificate
* Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
* Cisco CyberOps Associate

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or pursuing degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Strong desire to build a career in penetration testing.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn from senior security professionals.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

### **Success Profile**

The ideal candidate is:

* Curious and self-driven.
* Passionate about ethical hacking.
* Active in cybersecurity learning platforms.
* Interested in offensive security and attack techniques.
* Eager to progress toward certifications such as OSCP, PNPT, or CRTO.

### **Growth Path**

Associate Penetration Tester Penetration Tester Senior Penetration Tester Lead Penetration Tester Offensive Security Manager

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description:
Position Summary
  
  
As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will protect Litera’s systems, data, and customers from evolving cyber threats. By leading security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and continuous security improvements, you will help ensure a resilient and compliant security posture. Your work will support business continuity, safeguard enterprise assets, and strengthen trust internally and with customers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor, investigate, and respond to security threats and incidents across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Scope, design, and build automation to solve recurring security and compliance problems, reducing manual effort and improving consistency and scalability.
* Develop automated security controls and audits, such as validating security group membership and access against requirements, identifying access anomalies, and producing actionable findings.
* Build automated checks that evaluate internal systems and content against security criteria, including detecting exposed credentials, passwords, sensitive information, and other security or compliance conditions.
* Translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable technical solutions by defining the problem, identifying data sources, implementing detection or validation logic, validating results, and producing actionable output for remediation.
* Maintain and improve security automation as requirements, systems, and risks change.
* Lead vulnerability management, including risk assessment, remediation, and escalation.
* Implement and maintain security controls aligned with Zero Trust and security best practices.
* Partner with IT, DevOps, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to strengthen security posture.
* Support compliance initiatives, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, audit readiness, and policy management.
* Drive continuous improvement through security automation, measurable control validation, cloud security enhancements, and emerging technology adoption.
* Stay current on evolving cyber threats and recommend security improvements.

**Qualifications**
Must Haves:
  
  

* 5+ years of cybersecurity experience, including hands-on Security Operations Center (SOC) experience.
* Experience operating and investigating security events in cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience scoping and building automation to solve security or compliance problems using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar technologies.
* Ability to take a security requirement from problem definition through implementation, including identifying data sources, developing logic, validating results, handling exceptions, and producing actionable output.
* Experience automating security or compliance activities such as access and entitlement reviews, configuration validation, data discovery, control testing, or other repeatable processes.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

Education & Certifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred certifications include CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, Microsoft security certifications, or an AWS/Azure cloud security certification.

Nice to Haves:
  
  

* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Experience integrating security tools and data sources through REST APIs, webhooks, or similar methods.
* Ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.
* Unyielding curiosity and a strong desire to get to the “why”.
* Challenges assumptions and brings fresh perspectives to problems.
* High adaptability and continuous learning mindset.
* Passion for promoting security awareness and best practices.

Litera is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Responsibilities include supporting security incidents, assisting with investigations, contributing to remediation activities, and supporting security‑related changes in line with established change and governance processes.
  
  
The Cyber Security Analyst works closely with senior engineers and stakeholders across the cyber estate, providing operational support and technical input across a range of security controls. The role includes maintaining accurate documentation, procedures, and evidence to support operational, audit, and governance requirements. This position suits an individual who enjoys problem solving, is comfortable working in technical environments, and is keen to continue developing their skills across network security and cyber engineering.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
The role involves acting as a supporting point of contact for internal audit, IT risk, and security governance teams, assisting with alignment to regulatory frameworks such as ISO 27001, SAMA, and SWIFT CSCF, as well as internal security standards. The analyst will support the operation, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance of network security platforms across the EMEA Bank and EMEA Securities technology estate and will work closely with senior engineers, vendors, and internal teams to support the implementation and continuous improvement of network security controls.
  
  

* Domain Experince – Network Security

+ Good experience in network security operations, with an understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and traffic‑flow analysis.
+ Hands‑on experience supporting perimeter security controls, including next‑generation firewalls and intrusion prevention systems (IPS).
+ Experience working with cloud‑based edge security platforms including exposure to WAF, DDoS protection, and Zero Trust / ZTNA capabilities.
+ Experience supporting web security and Secure Web Gateway (SWG) or proxy solutions, including URL filtering, SSL inspection, and user‑based access controls.
+ Exposure to network visibility and microsegmentation tools, including application dependency mapping and east‑west traffic analysis.

+ Experience working in multi‑vendor network security environments, supporting integrations across diverse firewall and security platforms.
+ Exposure to cloud network security concepts, including VPC/VNet security, security groups, and integration with cloud‑native security controls.
+ Familiarity with Network Access Control (NAC) solutions such as Cisco ISE or similar.
+ Good understanding of security best practices, including Zero Trust principles, least‑privilege access, and network segmentation strategies.

* Risk Identification and Mitigation

+ Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to develop mitigation plans and track remediation progress through ServiceNow.
+ Support organistaions security risk profile and associated operational risk reporting.

* Process Optimisation

+ Support continuous improvement of operational processes and workflows.
+ Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, automation, or standardisation.

* Audit and Governance Support

+ Support internal and external audits by ensuring activities are documented and accessible in central respositries.
+ Align improvements and mitigation activities with organisational risk policies and governance frameworks.

* General

+ Support Information Security incidents where requested.
+ Support Operational Security duties where requested.
+ Responsibility covers EMEA for Bank and EMEA for Securities technology

* Key Deliverables

+ Fully supported and documented security tooling across multiple domains.
+ Timely and effective resolution of tooling and platform-related incidents.
+ Implementation packages and handover documents for new control deployments.
+ Accurate reporting of vulnerability status and policy compliance gaps.
+ Automation scripts, dashboards, or integrations that reduce manual workload.
+ Audit-ready documentation and evidence packs as required.

**Job Requirements**

* Education and Experience:

+ Strong secondary-level education is required, ideally to A-level or equivalent standard, in a technical or analytical discipline.
+ A university degree is not essential, though a qualification in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Risk Management, or a related field would be considered advantageous.
+ 2 – 4 years of experience in cyber security or information security roles.

* Knowledge and Skills:

+ Strong technical experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
+ Strong technical understanding of infrastructure, networking, and operating systems.
+ Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise cyber security tools
+ Knowledge of regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, CIS, NIST).
+ Comfortable supporting log analysis, access control configurations, and data protection tools.
+ Proficiency in troubleshooting integrated systems involving AD, DNS, GPO, and networked assets
+ Scripting or automation exposure (Python, Ansible, or PowerShell) is desirable.
+ Experience collaborating with audit, risk, and compliance stakeholders.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

* Success Measures

+ High availability and performance of cyber tooling platforms.
+ Reduction in platform-level incidents through proactive support or automation.
+ Timely delivery of project tasks and handover documentation.
+ Positive feedback from IT partners, operations, and audit stakeholders.
+ Contribution to ongoing improvements in detection, compliance, and control effectiveness.

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
+ Strong collaboration skills, with a focus on cross-functional teamwork and vendor relationship management.
+ Process oriented with keen attention to detail.
+ Supporting problem identification
+ Contributing to improvements
+ Assisting audit activities

* Certifications (Nice to have)

title: Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on-call rotation.
  
  
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
  
  
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
  
  

* Provision bare-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring-up free of manual per-node steps
* Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over

Kubernetes Cluster Operations
  
  

* Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control-plane topology, including etcd members, kube-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure-domain placement
* Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
* Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts

GitOps & Fleet Configuration
  
  

* Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
* Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
* Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team

Upgrades & Patching
  
  

* Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
* Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Observability & On-Call
  
  

* Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
* Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
* Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
* Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate

What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months
  
  

* Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
* Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
* Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
* Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
* Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
* Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
* Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
* Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
* Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
* Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
* On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
* Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it

**Preferred**

* Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi-cluster management plane
* Familiarity with DPDK-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR-IOV NIC tuning
* Exposure to SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

title: Senior Network and IP Engineer
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Senior Network and IP Engineer**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. As part of the Network Design & Planning team in Bangalore, this individual will design, build, and optimise the IP transport that ties Skylo’s network together, from ground stations and satellite gateways through backhaul and data centers to our cloud-native RAN and core in public cloud. Your work will ensure our transport network is resilient, secure, and scalable as Skylo’s commercial direct-to-device service grows across continents.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Design and implement IP transport and routing for Skylo’s network, including routers, switches, and firewalls across ground stations, data centers, and cloud.
* Design and operate routing architectures using BGP, OSPF/IS-IS, and MPLS (L3VPN/L2VPN, segment routing), including routing policy, traffic engineering, and redundancy (VRRP, BFD, ECMP).
* Design and deliver backhaul connectivity from ground stations and satellite gateways to Skylo’s cloud and data center sites, including carrier circuits, IPsec/SD-WAN overlays, and diverse-path resilience.
* Design cloud networking in AWS and GCP (VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect / Cloud Interconnect, VPN) and hybrid connectivity to on-prem sites.
* Define IP addressing, subnetting, VLAN, VRF, and QoS designs for RAN, core, management, and interconnect traffic.
* Support interconnects with MNO and roaming partners (IPX/GRX, peering, private interconnects) in collaboration with core network engineers.
* Implement network security controls, including segmentation, ACLs, firewall policy, and DDoS protection, together with the Security team.
* Automate network configuration and validation using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, and NetBox.
* Monitor transport performance (latency, jitter, loss, utilisation), perform capacity planning, and drive improvements to availability and scalability.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues and support Operations with root cause analysis and escalations.
* Document network architecture, configurations, and procedures, and conduct proof-of-solutions to validate technical proposals.

**What We Look For**

* 6+ years of experience in IP network engineering, ideally within a telecom operator, service provider, or large-scale cloud/data center environment.
* Strong hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF/IS-IS, and MPLS, including routing policy design and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, network tunnelling (GRE, IPsec, VXLAN), and redundancy protocols (VRRP, BFD, LAG/LACP).
* Experience configuring and optimising carrier-grade routers, switches, and firewalls (e.g. Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet).
* Experience with public cloud networking (AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect; GCP networking) and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience designing WAN/backhaul connectivity, including carrier circuits, SD-WAN, and QoS.
* Familiarity with network automation and infrastructure-as-code tools (Ansible, Terraform, Python, NetBox).
* Familiarity with mobile network transport (RAN backhaul, S1/N2/N3, GTP, IPX/GRX) is a strong plus.
* General knowledge of satellite communication over LEO and GEO, and ground station networking, is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Industry certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent are preferred.

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive occupational health coverage
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends multi-national characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

title: Engineer, NOC
description:
**About Consilio**
Consilio's consulting and services teams assist legal departments of multinational corporations and their outside counsel in responding to legal matters, reducing legal spend, minimizing risk, and operating more efficiently. Across eDiscovery, document review, and legal consulting services, Consilio is committed to delivering service excellence globally and applying proven knowledge and technology to help clients solve challenges with lower cost, lower risk, and improved speed.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The NOC Engineer provides first-line operational monitoring and incident response for Consilio's global technology environment. The role monitors infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, applications, and supporting services; validates and triages alerts; executes approved runbooks; and coordinates timely escalation and communication to minimize service disruption. The NOC Engineer contributes to reliable 24x7 operations through disciplined ticket documentation, shift handoffs, monitoring improvement, and collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, and service management teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Continuously monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of infrastructure, network, server, storage, cloud, application, and environmental services using approved monitoring and observability platforms.
* Validate, correlate, prioritize, acknowledge, and triage alerts based on business impact, severity, service dependencies, and documented operating procedures.
* Perform first-level troubleshooting and approved remediation, including service or job restarts, basic connectivity checks, log review, health validation, and execution of established runbooks.
* Create and maintain accurate incident and service tickets, including timestamps, affected services, troubleshooting performed, evidence collected, actions taken, escalation details, and final resolution.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact incidents to the correct technical team, vendor, incident commander, or management contact in accordance with defined SLAs and escalation paths.
* Initiate or support major incident bridges, maintain a clear incident timeline, provide concise stakeholder updates, and ensure ownership remains clear through service restoration.
* Complete structured shift handoffs that identify active incidents, degraded services, pending follow-ups, maintenance activities, and operational risks.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal support teams to resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and platform issues.
* Support planned maintenance and change windows by completing readiness checks, monitoring service health, documenting checkpoints, validating recovery, and communicating exceptions.
* Maintain and improve operational documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, monitoring inventories, and service ownership records.
* Assist with monitoring onboarding for new or changed services by validating dashboards, thresholds, routing, dependencies, ownership, and actionable alert content.
* Review false positives, duplicate alerts, missed detections, stale monitors, and recurring noise; recommend threshold, routing, suppression, or runbook improvements to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute incident data and timelines to problem management and post-incident reviews; track assigned corrective actions and knowledge updates to completion.
* Monitor operational performance indicators such as service availability, alert volume, mean time to detect, mean time to acknowledge, mean time to resolve, SLA compliance, and repeat incidents.
* Follow approved access control, data handling, change management, incident management, security, and audit requirements, and promptly escalate suspected security events to the appropriate response team.
* Participate in rotational shifts, weekend or holiday coverage, after-hours maintenance, and on-call support as required by business needs.

**Operational Tools and Technologies**

* Monitoring and observability: Grafana, Prometheus, and Uptime Kuma or comparable platforms.
* Incident alerting and coordination: JSM (Jira service management) or comparable on-call and incident management tools.
* IT service management and documentation: ServiceNow or another ITSM platform; SharePoint or Confluence for knowledge management.
* Operating systems and infrastructure: Windows and Linux fundamentals; server, virtualization, storage, network, and cloud concepts.
* Automation and configuration: Working knowledge of Windows PowerShell; familiarity with YAML syntax, PromQL (Prometheus Query Language) and API-based integrations is desirable.
* Core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, latency, packet loss, and common connectivity diagnostics.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in NOC, infrastructure operations, Service Now, systems administration, network support, or another 24x7 technical support environment is preferred. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships, labs, or certifications may be considered.
* Foundational understanding of incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management practices.
* Ability to interpret alerts, dashboards, logs, system events, and basic performance or capacity indicators.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow technical procedures, recognize operational risk, and escalate with complete and accurate context.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise technical updates to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and time management in a high-volume environment with shifting priorities.
* Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work rotational shifts, weekends, holidays, and scheduled maintenance windows as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, event management, or incident response tools.
* Experience supporting network, Windows, Linux, virtualization, storage, cloud, or enterprise application environments.
* Experience with ITSM ticketing platforms, CMDB concepts, service mapping, and operational knowledge management.
* Experience using PowerShell or another scripting language to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* ITIL Foundation and (or) relevant monitoring-tool certification.
* Experience in a regulated, audited, legal technology, eDiscovery, or globally distributed services environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational ownership and accountability
* Analytical troubleshooting and sound judgment
* Calm, structured response during high-impact incidents
* Customer and service orientation
* Clear communication and active listening
* Collaboration across technical teams
* Documentation discipline and attention to detail
* Continuous improvement and learning agility

Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  
  
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect . Welcome diverse views . Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  
  
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC) . Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
  
  
Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Operations Engineer to support and optimize enterprise cloud environments, with a primary focus on Amazon Web Services (AWS). The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring platform availability, reliability, security, and operational excellence while supporting cloud automation, modernization, and transformation initiatives.

* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required to support business operations and strategic objectives.

**Required Skills**

* 3–5+ years of cloud operations, infrastructure support, or cloud engineering experience.

* Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux system administration in cloud or hybrid environments.

* Experience working within Agile, DevOps, and IT Service Management (ITSM/ITIL) environments.
* Experience working with Managed Service Providers (MSPs), vendors, service providers, and cross-functional technology teams.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to proactively identify issues and implement improvements.
* Experience contributing to infrastructure and cloud modernization initiatives while collaborating across technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural, globally distributed, and matrixed organizations.
* Strong verbal and written English communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated accountability, adaptability, ownership, continuous learning, and results orientation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience operating within Agile delivery and DevOps-oriented environments collaborating effectively as part of geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.

* Experience with ADO (Azure DevOps), CI/CD, GitHub Actions.

Job Description: Senior Cloud Architect - P5

The Senior Cloud Architect sets and evolves the architectural direction for Carrier’s cloud platform across AWS, GCP, and Azure. This role works horizontally across our product portfolio to ensure we build solutions that are consistently secure, resilient, and cost effective. The architect defines reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails, then partners with Product Leads, Security, FinOps, and customer teams to put them into practice through Infrastructure as Code and automation. * Partner with FinOps to design cost-aware architectures, set tagging and accountability standards, and build cost efficiency into solutions from the start rather than as an afterthought.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture leaders to establish architecture patterns and best practices across the Enterprise.
* Define standards for observability and operational readiness so that solutions are monitored, supportable, and resilient in production.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to product teams, mentoring engineers and guiding them in adopting standardized cloud patterns and best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with at least 6 years in a cloud architecture role designing solutions on AWS and/or GCP.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of core cloud services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and data, with the ability to design solutions that are secure, resilient, and cost effective.
* Proven experience defining reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails that multiple teams adopt and reuse.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and version control (GitHub), including how to structure code for reuse across teams.
* Deep expertise in cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code approaches to governance.
* Proven ability to document, communicate, and govern complex designs, and to influence technical direction across multiple teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting across multiple cloud providers in a large enterprise spanning multiple business units and geographies.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tooling, and a track record of building cost efficiency into architectural decisions.
* Exposure to cloud governance frameworks such as AWS Control Tower or GCP Organization Policies, and to policy-as-code tooling.
* Professional certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction across large enterprise organizations.

* Controller faults

* Compressor problems
* High/low pressure conditions
* Refrigerant leakage
* Refrigerant flow issues
* Expansion valve problems
* Condenser/evaporator performance
* Oil/refrigerant-related issues.
* Check refrigeration operating parameters and identify abnormal trends.

* Heating systems

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Performance Testing Engineer (AI)
  
JLL | Full-Time
  
About the Role
  
JLL is rolling out AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the platforms behind them across the business. Before they reach thousands of users, they need to prove they are fast, stable, and affordable at scale.
  
You will own performance engineering for your assigned portfolio of applications and AI systems. The Center of Excellence in our central AI team gives you the methodology, the platform, and the patterns; the business gives you the systems, the SMEs, and the appetite for change. Your job is to design and run load, stress, and resilience tests, find bottlenecks before production does, and turn the results into clear recommendations that teams act on.
  
We expect engineers at this level to operate with AI tools as a primary part of their workflow. You will use AI to generate test scripts, model realistic workloads, analyze results, and automate reporting. Your leverage comes from the skills, workflows, and automations you build to test safely and repeatedly. The leverage in this role is AI, not headcount.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
Design and run performance, load, stress, soak, and scalability tests for applications, APIs, and data pipelines, in close partnership with developers and business SMEs.
  
Performance-test AI systems (LLM gateway, shared RAG services, MCP servers, and agents), measuring time to first token, end-to-end latency, throughput, concurrency limits, rate-limit behavior, and token cost per transaction.
  
**Build AI-assisted test automation:** use LLMs and agents to generate scripts, create realistic synthetic workloads and data, triage results, and draft reports.
  
Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with SLO-based thresholds and gates so regressions are caught before release.
  
Instrument and monitor systems with observability tooling, diagnose bottlenecks across the application, database, network, and infrastructure layers, and recommend fixes.
  
Build evaluation harnesses that track AI output quality alongside performance, so speed and cost optimizations do not quietly degrade answers.
  
Run workshops with engineering and business teams on performance testing practices and on using tools like Claude Code in testing workflows.
  
Feed benchmarks, patterns, anti-patterns, and platform gaps back into the Center of Excellence so the next engagement moves faster.
  
  
Must Have Experience
  
Hands-on performance testing of production systems using tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, or Locust.
  
Production-quality code in at least one of Python, JavaScript/Node, or Java/.NET, enough to build custom load generators and test automation.
  
Experience with observability and APM tools (such as Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana, or Azure Monitor) and with analyzing metrics, traces, and logs to find root causes.
  
Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS) and containers, and of how relational, NoSQL, and vector data stores behave under load.
  
Used AI tools or LLM APIs in real engineering or testing workflows, with a grounded understanding of how LLM systems behave under load: token limits, rate limiting, streaming, caching, and concurrency.
  
  
Traits
  
Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain results and risk to non-engineers.
  
Pragmatic judgment on what to test, how deep to go, and when results are good enough to ship.
  
Systems thinking with a focus on failure modes; AI helps write the tests, you own the results.
  
Comfort running multiple agents and automations in parallel as part of daily workflow.
  
  
Why This Role
  
JLL. A Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate, with the stability of a $20B+ business and the resources to invest seriously in AI.
  
The team. You sit at the seam of the business, product, and engineering, with a direct line into JLL's central AI platform via the Center of Excellence. Your findings are visible from business leadership on down.
  
The role. The systems you test are the agents and platforms thousands of JLL employees rely on every day, and your work decides whether they hold up at scale. You will see the impact within weeks, not quarters.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

The Bids and Proposals Specialist will generally support the Bid Manager and/or Associate Bid Director leading the bid, having read and understood the client requirements. They will devise draft bid programmes, coordinate inputs from Subject Matter Experts and track progress against tasks and individuals for reporting to the Bid Manager. The Bids and Proposals Specialist will work collaboratively with technical and operational colleagues, writers, graphic designers and the leadership team. The role covers the full procurement lifecycle and proposals.

Aside from supporting bids, the role requires proactive engagement in ad hoc tasks around general bidding best practice, including but not limited to: driving bid knowledge management through the breakdown of bids into a bid library; collaboration with the knowledge team to log model responses and useful information; collaboration with graphic designers to support on ad hoc, simple graphics requirements; and supporting the leadership team to develop processes, tools and guides around bidding.

*This position will offer flexibility for hybrid work schedules to include both in-office presence and telecommute/virtual work. Candidates from Bangalore, New Delhi, and Mumbai are welcome to apply.*

* Lead mid-size proposals and task orders
* Participate in Go /No Go and green light analysis / readiness to bid assessment in partnership with bid / capture managers. Update CRM data as needed to maintain accuracy
* Contribute to pre-RFP proposal planning, including Four Rules win strategy development, applying win plan, messaging, and discriminators in deliverables
* Develop compliance matrices, identify required items, and create proposal plan and schedules
* Create drafts and organize narratives and sections for experience, people, executive summaries or cover letters. Develop section content plan/ templates to guide writers
* Organize and manage content for reviews and manage the recovery and implementation of comments and finalization of documents and compliance
* Coordinate with subcontractors to gather required data and provide guidance
* Collaborate with graphic designers to support graphic design requirements and coordinate final productions. May also follow branded templates in performing document layout
* Collaborate with knowledge team to log model responses and useful information
* Provide support in general bidding practices by driving bid knowledge management through the breakdown of bids into a bid library
* Update and maintain bid and project profile libraries, including filing completed proposals and CVs
* Maintain trackers and identify useful/updated standard content for enhancement of bid resources
* Undertake support research, including the collection of project profiles, mining Salesforce, searching internal databases
* Maintain standard supporting documentation for bids such as company certificates, standard responses, company reports
* Perform moderately complex tasks in compliance with service level agreement, process, policies, and procedures
* Contribute specialized expertise to different assigned projects and process improvement initiatives. Provide key updates to Team Lead and Manager
* Escalate issues and recommend resolutions to the Team Lead. May support junior members of the team in addressing routine issues within the assigned processes

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Business, Marketing, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* At least four (4) years Bid support experience, preferably within a professional services firm in a similar industry
* Strong knowledge of marketing best practices and procedures, work processes, and tools as related to proposal management of RFQ/P responses
* Experienced in proposal and presentation writing and production
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Office tools such as Word and PowerPoint
* Understanding of graphic design and an eye for communicating content visually – can effectively use our brand guidelines and work with our corporate identity
* Skills in Adobe Creative especially InDesign and Salesforce experience would be highly regarded

 **Additional Information**

Attributes:

* Ability to be thorough and meticulous in completing assigned tasks and with the ability to propose ways to prevent or eliminate errors, discrepancies & issues. (Attention to Detail)
* Ability to maintain good customer relationship and initiate ways to improve customer experience (Customer Service)
* Ability to maintain a high level of collaboration among multiple internal and external stakeholders to effectively arrive at solutions and develop initiatives. (Collaboration)
* Ability to effectively communicate within a varied audience and internal and external customers using different platforms. (Communication)
* Ability to identify and resolve moderate and complex issues by applying best practices and technical expertise and may recommend solutions for unique scenarios. (Problem Solving)

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, and service recognition awards.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact.
