title: Sr. Kubernetes Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About the Technology Organisation
  
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
About the Business Function
  
  
The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialised engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a Sr. Kubernetes Engineer, you will design, build, and operate Lilly's Kubernetes-based hosting platform across multiple clouds. You will own platform capabilities end to end: writing Kubernetes controllers in Go and platform automation in Go or Python, defining infrastructure as code, evolving CI/CD and GitOps delivery, and raising the reliability and security of the platform.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build, deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters end to end, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, networking, scaling and decommissioning, on a managed offering such as EKS or ROSA, or an equivalent platform.
* Develop and maintain custom Kubernetes controllers and operators in Go (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or Operator SDK), including CRD design, reconciliation logic, finalizers, and admission webhooks.
* Author and maintain automation, tooling, and services in Go or Python that streamline platform operations, onboarding, and review processes.
* Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize, with strong module design, state management, and policy-as-code practices.
* Own and evolve CI/CD and GitOps pipelines using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Artifactory, and Checkmarx, with a security-first approach to software supply chain.
* Implement node and workload autoscaling with Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, HPA/VPA, and KEDA, including node image and upgrade strategies.
* Partner with application teams during onboarding, migration, and go-live, providing hands-on technical guidance and clear documentation.

How You Will Succeed
  
  

* Demonstrate deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, API machinery, and troubleshooting production issues.
* Write production-quality Go (and Python where needed), including tests, and apply good software engineering practices to platform code.
* Apply strong knowledge of AWS/Azure, including compute, networking (VPC/VNet, routing, private endpoints), IAM (IRSA, Pod Identity, workload identity), and managed Kubernetes services.
* Operate CI/CD and GitOps toolchains effectively, with sound judgment on release strategies such as progressive delivery, canary, and rollback.
* Use observability tooling to diagnose platform and application issues quickly, and drive improvements from the findings.

What You Should Bring
  
  
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4-7 years of experience in Platform or DevOps engineering, including running Kubernetes in production.
* Strong, hands-on experience with at least one managed Kubernetes offering (EKS, AKS, ROSA, or ARO); exposure to multiple is strongly preferred.
* Strong programming experience in Go, including hands-on experience building Kubernetes controllers and operators; Python for tooling and automation is a plus.
* Solid knowledge of Kubernetes internals and extension points: CRDs, controllers and operators, admission webhooks, finalizers, and the client-go and controller-runtime libraries.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management (Artifactory or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure core services, networking, and IAM.
* Practical experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, or equivalents) and log analysis in Splunk or similar.
* Experience with Linux, containers, and container runtimes, and strong troubleshooting skills across the network and OS layers.

Additional Information
  
  
This is a full-time employee position. Availability for flexible hours may be needed to support platform operations, and some on-call or non-standard-hours support may be required depending on platform incident volume.
  
  
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

**We believe that you bring**  
You are a technically experienced and pragmatic security professional who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.

You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You can balance risk, cost, complexity and delivery needs, explain why a security decision makes sense, listen to different perspectives and help teams reach a good solution.

You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and architects, and you see security architecture as something developed together with delivery teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

**About the role:**

Job Description: Senior Cloud Architect - P5

### **Role Description**

The Senior Cloud Architect sets and evolves the architectural direction for Carrier’s cloud platform across AWS, GCP, and Azure. This role works horizontally across our product portfolio to ensure we build solutions that are consistently secure, resilient, and cost effective. The architect defines reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails, then partners with Product Leads, Security, FinOps, and customer teams to put them into practice through Infrastructure as Code and automation. The result is a coherent, well-governed cloud foundation that product teams can build on with confidence.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve reference architectures and design patterns across AWS, GCP, and Azure covering compute, storage, networking, identity, and data services that product teams reuse.
* Establish architectural standards and guardrails for security, resilience, and cost efficiency, and ensure they are applied consistently across the product portfolio.
* Translate architectural decisions into Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines so designs are repeatable, versioned, and easy to adopt.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction on design trade-offs, with a focus on security posture, reliability, and total cost of ownership.
* Partner with Security to embed controls into platform designs, including identity and access management, encryption, network segmentation, and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Partner with FinOps to design cost-aware architectures, set tagging and accountability standards, and build cost efficiency into solutions from the start rather than as an afterthought.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture leaders to establish architecture patterns and best practices across the Enterprise.
* Define standards for observability and operational readiness so that solutions are monitored, supportable, and resilient in production.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to product teams, mentoring engineers and guiding them in adopting standardized cloud patterns and best practices.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with at least 6 years in a cloud architecture role designing solutions on AWS and/or GCP.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of core cloud services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and data, with the ability to design solutions that are secure, resilient, and cost effective.
* Proven experience defining reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails that multiple teams adopt and reuse.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and version control (GitHub), including how to structure code for reuse across teams.
* Deep expertise in cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code approaches to governance.
* Proven ability to document, communicate, and govern complex designs, and to influence technical direction across multiple teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting across multiple cloud providers in a large enterprise spanning multiple business units and geographies.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tooling, and a track record of building cost efficiency into architectural decisions.
* Exposure to cloud governance frameworks such as AWS Control Tower or GCP Organization Policies, and to policy-as-code tooling.
* Professional certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction across large enterprise organizations.

title: Senior HR Executive- Immediate Joiner Only
description:
**Note : Immediate Joiner Only**

**The role**

You will be the owner of the HR function at Enview.ai . This is a hands-on generalist role in a growing company: you will build processes where none exist and execute them yourself.

Recruitment comes first in this role: Enview.ai hires continuously across field, sales and software teams, and we need someone who can personally source and close people, not just run the process.

Reporting to the Founder, you will run recruitment, payroll inputs, statutory compliance, employee relations and HR operations end to end for a workforce deployed across India.

**Location:** Whitefield, Bengaluru (on-site) · **Type:** Full-time · **Reports to:** Founder

**Key responsibilities**

**Recruitment & onboarding**

* Own hiring end to end: field technicians, pre-sales and network engineers, sales, software engineers and data-labeling/annotation staff across India - sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and closures.
* Build pipelines for each talent pool: job portals, referrals and institute tie-ups for ITI/diploma technicians and CCTV/network engineers; LinkedIn, campus and referral channels for software, data-labeling and sales roles.
* Run background and police verification for staff deployed at sensitive customer sites (defence, banking, judiciary, atomic energy) and keep verification records audit-ready for tenders.
* Onboard new joiners: documentation, ESI/PF enrolment, induction, tools and safety briefing for field staff.
* Track hiring metrics- time-to-hire, offer acceptance, source effectiveness, joining ratios- and give hiring managers clear, timely updates on every open role.

**Payroll, compliance & HR administration**

* Own monthly payroll inputs- attendance, leave, overtime, travel and site allowances.
* Manage statutory compliance with our external partners- EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, Gratuity, Karnataka S&E Act, CLRA — keeping challans, registers and returns accurate and on time.
* Maintain compliance documentation (challans, registers, returns) required for government and PSU tender submissions.
* Maintain employee records, contracts, offer and relieving letters in the HRMS.
* Build SOPs, checklists and templates so routine HR work runs consistently through the team.
* Maintain a simple HR dashboard- headcount, open roles, attrition, probation status. Update leadership regularly on staffing risks and compliance deadlines.

**Performance, training & safety**

* Run the appraisal cycle- scheduling, documentation, follow-through. Support managers on reviews and feedback.
* Coordinate technical certification and OEM training (e.g., CCTV, networking, cybersecurity partners) and track skill development.
* Monitor site-safety compliance for field staff: PPE, work-at-height norms, incident reporting.
* Run probation reviews and confirmations; conduct exit interviews and analyse attrition patterns to improve retention.

**Employee relations & engagement**

* Be the first point of contact for office and field employees on policies, pay queries and grievances; resolve issues quickly and fairly.
* Keep field staff connected: regular check-ins with site-deployed engineers, clear escalation paths, timely reimbursements.
* Run engagement initiatives, celebrations and recognition suited to a small, distributed team.

**What we're looking for**

* 4–6 years of HR experience with recruitment at its core, including at least a year running recruitment independently.
* A track record of personally sourcing and closing difficult roles, not just coordinating the process; experience in a system integrator, engineering services or similar field-workforce company strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance: EPF, ESI, PT, Gratuity, POSH, Karnataka S&E Act; exposure to compliance paperwork for government/PSU tenders is a big plus.
* Comfortable with an HRMS/payroll tool (e.g., Keka, greytHR, Zoho People) and an ATS; strong Excel.
* High integrity with confidential information; organized, proactive, and comfortable leading a two-person team while staying hands-on yourself.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

**Compensation & benefits**

* Provident Fund and statutory benefits (ESI/gratuity as applicable)
* Paid time off and paid sick leave
* Health insurance
* A role with real ownership: you build the HR function, directly with the founder

Pay: ₹420,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

title: Application Engineer III
description:
**About India Sales Support CoE**

### **India Sales Support CoE organization entails of 792+ engineers supporting Johnson's Controls branches across the world for 20+ years. We are a global organization with field experiences across the different markets right from Asia to North America, Europe to Latin America, and the Middle East. The collected diverse experience in one single organization enables us to be an effective partner for our JCI branches. This engineering organization offers controls, Security & Fire and Energy solution.**

**About Fire & Security Business**

10+ years of wide JCI/Tyco and third-party system knowledge for design, detailed engineering and implementation of Fire Protection and Suppression system. Team provides the services and value-added solutions for the system and provides onsite & remote engineering support across the globe for engineering.

**What you will do**

The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire protection & Suppression opportunities from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various such as Fire Sprinkler, Hydrant, water spray, foam and gas suppression Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.

**How you will do it:**

* Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
* Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
* Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
* Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
* Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
* Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
* Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
* Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
* Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

**What we look for**

* BE (Mechanical / Electrical)
* Must have 6+ years of relevant experience in Fire Protection & Suppression Systems domains.
* Strong knowledge of Fire Protection & Suppression Systems (Fire Sprinkler, Pre-action system, Water spray, standpipe & hose system, Hydrant network, Fire water storage, Stationary pumps, Foam suppression, water mist system, Kitchen hood system, Gas Suppression – FM, Novec, Inergen & Co2 etc.).
* Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
* Must have presales and estimation experience on various verticals (Transportation, Commercial, Fit-outs, Industries, Data Centers, etc.).
* Capable of performing hydraulic and flow calculation and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
* Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
* Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
* Must build a strong network with the 3rd party vendors regionally specific.
* Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Must be a good team player.

**Preferred**

* Experienced in designing Fire Protection & Suppression systems (fire hydrant, sprinkler, HVWS, MVWS, Foam, Water Mist, Gas Suppression) per NFPA, BSEN, Vds, TAC, and NBC norms.
* Proficient in hydraulic and flow calculations using SprinkCAD, Fire-CAD, ANSUL, and HYGOOD.
* Preparing the bill of quantity (BOQ) & material track sheet as per approved / shop drawings and material technical data sheet.
* Coordination with consultants / clients for contractual clarifications and to get the approval of design.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Sprink CAD, Fire CAD, Navis and Excel.

title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.
* Production discipline — testing in a lab tenant first, ring-based release, blast-radius awareness, and the habit of asking "what does this do to 50,000 people" before pressing apply.
* Clear technical writing — runbooks, knowledge articles and design notes others can actually follow.
* Ownership — sees an item through to working in production and stays with it when it misbehaves afterwards.
* Curiosity and self-direction — reads release notes, tests in a lab, and brings improvement ideas to refinement unprompted.
* Collaboration — works well with product, architecture, security and the service desk; explains technical constraint without condescension.
* User empathy — remembers that a policy setting is somebody's Monday morning.

**Skills**

Access Control (AC), Agile Methodology, Cisco Routing, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Data Migration Testing, Microsoft Office 365, Operator Interfaces, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

description:
**Job Title: Lead Specialist, Network Engineer**

  
  

**About the role:**

  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to join our team as we continue to modernize and evolve our global network infrastructure. Built on a strong and well-managed Cisco Meraki foundation, we are actively expanding our Zero Trust architecture and cloud security capabilities through Zscaler.

  
  

As a Network Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our network by helping to drive initiatives that improve connectivity, security, resiliency, and operational efficiency across the organization. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern enterprise networking technologies, participate in large-scale infrastructure projects, and help guide the transition toward cloud-delivered security and Zero Trust networking.

  
  

This role offers a unique blend of day-to-day operational support, network architecture, project delivery, and next-generation security technologies. If you're passionate about networking, security, automation, and solving complex technical challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

  
  

**Position Summary**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and support enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of Cisco and Meraki networking technologies, cloud security platforms, routing and switching, and end-user connectivity troubleshooting. This role requires hands-on experience with network design, deployment, and operational support, as well as the ability to travel to company locations as needed.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meraki Wireless Access Points
  
  
* Meraki MS Switching
  
  
* Meraki MX Security Appliances
  
  
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco networking equipment, including:
  
  
* Cisco Routers
  
  
* Cisco Catalyst Switches
  
  
* Cisco ASA Firewalls
  
  
* Administer and support Zscaler cloud security solutions, including:
  
  
* Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
  
  
* Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
  
  
* Zero Trust Branch (ZTB)
  
  
* Zscaler Branch Architecture (ZBA)

* Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot routing protocols, including:
  
  
* BGP
  
  
* EIGRP
  
  
* OSPF
  
  
* Perform network capacity planning, architecture reviews, and infrastructure design.
  
  
* Lead network installations, upgrades, migrations, and refresh projects.
  
  
* Troubleshoot network, wireless, routing, switching, VPN, and security-related issues.
  
  
* Diagnose and resolve connectivity and performance issues affecting:
  
  
* Windows clients
  
  
* macOS clients
  
  
* Coordinate network equipment procurement, asset lifecycle management, and vendor engagement.
  
  
* Work with service providers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver network solutions.
  
  
* Create and maintain network diagrams, standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation.
  
  
* Participate in network incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
  
  
* Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations that improve network performance, security, and operational efficiency.
  
  
* Support automation initiatives and continuously improve operational processes.
  
  
* Provide after-hours support and participate in an on-call rotation as required.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
  
  
* 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Cisco Meraki solutions, including wireless, switching, and MX security appliances.
  
  
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco routers, switches, and ASA firewalls.
  
  
* Experience administering Zscaler security platforms, including ZIA, ZPA, ZTB, and ZBA.
  
  
* Strong understanding of:
  
  
* TCP/IP
  
  
* DNS
  
  
* DHCP
  
  
* VLANs
  
  
* VPNs
  
  
* Network Security
  
  
* Wireless Networking
  
  
* Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting:
  
  
* BGP
  
  
* EIGRP
  
  
* OSPF
  
  
* Experience troubleshooting network-related issues on both Windows and macOS endpoints.
  
  
* Experience with network architecture, deployment, and operational support.
  
  
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent certification.
  
  
* Cisco Meraki CMNA, ECMS, or related certifications.
  
  
* Zscaler certifications or experience with Zero Trust architectures.
  
  
* Experience with network automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar tools.
  
  
* Experience supporting cloud networking environments such as AWS or Azure.
  
  
* Familiarity with network monitoring, performance management, and troubleshooting tools.
  
  
* Experience supporting global or multi-site enterprise environments.
  
  
* Experience participating in network modernization and transformation initiatives.
  

  

**Travel Requirements**

* Site surveys
  
  
* Infrastructure upgrades
  
  
* Project deployments
  
  
* Troubleshooting and operational support

**What You'll Work On**

  
  

As part of our team, you'll help drive initiatives including:

  

  
* Expansion of our Zscaler-based Zero Trust architecture.
  
  
* Branch modernization leveraging Zero Trust Branch technologies.
  
  
* Global wireless, switching, and security refresh projects.
  
  
* Network automation and operational efficiency improvements.
  
  
* Cloud security and secure access transformation initiatives.

This is an opportunity to directly influence the future direction of our network and security architecture while working with industry-leading technologies in a collaborative, global environment.

  
  

**Technical Skills Summary**

**Infrastructure**

* Network Procurement and Equipment Ordering
  
  
* Network Installation and Deployment
  
  
* Network Documentation
  
  
* Vendor and Carrier Management
  
  
* Network Lifecycle Management
  

  

**Automation & Operations**

This version presents the role as more than a support position. It highlights the opportunity to be part of a strategic transformation from a traditional network model to a modern Meraki and Zscaler-based Zero Trust architecture, which tends to attract stronger senior-level candidates.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
  
  
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
  
  
As
**Senior Security Architect**
, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.
  
  
**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

**Qualifications**

Experience Required: 6–9+ Years
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.
* Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.
* Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.
* Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.
* Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.
* Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering
* Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.
* Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.
* Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.
* Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.
* Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering
* Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).
* Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.
* Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.
* Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.
* Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration
* Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.
* Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.
* Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.
* Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture
* Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).
* Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.
* Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.
* Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).
* Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning
* Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.
* Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.
* Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.
* Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.
* Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture
* Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.
* Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.
* Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.
* Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.
* Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship
* Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).
* Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.
* Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.
* Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

Key skills :
  
  
Backup strategies, disaster
  
  
Recovery plans
  
  
Performance tuning,
  
  
Capacity/resource planning
  
  
Data Restoration
  
  
System Upgrades
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.
* Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).

**Required Technical Skills**

* Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.
* OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.
* Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.
* High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.
* Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.
* Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.
* Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.
* Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.
* Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.
* Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).
* Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).
* Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.
* Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.
* Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.
* Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.
* Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models.
* Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability.
* Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).
* TOGAF, a cloud security certification (e.g. CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty) or GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying risk assessment methods such as ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800-30.
* Working knowledge of the NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk, and producing clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator-facing documentation.

Ability to lead and quality-assure the work of other engineers

Desired skills:

* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Knowledge of OT/ICS security concepts, the Purdue model and IEC 62443.
* Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. ServiceNow IRM, Archer).
* Experience with Ofgem or NIS-regulated cyber assurance activity.

Experience:

* 12+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.
* Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.
* Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.
* Experience working with multi-supplier environments and managed security service providers.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”

If you are an experienced Security Architect with a strong background in enterprise and CNI security architecture, and you enjoy shaping how critical services are secured, we encourage you to apply today.

description:
