Main location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad  
Position ID: J0926-1800  
Employment Type: Full Time  
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience  
  
Job Summary  
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years  
  
Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.  
  
Key skills :  
Backup strategies, disaster  
Recovery plans  
Performance tuning,  
Capacity/resource planning  
Data Restoration  
System Upgrades  
  
  
Required Qualifications  
  
. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.  
. Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.  
. Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).  
  
  
Required Technical Skills  
  
. Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.  
. OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.  
. Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.  
. High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.  
. Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.  
. Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.  
. Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.  
. Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.  
. Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
. IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.  
. Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).  
. Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).  
. Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.  
. ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.  
  
  
Key Competencies  
  
. Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.  
. Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.  
. Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.  
. Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

title: Network Development Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
As an Network Development Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you are an experienced Builder. You will own the design and delivery of automation systems that transform capacity restoration from a manual, labor-intensive process into a scalable, self-service operation. You will architect solutions, lead technical projects end-to-end, mentor NDEs, and partner with service teams to integrate restoration automation into the broader tooling ecosystem. This role demands strong software engineering skills, deep networking knowledge, and the ability to drive results across organizational boundaries.
  
  
Technical strategy is defined; component design is not. You are trusted with autonomy and are expected to make pragmatic trade-off decisions at product and component levels, identify and eliminate patterns affecting reliability and availability, and define and simplify team processes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Automation & System Design
  
  

* Own design and delivery of automation systems that restore out-of-service capacity with minimal manual intervention.
* Develop end-to-end link automation frameworks that transform manual troubleshooting into automated, system-guided restoration workflows.
* Build and improve centralized device health validation services for border, backbone, and regional network layers.
* Design self-service frameworks and next-step engines for automated troubleshooting and remediation.
* Architect solutions that are scalable, secure, maintainable, and extensible across a growing multi-timezone team.

Metrics & Monitoring
  
  

* Create and maintain the metrics and monitoring infrastructure for CRT: capacity out-of-service dashboards, burndown tracking, TTR, restoration success rate, and SLA compliance.
* Build systems to track and optimize bandwidth utilization trends, available capacity vs. projected peak, and redundancy coverage.
* Design automation to improve in-team resolution percentage and reduce escalation to Operations and Engineering teams.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Lead technical projects end-to-end; drive engineering best practices for development, testing, deployment, and operational excellence.
* Mentor NDEs; actively participate in hiring and conducting technical assessments.
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams to integrate restoration automation into the broader ecosystem.
* Identify and proactively address architectural or process deficiencies affecting restoration performance, reliability, and scalability.

Operations
  
  

* Participate in on-call rotations and operational reviews for follow-the-sun coverage.
* Lead complex incident response for capacity events; drive root-cause analysis and remediation for systemic failures.

A day in the life
  
  

* Review the capacity out-of-service dashboard; triage restoration priorities by customer impact and network health blocking status.
* Design and implement scalable automation to systematically restore capacity at fleet level (e.g., end-to-end link lifecycle automation).
* Solve complex network problems applying correct technologies and best practices; lead design reviews and architecture discussions for restoration tooling.
* Identify patterns affecting reliability/availability and drive them out through automation improvements.
* Partner with service teams to integrate self-service automation capabilities into the broader tooling ecosystem.
* Mentor engineers on software engineering best practices and system design.
* Participate in hiring, interview processes, and technical assessments for the team.
* Contribute to long-term technical strategy and automation roadmap; hand off active restoration work to your counterpart in the next time zone.

**About The Team**
The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end-to-end restoration of out-of-service inter-metro and intra-metro network capacity.
  
  
CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time-to-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
  
  
We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow-the-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
  
  
**About Aws**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* - 5+ years of experience in network development engineering, software engineering for networking, or network automation.
* - Proficiency in Python or another scripting/programming language for building network automation tools and services.
* - Experience with routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS) in large-scale network environments.
* - Experience designing and implementing automation for network operations at scale.
* - Experience with workflow orchestration systems and service-oriented architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of network hardware and packet forwarding architectures
* Experience working in a large-scale networking environment
* Experience building end-to-end network automation (link lifecycle management, device provisioning, health validation).
* Experience with network design and selecting platforms for implementation at hyperscale.
* Experience with workflow orchestration engines and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with distributed systems concepts applied to networking at scale.
* Experience building automation for large-scale networks with no scheduled downtime.
* Familiarity with deployment automation tools, link testing services, and operational event monitoring systems.
* Experience with data analysis and mining for operational insights.
* CCNP, JNCIP, or equivalent networking certification.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: System Administrator
description:
Winsupply is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Systems & Security Administrator (L2) with 2 to 4 years of experience to support our hybrid enterprise infrastructure and frontline security operations. In this role, you will safeguard core digital assets across multi-regional environments—monitoring endpoint and web application security events, deploying critical system patches, and responding to operational incidents. Alongside security monitoring, you will play a key role in maintaining system uptime, verifying data backups, and supporting database and network health. This is an excellent opportunity for a technical professional looking to expand their expertise across both enterprise systems administration and frontline SecOps within a collaborative global team.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our technical operations, ensuring high availability across servers, networks, and databases while executing critical backup routines and disaster recovery procedures. In addition, you will act as the frontline responder for security alerts (EDR/XDR and SIEM), vulnerability patching, and off-hours operational disruptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.Database Maintenance & Monitoring**

* Monitor relational database health, CPU utilization, disk space, memory utilization, connection pool limits, and blocking locks (e.g., DB2, SQL Server, MariaDB, or MongoDB).
* Track replication status, high-availability cluster health, and alert on replication lag or database service interruptions.
* Perform operational maintenance tasks including checking table bloat, space allocation, and executing standard service restart playbooks during scheduled off-hours.

**2.Backup, Disaster Recovery & Storage Management**

* Oversee and verify automated daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules across enterprise systems, databases, and cloud/on-premise storage.
* Actively investigate backup failures, resolve storage capacity bottlenecks, and re-trigger failed backup jobs.
* Participate in scheduled Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and execute routine restoration validations to ensure Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are strictly maintained.

**3.Network & Operating System Administration**

* Administer Windows Server and Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) environments, including user access, OS patching, disk space management, and system services.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including DNS resolution failures, DHCP scopes, routing issues, and VPN tunnel drops.
* Verify firewall traffic rules, monitor reverse proxy/load balancer health checks, and manage SSL/TLS certificate renewals to prevent service outages.

**4.Endpoint & Web Application Security Monitoring**

* Monitor enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Defender for Endpoint).
* Triage high-severity alerts, including
  **WildFire Malware**
  sandbox verifications,
  **Local Analysis Malware**
  , and suspicious process executions.
* Execute frontline containment procedures, including host network isolation and account lockdowns following established security playbooks.
* Monitor Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and API gateways for abnormal traffic spikes, suspicious request patterns, and Layer 7 anomalies.

**5.Vulnerability & System Patch Management**

* Track infrastructure and endpoint vulnerabilities across Linux, Windows, and third-party software.
* Plan, test, and deploy monthly OS patches, kernel updates, and critical security hotfixes during approved off-hours maintenance windows.
* Coordinate patch rollbacks and mitigation steps if updates conflict with production databases or application dependencies.

**6.Incident Response & SIEM Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary responder for off-hours system outages, database alerts, network interruptions, and high-priority security incidents.
* Monitor enterprise SIEM queues (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) for suspicious authentication attempts, brute-force patterns, and privilege escalation.
* Facilitate swift triage, coordinate with upstream engineering/DBA leads when needed, and lead post-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reporting.

**7.Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, and shift handover records.
* Track and report on key operational SLAs, including backup success rates, patch compliance percentages, and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

**Candidate Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Support, or an integrated SysAdmin / SecOps role.
* **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **OS & Networking:**
  Proficient in Linux and Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, TCP/IP troubleshooting, and basic firewall configurations.
* **Database & Backups:**
  Hands-on experience checking database services and locks, combined with practical exposure to enterprise backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, AWS Backup, native DB dumps).
* **Security Tools:**
  Practical familiarity with EDR/XDR consoles (Palo Alto Cortex XDR preferred) and SIEM alert monitoring.
* **Scripting (Advantageous):**
  Working knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, or Python to automate basic health checks and log reviews.
* **Work Style:**
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset under incident conditions.
* **Flexibility:**
  Willingness to work in rotational shifts and participate in scheduled off-hours/weekend on-call rotations.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Associate or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, or (ISC)² SSCP are preferred.
* Familiarity with web application security concepts and common vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* Basic scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and log processing are a plus.
* Experience operating within a SIEM or Security Operations Center (SOC) environment is advantageous.

description:
**About Signant Health**

We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.
  
  
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work-arounds and resolution of reported issues.
* Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run.
* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right-size servers and services.
* Migrate on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
**Essential:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.

**Desirable:**

* 5+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

title: Elastic Engineer
description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\_cat, \_cluster, \_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

Access and security
  
  

* Kibana spaces, RBAC, roles and role mapping (SAML, LDAP, AD)
* TLS and certificate management for the stack

Cloud, containers and networking
  
  

* AWS basics (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) and Azure basics
* VPC concepts: subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs
* Network connectivity options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, load balancers
* EKS and Kubernetes operations, including ECK
* Senior level: AWS architecture in depth, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail and cross-account logging

Automation and DevOps (Senior Engineer and Operations Lead)
  
  

* Hands-on Python for automation against Elastic APIs
* CI/CD setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Terraform and infrastructure as code; Git-based workflows
* A track record of automations delivered, e.g. upgrade automation, onboarding automation, health-check scripts

Operations practice (Operations roles; valued for all)
  
  

* Ticket handling within SLA in ServiceNow, Jira or similar
* Incident calls, Sev1 triage and escalation handling
* RCA findings and write-ups; runbook and knowledge-base upkeep
* ITIL incident, problem and change processes
* Willingness to work 24×7 rotational shifts from office

Good to have
  
  

* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Observability Engineer
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional); HashiCorp Terraform Associate; ITIL v4 Foundation
* Exposure to Elastic Security (SIEM) and detection rules
* Azure log sources and networking (Event Hub, Azure Monitor)
* Linux administration and shell scripting

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
* Clear written and spoken communication for tickets, RCAs and stakeholder updates

title: SAP PI - CI Engineer [T500-30335]
description:
**About Costco Wholesale:**

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.

Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale.

**Position Summary:**

The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of SAP Process Integration and SAP particularly Cloud Integration (CPI) and API Management along with a strong understanding of modern enterprise architecture and integration best practices. The SAP PI/CI Engineer is responsible for the design, build, testing, implementation, and environment support of SAP BTP Integration solutions and associated application components. In this role, you will design and develop interfaces using SAP as the middleware tool, delivering SAP integration solutions for hybrid scenarios using integration protocols and adapters (SFTP, SOAP, REST, etc.). They will work with the SAP Functional Team and non-SAP application teams to ensure application designs follow the appropriate integration patterns and standards. You will also support application engineers, functional business specialists, and client team members to resolve issues and deliver enhancements.

* Lead efforts to design, develop, test, troubleshooting and maintenance of integration components for applications and systems. SAP APIs, web services, and middleware platforms.

* Collaborate with stakeholders, Solution Architects, and Engineers to design and implement efficient and scalable integration solutions based on business requirements, and provide guidance on integration best practices.
* Identify and resolve integration issues, system errors, and performance bottlenecks.
* Monitor and maintain integration landscapes, ensuring smooth data flow and providing support for system integrations and process orchestration.
* Document integration designs, configurations, and processes for future reference and knowledge sharing.
* Works independently and within a team environment.
* Pays attention to detail, self motivated with the ability to follow instructions and completes assignments on time.
* Learns and applies new concepts, processes, and tools.

* Understand, refine and comply with integration patterns, standards, guidelines, and best practices.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry trends and standards.
* Ability to lead small teams of contractors and mentor junior Engineers.
* Build and maintain a solid understanding of the application areas and the business areas they support.
* Takes initiative to solve problems and multi-tasks by prioritizing projects and deadlines.
* Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders, and all levels of management.
* Work with PI/CI team members and prepare system documentation, training material, and configuration and process documentation.
* Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location.

**Experience, skills, education & licenses/certifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Business, or another related technical discipline.
* Experience with Integration suite and CPI.
* 10+ years of experience developing interfaces using SAP , PI/CI, ABAP, and APIs.
* Skilled in interface design and development using SAP as the middleware tool.
* Experience linking SAP to both SAP and multiple non-SAP systems.
* Experience coordinating full lifecycle SAP implementations from preparation through go live and operations.
* Experience with protocols and formats such as flat file, SFTP, SOAP, REST, RFC, IDoc, etc.
* Knowledge of SAP IDoc processing and monitoring services.
* Knowledge of REST architecture/technology and experience with REST/OData adapters.
* Working knowledge of SAP finance-related business processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport and supports understanding among both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to analyze problems and provide clear recommendation
* Hands on experience working with business users and Solution Architects to determine integration requirements, develop and test PI/CI interfaces.
* Experience with Groovy and JAVA Scripting.
* Experience in the configuration of adapters such as JMS, SFTP, SOAP, IDOC, Proxy, FTPS, web services, and iFlows.
* Experience working in and administering a multi-tenant PI/CI Environment.
* Experience with CTS+ transport management and alert configuration.
* Experience in integration with SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors with On-premise solutions.
* Experience in setting up Keystore, generating SSL certificates and SSH Tokens.
* Must be self-motivated, responsible, conscientious, and detail-oriented.
* Must have proven ability to set and follow priorities and timeline.
* Ability to develop repeatable development processes with supporting documentation.
* Must have the ability to build lasting trusted partnerships across various functional areas and technical disciplines. Able to support off-hours work as required, including weekends, holidays, and 24/7 on call responsibilities on a rotational basis
* International travel may be required

**Recommended:**

* Experience with SAP PI/CI 7.4 or higher.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Connector.
* Experience with BPM design and modeling. optional
* Experience integrating custom and package products across complex enterprise environments.
* Working understanding of security standards such as SAML, XACML, MASSL, and OATH.
* Successful internal candidates will have spent one year or more on their current team

**Other Conditions:**

* Management will review the Job Analysis for this CIsition prior to a job offer

title: Sr. Service Operations Engineer
description:
Lead Support Operations Engineer
  
  
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology & Ancillary Clinical Systems**
**About The Role**
Providence Global Center is seeking an experienced Lead Support Operations Engineer to lead reliable, secure and efficient support for
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and other ancillary clinical applications**
. The role combines hands-on L2/L3 technical ownership with operational leadership, service governance, major-incident coordination, problem management, change oversight and team capability development. The engineer will partner with clinical stakeholders, product teams, infrastructure teams, vendors and senior engineers to maintain application availability, protect patient-care workflows and drive continual service improvement across on-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
  
  
**Role Outcomes The Role Is Accountable For**

* Stable and resilient clinical application services with effective monitoring, incident response and recovery.
* Consistent SLA performance, clear operational ownership and timely stakeholder communication.
* Reduced recurring incidents through root cause analysis, problem elimination, automation and knowledge reuse.
* Controlled delivery of patches, upgrades, interface changes and production deployments.
* Strong team readiness through work allocation, technical coaching, documentation and succession coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Service Operations Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day support operations across Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and ancillary clinical applications.
* Provide technical direction for L2/L3 incidents, complex service requests, application defects and workflow disruptions.
* Prioritise work based on clinical impact, urgency, risk and agreed service levels; coordinate workload across the support team.
* Maintain operational readiness, support coverage, escalation paths, runbooks and handover practices.
* Review service performance, ageing work, repeat incidents, backlog, availability risks and improvement actions with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Clinical Workflow & Application Support**

* Support end-to-end clinical workflows, including laboratory order-to-result processes, medication-management workflows, imaging order-to-report processes and associated ancillary-service workflows.
* Translate clinical and operational impact into clear technical investigation, restoration and follow-up actions.
* Partner with clinical SMEs and business stakeholders to validate workflow behaviour, configuration changes and recovery outcomes.
* Ensure support decisions consider patient-care continuity, data integrity, operational safety and downstream system dependencies.

**3. Integrations, Interfaces & Data Exchange**

* Lead troubleshooting of integrations among clinical applications, medical devices or instruments, middleware, interface engines, EHR platforms and downstream systems.
* Investigate HL7 message failures, queue backlogs, interface interruptions, data mismatches and mapping issues using logs and monitoring tools.
* Support clinical terminology, coding and mapping where applicable, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Coordinate with interface, infrastructure, network, database, security, vendor and application teams to restore and stabilise services.

**4. Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management**

* Own or coordinate high-impact incidents from triage through service restoration, validation, communication and closure.
* Provide concise technical updates, impact statements, recovery status and decision points during major incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant issues and track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify opportunities to automate, correct or eliminate repeat work and reduce avoidable support demand.

**5. Change, Release & Environment Management**

* Assess operational readiness and risk for application changes, patches, upgrades, cloud migrations and integration releases.
* Coordinate implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, support coverage and post-deployment verification.
* Support environment health, configuration consistency and production-readiness checks across on-premises and Azure Cloud services.
* Ensure changes follow applicable ITIL, security, compliance and change-management controls.

**6. Monitoring, Reliability & Continual Improvement**

* Strengthen proactive monitoring, alert quality, service dashboards and early-warning indicators for critical clinical applications.
* Analyse incident trends, recurring failure patterns and operational bottlenecks; recommend measurable improvements.
* Promote automation, self-service, standardisation and knowledge-centred support to improve reliability and team efficiency.
* Contribute to service continuity, disaster recovery testing and operational resilience activities.

**7. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Coach support engineers on technical troubleshooting, clinical workflows, incident ownership, documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Delegate work with clear accountability; review technical quality and support the team during complex escalations.
* Build cross-training and backup coverage across supported applications and domain workflows.
* Work closely with SMEs, product owners, developers, vendors and cross-functional teams across geographies.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, known-error records, support models and troubleshooting guides.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of application support or service operations experience, including ownership of complex or business-critical applications.
* Strong experience supporting one or more clinical domains such as Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology or ancillary clinical systems, with the ability to build cross-domain knowledge.
* Demonstrated L2/L3 troubleshooting experience across applications, interfaces, middleware, logs, infrastructure dependencies and data flows.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging, interface support and integrations among clinical applications, devices or instruments, middleware and EHR systems.
* Understanding of clinical terminology, coding or mapping standards where relevant, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Experience with incident, major incident, problem, change and release management in an ITIL-aligned environment.
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and on-premises application environments, including monitoring, availability and operational support concepts.
* Experience leading technical investigations, coordinating cross-functional teams and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, documentation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, distribute work, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a 24x7 support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple clinical application domains or enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with interface engines, clinical middleware, medical-device integrations, PACS/RIS, pharmacy platforms or LIS/LIMS solutions.
* Experience with scripting, workflow automation, observability tools or service-management reporting.
* Participation in application upgrades, cloud migrations, disaster-recovery exercises or major clinical go-lives.
* ITIL, Azure, healthcare interoperability or relevant vendor/product certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams and external vendors in a regulated healthcare environment.

**Core Competencies**
**Technical & Domain**
**Operational Leadership**
**Ways of Working**

* Clinical application support
* HL7 and integration troubleshooting
* Cloud and on-premises operations
* Monitoring and reliability
* Major-incident coordination
* Problem elimination
* Change and release oversight
* Risk-based prioritisation
* Clinical stakeholder partnership
* Coaching and delegation
* Clear executive communication
* Knowledge sharing and collaboration

**Success Measures**

* Service availability, SLA achievement and timely restoration of clinically significant incidents.
* Reduction in repeat incidents, ageing backlog and avoidable support demand.
* Quality and completion of root cause, corrective action, change validation and operational-readiness activities.
* Improved monitoring coverage, documentation quality, automation adoption and cross-training readiness.
* Stakeholder confidence in service ownership, communication and operational follow-through.

**Note:**
The 8-12 year experience range is recommended to reflect the expanded lead-level scope and should be aligned with the organisation's approved job architecture before publication. Product-specific requirements may be added based on the final application portfolio.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role description**

Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)

Location: UST Hyderabad

Type: Full time, in-house

About the role

Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write

audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green

deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.

We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You

will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.

What you will do

Architecture and roadmap

* + Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.

* + Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.

* + Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.

* + Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security

* + Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).

* + Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.

* + Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate

* + Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.

* + Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.

* + Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.

* + Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.

Work with others

* + Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.

* + Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.

* + Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring

Experience

* + 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.

* + You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.

* + You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical

* + AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.

* + Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.

* + Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.

* + Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.

* + Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.

* + Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working

* + You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.

* + You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.

* + You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)

* + AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional

* + Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

* + A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have

* + Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.

* + Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.

* + FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.

* + Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.

2.Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.

3.A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.

4.The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.

5.Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

  
**Skills**

AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Support Engineer
description:
Our client is a technology company in the infrastructure-reliability space, helping enterprises keep modern infrastructure, AI workloads and hybrid clouds running reliably. Its customers depend on that reliability, so the support desk that answers them has to be fast and technically sharp.

**Softelite Technologies** is a software development company. You will be employed by Softelite and placed with one of our clients as part of a dedicated 24/7 support team.

**Key responsibilities**

* Monitor the Zendesk queue and answer inbound support calls; give every ticket or call a first response within 15 minutes.
* Triage each issue by severity and impact, and collect the details needed to act: logs, timestamps, affected cluster, node or VM.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes issues with kubectl: pod and node status, events, logs, restarts, and failures such as CrashLoopBackOff, Pending and ImagePullBackOff.
* Troubleshoot virtual machines and Linux hosts: connectivity, disk, CPU, memory, services and log review.
* Resolve known issues using runbooks and the knowledge base, and follow documented procedures exactly.
* Escalate to L2/L3 with a complete summary (symptoms, steps tried, evidence) when an issue is beyond runbook scope.
* Keep customers updated in Zendesk and on calls until the issue is resolved or handed off.
* Write clear shift-handover notes so the next shift picks up open tickets without gaps.
* Flag SLA risks, repeat incidents and knowledge-base gaps to the team lead.

**Must-have skills**

Candidates without hands-on Kubernetes, VM and Linux experience will not be considered.

**Kubernetes**

Use kubectl to get, describe and read logs for pods, deployments, services and nodes; read cluster events; spot why a pod is failing; restart or scale a workload under a runbook; know namespaces, ConfigMaps and Secrets

**Virtual machines**

Check VM state, start, stop and reboot, reach the console or SSH, and diagnose network, disk and resource problems on VMware, KVM or cloud VMs (AWS, Azure or GCP)

**Linux commands**

Work fluently in the shell: ls, cd, cat, grep, awk, sed, tail, find, ps, top, df, du, free, ss or netstat, systemctl, journalctl, chmod, chown, ssh, curl, ping, dig, traceroute

**Ticketing and calls**

Work a queue in Zendesk or a similar tool, write clear updates, and handle live customer calls calmly

**Communication**

Fluent spoken and written English

**Good-to-have skills and qualifications**

* Docker and Helm; basic CI/CD awareness
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog
* Basic networking: DNS, TCP/IP, load balancers, firewalls
* Bash or Python scripting for routine checks
* Certifications: CKA, CKAD, RHCSA, AWS Cloud Practitioner or Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL foundation and incident-management experience
* Exposure to AI or GPU workloads

**Education:** Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What we look for in a person:** calm under pressure, disciplined about SLAs, a clear communicator on calls and in writing, willing to follow runbooks, and honest about when to escalate.

**Shift and working model**

The support desk runs 24/7, covered by a team of eight. Each engineer works one shift at a time (about 9 hours, 5 days a week) on a rotation, with rotational weekly offs. Candidates must be comfortable with night and weekend shifts and must be reachable and online from the first minute of every shift, because of the 15-minute response SLA.

title: RFIC Engineer
description:
Role Overview

* Design and develop RF and microwave integrated circuits from specification through simulation, layout, verification, GDSII preparation, and post-fabrication evaluation.
* Work on power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, and other RF front-end/MMIC/RFIC building blocks under the guidance of senior designers, with increasing independent ownership.
* Contribute to customer-specific and product-specific designs by converting defined RF requirements into circuit-level implementations.
* This is a hands-on design role for engineers who want early ownership of real semiconductor development rather than simulation-only work.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand product and customer requirements and convert them into circuit-level design targets with guidance from senior engineers.
* Design RF/MMIC/RFIC circuit blocks, including power amplifiers, LNAs, and related RF front-end circuits.
* Perform schematic capture and RF circuit simulation using industry-standard design tools.
* Perform S-parameter, harmonic-balance, stability, compression, gain, efficiency, noise, and other relevant analyses.
* Design impedance-matching networks, bias networks, RF passives, and supporting circuitry.
* Optimize designs across frequency and relevant process, voltage, temperature, and operating-condition variations.
* Perform EM simulation of RF structures and include parasitic and distributed effects in circuit verification.
* Create and refine MMIC/RFIC layouts with attention to grounding, coupling, parasitics, current handling, symmetry, and thermal constraints.
* Execute DRC, LVS, and other foundry-required physical verification.
* Perform post-layout and EM-aware simulation and participate in design sign-off reviews.
* Prepare designs and associated documentation for GDSII release under senior review.
* Support post-fabrication characterization and compare measured performance with simulation.
* Debug design issues methodically and propose corrective actions based on simulation and measurement data.
* Prepare clear design notes, simulation reports, and technical presentations.
* Participate actively in schematic, layout, verification, and tapeout reviews.
* Progress toward independent ownership of complete RF blocks and smaller MMIC developments.

Required Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech., or MS in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, Microelectronics, or a closely related discipline.
* 1–3 years of relevant RFIC/MMIC, RF/analog IC, or microwave circuit design experience.
* Strong understanding of S-parameters, impedance matching, transmission lines, gain, noise, stability, nonlinear behavior, P1dB, IP3, RF power, efficiency, and passive RF networks.
* Hands-on experience using an RF/MMIC design environment such as Keysight ADS, Cadence Virtuoso, or Cadence/AWR Microwave Office.
* Practical design exposure to at least one RF circuit such as a PA, LNA, driver, switch, attenuator, mixer, phase shifter, or related front-end block.
* Understanding of IC layout and the effect of parasitics, grounding, coupling, and physical implementation on RF performance.
* Exposure to EM simulation using Momentum, HFSS, EMX, Sonnet, CST, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical ability and willingness to debug designs from first principles rather than rely only on tool optimization.
* Ability to document and communicate technical work clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with GaN or GaAs MMIC design.
* Experience with RF power-amplifier or LNA design.
* Participation in at least one IC/MMIC tapeout.
* Experience taking a circuit from schematic through layout and physical verification.
* Familiarity with PDK-based design, DRC/LVS, and GDSII generation.
* Hands-on RF measurement experience using VNAs, spectrum analysers, signal generators, power meters, probe stations, or related equipment.
* Exposure to post-layout/EM co-simulation and simulation-to-silicon correlation.
* Basic understanding of semiconductor device physics relevant to RF design and foundry process limitations.

What We Expect From This Role

* Strong fundamentals and curiosity about why a circuit behaves as it does, not just whether a simulation converges.
* Ability to take ownership of an RF block, carry it through implementation, and respond constructively to design-review feedback.
* A disciplined approach to simulation, layout, verification, documentation, and measurement correlation.
* Clear progression toward independent ownership of increasingly complete MMIC/RFIC designs.

Pay: ₹329,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Support, maintain, and improve third-party Enterprise Applications infrastructure through platform operations, administration, automation, monitoring, and cross-team delivery.
* Own assigned operational activities with increasing independence while following approved standards and partnering with senior engineers on complex issues, platform improvements, and project delivery.
* Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve repeatability, reliability, and support efficiency.
* Work closely with senior team members, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors to deliver stable services and build technical capability across E-Apps operations.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Platform operations: Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.
* Administration and maintenance: Perform platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, service management, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.
* Web and application platforms: Administer and troubleshoot IIS, JBoss, and Apache, including application hosting, configuration, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, service restarts, and basic Java application troubleshooting.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Work with GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.
* Automation: Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.
* Observability and performance: Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.
* Incident and ITSM support: Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.
* Project delivery: Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.
* Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Collaboration: Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.
* Support Requirement: Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.
* GCP and infrastructure: Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.
* Middleware and platform administration: Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.
* Operating systems and databases: Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Monitoring and operations: Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.
* ITSM and collaboration: Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Core proficiency: Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.
* Project methodology: Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.
* Continuous improvement: Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.
* Professional behaviors: Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: TC-CS-CDR-Infrastructure Security-Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Lead complex Infrastructure Security and Cloud Security consulting engagements across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Drive security transformation, Zero Trust initiatives, architecture modernization, governance programs, and client advisory while owning delivery, commercials, and people leadership.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
