* Define secure architectures covering Network Security, Zero Trust, SASE, IAM, PAM, and Hybrid Cloud Security.
* Oversee NGFW, WAF, segmentation, CSPM, CWPP, endpoint security, vulnerability management, and SIEM integration engagements.

* Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Zero Trust and SASE
* Infrastructure Security Architecture
* Network Security and Segmentation
* IAM and PAM
* Vulnerability Management
* Security Governance and Compliance
* Executive Stakeholder Management
* Pre-Sales and Solutioning
* Global Delivery Leadership

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

title: Customer Engineer II, Platform, Google Cloud
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience working with AI, building Agentic systems and AI based solutions.

**About the job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior SIEM Consultant
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats.
  
  
Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.
  
  
Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers
  
  
worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.
  
  
At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:
  
  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes
* Customer Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior SIEM Consultant position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of information security and networking and extensive experience interacting with customers. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.
  
  
**Primary Responsibility**

* Lead end-to-end SIEM implementation or integrations in a customer environment.
* Understand customer business requirements and the threat landscape applicable to their industry’s vertical sector to develop tailored use cases for security and Incident monitoring.
* Coordinate with customers to deploy collectors and agents in the on-premises network for data collection and forwarding.
* Work with customers to design and implement secure data flow into the Securonix cloud, following industry-standard best practices.
* Coordinate with service delivery managers, management, engineering, maintenance, and operational support teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Develop content, use cases, data models, dashboards, and connectors to support custom user requirements.
* Troubleshooting end-to-end network and infrastructure issues during data onboarding.
* Deploy and integrate the Securonix SOAR solution with the customer infrastructure for response orchestration.
* Engage with customers and internal product development teams to gather user requirements, suggest new product features, and help improve existing ones.
* Training and enabling customers and partners for successful adoption.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in information security and SIEM field.
* Strong understanding of SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Qradar, ArcSight, Logrhythm and Exabeam.
* Experience deploying SIEM acorss multiple customers.
* Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
* Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
* Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM

**Preferred**

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, CyberSecurity
* 3-4+ years of experience in UEBA deployment
* Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
* Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
* Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
* Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions
* Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump

**Benefits**
As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:
  
  

* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

Securonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
  
  
Securonix expressly prohibits any form of unlawful employee harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, genetic information, disability or veteran status. title: Server Load Balancer Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Remote Field Service Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, operating in region and is responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
  
  
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Maintains the support process and ensures that requests for support are handled according to the procedures.
* Uses service assurance software and tools to investigate and diagnose problems, collects performance statistics and creates reports, working with users, other staff and suppliers as appropriate.
* Identifies and resolves problems following agreed procedures.
* Carries out agreed maintenance tasks.
* Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
* Performs defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information.
* Analyses service records against agreed service levels regularly to identify actions required to maintain or improve levels of service, and initiates or reports these actions.

• **Continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.

• **Collaboration:** Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations**
will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies.
**12 to 16 years**
of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise
  
  
**Role**
The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:
  
  

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In This Role, You Will**
1. Service Ownership and Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.
* Architecture and Design Governance
* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.
* Technology and Engineering Leadership

Maintain Sufficient Technical Depth To Guide Engineering Teams, Challenge Vendor Recommendations, Approve Designs And Support Critical Escalations Across The Following Domains
  
  
**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging
* Operations, Delivery and Problem Management
* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**
**Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Job Title: Linux Administrator (AWS Cloud Migration)**

**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid)**

**Shift Time: 2PM-11PM IST / 3PM-12AM IST**

**Key responsibilities**

**Discovery and planning**

* Inventory on-prem Linux servers (RHEL), applications, dependencies, storage and network flows using tools such as AWS Application Discovery Service or Migration Evaluator.
* Classify workloads by migration strategy (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire) and group them into migration waves.
* Define target-state designs: instance sizing, OS versions, EBS/EFS/FSx storage, VPC placement and security groups.

**Migration execution**

* Migrate servers with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), plus rsync, LVM snapshots or image-based methods where needed.
* Move file shares and data using AWS DataSync, Snowball or S3 transfer as appropriate.
* Upgrade or re-platform legacy OS versions (e.g., RHEL ) during migration.
* Plan and run cutovers, including DNS changes, rollback plans and post-migration validation with application owners.

**AWS Linux operations**

* Build, patch and maintain Linux on EC2 using AMIs, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command) and Auto Scaling.
* Manage users, sudo, SSH keys and directory integration (Active Directory / SSSD / AWS Managed Microsoft AD).
* Monitor health and performance with CloudWatch metrics, logs and alarms; tune kernel, memory, disk I/O and network settings.
* Set up backup and DR with AWS Backup, EBS snapshots and cross-region copies; test restores.

**Automation and infrastructure as code**

* Provision infrastructure with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate configuration and builds with Ansible, Bash and Python; build golden AMIs with EC2 Image Builder or Packer.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or CodePipeline) for infrastructure changes.

**Security and compliance**

* Apply CIS benchmarks and OS hardening; manage IAM roles and instance profiles on least privilege.
* Encrypt data at rest and in transit (KMS, TLS); manage secrets with Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.
* Support audits with evidence from CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub and Inspector.

**Hypercare and handover**

* Provide post-cutover support, resolve incidents and drive root-cause analysis.
* Write runbooks, architecture diagrams and SOPs; hand over to steady-state operations teams.
* Track cost and right-size instances using Cost Explorer and Compute Optimizer.

**Required qualifications**

* 6+ years administering enterprise Linux (RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) in production.
* 2+ years hands-on with AWS: EC2, VPC, EBS, EFS, S3, IAM, Route 53, ELB, CloudWatch and Systems Manager.
* Completed at least one on-prem to AWS migration, including server rehost with AWS MGN or an equivalent tool.
* Strong troubleshooting across boot, kernel, filesystems (LVM, XFS, ext4), networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalld/iptables) and performance.
* Scripting in Bash and Python; configuration management with Ansible.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of VMware or other on-prem virtualization as a migration source.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and change management (ITIL, ServiceNow or Jira).

**Preferred qualifications**

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Solutions Architect – Associate (Professional level a plus).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Engineer (RHCE).
* Familiarity with the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and the Well-Architected Framework.
* Exposure to containers (Docker, Amazon ECS or EKS) and serverless services.
* Experience migrating databases or middleware hosted on Linux (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Tomcat, JBoss, Apache, NGINX).

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented
**Installation & Commissioning Engineer**

to oversee the deployment, integration, and testing of
**SCADA systems**

and
**Weather Monitoring Systems (WMS)**

across our utility-scale solar power plants. In this role, you will bridge the gap between field construction and digital operations, ensuring all control systems, data loggers, network switches, and environmental sensors are physically installed correctly, networked properly, and communicating seamlessly with the central monitoring platform.

**Travel: Willingness to travel extensively to remote project sites (up to 70-80% travel required).**

**Key Responsibilities**

**SCADA & Network Commissioning**

  **SCADA hardware**
  , including RTUs, PLCs, network switches, and fiber-optic communication networks.

  **Point-to-Point (P2P) testing**
  , loop checking, and signal mapping between field devices (Inverters, Trackers, Transformers, Meteo stations) and the Power Plant Controller (PPC).
* Configure communication protocols including
  **Modbus (RTU/TCP), DNP3, and IEC 60870-5-104**
  .
* Execute
  **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)**
  and
  **Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)**
  protocols to verify control system integrity.

**Weather Monitoring System (WMS) Integration**

* Supervise the mechanical installation, leveling, and alignment of meteorological masts and environmental sensors.
* Wire, configure, and calibrate critical weather sensors including
  **pyranometers (GHI, POI), albedometers, anemometers, back-of-module temperature sensors**
  , and soiling stations.
* Integrate WMS data loggers into the main SCADA network to ensure real-time, accurate environmental data is available for
  **Performance Ratio (PR)**
  calculations.

**Site Management & Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve complex networking, wiring, and communication faults during the commissioning phase.
* Coordinate with electrical subcontractors to ensure panel wiring and field instrumentation comply with engineering Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) and schematics.

**Documentation & Handover**

* Redline engineering drawings to create accurate
  **As-Built documentation**
  .
* Compile detailed commissioning reports, loop sheets, and calibration logs for handover to the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team.
* Provide basic system orientation and training to site operators upon successful plant energization.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Communication, or a related field.

**Experience:**
3+ years of field experience in commissioning
**SCADA systems and/or Weather Monitoring Systems**
preferabbly within utility-scale solar PV plants.

**Technical Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience with industrial protocols (Modbus RTU/TCP is a must).
* Familiarity with meteorological sensor brands.
* Understanding of industrial networking, fiber optic splicing concepts, and IP routing.
* Ability to read and interpret Electrical Schematics, Single Line Diagrams, and P&ID diagrams.

* Familiarity with compliance standards such as NIST, GDPR, and HIPAA.

and

**Cloud Monitoring Administrator**
in the
**Enterprise**
will…
  
  
We are hiring an Associate to administer our SolarWinds platform and monitor Windows, Linux, network and application infrastructure. You will build and tune monitoring, act first on alerts, and log in to servers to investigate and resolve issues before they affect users.
  
  
**SolarWinds administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade and maintain SolarWinds Orion / Hybrid Cloud Observability modules (NPM, SAM, SCM, NTA, NCM, WPM, Log Analyzer).
* Add and manage nodes, interfaces, volumes and application templates; discover new devices via Network Sonar.
* Create and tune alerts, thresholds, dependencies and escalation rules to reduce noise and false positives.
* Build custom dashboards, views and scheduled reports for operations and management.
* Manage polling engines, agents (agent-based and agentless), WMI/SNMP credentials and platform health.
* Perform routine maintenance: database cleanup, license tracking, certificate and service checks, backups.

**Infrastructure monitoring**

* Monitor Windows and Linux servers for CPU, memory, disk, services, processes and event logs.
* Monitor applications such as IIS, SQL Server, Apache/Tomcat, Active Directory, Exchange and custom services.
* Monitor network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless controllers) for availability, interface utilization, bandwidth, errors and latency.
* Respond to alerts 24x7 in shifts, triage incidents, and escalate to L2/L3 or application teams with clear diagnostics.
* Onboard new servers and applications into monitoring as per the change process.

**Hands-on server work**

* Log in to Windows servers (RDP) and Linux servers (SSH) to validate alerts and perform first-level troubleshooting.
* Check and restart services, review logs, clear disk space, and verify connectivity (ping, traceroute, telnet, nslookup).
* Install and troubleshoot SolarWinds agents, SNMP and WMI configuration on servers.

**Process and documentation**

* Create and update tickets in ITSM tools (ServiceNow or Jira) within SLA.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks and monitoring inventory; share shift handovers and daily health reports.
* Support audits, patching windows and maintenance mode scheduling.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience as a SolarWinds administrator.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools, such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SCOM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk or Grafana/Prometheus.
* Proven experience monitoring Windows servers, Linux servers, network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) and business applications.
* Hands-on server experience: has logged in to servers via RDP and SSH and performed basic tasks independently.
* Basic Windows Server administration: services, Event Viewer, Task Manager, disk management, IIS basics, user and permission checks.
* Basic Linux administration: common commands (top, df, du, free, ps, grep, systemctl, journalctl), file permissions and log navigation.
* Understanding of SNMP, WMI, ICMP and agent-based polling, plus networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls).
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, change and problem processes and an ITSM ticketing tool.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends when rostered.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

title: Production Support Systems Intern
description:
**About Vcheck**
Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.
  
  
We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Production Support Systems Intern supports the team that keeps our production systems stable and available. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will learn how incidents, monitoring alerts, and escalations are handled in a live environment—starting by observing and following runbooks, and gradually taking on more of the triage yourself. You will get hands-on exposure to our AWS-hosted Python/Django/FastAPI backend and React JS frontend, and learn to track incidents via JIRA Service Management while monitoring system health through Sentry and CloudWatch. This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend and structured mentorship, and it offers a clear path to a full-time Production Support Systems Engineer role.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Monitor Sentry and CloudWatch dashboards for errors and anomalies under the guidance of a senior engineer
* Perform first-level triage of alerts and follow documented runbooks for known issues
* Create and update JIRA Service Management tickets with clear, complete incident details
* Escalate issues to the on-call engineer or Tier 3 with accurate, well-structured summaries
* Prepare shift handoff reports and join the overlap with the wider team
* Read CloudWatch Logs to identify ECS task errors, AWS Batch job failures, and Lambda/API issues
* Assist with restarting failed ECS tasks and retrying Batch jobs, as directed by the senior engineer
* Run start-of-shift and end-of-shift environment health checks and confirm nightly batch jobs have completed
* Learn to tell frontend (React JS) issues from backend API failures using Sentry error traces
* Run basic PostgreSQL/RDS checks and flag slow queries or connection issues to the team
* Verify that nightly backup and data replication jobs completed, and report any failure promptly
* Observe and support scheduled maintenance and deployments, including post-deployment monitoring
* Write simple Python scripts to automate repetitive checks and parse logs
* Document incident summaries, resolution steps, and learnings; help update runbooks and SOPs in the knowledge base

**About You**
****Key requirements:****
We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
  
  

* We're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and driven to grow through ownership, attention to detail, and upstanding character. No prior production support experience is needed. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Foundational understanding of cloud concepts; exposure to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch, RDS) through coursework, projects, or certifications is a plus
* Basic proficiency in Python for scripting and log parsing
* Basic understanding of SQL/PostgreSQL and how web applications and REST APIs work
* Familiarity with Linux command line and Git fundamentals
* Awareness of Docker and containers is a plus; exposure to Django, FastAPI, or React JS is a plus
* Curiosity about monitoring and incident management tools such as Sentry, JIRA, or similar; prior use is a plus
* Calm, methodical, and attentive to detail when things go wrong
* Strong written communication skills for incident notes and shift handoffs
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and ask for help or escalate when unsure
* Prior internship, academic project, or hands-on lab experience in IT support, DevOps, or NOC environments is a plus
* AWS Cloud Practitioner or ITIL Foundation certification (or willingness to pursue one) is a plus

****Why us?****
You Will Be Joining a Cutting-edge Company, Where You Will Tackle Complex Challenges And Work With The Very Best In The Industry. In Addition, We Offer
  
  

* Competitive compensation package, including equity
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage for you & your loved ones
* 401k plan with a 4% employer match
* Flexible vacation policy, encouraging you to take the time you need
* Annual wellness allowance to support your health and well-being
* Quarterly team events to keep us connected in a hybrid environment
* Playing a vital role in shaping our company's future
* A fun and collaborative work environment where you'll be supported by a team of dedicated and collaborative colleagues

Please be aware that Vcheck uses AI-powered note-taking, interview recording, and transcription tools to ensure accuracy and efficiency during our talent acquisition processes. By participating in the application and interview stages, you acknowledge and consent to the use of these technologies.
  
  
**Vcheck is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, and training.**
**Vcheck expressly prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.**
**No matter what background you bring with you, if you are committed to excellence and good at what you do, we welcome you to apply to join us and encourage you to come as you are.**

title: Network Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description: Network EngineerAbout the Role

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Network Engineer to install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure connectivity. The role involves managing network devices, monitoring network performance, resolving technical issues, and supporting day-to-day IT infrastructure operations.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals, routing and switching technologies, network security, and troubleshooting methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

* **Network Installation and Configuration:** Install, configure, and maintain network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, and other networking equipment.
* **Network Monitoring:** Monitor network performance, availability, and connectivity to ensure optimal operation and minimal downtime.
* **Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, hardware failures, configuration errors, and performance-related problems.
* **Routing and Switching:** Configure and maintain routing and switching protocols to ensure efficient communication across network environments.
* **Network Security:** Support the configuration and maintenance of firewalls, access controls, and other network security measures.
* **Infrastructure Maintenance:** Perform routine network maintenance, software updates, configuration backups, and system checks.
* **Performance Optimization:** Identify network bottlenecks, analyze performance metrics, and implement improvements to enhance reliability.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, infrastructure diagrams, troubleshooting activities, and maintenance procedures.
* **Incident Management:** Respond to network incidents, investigate root causes, and implement corrective measures to prevent recurring issues.
* **Team Coordination:** Collaborate with IT support teams, system administrators, and other technical professionals to resolve infrastructure-related issues.
* **User Support:** Provide technical assistance for network-related problems and ensure timely resolution of service requests.
* **Compliance and Best Practices:** Follow established IT policies, network security standards, and infrastructure management procedures.

Qualifications and Experience

* **Educational Qualification:** Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Relevant experience in network administration, network engineering, or IT infrastructure support is preferred.
* **Networking Knowledge:** Strong understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, and network connectivity.
* **Routing and Switching:** Familiarity with network routing protocols, switching technologies, VLANs, and network configuration.
* **Network Security:** Basic knowledge of firewall configuration, access control, and network security principles.
* **Troubleshooting Skills:** Ability to diagnose and resolve network connectivity and performance issues systematically.
* **Monitoring Tools:** Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* **Communication Skills:** Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities with attention to detail.

Required Skills

TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Routing, Switching, Firewalls, Network Troubleshooting, Network Monitoring, Network Configuration, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, Network Security, Infrastructure Maintenance, Incident Management, Technical Documentation, IT Support, and Problem-Solving.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should possess a solid understanding of networking concepts, hands-on knowledge of network infrastructure, and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.

Candidates should be proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to maintaining network reliability, security, and performance. The ability to work collaboratively with IT support teams and maintain accurate technical documentation is essential.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Agentic AI Lead - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Agentic AI Engineering**

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems.
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration.
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

### **Architecture & Knowledge Management**

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions.

### **Quality, Security & Operations**

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics.
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies.
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls.
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments.

### **Initial Focus Areas**

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms.
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities.
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources.
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates.
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap.

### **Broader Business Impact**

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains.
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years.
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions.
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous.
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices.
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions.
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI.
* Relevant Google Cloud or Microsoft certifications.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

Opportunity to define and influence the future state of enterprise agentic AI architecture across a global organisation.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies spanning Google Cloud AI, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI and multi-agent systems.Collaboration with global AI, architecture, HR and digital transformation teams.Opportunity to drive innovation through proof-of-concepts, experimentation and emerging technology adoption.Ability to create reusable solutions with impact across multiple business functions and global markets.Continuous learning within a rapidly evolving AI and cloud technology landscape.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Advanced multi-agent architecture design and orchestration.Enterprise-scale implementation of Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and secure enterprise AI deployment practices.End-to-end LLMOps, AI observability and automated evaluation methodologies.Integration of AI agents across SAP, Copilot Studio, Google Cloud and enterprise platforms.Scalable knowledge management, RAG optimisation and conversational AI design techniques.Strategic technology planning and AI portfolio leadership.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise

The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In this role, you will:**

### **1. Service Ownership and Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.

### **2. Architecture and Design Governance**

* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.

### **3. Technology and Engineering Leadership**

Maintain sufficient technical depth to guide engineering teams, challenge vendor recommendations, approve designs and support critical escalations across the following domains:

**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging

4. Operations, Delivery and Problem Management

* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**

### **Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*

Information Technology

Head – IT

Full Time

· Manage LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, Internet and VPN connectivity.

· Configure and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, DNS, DHCP and IP addressing.

· Create, modify and disable user accounts and system access.

· Control access to network folders, email, ERP and applications based on approved roles & authorization.

· Coordinate with the ERP implementation/support partner for issues, configuration, reports, integrations and upgrades.

· **Knowledge of Odoo ERP or another manufacturing ERP is preferred.**

**D. Manufacturing & Engineering Systems**

· Provide IT support to Engineering, Production, Stores, Maintenance and Quality.

· Coordinate IT requirements for **CAD, PDM/PLM, document management and other engineering applications**, where applicable.

· Support integration and connectivity between ERP and other business/engineering systems.

**E. Security & Backup**

· Implement and monitor basic IT security controls.

· Ensure regular backup of critical ERP, engineering and business data.

· Maintain basic disaster recovery procedures.

· Promote employee awareness of phishing, passwords, malware and data security.

**4. Required Technical Skills**

**Essential**

* Windows desktop and server administration.
* LAN/WAN and network troubleshooting.
* IT asset management
* User account and access management.
* Hardware and software troubleshooting.

**ERP & other Skills**

* Understanding of ERP concepts and business processes.
* ERP user and role administration.
* Ability to coordinate with ERP implementation/support partners.

· CAD/PDM/PLM systems.

* **Odoo ERP experience is an advantage.**

**5. Educational Qualification & Experience**

**Qualification:**

· Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics or equivalent.

**Experience:**

· 3–7 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, system administration and user support.

· Should be capable of working independently and managing day-to-day IT operations.

· Experience supporting **50–100 users** preferred.

· Experience in a **manufacturing organization** is an advantage.

**6. Key Competencies**

· Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

· Good understanding of IT infrastructure and networking.

· User and access management discipline.

· ERP/application support capability.

· Good communication and vendor coordination skills.

· Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.

**7. Overall Responsibility**

The IT Engineer will be the **primary operational IT support resource** for the organization and will ensure that the company's IT infrastructure, network, user access, cybersecurity, backups and ERP environment remain reliable and secure.

The position is expected to work as a **hands-on IT professional and internal system coordinator**, while engaging external specialists/vendors for advanced ERP, cybersecurity, infrastructure or application requirements.

**Key focus areas:**

**IT Infrastructure → Networking → User Access → Cybersecurity → ERP Support → Manufacturing/Engineering Systems → Vendor Management**

Pay: ₹30,800.00 - ₹44,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Advisor, Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Infrastructure Engineering
  
  
**About Your Role**
As a Load Balancer Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain load balancing and traffic management solutions that support secure, scalable, and highly available network services. You will partner with network, security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver resilient solutions across data center and cloud environments. Your work will help improve application availability, strengthen enterprise network performance, and support secure infrastructure modernization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain load balancing infrastructure using F5 BIG-IP, Citrix NetScaler, Avi Networks, or similar application delivery controller (ADC) platforms.
* Configure and support local and global load balancing solutions, including Domain Name System (DNS)-based Global Server Load Balancing and application traffic management capabilities.
* Manage the daily administration of load balancing environments, including monitoring, troubleshooting, change implementation, and performance optimization.
* Analyze network and application traffic flows, including Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) behavior and packet inspection, to resolve issues and improve service availability.
* Partner with network engineering, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams to support new implementations, migrations, baseline reviews, and enterprise architecture initiatives.
* Design and engineer Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), and IP Address Management (IPAM) solutions using platforms such as Nokia VitalQIP, NS1, BlueCat, Infoblox, or similar technologies.
* Support cloud and data center load balancing strategy, including design of highly available network solutions aligned with enterprise standards and security baselines.
* Identify, assess, and recommend new technologies, protocols, and solutions that improve network efficiency, resiliency, and operational effectiveness.
* Develop testing, backup, and disaster recovery processes for load balancing and telecommunications infrastructure to minimize malfunctions and service disruption.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and support for complex load balancing issues and collaborate with internal teams to resolve engineering and deployment challenges.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience You'll Need To Have**

* 6+ years of experience in network engineering, load balancing engineering, application delivery, or related infrastructure roles supporting enterprise environments.
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting load balancing solutions using F5 BIG-IP, Citrix NetScaler, Avi Networks, or similar application delivery controller platforms.
* Experience with DNS, DHCP, and IPAM technologies, including design and engineering of DNS-based global server load balancing solutions and local application load balancing solutions.
* Experience working with data center and cloud networking concepts, including high availability, routing, switching, firewall concepts, WAN, LAN, and network security fundamentals.
* Experience troubleshooting network and application traffic flows, including TCP/IP, OSI model concepts, network performance, and capacity issues.
* Experience supporting infrastructure migrations, security baseline reviews, and operational improvements in complex enterprise networks.
* Bachelors degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5-CTS), F5 Certified Solution Expert (F5-CSE), or equivalent certification.
* Experience with disaster recovery planning and operational procedures for telecommunications or network infrastructure.
* Experience supporting cloud-native application delivery and hybrid network architectures.
* Experience in financial services, payments, or similarly regulated infrastructure environments.

**How You'll Work**

* This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.About your role:As a Load Balancer Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain load balancing and traffic management solutions that support secure, scalable, and highly available network services. You will partner with network, security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver resilient solutions across data center and cloud environments. + Design and engineer Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), and IP Address Management (IPAM) solutions using platforms such as Nokia VitalQIP, NS1, BlueCat, Infoblox, or similar technologies.

+ Develop testing, backup, and disaster recovery processes for load balancing and telecommunications infrastructure to minimize malfunctions and service disruption.

* Experience you'll need to have:

+ 6+ years of experience in network engineering, load balancing engineering, application delivery, or related infrastructure roles supporting enterprise environments.
+ Experience designing, implementing, and supporting load balancing solutions using F5 BIG-IP, Citrix NetScaler, Avi Networks, or similar application delivery controller platforms.
+ Experience with DNS, DHCP, and IPAM technologies, including design and engineering of DNS-based global server load balancing solutions and local application load balancing solutions.
+ Experience working with data center and cloud networking concepts, including high availability, routing, switching, firewall concepts, WAN, LAN, and network security fundamentals.
+ Experience troubleshooting network and application traffic flows, including TCP/IP, OSI model concepts, network performance, and capacity issues.
+ Experience supporting infrastructure migrations, security baseline reviews, and operational improvements in complex enterprise networks.
+ Bachelors degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

* Experience that would be great to have:

+ Experience with disaster recovery planning and operational procedures for telecommunications or network infrastructure.
+ Experience supporting cloud-native application delivery and hybrid network architectures.
+ Experience in financial services, payments, or similarly regulated infrastructure environments.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
Dear LinkdIn Family,

ACL Digital is hiring for Permanent role for Data-Center Engineer for Gurugram.

**Senior Data Center & SDN Network Engineer**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced
**Data Center & SDN Network Engineer**
to design, implement, operate, and migrate high-performance Data Center fabrics. In this role, you will be responsible for building modern Spine-Leaf topologies, managing overlay/underlay protocols (EVPN/VXLAN), integrating gateway solutions, and executing seamless network migrations using Software-Defined Networking (SDN) architectures.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Fabric Design & Deployment:**
  Architect, deploy, and maintain Data Center Spine-Leaf fabrics, ensuring low latency, high availability, and scalability.
* **Underlay & Overlay Management:**
  Design and implement robust IGP underlays (OSPF/eBGP) and modern EVPN/VXLAN overlay architectures using MP-BGP.
* **Routing & Switching Operations:**
  Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot core routing protocols including BGP (eBGP/iBGP), OSPF, L2/L3 VPNs, and advanced traffic engineering.
* **SDN Integration:**
  Operationalize and maintain Software-Defined Networking (SDN) solutions, automating network provisioning and orchestrating fabric workloads.
* **Migration & Integration:**
  Lead Data Center network migrations, integrating legacy infrastructure into modern Spine-Leaf topologies and external network gateways with zero to minimal business downtime.
* **System Administration & Automation:**
  Utilize Linux commands and environment tooling for network testing, troubleshooting, telemetry, and system maintenance.
* **Gateway & Edge Routing:**
  Configure DC edge/gateway routers to route traffic between DC fabrics, WAN, public/private clouds, and enterprise boundaries.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Data Center Fabric Architecture:**
  Deep hands-on experience with Spine-Leaf topologies and Data Center Fabric designs.
* **Overlay/Underlay Technologies:**
  VXLAN, EVPN, MP-BGP, IGP Underlays (OSPF, eBGP).
* **Routing Protocols:**
  BGP (iBGP, eBGP), OSPF, L2 VPN, L3 VPN.
* **SDN & Automation:**
  Hands-on experience with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) controllers and fabric management platforms.
* **Migration & Integration:**
  Proven track record in DC network migration, cutovers, and gateway integration.
* **Operating Systems & Tools:**
  Working proficiency with Linux CLI, network diagnostic tools, and system administrative commands.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of experience in Data Center Networking, Architecture, and Operations.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Certifications (Preferred):**
  CCIE (Data Center / Enterprise), JNCIE-DC, CCNP Data Center, or vendor-equivalent SDN certifications (Arista, Cisco ACI, Juniper Apstra).

Interested candidate's can share their resume to amit.k@acldigital.com. You can share with your friends and colleagues.

Thanks & Regards

Amit Kumar

**Job Description**
Job Title
  
  
**ELV / ICT Engineer**
Department
  
  
MEP Engineering / Building Services
  
  
Reports To
  
  
ELV/ICT Sr Engineer/Lead /Assitant Manager / Design Manager
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The ELV / ICT Engineer shall be responsible for the
**design, coordination, and documentation of Extra Low Voltage (ELV) and Information & Communication Technology (ICT) systems**
as part of MEP consultancy services, ensuring compliance with project requirements, local codes, international standards, and client specifications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Design & Engineering
  
  

* Prepare concept, schematic, detailed design, and tender drawings for ELV/ICT systems, including:

+ Structured Cabling Systems (SCS – copper & fiber)
+ Data & Voice Networks
+ CCTV & Video Surveillance
+ Access Control Systems
+ Intrusion Detection / Burglar Alarm
+ Public Address & Voice Alarm (PA/VA)
+ IPTV / SMATV / MATV
+ Building Management System (BMS) interfaces
+ Audio-Visual (AV) systems
+ Intercom & Parking Management Systems
+ Airport systems and integration

* Develop system architectures, riser diagrams, layouts, schematics, and single-line diagrams.
* Perform load calculations, bandwidth calculations, and equipment sizing.
* Select appropriate equipment in line with project specifications, standards, and budget.

Standards & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure designs comply with:

+ Local authority regulations
+ International standards (TIA/EIA, ISO/IEC, IEC, NFPA, BS, EN)
+ Client and operator requirements

* Coordinate approvals with relevant authorities and stakeholders.

Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate ELV/ICT designs with:

+ Electrical, Mechanical, and Architectural disciplines
+ IT, Security, and AV specialists
+ BIM and CAD teams

* Resolve clashes and ensure integrated MEP design delivery.

Documentation & Deliverables
  
  

* Prepare:

+ Design reports
+ Technical specifications
+ Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
+ Cost estimates
+ Tender and IFC documentation

* Review shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements during construction phase.
* Support site teams with technical clarifications and design revisions.

Construction & Commissioning Support
  
  

* Provide technical support during installation, testing, and commissioning.
* Attend design coordination and site meetings.
* Review as-built drawings and system documentation.

Software & Tools
  
  

* AutoCAD / Revit (BIM preferred)
* MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* ELV design tools (e.g., cable calculation, network planning tools – advantage)

**Experience**

* 4–10 years of experience in ELV/ICT design within MEP consultancy or contracting
* Experience in Airports, metro, Railways and ports
* Data center or mission-critical project experience is a plus

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of ELV & ICT systems and integration
* Knowledge of MEP coordination processes
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and MEP drawings
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Time management and ability to handle multiple projects
* Problem-solving and attention to detail

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience working in multidisciplinary design teams
* Familiarity with authority submission procedures
* Exposure to BIM-based design workflows

**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical / Electronics / Telecommunication Engineering

**Additional Information**
We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500.
