In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
*.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Notice:***

*name@cvent.com*
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*.*
****In This Role, You Will:****
Cvent is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team in Gurugram, India to help build and maintain the platform behind our event and hospitality SaaS business. This is a high impact engineering role for a person who thrives at:
  
  

* solving complex platform challenges,
* partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent’s customers, and
* executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption

In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale.
  
  
****In This Role, You Will:****

* Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments.
* Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability.
* Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis.
* Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges.
* Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving.
* Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution.

****How You Will Spend Your Time****
This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is:
  
  

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

The role will be responsible for maintaining a Zero-Touch PKI framework, ensuring automated certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, and compliance across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Venafi TLS Protect, Enterprise PKI, Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certificate lifecycle automation, machine identity management, and security governance. This role will work closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, Application, and Network teams to secure machine identities and eliminate certificate-related outages through automation.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Venafi Platform Administration-

* Ensure proactive replacement of expiring certificates with minimal manual intervention.

* Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS)
* Public Certificate Authorities
* Internal Certificate Authorities
* Cloud-based Certificate Services

* Windows Servers
* Linux Servers
* Cloud Platforms
* Containers
* Kubernetes Clusters
* Network Devices
* Load Balancers
* Web Servers

* Discovery and monitoring of unmanaged certificates.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce certificate security policies and governance standards.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Perform certificate risk assessments and remediation activities.
* Identify weak, expired, or non-compliant certificates and implement corrective actions.

* Kubernetes and Container Platforms

Reporting & Governance

* Certificate inventory
* Compliance status
* Expiring certificates
* Platform utilization
* Risk exposure
* Service performance

* Develop PKI roadmaps and automation strategies.

Job Description: Active Directory & PKI (Certificate Management) Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary -**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Active Directory & PKI Engineer to manage and support the organization's On-Premises Active Directory (AD), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), and Certificate Management infrastructure. * Support and maintain Domain Controllers across multiple environments.
* Administer Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and troubleshoot Group Policy-related issues.
* Manage AD replication, site topology, DNS integration, and authentication services.
* Perform health checks and proactive monitoring of Active Directory services.
* Support Azure AD / Entra ID Connect synchronization and related services.
* Troubleshoot Active Directory, DNS, authentication, Kerberos, LDAP, and replication issues.

PKI & Certificate Services Administration-

* Manage Certificate Authorities (CA), subordinate CAs, and certificate-related services.

Certificate Lifecycle Management-
  
  

* Manage the end-to-end certificate lifecycle, including:
* Certificate issuance
* Renewal
* Revocation
* Replacement
* Expiry management
* Process certificate requests and approvals.
* Troubleshoot certificate enrollment and authentication issues.
* Ensure timely renewal of certificates to prevent service impact.

Certificate Template Management-
  
  

* Create, modify, and maintain Certificate Authority (CA) templates.
* Manage certificate enrollment and auto-enrollment policies.
* Support certificate template design and implementation based on business and security requirements.
* Ensure compliance with PKI standards and security policies.

Security & Vulnerability Management-
  
  

* Remediate vulnerabilities identified on:
* Domain Controllers
* Azure AD / Entra ID Connect Servers
* DNS Servers
* Certificate Servers
* Perform AD and PKI security hardening activities.
* Support security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities.
* Implement industry best practices for identity and certificate security.

Incident, Change & Problem Management-
  
  

* Manage Incident, Change Request (CR), Service Request, and Problem Management activities.
* Process operational alerts and support requests within SLA targets.
* Perform queue management and ticket prioritization.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, security, and application teams during incident resolution and change implementations.

Monitoring & Operational Support-
  
  

* Monitor Active Directory and PKI infrastructure health.
* Provide Event ID analysis and troubleshooting support to monitoring teams.
* Respond to service degradation and infrastructure alerts.
* Support end users and application teams for authentication and certificate-related issues.

Reporting & Service Improvement-
  
  

* Generate weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Track service metrics, incidents, vulnerabilities, and certificate renewals.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend improvements.
* Participate in continuous service improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Management-
  
  

* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, technical documents, and operational procedures.
* Ensure Active Directory and PKI configurations are properly documented.
* Develop knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Support knowledge transfer and operational readiness activities.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
Active Directory Skills-
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with:
* Microsoft Active Directory (On-Premises)
* Domain Controllers
* Group Policy (GPO)
* DNS
* LDAP
* Kerberos Authentication
* AD Replication
* Organizational Units (OU)
* Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID Connect
* Experience managing large-scale enterprise Active Directory environments.

PKI & Certificate Management Skills-
  
  

* Strong experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
* Expertise in Enterprise PKI Administration.
* Experience managing Certificate Authority (CA) infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of SSL/TLS certificates and certificate lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with certificate template creation and management.
* Knowledge of certificate enrollment, auto-enrollment, and certificate renewal processes.

IT Service Management-
  
  

* Experience in Incident, Service Request, Change, and Problem Management.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and service delivery frameworks.
* Experience managing operational support queues and SLA-based environments.

**Preferred Skills-**

* PowerShell scripting and automation.

* Exposure to Microsoft Entra ID, Hybrid Identity, and Windows Server Administration.
* Experience supporting compliance and audit activities.

title: Security Analysis Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:** 391372
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Security Analysis Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description:** Senior Venafi PKI Engineer
  
Job Summary-
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Venafi PKI Engineer to lead the administration, automation, governance, and lifecycle management of enterprise digital certificates using the Venafi Platform. The role will be responsible for maintaining a Zero-Touch PKI framework, ensuring automated certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, and compliance across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Venafi TLS Protect, Enterprise PKI, Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certificate lifecycle automation, machine identity management, and security governance. This role will work closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, Application, and Network teams to secure machine identities and eliminate certificate-related outages through automation.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Venafi Platform Administration-
  

* Administer, configure, and maintain the Venafi platform across enterprise environments.
* Manage Venafi TLS Protect, Trust Protection Platform (TPP), and machine identity management solutions.
* Ensure platform availability, performance, scalability, and operational stability.
* Perform platform upgrades, patch management, and health monitoring activities.
* Manage Venafi administrative functions, policies, workflows, and RBAC controls.

Zero-Touch Certificate Lifecycle Management-
  

* Support and Maintenance of Zero-Touch certificate lifecycle management processes.
* Automate certificate discovery, enrollment, issuance, renewal, installation, and revocation.
* Ensure proactive replacement of expiring certificates with minimal manual intervention.
* Manage certificate inventories across enterprise applications, servers, databases, load balancers, and cloud workloads.
* Eliminate certificate-related service outages through automation and governance controls.

Enterprise PKI Management
  

* Integrate and manage enterprise PKI environments including:

o Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS)
  
o Public Certificate Authorities
  
o Internal Certificate Authorities
  
o Cloud-based Certificate Services
  

* Manage root CA and subordinate CA integrations.
* Maintain certificate trust chains and PKI security standards.
* Provide technical oversight for certificate authority architecture and governance.

Machine Identity Management
  

* Manage machine identities across:

o Windows Servers
  
o Linux Servers
  
o Cloud Platforms
  
o Containers
  
o Kubernetes Clusters
  
o Network Devices
  
o Load Balancers
  
o Web Servers
  

* Establish and maintain enterprise machine identity governance practices.
* Discovery and monitoring of unmanaged certificates.

Security Compliance
  

* Define and enforce certificate security policies and governance standards.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Perform certificate risk assessments and remediation activities.
* Identify weak, expired, or non-compliant certificates and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and PKI best practices.

Integration Automation
  

* Integrate Venafi with:

o Active Directory
  
o ServiceNow
  
o CyberArk/BeyondTrust
  
o SIEM Platforms
  
o DevOps Pipelines
  
o Cloud Security Platforms
  
o Kubernetes and Container Platforms
  

* Develop and maintain automation using:

o PowerShell
  
o REST APIs
  
o Python
  
o Venafi SDKs
  

* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code and certificate automation initiatives.

Incident, Change Problem Management
  

* Manage critical incidents related to certificate services and PKI infrastructure.
* Support Change, Incident, Service Request, and Problem Management processes.
* Conduct root cause analysis on certificate-related outages.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues within agreed SLAs.

Monitoring Operational Support
  

* Perform daily platform health checks.
* Monitor certificate expiry alerts, policy violations, and platform alarms.
* Manage dashboards, reporting, and operational metrics.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, cloud, and application teams during incident resolution.

Reporting Governance
  

* Prepare executive and operational reports covering:

o Certificate inventory
  
o Compliance status
  
o Expiring certificates
  
o Platform utilization
  
o Risk exposure
  
o Service performance
  

* Present PKI governance metrics to security leadership and stakeholders.
* Develop PKI roadmaps and automation strategies.

Documentation Continuous Improvement-
  

* Maintain architecture documents, SOPs, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Lead service improvement and certificate automation initiatives.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend platform enhancements.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to junior engineers.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Required Skills Experience
  
Core Technical Skills-
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Venafi TLS Protect / Trust Protection Platform (TPP).
* Expertise in Zero-Touch Certificate Lifecycle Management.
* Extensive experience with:

o Enterprise PKI
  
o Certificate Authorities (CA)
  
o SSL/TLS Certificates
  
o Machine Identity Management
  
o Certificate Automation
  
o Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS)
  

* Experience managing large-scale certificate environments with thousands of certificates.

Infrastructure Security-
  

* Strong knowledge of:

o Microsoft Active Directory
  
o Windows Server
  
o DNS
  
o Load Balancers (F5, Netscaler)
  
o Web Servers (IIS, Apache, NGINX)
  
o Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  
o Kubernetes and Container Security
  

* Understanding of cryptography, certificate trust chains, OCSP, CRL, and HSM concepts.

Automation Skills-
  

* PowerShell scripting.
* Python scripting.
* REST API integration.
* DevOps and CI/CD integration.
* Certificate deployment automation.

IT Service Management-
  

* Experience in Incident, Change, Problem, and Request Management.
* Familiarity with ITIL Service Management practices.

description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About This Opportunity**

Join our network operations team as a VAS Operations Engineer, where you will play a critical role in ensuring the continuous availability and performance of Value-Added Services across a live mobile network environment. You will work within a skilled, multi-vendor operations team, managing and supporting a wide range of VAS platforms including messaging, charging, broadcast, and policy control systems. This is a technically demanding and rewarding role for an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, 24/7 operations environment and takes pride in keeping mission-critical services running seamlessly for millions of subscribers.

**You Will Bring**

* Relevant years of hands-on experience as a System Engineer in a mobile network environment
* Strong working knowledge of GSM (2G/3G/4G) network technologies and TCP/IP fundamentals
* Solid understanding of signaling protocols — SS7, SIGTRAN, SCCP, SCTP, RADIUS, and Diameter
* Practical experience with VAS platforms including SMSC, MMSC, MCA, PCRF, SMS Firewall, Prepaid Charging, Rating, and Broadcast systems
* Proficiency in Linux OS (including Solaris), IP networking, and provisioning systems
* Familiarity with call flows for Charging systems, SMS/MMS/MCA, SMS Firewall, and Broadcast services
* Multi-vendor exposure across platforms such as Ericsson, Mavenir, Mobileum, Nokia, and HP
* Awareness of ITIL processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and security management
* Strong communication skills in written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage
* A proactive, self-motivated mindset with the ability to work under pressure, manage multiple tasks, and adapt to shifting priorities

**What Will You Do**

* Monitor, operate, and maintain VAS nodes to ensure maximum service availability across the network
* Administer VAS and support systems including SMSC, MMSC, MCA, PCRF, Prepaid Charging, Rating, and Broadcast platforms
* Handle alarm monitoring, first-level fault analysis, and escalation management
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities, including routine health checks and system backups
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and configuration issues, conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) where required
* Manage and report on outages and emergency incidents in a timely and accurate manner
* Conduct performance analysis and investigations to proactively identify and address service degradation
* Coordinate and interface with customers, third-party vendors, and internal Ericsson departments for issue resolution and project handovers
* Ensure smooth and quality service handover from project teams into live operations
* Adhere strictly to ITIL processes across all operational activities
* Work on a 24x7 shift rotation as per project requirements

**Key Qualifications**

* Education: BE / B.Tech, BCA, or MCA in a relevant engineering or technology discipline
* Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in a large-scale technical operations environment with direct customer service exposure
* Technical Skills: GSM/2G/3G/4G, SS7, SIGTRAN, TCP/IP, SCCP, SCTP, RADIUS, Diameter, Linux/Solaris OS, PCRF, SMSC, MMSC, MCA, SMS Firewall, Provisioning Systems
* Vendor Knowledge: Demonstrated experience working across multi-vendor environments — Ericsson, Mavenir, Mobileum, Nokia, HP

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and proactive On-Site Field Engineer to support IT infrastructure, network connectivity, hardware systems, industrial printers, embedded camera systems, and Android-based applications at the BPCL Lubricant Bottling Plant.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and reliable operation of Track & Trace systems used in production, printing, scanning, and validation processes. The role requires hands-on technical expertise, troubleshooting skills, preventive maintenance, and accurate daily reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Ifrastructure & Network Support**

* Maintain and troubleshoot LAN networks, switches, access points, and network connectivity.
* Perform LAN cable crimping, cable management, and network port troubleshooting.
* Monitor ISP connectivity and coordinate with service providers to resolve network issues.
* Manage IP addresses and IPsec configurations for connected systems and equipment.
* Perform preventive maintenance to ensure network stability and minimize downtime.

**2. System & Hardware Support**

* Perform daily system health checks and monitor application status and system logs.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues on Ubuntu/Linux-based systems.
* Install, configure, and maintain computer systems and related hardware.
* Replace faulty components and ensure the availability of systems used in production operations.

**3. Industrial Printer & Equipment Maintenance**

* Maintain and troubleshoot shipper carton printers, laser marking printers, and other production-line equipment.
* Create, modify, and update printing templates as per production requirements.
* Support printer configuration, print quality checks, and issue resolution.
* Learn and perform specialized equipment maintenance with the training provided.

**4. Embedded Camera & Vision Systems**

* Monitor and maintain embedded cameras used for scanning, inspection, and product validation.
* Assist with camera configuration, calibration, and alignment.
* Troubleshoot camera and sensor-related issues affecting production operations.

**5. Application & Device Support**

* Operate and troubleshoot Android-based applications used in plant operations.
* Ensure the smooth functioning of applications for scanning, validation, and Track & Trace processes.
* Support mobile devices and related equipment used on the production floor.

**6. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare and submit daily operational checklists and reports to the Reporting Manager.
* Maintain records of system health, network status, printer performance, and equipment availability.
* Document technical issues, corrective actions, downtime, and maintenance activities.

title: BIM Technician - MEP
description:
As a BIM Technician, you will be part of WSP. You will be providing CAD/BIM expertise in developing high quality design drawings. It is expected that you demonstrate clear understanding of various tools within BIM softwares such as REVIT/BIM 360 & Navisworks.

  

* Production of high-quality 3D BIM Models in Revit.
* Perform variety of moderately-difficult to difficult 3D CAD modeling assignments under minimal supervision.
* Coordinate with Design Engineer for the information required to prepare BIM models and generate drawings as per specifications defined by our Client.
* Must have strong 3D visualization capabilities.
* Must possess a strong ability to work independently within a project team. Collaborate with other designers, engineers, architects and clients to convert information into layout designs, drawings and models using REVIT.
* Decipher information received from various formats (hand sketches, BIM Execution Plans and Architectural drawings).
* Should be interested and able to work in an international environment.
* Complete other duties as assigned appropriate for the designated grade level.

  

* Degree/Diploma in Engineering.
* Experience with Architectural / Structural/ Mechanical drawings, developing equipment layout and site plan drawings.
* Experience in leading the modeling related tasks and coordinating with client to get the deliverables completed on schedule and budget.
* Must possess a strong working knowledge of core 3D CADD applications (such as Revit, Civil 3D, Plant 3D), as outlined above.
* Must have proficient knowledge in handling Revit and other BIM application tools and concepts of BIM. Capable of producing Revit plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules etc. must be familiar with all Revit tools and creating and editing view range, drafting views, view templates, system families, materials, project/shared parameters, multi-category schedules, project title blocks, Worksets, Revit category-based profile, annotation families etc., must be capable of linking multiple Revit files and work. Capable of handling Revit projects without any guidance from the superior and managing the tasks with sharing the work with others.
* Must be capable of performing Clash detection using Navisworks and Revit interference check, export Clash reports, review clash reports etc.
  + Create Dynamic Blocks with parameters
  + Use different 3D representations such as shading, conceptual etc.
  + Export 3D geometry for use by subcontractors and outside agencies.
  + Assist in the production of 2D sheets (plans, sections, 3D clips and details) from 3D/4D multi-discipline models (Transitional 2D techniques)

title: Senior Engineer - Electrical
description:
Applicant should have 8-12 years of experience on basic and detailed engineering design of Electrical works on combined cycle projects and substation projects. Has a good knowledge of Electrical Systems and Physical design, the principles, and practices of related technical areas and of coordinating with other technical disciplines. Candidate should have exposure to IEC, US, Euro or any other foreign codes/standards and middle east local practices.

  

* Technical review of electrical equipment sizing, specifications, technical datasheets, technical bid evaluation and vendor documents reviews of various electrical equipment like GIS, Switchyard equipment, Power Transformer, Busduct, MV & LV switchgear, MCCs, power & distribution transformers, EDGs, DC systems / UPS, Cables, generator circuit breaker, bus duct, lighting fixtures etc.
* Technical review of SLDs, protection & metering diagrams, switchgear scheme drawings and logic diagrams, relay setting & protection coordination of the system, cable sizing etc.
* Review of electrical layouts like raceways, lighting, grounding & lightning protection, Switchyard layouts etc.
* Working Knowledge of electrical system studies using ETAP software and conversant with short circuit, load flow, motor starting & voltage drop calculations.
* Participate in meetings with clients and contractors as on when needed.
* Maintain an awareness of technological advances and industry best practice.

**Mandatory skills**

* Possess good knowledge of international codes & standards and Industry practices focussing particularly on Middle East Markets.
* Experience in selection of electrical equipment.
* Interdisciplinary knowledge to coordinate with Mechanical, Electrical, C&I, Civil and Commissioning teams.
* Excellent Skill in oral and written communication, demonstrated skill in leadership.
* Self-propelled, plans, develop, schedule & coordinate the review engineering work within discipline on a multi discipline project or assignment.
* Technical design review of electrical equipment/systems on large scale projects. Reviews and approves key engineering drawings and calculations, including field and design documents relating to the discipline.

title: Software Development Engineer - I
description:
Blink Charging Co. (Nasdaq: BLNK) is a leading owner, operator, and provider of electric vehicle (EV) charging equipment and networked EV charging services. We're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles by deploying thousands of charging stations across the United States and around the world.

**What We Do:**

Blink offers both residential and commercial EV charging equipment and connectivity to the Blink Network—a comprehensive cloud-based software that operates, manages, and tracks our EV charging stations and payment processing. Our charging solutions serve a diverse range of customers including multi-family residential and commercial properties, airports, colleges, municipalities, parking garages, shopping malls, retail parking, and more.

**Why Blink:**

* **Industry Leader:** We're at the forefront of the EV charging revolution, building critical infrastructure for a sustainable future
* **Innovation-Driven:** We continuously develop cutting-edge technology to improve the EV charging experience
* **Growth Opportunity:** Join a rapidly expanding company in one of the world's fastest-growing industries
* **Mission That Matters:** Every day, we're helping reduce carbon emissions and create a cleaner planet

**Position Overview ( Remote or Hybrid role ) - IST day shift**

We are looking for a motivated **Software Engineer I** to join our **EnergyConnect** team. EnergyConnect is Blink's Energy Management System (EMS) platform, enabling intelligent energy optimisation, EV charging management, site monitoring, and grid integration.

This role is ideal for early-career engineers who enjoy building modern web applications, solving real-world problems, and working across the full software development lifecycle.

You will work with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and maintain production systems used by customers worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

**Build Product Features**

* Develop new EnergyConnect platform features using **TypeScript** and **React**
* Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations
* Design and implement database models, queries, and performance improvements using **PostgreSQL**
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and senior developers to deliver customer-facing functionality
* Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to platform reliability and performance

**Quality & Testing**

* Write automated tests for applications and services
* Build and maintain end-to-end test suites using **Playwright**
* Participate in code reviews and follow engineering best practices
* Contribute to continuous integration and deployment workflows

**Learn & Grow**

* Work closely with experienced engineers and mentors
* Gain exposure to scalable cloud-based systems and modern software architecture
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT responsibly to improve productivity and code quality

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 0-2 years of professional software development experience
* Strong hands-on experience with:
* + **TypeScript**
  + **React**
  + **PostgreSQL**
  + **Git**
* Understanding of REST APIs and modern web application architecture
* Familiarity with software testing principles and automated testing
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Passion for learning and building high-quality software

**Preferred Skills:-**

* Experience with:
* + **Node.js**
  + Express.js or similar backend frameworks
  + **Playwright** for end-to-end testing
  + Docker and containerised applications
  + CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, etc.)
* Knowledge of SQL query optimisation and database design
* Experience developing personal, academic, or open-source projects
* Interest in clean energy, sustainability, IoT, or EV technologies

**Technologies You'll Work With**

* TypeScript
* React
* Node.js
* PostgreSQL
* Playwright
* REST APIs
* Git/GitHub
* Docker
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Cloud-based Platforms

**Why Join Blink?**

* Build software powering the global transition to electric mobility
* Work on real-world products used by customers worldwide
* Learn from experienced engineers in a fast-growing industry
* Exposure to modern engineering practices and technologies
* Opportunity to grow your career in the EV and clean energy sector

**Join Blink Charging and help build the software that powers the future of transportation.**

* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS, especially in an operations context.
* Strong communication skills for stakeholder interactions, documentation, and process adherence.
* Experience working in 24x7 or follow-the-sun support models.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

**Work Requirements:**

* Willingness to work in rotational shifts or be part of on-call support as per business needs.
* Occasional off-hours or weekend support during critical issues or planned activities.
* Readiness to collaborate across time zones with global teams or clients.
* Willingness to travel as required.

description:

**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Remote Technical Support Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
  
  
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Maintains the support process and ensures that requests for support are handled according to the procedures.
* Use service assurance software and tools to investigate and diagnose problems, collect performance statistics and create reports, working with users, other staff and suppliers as appropriate.
* Identifies and resolves problems following agreed procedures.
* Carries out agreed maintenance tasks.
* Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
* Performs defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information.
* Analyzes service records against agreed service levels regularly to identify actions required to maintain or improve levels of service, and initiates or reports these actions.
* Prioritizes and diagnoses incidents according to agreed procedures.
* Investigates causes of incidents and seeks resolution.
* Escalates unresolved incidents and follow up until incident is resolved.
* Provides service recovery, following resolution of incidents.
* Documents and closes resolved incidents according to agreed procedures.

description:

IVGSSPL Kolkata, IN

**Description**
**Description:**
**Our Organization**
Indorama Ventures is a global sustainable chemical company operating across multiple verticals such as Combined PET, Fibers, and Integrated Oxides & Derivatives. The Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Kolkata, India supports worldwide operations through centralized IT, Finance and business process services.
  
  
**Job Location - Kolkata, Hyderabad**
**Position Overview**
The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
**owning, governing, and continuously improving the technical integration landscape**
supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides
**hands-on Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) expertise**
from day one, translating integration requirements into reliable, supportable, and scalable data flows across o9 and upstream or downstream enterprise systems.
  
  
This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

**Candidate Evidence Expected**
Candidates should be prepared to provide concrete examples from recent o9 engagements, including:
  
  

* Their exact role, duration, and ownership in each o9 project.
* INT3.0 interfaces designed or delivered, source and target systems, data volumes or cadence, and production responsibilities.
* Examples of complex incidents diagnosed and permanently resolved.
* Examples of integration design documents, runbooks, monitoring approaches, or error-management practices they created.
* Python solutions personally developed and the business or operational problem addressed.
* Current o9 certifications and evidence of relevant o9 training completion.

**Job Purpose**

We are seeking a skilled VoIP Engineer with hands-on experience in Asterisk, FusionPBX, FreeSwitch, ViCIdial, SBC configuration, and hosted contact centre environments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring, delivering, and maintaining SIP trunking, contact centre, and PBX/telephony systems from both application and backend perspective.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Contact Centre & PBX Administration**

* Configure and manage users, campaigns, and leads in a hosted contact centre platform.
* Create and deploy IVR menus and call flow configurations, including audio prompts and routing logic.
* Customize and manage disposition codes, call outcomes, and agent workflows.
* Monitor and maintain contact centre platform performance and availability.

**SIP Trunking & SBC Configuration**

* Configure and maintain SIP trunks between Asterisk, SBCs, and third-party PBXs.
* Perform integration of SBCs with other VoIP systems (e.g., EPBX, CUCM, or hosted PBX platforms/dialler).
* Troubleshoot and debug call flow, SIP signalling, and VoIP-related customer issues.
* Monitor and ensure call quality using knowledge of VoIP protocols and network fundamentals.

**Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution**

* Diagnose and resolve VoIP call quality issues including jitter, latency, packet loss, and codec mismatches.
* Troubleshoot SIP signalling, RTP media path, and authentication failures.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on recurring VoIP incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Coordinate with carriers and third-party vendors for SIP trunk and interconnect issue resolution.

**Qualification & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or equivalent field.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of practical experience with Asterisk / FusionPBX / FreeSwitch / VICIdial or other telephony platforms.
* **Certifications (if any):**
  CCNA-Voice or CCNP-Collaboration preferred; Relevant certifications in VoIP, Asterisk, or networking are a plus.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Technical Skills:**
  Asterisk, FusionPBX, FreeSwitch, ViCIdial; Oracle SBC / Session Border Controllers; SIP, RTP, SRTP, WebRTC, TCP/IP, UDP; Linux CLI; IVR design and deployment; Hosted Contact Centre platforms.
* **Functional Skills:**
  SIP trunk configuration and management; Call flow design; Contact centre administration; VoIP troubleshooting; Integration with EPBX and CUCM.
* **Behavioral Competencies:**
  Analytical and systematic problem-solving; Ability to work independently and under pressure; Good documentation skills; Strong coordination with cross-functional and vendor teams.

**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled Splunk Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our Splunk environment. The candidate will be responsible for log ingestion, platform administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, dashboards, alerts, and user access management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Splunk Enterprise environments.
* Administer Splunk components including Search Heads, Indexers, Universal Forwarders, Heavy Forwarders, and Deployment Servers.
* Configure and manage data inputs, indexes, sourcetypes, and data retention policies.
* Onboard logs from applications, servers, databases, network devices, and cloud platforms.
* Create and troubleshoot SPL queries, dashboards, reports, alerts, and scheduled searches.
* Monitor Splunk infrastructure health, indexing performance, search performance, and license utilization.
* Troubleshoot issues related to log ingestion, parsing, indexing, and search performance.
* Manage Splunk users, roles, authentication, and access permissions.
* Perform performance tuning, capacity planning, patching, and configuration changes.
* Maintain Splunk configuration files such as inputs.conf, outputs.conf, props.conf, transforms.conf, and indexes.conf.
* Support production incidents and coordinate with Infrastructure, DevOps, Application, and Security teams.
* Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.

**Required Skills**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Splunk Administration.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Enterprise architecture and SPL.
* Experience with Linux/Unix environments.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and SSL/TLS.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Basic scripting knowledge in Shell or Python is an advantage.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) or SIEM environments.
* Splunk Administrator/Power User certification.
* Experience with Splunk Cloud and AWS/Azure/GCP.
* Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes logging and REST API integrations.

Network Design & Build Engineering:

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description

Marketing Manager (Manufacturing and Technical Marketing)

Job Title: Marketing Manager

Company: SKS Accessories (pumps and industrial machines manufacturer)

Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Department: Marketing and Sales

Reports To: General Manager / Managing Director

Employment Type: Full-time, permanent

Experience: 2 to 4 years in industrial or manufacturing marketing / technical sales

Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (MBA in Marketing is an advantage)

Salary: Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Marketing Manager takes SKS Accessories pumps and industrial machines to the right customers. This is a technical, business-to-business role designed for a mechanical engineer. The Marketing Manager must understand the products well enough to explain them to dealers, contractors, farmers and industrial buyers, convert enquiries into quotations and orders together with the sales team, and build the SKS brand through catalogues, product demonstrations, exhibitions and digital channels.

The role is hands-on and customer-facing. It combines factory knowledge, technical communication and practical marketing, and works closely with the General Manager, production, quality, design and sales teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Product and Market Knowledge

* Learn every pump and machine in the range in detail, including specifications, performance curves, materials, applications, advantages and limitations.
* Identify target segments and regions such as agriculture, construction, industry, domestic and institutional buyers.
* Study customer needs and buying behaviour, and convert them into clear product positioning and selling points.
* Work with production and design teams to understand new products, upgrades and delivery capacity before promoting them.

2. Technical Marketing Material

* Prepare accurate catalogues, datasheets, brochures, price lists and product comparison sheets.
* Develop product videos, factory tour content, installation references and application case studies with correct technical information.
* Maintain a consistent brand identity (logo, colours, tone and messaging) across all printed and digital material.
* Coordinate with designers, photographers and printers, and ensure timely delivery of material.

3. Enquiry Handling and Sales Support

* Respond to enquiries from calls, website, portals and dealers promptly, and log each lead in a tracking sheet or CRM.
* Prepare technical quotations and proposals together with the sales team and the General Manager.
* Follow up on quotations, understand reasons for won and lost orders, and report findings.
* Track the full journey from enquiry to quotation to order to payment follow-up with the sales team.

4. Dealer and Channel Network

* Identify, appoint and support dealers and distributors in Tamil Nadu and nearby states.
* Plan dealer schemes, promotions and product training sessions on features, installation and service.
* Visit key dealers and customers regularly, collect market feedback and strengthen relationships.
* Maintain a dealer database with sales performance, outstanding follow-ups and support needs.

5. Customer Visits, Demonstrations and Tenders

* Support site visits, factory visits and live product demonstrations that build buyer confidence.
* Collect testimonials, installation photos and references from satisfied customers.
* Support quotations, documentation and submissions for government, industrial and institutional tenders.

6. Exhibitions and Events

* Plan SKS participation in trade fairs, agricultural and industrial exhibitions, and dealer meets.
* Manage stall design, sample products, printed material, staffing and logistics within the approved budget.
* Capture leads at events and follow up within an agreed time.

7. Digital and Online Presence

* Manage the company website, LinkedIn page, Instagram, Facebook and Google Business profile with regular technical and factory content.
* Maintain product listings on B2B portals such as IndiaMART and respond to portal leads.
* Run paid campaigns on Google and Meta within budget, and apply basic SEO to improve search visibility.
* Track website visits, enquiries and campaign cost, and improve what works.

8. Market Intelligence and Planning

* Track competitor products, pricing, schemes and promotions, and share a regular summary with management.
* Prepare a monthly and annual marketing plan with targets and budget, and review progress against it.
* Share customer and dealer feedback with production and design to support product improvements.

9. Reporting and Coordination

* Submit a monthly report covering enquiries, quotations, orders won, lead sources, campaign spend and key learnings.
* Coordinate with accounts, dispatch and service teams so customers receive a smooth experience after the order.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (essential). An MBA in Marketing is an added advantage.
* 2 to 4 years of experience in industrial or manufacturing marketing or technical sales, preferably with pumps, motors, machinery or engineering goods.
* Experience working with dealers, distributors, contractors or industrial buyers is preferred.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

Technical and Functional

* Strong mechanical fundamentals and the ability to read technical drawings, specifications and performance data.
* Ability to prepare technical quotations and explain product benefits to non-technical customers.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, social media, basic SEO and design tools such as Canva; basic video editing is an advantage.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets, email and CRM or lead tracking.

**Behavioural**

* Clear communication in English and Tamil, both written and spoken (Hindi is an advantage).
* Confident negotiation and relationship-building with dealers and customers.
* Self-driven, organised and able to manage several follow-ups and campaigns at once.
* Willingness to travel to dealers, customers and exhibitions.
* Team player who works well with production, sales and management.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Number of qualified enquiries per month
* Enquiry-to-quotation and quotation-to-order conversion
* Orders from new dealers and new customers
* Cost per lead and return on marketing spend
* Quality and timeliness of marketing material and reports
* Growth in website, portal and social media enquiries

**AUTHORITY AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Spends marketing budget and commits to vendors within limits approved by the General Manager.
* Prices, discounts, dealer terms and tenders require management approval.
* Based at the factory in Coimbatore, with regular travel for dealer visits, customer demonstrations and exhibitions.
* Working hours may extend during exhibitions, campaigns and peak dispatch periods.

**COMPENSATION**

Salary of Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month, based on experience and skills, along with statutory benefits as per company policy. Travel expenses for official visits are reimbursed as per company policy.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
The Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated and manual test solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise applications. This role will have a strong focus on test automation using Tricentis Tosca and will collaborate with business analysts, developers, product owners, and other QA team members to validate business requirements and ensure high-quality software delivery.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about quality engineering, automation, and continuous improvement, with experience testing complex enterprise applications. Experience with Oracle EBS, Siebel, SAP, or Salesforce (SFDC) environments is highly desirable.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Tricentis Tosca for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Create and execute manual test cases where automation is not practical or feasible.
* Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and project review sessions to ensure quality requirements are properly addressed.
* Perform functional, system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.
* Design reusable automation components and optimize automation frameworks for scalability and maintainability.
* Execute automation suites as part of release validation and production readiness activities.
* Identify, document, track, and validate software defects through resolution.
* Support CI/CD and continuous testing initiatives by integrating automated testing into deployment pipelines.
* Develop and maintain test data required for test execution.
* Collaborate with business users, developers, architects, and analysts to understand application behavior and business processes.
* Generate testing metrics, test execution reports, and quality dashboards.
* Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis of application issues.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, testing efficiency, and quality processes.
* Participate in peer reviews of test cases, automation scripts, and testing artifacts.
* Validate integrations between enterprise applications and supporting systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing.
* 3+ years of hands-on test automation experience using Tricentis Tosca.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and quality assurance best practices.
* Experience creating automated test cases from business and functional requirements.
* Experience with regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, and system testing.
* Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile and hybrid development environments.
* Experience validating data across front-end and back-end systems.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.

**Test Automation Skills (Required)**
Tricentis Tosca Expertise
  
  

* Advanced hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca automation framework.
* Expertise in:Model-Based Test Automation Module creation and maintenance Test Case Design Test Data Service (TDS) Test Case Templates Execution Lists Requirements Traceability Risk-Based Testing API and Web Service Testing Distributed Execution
* Experience developing and maintaining large-scale automated regression suites.
* Ability to troubleshoot and optimize unstable automation scripts.
* Experience integrating Tosca automation within CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with automation reporting and quality metrics.
* Experience validating web, desktop, API, and enterprise applications using Tosca.
* Ability to identify and automate high-value business processes and critical user journeys.

**Additional Automation Experience**

* Experience with one or more of the following automation tools:OpenText UFT / UFT One Selenium Playwright Postman SOAP UI
* Familiarity with source control and DevOps tools:Git GitHub Azure DevOps Jenkins

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing enterprise applications such as:Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Siebel CRM SAP Salesforce (SFDC)
* Experience validating end-to-end business processes across enterprise systems.
* Experience supporting enterprise application upgrades, implementations, and enhancements.
* Knowledge of API, middleware, and integration testing.
* Experience working with cloud-based enterprise applications.
* SQL knowledge for data validation and backend testing.

Nice to Have
  
  
Domain Knowledge
  
  
Experience supporting business processes in one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Supply Chain Management
* Order Management
* Inventory Management
* Procurement
* Repair Services / Service Operations
* Finance
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* General Ledger
* Financial Reporting

**Additional Skills**

* Experience working with global teams.
* Exposure to performance and load testing concepts.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing tools and quality engineering practices.
* Understanding of test data management and test environment management.

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. title: Senior Test Engineer, IMS & AI Communication Products
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Test Engineer with 5-6 years of experience in testing IMS-based telecom products and next-generation AI-powered communication applications, including Voice Translation, Speech Processing, Conversational AI, and Real-Time Media platforms
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**IMS & Telecom Testing**

* Perform functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing of IMS-based products.
* Validate end-to-end call flows across IMS network elements.
* Analyze and troubleshoot telecom signaling and media issues.
* Execute interoperability testing with various IMS components and network elements.
* Perform capacity, load, scalability, failover, resiliency, and soak testing.

**AI Product Testing**

* Test AI-powered communication products such as:

+ Voice Translation
+ Speech-to-Text (STT)
+ Text-to-Speech (TTS)
+ Conversational AI / Voice Bots
+ Real-time Media Processing

* Validate AI inference accuracy, latency, scalability, and multilingual capabilities.
* Develop test scenarios for AI model validation and user experience verification.

**Automation & Cloud-Native Testing**

* Design and implement automation frameworks using Python.
* Develop test scripts for validating APIs, SIP call flows, and media scenarios.
* Execute testing in Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
* Validate deployment, upgrade, rollback, and high-availability scenarios.

**Protocol & Media Validation**

* Analyze SIP traces using Wireshark, HOMER, or equivalent tools.
* Validate RTP, SRTP, RTCP media flows.
* Debug signaling and media issues across distributed systems.

Review logs, packet captures, and KPIs to identify product defects
  
  
**Job Requirements**

* Telecom / IMS: IMS Architecture, SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, Diameter, HTTP/REST APIs, WebRTC
* IMS Network Elements: SBC, TAS/Application Server, MRF, IMS Core Components
* Cloud & Containerization: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Helm, Microservices, Cloud-Native Deployments, OpenShift (Plus)
* Automation: Python (Mandatory), API Automation, PyTest/Robot Framework, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions)
* Testing & Monitoring Tools: Spirent Landslide, Spirent Abacus, Ixia, Wireshark, HOMER, SIPp, Prometheus/Grafana (Preferred)
* Experience: 5 - 8 years of relevant experience
* Candidates available to join immediate and currently working in Bangalore are preferred

**Accessibility**
Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.
  
  
Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status.

As a Test Engineer, you will independently own test automation, continuous integration, and regression for specific feature areas, ensuring high-quality product verification. You will leverage Agentic AI tools to accelerate test design and automation, and coach junior engineers on best practices in Robot Framework, Python, CI, and test reliability. * Use Agentic AI tools to accelerate test design and automation
* Coach juniors on Robot Framework, Python, CI and test reliability

* A Graduate / Master degree in Engineering or equivalent with 5+years of experience in SW/telecom product verification and test automation using Robot Framework, Python, and Bash for scripting and test environment setup.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer, FBA
description:
**Description**
READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world-class infrastructure. Sellers, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, in 135 countries worldwide, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.
  
  
Our team is working to solve what is arguably the most difficult eCommerce problem that exists today: building sophisticated, scalable technology to effectively simplify the complexity of connecting millions of FBA sellers with hundreds of millions of consumers who buy their products. Even small improvements result in millions of dollars in savings for our sellers and customers. Given the importance of small and medium sized businesses, these savings are what helps drive the global economy.
  
  
Specifically, the Send to Amazon - STA Platforms (STAP) team is part of the broader Inbound Workflows and Platforms organization. The STAP team owns the user interface platform that enables sellers to inbound products to Amazon. As the owners of this platform, the STAP engineering team is responsible for the codebase, development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and providing on-call support. The team is also accountable for the inbounding workflow built on this platform, which supports a wide range of marketplaces categorized as "Worldwide" (WW). This encompasses the end-to-end engineering and quality assurance for the seller-facing UI on Seller Central. Additionally, the STAP team owns various services that they have inherited over time from other teams. The QA team within STAP specifically owns manual feature and regression testing across multiple initiatives, both within the inbound workflows organization and beyond.
  
  
We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing our team great flexibility in product and technology direction. Come, join us and build the future!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plan, automation, and methodologies to ensure the quality and reliability of software products.
* Collaborate and influence cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and project managers to understand software quality requirements and design effective test strategies.
* Define release planning and provide input on the readiness of software for production deployment.
* Work with component teams to identify the pain points in their area and provide technical guidance.
* Create, maintain, and execute test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for various software components, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing.
* Identify and document defects, issues, and potential areas of improvement in the software development process.
* Perform root cause analysis of complex issues and work with the development team to resolve issues and enhance the overall product quality.
* Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in QA and testing, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve testing processes.
* Define key metrics for measuring and reporting on the quality of software products and test effectiveness.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* 5+ years of delivering test frameworks, test tools, leading the QA projects and initiatives experience
* Knowledge of QA methodology and tools, with demonstrated experience in an QAE role
* Excellent English written and verbal skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
* Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
* Knowledge of at least one modern object-oriented programming language such as C++, Java, Objective C
* Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
* Experience in leading/coordinating work for other test teams
