title: Software QA Engineer
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.
  
  
You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages.
* Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
* Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
* Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
* Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
* Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
* Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation.
* Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions.
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.
* Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger.
* Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation.
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts.
* Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: Quality Assurance Lead (OSS FCAPS)
description:
Job Description

**Greetings From Rakuten Symphony!**

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.

Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together! About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Lead/Senior QA Engineer to design, architect and lead end-to-end integration testing and validation strategies across our OSS (Operations Support Systems) platforms. In this role, you will drive quality governance for complex multi-vendor ecosystems spanning Configuration Management (CM / Config Manager), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM), Performance Management (PM), Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Cloud Observability workflows. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in telecom service assurance, network synchronization parameters and a strong background in validating highly distributed data layers— specifically leveraging Graph databases for complex network topologies alongside Redis for high through put, real-time caching and data streaming pipelines.

**Key Responsibilities :**

•
**Integration & E2E Validation: Architect and execute comprehensive integration testing strategies across highly interconnected OSS environments, ensuring flawless structural data orchestration between northbound/southbound APIs, multi-vendor EMS/NMS and physical/virtual network elements.**

**• Configuration Management (CM) Validation: Design and drive automated validation frameworks for CM engines to audit network configurations, track baseline drift, validate parameters (e.g., cell parameters, routing tables) and verify automated network provisioning rollbacks.**

• Database & Network Topology Testing: Validate large-scale Graph databases (e.g., Janus Graph)utilized for real-time network topology mapping, complex entity relationship queries and cross domain dependency modeling.

• Performance & Cache Validation: Performance-test and validate distributed Redis DB implementations, ensuring active data structures, eviction policies, session states and high frequency pub/sub message queuing behave reliably under simulated peak telecom traffic loads.

• Test Automation Frameworks: Design, build and scale custom test automation frameworks from scratch using Java and/or Python leveraging industry-standard tools such as Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, TestNG and REST Assured.

• Observability & Streaming Validation: Validate cloud-native observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) along with high-throughput distributed messaging and event data logs streams orchestrated via Apache Kafka clusters.

• AIOps & Closed-Loop Automation: Lead end-to-end quality validation initiatives for AI/ML-driven root cause analysis (RCA), predictive network analytics, anomaly detection algorithms and closedloop self-healing operational workflows.

• CI/CD/CT Quality Gates: Embed robust automated quality validation gates, automated continuous regression suites and infrastructure tests seamlessly into DevOps deployment pipelines via Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD/CT engines.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies:**

**OSS & Telecom Domain Expertise**

• Comprehensive understanding of the FCAPS structural framework and modern Telecom Service Assurance principles.

• Hands-on validation experience covering Configuration Management (CM), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM) and Performance Management (PM) domains.

• Expertise in parsing network topology nodes, checking delta configurations and validating multivendor EMS/NMS integration points.

Database & Architectural Skills

• Strong querying and structural knowledge of Graph Databases along with graph query languages.

• Deep understanding of Redis DB core architecture, including data structures, replication, eviction policies, clustering and Pub/Sub functionality.

• Proven experience verifying log, search and transactional accuracy across distributed data backends including Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Cassandra.

Automation Engineering

• Advanced proficiency using Python or Java to design test libraries, custom keywords and object oriented testing suites.

• Robust hands-on framework experience with programmatic API Testing Tools (REST Assured, Postman) and message brokers (Kafka).

• Solid architectural knowledge of containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes orchestration and Helm charts.

**Experience & Qualifications**

• 5-10 years of direct, hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on Telecom OSS and Service Assurance systems.

• Proven background validating highly distributed distributed systems with demanding high availability, real-time telemetry and complex data persistence requirements.

• Excellent analytical, root-cause isolation and communication skills to collaborate efficiently across multi-vendor technical domains.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical engineering field.

**Rakuten Shugi Principles:**

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world.

We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

• Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.

• Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.

• Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.

• Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.

• Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

**AI QA / SDET Engineer**
to join our Software Engineering team. Penguin Computing’s Scyld Software products are used to deploy, provision, manage, and monitor some of the largest computational systems in the world. As we expand these platforms with
**AI/LLM-powered and agentic capabilities**

**quality, reliability, performance, and security**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in software testing and automation with hands-on knowledge of
**LLM evaluation, AI agent testing, AI security testing, and modern AI quality methodologies**
. You will help define testing strategies, build scalable automation and AI evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve our testing processes and tools.
  
  
This role requires strong technical problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work with a high degree of independence. You will have the opportunity to shape our evolving
**AI quality engineering practice**
and ensure that both traditional software and AI-powered capabilities are reliable, secure, measurable, and production-ready.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define and execute end-to-end QA strategy for software, AI/LLM features, and AI agents.
* Design and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering API, UI, integration, regression, performance, and infrastructure testing.
* Build LLM/AI evaluation frameworks and automated evaluation pipelines integrated with CI/CD.
* Define evaluation datasets, test scenarios, golden datasets, and quality benchmarks for AI features.

* Test AI agents and agentic workflows including reasoning, tool/function calling, multi-step execution, state management, error handling, and recovery.
* Validate RAG pipelines , including retrieval quality, context relevance, grounding, citation accuracy, and response quality.

* Test AI systems across different models and configurations to validate reliability and model-independent behavior.
* Replicate customer environments through simulated data and usage patterns for realistic end-to-end testing.
* Partner with Software Engineering, AI Engineering, Product, and Architecture teams to embed quality engineering early in the SDLC .
* Troubleshoot complex issues across Linux, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and AI application layers.

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  
  

* LLM Evaluation: LLM-as-a-Judge, golden datasets, pairwise evaluation, rubric-based scoring, human-in-the-loop evaluation
* Evaluation Frameworks: DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals or equivalent
* Agent Testing: tool/function-call validation, trajectory evaluation, task-completion testing, multi-agent workflow testing
* RAG Evaluation: retrieval precision/recall, context relevance, faithfulness/groundedness, answer correctness
* AI Security: prompt injection, jailbreak testing, data-exfiltration testing, privilege/access-control testing, adversarial testing
* Security Frameworks/Tools: OWASP LLM guidance, Garak, PyRIT, Promptfoo or equivalent AI red-teaming tools
* Observability: tracing and evaluation of prompts, model responses, tool calls, agent decisions, latency, token usage, and failures

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 6-8 years of experience in QA, SDET, software engineering, or test automation.
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test architecture, and software development lifecycle.
* Strong coding/scripting skills in Python ; Bash, JavaScript, or C experience is beneficial.
* Experience building automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines .
* Strong Linux command-line, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with API, functional, integration, regression, performance, and security testing.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization .
* Hands-on exposure to LLMs, Generative AI applications, RAG, AI agents or Agentic AI Platforms .
* Understanding of LLM-specific failure modes including hallucination, non-determinism, prompt injection, and unsafe agent behavior.
* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, or similar testing frameworks.
* Knowledge of HPC/AI infrastructure, networking, GPUs, or distributed systems is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**
Build a modern quality engineering practice where
**traditional software testing and AI evaluation come together**
**,**
enabling us to ship infrastructure software and AI agents that are
**reliable, measurable, secure, and safe to operate in production**
**.**

Monitor runs, triage failures quickly, separate infra issues from product bugs, and file high‑quality defects with clear workload, scale, logs, and impact—driving them to closure with Dev, PM, and Release teams.

* Proven ability to design and execute long‑running scenarios that surface race conditions, memory leaks, scaling issues, and resiliency gaps.
* Strong debugging skills across host, network, storage system, logs, and metrics.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux and at least one of VMware, Windows, or Kubernetes.
* Solid experience with test automation (Python, shell), CI pipelines, and result dashboards.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional collaboration with Development, System Test, Release, and Support.
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting complex findings and risk assessments to senior engineers and leaders.
* Directory services and identity:AD, LDAP, Kerberos, ID mapping — and how per-tenant auth domains explode the test matrix.
* Linux systems skills:shell, networking (VLANs, sub-interfaces, routing,ip,tc), service debugging, log and core analysis at scale

**Nice‑to‑have**

* Background in enterprise storage.
* Experience with performance engineering, capacity / longevity modeling, or customer‑data‑driven test design.
* Exposure to AI‑assisted test design or triage and interest in using new tools to improve coverage and efficiency.
* Experience working with different hypervisors, backup applications, databases, video streaming or healthcare applications/workloads is a plus
* Prior multi-tenancy / RBAC / virtual-array isolation work in storage or cloud.
* Replication and DR:async/ADR, sync-rep, ActiveCluster or metro-cluster, split-brain and resync validation.
* QoS and quotatest background.

* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
  
  
**Accommodations And Accessibility**
Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
  
  
**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

title: Software Engr II
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience to join our Quality and Automation Team. The role will be approximately 80% automation and 20% manual testing, with primary responsibility for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation solutions for cloud-based and web-based cybersecurity applications, complemented by focused exploratory, functional, and release-validation activities. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation teams to accelerate delivery, improve coverage, and strengthen product quality
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Spend approximately 80% of the role owning the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of automation frameworks for cloud and web-based cybersecurity applications.
* Build reusable automation libraries, utilities, services, and test infrastructure that support functional, integration, API, UI, system, and end-to-end validation.
* Develop reliable automation using appropriate programming languages and frameworks, with emphasis on clean code, modular design, maintainability, and scalability.
* Automate REST API, web UI, backend service, and cloud workflow validation across supported environments.
* Integrate automated suites with CI/CD pipelines and enable scheduled, on-demand, and release-gating execution.
* Analyze failures, identify product and framework defects, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.
* Spend approximately 20% of the role on risk-based manual testing, including exploratory testing, complex scenario validation, usability checks, and release verification where automation is not practical or has not yet been implemented.
* Define automation strategy, coding standards, review practices, quality metrics, and technical roadmaps.
* Review code, mentor engineers, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide technical leadership within the automation team.
* Collaborate with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation stakeholders to understand requirements and improve testability.
* Translate suitable manual test scenarios into maintainable automated coverage, while documenting justified manual-only coverage and associated risks.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, execution reports, dashboards, traceability, and evidence required for releases.
* Evaluate tools and technologies, lead proof-of-concept activities, and continuously improve automation efficiency, reliability, and coverage.
* Follow secure coding, credential-management, data-protection, and cybersecurity best practices throughout the automation lifecycle.

**Qualifications**
Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in software testing and test automation, with demonstrated delivery in roles primarily focused on automation and supported by hands-on manual testing.
* Demonstrated experience as a core contributor or technical lead for automation solutions supporting cloud-based or web-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, data structures, design patterns, debugging, and source-control practices.
* Practical experience in test design, exploratory testing, defect reporting, regression testing, and release validation, with the ability to determine which scenarios should remain manual and which should be automated.
* Experience working in Agile product-development environments and collaborating with geographically distributed teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* The following skills and experience are mandatory for this role:
* Advanced proficiency in at least one automation-oriented programming language as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with web automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Strong experience in API automation and validation using REST clients, libraries, or frameworks.
* Experience with unit and test frameworks such as PyTest, JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including services, identity, networking, logging, and deployment concepts.
* Experience in integrating automation into CI/CD systems such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Proficiency with Git-based workflows, code reviews, branching strategies, and build pipelines.
* Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Good understanding of web technologies, authentication and authorization mechanisms, certificates, APIs, databases, and distributed-system fundamentals.
* Ability to diagnose failures using logs, traces, monitoring data, and systematic debugging techniques.
* Understanding of secure software-development practices and common cybersecurity concepts relevant to cloud and web applications.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience automating cybersecurity products, security platforms, connected systems, or enterprise software.
* Knowledge of security testing concepts, including vulnerability management, identity and access management, encryption, audit logging, and role-based access control.
* Experience with performance, reliability, resilience, or security-focused automation.
* Experience designing automation for multi-tenant SaaS platforms or microservices-based applications.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Senior SDET – AI-Driven Quality Engineering**

* Champion an AI-first testing culture — proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML-powered tools into test design, execution, maintenance, and defect analysis.

* Leverage large language models (LLMs) and AI assistants to generate test cases from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria — then validate, refine, and own the output.
* Implement AI-augmented log and anomaly analysis to proactively identify patterns that precede failures in production or staging environments.

* Be the first customer to the product and its documentation; provide feedback from the customer's perspective and act as the quality champion for the team.

* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in SDET or quality engineering roles, with demonstrable exposure to AI-assisted testing or tooling.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and modern software testing methodologies.
* Proficiency in Java, Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; ability to write, review, and debug automation code at scale.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright/Selenium for UI and API testing.
* Practical experience with one or more AI-powered testing tools - such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, similar.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Senior Automation QA Engineer Role**
Qlik is seeking a highly skilled
**Senior Automation QA Engineer**
to design and develop automated testing solutions for our
**Salesforce**
and
**NetSuite**
platforms.
  
  
This role combines strong QA automation engineering with
**hands-on AI agent development using Playwright**
. The engineer will use AI agents and modern automation techniques to accelerate testing, improve coverage and reliability, and provide faster quality feedback throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**The role also requires a responsible approach to AI development, considering appropriate ethical, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight**
principles.
  
  
**What makes this role interesting?**
The software testing landscape is rapidly evolving, and the biggest challenge we are tackling right now is balancing deployment speed with flawless reliability. You will be at the forefront of solving this by replacing manual bottlenecks with intelligent, AI-driven automation.
  
  
**Here Is Why You Will Love What You Do**

* Pioneering AI in QA: You get to build and deploy advanced AI agents using Playwright, completely transforming how test creation, execution, and regression testing are handled.
* Accelerating development cycles: By seamlessly integrating your automated tests directly into CI/CD pipelines, you will give developers the immediate, reliable feedback they need to build faster.
* Elevating the testing framework: Instead of maintaining legacy code, you will design and develop highly reusable automation frameworks and utilities from the ground up, freeing yourself from repetitive maintenance.
* Championing ethical AI: You won't just blindly trust AI outputs; you will be the human-in-the-loop. You will apply vital oversight, evaluating AI-generated results to ensure our testing practices remain secure, fair, and highly accurate.

**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**
Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely we deliver software. By joining us, you aren't just finding bugs—you are engineering a smarter, more efficient way to build products.
  
  

* Driving strategic quality: You will partner closely with developers, product owners, and key stakeholders to identify risks early, shifting quality left and shaping the overall testing strategy.
* Transforming defect detection: Your sophisticated, AI-enhanced test scenarios will catch critical issues before they reach production, ensuring rock-solid reliability across our Salesforce and NetSuite environments.
* Streamlining QA processes: Your clear, actionable insights from test failures and meticulous tracking metrics will continuously elevate our entire software development lifecycle.
* Mentoring through innovation: By introducing AI-assisted testing practices and clear documentation, you will naturally elevate the technical capabilities of the wider team and establish new industry-leading standards.

**We’re Looking For a Teammate With**

* 5+ years of hands-on QA automation experience.
* Strong programming and automation experience with Playwright and Python; experience with Selenium or similar frameworks is beneficial.
* Proven experience building AI agents using Playwright for software testing or QA automation.
* Good understanding of AI models, LLMs, and AI agent development, including how agents use tools and interact with applications.
* Experience with AI/agent technologies such as OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce (Apex, Lightning) and NetSuite (SuiteScript, workflows, or saved searches).
* Experience developing end-to-end automation across complex enterprise applications and integrations.
* Strong understanding of QA fundamentals, including test planning, test design, regression testing, defect management, and Agile/Scrum.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Jira, and test management tools such as Zephyr.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and effective use of LLMs in software engineering.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices, including ethical use, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight.
* Performance, load, or security testing experience is desirable.
* Salesforce or NetSuite certifications are desirable.

**The location for this role is:**
Bangalore, India
  
  
**Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!**
**More About Qlik And Who We Are**
Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page.
  
  
**What else do we offer?**

* Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs.
* Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness.
* Flexible, diverse, and international work environment.

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs

Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes.

**The role:**

**Title:**
AI Engineer

**Function:**
Technology

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Why this role exists:**

The AI Engineer orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design mock-ups within a pod delivery model. The role translates product specifications into functional instructions for AI agents, running multiple agent workstreams in parallel across standard-complexity work while holding the pre-production commit gate for routine changes.

The role evolves how engineering is executed. AI agents carry a significant share of test generation, documentation and code execution, while the AI Engineer remains fully accountable for system design judgement, code review, quality and all commitments to production. The role relies on AI-driven test coverage, agent-supported execution and human-in-the-loop validation to maintain high release standards.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Agent Orchestration and Delivery:**

* Translate product specifications from the Product Orchestrator into functional specifications and instructions that AI agents can execute, clarifying intent where requirements are ambiguous.
* Run multiple technical agents in parallel across standard-complexity work (coding, test case generation, documentation and visual design mock-ups) sequencing outputs so one stream is usable by the next.
* Apply base context, security policies, architecture patterns and coding standards established by the platform team to every agent run.
* Improve agent workflows continuously, sharing prompt techniques, context improvements and automation patterns across pods.

**Review, Quality Engineering, and Commit Gate:**

* Hold the pre-production commit gate on routine changes, ensuring no code reaches production without thorough review.
* Perform fast and accurate reviews of generated code, tests and specifications, identifying subtle errors, logical defects or plausible but incorrect outputs.
* Confirm that instructions given to technical agents have been executed to the expected standard before committing code.
* Design and execute test strategy for assigned workstreams, including functional integration and regression testing, building on AI-generated test coverage and agent-supported execution.
* Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, communicating severity and coordinating fixes with technical and functional stakeholders.
* Own non-functional outcomes for assigned workstreams, including performance, resilience, accessibility and security, and confirm architectural fit before commit.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or major architectural changes to the Senior AI Engineer or Principal AI Engineer for higher-level review.

**Context, Documentation and Knowledge Management:**

* Verify that technical documentation exists and is accurate, maintaining documentation as an active input to subsequent agent runs rather than an after-the-fact record.
* Maintain knowledge artefacts for workstreams so future code and agent outputs draw on detailed, reusable domain context over time.
* Contribute domain knowledge back to shared context repositories in line with central standards managed by Context Engineers.
* Maintain clear system provenance to distinguish agent-generated components from human-authored code.

**Production Support and Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve reported defects and incidents promptly across the platform domains the pod touches, including participation in on-call rotations.
* Support and maintain existing platforms, integrations and legacy services alongside agent-based delivery flows during technical transition periods.
* Execute production verification testing during post-deployment and hypercare periods, confirming release quality before handover to steady-state support.
* Report observed drift, hallucinations or specification failures in agent tooling to Agent Integrity Engineers.

**Who you will be working with:**

**In this role, you will:**

* Product Orchestration: Clarify specification intent and raise technical feasibility or workstream sequencing considerations with Product Orchestrators.
* Engineering Leadership: Seek higher-level review for complex or high-risk changes from Senior AI Engineers, Principal Domain Engineers, and Associate Engineering Managers.
* Architecture and Context Teams: Apply platform context libraries and feed domain knowledge back to Context Engineers, Solution Architects and Domain Architects.
* Platform and Integrity Specialists: Report agent drift or hallucination to Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and collaborate with Platform Engineers on workflows and permissions.

**What success looks like:**

* Workstream Throughput: High throughput of reviewed and committed work delivered through parallel multi-agent workstreams.
* Commit Gate Quality: High review quality with minimal defects escaping to production, backed by rigorous verification.
* Context Artefact Accuracy: High standard of accurate, reusable documentation and context artefacts that continuously improve subsequent agent runs.
* Platform Stability: High stability, supportability, and swift issue resolution across owned platform domains and legacy components.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How will you lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. We begin with customer, We do the right thing, We execute with accountability and We lead with ambition

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 6-8 years of software engineering experience, combining full-stack development with hands-on software quality assurance and testing across manual and automated methodologies.
* System Design Judgement: Demonstrated system design judgement to assess whether AI-generated code and technical output are fit for purpose, performant, and secure.
* Agent Orchestration: Practical experience or strong capability in orchestrating AI agents and developer tooling across parallel workstreams.
* Specification Literacy: Proven ability to write clear, precise functional specifications and prompts that produce accurate agent output.
* Quality Engineering: Demonstrated experience designing and executing test strategy (test planning, functional, integration and regression testing, test automation and defect management) across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Code Review Discipline: Experience conducting fast, accurate code reviews and managing pre-production commit gates, with an ability to identify plausible but incorrect logic.
* Operational Resilience: Experience supporting services in production, including incident handling and participating in on-call rotations across complex cloud architectures

**Preferred:**

* Retail Commerce Architecture: Experience working with modern headless retail platforms and commerce developer tooling.
* Observability Tooling: Familiarity with modern log management and observability tooling such as Sumo Logic or Datadog.
* Cloud and CI/CD Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS), Docker containerization, Git workflows, and modern CI/CD pipelines

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.
* Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models.
* Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability.
* Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

title: ERP Implementation Executive
description:
**ERP Implementation Executive – BOS**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About BOS**

**BOS is a next-generation Business Operating System designed to help companies manage and connect their operations across areas such as sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, finance, workforce management and other business functions.**

**BOS goes beyond traditional ERP software by adapting to the operational processes of each organisation rather than forcing every business into a rigid, predefined system.**

**We are currently implementing BOS with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an ERP Implementation Executive to work directly with customers and our product and development teams.**

**About the Role**

**As an ERP Implementation Executive, you will help businesses successfully adopt and implement BOS.**

**This is not primarily a software development role. You will work closely with business owners, department heads and operational users to understand how their business works, configure BOS around their processes, coordinate data migration, train users, support testing and take departments through go-live.**

**You will act as the bridge between the customer and the BOS product/development team**
.

The role provides significant exposure to real business operations and is suited to someone who wants to develop a career in ERP implementation, business analysis and enterprise technology consulting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meet customers, department heads and operational users to understand their existing business processes.
* Study how departments currently operate using ERP systems, Excel, documents and manual processes.
* Document business processes, requirements, approval flows, user roles and operational rules.
* Map existing customer processes to BOS and identify configuration or product requirements.
* Work with the BOS product and development teams to translate business requirements into system requirements.
* Configure customers, users, roles, permissions, departments, workflows and other implementation settings within BOS.
* Assist with collection, cleaning, validation and migration of master and transactional data.
* Coordinate implementation activities across departments such as Commercial, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Finance and HR/Workforce.
* Conduct product demonstrations and user training for department heads and end users.
* Prepare test scenarios and coordinate functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Record issues, gaps and enhancement requirements identified during implementation.
* Work with developers to verify that issues have been correctly resolved.
* Support customers during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Monitor adoption after go-live and help users transition from their existing processes to BOS.
* Maintain implementation documentation, meeting notes, action items and implementation status.
* Visit customer offices and operational locations when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who combines business understanding, communication skills and technology aptitude**
.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, managers and operational staff.
* Be curious about how businesses actually operate.
* Be able to understand a business process and translate it into a software workflow.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Be organised and capable of following multiple implementation activities simultaneously.
* Be comfortable working with Excel and business data.
* Have good written and verbal communication skills.
* Be comfortable learning complex enterprise software.
* Be willing to visit customer locations and work closely with customers during implementations.
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing requirements between the customer and development team.

**Preferred Experience**

**Candidates with 1–4 years of experience**
in any of the following would be particularly suitable:

* ERP implementation
* ERP functional consulting
* Business analysis
* Software implementation
* Customer onboarding for enterprise software
* Manufacturing ERP
* Inventory or warehouse systems
* Procurement systems
* HRMS / payroll implementation
* Accounting or finance software implementation

Experience with systems such as
**SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Tally, ERPNext or similar ERP/business applications**
would be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Candidates who have worked inside manufacturing or other operational businesses and have strong systems knowledge may also be considered.

**Educational Background**

**Relevant qualifications may include:**

* B.Com / M.Com
* BBA / MBA
* BCA / MCA
* BE / B.Tech
* Information Systems
* Operations / Supply Chain
* Finance / Accounting
* or another relevant discipline

We value practical ability and willingness to learn more than a specific degree.

**Skills That Will Be Valuable**

* ERP implementation
* Business process mapping
* Requirements gathering
* Functional documentation
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Data migration
* Microsoft Excel
* User training
* Customer communication
* Project coordination
* SQL knowledge – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of APIs/integrations – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of AI and modern business software – advantageous

**Why Join BOS?**

**BOS is being built as an alternative to the traditional approach to enterprise software.**

**Rather than joining an organisation where you repeatedly implement the same predefined ERP modules, you will have the opportunity to understand different businesses and help shape how their operations are represented within a new generation of business software.**

**You will work closely with the BOS leadership, product and engineering teams and gain exposure to:**

* Enterprise software implementation
* Business process design
* Manufacturing and operational businesses
* Product development
* Business analysis
* AI-enabled enterprise software
* Customer consulting
* Implementation project management

As BOS grows, this role can develop into
**Implementation Consultant, Senior Implementation Consultant, Implementation Manager and Implementation/Operations leadership roles**
.

title: Software Quality Engineer – Automation & AI
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Qualify new and existing software products and features through functional, regression, performance, reliability, and system-level testing.
* Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and validation strategies to ensure high product quality.
* Analyze test results and publish qualification reports, recommendations, training materials, and Best Known Methods (BKMs).
* Collaborate with Algorithm, System Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Customer Support teams across global locations.
* Assess automation feasibility and develop automated test solutions, frameworks, and tools to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design reviews, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer support.

**AI & Innovation Responsibilities**

* Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered tools to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, reporting, and documentation.
* Develop AI-enabled utilities, applications, and productivity tools for engineering and quality workflows.
* Explore and implement solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern AI frameworks.
* Drive AI adoption within the SQE organization by identifying, prototyping, and deploying high-impact use cases.
* Utilize AI and data analytics techniques to improve quality insights, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C#, C++, or Java.
* Experience with software testing, automation frameworks, and quality engineering methodologies.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI agents, or AI application development is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Represent SQE in product lifecycle reviews, key program meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Willingness to travel to customer fabrication facilities for use-case understanding, software deployment, and troubleshooting support as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Performance Test Engineer
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Performance Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for performance testing.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Develop proven grasp of the DTCC Software Delivery process, Performance Test Engineering framework, CoE (Center of Excellence) Engagement process as well as understanding of tech-stack (tools and technologies) to perform day-to-day job
* Prepare, maintain, and implement performance/resiliency test scenarios based on non-functional requirements and follow standard DTCC testing guidelines
* Automate performance test scenarios by using current automated functional and performance test scripts in compliance with the non-functional framework
* Maintain traceability across Non-Functional Requirements, Performance Test Scenarios and Defects
* Review of performance and resiliency test scenarios from both a technical and business perspective with collaborators, such as development teams and business
* Track defects to closure, report test results, continuously supervise execution achievements and call out as required
* Contribute to the technical aspects of Delivery Pipeline adoption for performance testing and improve adoption
* Identify environmental and data requirements; collaborate with Development and Testing teams to manage and maintain environment and data
* Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered including architecture considerations and technical design of the supported applications in relations to the performance, resiliency and scalability.
* Work with Development and Architecture teams and find opportunities to improve the test coverage. Share suggestions for performance improvements
* Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; raises appropriately

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected.
* Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up-to-date.
* Collaborates well within and across teams.
* Communicates openly with team members and others.
* Experience in performance engineering (analysis, testing, and tuning)
* Experience in Resiliency and Chaos engineering
* Expertise in load testing tools, such as JMeter, LoadRunner etc.
* Experience with Snowflake tasks, warehouse, components and optimization
* Experience with AWS services (Kinesis, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc)
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline implementations, including testing, using Jenkins or similar tool
* Expertise in performance analysis of distributed platforms including Linux, Windows, AWS, Containers and VMware (tools: Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, CloudWatch, TeamQuest)
* Knowledge of the functionality and performance aspects of the above computing platforms
* Understanding of queuing networks modeling and simulation modeling concepts and experience with one of the industry standard analytic modeling tools – TeamQuest, Metron-Athenee, HyPerformix, and BMC
* Experience in scripting (Perl, Unix shell, Python, Terraform, Chef, Jenkins)
* Experience using JMS/IBM-MQ messaging system
* Understanding of RESTful web service, JSON, and XML
* Experience in Relational Databases, preferably Oracle
* Expert MS Office skills. Effective use of Excel statistical functions and sophisticated Power Point presentation skills
* Experience working with Agile teams (preferably scrum)
* Experience in the financial services industry is good to have
* Experience working in Unix or Linux environments

**Junior Engineer - Quality**
in

description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Responsable de la qualité de son travail. Assujetti à la supervision directe des opérations, aux instructions de travail prescrites et à une vérification système. Exécute ses tâches dans un cadre opérationnel bien défini. Il y dispose généralement d'une séquence détaillée des tâches opérationnelles standard à suivre pour obtenir le résultat final escompté.

Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. title: Supplier Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
**Intuitive**
. As a global leader in
**robotic-assisted surgery**
and
**minimally invasive care**
, our technologies—like the
**da Vinci surgical system**
and
**Ion**
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
In this role, a Supplier Engineer is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet ISI requirements for quality, service, delivery, and cost. Drive suppliers to continuously improve business and manufacturing processes. Evaluate and select suppliers. Guide Engineering in choosing suppliers for new products and provide DFM input to new designs to support NPI projects. Executes detailed projects with suppliers to ensure excellence across quality, cost, capacity, risk management, and sub-supplier management.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Drive PCBA manufacturing qualification at contract manufacturers, including readiness requirements and milestone reviews.
* Provide PCB/PCBA DFM feedback and escalate manufacturability risks early in product development.
* Complete project/ part qualification deliverables including: Supplier pFMEA, Process Validations (IQ/OQ/PQ), Inspection Reports, Gage R&R, and Process Capability Analysis
* Develop and implement manufacturing technologies and process improvements to enhance quality, reliability, throughput, and cost.
* Work with suppliers to execute cost reductions, capacity improvements, and risk mitigation
* Select the right process and supplier for the part, considering long term fit and total ownership cost
* Manage supplier changes including manufacturing process changes, production optimization, facility changes, new equipment qualification, and new line validations
* Drive changes to ISI requirements as necessary by initiating and managing changes to specifications and drawings through the engineering change order process
* Own and drive to closure supplier variances from symptom through root cause analysis to corrective action, including careful CAPA documentation
* Effectively prioritize and advance multiple concurrent projects and tasks
* Clearly communicate project status to key stakeholders
* Build, own, and relentlessly pursue a vision for developing suppliers
* Understand proper level of documentation detail for tracking of actions and justification of decisions
* Generate key metrics for the team and suppliers, and continually drive for timely achievement of those metrics
* Drive suppliers to continually improve their business and manufacturing process performance to meet Intuitive’s requirements for supplier excellence using a collection of best practices in project management, Six Sigma, Lean, SPC and negotiation. Lead these efforts without managerial guidance at several suppliers simultaneously
* Implement corrective and preventive actions for supplier process by driving supplier’s investigations and root cause analysis
* Provide effective and timely supply base health information and recommendation to management by creating and delivering data-driven supply base information to any level of management at ISI with little or no guidance
* Prepare and deliver supplier communications as required by independently working with suppliers on scorecard creation
* Work with suppliers and ISI design engineering for the new product introduction to:
* Create product supplier landscapes to determine launch readiness and report to management
* Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability.
* DFM by engaging suppliers early in development cycle to feedback manufacturability improvements in the designs prior to production
* Influence and guide Design Engineering in choosing suppliers by determining selection criteria for preferred suppliers and leading the team effort to evaluate preferred suppliers
* Review, analyze and close customer complaints, manufacturing variance requests, and first article inspections by judging risk analyses and justifications
* Evaluate corrective and preventive actions at suppliers, looks for opportunities with suppliers to eliminate recurrence

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 yrs related experience in engineering/manufacturing of Electronics (PCBA, PCA, cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, etc.) preferred.
* Experience with board assembly processes and equipment, including stencil, paste print, SPI, pick and place, SMT reflow, AOI, AXI, selective solder, flying probe, wash, and conformal coating.
* PCBA DFM experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
* Excellent Interpersonal, team building and project management skills
* Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
* Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, and capacity
* Excellent knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485
* Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Project, Access, and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP or Agile

**Required Education And Training**

* Minimum Education: BS degree in Engineering or equivalent experience, advanced degree preferred
* Experience with SMT/PCBA manufacturing and process development
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis – domestic and international.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Medical Device experience is a plus
* Supplier management experience is a plus
* Advanced degree preferred
* DFM tools experience, such as Valor or Allegro, is a plus.
* Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

title: Team Lead, Quality Assurance - 1
description:
**Department:**
Development
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Description**
Infor's AI Studio represents an agentic platform that enables teams to author, configure, and deploy Infor OS and ERP solutions utilizing natural language processing capabilities. We are seeking an Lead Quality Assurance Engineer to join the AI Studio team and lead the QA team to thoroughly validate the agent architecture of AI Studio. The testing will spread across components like ION, Data Fabric, Birst, EPM, RPA/IDP, CSD, and Portal. This initiative constitutes a strategic priority for Infor, designed to accelerate velocity suite sales, enhance customer experience, and facilitate more effective collaboration between Cutomers and Sevices, FDEs, Partners and SCs
  
  
We are seeking a Team Lead for Quality Assurance to lead the testing efforts to deliver high quality software solutions across our cloud product portfolio.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
**A Day in the Life Typically Includes:**

* Define and own the overall QA strategy for AI Studio — covering search relevance, multi-agent coordination, schema validation, tenant isolation, and LLM output quality.
* Lead a team of QA engineers, assign test coverage areas, review test plans, and ensure quality gates are met before each release.
* Collaborate with the AI Studio architecture team, component teams, and FDEs to understand new features, contribution model changes, and agent updates — translating these into test requirements.
* Drive the design of evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic Orchestrator outputs — defining what "correct" means for gap maps, dependency graphs, and blueprint quality across varying user inputs.
* Oversee search relevance regression testing — ensuring that as the knowledge corpus grows, existing query-result quality does not degrade.
* Define and enforce tenant isolation testing standards, ensuring no cross-tenant data leakage across sessions, project history, or search results.
* Report quality metrics to engineering leadership — solution generation success rates, clarification round counts, agent failure rates, and corpus coverage gaps.

**Basic Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 8–10 years of experience in software quality assurance with at least 3 years in a lead or principal QA role.
* Proven experience leading QA for an AI or data-intensive product in production — not just familiarity with concepts but hands-on ownership of quality outcomes.
* Deep understanding of RAG system testing — search relevance validation, embedding quality assessment, hybrid search behaviour, and corpus quality measurement.
* Strong experience with multi-agent or distributed system testing — tracing failures across service boundaries, validating inter-agent contracts, and verifying execution ordering.
* Experience building and maintaining automated test suites in Python, with the ability to define quality frameworks from scratch rather than inheriting them.
* Solid understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies and tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent — with the ability to select and adapt them to non-standard evaluation problems.
* Experience with REST API contract testing and integration testing across multi-service architectures.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS (Preferred), Azure, or GCP.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — ability to translate quality findings into clear risk assessments for engineering leadership and product teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience leading QA for agentic AI systems or LLM orchestration pipelines where output correctness is semantic rather than deterministic.
* Familiarity with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other vector and hybrid search platforms — ideally with hands-on experience designing relevance test suites.
* Knowledge of prompt adversarial testing — designing inputs that expose reasoning failures, hallucinations, incorrect component selection, or silent gap map errors.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps observability tooling — defining monitoring standards, alert thresholds, and trace inspection processes for AI pipelines.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS security testing, particularly tenant isolation and session boundary enforcement.
* Exposure to Infor OS, ERP systems, or enterprise workflow automation products — understanding the domain context that AI Studio operates in.
* Experience establishing QA contribution processes for knowledge-driven systems where test data quality directly determines test coverage effectiveness.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices — ability to integrate quality gates into automated deployment workflows.
