title: QA Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
As the QA Engineer on the Smart Water pod, you will own quality for a product being scaled into RealPage's standard meter-operations offering, and you will do it by writing test automation rather than clicking through manual passes. You will build automated coverage for the customer-facing Smart Water experience in the Smart Building Portal, the C#/.NET services behind it, and — critically — the accuracy of the meter and usage data flowing through the ingestion pipeline.
  
  
Smart Water's history of data-integrity and onboarding defects makes this a high-impact role: you will stand up the automated regression and data-validation suites that keep calculations correct (cost, usage, loss, occupancy), run in CI on every change, and prevent the kinds of issues that have delayed customer go-lives. A core goal of the pod is to move Smart Water off manual, PME-driven QA and onto repeatable automated tests.
  
  
This role suits a QA engineer who thinks like a developer — someone who reaches for a script before a manual test case and wants to build the automation foundation for a small, fast-moving pod.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, API, data-validation) as the primary way Smart Water is tested — integrated into the Azure DevOps CI pipeline to run on every change.
* Write automated UI and API tests across the Angular front end and C#/.NET services, replacing manual, repetitive test passes with scripted coverage.
* Automate data-integrity checks across the ingestion pipeline — meter reads, usage, cost, loss, and occupancy calculations — so regressions are caught in CI rather than by hand.
* Encode water-usage anomaly detection scenarios (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) as automated test cases against known data.
* Automate verification of onboarding and self-service workflows to prevent the data and configuration defects that have historically required PMEs.
* Partner closely with the pod's developers on quality — reproducing issues, adding regression tests, and confirming fixes.
* Reserve exploratory/manual testing for genuinely new features, and convert what you learn there into automated coverage.

**Qualifications**
This is an automation-first QA role on a C#/.NET and Angular product — the goal is scripted, CI-integrated tests, not manual QA.
  
  

* 2+ years in software QA with a strong emphasis on test automation.
* Proven experience writing and maintaining automated tests (e.g., Selenium/Playwright/Cypress for UI, plus REST API test frameworks) — this is the core of the role.
* Comfortable writing code/scripts to test software, not just executing manual test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for automating data validation in MSSQL.
* Experience integrating automated tests into a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps or similar).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Required**
**Preferred Skills but not required**

* Experience testing data pipelines / ETL or analytics products where data accuracy is critical.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch or performance testing.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET test tooling ( xUnit / NUnit ).

title: Manager, Business Process Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
The Business Process Improvement Analyst sits within the Enterprise Transformation Office. This role works under the direction of the Director of Process Transformation to engage with Service Lines or other functions across the business to diagnose root causes of pain points, understand and map current-state processes, define performance metrics and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations including; process redesign, automation AI-enabled solutions, and draft relevant requirements.
  
  
Engagements span the full range from targeted improvements within a single business team to larger, enterprise-wide initiatives. The analyst can engage across the firm, including Tax, Assurance, Advisory and Outsourced Services Service Lines, as well as other operational teams, wherever process improvement work is needed.
  
  
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support ETO business analysts & engage as directed with business unit stakeholders to identify pain points, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities through interviews, workshops, and process observation.
* Map & analyze current-state ("as-is") processes using ETO standard notation (swim lanes, SIPOC, value stream) and validate with process owners.
* Document data flows and system touchpoints as part of process mapping, particularly where they inform automation, integration, or AI-enabled recommendations.
* Design and support the implementation of process performance metrics and KPIs (leading and lagging indicators) to baseline performance and track the impact of improvements.
* Develop future-state ("to-be") process recommendations, including process redesign, automation, and AI/technology-enabled solutions.
* Translate discovery sessions and stakeholder input into structured requirements, process documentation, and decision-ready materials for the Director and business sponsors.
* Understand what’s needed to develop credible business cases for recommended changes, including effort, cost, and expected benefits, and work to gather relevant data/information as part of the initiative documentation.
* Contribute reusable process artifacts (templates, capability maps, documentation standards) to the Process Center of Excellence to promote consistency across projects and across the firm.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams by clearly articulating business requirements and validating that proposed solutions address the root problem.
* Track and report on the status of improvement initiatives, flagging risks and dependencies to the Director.
* Promote a continuous improvement mindset within partner business units.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Process maps and requirements are accurate, validated by stakeholders, and reused without rework.
* KPIs/metrics are in place and actively tracked within [60–90] days of engagement start.
* Improvement recommendations are adopted by business sponsors and show measurable impact against baseline.
* Documentation meets Process COE standards and is contributed back to the shared library.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in business process analysis, operations, consulting, or transformation roles, with demonstrated ownership of process work (not just support/documentation).
* Proven ability in writing business, data, & technical requirements and the development of wireframes to clearly articulate solutions
* Proven proficiency in process mapping (current- and future-state) - able to independently run mapping sessions and produce validated, accurate artifacts with minimal oversight.
* Confident engaging business unit stakeholders directly - able to ask the right questions, surface real pain points, and read between the lines of what's said versus what's actually broken.
* Demonstrated ability to recognize and shape improvement opportunities - not just document "as-is" state, but connect root causes to practical recommendations (process, tech, automation, or AI).
* Experience defining and standing up KPIs/metrics; familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, BPMN, or similar frameworks preferred.
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable working with process and operational data to identify root causes and quantify impact.
* Ability to manage time across multiple projects and escalate when help is required.
* Working knowledge of process/workflow tools (e.g., Visio, Miro) and data/reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to automation or AI-enabled process solutions (RPA, GenAI use cases, workflow tools).
* Process improvement certification (Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP, or equivalent).
* Experience in a shared services or enterprise transformation function.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax and business advisory firms in the U.S., with more than 5000 employees and over 450 partners across the country. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today, and position them for success tomorrow. Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries.
  
  
We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers and investors who serve these clients. Our reach extends globally, with offices in the United Kingdom, Israel, India, the Cayman Islands, Singapore, and Ireland.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. title: Technical Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
The Technical QA Analyst ensures that all code changes and product releases are thoroughly tested and correctly implemented before deployment. The primary goal of the role is to protect product quality by identifying bugs, usability issues, and unintended side effects early, reducing incidents in live environments.
  
  
The role also plays a key part in problem definition: working closely with end users and stakeholders to understand reported issues, reproduce them accurately, and assess their scope, severity, and root conditions.
  
  
This role is expected to grow its automation capability — moving from manual and exploratory testing towards developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks that support faster, repeatable release validation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Test code changes, fixes, and new features prior to release, ensuring they meet functional and technical requirements.
* Validate that deployments have been implemented correctly across environments (e.g. test, staging, production).
* Identify bugs, regressions, and edge cases before and after releases.
* Document test results clearly, including steps to reproduce issues and expected vs actual behaviour.
* Support release sign-off by providing confidence-based quality assessments.
* Develop, maintain and execute automated test scripts and test plans to validate software functionality and regression coverage.
* Contribute to the build-out of automated testing frameworks, working towards integration within the CI/CD pipeline over time.

**Issue Reproduction & Analysis**

* Work with end users, product teams, and support teams to understand reported issues.
* Recreate problems in test environments to determine:

+ How widespread the issue is
+ Under what conditions it occurs
+ Whether it is intermittent or consistent
+ What makes the issue better or worse

* Distinguish between user error, configuration issues, data-related problems, and genuine defects.
* Provide structured findings to developers to support fast and accurate fixes.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with software engineers, product managers, and IT colleagues throughout the development and release lifecycle.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical users by translating user experience into clear technical detail.
* Provide feedback to improve testing processes, release checklists, and documentation.

**Process Improvement**

* Help improve test coverage and testing approaches over time (with a growing emphasis on automation, alongside manual and exploratory testing where appropriate).
* Contribute to quality standards for releases and change management.
* Identify recurring problem patterns and suggest preventative improvements.

**Essential**
**Skills & Experience**

* Experience working in a technical or IT environment (QA, testing, support, engineering, or similar).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to methodically reproduce and isolate technical issues.
* Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to testing.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining issues and impact.
* Comfortable working with developers and technical systems.
* Foundational understanding of, or demonstrable interest in, test automation — including scripting, automation frameworks or tools (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing.

**Desirable**

* Experience testing software applications, platforms, or internal systems.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and release processes.
* Familiarity with bug tracking or ticketing tools.
* Basic understanding of code, APIs, databases, or system configuration — including the ability to write or interpret basic test scripts.
* Experience with regression testing, UAT, or exploratory testing.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools or CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious and investigative mindset.
* Patient and persistent when tracking down complex or intermittent issues.
* Comfortable asking questions and challenging assumptions.
* User-focused: concerned with how real people experience the product.
* Calm and structured, particularly during incidents or release windows.
* Eager to grow technical skills, particularly in test automation and quality engineering.

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**

* Fewer bugs and incidents reaching live environments.
* Faster resolution of reported issues due to clear reproduction and diagnosis.
* Increased confidence in releases from both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Improved understanding of product behaviour and risk areas over time.
* Growing test automation coverage, reducing reliance on manual regression testing over time.

**Why join YouGov?**
Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.
  
  
Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

title: Food Technologist
description:
Hiring: Food Technologist – In-House Manufacturing, Quality & Food Safety

**Location:**
Andheri East, Mumbai (Manufacturing Facility)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Department:**
Manufacturing / Operations

**Reports To:**
Founders / Head of Operations

Role Purpose

The Food Technologist will be the technical owner of in-house food manufacturing, responsible for ensuring all products are safe, compliant, consistent, shelf-stable, and scalable.

This role has end-to-end responsibility from raw material intake to finished goods dispatch, with authority over production processes, quality control, food safety systems, and factory discipline.

This is a hands-on factory-floor role, not a desk-based QA position.

Scope of Authority

The Food Technologist is authorized to:

* Stop production in case of quality or food safety risk
* Approve or reject raw materials, in-process batches, and finished goods
* Define and enforce SOPs, GMP, and HACCP requirements
* Set and modify production process parameters
* Lead corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

Key Responsibilities1. In-House Production Management

* Own daily production operations across all SKUs
* Define and control batch sizes and process parameters
* Monitor environmental conditions (temperature, humidity)
* Ensure production targets, yields, and timelines are met
* Troubleshoot issues related to texture, binding, moisture, breakage, and packaging
* Minimise downtime, rework, and wastage

2. Product Development & Scale-Up

* Translate R&D formulations into production-ready recipes
* Conduct pilot trials and commercial validation batches
* Optimise formulations for:
* Shelf life
* Process stability
* Ingredient functionality
* Cost efficiency
* Support new product launches from trial to full-scale production

3. Quality Control & Quality Assurance

* Design and implement factory-wide QC systems
* Define quality specifications and acceptance criteria
* Oversee:
* Incoming raw material checks
* In-process quality controls
* Finished goods inspections
* Review and approve batch manufacturing records
* Manage non-conformances, deviations, and CAPAs

4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Compliance

* Implement and maintain GMP and HACCP systems
* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations
* Maintain food safety documentation and records
* Lead internal and external audits
* Act as the primary food safety contact for regulatory authorities

5. Shelf Life, Stability & Packaging Control

* Design and execute shelf-life and stability studies
* Monitor oxidation, moisture migration, texture changes, and sensory drift
* Validate packaging materials and sealing integrity
* Define storage and distribution conditions
* Implement natural shelf-life enhancement strategies

6. Raw Material & Supplier Quality

* Approve raw material specifications and suppliers
* Monitor ingredient variability and seasonal changes
* Handle supplier quality issues and corrective actions
* Maintain COAs and full traceability

7. Documentation & Traceability

* Create and maintain:
* SOPs
* Work instructions
* Batch records
* Cleaning and sanitation logs
* Ensure full lot traceability and recall readiness
* Conduct mock recall drills when required

8. Team Training & Factory Discipline

* Train production staff on SOPs, hygiene, and quality checkpoints
* Enforce hygiene and food safety behaviour
* Build a quality-first culture on the factory floor
* Support hiring and evaluation of production staff

9. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimisation

* Lead initiatives for yield improvement and waste reduction
* Optimise ingredient usage without compromising quality
* Improve line efficiency and process robustness
* Track and report production and quality KPIs

Qualifications & ExperienceEducation

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Nutrition, or related fields

Experience

* 5–10 years of hands-on experience in in-house food manufacturing
* Strong factory-floor exposure
* Experience with shelf-stable products preferred
* Audit and inspection handling experience required

Skills & Competencies

* Food chemistry and ingredient functionality
* Shelf-life science and packaging interactions
* HACCP and GMP implementation
* Root-cause analysis and problem-solving
* Strong documentation and execution discipline
* Leadership and decision-making under pressure

Career Growth Path

Food Technologist → Production & Quality Head → Plant Head / Operations Head

description:

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Software Integration Engineer(Quality Engineer)
  
  
**Overview**
The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards.
  
  
This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
  
  
The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
  
  
Role
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
* Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.
* Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC.
* Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable.
* Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services.
* Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools.
* Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
* Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.

**All About You / Experience**
The ideal candidate for this position should have:
  
  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.
* Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals.
* Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress.
* Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation.
* Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions.
* Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks.
* Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems.
* Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes.
* Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia.
* Experience with test case management tools such as XRay.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators.
* Ability to work on proof-of-concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly.
* Self-driven, proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. * Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.

* Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
* Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
* Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Experience with PostgreSQL-to-Oracle schema conversion, including tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, views, triggers, stored procedures, and functions.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills.
* Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.
* Experience using Oracle SQL Developer Migration Workbench or equivalent schema conversion tools.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Database architecture, Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB), and performance tuning.

* Identify and resolve migration defects, mapping inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Conduct pre-migration, mock migration, production migration, and post-migration verification.
* Support migration testing including SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation. Page 4 of 4 CONFIDENTIAL ERD-3-01b, Job Description Template, Rev. 13.0, Eff. 02/22/2023

title: Default Job Template
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer II is a senior technical person who partners with government
  
  
customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product
  
  
configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database
  
  
expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the

most complex government implementations across the United States
  
  

* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data,

resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
  
  

* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and

migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder

like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the
  
  
deployment and integration process
  
  

* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to

simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
  
  

* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their

configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
  
  

* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable

tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
  
  

* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and

channel field feedback into the product roadmap
  
  
**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical

consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data

transformation, and reconciliation
  
  

* 2+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts

and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
  
  

* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or

provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
  
  

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on

data and configuration for accuracy
  
  

* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving

customer needs
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: QA Engineer II
description:
**Let’s Build What’s Next, Together.**
We are Spotnana. We’re on a mission to modernize the infrastructure of the $11.7 trillion travel industry to power the perfect trip for travelers everywhere. Our Travel-as-a-Service platform is designed to make every trip better, whether someone is booking for work or leisure travel, building a travel tool, or looking to offer personalized experiences at scale.
  
  
We’re not just modernizing tech, we’re rethinking how the industry works. And to get there, we’re bringing together innovative, ambitious, and open-minded people who want to build something that lasts.
  
  
At Spotnana, our values and principles guide how we work and grow together:
  
  

* Build the future – We are leaders, we are innovators, we are ambitious.
* Commit to excellence – We’re accountable, we are partners, we are agile.
* Stronger together – We lead with respect and integrity, we are inclusive, we are lifelong learners.

**How You'll Help Us Build**

* Designing, writing, and executing comprehensive manual test cases for Spotnana's web and mobile applications, APIs, and backend services
* Performing functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing across product releases
* Collaborating with developers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and translate them into thorough test scenarios
* Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and supporting evidence
* Defining and monitoring quality assurance metrics to drive continuous quality and process improvements
* Leveraging AI tools to assist in test case generation, test data creation, exploratory test ideation, and defect summarization
* Supporting and contributing to automation efforts by reviewing automated test results, flagging gaps, and working alongside SDETs to improve coverage
* Communicating clearly with internal stakeholders regarding test progress, risks, blockers, and release readiness

* Working closely with the engineering and QA team to continuously improve testing processes, checklists, and quality benchmarks

**Experience You Bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent with 5+ years of manual QA / functional testing experience
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test lifecycle, and QA best practices
* Hands-on experience testing REST APIs using tools like Postman or similar
* Ability to write clear, structured, and reusable test cases and test plans
* Familiarity with at least one automation framework (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, PlayWrite)

* Good understanding of web application architecture and how frontend, backend, and APIs interact
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a sharp eye for detail
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams
* A curious, quality-first mindset with the initiative to ask "what could go wrong?" before it does

**What To Expect Next**
The process typically begins with an introductory call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll discuss your background, career aspirations, and what makes Spotnana a great fit for you. Then a live virtual and onsite interview with a panel of engineers and hiring managers.
  
  
We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment and to encourage these values in everyone on our team. We believe that diversity and inclusion for people from all walks of life is key to our success as a company.

- All recruiting outreach and communication comes directly from our internal team via an email with an @spotnana.com address or through LinkedIn. We encourage candidates to verify the source of any outreach before sharing personal information. We do not use external recruiting partners for our hiring efforts or Microsoft Teams for interviews. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, visa fees, or anything else during the hiring process. We do not extend offers via text-based apps or use Microsoft Teams for interviews. All legitimate openings are listed at https://www.spotnana.com/careers/careers-listing/.

title: Software QA Engineer - Physics AI
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results.
  
  
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results.
* Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities.
* Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases.
* Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate.
* Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.
* Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation.
* 1–3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products.
* Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results.
* Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications.
* Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing.
* Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**
**#DISWSIM**

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
ACA believes that we can deliver the world’s best GRC software to our blue-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have extensive experience successfully implementing test automation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Develop an automation-first testing strategy for functional, performance, and regression testing.
* Architect and develop reusable and scalable multi-layer automation frameworks for UI, API, and database automated test scripts that cover the functional areas of our application suite.
* Guide other test automation engineers embedded in cross-functional development teams, to create scripts and provide faster, scalable, and more comprehensive test coverage.

* Always be the advocate for automation and quality best practices.
* Review requirements stated in product backlog and assign to each sprint as needed.
* Partner with product, engineering, and IT personnel to align long term solution roadmap with quality assurance efforts.
* Analyze root cause of failing test automation test scripts and fix.
* Lead the collaboration with software developers as needed to identify root cause of product defects and resolve problems.
* Align strategies with organizational goals and report progress to the product owner.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* You must always be curious about the business and customers you support. The more you know and understand your customers and how they work on a daily basis, the better equipped you will be to deliver high quality technology solutions.
* Motivated to deliver the best possible software solutions in a fast-paced collaborative environment.
* Ability to quickly identify and communicate risks.
* Proactively learn and experiment with new technologies and cloud development strategies, staying ahead of the curve.
* Ability to self-manage multiple priorities and understand when to ‘switch gears’ to unblock others.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
* Diplomatic with strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* Self-motivator with a strong work ethic, able to perform job duties without significant supervision.
* Comfortable with leveraging approved AI toolsets to help you be more efficient and productive.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 to 7 years of test automation experience, with at least 2 years using Playwright and Typescript (or Javascript).
* Development experience with Typescript/Javascript, C#, Java, or any other Object Oriented Programming language.
* Experience implementing APIs (OData, REST, SOAP) and database automated tests.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins / TeamCity, LambdaTest, etc. is preferred
* Experience with development tools, such as Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Junit, and Eclipse.
* Working knowledge of code coverage tools, defect-tracking systems, test case management systems, and performance tools.
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN.

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM.
* Experience with Agile Scrum and ATDD methodologies.
* Experience automating mobile platforms, a plus.
* Experience in writing SQL queries and database automation.
* Experience in scripting languages, such as Python or Ruby, are a plus.

**What We Look For**
We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you.
  
  
**What Working At ACA Offers**
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  
  
  
  
**Plus, we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Why join our team?**
We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
  
  
Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**More About ACA**
ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
  
  
Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.

ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
  
  
ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
  
  
Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

**About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.
* Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes.
* Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power.
* Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results.
* Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up.
* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.
* Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. title: Lead QA Engineer -Release & Automation
description:
**Job Description**
**Lead QA – Release & Automation**
**Role Overview**
Williams-Sonoma is seeking a Lead QA – Release & Automation to lead end-to-end mobile QA activities across iOS and Android releases, with strong hands-on experience in mobile testing and automation.
  
  
This role will own QA release sign-off, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, drive release regression, and continuously improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing. Exposure to Web, API, and Microservices testing will be an added advantage.
  
  
The ideal candidate will help accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.
  
  
**Impact of the Role**

* Accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.
* Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.
* Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.
* Drive continuous improvements in automation coverage, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness.

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

* iOS and Android mobile applications
* Mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent tools
* Mabl, Selenium, and Playwright
* Web, API, and Microservices testing
* CI/CD platforms including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end QA release sign-off for mobile applications across iOS and Android.
* Lead release regression testing and ensure production readiness across multiple engineering teams.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Release Management, and Vendor QA teams to plan, coordinate, and execute successful releases.
* Define and standardize QA release processes, quality gates, and release sign-off criteria.
* Drive mobile automation strategy across iOS and Android to maximize automation coverage and reduce manual regression effort.
* Ensure automation suites are stable, maintain high pipeline pass rates, minimize flaky tests, and support reliable CI/CD execution.
* Continuously optimize QA validation and regression processes to reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency.
* Champion AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection.
* Monitor QA metrics such as automation coverage, execution success rate, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness, driving continuous improvements.
* Coordinate with multiple engineering teams to streamline testing activities and remove bottlenecks in the release process.
* Mentor QA engineers and promote best practices in automation, quality engineering, and release management.

**Qualifications**

* 10–12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, QA Automation, or Release QA for enterprise applications, including 4+ years of hands-on mobile testing and automation experience.
* 4+ years of experience leading QA release management or centralized regression testing teams.
* Must have strong experience in Mobile QA across iOS and Android, including functional, regression, release, and automation testing.
* Must have hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent mobile automation tools.
* Exposure to Mabl, Selenium, Playwright, Web testing, and API testing is good to have.
* Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience working in Agile environments with multiple teams contributing to shared releases.
* Must have a strong understanding of release management, quality governance, and regression optimization.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in large-scale retail/eCommerce organizations.
* Experience leading QA transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to Web and API testing.
* Experience leveraging AI-enabled testing to accelerate software delivery.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

**About Us**
Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.
  
  
Williams-Sonoma has established a technology center in Pune, India to enhance its global operations. The India Technology Center serves as a critical hub for innovation and focuses on developing cutting-edge solutions in areas such as e-commerce, supply chain optimization, and customer experience management. By integrating advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, data analytics, and machine learning, the India Technology Center plays a crucial role in accelerating Williams-Sonoma's growth and maintaining its competitive edge in the global market

title: ServiceNow Business Analyst

Validation

title: Quality Assurance Officer
description:
**Main Purpose**

**Responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of quality control operations within the laboratory unit. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that all laboratory activities, processes, and products meet the highest standards of quality, safety,and compliance with industry regulations. This role involves overseeing testing, inspection, auditing, and the implementation of corrective actions to ensure that quality benchmarks are consistently met.**

**Main Duties**

**Regulatory Affairs Ensure regulatory compliance India CDSCO / Pharmacopeia, FDA regulations / ISO 9000 and others as applicable**

**Quality Systems. Perform internal audits of Quality System according to Indian and US FDA's Quality System Requirements, ISO 9001 or any other quality standard deemed**

**necessary.**

* **Participate in external audits, including supplier audits, customer audits and inspections by Indian and FDA's agencies and ISO Notifying Body.**
* **Conducting periodical evaluation of Suppliers and supplier development. Prepare documents and data for different Supplier/ contractor for audits as needed**
* **Submit reports from internal and external audits to appropriate personnel and initiate audit follow up actions, to include Corrective and Preventive Actions where applicable.**
* **Provide support in development of QMS procedures, instructions and forms while ensuring continuous improvement of quality management system. Participate in implementing CAPA actions where needed**
* **Manage and maintain all aspects of the Quality System, including Change Control; CAPA; Customer Complaints and Compliance**
* **File complaints to vendors; initiate corrective action requests; assess suppliers' CAPA reports; participate in suppliers' auditing and qualification process.**

**Quality/Regulatory General**

* **Perform function of Official Correspondent in front of the FDA and other government authorities.**
* **Review and draft new business Quality Agreements.**
* **Supervise, coach, and develop all quality employees.**
* **Mentor, train, and recommend qualified employees for advancement.**
* **Perform the responsibilities of Quality Control Manager during his/her absence.**
* **Adhere to safety and security policies; participate in safety and security training and improvement projects**
* **Report unsafe or unhealthy conditions and assist with emergency or investigative situations related to areas of responsibility**

**Quality Assurance**

* **Maintain all controlled document files and test records in a timely and accurate manner.**
* **Maintain updated matrix of records; maintain backup copies of required records and archive.**
* **Participate in the qualification of packing processes and software validation as required.**
* **Coordinate associated training activities for the company: develop training matrix for every position and annual/semi-annual training plans, initiate training requests, perform trainings, and maintain training records**
* **Develop comprehensive Quality and Regulatory training programs for all employees.**
* **Make written procedures for identification, documentation, appropriate review and approval of RM, specifications, analytical methods, facilities, support systems, equipment, processing steps, labeling and packaging materials and computer software.**
* **Written procedures shall be established assigning responsibility for sanitation and describing the cleaning schedules, methods, equipment, and materials to be used in cleaning buildings and facilities**
* **Ensures written procedures for all activities carried out, are established and followed**
* **Ensures personnel shall practice good sanitation and health habits appropriate measures shall be established and implemented to prevent cross-contamination from personnel and materials moving from one dedicated area to another**
* **Ensures there are written procedures describing in detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, testing and approval or rejection of raw material containers and closures and these procedures are followed**
* **Reviewing completed laboratory control records of critical process steps before release of the material.**
* **Reviewing and approving validation protocols and reports**
* **Ensuring data protection shall be established for all computerized systems**
* **Check records of different departments as needed for audits**
* **Validation of general, cleaning, analytical methods, in-process control, test procedures, computerized systems and persons responsible for design, review, approval and documentation of each validation phase**
* **Approving changes that potentially affect the product quality and performing below product quality reviews**
* **A review of all lot of raw materials that failed to meet established specification(s)**
* **A review of all critical deviations or non-conformances and related investigations**
* **A review of results of the stability monitoring program**
* **A review of all quality-related returns, complaints and recalls**
* **A review of adequacy of corrective actions**
* **Evaluate and assess the results of the above reviews and decide whether corrective or any revalidation shall be undertaken. Documents the reasons for such corrective action and ensures agreed corrective actions is completed in a timely and effective manner**
* **Ensures that training shall be regularly conducted by qualified individuals and shall cover, at a minimum, the particular operations that the employee performs and as applicable to the employee's functions.**
* **Ensures records of all the trainings are maintained and periodically assessed**
* **Investigate the discrepancies established during reconciliation of labels issued, used and returned**
* **Ensures raw material containers and closures shall at all times be handled and stored in a manner to prevent contamination**
* **Verifies each container or grouping of containers for raw material or each lot of raw material shall be appropriately identified as to its status(i.e., quarantined, approved, or rejected)**
* **Ensures each lot of raw material shall be withheld from use/export until the lot has been sampled, tested, or examined, as appropriate, and released for use/export by QC.**
