**Senior Associate, Quality Engineering - Level 1**
Publicis Sapient is looking for a Senior associate in quality engineering with strong functional and manual testing experience to help deliver high-quality technology solutions for our clients. You will apply your knowledge of capital markets, testing practices, APIs, and databases to validate complex trading applications across the development lifecycle. You will collaborate with developers, business stakeholders, and other quality engineers to identify risks, resolve defects, and improve product quality. Your testing expertise and problem-solving skills will contribute to reliable solutions that create meaningful value for our clients.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Plan and execute functional, manual, regression, and progression testing to ensure the quality and reliability of complex applications.
* Validate capital-markets workflows across the trading lifecycle, including order creation, execution, settlement, and related lifecycle events.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios covering Equities and Fixed Income instruments, including Bonds, Bond Forwards, Futures, and Swaps.
* Test REST and SOAP APIs by validating contracts, requests, responses, business fields, and error scenarios using tools such as Postman or curl.
* Write and execute SQL queries independently to validate application and test data across relevant database tables.
* Manage defects through their complete lifecycle, participate in defect triage, analyse application logs, and support root-cause investigation.
* Collaborate with developers, traders, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to complete testing activities and support successful releases.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

* 4+ years of hands-on functional or manual testing experience, preferably involving capital-markets or trading applications.
* Practical knowledge of the capital-markets trading lifecycle and experience testing Equities and Fixed Income products.
* Strong understanding of test planning, test-case design, estimation, regression testing, defect management, and test metrics.
* Working knowledge of REST and SOAP API testing, including request and response validation using Postman, curl, or similar tools.
* Ability to independently write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, and GROUP BY.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and participating in relevant sprint ceremonies.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently and drive assigned activities to completion.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With**
**:**

* Experience working with front-office or middle-office applications within an Asset Management organization.
* Exposure to test automation using Selenium with Java or Robot Framework with Python.
* Python scripting experience for test utilities, data validation, or simple automation.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions for test-case generation or defect analysis.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
*“Bring strong testing fundamentals, curiosity about capital markets, and the confidence to independently investigate complex issues.”*
**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 5-7 years of experience in software quality engineering with hands-on expertise testing Java-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces
* Proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, RestAssured, or Cucumber for user interface and application programming interface testing
* Strong understanding of relational databases including PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server to perform data validation and verify data integrity across test scenarios
* Hands-on experience testing Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, semantic evaluation techniques, hallucination detection, and streaming application programming interface behavior
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and agentic artificial intelligence testing patterns, including tool-use accuracy, context management, and deterministic versus non-deterministic output validation
* Experience with artificial intelligence security testing, including prompt injection testing, jailbreak validation, sensitive data leakage checks, and application reliability and performance assessments
* Strong understanding of software design principles and microservices architectures, with the ability to develop effective test strategies and identify system-level edge cases
* Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

**Responsibilities**
Lead quality engineering and artificial intelligence testing initiatives to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions across cloud-based platforms.
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for Java-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces to ensure high software quality across releases
* Own the test strategy for Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, regression baselines, tool-call accuracy verification, context management validation, and end-to-end integration coverage
* Build and maintain continuous integration integrated evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic artificial intelligence outputs, including rubric-based scoring, automated prompt regression suites, and behavioral drift detection
* Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, and machine learning engineers to define testable requirements, review acceptance criteria, and ensure high-quality delivery across agile releases
* Perform database validation testing against PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server environments to verify data integrity, transformation logic, and backend workflow accuracy
* Conduct artificial intelligence specific security testing, including prompt injection, adversarial input validation, jailbreak testing, and sensitive data leakage assessments aligned with Moody’s governance standards
* Define and enforce synthetic or masked test data standards for artificial intelligence feature testing to ensure appropriate handling of confidential and regulated information
* Monitor and report quality, performance, and artificial intelligence observability metrics including token consumption, streaming latency, tool-call success rates, model error rates, and reliability indicators
* Integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, ensuring quality gates and deployment controls are effective and actionable
* Conduct test code reviews, mentor quality engineering team members, perform exploratory testing, and drive continuous improvement of testing practices and processes
* Support performance and load testing of cloud-native software-as-a-service platforms on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure to validate scalability, availability, and reliability requirements
* Maintain clear test documentation, traceability matrices, defect analysis reports, and quality metrics to ensure transparency and alignment across stakeholders

**About The Team**
At Moody’s, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. As part of Moody’s Insurance Solutions, the Climate on Demand team develops innovative software, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence enabled capabilities that help organizations understand and manage climate and natural catastrophe risks. You will contribute to building impactful solutions that support informed decision-making, strengthen resilience for customers around the world, and advance the adoption of responsible artificial intelligence across our products and services.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Application Administrator
description:
As an Application Administrator your primary responsibly is to manage, optimize and maintain enterprise (business) application software for the AVI-SPL organization. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all software operations, ensuring that applications align with business processes while supporting organizational growth initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams – including Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and HR to design workflows, manage user access, build custom reports, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure maximum system efficiency. In addition, you will partner with other members of the IT organization including business analysts, software engineers, and other platform managers to ensure optimal utilization of our applications.
  
  
**Who We Are**
AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. Our success starts with our people; and a workplace that champions culture and belonging ensures we grow and thrive together.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As an Application Administrator your primary responsibly is to manage, optimize and maintain enterprise (business) application software for the AVI-SPL organization. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all software operations, ensuring that applications align with business processes while supporting organizational growth initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams – including Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and HR to design workflows, manage user access, build custom reports, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure maximum system efficiency. In addition, you will partner with other members of the IT organization including business analysts, software engineers, and other platform managers to ensure optimal utilization of our applications.
  
  
**Day-To-Day Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders across multiple geographies (including India and Canada) to document and analyze business requirements for NetSuite.
* Design, develop, and maintain custom scripts (SuiteScript 1.0/2.0), workflows, and integrations within NetSuite.
* Perform testing, debugging, configuration (as needed) and documentation activities during development and planned in-place upgrades.
* Provide technical expertise and support to end-users and stakeholders, assisting with troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Conduct system maintenance, including upgrades, patches, and enhancements in accordance with best practices and business needs.
* Design, build, and test automated business workflows using built-in workflow tools.
* Maintain documentation of system configurations and customizations.
* Maintain and update core system configurations, forms, fields, custom records, and general ledger settings.
* Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks and implement optimizations as needed
* Troubleshoot system errors, resolve user helpdesk tickets, and coordinate with the software platform provider for platform bugs.
* Keep up to date with latest application features, functionalities, and industry trends
* Other duties include but are not limited to:

+ User Management: Provision user accounts, manage custom roles, assign permissions, and conduct regular security access audits.
+ Data Integrity: Monitor data imports, perform regular data cleansing, and manage data migration tasks.
+ Reporting & Analytics: Create, modify, and maintain complex Saved Searches, KPIs, dashboards, and financial reports.
+ Release Management: Test business processes during platform upgrades and manage the sandbox environment.
+ Training & Documentation: Develop internal training materials and provide hands-on guidance to onboarding users.

* Perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects as needed to support the team and organization, ensuring flexibility in adapting to evolving priorities and objectives.

**Must-Haves**
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 5-7+ years of experience in NetSuite development and administration with minimum 3-5 years of professional hands-on experience with NetSuite platform administration including configurations, integrations, data model, report development, and in-place upgrades.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of professional experience with IT applications.
* Certified as a NetSuite Foundational Specialist.
* Strong proficiency in SuiteScript (JavaScript), SuiteFlow, and SuiteAnalytics.
* Experience with NetSuite ERP modules (Finance, Inventory, CRM).
* Solid understanding of integration technologies (REST, SOAP, APIs).
* Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Clear and professional communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across all levels of the organization leveraging direct, clear and confident communication.
* Ability to work with and manage stakeholders across the globe.
* Stable presence with strong judgment and decision-making quality.
* Ability to work and think independently; self-starter that demonstrates initiative and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously; demonstrates effective prioritization skills when balancing dynamic priorities.
* Inquisitive and data-oriented.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Proven time management skills with attention to detail.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint), requirements management tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps), visualization and diagramming tools.
* Two-year degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field is required.

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Certified as a NetSuite Administrator Professional.
* Certified as a NetSuite BI and Saved Searches Professional.
* Four-year degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or related field is preferred.
* ITIL Certification

title: Integration Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
Freight Tiger is looking for an Integration Lead to own end-to-end customer integration delivery between the Freight Tiger platform and customer ERP, SAP and Third party systems. The role combines technical integration expertise, solution design, customer engagement and delivery ownership. The person will work with customer IT/SAP teams, Integration Solution Engineers, Product, Engineering and DevOps to take integrations from requirements to production. This can be a strong IC or a team-lead role, depending on experience. The person should be comfortable designing solutions, guiding engineers, managing delivery and resolving production issues.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
***Customer & Solution Ownership***

* Own customer integration requirements and act as the primary technical integration contact.
* Lead requirement and solution-design discussions with customer IT/SAP teams.
* Understand business flows and translate them into practical integration solutions.
* Define integration architecture, interfaces, data mappings and dependencies.
* Identify risks, effort and technical constraints early.

***Integration Delivery***

* Drive integrations end-to-end: Design → Development → SIT/UAT → Go-Live → Hypercare.
* Guide Integration Solution Engineers and review their technical implementation.
* Work hands-on with Dell Boomi or other similar integration platform, APIs and data transformations when required.
* Ensure appropriate security, error handling, retry and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Product, DevOps and external implementation partners.

***Delivery & Production***

* Own delivery plans, milestones, dependencies and customer commitments.
* Proactively identify and resolve delivery blockers and risks.
* Support customer go-lives and production troubleshooting.
* Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of integration issues.
* Maintain key integration documentation and reusable implementation patterns.

***Team Contribution***

* Mentor and provide technical direction to Integration Solution Engineers.
* Contribute to integration standards, reusable patterns and improved delivery practices.
* People management experience is an added advantage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, API integration or technical delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with Dell Boomi AtomSphere or a similar integration platform.
* Good experience with REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, JSON/XML and data transformation.
* Practical experience with SAP ECC/S4HANA integrations, preferably IDoc, RFC/JCo or OData.
* Understanding of authentication, certificates, networking and cloud connectivity.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across application, middleware and integration layers.
* Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management.
* Proven ability to manage multiple integration deliveries independently.
* Experience guiding or mentoring engineers is preferred.

***Architectural Knowledge***

* Enterprise integration and API patterns
* Synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven integration
* Data mapping, transformation and validation
* Error handling, retry, idempotency and reconciliation
* Integration security and connectivity
* Basic distributed systems and microservices concepts
* Integration monitoring and production reliability

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. title: Data Operations Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience understanding complex data structures, schemas, and migration requirements, combined with proficiency in extract, transform, and load processes across enterprise environments.
* 3-7 years’ experience required for this role. Proficiency in SQL for data querying, manipulation, and validation, with experience mapping data fields between source and target systems to meet business rules and technical requirements.
* Knowledge of data validation techniques, data quality assurance best practices, and data governance principles, including documentation of business rules, standard operating procedures, and data lineage.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, and hands-on experience with reporting and automation tools including Power Automate, Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks; experience with master data management tools such as Collibra or DBeaver preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong problem-solving ability; capable of collaborating across business users, data stewards, and technical teams while clearly explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's / postgraduation degree in finance or Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field required

**Responsibilities**

* Supports enterprise-wide data migration initiatives by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data as it transitions across systems.
* Analyzes data structures and identifies migration requirements, collecting, cleaning, and validating datasets from multiple source systems
* Documents business rules for data quality checks and applies validation and quality assurance techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency throughout the migration lifecycle
* Maps data fields from source to target systems and transforms data to align with new system requirements and business rules
* Executes data migration processes including extraction, transformation, and loading, monitoring migration progress and troubleshooting issues in real time
* Identifies and resolves data discrepancies, errors, and anomalies, collaborating with technical teams to implement corrective actions
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and visualizations to highlight key trends and document data quality issues for stakeholder review
* Works closely with business users, data stewards, and technical teams to gather requirements, communicate progress, and facilitate cross-functional alignment to ensure a smooth migration transition
* Creates and maintains comprehensive documentation including migration plans, data mappings, validation rules, standard operating procedures, and post-migration reports to support governance and audit readiness

**About The Team**
Our Ratings Operations and Controls (ROC) team is responsible for supporting the data management, quality, and operational processes that underpin Moody's global ratings and research activities. We contribute to Moody's by ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and consistency across critical systems, enabling seamless data transitions that support business continuity and analytical integrity, and driving operational efficiency through technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in enterprise data migration, digital transformation, and process innovation across our Gurgaon operations.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
  
  
For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

As SSO for the Test Automation Service, you will ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations while overseeing governance, risks, documentation, stakeholder collaboration, continuous improvement, and financial planning aligned with the service roadmap. You will also drive ongoing validation and quality assurance to ensure that deployed automation remains effective, efficient, compliant, and aligned with business requirements throughout its lifecycle, including monitoring automation quality, reviewing test assets, validating execution results, and driving continuous improvement of testing processes.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Review and validate automation scripts, test cases, test data, and execution strategies.
* Ensure compliance with established automation standards, naming conventions, and development guidelines, and define and continuously improve quality standards for automated testing.
* Conduct quality reviews of automation assets and automation frameworks, assess automation coverage, and identify opportunities to expand automation adoption.
* Establish controls to ensure consistency and reusability of test assets across projects and verify traceability between requirements, business processes, test cases, and execution results.
* Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies and test automation practices.
* Ensure secure, compliant, reliable, and lifecycle-oriented operation of the Test Automation Service (SSO).
* Coordinate service governance and manage operational, technical, and compliance risks while maintaining service documentation and controls.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, platform teams, vendors, and support organizations, and define and drive the service roadmap and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support financial planning, forecasting, and budget monitoring.
* Monitor the health, quality, and effectiveness of deployed automated tests, analyse execution trends, automation success rates, and defect leakage, and coordinate root-cause analysis of failed executions.
* Ensure automation assets remain current following SAP releases, transports, upgrades, and business process changes, while managing the automation maintenance backlog and technical debt.
* Support the introduction of self-healing and AI-assisted automation capabilities where appropriate, and monitor and report automation KPIs and quality metrics.
* Support and optimise the enterprise testing toolchain, including Tricentis Tosca, Tricentis qTest, SAP Cloud ALM, and SAP Solution Manager, and collaborate with teams using these solutions.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI-enabled testing capabilities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and testing transformation programs.
* Increase automation coverage across critical business processes, improve reliability and maintainability of automated test suites, reduce regression testing effort and execution time, and improve traceability and quality of test assets.
* Strengthen governance and quality controls in automated testing, provide transparency through meaningful testing KPIs and reporting, and enable faster, safer, and higher-quality SAP releases.
* Ensure reliable, compliant service delivery, continuous improvement, and effective budget management.

**What You Bring**

* 8–10 years of overall experience in software testing, quality engineering, and test automation.
* Approximately 5 years of experience in software testing and test automation, with strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience in SAP testing environments and enterprise-scale test automation solutions; experience supporting large transformation, ERP, or SAP S/4HANA programs is preferred.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and SAP ECC is advantageous.
* Strong experience with End-to-End Business Process Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, and User Acceptance Testing.

title: Business Analyst – SaaS Product & Solution Design
company: PepUpSales - Integrated SaaS Platform for Field Sales & Distribution
description:
The ideal candidate should be able to understand both
**the business problem and the system logic required to solve it.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Requirement Gathering and Business Analysis**

* Interact with customers, including business heads, sales teams, IT teams, and operations teams, to understand their business processes, challenges, and expectations.
* Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process walkthroughs.
* Ask the right questions to identify the underlying business problem rather than simply documenting what the customer requests.
* Map existing business processes and identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.
* Convert customer discussions into clear, structured, and actionable requirements.

**2. Functional Solution Design**

* Map customer requirements against existing PepUpSales functionality and identify whether they can be addressed through standard features, configuration, process changes, or custom development.
* Design end-to-end functional workflows covering users, roles, business rules, validations, approvals, exceptions, and system behavior.
* Prepare functional requirement documents (FRDs), business requirement documents (BRDs), user stories, use cases, process flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria.
* Define screen-level requirements, field validations, data dependencies, business logic, reports, and dashboards wherever required.
* Identify the impact of proposed changes on existing modules, customers, and business processes.

**3. Technical Solution Mapping**

* Work closely with developers and technical leads to translate functional requirements into technically feasible solutions.
* Understand database structures, APIs, integrations, data flows, system dependencies, and application architecture at a level sufficient for effective solution design.
* Prepare data flow diagrams, integration requirements, field mappings, API specifications, and logical solution designs in collaboration with the technical team.
* Identify technical dependencies, edge cases, risks, and potential performance or scalability issues.
* Ensure requirements are sufficiently detailed for developers to estimate, design, and implement without repeated clarification.

**4. Product Gap Analysis and Standardisation**

* Identify gaps between customer requirements and the existing PepUpSales product.
* Recommend whether a requirement should be handled through configuration, a reusable product enhancement, or customer-specific customisation.
* Evaluate the impact of customisations on the existing product and other customers in the multi-tenant SaaS environment.
* Help convert recurring customer requirements into standard product capabilities.
* Maintain a structured record of requirements, product gaps, change requests, and approved solution designs.

**5. Coordination with Development, QA and Delivery Teams**

* Explain approved requirements and workflows to developers, QA engineers, and implementation teams.
* Coordinate with the development team during implementation to resolve functional queries and clarify expected system behaviour.
* Review developed functionality against approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support test-case preparation, UAT planning, defect clarification, and customer sign-off.
* Ensure scope, dependencies, assumptions, and change requests are documented and controlled throughout the project lifecycle.

**6. Documentation and Process Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date functional specifications, workflow diagrams, requirement traceability matrices, and product documentation.
* Ensure that requirements, design decisions, development tasks, and test cases remain aligned.
* Identify opportunities to improve requirement-gathering practices, solution quality, and implementation efficiency.
* Contribute to the development of reusable templates, standard workflows, and product knowledge repositories.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in business analysis, SaaS implementation, enterprise software, product analysis, or solution consulting.
* Strong experience in requirement gathering, business process mapping, functional specification writing, and solution design.
* Ability to understand complex business processes and convert them into structured workflows and system requirements.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, APIs, JSON, system integrations, and application architecture.
* Experience creating process flow diagrams, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both non-technical business stakeholders and technical development teams.
* Proficiency in documentation and process-modelling tools such as Microsoft Visio, draw.io, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent tools.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with SaaS-based enterprise applications, CRM, SFA, DMS, ERP, retail execution, or supply chain management solutions.
* Understanding of FMCG sales processes, distributor and stockist operations, sales-force automation, beat planning, order booking, retail execution, and secondary sales.
* Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS applications and configurable enterprise products.
* Exposure to mobile applications, offline workflows, third-party integrations, and reporting dashboards.
* Experience in UAT coordination and working in Agile or iterative software development environments.

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

description:
**Role Description**
**UST Job Title: Lead II - Software Testing**
At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in over 25 countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .
  
  
**The Opportunity**
UST is looking for Test Architect/Lead
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced Test Architect to define and drive the overall testing strategy for complex web-based full-stack applications. The candidate will be responsible for designing comprehensive test strategies, creating high-quality test cases, defining automation approaches, and ensuring end-to-end product quality across the UI, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, security, performance, and infrastructure. The Test Architect will work closely with Product, Development, DevOps, Architecture, and Business teams to establish quality engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy & Architecture Define the overall test strategy, test architecture, and quality engineering framework for full-stack applications.
* Develop test plans covering functional, integration, system, regression, API, database, performance, security, and end-to-end testing.
* Define the appropriate test pyramid and testing levels across UI, API, services, and database layers.
* Establish testing standards, processes, templates, and best practices.
* Identify test risks, dependencies, and quality gaps early in the development lifecycle.
* Test Case Design Analyze business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and technical architecture.
* Create detailed and comprehensive test scenarios and test cases for web applications.
* Develop positive, negative, boundary, exploratory, and edge-case scenarios.
* Ensure complete requirements-to-test-case traceability.
* Web/UI Testing Define testing approaches for modern web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, Vue, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Validate cross-browser and cross-platform behavior.
* Test responsive web applications across different screen sizes and devices.
* Validate usability, accessibility, navigation, forms, workflows, and client-side validations.
* API & Backend Testing Design and execute comprehensive API and service-level test cases.
* Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication, authorization, error handling, and data consistency.
* Test microservices, service-to-service communication, asynchronous workflows, queues, and event-driven architectures.
* Validate backend business logic independently of the UI.
* Database Testing Design test cases for relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Validate data integrity, data transformation, CRUD operations, stored procedures, queries, and transactions.
* Perform backend-to-database and UI-to-database validation.
* Identify data consistency and synchronization issues across systems.
* Test Automation Define the automation strategy and framework architecture.
* Identify suitable candidates for automation and establish automation priorities.
* Establish reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and reporting mechanisms.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Performance & Scalability Testing
* Define performance testing strategy for web applications and APIs.
* Develop scenarios for load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Analyze response time, throughput, resource utilization, and system bottlenecks.
* Work with development and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve performance issues.
* Security & Reliability Testing Define security testing requirements covering authentication, authorization, session management, data protection, and common web vulnerabilities.
* Work with security teams to incorporate security testing into the SDLC. Validate application resilience, error recovery, failover, and disaster-recovery scenarios where applicable. 9. CI/CD & DevOps Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Work with DevOps teams on quality gates and automated validation.
* Support testing across development, QA, staging, and production-like environments.

**Required Skills**

* 10–15+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering.
* Strong experience testing web-based full-stack applications.
* Excellent understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, Scrum, and DevOps.
* Strong hands-on experience in test case design and test strategy development.
* Strong knowledge of: UI testing API testing Backend/service testing Database testing Integration testing End-to-end testing Regression testing
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, OAuth/JWT.
* Good SQL skills and understanding of databases.
* Experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Experience with API automation tools such as REST Assured or Postman.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Knowledge of performance testing tools and methodologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based applications and distributed systems.
* Preferred Skills Experience with microservices and containerized applications.
* Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Kafka or other messaging platforms.
* Knowledge of accessibility testing and WCAG.
* Knowledge of OWASP and web application security testing.
* Experience implementing Quality Engineering / Shift-Left testing.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing and test automation is an advantage.

**What We Believe**
We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. * Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness.

* Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons.
* Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation.
* Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Member of Technical Staff- Quality Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
We are hiring a
**senior quality engineer**
to own
**System Testing**
for Pure’s FlashArray products. You will validate
**stability, resiliency, and performance under sustained, production‑like workloads**
, far beyond basic functional testing.
  
  
You will design and run
**multi‑week, customer‑like scenarios**
that combine workloads, failovers, upgrades, and fault injections, and use the insights to influence architecture, design, and release decisions.
  
  
This is a
**hands‑on, high‑impact role**
at the intersection of architecture, systems, and large‑scale testing—acting as a key quality gate before releases reach Pure’s customers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own System Testing strategy for releases Define System Testing strategy and test plans for major features and releases, focusing on stability, longevity, and end‑to‑end behavior, not just feature correctness.
* Design realistic, high‑value scenarios Build scenarios that mirror Pure customer environments: mixed workloads (block, file, object), long‑running IO, failovers, NDUs, hardware events, and background operations (replication, snapshots, quotas, etc.), combining automation with targeted “tortures”.
* Drive execution and triage on System Testing beds Own System Testing environments (arrays, initiators, OSes, accessories); keep them healthy, representative, and well‑instrumented. Monitor runs, triage failures quickly, separate infra issues from product bugs, and file high‑quality defects with clear workload, scale, logs, and impact—driving them to closure with Dev, PM, and Release teams.
* Be a key voice in release readiness Act as a primary quality gate for Release Candidates: define System Testing entry/exit criteria, sign‑off requirements, and soak expectations (for example, 24–48h+ without critical events). Summarize findings, risks, and recommendations and provide data‑driven input on go/no‑go decisions.
* Lead technically and mentor others Coach mid‑level and junior QE engineers (System Testing and system test) on test design, debugging, triage, and long‑running validation best practices. Refine System Testing processes, playbooks, and governance in partnership with engineering managers and technical leaders.
* Advance automation, tooling, and observability Partner with automation teams to extend System Testing workflows (workload drivers, torture suites, health checks, dashboards). Improve observability for System Testing: metrics, alerting, and automated log/triage helpers that make issues obvious and actionable.

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years in software QA / system test / performance / reliability engineering, with significant experience in system‑level or longevity testing of complex distributed or storage systems.
* Strong understanding of storage concepts (block, file, snapshots, replication, HA/failover, NDUs) and their behavior under sustained load and fault conditions.
* Proven ability to design and execute long‑running scenarios that surface race conditions, memory leaks, scaling issues, and resiliency gaps.
* Strong debugging skills across host, network, storage system, logs, and metrics.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux and at least one of VMware, Windows, or Kubernetes.
* Solid experience with test automation (Python, shell), CI pipelines, and result dashboards.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional collaboration with Development, System Test, Release, and Support.
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting complex findings and risk assessments to senior engineers and leaders.
* Directory services and identity:AD, LDAP, Kerberos, ID mapping — and how per-tenant auth domains explode the test matrix.
* Linux systems skills:shell, networking (VLANs, sub-interfaces, routing,ip,tc), service debugging, log and core analysis at scale

**Nice‑to‑have**

* Background in enterprise storage.
* Experience with performance engineering, capacity / longevity modeling, or customer‑data‑driven test design.
* Exposure to AI‑assisted test design or triage and interest in using new tools to improve coverage and efficiency.
* Experience working with different hypervisors, backup applications, databases, video streaming or healthcare applications/workloads is a plus
* Prior multi-tenancy / RBAC / virtual-array isolation work in storage or cloud.
* Replication and DR:async/ADR, sync-rep, ActiveCluster or metro-cluster, split-brain and resync validation.
* QoS and quotatest background.

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

**About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.
* Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes.
* Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power.
* Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results.
* Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up.
* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.
* Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.

* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.

title: Software Quality Engineer – Automation & AI
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Qualify new and existing software products and features through functional, regression, performance, reliability, and system-level testing.
* Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and validation strategies to ensure high product quality.
* Analyze test results and publish qualification reports, recommendations, training materials, and Best Known Methods (BKMs).
* Collaborate with Algorithm, System Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Customer Support teams across global locations.
* Assess automation feasibility and develop automated test solutions, frameworks, and tools to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design reviews, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer support.

**AI & Innovation Responsibilities**

* Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered tools to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, reporting, and documentation.
* Develop AI-enabled utilities, applications, and productivity tools for engineering and quality workflows.
* Explore and implement solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern AI frameworks.
* Drive AI adoption within the SQE organization by identifying, prototyping, and deploying high-impact use cases.
* Utilize AI and data analytics techniques to improve quality insights, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C#, C++, or Java.
* Experience with software testing, automation frameworks, and quality engineering methodologies.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI agents, or AI application development is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Represent SQE in product lifecycle reviews, key program meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Willingness to travel to customer fabrication facilities for use-case understanding, software deployment, and troubleshooting support as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
