We are seeking a high-performing
**Software Engineer transitioning into Architecture (Aspirant Architect)**
. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between hands-on code execution and high-level architectural design.

You will work directly alongside Principal Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineering Managers to architect, evaluate, and scale distributed systems on modern cloud platforms. This role is built for a senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep cloud and distributed systems experience, and a passion for system design, data modeling, and technical leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Design & Technical Leadership**

* Assist in drafting architectural blueprints, tech stack evaluation documents, and Architecture Decision
* Perform trade-off analyses balancing performance, maintainability, security, scalability, and operational costs across cloud services and codebases.
* Help define and enforce coding standards, API specifications (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and design patterns across delivery teams.

**2. Hands-on Engineering & Prototyping**

* Write production-ready, highly maintainable code (primarily using
  **Python**
  or equivalent modern languages).
* Build Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to test emerging technologies, validate architectural hypotheses, and bench-test performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot complex, non-deterministic bugs and failure modes in distributed production environments.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Integration**

* Architect resilient, highly available cloud applications on
  **AWS**
  or
  **Azure**
  using microservices, serverless, and containerized topologies.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and deployment strategies (Canary, Blue/Green).
* Integrate full-stack observability (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) into software architecture from inception.

**4. Data Modeling & System Design**

* Design efficient relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) schemas optimized for read/write access patterns, storage efficiency, and data integrity.
* Implement event-driven and streaming architectures using message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Event Grid).

**5. SDLC Execution & Engineering Mentorship**

* Champion the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from threat modeling and capacity planning to post-launch monitoring.
* Conduct high-impact code and design reviews, mentoring mid-level and junior engineers on clean architecture, principles, and system resilience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Software Development:**
  7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python**
  or similar languages (Go, Java, C#).
* **Distributed Computing:**
  Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems. Strong understanding algorithms, caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), load balancing, and fault-tolerance patterns (Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads).
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  3+ years of building and deploying production workloads on
  **AWS**
  (e.g., EKS/ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, S3) or
  **Azure**
  (e.g., AKS, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL).
* **Data Modeling:**
  Proficiency in designing data schemas) and database migrations, and query optimization.
* **DevOps & IaC:**
  Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep), and automated pipeline tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* **Full SDLC Mastery:**
  Practical exposure to complete software life cycles, agile methodologies, secure coding practices (OWASP top 10), and automated testing frameworks (Unit, Integration, E2E).

**Behavioral & Aspirant Attributes**

* **Architecture Mindset:**
  Strong grasp of software design philosophies (Domain-Driven Design, SOLID principles, 12-Factor App methodology, Clean Architecture).
* **Communication:**
  Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and write concise technical documentation.
* **Continuous Learner:**
  Eagerness to evolve from feature implementation to enterprise-wide system strategy.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional) or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with data engineering pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or similar).

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists—engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders—around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients’ lives.
  
  
If you’re ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

21-Oct-2026

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Moative**

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

Our Past: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

Team: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders.

This role focuses on healthcare and RCM, working alongside our AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists.

**Work you’ll do**

We are looking for an experienced AI engineer with hands-on experience in healthcare and revenue cycle management (RCM). You will build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for healthcare operations, with a focus on the US market. The work includes payer-portal automation for claim status and EOB retrieval, voice agents for payer follow-up, analysis of claim journeys and bottlenecks, and AI-assisted insights into practice performance. You will work directly with billing and operations teams, owning delivery from understanding the workflow through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement.

**Responsibilities**

● Own AI agent and automation workflows from requirements through design, development, deployment and monitoring.

● Build agents that work across payer portals, healthcare documents, practice-management systems, EHR-connected tools and voice channels.

● Turn fragmented healthcare data into validated, structured inputs for automation and analysis.

● Work directly with billing and operations teams to understand workflows, resolve exceptions and improve systems based on user feedback.

● Evaluate workflow accuracy and completion rates using representative test sets. Monitor failures and operating costs, and implement retries, exception queues and human escalation.

● Implement approved privacy and security controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access restrictions, audit trails and safeguards against exposing patient information in logs or model inputs.

● Diagnose and improve failures across data ingestion, integrations, agent execution and user-facing workflows.

● Measure operational outcomes, such as time saved, reduced manual effort and faster turnaround, with the teams using the systems. Who you are You are a passionate and results-oriented engineer who is driven by the potential of AI/ML to revolutionize processes, enhance products, and ultimately improve user experiences. You thrive in dynamic environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong sense of ownership and are eager to take initiative, advocating for your technical decisions while remaining open to feedback and collaboration. You are adept at working with real-world, often imperfect data, and have a proven ability to develop, refine, and deploy AI/ML models into production in a cost-effective and scalable manner. You are excited by the prospect of making US healthcare operations faster and more reliable, for the people who run them and the patients they serve. Skills & Requirements Must have

● At least 2 years of professional AI engineering experience, including deploying and supporting systems used in real operations. Internships and academic projects alone do not meet this requirement.

● Hands-on experience building AI or automation solutions for healthcare RCM workflows, such as claim status checks, accounts receivable follow-up, denial management, payment posting or payer interactions.

● Practical understanding of how billing teams work, how claims move through the revenue cycle, and how incomplete data and exceptions affect execution.

● Experience deploying and supporting an LLM-based application or AI agent in production, using capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling or multi-step workflows. Ability to explain your engineering contribution, how the system was evaluated, what failed and how you addressed it.

● Strong production Python and SQL skills, experience integrating APIs, and working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript for browser automation or application integration.

● Experience automating workflows across APIs, browsers or user interfaces, using tools such as Playwright, Selenium or UiPath, with error handling and human escalation where needed.

● Experience deploying and monitoring applications on at least one cloud platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—using containers, version control and automated testing.

● Experience handling imperfect inputs such as scanned PDFs, inconsistent portal layouts or incomplete records, with validation and exception handling.

● Experience working directly with billing or operations teams, improving systems based on their feedback, and demonstrating outcomes such as time saved, claims processed or reduced turnaround time.

● Experience handling sensitive healthcare data through appropriate access controls, secure logging and approved data-handling practices.

**Preferred experience**

● Experience delivering solutions for US healthcare providers, RCM companies or payer-facing operations, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.

● Experience with practice-management or EHR integrations, payer portals, explanation of benefits (EOB) documents or electronic remittance advice (ERA) data.

● Experience analyzing claim histories, revenue-cycle bottlenecks or practice performance.

● Experience building voice agents or integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech services is a plus.

● Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

● Experience with Kubernetes, serverless applications or event-driven architectures. Working at Moative Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless.

**Here are some of our guiding principles:**

● Think in decades. Act in hours. As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.

● Own the canvas. Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.

● Use data or don’t use data. Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.

● Avoid work about work. Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.

● High revenue per person. We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

If this role and our work is of interest to you, please apply. When applying, describe one or two healthcare or RCM systems you have delivered, including your contribution, production challenges and outcomes. Share only material you are authorized to disclose; anonymized descriptions are sufficient. That said, you should demonstrate that you are in the 90th percentile or above.

The position is based out of Chennai. Our work currently involves significant in-person collaboration and we expect you to work out of our offices in Chennai.

title: Applied AI Platform Engineer (Performance Engineer) - Lead SDET I
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Platform Engineer (Performance Engineer) - Lead SDET I**
**Role Overview:**
As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (Performance Engineer) - Lead SDET I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.

Hands On experience with Performance Engineering is important.
  
  

* 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.
* 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
* 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.
* 1+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product.
* Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e.g., Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.
* Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage.
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Platform Engineer

Full-time

: Hyderabad, India

5+ Years

Immediate to 15 Days

**Work Model:**
4 Days Work From Office, 1 Day Work From Home.

**Description:**
As a Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in evolving our engineering platform to support scale, speed, and security across our enterprise. Unlike traditional operationsfocused roles, this position emphasizes software development skills: designing and building developer-facing tools, frameworks, and automations that accelerate delivery. You will leverage your experience with .Net/Java ecosystems, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Cloud, and CI/CD tools like GitHub or Azure DevOps and collaborate with Development, DevOps, Developer Enablement, and Change Management teams to enhance our build and release processes while empowering developers across the company.

• Design, develop, and maintain internal tools, frameworks, and APIs that improve

developer experience, reduce cognitive load, and productivity at scale.

• Build automation for CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps,

ensuring consistency, reliability, and security.

• Collaborate with application development teams to understand their workflows and

create solutions that simplify deployment, testing, and monitoring.

• Write high-quality, maintainable code in .NET, Java, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Contribute to the design and development of infrastructure-as-code solutions for

large-scale, cloud-native platforms (Azure, Kubernetes).

• Champion software engineering best practices: code reviews, automated testing,

version control, and observability.

• Partner with DevOps and development engineers to bridge gaps between

infrastructure and application development while evangelizing best practices.

• Mentor team members from operational backgrounds in software engineering

practices.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)

supporting web-scale applications.

languages: .NET, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript.

CI/CD workflows.

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, Bicep, or similar).

• Experience developing APIs, SDKs, or developer tools.

Grafana) to monitor platform health.

title: Quality Automation - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
**We Are**
A Quality Engineering practice that helps clients move from late-stage testing to continuous quality, efficiency, and resilience. We embed with product, engineering, and architecture teams, apply modern automation and AI-enabled testing, and take quality work from experiment into operational delivery at enterprise scale.
  
  
**You Are**
A hands-on SDET and quality leader with 12+ years in test automation and software quality engineering. You write and review automation, set and execute the quality strategy for your program, and coach a team while remaining technically engaged. You are comfortable in global, collaborative delivery environments and you care about embedding quality across the full software development lifecycle — not only at the end of a sprint.
  
  
The Work
  
  
You will lead quality for complex application delivery: partnering with product, development, and architecture teams; defining and executing a modern test strategy; and applying AI-enabled approaches where they deliver measurable value. You will take accountability for your team's delivery outcomes, technical direction, and continuous improvement, acting as both a technical lead and a client-facing quality partner.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and lead end-to-end quality for your program, including early validation, risk-based testing, and continuous testing.
* Own quality strategy, test planning, estimation, execution governance, defect management, and release-readiness assessment across your workstreams.
* Establish the appropriate balance of unit, API, UI, integration, regression, and exploratory testing based on product risk and architecture.

**SDET & Custom Application Quality**

* Lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and validation components — not test cases alone.
* Design, implement, and scale maintainable automation frameworks for web applications and services, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Build UI, API, and where required mobile automation using Playwright and comparable tools such as Appium and REST Assured.
* Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, coding standards, and shift-left quality practices.

**AI-Enabled Testing & Innovation**

* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and agentic test automation solutions to accelerate test design, implementation, maintenance, and analysis responsibly.
* Apply GenAI tooling (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve test design, code generation, debugging, and root cause analysis.
* Evaluate emerging AI-enabled testing tools through controlled proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, accuracy, and maintainability.

**DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gates that provide fast, reliable feedback.
* Embed automated testing into delivery pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, covering version control and artifact management.

**Cross-Platform Quality Deliver**
y
  
  

* Lead testing across web, API, and mobile (iOS/Android) layers as the engagement requires.
* Apply contract testing, test-data management, service virtualization or mocking, and observability practices.

**Client Engagement & Advisory**

* Partner with client and business stakeholders to shape quality strategy and support transformation initiatives.
* Facilitate workshops and deliver pragmatic quality solutions in ambiguous or evolving delivery environments.

**Team Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing quality engineering team, local or distributed, while remaining technically engaged.
* Own your team's delivery outcomes and guide day-to-day technical decisions.
* Coach team members, set technical direction, review automation code, and promote continuous learning and engineering discipline.

**Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Collaborate across product, development, architecture, DevOps, security, and business teams to resolve dependencies and embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.

**Continuous Improvement & Capability Building**

* Improve test coverage, automation maturity, and delivery efficiency over time.
* Champion quality engineering best practices, reusable standards, automation patterns, and shared assets that build team capability.

**Reporting & Insigh**
ts
  
  

* Produce clear test outcome reports covering execution status, coverage, defect trends, residual risk, release recommendations, and improvement actions.
* Track meaningful quality metrics and deliver dashboards that identify systemic issues, improve predictability, and reduce escaped defects.

**Security, Accessibility & Compliance**

* Embed secure, accessible, and compliant quality practices into delivery, including in regulated environments such as financial services, public sector, and healthcare.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in test automation, SDET, or software quality engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex automation programs.
* Proven experience leading quality engineering teams, managing priorities, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery outcomes.
* Hands-on coding proficiency in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java, with experience building automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, clean-code principles, reusable framework design, version control, and code reviews.
* Practical experience with Playwright or a comparable modern UI automation framework.
* Strong API testing and automation knowledge, including REST services, authentication, data validation, error handling, and service-level test design.
* Strong grounding in functional testing techniques, including requirements analysis, test design, boundary and negative testing, risk-based testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management.
* Experience with unit-testing frameworks and close collaboration with development teams to improve unit and component test coverage.
* Proven experience integrating testing into DevSecOps pipelines, including CI/CD, automated quality gates, reporting, source control, and artifact management.
* Strong experience in test strategy, test-data management, mocking, and observability.
* Ability to create effective test strategies and communicate concise, evidence-based test outcome reports to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder-management, written communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in SAFe Agile or other scaled Agile environments.
* Strong understanding of GenAI in the SDLC, including prompting techniques and AI-augmented testing approaches.
* Experience with contract testing and advanced observability frameworks.
* Background in cross-platform application testing across web and mobile.
* Experience in compliance-heavy or regulated industries such as financial services, public sector, or healthcare.
* Experience contributing to quality engineering transformation or digital testing programs.
* Experience leading quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, or distributed teams.
* Experience modernizing legacy automation suites or transitioning to Playwright and AI-enabled testing approaches.
* Familiarity with non-functional quality areas such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and observability.
* Relevant testing, cloud, Agile, DevOps, or engineering certifications are an advantage.

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Lead with accountability, sound judgment, and a strong customer-focused quality mindset.
* Communicate quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leaders and business stakeholders.
* Build alignment across teams without relying solely on authority, and facilitate timely resolution of quality issues.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports coaching, knowledge sharing, and sustainable delivery.
* Continuously improve processes while balancing speed, reliability, maintainability, and business value.

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

**About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.
* Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes.
* Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power.
* Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results.
* Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up.
* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.
* Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Senior System Software Engineer - Video
description:
NVIDIA's GeForce NOW, the next-generation gaming service powered by NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud, transforms a Mac, PC, or mobile device into a high-performance gaming machine. GeForce NOW keeps games up-to-date automatically, enabling users worldwide to instantly stream the latest games in high-definition resolution with minimal latency and the smoothest gameplay. Just click and play! Visit us at https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now. We are now extending this industry defining technology to a new range of applications including virtual and augmented reality, artificial intelligence and remote controlled robotics.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a team of skilled and motivated engineers who develop a high performance, low latency streaming stack that delivers unprecedented video quality at lowest latency that makes gaming from the cloud the preferred gaming platform for millions.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Design and develop new video streaming functionalities delivering new interactive experiences
* Innovate, design and develop features to improve image quality, performance, reliability, security and maintainability
* Analyze GPU/ CPU performance for the video pipeline, isolate bottlenecks and implement solutions in collaboration with GPU hardware and software teams to deliver top performance
* Develop tools to measure video quality experienced by users, refine to enable evaluation of quality improvements with high confidence
* Leverage features and toolsets in latest video compression technologies to deliver high quality streaming solutions tailored for different interactive graphics applications
* Develop quality-evaluation and analysis capabilities that use metrics along with encoder statistics to detect regressions, evaluate new video features, and guide codec and pipeline tuning.
* Apply machine learning and AI models to develop specialized video processing and adaptive streaming algorithms to minimize perceptible artifacts while delivering the lowest latency under different network conditions.

**What We Need To See**

* 5+ years of experience with Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related area.
* Proficiency in C, C++, Python
* Strong understanding of real-time GPU-accelerated video pipeline performance, including encoder behavior, color spaces, video scaling, transport efficiency, buffering, pacing, bitrate adaptation, frame handling, and latency-sensitive optimizations in distributed or cloud-based systems.
* Familiarity with API frameworks such as Vulkan, CUDA, OpenGL and DX
* Solid understanding of toolsets in different video codecs like H.264, HEVC, and AV1, including tuning codec configurations to meet application requirements and trade-offs.
* Experience debugging and improving reliability and stability in complex streaming systems, including issues related to degraded network conditions, packet loss recovery, telemetry, tracing, field validation, and long-running session behavior.
* Proficiency in telemetry, statistical data analysis, and performance monitoring to measure and optimize video quality, latency, and system performance in cloud infrastructures.
* Experience in using and integrating AI models into real-time video pipelines
* Experience with objective video quality assessment using metrics such as VMAF, CAMBI, PSNR, and SSIM/MS-SSIM, and the ability to correlate those metrics with perceptual video quality across different content types and artifacts.
* Strong understanding of different layers of software stack including OS internals, user-mode and kernel-mode drivers, strong system software performance analysis, testing and debugging skills

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience in optimizing video pipelines on multiple GPU families such as Intel integrated and AMD GPUs
* Experience writing or analyzing graphics rendering applications or advanced AI based graphics generation such as DLSS, RTX, FSR

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

title: Technology consultant/ Fractional CTO
description:
**We're Hiring: Technology Consultant / Fractional CTO**

**Engineering Hiring | Technology Architecture | Strategic Advisory**

📍 
**Location:**
 Gurgaon, Haryana / Remote

💼 
**Engagement:**
 Paid Consulting / Contract / Fractional Advisory

🎯 
**Experience:**
 8+ years preferred (strong technical expertise takes priority over years of experience)

🚀 
**Opportunity:**
 Initial project-based engagement with potential for a long-term advisory partnership

**About Aumraa**

At 
**Aumraa**
, we're on a mission to build India's next-generation 
**Devotional Super App**
 — a unified faith-tech ecosystem that brings together temples, pujas, spiritual guidance, devotional content, sacred commerce and community, with a vision to become a trusted digital companion for millions of devotees.

As an early-stage startup, we're establishing our in-house technology team and laying the foundation for a scalable digital platform spanning web, mobile applications, commerce, service bookings and integrations.

**About the Opportunity**

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on 
**Technology Consultant / Fractional CTO / Engineering Leader**
 to work closely with our founder and help us make informed technical decisions as we build Aumraa.

**Our immediate priority is to hire Full-Stack Developers**
, and we need an experienced technology professional who can independently assess candidates, lead technical evaluations and help us build a capable engineering team.

Beyond recruitment, we envision this evolving into a long-term technology advisory relationship, supporting our platform architecture, mobile application development, engineering standards and broader technology initiatives.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys working with early-stage startups, combining hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking and helping founders translate ambitious product visions into reliable, scalable technology. Engagement Structure

**This is not a conventional full-time CTO position OR Co-founder position.**
We are initially seeking an independent technology consultant for a defined, paid technical hiring engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Hiring & Candidate Evaluation — Immediate Priority**

* Review and refine technical job descriptions, skill requirements and evaluation criteria for Senior and Junior Full-Stack Developer positions.
* Design and conduct structured technical interviews covering Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, databases and API development.
* Evaluate candidates on coding proficiency, debugging, problem-solving, system design, security fundamentals and real-world development experience.
* Develop practical technical assessments appropriate to each experience level.
* Assess candidates' ability to independently develop, maintain and deploy production-ready applications.
* Provide structured candidate scorecards, comparative assessments and clear hiring recommendations.
* Advise on engineering team structure, role ownership and technical competency expectations.

**2. Technology Architecture & Strategic Advisory — Longer-Term Scope**

* Review Aumraa's existing technology stack and recommend improvements where necessary.
* Advise on backend architecture, frontend architecture, database design, API standards and third-party integrations.
* Evaluate and recommend the appropriate mobile application framework, including React Native versus Flutter.
* Guide architectural decisions involving scalability, performance, security, maintainability and cost efficiency.
* Recommend infrastructure, cloud deployment, CI/CD, monitoring and development practices suited to an early-stage technology company.
* Help establish a practical technical roadmap aligned with Aumraa's product development priorities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical debt and potential implementation bottlenecks before they become costly.

**3. Engineering Guidance & Development Oversight — Ongoing Advisory Scope**

* Provide periodic technical guidance and mentorship to Aumraa's in-house engineering team.
* Review critical code, architecture decisions and implementation approaches.
* Help establish coding standards, code review practices, testing expectations and documentation guidelines.
* Advise on technical task breakdown, development estimates and engineering milestones.
* Review development progress and help resolve complex technical challenges.
* Support technical evaluations of external vendors, integrations and technology partners when required.
* Act as a trusted technology advisor to the founder on important engineering decisions.

**Technical Expertise Required**

* **Strong hands-on expertise in:**
* **Backend:**

   Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, RESTful APIs, authentication and authorisation.
* **Frontend:**

   React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript and modern frontend architecture.
* **Databases:**

   Relational database design, SQL, data modelling and performance optimisation.
* **Architecture:**

   System design, modular architecture, API integration, scalability and secure application development.
* **Engineering Practices:**

   Git, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and production deployment.
* **Security:**

   Application security, secure coding principles, access controls and data protection.

**Additional experience that would be valuable:**

* React Native and/or Flutter mobile application development.
* AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.
* Shopify, e-commerce integrations and third-party commerce platforms.
* Payment gateways, booking systems, notifications and service-oriented platform integrations.
* Experience designing or scaling consumer-facing web and mobile products.

*Expertise in our core Java/Spring Boot and React stack is essential. Direct experience with every additional technology is not mandatory.*

**Who We're Looking For**

* An experienced professional who:
* Has preferably 
  **8+ years of software engineering experience**

  , including substantial hands-on development and architecture responsibilities.
* Has worked as a CTO, Fractional CTO, Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, Solution Architect, Principal Engineer or Senior Full-Stack Engineer.
* Has personally built, shipped or scaled production-grade digital products.
* Can evaluate both junior and senior engineering candidates with confidence.
* Has experience mentoring developers and establishing practical engineering standards.
* Understands the challenges, resource constraints and decision-making needs of an early-stage startup.
* Can communicate complex technical decisions clearly to a non-technical founder.
* Takes a pragmatic, business-oriented approach rather than recommending unnecessarily complex technology solutions.
* Is comfortable working independently and providing objective technical recommendations.
* Experience advising startups or building engineering teams from the ground up will be a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

**During the initial engagement:**

* Clear technical evaluation criteria for the two Full-Stack Developer positions.
* Well-structured interviews and practical assessments.
* Objective, documented candidate evaluations.
* Confident hiring recommendations supported by technical evidence.
* Clear expectations for each developer's responsibilities and capabilities.

**As the relationship develops:**

* A well-defined, scalable technology architecture.
* Informed decisions about our mobile framework and supporting infrastructure.
* Improved engineering quality and technical accountability.
* A capable in-house development team supported by consistent technical guidance.

Based on mutual fit, availability and business requirements, the engagement may subsequently expand into a longer-term, fractional technology advisory relationship.

We welcome applications from independent consultants, fractional CTOs and experienced engineering leaders offering consulting services.

**Location:**
 Remote engagement is welcome. Gurgaon-based professionals are also encouraged to apply.

**Compensation:**
 Competitive consulting fees, based on relevant experience and the agreed scope of work.

**How to Apply**

If you have strong engineering expertise, enjoy solving real-world technology challenges and would like to help an ambitious startup build its engineering foundation, we'd love to connect.

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
**Our DTS Team Provides Following Services To Clients**

* Data & Applied Intelligence - Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision-making and transform businesses.
* Product and Innovation - Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage.
* Technology M&A and Strategy - Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M&A, integrations and carve-outs.
* Technology Transformation - A&M helps clients create a scalable, cost-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities.

**How You Will Contribute**

* Build the evaluation framework used to determine whether an AI application is fit to go live, covering component, trajectory and end-to-end outcome measurement, with defined pass thresholds integrated into the delivery pipeline.
* Work directly with business subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and convert them into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
