We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Business Analysis Leadership: Apply business analysis techniques and lead delivery within a global S/4HANA Finance transformation, ensuring solutions align with clear business objectives.
* Finance Capability Design: Be responsible for the design of Finance capabilities, enable seamless delivery across releases, and lead solution remediation to protect process integrity and performance.
* SAP Best Practice and Architecture: Ensure compliance with SAP best practices, maintain integrated architecture standards, and implement robust, compliant data designs that endure.
* Planning and Risk Management: Assist in project planning, proactively handle risks and interdependencies, and keep delivery on time and on budget.
* Delivery Methodologies: Organise and implement project activities using Agile or Waterfall approaches, including SAP Activate, selecting the right tool for the outcome.
* Multi-functional Solution Design: Partner with the IT Design Team to produce solution designs that meet business and multi-functional requirements without fragmenting standards.
* Global Process Alignment: Engage with Enterprise Process Owners to define IT solutions that align to standardised global processes and deliver consistent outcomes.
* Finance Process Design and Integration: Lead Finance process design during global definition, ensuring deep integration with SAP solutions and related data objects.
* Standards Development and Testing: Develop and test global standard solutions, and bring designs through governance forums and frameworks to ensure adoption and quality.
* Product and Design Integration: Work with IT Business Analysts, Product Managers, and design experts to ensure global designs are coherent, scalable, and integrated.
* Innovation with External Experts: Collaborate with partner SME to bring the best of technology and standard approaches into our solutions.
* Strategic Design Forums: Participate in cross-functional design forums to align global designs with strategic business goals and system architecture.
* Localisation within Standards: Address localisation needs during deployment while safeguarding global standardisation and maintainability.
* Documentation and Enablement: Create clear solution designs, maintain high-quality project documentation, and deliver training on relevant tools and technologies.
* Coupa Solution and Process Expertise: Apply hands-on Coupa experience to analyse, design, and support Coupa-enabled procurement and invoicing capabilities integrated with SAP S/4HANA.
* P2P and Accounts Payable Process Leadership: Bring strong end-to-end business process understanding across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP), including requisitioning, purchasing, goods receipt, invoicing, matching, approvals, and payment-related dependencies.
* Coupa-to-SAP Data Mapping and Validation: Define, review, and validate Coupa versus SAP field mappings for master and transactional data; establish mapping rules, identify data gaps, reconcile interface outputs, and support defect resolution through SIT and UAT.

**Essential For The Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study or equivalent experience
* Experience applying business analysis tools, techniques, and concepts (e.g., requirements management, user-centered design, business process/product design) to deliver business change
* Experience collaborating with business partners to identify and address process/product requirements and IT needs
* Experience leading discussions, identifying and documenting business IT problem statements, business process/product design, and report requirements
* Experience working with third-party suppliers/vendors and supplier solutions/products
* Experience planning and handling resources and budgets within assigned areas
* Demonstrable hands-on experience working with Coupa, including procurement and invoicing processes and integration touchpoints with SAP.
* Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP) business processes, controls, and data flows.
* Prior experience mapping Coupa fields to SAP fields for master and transactional data, with responsibility for data validation, reconciliation, interface testing, and defect analysis during SIT and UAT.

**Desirable for the Role**

* Certification in business analysis practice (preferred)
* Experience in advising business partners across one or more functional domains within the pharmaceutical industry;
* Experience in effectively communicating with and influencing individuals at various levels (e.g., peers, managers, team members)
* Experience working within a global matrix organization, including geographically dispersed teams and partners.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. title: System Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Responsable de la qualité de son travail. Assujetti à la supervision directe des opérations, aux instructions de travail prescrites et à une vérification système. Exécute ses tâches dans un cadre opérationnel bien défini. Il y dispose généralement d'une séquence détaillée des tâches opérationnelles standard à suivre pour obtenir le résultat final escompté.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. title: Implementation Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Implementation Engineer (SaaS & AI)**
**Company:**
MAKO IT LAB
  
  
**Experience:**
2–5 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai – Work from Office
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a customer-focused and technically capable
**Implementation Engineer**
to join our SaaS Implementation team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, designing practical solutions, configuring SaaS platforms, and delivering successful implementations.
  
  
This role combines
**solution consulting, SaaS implementation, basic Python programming, AI-assisted automation, and customer engagement**
.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable interacting directly with international customers, translating their business requirements into functional solutions, and independently managing implementation activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Discovery & Solution Consulting
* Engage with customers to understand their business requirements, workflows, and implementation objectives.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions and solution discussions.
* Recommend appropriate product features, configurations, and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify technical limitations, dependencies, and potential implementation risks.
* SaaS Product Implementation
* Configure SaaS platforms, including workflows, templates, custom fields, user roles, permissions, dashboards, and automation rules.
* Implement solutions based on approved customer requirements.
* Support data imports, mapping, migration, and validation activities.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues and resolve implementation challenges.
* Manage multiple customer implementations while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.
* Python & Technical Integration
* Write and modify basic Python scripts for data processing, validation, and automation.
* Work with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and webhooks.
* Use Python to support API interactions, data transformations, and implementation utilities.
* Assist integration teams with troubleshooting and technical validation.
* Collaborate with developers on complex customizations and third-party integrations.
* AI & Automation
* Use AI-powered tools to improve implementation efficiency, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Apply AI-assisted coding tools to develop and optimize basic Python scripts.
* Explore opportunities to automate repetitive implementation tasks.
* Understand fundamental AI concepts, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Demonstrate an interest in learning and working with AI-driven implementation platforms.
* Customer Training & Go-Live
* Conduct product demonstrations, configuration walkthroughs, and customer training sessions.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and resolve identified issues.
* Prepare implementation documentation, configuration guides, and handover materials.
* Support go-live activities and post-implementation stabilization.
* Ensure a smooth handover to Customer Success and Support teams.
* Project Ownership & Communication
* Independently own assigned implementation activities and smaller customer projects.
* Provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies.
* Proactively identify blockers and escalate issues when necessary.
* Maintain clear documentation and follow established implementation processes.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* 2–5 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical implementation, or solution consulting.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS product configuration and customer onboarding.
* Basic Python programming knowledge is mandatory, including scripting, data manipulation, and API interactions.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and Postman.
* Familiarity with AI technologies and tools is mandatory, including practical exposure to generative AI or AI-assisted development.
* Strong business requirement analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to independently interact with customers and recommend suitable solutions.
* Willingness to work from the Chennai office during the 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST shift.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with CRM, PSA, project management, or customer onboarding platforms.
* Exposure to Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, Monday.com, or similar SaaS products.
* Knowledge of SQL, data migration, and data transformation.
* Experience with Workato, Zapier, Make, or similar integration platforms.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Understanding of LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI workflow automation.
* Experience working with US-based customers.

What We Expect
  
  

* Strong ownership of customer implementations from discovery to go-live.
* A solution-oriented mindset rather than a task-execution approach.
* Ability to combine business understanding with technical capabilities.
* Willingness to continuously learn new SaaS products, Python, AI technologies, and automation tools.
* Strong communication, documentation, and customer management skills.
* Proactive identification of risks and timely escalation of blockers.
* Commitment to implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines.

**Required Skills**
Communication Solution Consulting Customer Onboarding ETL Basics Process Improvement Quick learner SaaS Implementation

SPEG team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. * Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation

* Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
* Can manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

* Associate's degree or above, or Master of Business Administration

title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms
description:
**Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms**
**GCL: E**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.
  
  
You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
* Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and related DevOps services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
* Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
* Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
* Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
* Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, DevSecOps practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
* Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
* They will bring strong expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
* They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
* The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
* Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
* Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
* This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
* Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, including GxP, would be helpful.
* Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, platform decisions turn into real-world impact for patients. We bring surprising combinations of guides together to reinvent how data, machine learning and modern engineering accelerate discovery and delivery. You will shape the backbone that powers science at scale—working with leading specialists, pushing forward with a multifaceted operating model, and learning fast without compromising on doing things the right way. We value grit alongside ambition, coupling high standards with genuine support so you can take bold bets, see your work recognized, and grow your craft while improving lives.
  
  
Step in to lead the DevOps platforms within the enterprise that accelerate science. Take ownership of the portfolio and help us build the future of delivery.

title: Associate Product Manager/Product Manager (Reference Standards)
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Reference Standards Product Manager Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
* Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
* Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
* Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
* Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
* Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
* Minimum three (3) to seven (7) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field
* At least one (1) to two (2) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross-functional teams.
* Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools
* Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data-driven solutions.
* Ability to develop and present dashboards, templates and business cases supported by strong rationale, customer insights and business growth goals.
* Self-starter and highly self-motivated, assumes personal accountability for results and performance.
* Working knowledge of syndicated data and analysis, such as IQVIA, Cortellis, Dailymed, etc
* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

**Technical Program Manager**

The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive-level reporting.
  
  
This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI-enabled delivery practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud-native, and enterprise-grade digital applications.

* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.

**AI & Gen AI Enablement**

* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise-approved AI platforms.

* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.

**Agile, DevSecOps & Release Governance**

* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.

**Stakeholder & Executive Communication**

* Provide clear, concise, and data-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business-relevant insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 14+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.

**Preferred Technical Capabilities**

* Prior hands-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.

* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance-heavy environments.

We are a diversified international business group with operations and commercial interests across multiple countries, specializing in minerals and metals trading, manufacturing, sourcing, imports, exports, logistics, and trade finance.

As part of our digital transformation initiative, we intend to develop an integrated, AI-enabled business operating platform that connects our commercial, operational, financial, and management functions.

We are seeking a hands-on AI Automation Lead capable of independently designing, developing, deploying, and scaling intelligent automation solutions across the group.

Position Objective

To lead the development of a centralized AI-powered business automation and intelligence ecosystem covering the complete commercial lifecycle—from global market research, customer acquisition, supplier sourcing, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, international logistics, and trade finance through collections, financial realization, and management reporting.

The successful candidate must combine strong software engineering capabilities with an understanding of business processes, data architecture, enterprise integrations, and AI-powered research systems.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. AI Agents, Bots & Intelligent Workflow Automation

\* Design and deploy AI-powered agents and bots for business process automation.

\* Build intelligent workflows using Python, n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or equivalent technologies.

\* Automate data collection, document processing, email classification, task allocation, approvals, reminders, and management reporting.

\* Develop AI systems capable of extracting, analyzing, validating, and organizing structured and unstructured business information.

\* Implement reliable workflow orchestration, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval mechanisms.

B. End-to-End Trade & Manufacturing Automation

\* Map and automate the full purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes.

\* Digitize RFQs, quotations, purchase orders, sales contracts, supplier management, and customer order tracking.

\* Develop manufacturing and inventory monitoring systems covering raw materials, production status, quality checks, warehouse movements, and dispatches.

\* Automate export/import documentation workflows including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, inspection certificates, and customs-related documents.

\* Integrate shipping, freight forwarding, logistics milestones, delivery confirmations, and transaction-level profitability.

\* Establish transaction-level visibility across all participating group entities.

C. Global Market Research & Commercial Intelligence

\* Develop AI-enabled research systems for international minerals and metals markets.

\* Build searchable, structured databases of global importers, exporters, buyers, manufacturers, suppliers, commodity traders, and logistics providers.

\* Automate market mapping by commodity, country, trade route, demand, supply, and potential business opportunity.

\* Collect and analyze information from licensed trade databases, public registries, market intelligence platforms, and authorized data sources.

\* Build data enrichment, duplicate detection, company classification, contact verification, and research update workflows.

\* Generate actionable business intelligence reports for commercial and business development teams.

D. Trade Finance, Banking & Investment Intelligence

\* Build and maintain structured databases of international banks, NBFCs, trade finance institutions, private credit funds, alternative lenders, and investment institutions.

\* Develop tools to identify potential financing institutions based on geography, transaction type, commodity, collateral, and funding requirements.

\* Automate lender prospect research, eligibility screening, outreach tracking, follow-ups, and financing pipeline management.

\* Develop systems to organize financing documentation, transaction information, KYC requirements, and due diligence checklists.

\* Automate monitoring of letters of credit, bank guarantees, receivables financing, invoice discounting, trade loans, and other working capital arrangements.

\* Build dashboards for funding proposals, lender engagement, sanctions, disbursements, repayment schedules, and outstanding obligations.

E. Group Management Information Systems

\* Develop centralized management dashboards covering multiple group companies and international operations.

\* Consolidate data from ERP, accounting, spreadsheets, databases, emails, and operational applications.

\* Automate daily, weekly, and monthly reporting.

\* Develop dashboards for procurement, production, sales, shipments, inventory, profitability, working capital, cash flow, receivables, and financing.

\* Create exception-based alerts for management intervention.

\* Establish consistent reporting definitions, data quality controls, and entity-wise access permissions.

F. Systems Integration & Technology Architecture

\* Design scalable databases, APIs, data pipelines, workflow engines, and internal applications.

\* Integrate existing ERP, CRM, accounting, document management, and communication platforms.

\* Develop secure cloud-based or hybrid technology infrastructure.

\* Implement role-based access control, encryption, logging, monitoring, backup, and recovery processes.

\* Ensure compliance with applicable data protection, cross-border data transfer, and commercial data licensing requirements.

\* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, testing procedures, and deployment standards.

Mandatory Technical Qualifications

\* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, REST APIs, and backend development.

\* Practical experience integrating LLMs and developing AI agents, tool-calling systems, and retrieval-augmented generation solutions.

\* Hands-on experience with n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or equivalent workflow automation platforms.

\* Experience in database architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, data extraction, validation, and integration.

\* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or comparable relational databases.

\* Working knowledge of Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools.

\* Experience integrating ERP, CRM, finance, and third-party business applications.

\* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Docker, Git, CI/CD, testing, and production monitoring.

\* Ability to independently take solutions from business requirements through deployment and maintenance.

Preferred Experience

\* International trade and commodity trading operations.

\* Manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, and logistics technology.

\* Trade finance, banking, lending, or fintech automation.

\* Multi-company, multi-currency, and cross-border operations.

\* Enterprise automation projects with measurable business outcomes.

Key Performance Indicators

\* Number of production-ready automations deployed and adopted.

\* Reduction in manual processing time and repetitive work.

\* Improvement in transaction visibility and operational turnaround time.

\* Accuracy, completeness, and freshness of business intelligence databases.

\* Reliability of integrations and management dashboards.

\* Reduction in reporting delays and operational exceptions.

\* Measurable commercial value generated through improved research, workflow efficiency, and financial visibility.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a builder, not merely a technology coordinator.

The ideal candidate should be technically independent, commercially aware, analytical, and capable of working closely with senior leadership.

They must be able to understand business operations, translate requirements into technical solutions, write and review code, integrate systems, troubleshoot production issues, and progressively establish a scalable technology ecosystem.

* This is a high-ownership role with the opportunity to architect and build the digital intelligence and automation infrastructure of an international business group

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About The Company**
Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.
  
  
We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Finance and Planning team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to help own
**US Payroll**
. You'll work on the features that make sure every US employee and contractor is paid accurately and on time, and that taxes, deductions and benefits are handled correctly. It's a role for someone early in their product career who wants to go deep into a hard, high-stakes domain and grow fast.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own features across the US payroll run: pay schedules, regular and off-cycle payrolls, approvals, payroll funding and data checks that keep payroll on time.
* Work on tax setup, employee and contractor tax documents (W-2, 1099), deductions and garnishments.
* Help improve integrations with benefits providers (such as 401(k) and health insurance) and accounting tools (such as QuickBooks).
* Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work closely with Engineering and Design to ship reliable features.
* Talk to US payroll admins and customers. Understand their workflows and pain points and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Work with CX, Implementation and Support to understand escalations, find root causes, and fix recurring themes for good.
* Work with partner teams to understand their APIs and behaviour, and raise and track issues that affect our customers.
* Define success metrics for what you ship, track adoption and correctness, and improve based on data.

**What You'll Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis or a similar role in B2B SaaS. Strong freshers with relevant internships are welcome to apply.
* Any exposure to finance, fintech, payments, accounting, payroll or HR tech is a strong plus. So is any work with US customers or US-market products.
* A CA, CA-Inter, CPA, CFA or finance degree is a bonus but not required.

*Domain & customer*

* Curious about money, tax and how payroll works: you enjoy understanding the rules behind how people get paid, and you want to go deep, not just manage tickets.
* Learns fast: you've picked up something complex quickly before, and can explain it simply to others.
* Customer-led thinking: you're comfortable talking to users, asking good questions, and finding the real problem behind a request.

*Product craft*

* Attention to detail: in payroll, small mistakes matter. You think through edge cases and write clear acceptance criteria.
* Structured thinking: you can break a messy problem into clear parts, prioritise, and explain your reasoning.
* Comfortable with data: basic SQL, spreadsheets or dashboards. You like checking whether something actually worked after launch.
* Clear communication: you write crisply and can keep engineering, design, support and customers on the same page.

*Engineering partnership*

* Technically curious: you're comfortable reading API documentation and understanding how data moves between systems, or you're keen to learn quickly.
* Owns quality: you test what you ship, and when something breaks, you help find the root cause and push for a lasting fix.
* A good partner to Engineering: you work through disagreements with evidence and customer outcomes, and you're open to changing your mind.

*Ways of working*

* Uses AI tools to learn faster, research, and work more efficiently.
* Open to working with US customers and partners, including some calls in US hours when needed.

title: Business Analysis - Product Owner, AVP
description:
Who We’re Looking For
  
  
State Street Alpha is seeking an Assistant Vice President, Product Manager to help drive the next generation of our Enterprise Data Management (EDM) platform services. You’ll help shape cloud-native, independently deployable data services that help some of the world’s largest investment firms master, govern and distribute their data at scale.
  
  
This role suits a product manager with 12+ years of experience in data management or financial software who is ready to own significant capability areas. Reporting to the EDM product lead, you will own requirements and delivery for capabilities across entity and identifier resolution, reference data management, extensible data models and release management.
  
  
You’ll work closely with engineering, architecture and client teams to turn business needs into well-defined, prioritized features that deliver measurable client value.
  
  
Why This Role Is Important to Us
  
  
State Street Alpha brings together data and capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help clients make better decisions, grow at scale and deliver returns for their clients. The Alpha Data Platform is a market-leading SaaS platform powering front-to-back investment workflows for global financial institutions.

title: Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)
description:
**Job Description — Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

Y-Axis Overseas Careers · October 2026

**About Y-Axis and the opportunity**

Y-Axis is hiring one person to build and scale a new direct-to-consumer channel: service products that customers browse, choose and buy online without a sales call.

Y-Axis Overseas Careers is one of India's best-known migration and overseas career consultancies. For years our services have been sold through counsellors and branches. We are now packaging them as fixed-scope, fixed-price products, such as Work in Europe, Work in Germany and Work in Dubai for Nurses, sold through dedicated sales pages with a self-serve checkout.

Selling a service online is harder than selling a physical product. The buyer cannot touch it, the outcome is months away, and trust decides the sale. We need someone who has already solved that problem in a service business, not only in retail or FMCG e-commerce.

**The role: Growth Lead – D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**Experience**

6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, at least 3 in a service-based business

**Reports to**

Head of Digital / Business Head

**Works with**

Performance marketing, web development, design, CRM, content, sales and operations

**Role summary**

You will own the online sale of Y-Axis service products end to end: the product catalogue, the storefront and checkout, the traffic that reaches it, and the revenue it produces. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and do much of the work yourself, while directing existing marketing, web and CRM teams to execute.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and revenue ownership**

•    Own the growth plan and revenue target for online service products, with clear goals for customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS) and payback.

•    Decide which products, countries and customer segments to prioritise, using data on demand, margin and conversion.

•    Run a weekly growth review with clear owners, actions and results.

**Catalogue and offer**

•    Turn Y-Axis services into clear, buyable products: scope, inclusions, timelines, price points, tiers and bundles.

•    Write and maintain product pages, comparison tiles and FAQs that answer objections before they become sales calls.

•    Work with finance and operations on pricing, refunds, instalments and payment options.

**Storefront, checkout and conversion**

•    Own the sales-page and checkout journey on y-axis.com, from product tiles to payment and confirmation.

•    Brief design and development on new pages and features; write clear requirements and test before launch.

•    Build trust into every step: reviews, success stories, credentials, guarantees and a transparent process.

•    Run A/B tests on headlines, pricing display, trust signals, creatives and checkout steps.

**Acquisition and retention**

•    Direct paid acquisition across Google, Meta, YouTube and affiliates for product-led campaigns.

•    Work with SEO and content teams to build organic demand for each product page.

•    Set up abandoned-cart recovery and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp and SMS.

•    Design a hybrid path where high-intent buyers can move between self-serve checkout and a counsellor without friction.

•    Drive upsell and cross-sell to related services after the first purchase.

**Analytics and reporting**

•    Track the full funnel in GA4: sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts, payments and refunds.

•    Report weekly to leadership on revenue, conversion, CAC and drop-off points, with clear next actions.

**What we are looking for**

•    6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, with at least 3 in a service-based industry: edtech, immigration, study abroad, travel, healthcare, insurance, fintech or professional services.

•    Proven record of selling a service or digital product online, with numbers to show: revenue grown, conversion improved, CAC reduced.

•    Hands-on with GA4, tag management, A/B testing tools, landing-page builders and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar).

•    Has managed paid media budgets with a clear return.

•    Understands high-consideration buying: long decision cycles, trust building and the hand-off between digital and human sales.

•    Clear, persuasive product copywriting in English; can brief developers and designers precisely.

•    Comfortable working without a dedicated team, influencing other teams to get things done.

**Good to have**

•    Experience launching a D2C or self-serve channel inside a sales-led business.

•    Knowledge of international markets (Europe, Gulf, Canada, Australia) and NRI or migrant audiences.

•    Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and WhatsApp commerce.

**How we will measure success**

**Metric**

**What it tells us**

**Online service-product revenue vs target**

Is the channel delivering?

**Visit-to-purchase conversion rate**

Is the storefront doing its job?

**CAC and ROAS**

Is growth profitable?

**Average order value and cross-sell revenue**

Are tiers, bundles and upsells landing?

**Refund and cancellation rate**

Are we selling the right product to the right buyer?

**What we offer and how to apply**

**What we offer**

•    The chance to build a new revenue channel from the ground up, with leadership backing.

•    Direct impact on people's lives: every sale helps someone start an overseas career.

•    A strong brand, an established customer base and a large existing service catalogue to package and sell.

•    Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives.

**How to apply**

* Send your CV and a short note (no more than 300 words) to [email address]. In the note, tell us about one service or digital product you helped sell online: what you changed, and what happened to the numbers.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the service transformation teams**
Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.
  
  
**Turn architecture into shipped services**
Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered.
  
  
**Establish the base service tier**
Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.
  
  
**Protect compatibility and business continuity**
Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.
  
  
**Modernize the application foundations**
Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.
  
  
**Raise the bar for engineering quality**
Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.
  
  
**Drive AI-native ways of working**
Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.
  
  
Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.
  
  
**Hire and grow strong engineers**
Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through.
  
  
**Partner across the program**
Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed.
  
  
**What This Is Not**
This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.
  
  
This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Proven engineering leadership**
Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.
  
  
**Service transformation depth**
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.
  
  
**Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency**
Enough hands-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room.
  
  
**Migration safety instincts**
You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
**Quality and operational discipline**
You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built — and you hold that bar for your teams.
  
  
**People development**
You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care.
  
  
**Cross-functional execution**
You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
**An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**
You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning — and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
**Bonus Points**
Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well.
  
  
Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers.
  
  
Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks).
  
  
Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
**The base service tier becomes real**
Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired — reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered.
  
  
**Convergence advances without destabilizing the business**
Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use.
  
  
**The platform compounds**
New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver.
  
  
**The team gets stronger**
Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change.
  
  
**Why This Matters**
Everything ABC is building — the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform — stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted.
  
  
This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

description:

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) with deep expertise in digital commerce and eCommerce platforms to support SAP Commerce (Hybris) programs across AMS, enhancements, and transformational initiatives. The role will own requirements quality, business-process alignment, cross-functional coordination, and functional readiness from discovery through deployment and hypercare.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess advanced requirements-management skills, strong stakeholder-engagement experience, and a solid understanding of B2B commerce processes. The individual will act as a trusted advisor and liaison among business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and technology teams; challenge assumptions constructively; drive alignment on priorities and scope; and ensure that delivered solutions achieve measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Requirements Management
* Elicit, analyse, document, and validate business requirements from stakeholders.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement-gathering meetings.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify gaps, dependencies, and process improvement opportunities.
* Stakeholder Management
* Establish and maintain business analysis standards, requirement templates, traceability practices, review checkpoints, and quality controls across the engagement.
* Lead requirement reviews, resolve conflicting requirements, and ensure that scope changes are formally assessed, approved, and communicated.
* Collaborate with business users, product owners, IT teams, and external partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for requirement clarifications.
* Present business process recommendations and solution options.
* Support decision-making by providing impact and feasibility assessments.
* Digital Commerce Support
* Provide functional leadership across delivery teams.
* Review deliverables, promote reusable practices, and support estimation, planning.
* Analyse and document end-to-end commerce processes as per the client needs.
* Support implementation and enhancement initiatives within SAP Commerce environments.
* Facilitate backlog prioritization and release-planning activities and supporting product owners in making transparent prioritization decisions.
* Analyse complex B2B business models and processes, and customer journeys as per the client needs.
* Agile Delivery Support
* Define and validate functional requirements for integrations among SAP Commerce, ERP, CRM, PIM, payment, tax, logistics, identity, and other enterprise systems.
* Document data flows, mappings, business rules, interface dependencies, exception handling, reconciliation requirements, and ownership of master and transactional data.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews.
* Coordinate with development and QA teams to ensure requirements are implemented correctly.
* Define business outcomes, success measures, and acceptance thresholds for major initiatives.
* Track whether delivered capabilities achieve the intended customer, operational, and commercial benefits, and recommend corrective actions where expected value is not realized.
* Testing & Validation
* Support AMS operations by analysing incidents, service requests, recurring defects, and business-impact trends.
* Clarify functional behaviour, contribute to root-cause analysis, identify permanent corrective actions, and help prioritize fixes and service improvements against agreed service levels.
* Elicit and document non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, availability, security, privacy, accessibility, auditability, localization, supportability, and regulatory compliance.
* Support cutover and data-migration planning by defining business validation rules, reconciliation criteria, mock-cutover scenarios, readiness checkpoints, rollback considerations, and business sign-off requirements.
* Develop test scenarios and business validation criteria.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements.
* Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing by defining the UAT scope, entry and exit criteria, scenarios, test data needs, participant responsibilities, defect-severity rules, progress reporting, and business sign-off requirements.
* Lead business readiness activities for deployment and hypercare, including process and training impact assessments, operational handover, release communications, support documentation, adoption tracking, issue escalation, and confirmation that business teams are prepared to use and support the delivered capabilities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of Business Analysis experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex digital commerce initiatives and leadership of business analysis activities across multiple workstreams or releases.

* Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycle (SDLC).

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Digital & Innovation group at USP is seeking a Business Analyst who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs.
