title: Technical Business Analyst III
description:
Are you a seasoned Technical Business Analyst with a passion for transforming complex financial systems into streamlined, high-performing solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and finance, turning business challenges into smart, scalable IT innovations? If so, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in a globally connected, SAP-driven financial closing environment — and leave a lasting mark on how the world's (re)insurance industry reports its financials.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Technical Business Analyst**
, you will sit at the heart of our global financial closing ecosystem, acting as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and our SAP-based platform. You will not only maintain and enhance a sophisticated financial subledger solution, but you will also champion simplicity, standardization, and innovation. From shaping new functionality to validating, it through rigorous testing and live production runs, your fingerprints will be on every improvement we make. You'll engage continuously with a global user community — educating, aligning, and supporting teams across time zones and disciplines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with global stakeholders to capture business objectives and requirements, translating them into pragmatic, effective IT solutions
* Challenge complexity — act as a champion for standard components and push back on unnecessarily complicated solutions in favor of elegant, maintainable designs
* Establish yourself as a subject matter expert on SAP systems and financial closing processes, providing trusted guidance and mentorship to stakeholders and team members alike
* Drive end-to-end system changes and customizations through the full lifecycle — from solutioning and implementation through to testing and go-live
* Support quarterly close operations including incident handling, process documentation, and continuous improvement of E2E system workflows
* Engage and educate the global user community on an ongoing basis, ensuring alignment, adoption, and confidence in the platform
* Validate new and enhanced functionality during both testing phases and productive runs, ensuring quality and reliability at every step

**About The Team**
The
**FPSL Subledger Liability**
team is an international product team made up of experienced professionals with diverse and complementary backgrounds. We provide the platform that enables global and local financial closings under IFRS for (re)insurance contracts. At the core of this platform is a robust SAP solution, embedded within an evolving technology landscape that enriches our data and ultimately produces financial statements for the quarterly finance closing process. We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values expertise, curiosity, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  
  
**About You**
You are a strategic and creative problem solver who thrives on turning complexity into clarity. Your strong interpersonal skills allow you to build trusted relationships across diverse, global teams, and your natural curiosity keeps you constantly learning and improving. You bring an ownership mindset to everything you do — self-driven, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. You are as comfortable diving into technical detail as you are facilitating a conversation with senior business stakeholders, and you bring both rigor and enthusiasm to every challenge.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* University degree in a technical, financial, or business discipline (or comparable qualification/experience)
* 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst working with IT systems in complex, enterprise environments
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with FPSL systems, including solid knowledge of IFRS 17 and its application in (re)insurance financial reporting
* Good working knowledge of SQL and the MS Office suite, including advanced Excel skills
* Proven experience delivering product changes and operations with end-to-end ownership, including requirements analysis, testing, process standardization, optimization, and documentation

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Basic knowledge of accounting and financial reporting principles, enabling effective communication with finance stakeholders
* Willingness and ability to learn a scripting language for formulating and automating test cases
* Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies, including experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for backlog management and sprint planning
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones and cultures
* A continuous improvement mindset with the drive to proactively identify and implement enhancements to both processes and systems

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

title: Project Manager (PMO)
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Project Manager to own delivery execution across our technology teams. You take the prioritized backlog and make delivery happen planning and tracking the work, running the sprint process, keeping Jira clean, coordinating the people, and acting as the tech team's face to business stakeholders.

This is a pure project management and delivery role. You are the person who keeps everyone aligned, unblocked, and on schedule, and who represents the technical team's status and constraints clearly to the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery planning & tracking**

·      Take the prioritized backlog and turn it into an executable sprint / release plan.

·      Track progress against timelines, milestones, and commitments; keep delivery on schedule.

·      Manage risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively surface slippage early with options.

**Jira & project tooling management**

·      Own Jira day to day boards, workflows, sprint setup, ticket hygiene, and accurate status.

·      Ensure every task moves through its states cleanly, and nothing stalls silently.

·      Maintain dashboards and delivery reports as a single source of truth for status.

**People & team management**

·      Coordinate developers and QA across workstreams; manage capacity, allocation, and follow-ups.

·      Keep the team unblocked and accountable; drive tasks to completion.

·      Run the sprint ceremonies planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Stakeholder communication (tech team's face to business)**

·      Represent the technical team to business stakeholders communicate delivery status, timelines, and technical constraints in terms the business can act on.

·      Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and change; negotiate when capacity is tight.

**Quality & release**

·      Ensure testing and release readiness are planned in advance, not left to the last day.

·      Coordinate deployments and releases with Engineering and QA.

**Process & governance**

·      Establish and continuously improve lightweight delivery processes suited to a fast-moving company.

**Required Qualifications**

·      Strong hands-on experience with Agile and day-to-day Jira management.

·      Proven track record coordinating cross-functional teams and managing people to deliver on time.

·      Solid understanding of the software delivery lifecycle enough to hold credible conversations with engineers and QA and to explain constraints to the business.

·      Excellent written and verbal communication.

**Core Skills**

·      Delivery planning, scheduling, and tracking.

·      Jira administration, sprint management, and delivery reporting.

·      People and team coordination; driving accountability.

·      Risk, dependency, and blocker management.

·      Stakeholder management and clear status communication.

·      Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

**Emotional Intelligence & Behavioural Competencies**

·
**A two-way bridge, and a balanced advocate.**
You carry the tech team's status and constraints to business stakeholders, and business context back to the team representing both sides fairly. You do not consistently push the pressure onto one side; you find the trade-off that works for the goal.

· 
**Composed under pressure.**
When timelines, scope, and expectations collide, you stay calm and solution focused. You absorb pressure and convert it into clear next steps, rather than passing panic down to the team or frustration up to stakeholders.

· 
**Empathetic, and a genuine listener.**
You understand the real concerns behind what each side is saying the business's urgency and the team's constraints and you listen before you react.

·
**A positive, ownership-driven attitude.**
Proactive, accountable, dependable, and humble. You bring solutions, not just problems and people trust you because both sides feel genuinely heard.

· 
**Resilient and adaptable.**
You stay steady and constructive through changing priorities and tight cycles.

**Nice to Have**

· Experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**

As an early-stage startup, Cohere Health's marketing efforts span a wide range from demand generation and product marketing to event management, content development, and analyst and media engagement. This role offers an exciting opportunity for an analytical, curious, and highly organized individual to make an immediate impact on Cohere's growth.

Reporting to the Manager of Marketing Operations in India and collaborating closely with the Demand Generation team in the US, you will sit at the intersection of process, people, and technology. Your responsibilities will include campaign execution, AI-enabled workflows, KPI reporting, project coordination, and process documentation.

**What you'll do:**

* **Campaign Operations**: Support campaign setup and execution across HubSpot and Salesforce, including audience/list creation, campaign tracking, account and contact research, QA, and post-campaign reporting.
* **Marketing Automation & CRM**: Support segmentation, workflows, campaign management, data hygiene, and ongoing database maintenance across HubSpot and Salesforce.
* **Reporting & Analytics**: Build and maintain recurring marketing reports and dashboards covering campaign performance, MQAs, account engagement, pipeline contribution, and ROI using tools including Tableau and Google Sheets.
* **Data Quality & Governance**: Identify and resolve account, contact, campaign, and engagement data issues and support ongoing enrichment and data quality initiatives.
* **AI & Workflow Optimization**: Use Claude and other AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, reporting, and repetitive marketing workflows while maintaining appropriate QA.
* **Project Coordination**: Manage assigned projects and tasks in Monday.com, proactively communicate status, dependencies, and blockers, and help ensure work stays on schedule.
* **Process Documentation**: Create and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and process documentation in Confluence, while identifying opportunities to simplify and improve existing processes.

**ISMS roles and responsibilities**

* Fair understanding of Information Security practices.
* Align to the organization policies and procedures.
* Ensure to get updated with ISMS roles as assigned by the department/process heads.

**What you'll need**

**Must haves**

* Working knowledge of HubSpot and Salesforce (for activities such as list management, campaign/member management, segmentation, data hygiene, and basic reporting)
* 5 years of work experience in B2B or D2C marketing ops, martech or rev ops
* Tableau (reporting/dashboards), Claude (AI platform), Monday.com (project management), Google Workspace
* AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude to research, analyze and structure data, document processes, automate repetitive work and improve existing marketing workflows.
* Clear communication and proactive escalation of blockers
* Ability to own projects from briefing through delivery with minimal hand-holding

**Nice-to-haves**

* Able to follow established SOPs while identifying gaps, inefficiencies, data issues, and opportunities to improve or automate workflows.
* HubSpot certifications
* Demonstrated success in HubSpot and / or Salesforce management (stretch)

**Ability to commute/relocate:**

* Hyderabad (Nacharam), Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Interview Process\*:**

* Connect with Talent Acquisition

* Meet with the Hiring Manager

* Behavioral Interview(s)

* Case Study

* Interview with Senior Leadership

* Subject to change

**About Cohere Health:**

Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans' strategic goals and providers' needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.

With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end-to-end payment integrity services across pre- and post-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.

Cohere Health's innovations continue to receive industry-wide recognition. We've been recognized on TIME's World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Job Description – Sales Manager

**Celes’tile Ceramics Pvt. Ltd. | Luxury Designer Tiles, Natural Stones & Interiors**

About the Company

Celes’tile Ceramics Pvt. Ltd. specializes in premium designer tiles, natural stones, stone cladding, metal art and luxury interior surface solutions. We cater to architects, interior designers, builders, developers, contractors and premium residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

We are seeking a results-driven **Sales Manager** responsible for revenue generation, monthly target achievement, lead conversion, team performance and business development across showroom, inside sales and project sales channels.

Position Details

* **Designation:** Sales Manager
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Work Location:** Shamshabad, Hyderabad, Telangana (Near KLCC Convention Centre)
* **Work Mode:** On-site
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years in Sales / Sales Management, preferably in Tiles, Natural Stones, Building Materials, Luxury Interiors or Premium Retail.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Sales Strategy & Revenue Generation

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Take ownership of overall sales performance, revenue generation, order booking and business growth.
* Establish individual and team-wise monthly sales targets and monitor achievement against defined KPIs.
* Identify new revenue streams, market segments and opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Improve conversion rates, average order value, repeat business and customer retention.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective measures to address target shortfalls.

2. Lead Generation & Business Development

* Generate qualified leads through outbound calls, referrals, networking, market visits, digital enquiries and industry connections.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and project opportunities.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with prospective clients to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Develop new business opportunities through architects, interior designers, builders, developers, contractors and channel partners.
* Maintain an updated database of prospects, enquiries, follow-ups, quotations and sales closures.
* Explore opportunities in residential, commercial, hospitality and large-scale interior projects.

3. Architect & Interior Designer Relationship Management

* Establish and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, interior designers, design consultants and project decision-makers.
* Conduct product presentations, showroom visits, design discussions and product demonstrations.
* Understand project specifications, design preferences, quantities, budgets and delivery requirements.
* Promote the company's premium tiles, natural stones, stone cladding and related product portfolio for project specifications.
* Develop long-term business relationships to secure repeat orders, referrals and project-based sales.
* Track upcoming projects and proactively engage stakeholders during the material selection and specification stages.

4. Inside Sales & Enquiry Management

* Supervise inside sales activities, including incoming enquiries, outbound calls, lead qualification and customer follow-ups.
* Ensure timely responses to enquiries received through calls, WhatsApp, email, website and other channels.
* Monitor the sales pipeline from initial enquiry through quotation, negotiation, order confirmation and handover.
* Ensure quotations are prepared accurately and followed up systematically until closure.
* Coordinate with the CRM team to maintain enquiry records, follow-up schedules and lead status updates.
* Improve lead response time, follow-up discipline and enquiry-to-order conversion.

5. Showroom & Project Sales

* Drive showroom walk-in conversions and project-based sales for premium tiles, natural stones and interior products.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on design, application, budget and project specifications.
* Manage pricing discussions, commercial negotiations, quotation finalisation and order closures within approved commercial policies.
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehouse, Installation and Finance teams for stock availability, delivery schedules, payment follow-ups and project execution.
* Ensure a professional customer experience throughout the sales cycle.

6. Sales Team Leadership & Performance Management

* Lead, guide and monitor the sales team to achieve individual and overall monthly targets.
* Allocate sales targets, territories, leads and customer accounts based on business priorities.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews and sales meetings.
* Coach team members on product knowledge, lead generation, negotiation, customer engagement and closing techniques.
* Identify performance gaps and implement action plans to improve productivity and target achievement.
* Ensure accountability, timely reporting, disciplined follow-ups and professional conduct across the sales function.

7. Sales Reporting, MIS & CRM

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales reports covering revenue, order bookings, enquiries, lead conversion, pending quotations and target achievement.
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales pipelines, forecasts and follow-up activities in the CRM system.
* Analyse sales trends, lost opportunities, customer feedback and reasons for non-conversion.
* Submit periodic performance updates and business forecasts to Management.
* Use sales data to identify growth opportunities and improve sales effectiveness.

8. Market Intelligence & Commercial Coordination

* Monitor competitor pricing, product launches, market demand and industry trends.
* Identify potential customers, new project locations and opportunities for market expansion.
* Coordinate with Marketing for campaigns, promotional activities, lead generation and customer engagement initiatives.
* Work closely with Finance on payment terms, outstanding collections and credit approvals within company policy.
* Ensure adherence to approved pricing, discount policies and commercial procedures.

Performance Expectations & KPIs

The Sales Manager will be evaluated on the following parameters:

* Achievement of assigned monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Qualified lead generation and enquiry-to-order conversion ratio.
* New customer acquisition and architect/interior designer network development.
* Showroom sales, inside sales and project-sales performance.
* Value of confirmed orders and growth in repeat business.
* Sales pipeline health, quotation follow-ups and closure rates.
* Sales team productivity and individual target achievement.
* Accuracy and timeliness of CRM updates, MIS reports and sales forecasts.
* Customer satisfaction and coordination for timely order execution.

**Note:** Monthly revenue targets will be defined by Management based on business objectives, product categories, sales channels and market opportunities.

Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant sales experience, preferably with experience in sales management or team handling.
* Proven track record of revenue generation, lead conversion and achievement of sales targets.
* Experience in tiles, natural stones, architectural products, building materials, luxury interiors or premium retail will be preferred.
* Strong business development, negotiation, presentation and customer relationship management skills.
* Experience in inside sales, project sales, lead management and CRM systems.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, sales reporting and MIS.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to engage professionally with architects, interior designers, builders and premium customers.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings, project visits and business development.

Compensation

Compensation will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, sales achievements and overall suitability for the position. Plus incentives of 25000 Monthly Minimum

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume through the following channels:

* **Email:** hr@celestile.com | edward@celestile.com
* **WhatsApp:** +91 8008003232
* **Website:** https://www.celestile.com/contact.html

**Work Location:** In person – Shamshabad, Hyderabad, Telangana.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for experienced Marketing Manger for overseeing the decision-making process for new products, including conceptualization, prioritization, and successful market launches. Ensuring the review and implementation of pre-launch strategies and brand plans, while fostering strong relationships with key customers. Leading strategic initiatives and providing guidance to subordinates for effective product planning and execution, within the constraints of regulatory frameworks and market capabilities, to achieve continuous growth in market share and product portfolio expansion annually.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for identifying gaps in the product portfolio, analysing international trends, and proposing new product ideas based on unmet needs. Deliberating with the cross-functional team regarding the profitability of new products, and making final decisions on new product ideas from a marketing perspective.
* You will be responsible for conducting risk versus benefit analysis, discussing the merits and demerits of new product ideas with the medico-marketing team, and finalizing the prioritization of new products in consultation with the vertical head to ensure the implementation and launch of the most promising products.
* You will be responsible for reviewing go-to-market strategies, validating launch plans, and overseeing the successful implementation of strategies, as well as ensuring the effective launch of new products.
* You will be responsible for sales planning & budgeting of existing products by setting growth goals for subordinate marketing teams, deciding overall targets for the therapeutic area, and monitoring market potential to ensure consistent growth in market share.
* You will be responsible for Brand Strategy formulating of existing products by implementing brand strategies, monitoring their execution, identifying gaps, and suggesting corrective actions to strengthen brand positioning and market presence.
* You will be responsible for making decisions on initiatives to maintain customer relationships, reviewing non-product-based programs, and refining strategies based on customer feedback, especially from Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
* You will be responsible for initiating strategic activities to enhance brand presence, designing the future roadmap, and implementing initiatives through agencies after thorough evaluation and regular interaction with the strategy team.
* You will be responsible for leading and developing a team by conducting goal setting, performance appraisals, and providing mentorship, training, and development opportunities to ensure a high-performing and cohesive team environment.

 **Qualifications**

**Education Qualification:** MBA along with a graduate degree in Science stream  
  
**Minimum work experience:** 10-12years of experience in Indian Pharmaceutical Industry and experience in Product Management, launching at least one new product.  
  
**Skills & attributes**  
**Technical Skills**  

* In-depth understanding of Indian Pharmaceutical Industry,
* Understanding of diseases, therapy and relevant therapeutic areas
* Financial management skills to develop and manage budgets, allocate resources effectively, and optimize cost control for the product portfolio.
* Functional understanding of chronic market
* Scientific Knowledge of Product
* Ability to analyse market data, clinical trial results, and sales performance to inform decision-making and product portfolio strategies

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Proactive and visionary mind-set
* Strong networking skills
* Effective people management abilities
* Adaptability and change management skills
* Strategic orientation and decision-making capabilities
* Creative and ability to draw insights

 **Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  
For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

title: Product Manager
description:
Discover & define. Talk to users, understand real workflows, identify pain points, and convert ambiguous asks into clear problem statements and requirements.

AI evals. Create representative test cases and evaluation criteria for quality, relevance, reliability, latency, cost, and failure modes; use results to iterate before and after launch.

title: Senior Product Manager - APAC
description:
Join us as Senior Product Manager - APAC, where you will be responsible for the development and oversight of our loan and overdraft products across India, broader Asia and the Middle East. You will work closely with loan originators and broader stakeholders across the region, including coordinating new product approvals, performing annual product reviews, and acting as the business product owner in the region to help prioritise technology and process changes. You will also work closely with Operations and Technology on the rollout of our strategic loan platform across the region. The role will sit with our Investment Banking Origination team in Mumbai and report jointly to the Global Head of Loan Product Management and the Global Head of Loan Transformation.
  
  
**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should**
Be a strong and ambitious candidate at Vice President level with strong product management, business analysis, stakeholder management and loan product knowledge, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**

* Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to capture key requirements.
* Strong bilateral and syndicated loan product knowledge.
* Strong communication, relationship management and networking skills.
* Strong product management skills.
* Ability to capture key requirements and summarise them into management-style presentations and proposals.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive process improvements.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Good presentation and PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of process design, optimisation and ownership, with a focus on client outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to product ownership models within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and controls within lending processes.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:
  
  
  

* Contributing to and influencing policies and procedures for the function, and planning, managing and consulting on multiple complex and critical strategic projects which may be business-wide.
* Providing expert advice to business and functional management and committees to influence decisions.
* Escalating breaches of policies and procedures appropriately.
* Fostering and guiding compliance, ensuring regulations are observed and relevant processes are in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focusing on the external environment, regulators or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Maintaining broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within the relevant discipline, alongside up-to-date sector and functional knowledge and insight into external market developments and initiatives.
* Negotiating with and influencing stakeholders at a senior level, both internally and externally.
* Acting as a principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions and business divisions.
* Acting as a mandated spokesperson for the function and business division.

Job location is Mumbai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop and manage the wholesale lending products and services, collaborating with, and ensuring service standards are complied with by, business partners across the bank, including investment bankers, credit analysts, risk managers, and operations professionals, to ensure that our products meet the needs of the bank's clients and are aligned with the bank's overall strategic objectives whilst ensuring all governance, control, regulatory and legal requirements are met.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of product strategy for financial products and services offered within the wholesale division.  .
* Identification of investments opportunities and customer needs to create new products or enhance existing ones.  .
* Management of the entire product lifecycle, including product planning, development, launch, and ongoing management, including oversight of service levels.  .
* Analysis of market data to make informed decisions regarding product positioning and pricing.  .
* Assessment and management of risks associated with lending products and implement risk mitigation strategies, including the operation of and attendance to governance forums.  .
* Oversight of regulatory and technological change.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.

* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Sr. Business Innovation Manager (Hyderabad/Bangalore/Mumbai)
description:
**Department:**
Finance
  
  
**Location:**
APAC-India-Mumbai
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Business Innovation to join Align's New Business Models & Services team in APAC. This is neither a sales role nor a pure strategy role. It’s a “build-and-execute” position for someone who wants to create with urgency, can influence without authority, and gets things done without a detailed brief. Fintech fluency is a must.
  
  
This is a newly created role sitting in a small, high-visibility team in the CFO organization, tasked with transforming how Align goes to market through innovative business models, services and solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, New Business Models & Services APAC, this role sits as a core member of the India commercial leadership team.
  
  
You will be a key connector between the India market needs and our global Business Model Innovation strategy. Working closely with Align's local commercial leaders and building close partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal, you will diagnose growth blockers and design, test, and scale solutions that address them, translating market insight into scalable, revenue-generating programs. You will tweak and test existing solutions as well as identify and incubate new opportunities specific to India
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Embed yourself with the commercial team. Build trusted relationships. Become the person local leadership calls when they want to think about a problem differently.
* Run structured discovery to surface growth blockers.
* Understand existing innovation programs & priorities and figure out what they need to look like in India.
* Build business cases, develop business plans, and evaluate new business opportunities for investment by the organization.
* Design and run pilots. Iterate fast. Know when to kill something and when to double down.
* Execute with urgency. Turn validated ideas into live programs, working across internal teams and external partners to make sure what gets built gets adopted.
* Source, evaluate and manage third-party partners. Negotiate agreements. Own the relationships.
* Develop the internal materials (playbooks, training, commercial enablement) that will allow the local teams to adopt and deploy what’s been proven.
* Feed learnings back into the global innovation team so that what works in one market can be adapted and scaled elsewhere.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Strong business acumen, judgment, and maturity: you think naturally in terms of unit economics, incentive structures, and value exchange, not just features and benefits.
* Meaningful fintech experience: at least 3 years of hands-on experience in consumer lending, BNPL, payments, healthcare financing, or adjacent fintech domains. You understand how financing products are structured from both the provider and lender side, how to evaluate and negotiate with financial partners, and how to design solutions that work within the regulatory and consumer credit frameworks of India.
* Experience with iterative product or solution design: You know how to run a structured pilot, what good validation looks like, and how to make go/no-go decisions based on imperfect information.
* Ability to context-switch easily: One week you're deep in a fintech partnership negotiation, the next you're thinking of systems integrations or designing new revenue models.
* Soft power and collaboration skills: You have a track record of getting things done through your credibility, your relationships, and your ability to make people want to work with you.
* Comfort with ambiguity and independent working: This team is small, and the mandate is broad. You need to be able to prioritize and create structure where there isn't any.
* Affinity for AI: you use AI tools as a practical part of how you work: research, analysis, synthesis and building materials. You keep pushing the boundaries of how it can make you (and the company) more effective.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills:Ability to manage budget, resources and multiple workstreams simultaneously.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* 10+ years of commercial / product management / consulting experience, of which at least 3 years in fintech, with a track record of building or scaling something (a product, a program, a market), not just executing a playbook.
* Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA or equivalent a plus but not required if the experience speaks for itself.

***Nice to Have***

* Experience in medtech, healthtech or any other regulated industry, in particular working within or alongside a DSO or multi-site dental or healthcare group.
* SaaS, platform or API product management experience, particularly relevant for systems integration work.
* Experience working in an overlay or matrix organization where influence without authority is the primary operating model.

title: Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal Member Engagement
description:
**1. Position overview**

**Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal and Member Engagement**
is accountable for the IC3 membership portal, the primary channel through which members receive their membership value. The role owns the portal's technology, information architecture, content program, operational upkeep and member engagement, serving schools and counsellors, universities, and organisations (NGOs, NFPs & corporates in education/ career counseling)

**2. Key responsibilities Indicative time allocation is shown against each area. Member engagement carries the largest share, reflecting its priority.**

**2.1 Platform and technology management (20%)**

* Serve as product owner for the membership portal, maintaining a prioritised feature backlog and a quarterly release plan.
* Manage the technology vendor or internal developers against agreed service levels, including uptime, defect resolution and change requests.
* Oversee integrations with payments, email, CRM etc.

**2.2 Information architecture and user experience (15%)**

* Define and maintain the portal structure, navigation and dedicated areas for each stakeholder group.
* Ensure a mobile-first experience, with pages that load reliably on lower-bandwidth connections (if applicable).
* Apply accessibility and brand standards consistently across all pages and templates.
* Use analytics and member feedback to run at least one usability improvement per quarter.

**2.3 Content quality (25%)**

* Own a 12-month content calendar covering all three stakeholder groups, reviewed monthly.
* Publish new content at least weekly, including resources, toolkits, webinar recordings, event updates, research and member news.
* Source content from IC3 programs, conferences, partner universities, member institutions, and the content committee and manage approvals and attributions.
* Maintain a content governance policy covering ownership, review dates, archiving and quality standards.

**2.4 Operations and maintenance (10%)**

* Monitor portal health weekly, including broken links, login issues, page performance and security updates.
* Maintain accurate member records, renewal dates and access rights in coordination.
* Manage the member helpdesk for portal queries, responding within two business days.
* Ensure compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and IC3 data policies, including consent and data retention.
* Retire or refresh outdated content in a quarterly content audit.

**2.5 Member engagement (25%)**

* Design structured onboarding journeys so that every new member activates core benefits within 30 days.
* Run a recurring engagement programme of newsletters, webinars, discussion forums, polls, member spotlights and recognition.
* Segment members by type, tier and activity, and tailor communication accordingly.
* Identify inactive members through usage data and run re-engagement campaigns ahead of renewal.
* Collect member feedback through surveys at least twice a year and report findings with recommended actions.
* Build communities of practice, for example among counsellors in the same city or universities recruiting from India.

**2.6 Contribution to membership growth (5%, secondary)**

Outreach and conversion are not primary responsibilities of this role. The incumbent will support the membership team by:

* Providing portal content, case studies and demo access for outreach campaigns.
* Sharing engagement and usage insights that inform renewal and acquisition strategy.

**3. Strategic priorities for the first 12 months**

The incumbent is expected to advance the following priorities.

* **Run the portal on data.**
   Establish an engagement dashboard within the first 90 days and use it to steer content, renewals and upgrades.
* **Build for scale.**
   Prepare processes, content and support to serve approximately 4,000 member institutions, the 12-month target in the membership plan.

4.
**Qualifications and competencies**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; a qualification in instructional design, educational content design, or career & college counseling is an advantage.
* 4 to 7 years of experience managing a learning portal or online community, including at least 2 years in an ownership role.
* Hands-on proficiency with content management or membership platforms (for example WordPress, a membership plugin, or a learning management system). Coding is not required.
* Experience managing technology vendors, defining requirements and running user acceptance testing.
* Working knowledge of web analytics, email platforms and CRM tools.
* Excellent written English and strong editorial judgement.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver a content calendar on schedule.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the education sector, particularly school counseling, university admissions or international education.
* Familiarity with K-12 and the higher education landscape.

**Core competencies**

* Member-centric mindset and a service orientation.
* Analytical thinking and data-informed decision making.
* Attention to detail and quality.
* Stakeholder management across internal teams and external partners.
* Initiative, ownership and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

**5. Key performance indicators**

* Member onboarding
* Engagments
* Content quality & stakeholder relevance
* Member satisfaction & Renewals
* Service

title: Sr. Product & Automation Lead
description:
**Job Title: Sr. Product & Automation Lead**

**Company:**
Scale100x.ai by Expertrons

**Location:**
Mumbai (Work from Office)

**Compensation:**
Ranging from ₹12 LPA to 20 LPA (Fixed + Variable) + ESOPs + milestone-based compensation growth

**Experience:**
5+ years

**About Scale100x.ai**

Scale100x.ai is the world's first AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner expansion. Built by the founders of Expertrons, we are serial entrepreneurs and IIT Bombay alumni who have built and exited ventures and scaled 300+ franchise networks across industries.

We partner with high-potential brands to:

* Build 100+ offline outlets/partners per year
* Use AI agents to supercharge sales and marketing execution
* Improve profitability through data-driven operations
* Support fundraising, investor relations and IPO readiness

In the last year we've driven scale for brands across EV, F&B, Salon, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more, including helping one brand close a $5.4M Series A. Our sales engine runs on high-volume, WhatsApp-first lead flow, and we are rebuilding it to be AI-native.

**The Role**

We are moving from LeadSquared to an AI-native CRM and want to put AI agents at the center of how we sell, follow up, onboard and report. You will own that transformation end to end: choosing the platform, migrating without losing a single lead, and building the agents and automations that run on top of it, across our different verticals.

This is a builder's role. You will work directly with the founders, and you should be as comfortable in a CRM admin panel or an n8n workflow as in a leadership review.

**What You'll Own**

**1. CRM selection and migration (LeadSquared → AI-native CRM)**

* Evaluate AI-native CRM options against our needs (cost, WhatsApp and telephony support, agent capabilities, integrations) and make a clear recommendation.
* Plan and run the migration: data cleanup and mapping, pipeline redesign, integrations, cutover and parallel run.
* Drive team adoption so that data quality and usage improve after the switch, not just the tooling.

**2. AI agents and automation across verticals**

* Map the lead-to-onboarding journey (enquiry, qualification, commercials, agreement, onboarding) and identify what agents can own and where a human must stay in the loop.
* Build and deploy agents and automations for lead qualification, follow-ups, call summaries, CRM updates, reminders and reporting.
* Adapt and reuse these workflows across verticals such as EV, F&B, Salon, Retail and EdTech, and over time package them for client brands.
* Measure every automation on time saved, response time and conversion impact.

**3. Integrations and systems**

* Connect the CRM with WhatsApp Business API, telephony/IVR, e-sign, email, finance and internal tools using APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms.
* Own reliability: monitoring, fallbacks and documentation.

**4. Analytics and ROI**

* Build dashboards for pipeline health, leakage by stage, agent performance and revenue outcomes.
* Build the business case for each initiative and report results to the founders.

**5. Ownership and execution**

* Run projects from problem definition to rollout with clear milestones and accountability.
* Work with sales, operations, product and tech teams, and flag risks and dependencies early.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years in CRM implementation, business systems, revenue operations, product operations or automation-led roles.
* Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CRM (LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), including at least one full data migration and cutover.
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-based automations in production. Please share a workflow you built and its outcome.
* Fluency with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar).
* Experience integrating WhatsApp Business API and telephony/IVR into a sales workflow.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define metrics, build dashboards and quantify ROI.
* Ability to work independently with founders and cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI-native CRM platforms.
* Background in high-volume, lead-driven businesses such as franchising, edtech, real estate or D2C.
* Exposure to product strategy or product operations, and to financial modelling.
* Startup, consulting or SaaS experience.

**What We Expect**

* **Ownership:**
  you drive initiatives without continuous supervision.
* **Execution:**
  you move from recommendation to live implementation.
* **Business sense:**
  you connect every system and automation to a measurable outcome.
* **Structured problem-solving:**
  you frame the problem, test quickly and iterate.

**Who Should Apply**

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

title: Manager – Customer Experience
description:
* Customer Experience Strategy & Economics
* Build and own the CX scorecard beyond NPS: OTIF (on-time-in-full), CPKO, resolution speed, escalation

rate, repeat-purchase behavior by customer tier — and tie every one of them to a revenue or retention
  
  
number leadership can act on.
  
  

* Quantify the cost and reorder impact of every major CX failure mode (damaged/missing items, delivery

issues, refund delays) and use it to prioritize fixes by rupee impact, not by ticket volume.
  
  

* Own resolution-policy decisions (e.g., redispatch vs. refund) with hard data on which choice actually

keeps a customer.
  
  
Data-Driven Program Management
  
  

* Be comfortable pulling and validating your own data (SQL, BigQuery or equivalent) rather than waiting

on a dashboard someone else maintains.
  
  

* Run root-cause analysis that survives scrutiny — right-sized samples, corrected logic, honest callouts

when two systems disagree, and a clear line between “verified” and “a model.”
  
  

* Segment customers by lifetime value and behavior (tiers, first-time vs. repeat, state/geography) to find

where the highest-leverage interventions are, not just the loudest complaints.
  
  

* AI &Automation
* Own the chatbot/IVR stack end to end: containment rate, cost per conversation, and — critically —

instrument what today isn't measured (does “closed” actually mean “resolved”?).
  
  

* Identify and build the next generation of AI-driven CX: proactive delivery-risk alerts, automated win-

back campaigns for lapsing customers, smarter self-serve flows — always backed by a quantified
  
  
opportunity size.
  
  

* Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (chat, IVR, call-scoring platforms) on total cost and actual

capability, not the sales deck.
  
  
Team & Operating Model
  
  

* Build and lead a small, accountable team across three areas: CX Tools & Vendor Management, CX

Metrics & Voice of Customer, and Data & Automation.
  
  

* Replace informal, single-point-of-failure ownership with clear RACI, documented processes, and a team

that can operate without you in the room.
  
  

* Run structured win-back and retention initiatives (e.g., outbound campaigns for customers who've gone

quiet at 90/180 days) with proper reason-code diagnosis, not just reminder blasts.
  
  

* Voice of the Customer
* Personally read and act on customer feedback — the good, the near-miss, and the genuinely angry.

Every customer who takes the time to write in is a free, high-signal data point; treat it that way.
  
  

* Turn qualitative complaints into structured, quantified problems the business can prioritize.

title: Associate Product Manager - Supply Chain (Logistics B2B)
description:
**About The Team**
Purplle’s Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own the product charter for B2B logistics, covering how we move goods to retailers, distributors, modern trade, marketplaces, and institutional buyers, as well as stock movement between our plants and warehouses. You will work at the intersection of product, logistics operations, and finance systems, turning the needs of operations and business stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role with end to end ownership of the B2B logistics roadmap and its business impact. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and logistics partners to deliver it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**B2B Logistics Product Ownership**

* Own the product roadmap for B2B logistics flows, including customer orders, stock transfers between locations, and B2B returns, prioritised by business impact.
* Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
* Lead initiatives such as automatic carrier enablement for B2B shipments and the CPG forward and returns flow, from problem definition to rollout and adoption.
* Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
* Maintain a separate B2B layer for carrier and logistics partner integrations, and coordinate with the B2C logistics owner on anything shared.

**Delivery Reliability and Network Performance**

* Own delivery promise reliability for B2B orders, defining and tracking the metrics that show whether commitments to customers are met.
* Improve network cost, capacity, and delivery performance across carriers and lanes through structured product changes.
* Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground and define improvements that scale.

**Compliance and ERP (SAP)**

* Own B2B compliance flows such as e-way bills and invoicing, and keep them aligned with SAP.
* Support integration and data consistency between the warehouse systems, logistics partners, and SAP for sales, stock movement, and returns.
* Work with engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.

**Governance, Analytics, and Stakeholders**

* Drive operations governance and risk reduction by defining clear processes, escalation paths, and checks that prevent repeat failures.
* Use logistics data and dashboards to track performance, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
* Delegate and escalate effectively, and push repeatable manual work toward automation.
* Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to operations, business, and engineering stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills And Requirements**

* 1+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply-chain technology role.
* BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
* Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Working understanding of ERP systems such as SAP and how sales, invoicing, and compliance data flow through them.
* Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to logistics, 3PL, carrier management, or B2B supply chain operations.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
* Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
* Familiarity with e-way bill and GST compliance in the Indian supply chain context.
* Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems or quick-commerce operations.

**What You Will Gain**

* End to end ownership of the B2B logistics charter, from roadmap to measurable impact.
* A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
* Deep exposure to carrier integrations, compliance flows, and SAP across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
* A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: APM/PM - FMCG Supply & Demand Planning
description:

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply
  
  
planning products.
  
  

* Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.
  
  

* Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line
  
  
and on how fast our brands can grow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Roadmap & Execution: Set a prioritised roadmap with the Senior Product Manager and own

delivery.
  
  

* Demand Planning: Build demand forecasting, sensing and planning at range, channel, product

and region level, including new product forecasting.

* Zero-to-one ownership of demand and supply planning products for a fast-growing FMCG

title: Technology Product Manager – Design, Construction, Quality, Safety & Strategy
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)**
At the Godrej Industries Group, we serve over 1.4 billion people globally through a diverse portfolio of businesses, united by our purpose of Crafting tomorrow. With revenues of USD 7.2 billion in FY26 and a market capitalisation of USD 19 billion as of 31 March 2026, we operate across FMCG, real estate, financial services, agriculture, and chemicals. We are the leading player in India across several business categories, including residential real estate, animal feed, crude palm oil, oleochemicals, household insecticides, hair colour, and air care.
  
  
We are committed to building a more sustainable future through our Good & Green programme, with ambitions of net-zero operations by 2035 and responsible supply chains by 2047. In 2025, Godrej Consumer Products and Godrej Properties were both ranked number one globally in their respective categories on the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Sustainability Indices.
  
  
www.godrejindustries.com
  
  
**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
At Godrej Properties, part of the Godrej Industries Group, we are driven by a singular purpose: crafting joy. Over 100,000 families have found a home with us, making us India’s largest residential developer by both value and volume of homes sold.
  
  
Our approach is anchored in thoughtful design, sustainability, thriving communities, and uncompromising quality. As of December 2025, we were ranked the number one real estate company worldwide on both the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Sustainability Indices and the Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark.
  
  
www.godrejproperties.com
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Domain Champion & Front Door for Technology**

* Act as the single accountable point of contact for all technology applications, platforms and tools within Design, Construction, Quality, Safety & Strategy.
* Build deep domain and technical knowledge of the applications, integrations and data flows supporting the function.
* Own and maintain the application landscape map, roadmap and lifecycle plan for the domain.
* Serve as the trusted technology advisor to the function head and business stakeholders in the domain.

**Demand Management & Prioritisation**

* Manage the end-to-end demand funnel for the domain — intake, qualification, business case validation and prioritisation.
* Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, prioritised product/technology backlogs.
* Balance run-the-business (support, enhancements) and change-the-business (new initiatives) demand within capacity constraints.
* Facilitate governance forums to align stakeholders on priority calls and trade-offs.

**Delivery Orchestration & Quality**

* Orchestrate delivery across internal teams, vendors/SIs and platform teams to ensure committed timelines and quality are met.
* Track delivery milestones, dependencies and blockers, and drive resolution with delivery teams.
* Ensure adherence to defined SDLC, testing, security, UAT and release management standards prior to go-live.
* Own post-go-live stabilisation, adoption tracking and continuous improvement of solutions in the domain.

**Design, Construction, Quality, Safety & Strategy**

* Own the technology roadmap for design management (BIM/CAD collaboration), construction management, site progress monitoring, quality and safety (EHS) systems and strategic/business planning tools.
* Partner with Design, Construction, Quality, Safety and Strategy leadership to digitise project execution, quality audits and safety compliance workflows.
* Ensure integration between design, construction management, quality/safety and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, project management platforms) for real-time project visibility.
* Drive adoption of site digitisation tools (e.g., drones, IoT sensors, mobile inspection apps) to improve construction quality and safety outcomes.
* Support strategy teams with technology-enabled planning, MIS and decision-support tools.

**Escalation Management**

* Serve as the first point of escalation for technical/application failures, outages or performance issues impacting the domain.
* Drive root-cause analysis with technical teams and ensure timely resolution and permanent fixes.
* Maintain a risk and issue log for the domain, and proactively flag risks before they impact business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management, Communication & Governance**

* Own and publish regular dashboards/status reports on demand, delivery progress, risks and issues to function heads and leadership.
* Run periodic governance reviews (steering committees, sprint reviews, monthly business reviews) with key stakeholders.
* Manage dependencies across other domains, enterprise technology teams (infrastructure, security, data, ERP) and external vendors.

Build strong working relationships with business leaders to ensure technology is seen as a trusted enabler of business outcomes.
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline (mandatory).
* MBA or equivalent management qualification is preferred from a premier B-school.

**Experience**

* 8–10 years of experience, including experience leading technology delivery for design/construction/quality/safety functions, with proven stakeholder and vendor management at a leadership level.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to influence business and technical audiences.
* Sound understanding of product management, agile delivery and vendor/SI management practices.
* Ability to manage a demand funnel and prioritise competing requirements under constraint.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable driving root-cause analysis on technical issues.
* Experience with dashboarding/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Jira, Confluence) for governance reporting.
* Real estate or D2C/BFSI domain exposure is an advantage.

**Work Experience**
8–10 years
  
  
**Benefits**
**Be an equal parent**
Childcare benefits for the birthing parent, commissioning parent (in case of surrogacy) or adoptive parent, and their partners
  
  

* 6 months of paid leave for primary caregivers, flexible work options on return for primary caregivers
* 2 months paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Caregiver travel for primary caregivers to bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel

Coverage for childbirth and fertility treatment
  
  
**No place for discrimination at Godrej**

* Gender-neutral anti-harassment policy
* Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses
* Coverage for gender reassignment surgery and hormone replacement therapy
* Community partnerships and advocacy
* Persons with Disability (PwD) care

**We Are Selfish About Your Wellness**

* Elder care for those who might need to extend support to senior family members
* Preventative healthcare support
* Outpatient Department (OPD) coverage, including vaccinations, dental, vision, etc.
* Uncapped sick leave
* Flexible work options, including remote working and part-time work
* Mental wellness and self-care programmes, resources and counselling

**Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way**

title: Senior Manager - Fixed Income, Alternatives and Structured Products
description:

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Vice President, Product Manager - Fixed Income, Structured Products & Alternatives**
**Division:**
International Wealth & Premier Banking – Wealth Management
  
  
**Entity:**
HSBC India
  
  
**Role purpose**
The role will lead the investment product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth business.
  
  
The role will translate market opportunities, client needs and regulatory developments into a compelling, commercially viable and well-governed product shelf. This means ensuring that products are relevant for clients, practical for relationship managers to distribute and sustainable for the bank.
  
  
Working closely with Markets, Investment Advisory, Risk, Compliance, Legal and regional and global Wealth teams, the role will provide end-to-end ownership of product strategy, governance, commercialization and lifecycle management.
  
  
**Key Priorities Include**

* Accelerating the growth of Fixed Income Products, Alternative Investments and Structured Products.
* Integrating GIFT City offerings into the core investment proposition.
* Establishing Fixed Income as a central component of every relevant advisory conversation.
* Maintaining a high standard of product governance, suitability and risk management.
* The successful candidate will combine deep investment expertise with commercial judgement, disciplined execution and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product strategy and shelf architecture
* Define and execute the product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth segments.
* Own the frameworks for product due diligence, approval, whitelisting, shelf sizing, review and retirement.
* Assess the shelf regularly to identify product gaps, client suitability considerations and opportunities to improve portfolio coverage.
* Maintain the right balance between product breadth, client relevance, governance requirements and commercial viability.
* Ensure the shelf reflects the needs and risk profiles of different client segments.
* Fixed Income
* Build and strengthen the Fixed Income proposition across government securities, corporate bonds and structured credit.
* Translate views on interest rates, yield curves and credit cycles into practical investment solutions.
* Develop propositions that support income generation, yield enhancement, diversification and capital preservation.
* Improve product availability, pricing, execution and servicing so that Fixed Income can be incorporated naturally into client portfolios.
* Partner with Investment Advisory and distribution teams to strengthen the role of Fixed Income in portfolio construction and client conversations.
* Structured Products
* Develop structured investment solutions designed to provide yield enhancement, capital protection or targeted market exposure.
* Work with Structuring, Treasury and Markets teams to create products aligned to defined client segments and investment objectives
* Evaluate underlying assets, payoff structures, liquidity, counterparty exposure and other relevant risks.
* Maintain a robust and transparent product pipeline, supported by appropriate approvals and governance.
* Ensure product documentation, client communication and distribution materials clearly explain features, risks and expected outcomes.
* Alternative Investments
* Grow the Alternative Investments shelf across Portfolio Management Services, Alternative Investment Funds and private-market strategies.
* Identify and assess investment managers based on track record, investment philosophy, process, risk management, governance and operational capability.
