title: Director of Product
description:
**Director of Product**

AI Cloud and Orchestration, Velocis Platform

**Reports to**
Chief Product Officer

**Location**
Mumbai

**Function**
Product Leadership, AI Infrastructure (Velocis)

**Why this role, why now?**

Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.

Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go-to-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.

You will move between whiteboarding high-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.

**What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap**

• Co-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off end to end.

• Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day-0 and Day-1 user journey.

• Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.

**Team and craft**

• Lead, mentor and hold accountable a team of four or more product managers across the core Velocis modules.

• Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.

• Coach high-potential talent and step in where a track needs lift.

**Enterprise commercials and offtake**

• Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.

• Act as executive product sponsor for key Indian enterprise accounts.

• Turn bespoke offtake and enterprise requirements into platform capabilities the wider base can use, without fragmenting the core codebase. This is one of the hardest and most important parts of the role.

**Platform economics**

• Own core product economics with the CPO, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin, tenant density and feature monetisation.

• Treat onboarding time to value and expansion as first-order outcomes, since Velocis revenue behaves as consumption rather than subscription and expansion is the dominant growth lever.

**What you bring?**

• Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large-scale cloud or general-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.

• A track record of shipping complex B2B infrastructure products from concept to meaningful revenue scale.

• Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.

• Working command of multi-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air-gapped clusters and customer-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.

• Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.

**How you work?**

• You zoom out to market positioning and a two-year horizon, and zoom in to specifications, telemetry and the granular detail, without losing either.

• You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.

• You are a low-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.

• You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.

**Your first 90 days**

• Take full ownership of the roadmap and prioritisation across the PM tracks, with clear ownership lines in place.

• Land the near-term Velocis milestones with clean telemetry on adoption and stability.

• Establish a working rhythm with engineering, operations and go-to-market that delivers predictably.

**Success in the first 6 to 12 months**

• Roadmap predictability and release velocity, with the Velocis milestones shipped and instrumented for adoption and reliability.

• Movement on the economics you own, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin and tenant density.

• Time to production for offtake customers and time to value in onboarding, both trending down.

• Expansion on named enterprise and offtake accounts.

• A high-functioning product team with clear ownership and a rising bar.

title: Senior Manager - NPI
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Own the end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from design transfer to stable commercial production. Lead cross-functional stage-gate reviews, ensuring products progress only when readiness criteria for cost, quality, supply, and operational execution are met, delivering successful launches on time and in full.
  
  
This role provides leadership and governance for the NPI portfolio, owning launch outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and stage-gate decisions. While the NPI Planner manages operational execution across materials, capacity, builds, and inventory, this role is accountable for overall NPI success and commercialization readiness.
  
  
**Key Tasks**
NPI process ownership
  
  

* Define, run and continuously improve the stage-gate NPI process (concept, design, prototype, pilot, ramp, release to mass production), including gate criteria, templates and governance.
* Run the NPI portfolio: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
* Own the handover from Technology to Operations and the transition to steady-state manufacturing.

Cross-functional evaluation and gate decisions
  
  

* Chair NPI gate reviews with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing Engineering, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial.
* Assess each product for manufacturability, test and quality readiness, supplier readiness, compliance, cost and launch risk.
* Make or escalate go / no-go / conditional-go recommendations with documented risks and mitigations.

NPI delivery
  
  

* Own schedule, budget, scope and risk for each project; maintain the master NPI plan and critical path.
* Drive risk management and resolve cross-functional conflicts quickly.
* Manage contract manufacturers and key suppliers for pilot builds and ramp, where applicable.

Cost, quality and supply readiness
  
  

* Agree target cost, yield and first-pass quality with Finance, Quality and Manufacturing; track the gap to target at every gate.
* Ensure the NPI Planner’s material, capacity and build plans support each gate date and launch volume.
* Ensure change control, BOM and documentation are complete and released before production.

Lead NPI Portfolio & Performance Management
  
  

* Maintain the consolidated NPI roadmap and publish dashboards covering project health, milestone adherence, launch readiness, action closure, and post-launch performance.

Lead Export Readiness for NPI PLanning
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment and close coordination with Export teams to establish inventory strategies, distribution networks, capacity plans, and market-specific supply requirements for successful export launches.
* Govern the transition of NPI projects into business-as-usual export operations, ensuring seamless handover, supply continuity, and service reliability across all destination markets.

Leadership and stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the NPI team; set objectives and manage performance.
* Report on project status, risks and decisions to senior leadership and the executive team.
* Capture lessons learned after each launch and feed them back into the process.

**Experience Required**

* Graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage
* 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience with strong exposure to NPI, Planning, Product Lifecycle Management, Project Management, or Supply Chain Transformation.
* Proven experience in leading cross-functional NPI, commercialization, innovation, or product-transition programs.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, S&OP, and phase-in/phase-out processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Strong project management, risk management, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent launches.

Privacy

We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

title: Senior S2P Transformation SME (Techno-Functional)
description:
**Job Description: Senior S2P Transformation SME (Techno-Functional)**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Hybrid (on-site workshops and remote engagement)
  
**Experience:**
10+ years
  
**Engagement Type:**
Contractual – 6 months
  
**Industry Preference:**
Manufacturing, Building Materials, Chemicals, Industrial Products

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a senior Source-to-Pay (S2P) transformation expert to support the validation of an AI-first S2P platform implementation for a large, multi-entity manufacturing organisation.

The individual will work with business and technology stakeholders to validate the proposed future-state procurement processes, assess the platform design, and ensure that the solution reflects real-world procurement requirements across direct and indirect procurement, imports, and complex manufacturing supply chains.

This is a
**validation and design assurance role**
, not a greenfield implementation or training assignment. The ideal candidate will bring strong procurement domain expertise and the ability to challenge, validate, and sign off on the proposed operating model and platform design.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **S2P Design Validation:**
  Review and validate the proposed Source-to-Pay process design, workflows, business rules, and platform configuration against business requirements.
* **Procurement Expertise:**
  Assess direct and indirect procurement processes, including raw material sourcing, imports, supplier management, purchasing, and procurement operations in a manufacturing environment.
* **Operating Model Assessment:**
  Validate the proposed division of responsibilities between the business and Global Business Services (GBS), identifying activities that should remain business-owned versus those suitable for centralisation or outsourcing.
* **Manufacturing Supply Chain Context:**
  Evaluate procurement scenarios involving industrial raw materials, chemicals, international sourcing, import/export processes, and complex supplier ecosystems.
* **Techno-Functional Assessment:**
  Bridge procurement business requirements and platform capabilities, ensuring the proposed workflows and automation adequately address operational realities.
* **Gap and Risk Identification:**
  Identify missing scenarios, process gaps, design assumptions, control weaknesses, and potential implementation risks; recommend practical corrective actions.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work with procurement leaders, process owners, transformation teams, and technology partners during design reviews and workshops.
* **Sign-off and Recommendations:**
  Provide structured feedback, document findings, and support business validation and sign-off of the future-state design before production rollout.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience**

* 10+ years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on experience in procurement and S2P transformation.
* Strong expertise across
  **end-to-end Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay**
  , particularly the procurement stages preceding invoice processing and payment.
* Proven experience in both direct and indirect procurement.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing procurement, including raw materials, supplier sourcing, purchasing operations, and complex supply chains.
* Experience with international sourcing, imports, exports, and associated procurement processes.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing or validating procurement process designs, target operating models, workflows, or procurement platform implementations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into functional process and system requirements and challenge technology-led designs where necessary.
* Strong understanding of GBS/shared services operating models and procurement centralisation.
* Excellent stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, analytical, and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in manufacturing, building materials, glass, construction chemicals, industrial products, or related sectors.
* Prior involvement in a large-scale S2P transformation, procurement automation, or enterprise procurement platform rollout.
* Exposure to AI-enabled procurement platforms, digital procurement solutions, and workflow automation.
* Experience working across multiple business entities, geographies, or complex operating models.
* Experience with platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, SAP S/4HANA procurement, or comparable S2P solutions.

The ideal candidate is a
**procurement transformation practitioner who understands how procurement actually operates in a manufacturing business**
. They should have sufficient techno-functional knowledge to assess whether a proposed platform design is fit for purpose, identify overlooked business scenarios, and confidently challenge design decisions.

Candidates with backgrounds as Procurement Transformation Leads, S2P Process Owners, Procurement Excellence Leaders, or senior procurement SMEs are particularly relevant.

* Candidates whose experience is predominantly Accounts Payable (AP), invoice processing, or finance operations.
* Pure technology implementation consultants without deep procurement domain knowledge.
* Generalist project managers or transformation consultants who cannot independently validate procurement workflows.
* Candidates with only indirect procurement experience and no exposure to direct procurement or manufacturing supply chains.
* Junior functional consultants who require significant guidance to assess process design.

title: GTM Architect
description:
**Lloyd’s Register**
**Location: Mumbai, India**
**What We’re Looking For**
We are looking for a strategic GTM Architecture & Client Data professional who can bridge business, technology and data to deliver scalable, commercially effective solutions. Combining solid Salesforce experience, systems thinking and data governance capability, you will play a key role in shaping LR’s GTM architecture, improving client data quality and enabling more connected, efficient and insight-driven Marketing and Commercial operations. **What We Offer You**
The opportunity to work for an organization that has a clear sense of purpose, is values-based and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programmes.
  
  
A full-time permanent role
  
  
**The role**

* Design and coordinate the evolution of LR’s marketing and go-to-market (GTM) architecture, creating scalable, secure and commercially effective technology solutions.
* Shape the target-state GTM environment across Salesforce, Account Engagement and connected platforms, including system dependencies, integration patterns, data flows and technical standards.
* Develop and manage the marketing technology roadmap, business requirements and prioritised delivery backlog, aligned to the strategic direction set by the Head of Marketing Operations.

* Establish data definitions, ownership, validation rules and governance processes, while enhancing account hierarchies, identity resolution, segmentation and data stewardship practices.

* Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Commercial Excellence, CTIO, Reporting & Insights teams and external partners to deliver technology and data solutions that improve decision-making and commercial performance.

**What You Bring**

* Solid experience in GTM architecture, Salesforce, Revenue Operations, Marketing Technology or business systems within a B2B environment.
* Practical knowledge of Salesforce data structures, objects, workflows, automation and security.
* Experience with Account Engagement (formerly Pardot) or a comparable marketing automation platform.
* Experience designing system architectures, data models, integrations or scalable technical solutions.
* Understanding of lead, contact, account, opportunity and campaign management processes.
* Experience improving data quality, governance, validation, identity resolution and stewardship.

* Experience managing delivery with technology teams, consultants or implementation partners.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, automation and event-driven concepts.

* Is keen to take accountability and ownership for delivering customer needs
* Is able to self-manage and prioritize tasks towards meeting goals

* Is motivated and willing to take initiative
* Communicates in a structured way and has ability to present technical ideas in user-friendly language
* Displays a team spirit, particularly in a multicultural environment

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution

* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi-workstream delivery programs ($5M+/year in professional services revenue) end-to-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
* MBA, or 6+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. title: Associate Technical Project Manager - Client Delivery
description:
About us:

icogz is an industry leader in enterprise-grade AI, revolutionizing business operations with its innovative Aryabot™ Neuro-Symbolic AI engine and Autonomous Intelligence Architecture (AIA™). Designed to provide real-time AI-powered insights, icogz empowers organizations to make data-driven decisions and enable intelligent automation across all departments. By democratizing access to advanced data analytics, icogz bridges the gap between complex data insights and actionable strategies, allowing every team to operate smarter and faster. With a unified view of enterprise data and over 200 proprietary algorithms, icogz is pioneering the future of business intelligence and decision-making.

Role Overview

* We are looking for a Technical Project Manager who can sit comfortably on both sides of the table — technical enough to hold their own with engineering and data teams, and polished enough to be the primary point of contact for clients through the life of a project. This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination-only role. You will own timelines, scope, quality, and the client relationship on the projects assigned to you. Key responsibilitiesProject deliveryOwn end-to-end delivery for assigned projects — planning, resourcing, sprint/milestone tracking, risk management, and go-live.
* Translate client requirements into clear, technically sound scope documents, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with engineering, data, design, and QA teams to sequence work, unblock dependencies, and hold delivery dates.
* Maintain project documentation: project plans, RAID logs, status trackers, change requests, and release notes.
* Track effort against estimates and flag scope creep, resourcing gaps, or timeline risks early and in writing.
* Client servicing Act as the day-to-day point of contact for clients across all assigned projects.
* Run status calls, demos, walkthroughs, and review meetings; circulate minutes and action items.
* Translate technical constraints into business language for clients, and client expectations into actionable briefs for internal teams.

Required skills and experience

* Hands-on with project management and collaboration tools — Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Trello, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Strong written communication: crisp emails, clear documentation, well-structured status reports.

Good to have

* Exposure to data analytics, business intelligence, marketing technology, or AI/ML-led projects.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across creative, media, and technology functions.
* Experience managing offshore or distributed teams.

What We Offer· Direct ownership of client relationships and delivery outcomes from day one — this is a visible role with real decision-making authority, not a layer in a reporting chain.· Exposure to AI, analytics, and emerging technology projects across a diverse client portfolio, with the scope to shape how new tools are adopted internally.· The breadth of a multi-entity group — opportunities to collaborate across technology, creative, and media teams and to grow beyond a single functional track.

To Apply: Please share your resume to hr@icogz.com

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Product Designer, Flights & Accommodations**
At Priceline, our mission is simple: to be the best travel dealmakers in the world. As part of Booking Holdings (alongside Booking.com, Agoda, Kayak, and OpenTable). Our Product Design team takes the stress out of travel booking, turning it into simple, intuitive experiences traveller’s love using. As a Senior Product Designer for Flights & Accommodations, you won’t just be pushing pixels; you’ll be the architect of the traveller’s journey, turning ambitious ideas into high-performing reality.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
Travel is inherently complex. Using our product shouldn’t be. At Priceline, real-world user data guides our design choices, and AI is in every part of our workflow, so you’ll get from early concept to testable experience faster than ever. That leaves your time for core UX: uncovering insights, architecting seamless flows, and solving hard product problems. If you’re a strategic, tech-forward designer who loves untangling hard problems, actively experiments with emerging tools, and pairs that speed with an exacting eye for quality and taste, this role was built for you. This is a senior seat with serious ownership. Flights & Accommodations are two of our flagship products, and you won’t just be polishing a screen inside it; you’ll own an entire end-to-end journey.
  
  
**Craft Seamless Experiences**
**In this role, you will get to:**

* Design Holistic Journeys: Own an end-to-end journey within Flights & Accommodations, across the several teams that touch it, and make it hold together on responsive web, iOS, and Android. You’ll go from problem framing to high-fidelity prototypes and specs, designing the hard parts, not just the happy path.
* Master the Details: A sharp eye for hierarchy, and a talent for making dense pages feel light. You visibly raise the quality bar in your area, and you know when breaking a pattern is the right call and can defend it.
* Pioneer AI-Powered Workflows: Use AI tools (we use Claude) throughout your process so your throughput is genuinely different: a testable prototype in hours rather than a sprint. Check everything it gives you, and own every final UX decision you ship.

**Collaborate & Influence**

* Be the Connective Tissue: Turn a vague request into a clear problem, and get Product and Engineering agreed on it before you start designing. You’ll know which constraints are real and which are assumed, and bring Engineering in early enough to shape the work.
* Champion Quality: Run critique that makes other people’s work stronger, not just different, and hold the bar from concept through final build. You’ll sort out disagreements between Product and Engineering rather than waiting for someone else to.

**Listen to the Traveler**

* Uncover Insights: Write the research plan for your area and partner with our researchers as a peer rather than filing a request. You’ll read the numbers and the interviews together as a pair.
* Advocate for the User: Turn research findings into meaningful product changes, ensuring the "voice of the customer" is the loudest voice in the room. You’ll decide what a traveler needs to know and when, and cut the copy that serves the business rather than the customer.

**Scale the Vision**

* Evolve the System: Contribute patterns to Horizon properly, with their states, variants, accessibility notes, and reasoning, and then get other teams actually using them. So every team can build faster on shared standards.
* Iterate with Data: Help design the test, not just the screen in it. You’ll bring the hypothesis, the metric that should move, the metric that mustn’t get worse, and what result would make you drop the idea.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience in Product/UX design, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-step digital products, including at least one project where AI was materially part of how you worked.
* Hands-on with modern AI workflows: You use AI across your design lifecycle and can show us where, in the files: what you generated, what you overrode, and one thing it got plausibly wrong that you caught.
* Comfortable Being Measured: You’re at home in an experimentation culture. You form a hypothesis before you ship, you know what a guardrail metric is for, and you’d rather be proven wrong in two weeks than go unchallenged for a year.
* Problem-Framing Over Problem-Solving: You don’t just design screens; you decide which problem is worth designing for, get your partners aligned on it, and turn down work that won’t change anything.
* Influence Without Authority: You change minds by building the demo, bringing the proof, and picking the moment. You can lose an argument without sulking and come back with better evidence.
* Accessibility and Real-World Design: You design for edge cases as a matter of course: screen readers, low connectivity, high-stress travel. You catch accessibility problems in other people’s work during critique.
* Systems Thinking in Figma: Deeply fluent in Figma, thinking natively in tokens, variants, and component architecture so design decisions scale across platforms.
* Distributed by Default: You work well with partners in other offices and time zones, write things down, and keep a problem moving without needing everyone in the room.
* You are a relentless advocate for the customer, ensuring their needs shape our product delivery.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

**Revvity**

Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity.

**Ready to RiseUp?**

Through Revvity's RiseUp Internship Program, students and recent graduates gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and build skills for future success. With dedicated support and opportunities to learn, collaborate, and grow, our interns make an impact from day one. Click here to learn more

**Job Application Process**

1) Review the Job Description in detail

**2) Complete the mandatory questionnaire**https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/agdKBU4dTM (opens in new window)

3) Submit the application on Workday

  
  

Only candidates who complete the questionnaire and apply for Job on workday will be considered for further evaluation.

  
  

Revvity is looking for a Product Manager Intern.

About you:

You have a curious nature and keep abreast of new developments or ideas gaining momentum in the business. You want to know how and why people use technology and understand how they imagine better ways of working. You interject yourselves into the conversation to ask questions that help others clarify any problems, assumptions and risks. You are outgoing, a people’s person, can put people at ease and are easy to talk to. You are curious and want to help your team answer their toughest questions by learning from others and working together.

Requirements:

* Strong interest in artificial intelligence and its practical applications in business

* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and AI technologies

* Engaging with UX designers, UX researchers, developers and stakeholders to define and document clear product requirements

* Prioritizing and planning features based on company and stakeholder priorities and business values

* Distilling very technical concepts to business colleagues and vice versa

* Presenting information to others (e.g., to the design team/business stakeholders)

* Define and track success metrics

* Work with software engineering teams on bug triage and requirements

* You’re open to rolling up your sleeves and doing a bit of end-user research and testing as needed, to make the team and product a success

* Ability to effectively communicate in both oral and written English

Some of the other things we care about:

* Worked previously on an AI based product either as a PM or developer

* You are able to empathize with our end-users and are interested in doing some research.

* Are eager to learn from your team and others. We value making each other successful!

Using the “OCEAN” model which stands for Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism, we’re looking for the following personality traits:

Openness – The ability to take on new challenges and learn new things.

Conscientiousness – The ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work.

Extraversion – The ability to communicate directly with customers and users, and to present your work clearly and effectively to different stakeholders as needed.

Agreeableness – Be kind and thoughtful. We value people who are respectful of others and who are willing to jump in and help where and when needed.

Neuroticism – Although we try and minimize stress levels, there will be deadlines to meet. Plans can change, so the ability to pivot and adapt to changing priorities will be important.

title: Senior Manager - Fixed Income, Alternatives and Structured Products
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Description**

**Vice President, Product Manager - Fixed Income, Structured Products & Alternatives**

**Division:** International Wealth & Premier Banking – Wealth Management  
**Entity:** HSBC India

**Role purpose**

The role will lead the investment product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth business.

The role will translate market opportunities, client needs and regulatory developments into a compelling, commercially viable and well-governed product shelf. This means ensuring that products are relevant for clients, practical for relationship managers to distribute and sustainable for the bank.

Working closely with Markets, Investment Advisory, Risk, Compliance, Legal and regional and global Wealth teams, the role will provide end-to-end ownership of product strategy, governance, commercialization and lifecycle management.

**Key priorities include:**

  

* Accelerating the growth of Fixed Income Products, Alternative Investments and Structured Products.
* Integrating GIFT City offerings into the core investment proposition.
* Establishing Fixed Income as a central component of every relevant advisory conversation.
* Maintaining a high standard of product governance, suitability and risk management.
* The successful candidate will combine deep investment expertise with commercial judgement, disciplined execution and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Product strategy and shelf architecture**

* Define and execute the product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth segments.
* Own the frameworks for product due diligence, approval, whitelisting, shelf sizing, review and retirement.
* Assess the shelf regularly to identify product gaps, client suitability considerations and opportunities to improve portfolio coverage.
* Maintain the right balance between product breadth, client relevance, governance requirements and commercial viability.
* Ensure the shelf reflects the needs and risk profiles of different client segments.

* **Fixed Income**

* Build and strengthen the Fixed Income proposition across government securities, corporate bonds and structured credit.
* Translate views on interest rates, yield curves and credit cycles into practical investment solutions.
* Develop propositions that support income generation, yield enhancement, diversification and capital preservation.
* Improve product availability, pricing, execution and servicing so that Fixed Income can be incorporated naturally into client portfolios.
* Partner with Investment Advisory and distribution teams to strengthen the role of Fixed Income in portfolio construction and client conversations.

* **Structured Products**

* Develop structured investment solutions designed to provide yield enhancement, capital protection or targeted market exposure.
* Work with Structuring, Treasury and Markets teams to create products aligned to defined client segments and investment objectives
* Evaluate underlying assets, payoff structures, liquidity, counterparty exposure and other relevant risks.
* Maintain a robust and transparent product pipeline, supported by appropriate approvals and governance.
* Ensure product documentation, client communication and distribution materials clearly explain features, risks and expected outcomes.

* **Alternative Investments**

* Grow the Alternative Investments shelf across Portfolio Management Services, Alternative Investment Funds and private-market strategies.
* Identify and assess investment managers based on track record, investment philosophy, process, risk management, governance and operational capability.
* Connect onshore and GIFT City alternatives propositions to provide clients with differentiated and complementary investment opportunities.
* Manage capacity, liquidity, operational and concentration considerations across the alternatives range.
* Increase adoption through relationship-manager engagement, targeted campaigns, training and clear investment narratives.
* Work with regional and global teams to identify relevant strategies and share best practice.

* **Product lifecycle and commercialization**

* Take investment themes and product opportunities from initial concept through business case, approval, launch, monitoring and, where appropriate, retirement.
* Develop clear commercial plans covering target clients, value proposition, pricing, distribution approach and expected financial contribution.
* Equip frontline teams across Private Banking, Premier and High Net Worth/Ultra High Net Worth segments with effective sales narratives, tools and launch support.
* Monitor assets under management, client penetration, revenue, profitability and product utilization.
* Take corrective action where commercial performance, client adoption or profitability does not meet expectations.
* Use client and frontline feedback to improve product design and distribution effectiveness.

* **Governance, risk and regulation**

* Act as the first line of defence for product integrity and ensure alignment with Group policy, applicable local regulation and HSBC’s internal governance standards.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance and Legal to assess suitability, liquidity, concentration, conduct, counterparty and other relevant risks.
* Lead product reviews, governance forums and remedial actions.
* Ensure issues are identified, escalated and resolved promptly.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their implications for the product shelf, distribution model and client experience.
* Promote a culture in which commercial ambition and responsible product management go hand in hand.
* **Market intelligence and investment insight**

  

* Monitor developments across global and Indian public and private markets.
* Assess the implications of changes in interest rates, credit conditions, market structure, regulation and investor demand.
* Convert market intelligence into clear recommendations for product strategy and shelf development.
* Work with Investment Insights teams to strengthen HSBC’s market positioning and advisory narrative.
* Provide concise, credible investment views to senior stakeholders and distribution teams.
* **Leadership and stakeholder management**

* Serve as the subject-matter expert and escalation point for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments in HSBC India.
* Build effective working relationships with control functions, distribution leaders, Markets teams, regional and global Wealth colleagues and external partners.
* Manage relationships with asset managers, issuers and other ecosystem participants.
* Influence senior leadership through sound commercial analysis, clear investment judgement and well-structured recommendations.
* Coach junior colleagues and contribute to a strong, collaborative product management culture.
* Encourage constructive challenge and bring together different perspectives to improve outcomes.
* **Strategic initiatives**

* Lead or contribute to strategic priorities, including:
* Expanding HSBC’s investment footprint in GIFT City.
* Building investment-led digital client journeys.
* Enhancing data, analytics and management information for product governance and performance monitoring.
* Developing strategic partnerships with asset managers and other ecosystem participants.
* Improving product discovery, client engagement and frontline enablement.
* Strengthening connectivity between local, regional and global investment capabilities.

**Candidate Profile**

This is a senior product leadership role at the intersection of investment strategy, commercial growth, client outcomes and risk management.

The successful candidate will bring:

* Deep technical knowledge of Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments.
* Experience in wealth management, investment product management, asset management, investment banking or a related financial-services environment.
* Strong understanding of product governance, due diligence, suitability and regulatory expectations.
* A track record of taking investment products from concept through approval, launch, distribution and ongoing review.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to connect investment propositions to client needs and business outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management and influencing skills.
* The confidence to engage senior leaders and challenge constructively where required.
* A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to developing talent.
* The ability to operate effectively across local, regional and global teams.

**Pro-Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
Growth & Marketing Manager

**Location:** Mumbai | Full-time | Hybrid flexibility

**Compensation:** ₹8–12 LPA, depending on experience and capabilities

About Quickeee

Quickeee is a fashion quick-commerce startup built around one simple idea: **why wait days for fashion when you can get it in 60 minutes?**

We're rethinking how people discover, shop for, and receive fashion, combining speed, convenience, and experiences like Try & Buy.

We're an early-stage, execution-focused team building something ambitious. And we're looking for someone who wants to build alongside us.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a curious, analytical, creative, and entrepreneurial thinker who loves figuring out how businesses grow.

You might be someone who:

* Has worked at a marketing agency, handled multiple brands, and wants to take ownership of growing one.
* Has worked in growth, marketing, or the founder's office at a startup and wants more responsibility.
* Has tried building a startup of their own, whether it succeeded or not.
* Is exceptionally capable, early in their career, and has already demonstrated real marketing or entrepreneurial skills.

**We care more about how you think, what you've built, and how quickly you learn than impressive titles or degrees.**

What you'll do

**1. Own growth strategy and experimentation**

* Identify opportunities to acquire, engage, and retain customers.
* Develop creative online and offline growth strategies.
* Understand customer behaviour, competitors, trends, and emerging opportunities.
* Design and run experiments, measure results, and scale what works.

**2. Lead our marketing agencies**

* Work closely with our existing performance marketing and content creation agencies.
* Develop campaign strategies, briefs, and creative directions.
* Review agency performance, challenge assumptions, and identify improvements.
* Ensure marketing efforts contribute to measurable business outcomes.

**3. Make data-driven decisions**

* Monitor acquisition costs, conversions, campaign ROI, retention, and customer behaviour.
* Use analytics to understand what's working and what isn't.
* Translate data into clear actions and recommendations.
* Continuously improve marketing efficiency and resource allocation.

**4. Think beyond digital marketing**

* Explore offline activations, partnerships, community initiatives, referrals, and unconventional acquisition channels.
* Identify creative ways to build awareness and demand within our delivery locations.
* Collaborate with product, technology, operations, and leadership teams to improve customer growth.

What makes you a great fit

* Ideally 2–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in an agency, D2C brand, consumer startup, or high-ownership growth role.
* Exposure to multiple brands, campaigns, or customer acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with numbers.
* Creative problem-solving skills and an instinct for consumer behaviour.
* Understanding of performance marketing, marketing funnels, and campaign economics.
* Ability to turn ideas into execution through internal teams and external partners.
* High curiosity, ownership, adaptability, and a genuine desire to continuously learn.

Bonus points if you

* Have founded or attempted to build a startup.
* Have managed multiple clients at a marketing agency.
* Have worked with consumer apps, fashion, D2C, marketplaces, or quick commerce.
* Have executed growth campaigns with limited budgets.
* Can demonstrate an unconventional growth experiment that actually worked.

Why join us?

* **Real ownership:** Your ideas can directly influence how Quickeee grows.
* **Work closely with founders:** Get exposure to business strategy, product, technology, and operations.
* **Freedom to experiment:** Test creative ideas, challenge assumptions, and learn from results.
* **Resources to execute:** You'll work with existing content and performance marketing agencies rather than having to do everything yourself.
* **Growth opportunity:** Take on increasing responsibility as the company scales.

How to apply

Skip the generic cover letter.

Along with your profile, tell us:

* What's one growth experiment or marketing initiative you've personally worked on that you're proud of?
* If you had ₹1 lakh to grow a fashion delivery startup in Mumbai, what would you try first, and why?
* What's something interesting you've learned recently that changed how you think about marketing or business?

We're open to unconventional backgrounds, former founders, and ambitious professionals whose abilities go beyond their current job titles.

**If you enjoy solving difficult problems, questioning assumptions, and building things from scratch, we'd love to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Lead multiple technology engagements simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery across the lifecycle — discovery, requirements, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing operations.
* Build and manage client relationships across assigned accounts, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for technology initiatives and strategic discussions.
* Partner with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify technology-enabled solutions, and develop roadmaps that support long-term transformation.
* Drive account expansion — identify opportunities, shape proposals, facilitate client discussions and collaborate with internal teams on solutions.
* Coordinate cross-functional, geographically distributed teams across India and the US, ensuring collaboration, delivery excellence and alignment across workstreams.

***Subject matter (OT & industrial data) -***

* Act as the OT subject-matter expert — shape and drive manufacturing and Industry 4.0 use cases across sites and enterprise programs (process monitoring, predictive maintenance, OEE, yield, energy, asset reliability).
* Apply deep knowledge of plant-floor OT and industrial data: sensors and instrumentation, PLC / DCS / SCADA, historians (e.g. OSIsoft / AVEVA PI), industrial IoT and edge, and manufacturing data platforms.
* Design and govern OT/IT data layers and Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures; define semantic models / ontology and contextualization of time-series and equipment data.
* Apply industrial standards and connectivity — ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA and MQTT / UNS — and translate operational needs into scalable data products and analytics.

***Delivery & technology (SDLC) -***

* Lead end-to-end delivery and the full SDLC, guiding solution architecture, integration patterns, data models and the team’s technical approach while staying hands-on as and when required.
* Own estimation, planning, risk, dependency and delivery governance; ensure quality, non-functional requirements and, for validated systems, GxP / CSV validation (IQ/OQ/PQ, RVM traceability) and data integrity.

***Change Management & Value Delivery -***

* Drive organizational change management, ensuring adoption of new technologies and digital ways of working.
* Build business cases with clear ROI, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, quality, and time-to-market.
* Lead workshops, training, and stakeholder engagement to foster a culture of innovation and data-driven decision-making.

* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment across multiple locations (India and US).

title: Product Manager (Direct Procurement)
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
Only candidates based or willing to relocate to Pune will be considered, as our operations are strictly limited to this location.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
As the Product Manager for Distribution, you are the "Full-Stack" owner of the value stream connecting our suppliers to our customers. You will move beyond tactical ticket-writing to drive the "Why" and "What" for both customer sales and supplier purchasing capabilities. This role is part of our Functional Product Stream, focused on solving pervasive market problems to drive adoption and revenue.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Your work is structured around the Product Management Lifecycle (PMLC), focusing on outcome-based decision gates rather than feature output.
  
  

* Discovery & Strategy (The "Why")
* Market Sensing: Conduct biweekly customer and supplier interactions to validate that identified problems are urgent and pervasive.
* Problem Validation: Use data from Win/Loss reports and Customer Advisory Boards (CAB) to build evidence-based business cases.
* Opportunity Canvasing: Define the market driver, competitive landscape, and economic impact (ROI) for new distribution initiatives.
* Solution & Design (The "What")
* Roadmap Ownership: Maintain a 3-year Now/Next/Later roadmap that balances customer sales features, supplier integration, and technical health.
* Ruthless Prioritization: Apply the RICE framework (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) to the backlog to ensure we focus on "Return on Effort".
* Constraint Definition: Clearly distinguish between MVP (Technical Prototype) and MLP (Minimum Lovable Product) to prevent scope creep.
* Delivery & Market Alignment (The "How")
* Squad Leadership: Act as the strategic lead for a group of Autonomous Squads (Atomic Scrum Units), collaborating with a Tech Lead and Product Designer.
* GTM Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing to ensure Sales, Support, and Customer Success are operationally ready for new releases.
* Success Analysis: Post-launch, measure actual adoption and revenue against the original business case metrics to decide whether to Pivot, Persevere, or Kill.
* Success Metrics (KPIs)

In a product-led organization, you are measured on Outcomes, not outputs:
  
  

* ARR: Supporting growth goals for sales.
* Customer Retention: Ensuring users get continuous value from the distribution module.
* Outcome Achievement: Meeting the specific success criteria defined in your Business Cases (e.g., reducing purchasing lead times).
* Strategic Alignment: Ensuring 100% of your roadmap items are scalable for multiple customers and not bespoke requests.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 5-10 years of experience in Product Management within supply chain, ERP, or distribution software is highly preferred.
* Mindset: High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural curiosity for user problems over technical "purity".
* Decision Making: Ability to make "Green Light" investment recommendations based on hard data (logs, usage stats) rather than "gut feel".
* Tooling: Proficiency in Aha! for strategy/roadmapping and Jira for execution management.

**Additional Information**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Connectivity Product Manager to own and evolve strategic connectivity platforms within Vodafone Cloud & Infrastructure. The role focuses on driving the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management of FlowDB and GIANT, ensuring alignment with connectivity strategy, customer requirements and technology priorities. Working closely with architecture, engineering, operations and delivery teams, you will translate business and technical needs into prioritised product outcomes, support investment decisions, and help deliver scalable, automated and customer-centric platform capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to influence product direction across an international environment while driving adoption, value realisation and continuous improvement.

* Own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management for FlowDB and GIANT products within the connectivity portfolio
* Translate connectivity strategy, customer requirements and business needs into clearly prioritised product initiatives and investment opportunities.
* Manage product demand, backlog prioritisation and roadmap delivery across multiple stakeholders and teams
* Collaborate with product owners, network architects, engineering, operations and delivery teams to define and enhance product capabilities
* Support business case creation, funding approvals, go-to-market activities and communication plans for product initiatives.
* Drive simplification, standardisation and automation initiatives across the product lifecycle
* Monitor product performance, adoption, customer feedback and value delivery through measurable business and technical KPIs.
* Manage product risks, dependencies and lifecycle decisions while supporting Agile and SAFe ways of working

**Who You Are**

* Experience working within Product Management in connectivity, telecommunications, network infrastructure, cloud infrastructure or technology platform environments.
* Strong knowledge of product roadmap development, demand management, prioritisation and portfolio management.
* Experience working in Agile environments, including Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) practices
* Good understanding of telecom and network services, cloud technologies and supporting infrastructure platforms
* Ability to translate technical requirements into customer and business-focused product outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills with experience collaborating across international teams and markets.
* Experience working with architecture, engineering, operations and delivery functions in complex technology environments

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

* Experience influencing product investment decisions, roadmap priorities and technology transformation initiatives
