title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is hiring a Product Engineer to own a domain inside our ERP — the financial system of record for state and local government. You will own a product area end to end: customer discovery, the roadmap, the user experience, the build, the launch, and the adoption number. This is a new kind of role, born from AI's ability to handle execution work that once required three specialists. What AI cannot do is decide what matters, sit with a finance director through a budget cycle, make the right call in an ambiguous compliance question, or own whether a product succeeds. That is what Product Engineers do.
  
  
The shift to Product Engineering is primarily about owning the product — not becoming an engineer. The best Product Engineers are obsessed with the who and the why: who are these customers, what do they actually need, and what business outcomes depend on solving their problems. The how — writing code, building interfaces — is a skill you grow into using AI-native tooling. It is a career accelerator, not a job requirement on day one.
  
  
"Product Engineer" is two words — but the first word is the one that matters most. The second is how you get there.
  
  
We are hiring for judgment. You will own a domain where the decisions are load-bearing: a chart-of-accounts choice that a county lives with for a decade, a reporting model that either satisfies an auditor or does not. We expect you to make those calls, write down why, and defend them when the facts change.
  
  
**The Domain**
**Role**
ERP at OpenGov is a suite, and this role owns a domain within it. Depending on fit, that domain sits in or across:
  
  

* Financial Management — general ledger and the chart of accounts, accounts payable, accounts receivable and cash receipts, fixed assets, purchase card, requisitions, bank reconciliation, project accounting.
* Budgeting & Performance — budget creation and proposals on the ERP chart of accounts, worksheets, multi-period adoption, amendments and transfers, workforce planning, performance measures.
* Reporting & Financial Statements — the financial report engine, multi-hierarchy and multi-entity reporting, GASB-compliant statements, the datasets and pipelines beneath them, and the transparency surfaces governments publish to residents.
* Procurement — intake through solicitation, evaluation, award, and contract management, and the vendor record that connects procurement to AP.

Adjacent domains — payroll and HCM, utility billing, tax and revenue, permitting, asset management — sit alongside yours in the same platform. You will not own them, but your decisions will touch them, and you are expected to coordinate rather than escalate.
  
  
The hard, specific problems in this domain right now include chart-of-accounts migration and mutation, multi-entity and blended component-unit structures (a county and its school district, a city and its authorities), reporting parity for customers moving off a legacy product, and audit-readiness as a product capability rather than a services engagement. If those problems sound interesting rather than tedious, this is the right role for you.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* A domain. A defined set of customers, problems, and measurable business outcomes you are accountable for driving. You are the DRI — the directly responsible individual — for all things product in that domain.
* The roadmap. What gets built, in what order, and why, informed by customer research, competitive context, and business goals. You set it, defend it publicly, and update it when facts change. Aha and the Roadmap Portal stay the source of truth so GTM can work from it.
* The end-to-end user experience. From first interaction to last, you define the flow and validate the design within the design system — not just the requirements.
* The ship. From idea to live in customers' hands. You drive intent, design, build coordination, launch, and iteration without handing off across three roles. Engineers review your PRs the way they review each other's.
* The number. Adoption, go-live and retention targets, and the revenue tied to your domain. The outcome belongs to you.
* Field time. Product Engineers are members of Customer Product Squads alongside an Engagement Lead and a Solution Architect, and stay on accounts after go-live. Expect roughly 20–25 hours per implementation — concentrated in discovery, with lighter oversight through configuration and training — capped at about a quarter of your time. The other three quarters is your domain. When a bug surfaces on site, you fix it on site rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work.
  
  

* Spec writing. The prototype is the spec. You build first, in the product repo, with AI skills that carry our standards; the product brief is generated from what you built. Nobody writes a PRD first.
* UX design. AI generates screens from the design system based on your flow definitions, and design-review agents sanity-check what you built. You make the product decisions within the system and escalate genuinely new patterns.
* Research synthesis. AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, support cases, and product usage. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content. AI drafts release notes, in-app announcements, demo data, and enablement material from what you shipped.
* Code review and test coverage. Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues; AI generates test cases from your acceptance criteria. You stay accountable for quality outcomes, and your acceptance criteria have to be precise enough to verify.
* Competitive and regulatory monitoring. AI surfaces competitor moves and changes in accounting standards and state reporting requirements. You form the point of view and decide what it means for the roadmap.

What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.
  
  
You are also expected to improve the tooling itself — identify gaps in AI harnesses, skills, and design system coverage, and surface them as platform investment requests with a clear business case.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your domain, grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals — not inherited from committee.
* Conduct and synthesize discovery with government finance staff: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to platform and design when a genuinely new system-level pattern is required.
* Build. Use AI-native tooling to move from intent to working software in the product repo, validate with customers, and iterate. Own your PRs through review.
* Write acceptance criteria precise enough for automated tests to verify, and treat quality as a pipeline property rather than a hardening phase.
* Partner with engineering leads and squad engineers to unblock builds and resolve ambiguity in real time without becoming a bottleneck.
* Embed with Professional Services on implementations and migrations: run discovery, close the gap between what the product does and what the customer configured, and feed what you learn straight back into the roadmap.
* Track adoption, usage, go-live health, and business outcomes; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your domain in customer conversations, QBRs, steering committees, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Coordinate directly with adjacent domains when a customer need spans more than one, and bring a recommendation rather than a question.

**Core Skill Sets — Non-Negotiables**
Ranked in order of importance and impact. The first three are the screen; the rest are the bar.
  
  

* Ownership under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and iterate faster than you wait for certainty. One DRI means there is nobody else to point to, and that energizes you rather than worrying you. Candidates who have only operated inside a PM-designer-engineer trio, with someone else accountable for the outcome, will struggle here.
* Demonstrated product ownership with a track record. Product management, product design, or a closely adjacent role, where you shipped things customers actually use and can point precisely to what you owned versus what the team owned. This is an individual-contributor role, not a management one.
* Depth in a complex, workflow-heavy, compliance-bound B2B domain. Financial software, ERP, accounting, or a comparably regulated enterprise domain. The general requirement is that you have owned a product where being wrong had consequences beyond a churned subscription.
* Customer discovery you have actually run. You have conducted discovery, synthesized the research yourself, and changed a roadmap or a design because of what you learned — with a specific example.
* Written communication. You can articulate a product decision clearly enough that engineering, design, services, and leadership all walk away aligned, without a follow-up meeting. Expect a writing signal in the process.
* Willingness to build. You do not need to arrive as a developer, but code fluency has to read to you as a career accelerator rather than a threat. Experience in AI-native workflows is a plus; willingness to become proficient in them is required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Government finance, public sector accounting, or GovTech SaaS — or direct experience as a finance officer, budget analyst, auditor, or controller.
* Familiarity with fund accounting, chart-of-accounts design, GASB reporting, the annual budget cycle, or external audit workflows.
* Experience with data migration or platform replacement programs, where the hard part was the customer's existing data rather than the new feature.
* Multi-entity or multi-organization data models, consolidated reporting, or component-unit structures.
* Hands-on time with AI development tooling — Claude Code, Cursor, or similar — and with design systems and component libraries.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Director, Product Management - Learning
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Director, Product Management - Learning****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Pune Office**
**Director, Product Management — Learning | Pune |**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.
  
  
**About The Role**
Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.
  
  
You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**
**Set vision & strategy**
Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
  
  
Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
  
  
Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
  
  
Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.
  
  
**Lead & grow the team**
Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
  
  
Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
  
  
Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.
  
  
**Discover, experiment & measure**
Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
  
  
Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
  
  
Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
  
  
Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.
  
  
**Deliver with rigor**
Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
  
  
Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
  
  
Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
  
  
Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
  
  
A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability.
  
  
Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
  
  
AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
  
  
Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.
  
  
**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**
10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
  
  
A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
  
  
Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
  
  
Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
  
  
Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
  
  
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
  
  
Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.
  
  
**Nice to Have**
Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
  
  
Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
  
  
**Experience With Skills-based Capabilities, Content Ecosystems, Or Analytics/insights Products.**
Familiarity with regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven product environments and enterprise governance models for AI and data.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

title: Technical Product Analyst, 2027 Leadership Development Program, ION Group, India
description:
**Your Role**
As a Technical Product Analyst, you will work at the intersection of Product, Data, AI, and Business Operations to help build, improve, and scale ION products used by Tier 1 banks , Fortune 100 global corporations and other leading enterprises worldwide.
  
  
You will transform data into insights, customer challenges into product opportunities, and ideas into measurable business outcomes. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, customers, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to product innovation, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to combine analytical thinking, product understanding, customer engagement, and emerging technologies to shape the future of financial technology solutions.
  
  
Your Contribution
  
  
**Data & Insights**

* Analyze product, customer, and business data to identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities.
* Define, track, and measure key product and business metrics.
* Build dashboards, reports, and scalable analytics solutions that support data-driven decision making.
* Generate actionable insights and recommendations for Product, Engineering, and business teams.
* Support the development and maintenance of reliable data assets, pipelines, and reporting capabilities.
* Assist in building and validating predictive models to support business and product objectives.

**AI & Automation**

* Identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation, automation, and process optimization.
* Design and build analytical tools, automations, and workflow improvements that help teams turn data into action.
* Evaluate and leverage AI technologies, machine learning capabilities, and emerging tools to improve products and internal operations.
* Support the implementation, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI-powered solutions.
* Contribute to reducing operational complexity through scalable, technology-driven solutions.

**Product & Customer Impact**

* Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define requirements, validate product ideas, and measure outcomes.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and feature development through data-driven recommendations.
* Build a deep understanding of customer workflows, product usage patterns, and business requirements.
* Collaborate directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand challenges, resolve issues, and support product adoption.
* Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

across product and lifecycle-related activities.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Senior Manager Product and Lifecycle Management**
****About Medline****
Medline is the largest provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Ill., the company employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.
  
  
****Job Summary:****
Lead and integrate a global operations capability supporting the lifecycle of healthcare products and procedure kits, from product and component setup through controlled changes, commercial enablement, inventory management and discontinuation. The role connects product information, technical documentation, supply chain execution and business analytics to improve product availability, data quality, turnaround time and financial outcomes.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead through managers and team leaders, establish a common operating model across the combined teams, and partner with global Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality and Regulatory, and Technology leaders. The mandate includes building specialist talent, delivering reliable operations, and converting analytics, automation and AI opportunities into measurable improvements.
  
  
Business scope
  
  

* Kitting and lifecycle operations: new and revised kit setup, bill of materials maintenance, component changes, kit activation and closure, discontinued business, inventory disposition and lifecycle exceptions.
* Product information and technical support: product master data, technical data sheets, labeling and instructions for use support, packaging information, translations, product cross references and controlled documentation.
* Commercial and supply chain enablement: quotations and pricing support, vendor and sourcing administration, product availability and backorder insights, tender information and coordination across product divisions.
* Analytics and transformation: business intelligence, product and component analysis, workflow automation, project governance, process standardization and capability expansion.

****Responsibilities:****
Product and lifecycle accountabilities
  
  
Kitting and lifecycle operations
  
  

* Own service delivery for kit and component setup, bill of materials changes, revisions, activation and closure. Establish checks that keep approved product, quotation, packaging and system information consistent across handoffs.
* Coordinate new, revised and discontinued business with Product Management, planning, manufacturing, purchasing and customer-facing teams. Manage dependencies, exceptions and escalation to protect continuity of supply.
* Lead the operational response to excess, obsolete and expiring inventory, component shortages, revision runout and customer cancellations. Use analysis to recommend transfers, returns, purchase order actions or disposition for approval by the accountable business owner.

Product data and documentation
  
  

* Establish ownership and quality controls for product attributes, descriptions, packaging hierarchies, images, component data and cross references. Resolve data defects at source and maintain consistency across product information and ERP systems.
* Oversee technical data sheet creation and updates, labeling and artwork coordination, instructions for use documentation, translation workflows and document publication. Maintain version control, traceability and evidence of required reviews.
* Strengthen controls for product changes, component discontinuations and related document updates so that approved changes reach the affected systems, users and downstream processes.

Technical and product development support
  
  

* Lead the assigned support for supplier information, product specifications, sample review coordination, packaging study documentation and project milestones. Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies and outstanding decisions are clearly documented.
* Partner with Product Management, Quality and Regulatory specialists on technical reviews and change decisions. Exercise approval authority only within formally assigned responsibilities and approved procedures.

Commercial and supplier enablement
  
  

* Oversee quotation and pricing administration, component cost and margin analysis, product replacement information, tender responses and product documentation requests. Ensure business recommendations use validated information and reach the authorized decision maker.
* Direct assigned vendor setup, vendor data maintenance, purchasing support and pricing or invoice exception workflows. Improve coordination with Procurement, Finance and global commercial teams.
* Improve availability and backorder support by connecting inventory, production schedules, component constraints and product alternatives. Ensure customer-facing responses reflect approved product information and reliable supply assumptions.

Transformation and leadership accountabilities
  
  
Business analytics and decision support
  
  

* Build a prioritized analytics portfolio covering inventory exposure, expiry and obsolescence, component shortages, kit revisions, product availability, quotation economics, margin drivers and time to market.
* Translate business questions into data requirements, agreed definitions and actionable dashboards. Challenge data quality, assumptions and analytical conclusions, and ensure insights lead to documented decisions and follow-up actions.

Automation and AI
  
  

* Sponsor process simplification and automation using suitable tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, RPA and system integrations. Define requirements, controls, testing, adoption and support arrangements with Technology partners.
* Develop AI use cases for extracting and validating product information, comparing document versions, assisting product cross referencing, summarizing exceptions and supporting stakeholder queries. Define evaluation criteria and human review for technical, quality and regulatory content.
* Own the business case and benefits realization for each initiative. Establish a baseline, measure capacity released and improvements in quality or cycle time, and validate financial benefits with Finance while accounting for delivery and ongoing support costs.

People and capability leadership
  
  

* Lead managers, team leaders, analysts and domain specialists across the combined portfolio. Define accountabilities, performance expectations, succession coverage and decision rights at each level.
* Build specialist career paths in product lifecycle operations, product data, technical documentation, analytics and automation. Recruit and develop talent capable of taking on more complex global responsibilities.
* Create a common culture of ownership, problem solving and continuous learning. Coach leaders through change, resolve competing priorities and maintain employee engagement as scope and ways of working evolve.

Global partnership and operational governance
  
  

* Establish one service catalogue, demand and capacity process, performance scorecard and escalation framework. Lead business reviews with global stakeholders and align resources to business value, risk and service commitments.
* Manage delivery quality, turnaround time, backlog, productivity, controls, budget and continuity within delegated authority. Maintain current procedures, training records, access controls and reliable backup coverage.
* Shape a phased capability roadmap and lead new scope discovery, transition planning, knowledge transfer and stabilization. Define acceptance criteria, service ownership and controls before assuming additional work.

****Work Experience & Required Skills:****

* Typically 15 or more years of progressive experience across product operations, product lifecycle management, supply chain, technical business operations or global capability environments, with substantial responsibility for complex delivery portfolios.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers or team leaders across multiple specialist teams, including performance management, succession development, organizational change and global stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of product and component data, bills of materials, lifecycle changes and cross-functional dependencies. Relevant experience may come from medical devices, healthcare products or other complex manufactured-product businesses.
* Proven delivery of analytics and automation initiatives with measurable business outcomes. Ability to assess analytical logic, data quality, technology options and benefits rather than relying solely on project status reporting.
* Commercial and operational acumen sufficient to evaluate inventory exposure, cost and margin implications, service trade-offs and the business case for capability expansion.
* Ability to work with senior international stakeholders, influence decisions without direct authority, communicate complex issues clearly and lead teams through ambiguity.

****Educational Qualification:****

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, supply chain, operations, business or a relevant discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Lean Six Sigma, project management, supply chain or product lifecycle qualifications are useful where supported by delivery experience.
* Preferred exposure includes regulated product documentation, kitting or configurable products, product information management and ERP systems, Power BI and the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, RPA or AI implementation strengthens the profile.
* Relevant environments in the current scope include SAP, QAD, AS400, PIM, Medpack, NetQuote, Workfront and Smartsheet; expertise in every platform is not required.

We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. title: Finance Enterprise Systems Director (Netsuite)
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an AI-forward, strategic Senior Manager to lead our Finance Applications portfolio within Enterprise Systems. This is a high-impact role for a leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings order to complex cross-functional programs, and uses AI as a force multiplier across delivery, design, and decision-making. You will own end-to-end transformation of our Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report ecosystems — partnering with Finance, Procurement, Revenue Operations, IT, and external vendors to deliver outcomes that move the business forward.
  
  
If you are equally comfortable architecting a multi-quarter roadmap, stakeholder management, performing RCA, and presenting risk trade-offs to executives — we want to talk to you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead with strategy. Define and own the multi-year roadmap for Finance enterprise applications, aligning technology investments with business objectives across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Revenue/Close cycles.
* Turn chaos into clarity. Step into ambiguous, fast-moving programs and bring structure — clear scope, owners, decisions, and outcomes — without slowing the business down.
* Drive AI-native delivery. Embed AI tools (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and emerging assistants) into how the team operates: requirements drafting, test case generation, change documentation, status reporting, code review, and stakeholder communication. Set the standard for what an AI-augmented Finance Systems team looks like.
* Own the systems stack. Provide hands-on leadership across NetSuite, Zuora, SAP Ariba, and Klarity — partnering with admins, developers, and integration teams on configuration, enhancements, integrations, and support.
* Manage stakeholders end-to-end. Be the trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, RevOps, Procurement, Legal, and IT leadership. Translate business problems into delivery plans; translate technical trade-offs into business language.
* Run disciplined programs. Establish PMO best practices, govern scope/schedule/budget/quality, lead steering committees, manage risks and escalations, and deliver predictably across waterfall, Agile (Scrum/Kanban), and hybrid models.
* Lead vendors and SIs. Manage external implementation partners and product vendors — set expectations, hold them to outcomes, and integrate their work cleanly with internal teams.
* Protect the business. Ensure compliance with SOX, ITGC, and information security policies. Partner with internal and external auditors as a credible system and process owner.
* Continuously improve. Identify automation, simplification, and AI-driven opportunities that reduce cost, accelerate close, improve data quality, and free the team for higher-leverage work.

**Qualifications**

* Experience. 15+ years in Enterprise Systems / Technical Program Management, including 5+ years leading Finance application portfolios in mid-to-large enterprises (preferably SaaS, subscription, or high-growth tech).
* Hands-on systems expertise. Deep, working knowledge of NetSuite (ERP), Zuora (Revenue) and SAP Ariba (Procure-to-Pay). You can sit with an admin or developer and reason about configuration, data flow, and integration design — not just manage from a distance.
* AI fluency — hands-on, not theoretical. Demonstrated, daily use of Claude and/or Microsoft Copilot to ship work faster: writing prompts that get usable output, building lightweight workflows, evaluating AI suggestions critically, and coaching a team/s to do the same.
* Stakeholder management at the highest level. Track record of influencing VPs, CFOs, controller, and cross-functional peers — managing divergent expectations and landing decisions in writing.
* Chaos-to-clarity operator. Known for walking into messy programs and producing a one-page plan that everyone agrees with by end of week.
* Program delivery range. Comfort with both Waterfall and Agile (Scrum, Kanban, Lean); fluent in Jira, Confluence, MS Project, and modern collaboration tooling.
* Compliance grounding. Practical understanding of SOX, ITGC, segregation of duties, and audit support for finance systems.
* Education. Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related discipline. MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.

**Nice To have :**

* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience with Salesforce, Coupa, or Oracle Fusion Apps adjacent to the core stack.
* Prior experience leading offshore/onshore delivery models from Pune.
* Exposure to data platforms azure datalake and finance analytics.

title: Support AI Operations Manager
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**Support AI Operations Manager**
to drive and coordinate the growing portfolio of AI initiatives across QAD Support. This role will provide dedicated ownership for ensuring AI opportunities are identified, prioritized, coordinated across teams, and successfully moved from concept and pilot through implementation, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management skills with a practical understanding of AI technologies and delivery models. This person will serve as a bridge between Support and technical teams, bringing structure, governance, and accountability to AI initiatives without being responsible for hands-on AI development.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role that will work closely with Support leadership and cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, IT, Data, Security, and other relevant teams.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
**AI Strategy, Roadmap & Governance**

* Own and maintain the Support AI roadmap, ensuring initiatives are aligned with Support priorities and broader QAD AI strategy.
* Establish and maintain governance processes to evaluate, prioritize, and manage AI opportunities across Support.
* Create consistent operating mechanisms for AI initiative reviews, status reporting, decision-making, and leadership visibility.
* Track the overall portfolio of AI initiatives, including milestones, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and expected business outcomes.

**AI Project & Program Management**

* Manage AI use cases from initial intake and evaluation through prioritization, pilot, implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Coordinate cross-functional AI projects across Support, Engineering, Product, IT, Data, Security, and other stakeholders.
* Develop project plans, establish milestones and owners, identify dependencies, and proactively remove roadblocks.
* Partner with technical teams and external vendors as needed to ensure initiatives are delivered effectively and in accordance with business requirements.
* Ensure AI initiatives have clear success criteria and measurable outcomes, including productivity improvements, cost savings, customer experience improvements, and impact on key Support metrics.

**AI Adoption & Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI tools and capabilities across Support by partnering with leaders and teams to integrate AI into existing workflows and processes.
* Identify and address barriers to adoption, including process, technology, training, and change-management needs.
* Coordinate communications, training, documentation, and enablement activities to support successful implementation.
* Monitor adoption and effectiveness following implementation and identify opportunities for continued improvement.

**Opportunity Identification & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Support leaders and subject matter experts to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational performance and the customer experience.
* Evaluate potential use cases across areas such as Support productivity, case diagnostics, knowledge management, case resolution, customer self-service, and mean time to resolution (MTTR).
* Help assess the feasibility, potential value, risks, and organizational readiness of proposed AI use cases.
* Maintain awareness of emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to apply new technologies to Support operations.

**Risk, Security & Data Governance**

* Partner with technical, security, legal, and data governance teams to ensure AI initiatives comply with QAD's AI, security, privacy, and data governance requirements.
* Ensure appropriate governance and risk considerations are incorporated throughout the AI project lifecycle.
* Help establish repeatable processes for evaluating and managing AI-related risks within Support.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

**Experience**

* Overall 8-10+ years working within support with 2–3+ years of hands-on experience managing AI initiatives, AI projects, or AI-enabled business transformation programs.
* Additional experience in project management, program management, operations, or business transformation.

**Technical Skills**

* Practical understanding of AI technologies, use cases, implementation approaches, and AI delivery models; hands-on AI development experience is not required.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously and drive projects from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to establish structure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accountability across stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate business cases, define success measures, and track outcomes and ROI.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively translate between business and technical teams.
* Experience working with technology, product, engineering, data, or IT teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment where priorities and technologies may change quickly.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and removing obstacles.
* Experience with Support, Customer Service, SaaS, or other technology-enabled operations is preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or Hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

About the Role
  
  
The Senior Manager, Real-Time Operations and Workforce Management will build and lead a new 24/7 Real-Time Operations Center in Pune, India. This leader will establish the processes, operating rhythms, tools, and team capabilities required to manage intraday workforce performance across a global Support organization.
  
The role combines WFM expertise with strong operational leadership. The Senior Manager will oversee real-time staffing, schedule execution, adherence, shrinkage, queue health, and live customer demand across calls and case work. Using NICE CXone WFM and Salesforce, this leader will ensure emerging risks are identified early, decisions are made quickly, and actions are coordinated with Support leadership, WFM planning, and frontline managers.
  
This leader will also help translate broader Customer Experience priorities and the Operational Rigor framework into practical daily operating mechanisms. The goal is to improve visibility, accountability, service protection, productivity, and customer outcomes while freeing frontline managers to focus on case progression, coaching, quality, employee development, and customer commitments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Real-Time Operations Center Leadership
  

* Build and operationalize the Real-Time Operations Center, including its staffing model, coverage plan, role clarity, shift structure, handoff routines, escalation paths, and management cadences.
* Lead and develop a distributed 24/7 team of Real-Time Operations Specialists, establishing expectations for decision quality, responsiveness, documentation, communication, and customer-impact awareness.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, analytical thinking, and disciplined execution in which the Center actively protects service and customer outcomes rather than simply reporting conditions.

Intraday Workforce Management and Service Protection
  

* Oversee intraday monitoring and intervention across global Support operations, including staffing levels, queue conditions, contact volumes, case backlogs, service levels, productivity, occupancy, and emerging demand or capacity gaps.
* Use NICE CXone WFM to monitor schedules against actual activity, manage real-time adherence, identify late starts, absences, extended AUX states, and other deviations, and coordinate approved schedule or coverage changes.
* Establish response playbooks for staffing shortages, unexpected volume, shrinkage events, system disruption, high-priority customer demand, backlog risk, and other business-continuity situations.
* Ensure the Center monitors both live calls and Salesforce case queues so customer demand is managed across channels and work types rather than through a voice-only lens.

Operational Rigor and Process Design
  

* Design and continuously improve standard operating procedures, decision rights, escalation matrices, shift handoffs, incident routines, and evidence-based operating practices for real-time management.
* Partner with WFM leadership to align real-time execution with forecasting, scheduling, skill-group consolidation, shift optimization, heat maps, capacity models, and broader workforce planning.
* Help standardize AUX codes, shrinkage categories, schedule adherence practices, queue definitions, reporting logic, and operational terminology across Support business units.
* Develop dashboards, daily views, interval reporting, and recurring operational communications that create a reliable single source of truth for managers and leaders.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Customer Experience
  

* Partner with Support Services, WFM, Ready, Pro, Pro WFM, Operations, Technology, Product, and other stakeholders to align real-time actions to customer experience priorities and business commitments.
* Translate operational signals into clear recommendations, decisions, and escalations for Support leaders, including the likely effect on customer wait time, case aging, service level, resolution speed, and employee experience.
* Ensure real-time operations are connected to the broader Ops Rigor framework, including customer outcomes, operational health and flow, management routines, governance, and accountability.
* Represent the Real-Time Operations Center in operating reviews and transformation forums, bringing forward patterns, systemic gaps, and opportunities to improve the Support operating model.

Analytics, Governance, and Change Adoption
  

* Define and monitor performance measures such as schedule adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, queue and case service levels, staffing variance, productivity, backlog risk, escalation response, and data quality.
* Establish inspection and review routines that distinguish planned schedules from actual AUX activity and reinforce accurate, timely operational data.
* Lead change adoption for new WFM processes, CXone capabilities, Salesforce operational views, and real-time management routines, ensuring changes are understood and embedded into daily work.
* Use trends and root-cause analysis to recommend improvements to staffing, skills, processes, technology, and cross-functional ownership.

Basic Qualifications
  

* 8+ years of experience in workforce management, contact center operations, customer support operations, real-time management, or a related operational leadership field.
* Demonstrated experience leading intraday or real-time operations in a complex, multi-site, multi-channel contact center or enterprise support environment.
* Strong working knowledge of WFM disciplines, including forecasting and scheduling partnership, real-time adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, staffing variance, service levels, and interval management.
* Experience using NICE CXone WFM, NICE IEX, or a comparable enterprise WFM and ACD platform. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or comparable case-management tooling is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to build operating models, standard operating procedures, escalation frameworks, dashboards, and governance routines from the ground up.
* Strong people leadership, executive communication, analytical reasoning, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant WFM, contact center, or operations certification preferred.

  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience launching or transforming a command center, real-time operations center, or centralized intraday management function.
* Experience managing global operations across multiple regions, time zones, languages, channels, skill groups, or business units.
* Experience with workforce capacity models, interval forecasting, heat maps, business-continuity planning, and operational reporting.
* Experience driving change management, workforce discipline, and adoption of standardized operating practices across distributed teams.

  
Success Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is a builder and operator who can create structure without slowing the business down. This leader combines contact-center WFM expertise with sound judgment, clear communication, and a strong customer lens. They are comfortable making time-sensitive decisions with incomplete information, escalating appropriately, and turning real-time signals into coordinated action. They will be measured not only by the accuracy of reports, but by whether the Center helps Support leaders act earlier, protect customer experience, improve workforce discipline, and create a more predictable operating environment.

title: Senior Vice President, POM Product Management
description:
Senior Vice President, POM Product Management

We're seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Management. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways

* **Product strategy:** define and execute the product strategy for enterprise data capabilities, aligning the roadmap to DSS priorities, platform needs, business outcomes, and the firm's broader data and AI strategy.
* **Authoritative data masters:** own the product roadmap for increasing enterprise consumption of authoritative data masters, including Unified Client Master, Unified Product Master, Security Master, and related reference-data capabilities.
* **Migration and adoption:** partner with platforms and hubs to identify where local, fragmented, or duplicative data sources remain in use, and develop practical migration and adoption plans toward authoritative enterprise masters.
* **Requirements and delivery:** convert platform adoption barriers into prioritized product requirements, backlogs, milestones, ownership, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and measurable delivery outcomes, using Agile/SAFe practices including PI planning.
* **Resiliency through modernization:** identify product priorities that strengthen resilience, reduce dependency on legacy data infrastructure, simplify integration patterns, and improve the reliability of foundational data services.
* **Data quality:** define product capabilities that improve data-quality issue detection, triage, remediation, feedback loops, and accountability for data at its source.
* **Governance:** embed ownership, lineage, metadata, data-quality standards, permissible-use expectations, and regulatory requirements into product design and delivery.
* **Accessibility through Data Mesh:** make governed enterprise data easier to register, certify, discover, access, and reuse across reporting, analytics, business applications, and AI-enabled solutions.
* **Commercial value through Data Products:** identify reusable data-product opportunities, validate demand, define target consumers, connect products to measurable use cases, and track adoption and realized benefits.
* **Consumption experience:** shape capabilities such as APIs, events, self-service onboarding, reusable integration patterns, reference implementations, and implementation guidance that make authoritative data easier for platforms to consume.
* **Product measures:** define and track measures at the platform and application level, including master-data consumption, adoption progress, data-product usage, implementation milestones, service performance, and business outcomes.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Operations, Governance, Risk, Finance, and business teams to align investment, sequencing, delivery capacity, controls, and adoption commitments.
* **Full product lifecycle:** lead from discovery and prioritization through delivery, release, adoption, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
* **Executive communication:** communicate strategy, progress, value, risks, dependencies, and decisions through concise, data-driven materials for senior business and technology stakeholders.
* **Trusted advisor and global partner:** act as a senior product leader who influences platforms and hubs that consume DSS capabilities without directly owning their engineering resources, and connects DSS product teams in Pune with stakeholders across regions and time zones.
* **Building the team:** over time, hire, coach, and lead Product Owners and Product Managers, and grow the DSS product capability in Pune, while continuing to own key products yourself.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; Master's/MBA a plus.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of product management, data-product, platform-product, or related technology-delivery experience.
* **Enterprise delivery:** experience managing product roadmaps and end-to-end delivery in a complex enterprise environment.
* **Enterprise data depth:** strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, master/reference data, APIs, governance, and data quality.
* **Influence and execution:** demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional execution, including across geographies.
* **AI fluency:** credible understanding of how modern AI/GenAI depends on governed, high-quality data, and hands-on use of AI tools to accelerate product work.
* **Hands-on mindset:** recent, direct experience writing requirements, owning backlogs, and working day to day with engineers and data teams; comfortable being an individual contributor at a senior level.
* **Leadership readiness:** experience mentoring or leading product practitioners, or clear readiness to do so, with the judgment to balance personal delivery with developing others.

Preferred qualifications

* Financial services or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with client, product, or security master data and reference-data programs.
* Experience with Data Mesh, data-product operating models, data catalogs, or data contracts.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations for data, such as BCBS 239, data privacy, and data residency.
* Experience moving from a senior individual-contributor role into people leadership, or building a product team from a small base.
* Experience working in or with a global capability centre in India.

title: Director, Product Management - Learning
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Product Management - Learning**
===========================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

**Director, Product Management — Learning | Pune |**
  
  
**About Cornerstone**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.
  
You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In This Role You Will**

**Set vision & strategy**
  
Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
  
Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
  
Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
  
Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.
  
**Lead & grow the team**
  
Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
  
Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
  
Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.
  
**Discover, experiment & measure**
  
Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
  
Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
  
Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
  
Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.
  
**Deliver with rigor**  
Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
  
Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
  
Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
  
Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
  
  
A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
  
A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability.
  
Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, and measurable business outcomes.
  
Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
  
AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
  
Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.
  
  
**You have Got What it takes If you Have**
  
  
10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
  
A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
  
Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
  
Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
  
Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
  
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
  
Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.
  
  
**Nice to Have**  
  
Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
  
Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
  
Experience with skills-based capabilities, content ecosystems, or analytics/insights products.
  
Familiarity with regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven product environments and enterprise governance models for AI and data.

  

#LI-Onsite

  
  

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

title: Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software
description:
Date live: 10/22/2026

Business Area: Group Technology Service Management

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000099121

  

We are seeking an experienced Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software to join the Resilience Operations team, working alongside CTO Platform Engineering. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain cyber resilience and recovery tooling that enables teams across Barclays to autonomously manage protection and recovery operations. You'll work on a distributed microservices platform that orchestrates complex workflows across multi-infrastructure environments, integrates with enterprise governance systems, and handles real-time event streaming and state management. You will partner with infrastructure teams, security teams, and application owners to deliver solutions that reduce recovery times, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the bank's overall resilience posture. As a senior engineer, you'll own key architectural decisions, mentor team members, and contribute to evolving our platform's scalability, reliability, and security.

To be successful as a Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software , you should have experience in:

  
  

* React or Angular front-end development (responsive, accessible UIs).
* Go backend development, including REST API design and service integration.
* GitLab CI/CD pipelines (build, test, scan, deploy automation).
* Containerised applications on Kubernetes/OpenShift (deploy, run, troubleshoot).

Some other highly valued skills include:

  
  

* TypeScript and modern front-end tooling and patterns.
* API security and integration: OAuth2/OIDC/JWT, mTLS; data stores and messaging.
* Helm and Infrastructure as Code, monitoring and logging.
* Being a thought leader and innovator with experience in cloud and containerisation technologies.
* Proven track record of delivering transformation at scale, moving legacy applications to cloud native micro-services architecture.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, communication skills and interaction with a diverse range of stakeholders, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based out of Pune.

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

**Accountabilities**

title: Management
company: Chamber for Promotion and Facilitation of Innovative Business - CPFIB
description:
**Company Description**
Chamber for Promotion and Facilitation of Innovative Business (CPFIB) is dedicated to empowering micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and innovative startups to scale globally through trade opportunities, technology exchange, and facilitation of government schemes. The Chamber focuses on increasing awareness of innovative industry practices, support programs, and export incentives offered by relevant government agencies. CPFIB works to promote financial inclusion for innovative MSMEs by encouraging adoption of progressive financial models that reward innovation. The organization also provides mentoring and expert guidance across sectors, and facilitates buyer–seller meets to support sector-wise adoption of innovative practices within MSMEs.

**Role Description**
This is a part-time, hybrid Management role based in Delhi, India, with flexibility for some work from home. The individual in this role will oversee programs and initiatives that support MSMEs and startups, including planning and coordinating trade promotion activities, technology exchange initiatives, and government scheme awareness sessions. Daily responsibilities include stakeholder engagement with entrepreneurs, industry experts, and government bodies, organizing events such as buyer–seller meets, and managing communication and reporting on key projects. The role involves supervising outreach campaigns, ensuring timely delivery of program objectives, and monitoring the impact of CPFIB’s initiatives on member organizations. The manager will also contribute to strategic planning, process improvement, and documentation to strengthen CPFIB’s mission and operations.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in program or project management, including planning, coordination, and monitoring of initiatives supporting MSMEs or startups.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with entrepreneurs, industry partners, and government agencies.
* Background in business development, trade facilitation, or economic development, ideally with exposure to innovative business practices or financial inclusion.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to deliver presentations, conduct workshops, and prepare clear reports and proposals.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a hybrid environment, managing priorities and meeting deadlines in a part-time schedule.
* Understanding of Indian government schemes, export incentives, and support mechanisms for MSMEs and startups is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Management, Economics, Public Policy, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in chambers of commerce, industry associations, incubators, or innovation-focused organizations is an advantage.

title: Category Manager, E-commerce
description:
\*Please note this role is not for 2070 Health\*
  
  
**About BeatO**
BeatO is a digital health company in India focused on diabetes care and GLP-1 weight loss. It combines smart devices (glucometers, CGM, BP monitors, smart scales), doctor-led care programs, diet coaching, and a curated range of health foods, supplements, and lifestyle products, sold direct to consumers.
  
  
BeatO serves over 2 million patients and 10 lakh+ device users, backed by 100+ doctors and 200+ coaches.

BeatO is looking for an E-commerce Category Manager to own and grow its personal care category online. This is an individual contributor role for someone who is comfortable running a category end to end, from assortment and pricing to merchandising and performance.
  
  
Success means a growing, profitable personal care category with a sharp assortment, strong conversion, and healthy repeat purchase.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the P&L and growth plan for the personal care category across BeatO's online channels, with clear targets for revenue, margin, and conversion
* Build and manage the category assortment: decide which products to add, fix, or retire, based on sales data, customer demand, and competitor moves
* Own pricing, promotions, and offers for the category, balancing growth with profitability
* Drive category merchandising on the website and app, including collections, product pages, content, imagery, and cross-sell
* Track daily and weekly performance (traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat rate, return rate, margin) and take quick corrective action
* Work with performance marketing, CRM, and brand teams to plan category campaigns, launches, and seasonal events

* Present category performance and plans to leadership with clear insights and recommendations

**Requirements**

* 6 to 7 years of experience in e-commerce
* Hands-on experience managing D2C personal care categories (for example skincare, haircare, grooming, or body care)
* Track record of owning category performance, including assortment, pricing, and conversion
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working in Excel or Google Sheets and e-commerce dashboards
* Comfortable working as an individual contributor, executing hands-on without a team
* Based in Delhi, or willing to relocate

* Experience supporting new product launches, including vendor and brand coordination
* Working understanding of paid marketing and retention levers and how they affect category performance

title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Dhampure**

Dhampure is the branded sugar business of Dhampur Bio Organics Limited (DBO), a listed agro-processing and sugar company. We manufacture at two plants in western Uttar Pradesh, Asmoli and Mansurpur, and reach customers through a growing depot network.

Our range includes packaged sugar, specialty sugars such as icing sugar, sachets and related products, with new products in development. We sell across general trade, modern trade, e-commerce, quick commerce and HoReCa.

**The role**

We’re looking for a hands-on brand builder to take charge of Dhampure and grow it from a commodity into a brand consumers ask for by name. You’ll report to the Marketing Head, Dhampure, and work as an individual contributor, managing our creative, media and research agencies. You’ll work closely with Trade Marketing, E-commerce, NPD & QA, Sales (GT, MT, HoReCa, E-com) and Finance. The role involves regular market visits across our key states.

**What you’ll do**

* Brand strategy: Own Dhampure’s positioning, brand architecture and the annual brand plan.
* A&P budget: Plan and spend the advertising and promotion budget, and track the return on every rupee.
* Innovation: Drive new products, packs and price points with NPD & QA, from idea to launch.
* Market intelligence: Track market share, pricing, competition and consumer trends, and act on what you learn.
* Communication: Lead packaging design, campaigns, and digital and social content with our agencies.
* Brand health: Set up and track awareness, trial, repeat purchase and consumer feedback.
* Channel support: Give Trade Marketing and E-commerce the brand assets, content and story each channel needs.
* Compliance: Make sure packs and claims meet FSSAI labelling and Legal Metrology requirements

**What we’re looking for**

* 6–10 years of experience, including at least 3 years in brand management at a process-driven FMCG company
* MBA in Marketing from a reputed business school
* Brand experience in foods or staples, ideally taking a commodity category to a branded one
* A track record of owning an A&P budget, with results you can show
* At least one launch led end to end: concept, pack, pricing and go-to-market
* Exposure to digital and performance marketing, including e-commerce and quick commerce content

**Good to have**

* Packaging development experience and work with design agencies
* Experience with consumer research and brand health tracking
* An understanding of north Indian markets and the general trade consumer
* Strong written and spoken Hindi and English
