title: Founders’ Office ( IITian Preferred)
description:
**Founder's Office | Growth Valley Community**

Gurugram (in-office) | Full-time | 1-5 years experience | Reports directly to the Founder

**Tier One Education, IIT/IIM Preferred.**

**Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A consistent growth story will be awarded.**

**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.**

**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.**

**About GVC.**

Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. **What Makes You Qualified?**

* 8-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Well-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**

That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**

description:
**About Tech OVN**

Tech OVN is an innovative startup specializing in the development and manufacturing of Smart Energy Meters and EV Chargers. Our products are designed with cutting-edge technology, ensuring seamless integration, reliability, and efficiency. We aim to contribute in revolutionizing sustainable energy management and electric mobility in India and beyond.

Tech OVN is a group company of OVN, OVN has been involved in Pumping and Generators since 1949. Tech OVN was formed to diversify the group further into the energy sector.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced 
**Technical Head**
 with 10-15 years of expertise in product design, validation, and integrated testing breaking down to hardware, firmware, communication and mechanical for energy meters and EV chargers. This is a leadership role that requires a strategic thinker with hands-on technical capabilities to drive product development and ensure compliance with the industry standards.

Joining Tech OVN is a unique opportunity with a great growth opportunity where you will be tasked with contributing to India's critical infrastructure and be part of a nimble and rapidly growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**

        1.      
**Design and Development**

·       Lead the design of hardware, firmware, and mechanical components for energy meters and EV chargers managing the processes and people effectively

·       Oversee the development of industrial IOT-enabled smart energy meters and innovative EV charging solutions.

·       Requirement development and mapping and development management of tender

·       Use and development of automation and tools

·       Collaboration with technology partners

·       Design review and critical problem-solving skills

        2.      
**Validation and Testing**

·       Understanding of customer requirements and establish and manage protocols for product validation and testing, ensuring adherence to quality and regulatory standards

·       Analyze test results and implement necessary improvements to enhance product performance and reliability

·       Reliability testing for a 15-year lifecycle of the product

·       Integrated testing with communication software, Android applications and command software under all possible field scenarios

·       Liaoning with Government and Private Labs

        3.      
**Project Management**

·       Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Projects, production, and quality assurance, to meet project deadlines.

·       Manage technical aspects of product lifecycle, from prototyping to mass production to Repair and Servicing.

**4.     Compliance and Certification**

·       Ensure that all products meet national and international regulatory standards, including BIS, IEC, and other certifications required for energy meters and EV chargers.

        5.      
**Leadership and Mentoring**

·       Build and mentor a team of engineers specializing in hardware, firmware, mechanical design and product validation.

·       Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence within the organization.

**Key Qualifications**

·       Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics & Communication Engineering or a related branch of engineering.

·       10-15 years of experience in the design, validation, and testing of hardware, firmware, and mechanical components, preferably in the energy or EV sectors.

·       In-depth knowledge of smart energy meter technologies and EV charger systems.

·       Strong expertise in regulatory and certification standards (e.g., BIS, IEC).

·       Proven track record in leading technical teams and managing complex projects.

·       Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

**Why Join Us?**

     •           Be a part of a growing startup revolutionizing energy management and electric mobility in India.

     •           Work on cutting-edge technologies with significant market potential.

     •           Enjoy a collaborative and innovative work environment that values your expertise and ideas.

title: Senior Digital Product Manager
description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Product backlog and prioritization of user stories with team members
* Manage Capital fund and work directly with Finance to ensure we our budget is in line
* Establish success metrics, OKRs (Objective and Key Results), and go-to-market plan and help lead

* Be the voice of the customer and end-user; proactively provide customer feedback to internal teams. This includes being the voice of the service organization that is closest to the customer.

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**What You Will Need To Be Successful**

* Vision: Always looking through the lens of the consumer and thinking of how to make their life better
* A solid understanding of User Experience: Experience in product management, product development, and User Experience design
* Ability to ask Why: Comfortable asking the right questions to quickly understand the core of the user needs
* Instinct: Solid consumer product instincts
* Dig Deep: Being able to dig in and go all the way down the rabbit hole to identify those unique opportunities
* Collaboration: Experience incubating and commercializing new ideas by working closely with technical and creative teams. Ability to navigate and lead through a complex matrix organization to deliver outcomes
* Communication: Ability to present and hold a dialog in a variety of forums: executive, front-line and industry events
* Influence without authority: Provide guidance and information to business for prioritizing high value work

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of additional relevant experience
* 5+ years of experience with Product Owner, Project Management and / or Business Analysis
* 5+ years of experience working in a contact Center/Call Center Environment
* 3+ years working with Finance managing budgets and financial goals
* Experience driving teams and management to decisions
* Experience working with cross functional teams
* Experience systematically analyzing problems, drawing relevant conclusions, and devising appropriate courses of action

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in working with Agile / Scrum work environment as a Product Owner: writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance
* Experience working with IVR or call technology systems
* Healthcare insurance industry experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook
* Demonstrated ability to effectively break down barriers to maintain progress on initiatives
* Demonstrated ability to make quick decisions when clarification or modification is needed
* Proven diplomatic with solid negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Proven adept at adjusting to changing circumstances quickly and professionally
* Proven excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication with both technical and business audiences
* Demonstrated strategic thinking by using appropriate information to diagnose problems, identify possible solutions and collaborate with impacted groups to drive decisions
* Proven self-directed and able to drive detailed solutions to completion with minimal oversight
* Proven detail oriented and obsessively organized

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Digitial Product Management Sr Analyst
description:

title: Senior Product Discovery Manager
description:
**Senior Product Manager, Discovery**
( VZY)

**About VZY**

VZY is building the aggregation layer for how India streams. We bring the country’s OTT services together into one experience, with one login, one payment, and one place to find something worth watching, all running on our own billing and entitlement infrastructure. We think of it as infrastructure with a screen: the plumbing that makes streaming effortless, wrapped in a product people actually enjoy opening.

**About role**

At VZY, discovery is the product. When someone opens the app, everything they see (the home layout, the ranking, the rails, the curated shelves, the sense that something was picked just for them) is the discovery surface. It’s also the biggest lever we have on whether people come back and press play again.

As Senior PM for Discovery, you’ll own that surface from end to end. You’ll set the vision for how people find something to watch across dozens of services and thousands of titles, and you’ll ship the systems that make it work: the layout engine, search, the ranking and recommendation stack, personalization for very different kinds of viewers, and our new curator-led editorial shelves. You’ll work day to day with data science, engineering, editorial, and design, and you’ll help shape the discovery team as it grows.

Our North Star is Weekly Active Streamers, not installs and not sign-ups. Success looks like getting people to press play, and then to keep coming back.

**What you’ll own**

* The layout engine that assembles a personalized home surface for every user, along with the roadmap for making it smarter, faster, and easier to configure.
* Ranking and recommendations, working with data science on the models behind the rails, rows, and results, and deciding what relevance actually means for us.
* Search, so that when someone arrives knowing exactly what they want, they get to it in one try, and when they only half-know, they still land on something worth watching.
* Personalization across very different viewers (language, genre, price sensitivity, household versus individual), so the surface adapts to each one without the product coming apart at the seams.
* Our curator-led editorial shelves, the authored and followable format we’re building with the curation team. You’ll own the product side of how those shelves live inside the layout.
* Discovery analytics: the dashboards, funnels, and experiments that tell us whether any of this is actually working.

**What we’re looking for**

* 7 to 10 years in product, with real time spent owning search, recommendations, discovery, or user growth at consumer scale.
* A track record of AI and ML powered product work, where machine learning was the heart of the experience rather than a feature bolted on afterward. You can reason clearly about models, the tradeoffs they carry, and the ways they fail.
* Experience building automation that scales, the kind of system that replaces a hundred manual decisions (ranking, tagging, layout, targeting) with one that learns. Ideally you’ve done this somewhere in entertainment or media.
* Comfort with user growth problems like activation, retention, and the habit loops that turn a first stream into a weekly one, including ownership of the metrics underneath them.
* Strong data instincts. You can define the right metrics, design honest experiments, and tell a real signal from a vanity one, all in close partnership with data science.
* A feel for content and taste, because discovery in entertainment is as much editorial and emotional as it is algorithmic.
* The seniority to work through ambiguity, set a direction others can follow, and bring along the more junior PMs on the team.
* It’s a plus if you’ve worked in OTT, streaming, media, or music, or on aggregator or marketplace products where discovery drives the whole business.

**Why this role**

You’ll be the person who decides how a whole country finds what to watch, with real infrastructure, a listed parent company, and leadership backing the bet. Discovery isn’t a side project at VZY. It’s what we compete on.

And it’s a genuinely good team to spend your days with. Small, low on ego and politics, high on trust, with a real soft spot for people who care about getting the craft right.

description:

title: Product Modernization - ACC+AJO Migration - Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We seek Senior Consultants and Architects with deep, hands-on expertise in Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC), Adobe Campaign Standard (ACS), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) to help enterprise customers modernize campaign and customer-journey programs. The role leads discovery, current-state assessment, target-state architecture, implementation, integration, testing, coexistence, cutover, and enablement. You will understand how customers use ACC or ACS today, identify use cases suited to AJO, and redesign them for AEP and AJO. Some functionality must be rebuilt, redesigned, retained, or handled through an integration or alternative solution. Candidates must explain product boundaries, assess feature and use-case fit, surface gaps early, and set realistic customer expectations. In AJO, a migrated use case lands on AJO Journeys (profile-centric, event-driven orchestration on AEP Real-Time Customer Profile) or AJO Orchestrated Campaigns (campaign-centric, batch, multi-step workflows on the AEP relational data store). Candidates must design and build on both, and recommend the right path per use case.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
- Assess and plan
- Lead discovery workshops with marketing, campaign operations, data, architecture, security, mobile, and IT stakeholders.
- Inventory the Campaign estate: use cases (batch, scheduled, transactional, event-triggered, real-time); assets (campaigns, workflows, audiences, deliveries, templates, content blocks, personalization, typologies, suppression rules, reporting); data (schemas and extensions, custom resources, relational data, targeting dimensions, identifiers, consent, opt-out, quarantine, bounce, engagement history); and infrastructure (on-premises or Managed Services hosting, network access, firewalls, file transfer, decommissioning needs).
- Reverse-engineer custom logic and document the business rules: technical and marketing workflows (query, enrichment, split, deduplication, reconciliation, update data, JavaScript code activities), custom JavaScript, JSSP, SOAP/JS API calls, SQL functions, stored procedures, custom relational structures, typology rules, input forms, web applications, landing pages, subscriptions, Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, offer logic, external accounts, APIs, middleware, and enterprise integrations.
- Map each use case and dependency to an AJO/AEP target pattern and classify it as reuse, redesign, rebuild, integrate, defer, or retain elsewhere. For custom logic, decide whether to re-express it in AEP/AJO (data model, Query Service, custom actions, external services), redesign or rebuild it separately, or retain it in Campaign.
- Choose the execution path per use case based on the target customer experience, not the shape of the source Campaign workflow. Use AJO Journeys when each profile should progress individually based on behaviour, events, or elapsed time, including many scheduled and recurring Campaign workflows rebuilt as Read Audience or business-event journeys. Use Orchestrated Campaigns for relational or multi-entity data, complex audience construction and enrichment, exact pre-send counts, and multi-level sending. Use action campaigns for simple scheduled or API-triggered sends. Document the rationale, combined patterns, and license prerequisites (e.g., the Journey Optimizer Campaigns package).
- Surface product-fit gaps and operational impacts before committing to scope or feature-parity claims. Advise when Campaign coexistence or another path fits better: Campaign v8 for ACC customers, or the ACS-to-Campaign v8 transition for ACS customers.
- Develop phased roadmaps, effort estimates, dependency plans, risks, and customer decision points.
- Architect and implement
- Design the AEP foundation: XDM schemas and field groups (profile, event, lookup); identity namespaces, identity resolution, profile enablement, and data relationships; datasets, sources, destinations, batch and streaming ingestion, and event design; data quality and governance; audience qualification and segmentation; and Query Service or other processing for transformation, aggregation, and enrichment.
- Replace common Campaign data patterns with AEP capabilities: Federated Audience Composition on Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, or other warehouses (closest to ACC Federated Data Access); computed attributes for profile-level aggregates; Data Distiller for scheduled SQL transformations; merge policies; and profile and segmentation guardrails.
- Design customer experiences and build AJO journeys and campaigns across batch and event-driven engagement: event- and segment-triggered orchestration, conditions, actions, custom actions, message content, personalization, and decisioning.
- Apply journey and campaign governance and optimization: business rules, frequency capping, quiet hours, journey priority and arbitration, conflict management, wave sending, content experimentation, and decisioning policies and rankings.
- Define security, access, permissions, governance, and operational controls.
- Build channels, integrations, and extensibility
- Configure AJO channels end to end: email, mobile and web push, in-app, web, code-based experiences, content cards, inbox, live activities, SMS/MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, and direct mail. Cover channel configurations, subdomains, API credentials, feedback webhooks, mobile app and SDK dependencies, channel-specific data and consent requirements, and template approval rules (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta).
- Connect messaging providers: native SMS providers (Sinch, Twilio, Infobip); bring-your-own-provider (BYOP) setups with provider payloads, inbound keyword handling, delivery receipts, and opt-in/opt-out webhooks and flows; and Channel Builder custom channels for non-native platforms or customer-owned gateways (e.g., regional or industry-specific providers), covering endpoint, authentication, throttling, payload structure, and monitoring.
- Design and build integrations using supported APIs, source connectors, file exchange, middleware, or Adobe solution integrations, including custom actions that call external systems from journeys (CRM, loyalty, order, recommendation, call-center, notification services) with request/response schemas, authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, mTLS), capping, throttling, retries, and error handling.
- Implement event and API-triggered patterns: unitary and business events, API-triggered and transactional campaigns, Interactive Message Execution / Journey and Campaign APIs, and streaming ingestion via HTTP API.
- Design and build Journeys (profile-centric)
- Select and configure the journey entry pattern per use case: unitary-event journeys for behavioural and transactional signals; audience qualification journeys on streaming audiences for real-time lifecycle moments; Read Audience journeys, one-shot or recurring with incremental read, for scheduled and batch-initiated programs that previously ran as recurring Campaign workflows; and business-event journeys that release an audience when an operational event occurs (e.g., a price drop or flight delay). Configure identity namespaces, reentrance and wait periods, exit criteria, and time zones.
- Build multi-step journeys where each customer progresses at their own pace: Wait activities; the Optimize activity for conditions, path targeting, and path experiments; reaction events on opens and clicks with timeout paths; Update Profile; Content Decision for offers; external data sources and custom actions for real-time lookups and system writebacks; and Jump activities to split complex programs into reusable journeys.
- Use supplemental identifiers (e.g., order, booking, subscription, or policy IDs), where enabled, to run one journey instance per entity and personalize with its attributes. Decide when per-entity use cases fit journeys versus orchestrated campaign multi-level sending.
- Support phased migration and coexistence from the journey canvas, including Adobe Campaign v7/v8 and ACS actions that let AJO orchestrate while Campaign transactional messaging delivers, until channels and content move to native AJO.
- Design within journey guardrails (one active instance per profile per journey, one Read Audience per journey and concurrent-run limits, entrance and processing throughput per sandbox, Jump and supplemental identifier restrictions, reaction event placement, custom action capping, and versioning impact on live profiles). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Design and build Orchestrated Campaigns (relational)
- Design the data model with AEP relational (model-based) schemas, built manually or from a DDL or Excel upload: tables, primary and composite keys, version descriptors (e.g., lastmodified), ENUMs, data governance labels, identity fields mapped to identity namespaces, and links with correct cardinality (1-N, N-1, 1-1) to recipient and profile entities.
- Configure target dimensions, including the profile target dimension linking XDM profile and experience event data to relational data; decide what belongs in the profile store versus relational tables to avoid duplication.
- Set up Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion from supported sources (e.g., Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Databricks, Data Landing Zone): the \_change\_request\_type field for file-based loads, table logging for cloud warehouses, complete-record loads, deletion handling, and latency planning.
- Build multi-step canvases with targeting, flow control, and channel activities (Build, Read, and Save audience, Enrichment, Change dimension, Combine, Deduplication, Reconciliation, Split, Fork, AND-join, Wait, Alert), including multi-entity segmentation and multi-level sending (e.g., one message per booking, contract, subscription, account, or address linked to a profile) personalized with enriched relational attributes. Configure scheduling, recurring runs, and pre-send count validation.
- Design within orchestrated campaign guardrails (table count and schema size limits, daily change-volume limits, scalar-only audience attributes, uncached audience evaluation, permanent dataset table names, channel availability by license). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Migrate data, logic, and personalization
- Translate the ACC/ACS relational data model to AEP: map recipient, custom, and relational tables to XDM profile, experience event, and lookup schemas, or to relational schemas for orchestrated campaigns; define primary and secondary identities, relationships, cardinality, and denormalization trade-offs.
- Migrate historical and operational data (profile attributes, subscriptions, consent and opt-out status, quarantine and bounce history, engagement data) via batch backfill, delta loads, and reconciliation reports. Map ACC/ACS denylist and subscription data to the AEP Consent and Preferences field group and AJO subscription lists; load quarantined and bounced addresses into the AJO suppression list via the Suppression API so blocked recipients stay blocked from day one.
- Rebuild Campaign workflow logic according to the chosen path. For journeys, express targeting as AEP audiences (batch, streaming, or edge) and computed attributes, recurring workflows as scheduled Read Audience journeys, and waits, splits, and tests as Wait and Optimize activities. For orchestrated campaigns, rebuild queries, enrichments, splits, union/intersection/exclusion, deduplication, change dimension, and reconciliation as canvas activities. Use Query Service (SQL/CTAS) jobs or source dataflows for scheduled imports/exports and data preparation. Move logic neither canvas supports (JavaScript activities and code, SQL code, loops, file manipulation) to the source system, Query Service or Data Distiller, or external services.
- Re-architect lifecycle programs (welcome, onboarding, renewal, win-back, abandonment) built in Campaign as chained or recurring workflows into journeys, replacing workflow-based state tracking (custom flags, prior-recipient exclusion lists, wait loops) with journey state, reentrance rules, and exit criteria.
Convert ACC/ACS HTML content, templates, and personalization ( scripting, JavaScript in content, personalization blocks, conditional content) to AJO content templates and Handlebars/PQL: helper functions, conditional and dynamic content, expression and visual fragments, and decisioning outputs. Validate matching output with seed and test profiles.- Map Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, and other transactional or signal-driven flows to AJO unitary-event journeys or API-triggered campaigns, and typology, pressure, and fatigue rules to AJO business rules, frequency capping, suppression rules, and quiet hours.
- Migrate ACC Interaction offer logic (catalogs, categories, eligibility rules, weights, typology and presentation rules, inbound and outbound environments) to AJO Decisioning: decision items,
collections, selection strategies, ranking formulas or AI models, and capping. Confirm whether the customer is licensed for Decisioning or legacy Offer Decisioning.
  
  

* Rebuild Campaign landing pages, subscription and preference centers, web and survey forms, ACC web applications, and JSSP pages as AJO landing pages, subscription lists, or customer-owned web front ends connected through AEP APIs, writing consent and preferences back to AEP.
* Deliver, test, and transition
* Establish development, test/stage, and production delivery practices with Git version control and a sandbox strategy. Support controlled promotion and release management with AEP sandbox tooling packages (schemas, audiences, journeys, content templates), journey versioning, simulation, and dry-run checks before publishing.
* Build requirements-traceable test strategies and plans covering data and identity validation, audience counts, journey logic, personalization, rendering, API behavior, consent, suppression, channel delivery, and reporting.
* Design dual-run and cutover plans, synchronizing and reconciling consent, opt-outs, quarantine, bounces, profile data, and engagement history as needed.
* Plan deliverability readiness and email domain migration: subdomain delegation (full or CNAME), SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, one-click List-Unsubscribe headers, Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender requirements, IP pools and strategy, ramp-up and warm-up, bounce, quarantine, suppression, and opt-in/opt-out handling, and operational monitoring and reporting.
* Rebuild Campaign reporting and tracking with AJO built-in journey and campaign reports, Customer Journey Analytics where licensed, and Query Service on AJO system datasets (message feedback, email tracking, journey step events). Agree with the customer which ACC reports, KPIs, and tracking logs need equivalents.
* Define measurable launch and migration acceptance criteria; support business validation, production readiness, go-live, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
* Hand over with implementation documentation, architecture diagrams, reproducible data mapping specifications, runbooks, testing evidence, and operational and support materials; coach customer teams on the AJO operating model, AEP concepts, changed workflows, new responsibilities, and adoption needs.

What we want from you
  
  

* Adobe Campaign Classic - ACC v7/v8 architecture and implementation, including mid-sourcing, FFDA/Snowflake on v8, and Federated Data Access. Campaign data model and XML schema extensions; workflows and technical workflows; targeting and enrichment; deliveries, templates, personalization, typologies, and rules; transactional messaging (Message Center) and Triggers where applicable; tracking and delivery data; JSSP, web applications, SOAP APIs, packages, and external accounts; customizations and integrations.
* Adobe Campaign Standard - ACS campaign and workflow design; audiences, deliveries, templates, personalization, channel configuration, data resources, imports/exports, APIs, and consent and subscription practices. Assessing ACS implementations and translating requirements to AEP/AJO design.
* Adobe Experience Platform - XDM modeling; schemas, datasets, identity namespaces and identity resolution; Real-Time Customer Profile concepts; batch and streaming ingestion; sources and destinations; segmentation; Query Service/data transformation; governance and consent considerations; sandboxes and environment strategy.
* Adobe Journey Optimizer - Journey and campaign design (action, API-triggered, orchestrated); unitary, business, and audience-based patterns; journey activities, conditions

What we can offer you
  
  
Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
  
  
Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
  
  
We lead with
**Heart**
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
  
  
We empower your
**Brains**
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
  
  
And we champion
**Courage**
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Convert ACC/ACS HTML content, templates, and personalization ( scripting, JavaScript in content, personalization blocks, conditional content) to AJO content templates and Handlebars/PQL: helper functions, conditional and dynamic content, expression and visual fragments, and decisioning outputs. Validate matching output with seed and test profiles.- Map Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, and other transactional or signal-driven flows to AJO unitary-event journeys or API-triggered campaigns, and typology, pressure, and fatigue rules to AJO business rules, frequency capping, suppression rules, and quiet hours.
- Migrate ACC Interaction offer logic (catalogs, categories, eligibility rules, weights, typology and presentation rules, inbound and outbound environments) to AJO Decisioning: decision items,
collections, selection strategies, ranking formulas or AI models, and capping. Confirm whether the customer is licensed for Decisioning or legacy Offer Decisioning.
  
  

* Rebuild Campaign landing pages, subscription and preference centers, web and survey forms, ACC web applications, and JSSP pages as AJO landing pages, subscription lists, or customer-owned web front ends connected through AEP APIs, writing consent and preferences back to AEP.
* Deliver, test, and transition
* Establish development, test/stage, and production delivery practices with Git version control and a sandbox strategy. Support controlled promotion and release management with AEP sandbox tooling packages (schemas, audiences, journeys, content templates), journey versioning, simulation, and dry-run checks before publishing.
* Build requirements-traceable test strategies and plans covering data and identity validation, audience counts, journey logic, personalization, rendering, API behavior, consent, suppression, channel delivery, and reporting.
* Design dual-run and cutover plans, synchronizing and reconciling consent, opt-outs, quarantine, bounces, profile data, and engagement history as needed.
* Plan deliverability readiness and email domain migration: subdomain delegation (full or CNAME), SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, one-click List-Unsubscribe headers, Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender requirements, IP pools and strategy, ramp-up and warm-up, bounce, quarantine, suppression, and opt-in/opt-out handling, and operational monitoring and reporting.
* Rebuild Campaign reporting and tracking with AJO built-in journey and campaign reports, Customer Journey Analytics where licensed, and Query Service on AJO system datasets (message feedback, email tracking, journey step events). Agree with the customer which ACC reports, KPIs, and tracking logs need equivalents.
* Define measurable launch and migration acceptance criteria; support business validation, production readiness, go-live, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
* Hand over with implementation documentation, architecture diagrams, reproducible data mapping specifications, runbooks, testing evidence, and operational and support materials; coach customer teams on the AJO operating model, AEP concepts, changed workflows, new responsibilities, and adoption needs.

What we want from you
  
  

* Adobe Campaign Classic - ACC v7/v8 architecture and implementation, including mid-sourcing, FFDA/Snowflake on v8, and Federated Data Access. Campaign data model and XML schema extensions; workflows and technical workflows; targeting and enrichment; deliveries, templates, personalization, typologies, and rules; transactional messaging (Message Center) and Triggers where applicable; tracking and delivery data; JSSP, web applications, SOAP APIs, packages, and external accounts; customizations and integrations.
* Adobe Campaign Standard - ACS campaign and workflow design; audiences, deliveries, templates, personalization, channel configuration, data resources, imports/exports, APIs, and consent and subscription practices. Assessing ACS implementations and translating requirements to AEP/AJO design.
* Adobe Experience Platform - XDM modeling; schemas, datasets, identity namespaces and identity resolution; Real-Time Customer Profile concepts; batch and streaming ingestion; sources and destinations; segmentation; Query Service/data transformation; governance and consent considerations; sandboxes and environment strategy.
* Adobe Journey Optimizer - Journey and campaign design (action, API-triggered, orchestrated); unitary, business, and audience-based patterns; journey activities, conditions

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can work directly with multiple customers, acting as their product marketing partner and helping them translate business challenges into effective positioning, packaging, and demand generation strategies.
  
  
You'll collaborate with founders, CXOs, and marketing leaders at B2B SaaS companies to understand their markets, define compelling offers, develop differentiated messaging, and run marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline and business impact.
  
  
This role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll own product marketing programs end to end while identifying opportunities to build repeatable, scalable frameworks that can be adapted across customers facing similar challenges.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Product Packaging & Positioning: Work with our customers’ founders and CXOs to define product offerings, identify target audiences, sharpen differentiation, and develop compelling value propositions.
* Customer & Market Research: Engage with customers, prospects, sales teams, and other stakeholders to understand buyer needs, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and purchasing behaviour.
* Messaging & Go-to-Market Strategy: Translate research and business objectives into clear messaging, positioning frameworks, and GTM strategies that resonate with target buyers.
* Demand Generation: Plan, execute, and optimise integrated marketing programs across paid, SEO, organic, and social channels to generate demand and drive pipeline.
* Business Cases & Commercial Strategy: Help customer leadership evaluate growth opportunities, build business cases, and connect marketing initiatives to commercial outcomes.
* End-to-End Campaign Execution: Drive programs from strategy and planning through launch, measurement, and optimisation, collaborating with content, design, sales, and delivery teams.
* Scalable Marketing Programs: Develop modular playbooks and repeatable frameworks that can be adapted across multiple customers with similar business challenges.
* Content & Conversion Assets: Guide the development of landing pages, case studies, one-pagers, email sequences, and other assets that support positioning and buyer conversion.
* SEO & AEO: Improve content discoverability through traditional search and AI-powered answer engines.
* Performance & Reporting: Track campaign performance, evaluate pipeline contribution, and present actionable insights and recommendations to customer leadership.

****What success looks like****
Customers see measurable improvements in demand generation, conversion, and pipeline. Founders and CXOs trust you as a strategic partner who understands their business and can help them make better product marketing decisions. The programs you build are effective, repeatable, and scalable across customers with similar needs.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* Experience: 7–8 years of experience in product marketing, ideally working with US-based mid-market B2B SaaS companies selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers in the US.
* Product Marketing: Strong understanding of product packaging, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.
* Founder & CXO Engagement: Proven experience working directly with senior leaders to solve challenges related to positioning, demand generation, commercial strategy, and business cases.
* End-to-End Execution: Demonstrated ability to run product marketing and demand generation programs across paid, SEO, organic, and social channels, with measurable business impact.
* Systems Thinking: Ability to design modular programs, develop repeatable playbooks, and scale successful approaches across multiple customers.
* Commercial Acumen: Understanding of how marketing initiatives influence pipeline, conversion, and revenue, with the ability to connect strategy to business outcomes.
* Research & Insight: Strong customer research, competitive analysis, and market understanding, with the ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Communication: Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders.
* SEO & AEO: Understanding of search optimisation and content discoverability across search engines and AI-powered answer engines.
* Ownership & Execution: Comfortable managing multiple customers, navigating ambiguity, and balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Tools: Working knowledge of HubSpot, WordPress or other CMS platforms, Figma, analytics tools, and AI-assisted workflows is a plus.

****Why join us****

* Real business impact: Work on meaningful business challenges and directly influence how B2B companies position, market, and grow their offerings.
* Strategic ownership: Partner with founders and CXOs to shape product marketing strategy and execution.
* Variety and range: Work across multiple customers, industries, and GTM challenges while building expertise across the B2B SaaS ecosystem.
* Build for scale: Create reusable programs and frameworks that improve outcomes across customers rather than starting from scratch every time.
* A top-tier ecosystem: Work with a HubSpot Elite Partner serving ambitious businesses across global markets.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build, and the business outcomes you drive.

Founder and CTO

Engineering, product, finance, and external stakeholders

Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
  
  
Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
  
  
Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation.
  
  
Notre technologie commence avec vous.
  
  
**A propos de vos missions**

* Vous serez intégré(e) à l'équipe “Design Enablement” basée à Noida (Inde). Cette équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Design Flow & PDK basée à Crolles et à Grenoble (France) dont la mission est de fournir des livrables de plateformes technologiques aux divisions ST en charge de la conception de produits clients.
* L’un des principaux livrables est le Process Design Kit (PDK), qui répond aux enjeux de complexité technologique auxquels sont confrontés les clients.
* Vous serez responsable de la gestion de projets PDK pour certaines technologies, selon un processus bien défini, depuis la définition des spécifications jusqu’à la livraison, en assurant également le support des livrables PDK en fonction des demandes et des exigences des clients.
* Afin de bien comprendre les besoins de nos clients, le poste nécessitera de développer et d’élargir les différentes compétences techniques liées au produit PDK. Vous serez l’interface principale, de manière transverse, avec notre écosystème, les équipes de développement et les divisions ST afin de définir les spécifications, les ressources, la planification, la roadmap, le suivi des opérations (développement et validation) ainsi que le support pour les clients localisés en Asie principalement.
* Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes basées en Inde, en Italie et en France.

**A propos de vous**

* Compétences en gestion de projet : leadership, communication, interface transverse, gestion des priorités, des risques et du planning, définition de la roadmap, prise de décision, reporting, etc.
* Connaissance en design et technologie ; une bonne compréhension technique du produit PDK et du design flow serait un atout.
* Personne structurée, engagée, proactive et agile
* Très bonne maîtrise de l’anglais

ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025.
  
  
Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
  
  
Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
  
  
Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise.
  
  
Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.

title: Lead Business Analyst (Lead BA)
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Lead Business Analyst to join our Product Development team. This is a cross-client, cross-domain and multi-region role, requiring strong business acumen, Solution Design expertise and the ability to work effectively across Australian, UK and South Africa Regions.
  
  
The role will partner with Customers, Service Delivery Managers, Project Managers, Consultants, Product, Development, QA and Architecture teams to shape solutions and drive successful delivery.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end Business Analysis and Solution Design for complex product enhancements, client requirements and regulatory/business change.
* Work across multiple clients, domains and regions, rapidly understanding different business processes, regulatory requirements and client-specific needs.
* Perform cross-client, cross-domain and regional impact analysis, identifying dependencies, commonality, differences and opportunities for standardisation and reuse.
* Own high-quality Solution Designs / Business Solution Designs, translating complex business needs into scalable product solutions.
* Act as a key BA interface for Customers, Service Delivery Managers and Project Managers, managing requirements, priorities, scope, risks, dependencies and delivery expectations.
* Lead customer and stakeholder workshops, requirement discussions and solution walkthroughs, clearly communicating complex business and product concepts.
* Hands-on experience leveraging Generative AI/LLM tools across BA and SDLC activities, with the ability to develop effective prompts and reusable AI workflows, validate outputs, identify automation opportunities, and drive measurable improvements in productivity and quality.
* Partner with Product, Development, QA and Architecture teams across the SDLC, from requirements through UAT and release.
* Challenge requirements constructively, identify gaps and ambiguities, and recommend effective business and solution alternatives.
* Drive BA quality, governance, standardisation and continuous improvement across clients and domains.
* Mentor and coach Business Analysts and contribute to BA capability upliftment.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI, automation and process improvement to improve productivity, reduce effort and maintain/improve quality.

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 8+ years of Business Analysis experience in a software/product development environment.
* Exposure to the any of the Finance industries (Insurance, Investment banking, Capital Markets Superannuation, Pensions or UK wrap) is mandatory.
* Strong expertise in Business Analysis, Solution Design and Impact Assessment.
* Hands on experience in Software Testing/Business Analysis of multi-user software within a financial environment.
* Proven experience working across multiple clients, domains and/or geographical regions.
* Strong stakeholder management experience across Customers, Service Delivery Managers, Project Managers, Consultants and technical teams.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, influencing and presentation skills.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end SDLC and Agile delivery.
* Ability to quickly understand new domains, products and business processes and apply knowledge across different contexts.
* Experience mentoring/reviewing other Business Analysts and driving quality standards.
* Strong ownership, decision-making and ability to operate independently.

**Preferred Experience**

* Wealth Management / Portfolio Management / Financial Services.
* APAC and EMEA business and regulatory environments.
* Regulatory/legislative change and complex product ecosystems.
* Data, integrations, interfaces and cross-product impact assessment.
* Experience in leading AI adoption, creating reusable AI assets and coaching teams is highly desirable.
* CBAP certification
* RG 146 or relevant financial services certification is an advantage.

**Work Location**

* Office-based role in accordance with the organisation's current office working policy. This is not a permanent Work From Home position, and no permanent WFH exception is envisaged for this role.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Sr Solutions Consultant I
description:

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. We’re looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

title: 4809- Senior Manager- Product Designer
description:
**About the team**

Innovaccer builds AI agents for healthcare that automate administrative work, so care teams can get back to care. As a Senior Manager, you'll lead the team designing autonomous experiences for healthcare. You'll lead designers across related product areas, partner with product and engineering leaders to shape direction, and stay close to the work. Your impact will show up in the team you build, the quality of the experiences it ships, and the outcomes those experiences create.

**Product Management at Innovaccer**

The Product team at Innovaccer designs AI-native solutions for healthcare providers, payers, and government organizations: agentic workflows that automate complex clinical and operational processes, intelligent systems that replace manual work at scale, and data infrastructure that makes all of it possible. Every product decision here is a bet on what AI-native healthcare infrastructure needs to look like next, positioning Innovaccer as the autonomous operations platform leader.

If you think in systems, work well with ambiguity, and want your output to have real stakes, this team is where you will do your best work.

**Build and grow the team**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers through regular feedback, clear goals, and career conversations
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and team health. Build a team with diverse strengths and perspectives
* Plan design capacity with product and engineering, making clear choices about priorities and ownership
* Create a culture of trust, direct feedback, and accountability. Help designers grow their judgment and independence

**Shape product direction**

* Partner with product and engineering leaders to define problems, shape roadmaps, and agree on success measures across your product areas
* Use customer research, product data, and domain knowledge to challenge assumptions and guide decisions
* Bring coherence to data-dense clinical and operational workflows, including permissions

exceptions, and dependencies across products

* Favor small, testable releases. Measure usability, adoption, and task success, and improve the experience after launch

**Raise the craft bar**

* Lead specific, actionable critiques across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, accessibility, and content
* Stay hands-on when it helps the team move forward: pair on difficult problems, explore alternatives, and build prototypes
* Partner with engineering throughout implementation to protect quality, resolve tradeoffs, and address edge cases
* Strengthen shared components and patterns across Figma and code. Help teams reuse and contribute to the design system

**Evolve how we design with AI**

* Use AI tools such as Claude to explore ideas, prototype workflows, and shorten feedback loops. Help the team develop effective practices
* Guide AI-assisted experiences that make system behavior clear, support human review, and handle uncertainty, errors, and recovery
* Stay close to model capabilities and constraints, testing real behavior with engineering rather than relying only on static mockups
* Keep design reviews, documentation, and collaboration useful and lightweight as tools and ways of working evolve

  
  
**Requirements**  

### **What You'll Need**

* 8+ years in product design, including 3+ years directly managing designers, with evidence of helping people grow and perform
* A portfolio showing complex products shipped, your leadership contribution, and the customer or business outcomes achieved
* Strong product judgment, taste, and care for detail. You can explain what needs to improve and help a team get there
* Experience shaping priorities with product and engineering leaders and making clear tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
* Systems thinking and experience building coherent experiences across products
* Practical use of AI in your design workflow and comfort with Figma, interactive prototypes, and technical conversations with engineers
* Clear communication and the ability to influence across teams, resolve disagreements, and connect design decisions to user needs

Nice to have

* Experience designing for healthcare, regulated, or other complex enterprise products
* Experience shipping AI-assisted or agentic experiences
* Ability to prototype, with or without AI assistance
* Experience improving design-system adoption, team workflows, and collaboration

  
  
**Benefits**

Here's What We Offer

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends to the office. \*Noida office only
* Creche Facility for children\*: A convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices

Where and how we work

Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer: Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR

department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

About Innovaccer

Innovaccer Inc. is the data platform that accelerates innovation. The Innovaccer platform unifies patient data across systems and care settings, and empowers healthcare organizations with scalable, modern applications that improve clinical, financial, operational, and experiential outcomes. Innovaccer’s EHR-agnostic solutions have been deployed across more than 1,600

hospitals and clinics in the US, enabling care delivery transformation for more than 96,000 clinicians, and helping providers work collaboratively with payers and life sciences companies.

Innovaccer has helped its customers unify health records for more than 54 million people and generate over $1.5 billion in cumulative cost savings. The Innovaccer platform is the #1 rated Best-in-KLAS data and analytics platform by KLAS, and the #1 rated population health technology platform by Black Book. For more information, please visit innovaccer.com.

Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, and innovaccer.com.

title: PPC Manager
description:

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **PPC-first Digital Marketing professional** who can independently plan, execute, optimize, and scale paid marketing campaigns across Google, Meta, and other digital platforms.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in **performance marketing, PPC, SEM, SEO, analytics, conversion tracking, and digital strategy**, with the ability to drive measurable business growth and maximize ROI.

**PPC & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute, and manage paid campaigns across **Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)**.

* Manage daily and monthly campaign budgets and ensure effective budget utilization.
* Set up and optimize **retargeting, remarketing, custom, and lookalike audiences**.

* Track leads, bookings, enquiries, revenue, and other key conversion events.
* Create and maintain performance dashboards and regular marketing reports.
* Analyze customer journeys and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Monitor campaign attribution and ensure accurate tracking across platforms.

**Digital Marketing Strategy**

* Develop comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business and revenue goals.
* Identify new acquisition channels, audiences, and growth opportunities.
* Analyze customer behaviour, market trends, and competitor activities.
* Develop strategies for **travel lead generation, tour bookings, and activity sales**.
* Understand destination-based targeting and seasonality within the travel industry.
* Continuously test new platforms, audiences, creatives, and campaign strategies.
* Present campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **6–15 years of hands-on experience** in PPC, SEM, Performance Marketing, or Digital Marketing.
* Strong practical experience with **Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager**.
* Excellent understanding of **Google Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, and remarketing campaigns**.
* Strong knowledge of **PPC bidding strategies, keyword targeting, audience targeting, conversion optimization, and campaign scaling**.
* Experience with **GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and conversion tracking**.
* Strong understanding of **SEO, SEM, keyword research, link building, on-page and off-page optimization**.
* Experience in managing marketing budgets and optimizing campaigns for **ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, and conversions**.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Excellent understanding of digital marketing funnels and customer acquisition.
* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word**.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in the **travel, tourism, hospitality, OTA, or e-commerce industry**.
* Experience targeting **Australia or other international markets**.
* Experience with tour packages, travel bookings, activities, or travel lead-generation campaigns.
* Knowledge of **SEMrush, Ahrefs, Hotjar, Looker Studio, or similar marketing tools**.
* Experience with landing-page optimization and CRO.
* Experience managing high-budget performance marketing campaigns.

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About OneMetric**
-------------------

OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.

As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.

**Who we're hiring for**
------------------------

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can work directly with multiple customers, acting as their product marketing partner and helping them translate business challenges into effective positioning, packaging, and demand generation strategies.

You'll collaborate with founders, CXOs, and marketing leaders at B2B SaaS companies to understand their markets, define compelling offers, develop differentiated messaging, and run marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline and business impact.

This role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll own product marketing programs end to end while identifying opportunities to build repeatable, scalable frameworks that can be adapted across customers facing similar challenges.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Product Packaging & Positioning:** Work with our customers’ founders and CXOs to define product offerings, identify target audiences, sharpen differentiation, and develop compelling value propositions.
* **Customer & Market Research:** Engage with customers, prospects, sales teams, and other stakeholders to understand buyer needs, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and purchasing behaviour.
* **Messaging & Go-to-Market Strategy:** Translate research and business objectives into clear messaging, positioning frameworks, and GTM strategies that resonate with target buyers.
* **Demand Generation**: Plan, execute, and optimise integrated marketing programs across paid, SEO, organic, and social channels to generate demand and drive pipeline.
* **Business Cases & Commercial Strategy:** Help customer leadership evaluate growth opportunities, build business cases, and connect marketing initiatives to commercial outcomes.
* **End-to-End Campaign Execution**: Drive programs from strategy and planning through launch, measurement, and optimisation, collaborating with content, design, sales, and delivery teams.
* **Scalable Marketing Programs:** Develop modular playbooks and repeatable frameworks that can be adapted across multiple customers with similar business challenges.
* **Content & Conversion Assets:** Guide the development of landing pages, case studies, one-pagers, email sequences, and other assets that support positioning and buyer conversion.
* **SEO & AEO:** Improve content discoverability through traditional search and AI-powered answer engines.
* **Performance & Reporting:** Track campaign performance, evaluate pipeline contribution, and present actionable insights and recommendations to customer leadership.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Customers see measurable improvements in demand generation, conversion, and pipeline. Founders and CXOs trust you as a strategic partner who understands their business and can help them make better product marketing decisions. The programs you build are effective, repeatable, and scalable across customers with similar needs.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** 7–8 years of experience in product marketing, ideally working with US-based mid-market B2B SaaS companies selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers in the US.
* **Product Marketing:** Strong understanding of product packaging, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.
* **Founder & CXO Engagement:** Proven experience working directly with senior leaders to solve challenges related to positioning, demand generation, commercial strategy, and business cases.
* **End-to-End Execution:** Demonstrated ability to run product marketing and demand generation programs across paid, SEO, organic, and social channels, with measurable business impact.
* **Systems Thinking:** Ability to design modular programs, develop repeatable playbooks, and scale successful approaches across multiple customers.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Understanding of how marketing initiatives influence pipeline, conversion, and revenue, with the ability to connect strategy to business outcomes.
* **Research & Insight:** Strong customer research, competitive analysis, and market understanding, with the ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.
* **Communication:** Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders.
* **SEO & AEO:** Understanding of search optimisation and content discoverability across search engines and AI-powered answer engines.
* **Ownership & Execution:** Comfortable managing multiple customers, navigating ambiguity, and balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* **Tools:** Working knowledge of HubSpot, WordPress or other CMS platforms, Figma, analytics tools, and AI-assisted workflows is a plus.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **Real business impact:** Work on meaningful business challenges and directly influence how B2B companies position, market, and grow their offerings.
* **Strategic ownership:** Partner with founders and CXOs to shape product marketing strategy and execution.
* **Variety and range:** Work across multiple customers, industries, and GTM challenges while building expertise across the B2B SaaS ecosystem.
* **Build for scale:** Create reusable programs and frameworks that improve outcomes across customers rather than starting from scratch every time.
* **A top-tier ecosystem:** Work with a HubSpot Elite Partner serving ambitious businesses across global markets.
* **Outcomes over hours:** We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build, and the business outcomes you drive.
