title: Brand Manager
description:
**Company:**
UltraCare PRO (Zealmax Innovations Pvt. Ltd.)

**Experience:**
5-7 years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Why this role exists-**

UltraCare PRO already sells across marketplaces, quick commerce and our own website. The next step is to become a brand people look for by name and recommend to others.

Your mandate is to grow the brand organically, in both brand equity and revenue. We want growth that lasts: demand that compounds through search, content, community and word of mouth, not revenue that only grows when ad spend does.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the direction for four teams and stay close enough to the work to write a brief yourself, give sharp feedback on a design, or work out why a page lost its ranking.

**What you'll own**

**Brand strategy**

•        Build and run a 12-month brand and organic growth plan, with targets for brand demand and organic revenue.

•        Define what UltraCare PRO stands for and how it looks and sounds, in a brand system every team works from.

•        Set a clear architecture for the master brand and its sub-brands, so each has a job and the core brand gets stronger.

•        Keep the brand consistent wherever customers meet it: website, marketplace listings, quick commerce, packaging, social and ads.

**SEO**

•        Own SEO for our website end to end, from technical health to content and backlinks, and judge it on revenue, not just traffic.

•        Grow branded search on Google and the marketplaces, and track our share of search against competitors.

**Content**

•        Build an education-led content engine. Many people still don't know what a TENS machine does or which device is right for them, so clear explainers do a lot of the selling.

•        Turn reviews, customer stories and expert voices such as physiotherapists into content people trust.

**Social media**

•        Own organic social: strategy, calendar, formats and community management.

•        Run creator partnerships that build credibility and drive sales, and measure them properly.

**Design**

•        Lead the design team and raise the bar on quality and turnaround.

•        Keep performance marketing, marketplace and quick commerce teams supplied with on-brand creative, and feed back what's working.

**Team and collaboration**

•        Hire, coach and grow your teams, with clear goals and regular reviews.

•        Work closely with performance marketing, ecommerce, quick commerce and D2C so brand and performance pull in the same direction.

•        Brief and manage agencies and freelancers where they add speed or skill.

**Measurement**

•        Report monthly on branded search, share of search, organic traffic and revenue, social engagement, and ratings and reviews.

•        Show how organic growth improves blended MER over time, so each rupee we spend brings back more revenue.

**What success looks like**

We'll judge this role on organic revenue and brand demand, not on how much content goes out

•        Organic channels bring in a clearly larger share of revenue.

•        Branded search is up on Google and on the marketplaces.

•        Our website ranks for the searches that matter in our categories, and that traffic converts.

•        UltraCare PRO looks and sounds like one brand wherever customers find it.

•        The team is stronger than when you joined.

**What you'll bring**

**Must have**

•        5 to 7 years in brand, content or growth marketing, working on consumer brands.

•        Hands-on experience scaling a brand. You can walk us through what you did yourself, what changed and which numbers moved.

•        Working knowledge of design, content, social media and SEO.

•        Experience leading a team, and you enjoy developing people.

•        Comfort with data. You set targets, track them in tools like GA4, Search Console and marketplace dashboards, and act on what they show.

•        Strong taste in design and writing, and the ability to explain your feedback.

•        You think about revenue as well as reach.

**Good to have**

•        D2C experience. It's a strong plus but not a requirement, so if you've scaled a brand in another setting, we'd still like to hear from you.

•        Experience in health, wellness, personal care or consumer electronics.

•        Comfort communicating health benefits responsibly, within ASCI and regulatory guidelines.

•        An understanding of how brand strength shows up in marketplace and quick commerce sales.

**Why join us**

•        
**Real ownership.**
Four teams, a clear mandate and a direct say in how the brand grows.

•        
**Demand to build on.**
Our products already sell on India's biggest marketplaces and quick commerce apps, so you're not starting from zero.

•        
**Room to lead the category.**
Many customers are still learning what these devices can do. The brand that explains best and earns the most trust can pull ahead.

•   
**Work that matters.**
Our products help people with aches and pains they deal with every day.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform (AdTech)
description:
**Job Description**
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who is technical, data-driven, and energized by hard problems. The ideal candidate relentlessly pursues product-market fit, is comfortable with the ambiguity of building, and executes with discipline. You take ownership of an area end-to-end and you measure success by customer outcomes, not features shipped.
  
  
**Your Mandate**
Based in Ahmedabad, you'll own one of the core platform capabilities. These are the reusable building blocks the entire product depends on — so the quality, reliability, and reusability of what you ship is felt across every vertical.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap and end-to-end execution of your capability area — from discovery through delivery, iterating relentlessly on data and customer feedback.

**Execution & Ownership**

title: Project Coordinator (Delivery Enablement & Cross-Pod Coordination)
description:
**Job Role**
We are in need of an experienced Project Coordinator to serve as the connective tissue across multiple pods. This role sits at the intersection of planning, execution, and people—enabling every pod to deliver predictably, removing obstacles before they become blockers, and keeping the entire delivery engine running in sync.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in high-velocity, multi-team environments, has a natural instinct for process, and brings a collaborative energy that makes every pod they touch more effective.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cross-Pod/Business units Roadmap Chase & Delivery Tracking
* Maintain a consolidated view of roadmap items across all pods, tracking progress against committed timelines.
* Proactively chase open action items, pending decisions, and deliverables with pod leads and team members.
* Ensure roadmap milestones are visible, understood, and actively worked towards at all times.
* Flag slippages early and escalate with context to the right stakeholders.
* Jira + Other tools -Collaborative Hygiene & Delivery Practice Adherence
* Champion and enforce Jira usage standards—ensuring tickets are created, updated, estimated, and closed per agreed delivery practices.
* Audit sprint boards across pods regularly to identify stale tickets, missing acceptance criteria, unlinked dependencies, and velocity anomalies.
* Run regular hygiene drives and provide guidance to pod members on correct Jira workflows.
* Generate and distribute sprint/delivery health reports from Jira to keep leadership informed.
* Blocker Identification & Resolution Follow-up
* Maintain a live blockers register across all pods—tracking each blocker's owner, age, and resolution status.
* Facilitate cross-pod and cross-functional conversations needed to unblock teams (engineering, product, design, QA, infra).
* Escalate unresolved blockers to the appropriate level with clear context and a proposed path forward.
* Track recurrence patterns of blockers and recommend systemic improvements to reduce repeat issues.
* On-time Delivery Facilitation
* Drive release readiness checklists and pre-delivery coordination across pods.
* Coordinate go/no-go discussions, ensuring all dependencies are met before delivery milestones.
* Maintain a forward-looking calendar of planned deliveries, releases, and key ceremonies.
* Work closely with QA, DevOps, and product teams to align on delivery gates and ensure smooth handoffs.
* Pod-level Delivery Practice Coaching
* Observe pod ceremonies (standups, planning, retrospectives) and provide lightweight coaching on best practices.
* Help pods adopt and consistently follow agile/scrum delivery practices as defined by the delivery framework.
* Identify pods that need extra support and proactively engage with their leads.
* Create and maintain delivery playbooks and reference guides for pods to self-serve.
* Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
* Produce weekly delivery health dashboards summarising pod-level status, upcoming deliveries, and risk flags.
* Serve as the escalation point of contact for delivery-related queries from product owners and leadership.
* Facilitate cross-pod syncs and dependency reviews to ensure alignment on shared timelines.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 5+ years in a project coordination, delivery management role
* Proven experience working with multiple parallel teams or pods
* Strong hands-on Jira expertise—including board configuration, reporting, and workflow management
* Excellent written and verbal communication for cross-functional stakeholder management
* Demonstrated ability to manage blockers and drive accountability without direct authority
* Comfort working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments
* Structured approach to tracking and follow-ups with attention to detail

Good to Have
  
  

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM) or equivalent agile training
* Prior experience in a software product or technology delivery organisation
* Familiarity with Confluence or similar documentation platforms
* Experience producing delivery dashboards using Jira filters/reports or BI tools
* Understanding of SDLC and release management practices
* Exposure to OKR or outcome-based planning frameworks

We’re looking for a creative, organised Digital Media Marketing Manager to plan and manage Digital media activity across Client’s brands. The ideal candidate has strong command of English, understands the US audience, and can create clear, engaging content that supports brand growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage digital activities.
* Write, review and edit captions, posts, stories and campaign copy in excellent English.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors and other team members to produce content.
* Monitor comments, messages and social media trends, and recommend timely responses.
* Track engagement and campaign performance, prepare reports and suggest improvements.
* Ensure content follows each brand’s tone, guidelines and platform requirements.
* Build promotional calendars around US holidays, local events, seasonality and retail offers.
* Present performance reports with clear insights, corrective actions and growth opportunities.
* Ensure campaigns follow applicable advertising policies, category restrictions and internal approval processes.
* Manage external agencies and advertising partners where required.
* Coordinate with US-based teams during the night shift.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven experience in social media marketing or a similar role.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with strong grammar and editing skills.
* Understanding of major social media platforms and content formats.
* Strong planning, communication and coordination skills.
* Familiarity with social media analytics and scheduling tools.
* Proven experience managing performance campaigns for the US market.
* Good creative judgment and the ability to write clear briefs and evaluate campaign assets.
* Willingness to work night shifts aligned with US time zones.
* A portfolio or examples of previous social media work is preferred.
* Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business or a related field.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with multi-location retail, e-commerce product categories.
* Familiarity with CRM, loyalty programs, email/SMS marketing and retail sales attribution.
* Experience coordinating with US teams and managing multiple brands simultaneously.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

----------------

title: Marketing Manager - B2B Demand Generation (SEO, Paid Ads, HubSpot)
description:
**About company**
-----------------

Aubergine is a **global transformation and innovation partner**, shaping next-gen digital products through consulting-informed execution that integrates strategy, design, and development.

Since 2013, we've built **400+ B2B and B2C products worldwide**, turning powerful ideas into impact-driven experiences. We are one of the **top global B2B companies on Clutch**, rated highest among more than 80,000 technology service providers.

With more than **150 digital thinkers**, we are home to some of the brightest, most passionate people around the world who are committed to delivering excellence.

We’re not just another workplace. We’re officially **Great Place To Work® certified**, with an exceptional trust index rating, making Aubergine a community where you can thrive and grow.

**Read this first**

This is a hands-on demand generation role. You will be measured on qualified leads (MQLs) and the sales pipeline they create, not on traffic, followers, or impressions.

Please apply only if **all** of these are true for you:

  

* You have personally run SEO and paid campaigns yourself, not only briefed an agency or a team.
* You have been accountable for a lead or pipeline number for at least 3 years.
* You have marketed a B2B company to buyers in the US or Europe.

This role is **not** a fit if your experience is mainly social media, brand, or content only, B2C or D2C, or agency-side campaign execution for multiple clients.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the lead number.** Define what counts as an MQL with the sales team, set targets, and report monthly on leads, pipeline, and cost per qualified lead.
* **Run SEO hands-on.** Technical audits, keyword-to-page mapping, content briefs that rank and convert, and Google Search Console.
* **Run paid campaigns yourself.** Plan, launch, test, and stop Google and LinkedIn Ads with clear budgets, stop rules, and tracking.
* **Own marketing operations in HubSpot.** Lifecycle stages, lead scoring, workflows, and source attribution, so leadership can trust the numbers.
* **Improve website conversion.** Shape the ongoing website rebuild, so it brings in enquiries, not just visitors.
* **Sharpen our messaging.** Turn broad positioning into specific messages for US and European buyers with real problems.
* **Run the content calendar** with the marketing team and external partners.
* **Work with, not over, the team.** You'll set direction and also do a lot of the work yourself, from the plan to the deck that's due this week.

**What you'll need**

* 68 years in B2B marketing, ideally at an IT services, product engineering, or B2B SaaS company of 100500 people.
* At least 3 years personally accountable for leads or pipeline.
* Hands-on SEO and paid media experience. You know your past cost per qualified lead without opening a dashboard.
* Working command of HubSpot or a similar CRM.
* Work that built a company's reputation, and work that produced leads sales was glad to receive.
* Enough practical understanding of AI to tell a real capability from a demo.
* Clear written English, good enough to edit other people's work.
* No specific degree required.

**How we hire**

* HR screening call
* A short written assignment: a 2-page, 90-day marketing plan for aubergine.co. We grade thinking and prioritisation, not design.
* Technical interview
* Culture fit interview
* HR discussion, references and document checks

**What we offer**

* 5-day work week and flexible timings
* Competitive salary with performance incentives
* Company-sponsored certifications
* Flat hierarchy and a friendly, capable team
* Sports tournaments and team activities

**Explore:** http://aubergine.co

title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator
description:
**Company:** JRM Export Private Limited  
**Brand:** hepn  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-time

About hepn

hepn is a growing consumer food brand focused on making healthier everyday food choices more accessible without compromising on taste.

We are looking for a **creative, hands-on Social Media Manager & Content Creator** who can help us build a strong and distinctive brand presence across Instagram and other digital platforms.

This is not a role where you will simply schedule posts or follow a predefined content calendar.

We want someone who can **think of ideas, create content, shoot videos, write scripts/captions, edit reels, design creatives, follow trends and continuously experiment with new ways to grow the brand.**

What You'll Do

* Develop creative content ideas for Instagram, Reels, Stories and other social platforms
* Plan and manage hepn's monthly and weekly content calendar
* Write engaging captions, scripts, hooks and social media copy
* Shoot high-quality product, lifestyle and social media content
* Edit short-form videos and Reels
* Create social media posts, stories and creatives using Canva or similar tools
* Come up with interesting campaigns, concepts, trends and content series for the brand
* Turn simple brand/product ideas into engaging social media content
* Stay updated with Instagram trends, memes, audio trends and emerging content formats
* Coordinate product shoots and create content around launches, offers, events and campaigns
* Engage with the audience through comments, DMs and community-oriented content
* Monitor content performance and understand what type of content is working
* Experiment with different hooks, formats, storytelling styles and creative concepts
* Work closely with the founders/team to develop HEPN's overall social media personality

Skills We're Looking For

You should be comfortable with most of the following:

* **Content Writing & Copywriting**
* **Reels / Short-form Video Editing**
* **Basic Photography & Videography**
* **Content Shooting using a smartphone/camera**
* **Canva Designing**
* Instagram content creation
* Storytelling and script writing
* Understanding of social media trends
* Basic social media analytics
* Strong visual and creative sense

Experience with tools such as **Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Photoshop or similar tools** is an advantage.

Bonus Skills

These are not mandatory, but will be a major plus:

* Meta Ads / Facebook & Instagram Advertising
* Google Ads
* Influencer marketing
* Performance marketing
* SEO / digital marketing knowledge
* Experience working with D2C, FMCG, food or lifestyle brands
* Experience managing brand collaborations
* Understanding of e-commerce marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

* **Highly creative and full of ideas**
* Comfortable experimenting instead of simply copying competitors
* Someone who naturally notices interesting content, trends and campaigns
* Able to take an idea from **concept → script → shoot → edit → publish**
* Comfortable appearing behind or occasionally in front of the camera when required
* Detail-oriented about how content looks and feels
* Fast-moving and able to create content consistently
* Interested in building a brand, not just managing a social media account
* Proactive—you should be able to come to us with ideas rather than always waiting for instructions

You don't necessarily need many years of experience.

**A strong portfolio, creativity and the ability to actually create good content matter more to us than the number of years on your resume.**

What We'd Like to See When You Apply

Please share:

* Your resume
* Instagram/social media accounts you have managed
* Reels/videos you have created
* Designs or Canva creatives you have made
* Any campaigns, brands or personal content you are proud of

**Bonus:** Tell us 2–3 content ideas you would create for hepn if you joined us.

We are looking for someone who wants to **experiment, create and help build a memorable consumer brand from the ground up.**

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hepn.in/  
Website: https://hepn.in

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* Social Media: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

The ideal candidate will possess 3 to 8 years of relevant experience for Senior level a strong understanding of the insurance industry, and exceptional consulting skills. **Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage consulting projects for US group benefit and retirement clients, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze client needs, develop tailored solutions, and implement best practices.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities within the insurance sector.
* Develop and present comprehensive reports and recommendations to clients, showcasing insights and actionable strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their business challenges and providing expert guidance.
* Mentor and support junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Stay updated on industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging trends to provide informed consulting services.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Full-time MBA from a reputable institution.
* 3 to 8 years of experience in business consulting, with a focus on the insurance sector, particularly group benefits and retirement.
* Strong domain knowledge of insurance process, products, regulations, and market dynamics.
* Proven consulting skills, including project management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong client management skills, with a focus on building lasting relationships and delivering exceptional service.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Vice President - Product Engineering
description:
**Role: Vice President — Product Engineering**
**Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore**
**About AppViewX:**
AppViewX is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry’s most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
  
  

* **We Do What We Say:**
  We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:**
  We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:**
  We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:**
  We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
  
  
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

**What We Require**
***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

**Why AppViewX?**
AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
  
  
AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

description:
**ABOUT MARKETING & SALES DEPARTMENT**

The Marketing & Sales division at DHL Global Forwarding serves as a crucial link between clients and various operational and product departments. Its primary objectives include acquiring new business opportunities while also ensuring the retention of existing clientele.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As the Business Development Manager, you will spearhead the expansion of the business by identifying and capitalizing on opportunities from both potential clients and our existing customer base. Beyond conventional sales, your role extends to creating SOPs, fostering inter-departmental collaboration, and harnessing the power of Sales360. Your key focus lies in comprehensively grasping customer requirements and harnessing DGF's freight forwarding proficiency to provide personalized solutions.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Sales Cycle Management**

* Lead the entire sales process from lead generation to successful conversion.
* Facilitate seamless payment processes to ensure timely closure of deals.
* Conduct regular reviews to monitor business performance and adjust strategies as necessary.
* Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline to achieve individual and team targets for profitable volume growth.
* Utilize DHL’s Sales360 application to enhance sales efficiency.

  

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Gain insights into customers' core requirements and offer tailored solutions to drive profitable business relationships.
* Proactively address service issues and resolve them in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with existing clients to increase their share of wallet through value-based selling.
* Identify and onboard new clients that align with our service offerings and values.
* Managing internal and external stakeholders to aid in the development of products and solutions that align with market demands.
* Collaborate with colleagues from product and customer service divisions to meet customer expectations effectively.
* Gain insights into customer requirements and propose tailored solutions to address their needs.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Building Sales Pipeline: Efficiently managing the sales pipeline from lead generation to closure, ensuring timely follow-ups and conversions.
* Product Knowledge: Deep understanding of products like Air and Ocean, enabling effective communication of value propositions to clients.
* Sales Tools Utilization: Utilizing Sales360 tool effectively to track sales activities, manage customer relationships, and enhance productivity.
* Customer Focus: Dedication to understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions that exceed expectations.

  

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Resilience: Ability to handle rejection, setbacks, and pressure inherent in sales roles, maintaining a positive attitude and determination.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

**Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree is required.
* 5-6 years of hands-on experience in sales roles, preferably within the freight forwarding, shipping, or logistics sectors.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey ideas, negotiate deals, and address concerns effectively.

**Preferred**

* Post-graduate degree with a focus on sales/marketing.
* Experience of working at a multinational freight forwarding company.

title: Program Manager
description:
We need a hands-on Program Manager who can build and run plans across multiple engineering groups and projects — not a coordinator who only collects status. Will work in Kochi with US-based leadership, persist through ambiguity, and make progress visible when teams do not share a single backlog or manager.

Will use Jira as the system of record and AI to help build, maintain, and report on project and program plans. Comfortable in both Agile delivery and standard project management, and you can present status clearly to executives.

This is a program-level seat: several workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders. You get into the work — plans, risks, Jira hygiene, follow-through — rather than managing the process from a distance.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain program and project plans: scope, milestones, dependencies, owners, and dates.
* Keep plans current as engineering work moves Use Jira as the live plan.
* Structure epics, versions, and dashboards so status is pulled from the work, not rebuilt in slides.
* Use AI to draft, update, and report on plans while keeping them verified.
* Work across multiple engineering groups and projects.
* Translate between teams that operate differently Chase dependencies and decisions until they land.
* Run a reliable status rhythm.
* Produce executive-ready updates: progress, risks, asks, and what changed Present, do not only email a deck.
* Surface risks early, drive mitigation, and do not drop issues across teams. Tenacious close-the-loop ownership.
* Apply Agile where teams sprint, and standard project management where programs need milestones, gates, and integrated plans. Do not force one method on every workstream.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years' experience managing projects and operating at program level: multiple workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders — not only a single team sprint board.
* At least 2 years hands-on with Jira. Building and reporting on plans (epics, roadmaps or equivalent, filters, dashboards).
* You configure and maintain the plan; you do not wait for someone else to update tickets.
* Some experience using AI in project management; (build, maintain, and report on project plans, with human review).
* Experienced with Agile delivery and standard project management (schedules, milestones, RAID/risk logs, integrated plans).
* Comfortable with executive presentations and status: concise, current, and clear on asks.Soft skills and working access to operate across groups that are not one org chart.
* Builds trust, gets information, and keeps work moving without formal authority over every team. Hands-on and tenacious.
* Based in Kochi; collaborates with US-based leadership and local engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical background in software engineering (or equivalent) — enough to understand delivery, estimates, and dependencies on a Java/SaaS estate.
* Advanced Roadmaps, Structure, Automation, or similar.Confluence for program docs and decision logs.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent — credentials do not replace hands-on plan ownership. Healthcare IT, ambulatory, or similarly regulated product delivery.
* Comfortable overlapping US morning for executive status. Or mid-shift (although not required)

**Experience:2+ Years**

**Location: Kochi**

title: Product Manager - Flex Platform
description:
**Job Title: Product Manager - Flex Platform**

**Location: Kochi or Bengaluru, India**

**Permanent - Full time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Flex Platform team, a cross-functional product organization responsible for building the shared platform capabilities, workflows, and services that power Cyncly's products globally.

You will own a defined product area end-to-end from understanding customer problems and shaping the product strategy through prioritization, delivery, launch, and measuring outcomes.

This role is ideal for a PM who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with customers and engineering teams, and turning complex business needs into simple, scalable product experiences. Areas may include business workflows, CRM, payments, integrations, data and analytics, platform services, AI-enabled capabilities, or other emerging platform opportunities.

**About the Team**

The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for your pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

We believe PMs should own outcomes rather than simply manage backlogs. You will have the autonomy to determine what problem to solve, why it matters, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**

**Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand customer, user, and business problems through research, data, and stakeholder insights.
* Define problems clearly before committing to solutions.
* Develop product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed product trade-offs.
* Translate business strategy and customer needs into a clear product vision and roadmap for your area.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities that can scale across products, customers, and markets.

**Product Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with engineering.
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
* Make day-to-day product decisions and resolve ambiguity quickly.
* Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business value, and time-to-market.
* Ensure that products are delivered with the right level of quality, usability, and scalability.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Regularly engage with customers and users to validate problems and solutions.
* Partner with business unit leaders, customer success, sales, and other internal stakeholders.
* Build alignment across teams and communicate product decisions clearly.
* Represent the needs of your product area in quarterly planning and roadmap discussions.

**Outcomes & Continuous Improvement**

* Define measurable outcomes for the products and capabilities you own.
* Track adoption, usage, customer value, and business impact after launch.
* Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate manual processes, and improve customer productivity.

**Cross-Platform Collaboration**

* Work across Flex Platform pods when your product area has dependencies on integrations, APIs, data, AI, payments, or other shared capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage existing platform capabilities rather than building duplicate solutions.
* Help shape platform standards and reusable capabilities that benefit multiple Cyncly products.

**Go-to-Market & Communication**

* Partner with GTM, business units, and customer-facing teams to prepare products for launch.
* Communicate product changes, value propositions, and release plans clearly.
* Support customer and internal enablement for significant product launches.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 3 - 5 years of product management experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Strong customer-first mindset and experience conducting customer or user discovery.
* Comfortable owning and prioritizing a backlog without relying on a dedicated Product Owner.
* Strong product judgment and ability to make trade-offs in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product requirements, user stories, stakeholder communications, and product narratives.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering and understanding technical concepts, APIs, integrations, data, and platform architecture.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfortable working across multiple products, business units, geographies, and time zones.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to define and use product metrics to evaluate success.
* Ownership mentality, you take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building platform products, shared services, or reusable capabilities.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise applications, or vertical SaaS.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, data platforms, analytics, or workflow automation.
* Experience working with AI-enabled products or automation.
* Experience launching products across multiple markets or geographies.
* Experience working in an autonomous, cross-functional product pod or squad model.
* Experience with PLG, self-service products, or SaaS growth models.

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)
description:
**Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)**
**About The Company**
Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award-winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks. They are a Kochi-based deep-tech company building underwater robots for places people can’t safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are expanding our product portfolio, and we need a hands-on product leader to take the next generation of robots from idea to field-ready product.
  
  
**The role**
You will own the new product development pipeline and report to the CTO. This is not a pure research role, and it is not a sustaining-engineering role for existing products. You will turn emerging customer and mission needs into new, reliable, manufacturable robotic products. You will lead a multi-disciplinary team through concept, prototype, field trials and handover to production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the new-product roadmap with the CTO and CEO, based on customer needs, market gaps and technology feasibility.
* Run new-product programs end to end: requirements, architecture, prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Lead and mentor a multi-disciplinary team across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Run proof-of-concept and prototype cycles quickly, with clear go/no-go gates so that experiments don’t drift into commitments.
* Set up disciplined testing: lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Feed every failure back into the design.
* Keep production handovers clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales and customers on feasibility, estimates and early pilots for new products, and manage scope on custom requests.
* Manage program budgets, vendors, partners and component choices, including obsolescence and single-source risks.
* Contribute to IP creation and protection (patents, design records, documentation).
* Work closely with the existing product, production and field teams so that new products build on proven platforms.

**You might be a fit if you have**

* 8–12 years of experience in engineering and R&D, including 3+ years leading teams or programs.
* Experience at a robotics or drone company (UAV, UGV, marine or other autonomous systems), with new products taken from concept to field deployment.
* Hands-on depth in at least one core discipline (mechanical, electronics, embedded, controls or software) and enough breadth to lead across all of them.
* Experience with prototyping, validation, field trials and the move to manufacturing.
* Familiarity with sensors, navigation, communications and autonomy stacks (a strong plus).
* Exposure to defence, government or other high-reliability product requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, aerospace, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.

**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**

* You have reviewed the current new-product pipeline, team capacity, technical risks and key-person dependencies.
* A prioritised new-product portfolio is agreed, with owners, milestones and go/no-go gates.
* At least one priority program has a validated architecture and a working prototype in test.
* A repeatable prototype-to-field-trial-to-handover process is in place.
* A regular review cadence surfaces risks early for the CTO and leadership.

**What This Role Is Not**
It isn’t research detached from delivery, a role where every design decision runs through you, a pure project coordination role without technical ownership, or a firefighting role for existing products.
  
  
**Why join**
You will build the next generation of robotics for some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders and CTO, and own new products from first sketch to the field.
  
  
**Location**
Kochi, Kerala. Full-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Corporate Innovation Lab Leader
description:
At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time-to-value on federal client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and consultants, building a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Partner with business development and capture teams to shape technical solutions, proposals, and win strategies for federal opportunities.
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI-enabled solutions.

**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.
* Track record of standing up new practice areas or capability centers from the ground up.

**About Reply**
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: ASP.NET Developer

description:

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

**Role Purpose**

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **Premier Banking** team.

As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans. You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions. Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Business Impact:**

  

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products.

**Client Management:**

  

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling.
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration:**

  

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence:**

  

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development:**

  

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**

  

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* For GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager
* For GCB 5: More than 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager.
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licenses and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

  

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

Additional Information

*Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.*

***You’ll achieve more at HSBC.***

title: Product Manager
description:
**Location: Kochi or Bengaluru, India**  
**Permanent - Full time**

**About Us**  
Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Flex Platform team, a cross-functional product organization responsible for building the shared platform capabilities, workflows, and services that power Cyncly's products globally.

You will own a defined product area end-to-end from understanding customer problems and shaping the product strategy through prioritization, delivery, launch, and measuring outcomes.

This role is ideal for a PM who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with customers and engineering teams, and turning complex business needs into simple, scalable product experiences. Areas may include business workflows, CRM, payments, integrations, data and analytics, platform services, AI-enabled capabilities, or other emerging platform opportunities.

**About the Team**  
The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for your pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

We believe PMs should own outcomes rather than simply manage backlogs. You will have the autonomy to determine what problem to solve, why it matters, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**  
**Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand customer, user, and business problems through research, data, and stakeholder insights.
* Define problems clearly before committing to solutions.
* Develop product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed product trade-offs.
* Translate business strategy and customer needs into a clear product vision and roadmap for your area.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities that can scale across products, customers, and markets.

**Product Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with engineering.
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
* Make day-to-day product decisions and resolve ambiguity quickly.
* Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business value, and time-to-market.
* Ensure that products are delivered with the right level of quality, usability, and scalability.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Regularly engage with customers and users to validate problems and solutions.
* Partner with business unit leaders, customer success, sales, and other internal stakeholders.
* Build alignment across teams and communicate product decisions clearly.
* Represent the needs of your product area in quarterly planning and roadmap discussions.

**Outcomes & Continuous Improvement**

* Define measurable outcomes for the products and capabilities you own.
* Track adoption, usage, customer value, and business impact after launch.
* Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate manual processes, and improve customer productivity.

**Cross-Platform Collaboration**

* Work across Flex Platform pods when your product area has dependencies on integrations, APIs, data, AI, payments, or other shared capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage existing platform capabilities rather than building duplicate solutions.
* Help shape platform standards and reusable capabilities that benefit multiple Cyncly products.

**Go-to-Market & Communication**

* Partner with GTM, business units, and customer-facing teams to prepare products for launch.
* Communicate product changes, value propositions, and release plans clearly.
Support customer and internal enablement for significant product launches.  

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 3 - 5 years of product management experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Strong customer-first mindset and experience conducting customer or user discovery.
* Comfortable owning and prioritizing a backlog without relying on a dedicated Product Owner.
* Strong product judgment and ability to make trade-offs in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product requirements, user stories, stakeholder communications, and product narratives.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering and understanding technical concepts, APIs, integrations, data, and platform architecture.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfortable working across multiple products, business units, geographies, and time zones.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to define and use product metrics to evaluate success.
Ownership mentality, you take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.  

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building platform products, shared services, or reusable capabilities.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise applications, or vertical SaaS.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, data platforms, analytics, or workflow automation.
* Experience working with AI-enabled products or automation.
* Experience launching products across multiple markets or geographies.
* Experience working in an autonomous, cross-functional product pod or squad model.
Experience with PLG, self-service products, or SaaS growth models.  

**Working for Us**  
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: Associate Project Manager-Consulting
description:
**Department – Global Business Service Consulting**
**Location – Novo Nordisk GBS, Bangalore, India**
**Your impact begins here**
As Associate Project Manager in GBS Consulting, you will help drive the strategic initiatives that shape how GBS supports Novo. You will support projects, lead some of your own, and turn ambiguous problems into clear recommendations that senior stakeholders can act on. Working across research, development, regulatory, commercial and corporate areas, you will help GBS move with clarity and pace, so colleagues can focus on work that creates progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* A master’s degree and 2–5 years of management consulting experience in a leading consulting firm.
* The ability to structure and organise ambiguous problems, tasks and information, and to act independently.
* Experience solving strategic problems with standard consulting frameworks and turning the analysis into clear recommendations.
* Comfort with strategic frameworks and tools such as balanced scorecards, issue trees and scenario planning.
* Excellent Office 365 skills, especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
* Flexibility, and the ability to take on additional workload when projects need it.
* The ability to own and drive cross-functional initiatives with limited guidance from your manager.

**Useful, But Not Essential**
Experience with change management, or with the evolution and transformation of global business services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You will work alongside GBS Consulting project managers on the initiatives that matter most to GBS management and the affiliates, from supporting workstreams to leading projects as the need arises.
  
  

* Partner with global stakeholders, GBS colleagues and functional leaders on consulting projects across areas such as research, drug development, regulatory, medical affairs, safety, quality, supply chain, commercial and marketing.
* Run workshops that solve the problem at hand and help stakeholders reach decisions.
* Plan and track projects from scoping and design through validation and implementation: monitor progress, raise risks in the right forums and keep project documentation, such as agendas, minutes, memos and case studies, in order.
* Design solutions with stakeholders and build the tools, templates and governance cadence that help the team reach project milestones.
* Support General Management with GBS management meetings, including presentations, agendas and ad hoc analyses.
* Stay current on industry practice in change management and GBS transformation, and bring it into your projects, including through external meeting preparation and visits to peer companies where relevant.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will join GBS Consulting, an internal management consulting team within Finance, Legal & Global Solutions. The team works on strategic initiatives for GBS management and the affiliates, and offers high visibility and direct exposure to senior GBS leadership.
  
  
Your closest partners will be the other GBS Consulting project managers. You will also work with global stakeholders, including International Operations and HQ colleagues, the wider GBS organisation and functional leaders across the value chain. Many projects cross functions, so you will help bring different perspectives together, create clarity on priorities and keep decisions moving.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and work with limited guidance as you grow into the role. Working across functions gives you a broad view of how Novo operates, and the chance to build new skills on real projects alongside experienced colleagues. Clear expectations and a culture that rewards results mean your best work gets noticed.
  
  
**Start now**
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex problems into clear decisions for GBS, apply for the Associate Project Manager role by November 6, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
