description:
**Program Manager - First Mile / Middle Mile**
**About Blitz**
Blitz enables Same-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands to provide the best on-time delivery experiences to their customers. Blitz aims to simplify scalability & unlock the growth of new-age eCommerce brands by making Same-Day delivery more convenient, reliable & affordable. Same-Day Delivery helps brands with converting their browsers into buyers, serving as a competitive advantage and reducing working capital challenges. Blitz currently engages with enterprise brands with category focus into Fashion, Beauty & Personal Care and Healthcare; helping them with 30% - 40% increase in their website conversions & increasing retention by 2x by providing best in class experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Program Manager to drive initiatives across our first-mile and mid-mile network, covering the movement of goods from vendors to mother hubs and warehouses, and onward to dark stores. You will own programs that improve speed, cost, reliability, and scalability of inbound and line-haul operations, so that stores stay replenished on time in a high-velocity business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Plan and run first-mile and mid-mile programs end to end, from scoping and milestones to delivery and post-launch review.
* Maintain roadmaps, risk logs, and dependency trackers across Procurement, Warehousing, Transport, Finance, Tech, and Store Operations.
* Run weekly and monthly business reviews and give leadership clear updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

**First Mile Programs**

* Drive vendor pickup and inbound scheduling programs, including appointment booking, slot management, and dock-to-stock TAT improvement.
* Improve farm-to-hub and vendor-to-warehouse flows for fresh and perishable categories, with a focus on quality, wastage, and cold chain.
* Work with procurement on vendor delivery compliance, ASN accuracy, and inbound OTIF.

**Mid Mile Programs**

* Optimize line-haul and hub-to-dark-store movement through route planning, trip consolidation, and fleet utilization.
* Run transporter onboarding, rate contracts, and performance management programs (vehicle fill, TAT, damage, delivery adherence).
* Improve replenishment cycle times and cut-off adherence so stores receive stock before peak demand windows.

**Cost & Network Optimization**

* Reduce cost per kg / cost per case / cost per trip through route optimization, load planning, and vendor mix changes.
* Support network design decisions such as hub placement, cross-docking, and milk-run models.
* Build business cases and size savings for new initiatives.

**Process, Tech & Automation**

* Define requirements and work with product and tech teams on TMS, route optimization, vehicle tracking (GPS/telematics), and inbound/outbound visibility tools.
* Standardize SOPs for loading, unloading, seal and handover, GRN, and shortage/damage claims.
* Reduce manual effort and turnaround time through process redesign and automation.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Build dashboards and track KPIs: inbound TAT, trip utilization, cost per trip, on-time dispatch and delivery, shortage and damage rates.
* Use data to find bottlenecks, run root-cause analyses, and drive corrective actions.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to transport, safety, and statutory requirements (E-way bill, vehicle documentation, driver compliance, FSSAI for food movement).
* Manage transporter SLAs, penalties, claims, and dispute resolution.

**Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, transport operations, or program management, ideally in e-commerce, quick commerce, retail, FMCG, or 3PL.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent from a reputed institute preferred.
* Proven record of delivering cross-functional programs with measurable cost, speed, or reliability impact.

* Drive implementation of
  **B2B SaaS products**

* Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Establish project governance and reporting mechanisms.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

  **Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Operations**
  teams.
* Ensure smooth handover from Sales to Implementation.
* Align internal stakeholders on customer requirements, timelines, and dependencies.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful customer go-live.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

**Must-Have**

* **3–8 years of overall experience in Project Management / Program Management / Implementation.**
* Strong hands-on experience in BFSI
  **B2B SaaS implementation**
  or enterprise software delivery.
* Proven experience managing
  **Indian enterprise clients**
  and customer stakeholders.
* Prior experience in
  **team management**
  , including leading and mentoring project/implementation teams.
* Strong experience managing
  **end-to-end implementation projects**
  with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and client-facing capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Comfortable working
  **full-time from the Bengaluru office**

**Good to Have**

  **BFSI clients**

* Exposure to

  .

  .

  **Agile/Scrum methodologies**
  .

We’re looking for someone who can

The ideal candidate is a

**Job Description**

The Associate Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects by managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, and stakeholder expectations. The role ensures successful execution through structured project governance, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and customer communication. The Associate Project Manager drives predictable delivery outcomes, ensures compliance to internal processes, and supports business success by improving execution efficiency, controlling risks, and enabling high customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage project delivery from initiation to closure, ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, cost, and quality benchmarks.
* Lead cross-functional coordination with internal teams (Sales, PMO, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, Procurement, etc.) to ensure delivery readiness and execution success.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), stakeholder communication plans, and project closure documentation.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and critical path activities, proactively identifying bottlenecks and driving mitigation actions to avoid slippages.
* Ensure scope validation and change control by documenting exclusions, assumptions, customer approvals, and change requests through formal governance.
* Support budget and commercial governance including project cost tracking, vendor coordination, billing readiness, and delivery closure documentation.
* Drive lessons learned and process improvements to enhance delivery maturity and reduce recurrence of execution issues.

**Required Skills**

**Technical / Process Skills**

* Strong project management expertise across full project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure)
* Schedule management, dependency tracking, and milestone governance
* Risk, issue, and escalation management with structured mitigation planning
* Change management and scope control with documentation discipline
* Strong commercial understanding (budgeting, cost control, billing readiness, vendor governance)
* Experience in managing customer-facing projects and delivery governance

**Functional / Behavioural Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to influence cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication (written and verbal) with customer handling capability
* High ownership, accountability, and execution discipline
* Ability to manage multiple projects in parallel under tight timelines
* Strong problem-solving mindset with a structured and data-driven approach
* Leadership skills to drive outcomes through collaboration without formal authority

**Tools / Systems / Technical Knowledge**

* MS Excel / Google Sheets (tracking, dashboards, reporting, reconciliation)
* MS PowerPoint / Google Slides (leadership updates, customer decks, governance reporting)
* MS Word / Google Docs (documentation, SOPs, MOMs, closure reports)
* Project management tools (Zoho/ MS Project / Smartsheet / Jira / Asana / Monday.com or equivalent preferred)
* Collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams / Zoom / WhatsApp etc. for execution coordination)
* CRM / Ticketing exposure (Salesforce / ServiceNow preferred)

**Decision-Making Authority**

* Independently plan and execute project schedules, resource coordination, and task prioritisation within approved scope and governance.
* Drive project-level decisions on risk mitigation actions, escalation triggers, and corrective plans.
* Approve internal execution readiness checkpoints and closure documentation before leadership/customer submission.
* Influence operational and vendor scheduling decisions to meet delivery timelines and quality standards.

**Problem-Solving Complexity**

* Handles complex delivery scenarios involving multi-team dependencies, scope ambiguity, tight timelines, and changing requirements.
* Expected to resolve execution blockers through structured analysis, stakeholder alignment, and proactive escalation management.
* Drives preventive actions through continuous improvement, governance discipline, and lessons learned implementation.

**Stakeholder Management / Influence**

* **Internal Stakeholders:**
  Sales, PMO, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, Procurement, Leadership, HR, Support teams
* **External Stakeholders:**
  Customers, Vendors, Field Engineers, Partner teams
* Role requires strong customer-facing communication including project governance, expectation alignment, change discussions, and closure signoffs.
* Expected to influence cross-functional teams through structured reporting, ownership, and project discipline.

**Education & Certification Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, IT, Operations, or related field
* PMP / PRINCE2 / CAPM (anyone)

**Preferred**

* ITIL Foundation
* Agile certification (CSM / PMI-ACP – added advantage)

**Experience Requirements**

* **8–10 years of experience**
  in project management / PMO / service delivery/program coordination roles
* Strong experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and customer-facing delivery governance
* Exposure to IT infrastructure, field services, deployments, technical operations, or managed services is preferred
* Experience handling vendor coordination, execution governance, documentation control, and customer communication
* Strong reporting and project tracking expertise using standard tools, dashboards, and leadership reporting formats

title: Transformation Manager
description:
Job Title: Transformation Manager
  
  
Req ID: 58736
  
  
Job Function: Strategy, Transformation & Business Intelligence
  
  
Posting Start Date: 23/10/2026
  
  
Posting End Date: 30/10/2026
  
  
Division: Digital
  
  
Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld
  
  
Advertised Salary: Competitive
  
  
**Recruiter: Seema Shivakumar**
**Hiring Manager: Vivek Chavan**
**Career Grade: D**
**About The Role**
The Digital Change transformation manager will define and manage programmes and transformation initiatives within the Digital change journey. This role will own the plan and execution of these initiatives and ensure that they are meeting the objectives of the overall Digital change journey and integrated with the cultural initiatives in Digital. These initiatives are basic components of the overall Digital Change Programme which seeks to positions Digital as an enabler for BT and its customers and an inspiration and driver of innovation.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Digital Change Transformation Delivery –
* Leads the delivery of transformations and projects defining and maintaining realistic plans and managing project finances and progress against confirmed value drivers
* Build virtual teams to progress the transformation initiatives
* Acts as a credible advisor to key decision-makers, using data-led/technical insight and plans to help major business decisions to enable the Digital change journey
* Construction of programme and status materials to enable the influencing of stakeholders across Digital and ensure alignment with management on strategy, key decisions and progress.
* Makes decisions on progressing actions to assist problem resolution and project delivery.
* Identifies opportunities to improve key benchmarks and value drivers
* Process Improvement/data analysis - Use data analysis and process redesign to identify improved ways of working that deliver tangible business benefits for Digital
* Problem Solving – You will use a structured approach to identify problems, facilitate activity to identify root causes and develop optimal countermeasures to drive measured outcomes.
* Facilitation – You will facilitate large group workshops to scope, mobilise and drive project delivery.
* Stakeholder Management – You will building relationships and working with key partners across Digital and the units it works with
* Change Agent - Use of change implementation principles and tools to effectively implement sustained change into operational teams. Use communication and engagement to embed changes.
* Cultural change – you will role model the BT behaviours and the cultural change within Digital ensuring that the transformations you have responsibility consider both the ‘What’ and the ‘How’ of our journey
* Transformation strategy: you will driving continuous transformation and improvement of the operating and delivery model across the Digital change journey

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* 6+ years experience of portfolio management, project management or PMO
* Experience in change management frameworks
* Ability to build effective transformation and project plans to deliver benefits
* Conflict resolution skills, enabling the individual to cut across organisational and financial complexities to deliver meaningful change and to lead a multi-skilled team
* Knowledge of process improvement/project delivery/change management tools and techniques
* Ability to work with key stakeholders across Digital identify, scope, prioritise and mobilise transformation work packages.
* Confident managing board level/executive stakeholders across BT Group.
* Able to develop compelling reasons for change.
* Excellent logical investigation/root cause analysis skills.
* Confident leading teams through change & ambiguity in ever-changing environment as well as coaching and mentoring colleagues as required.
* Is an excellent collaborator: Builds great teams that are often ‘virtual’ in nature and often inclusive of people from other parts of BT Group.
* A confident and engaging managers who role models through their own behaviour and actions, the BT behaviours

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.
  
  
**Eligibility Criteria**
Please note that as per the IJP guidelines for India, if you have an active PIP/Disciplinary sanctions then you cannot apply for a role internally for the duration of that sanction. In circumstances when you are in a disciplinary process but the outcome hasn’t been reached or there is an active appeal then you can apply, however, the Offer could be withdrawn if, subsequently, you’re issued with a sanction or your appeal is unsuccessful.It is the responsibility of an applicant to not apply to IJP in case if they are on an active PIP/ Disciplinary case/ Warnings or sanction. description:
**About**
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.

Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.
  
  
**Senior Project Manager**
As a Senior Project Manager of the Global Business Services team, you will part of a dynamic team working across the enterprise to manage business process transitions from existing locations to offshore/nearshore or provider locations. Your primary focus will be transitions but other projects might be included as directed. * Act independently to deliver to schedule, budget, and scope
* Run projects, monitor progress, track risks while escalating and driving to resolution as needed
* Report on status
* Support resource and financial reporting
* Run projects, monitor progress
* Execute project controls
* Support the business case creation, presentation, and gather approvals
* Create efficient and effective project plans, taking into consideration the respective organizational and operational structure needs and adjust approach accordingly
* Deliver on the transition/project plan Report project/transitions progress, and risks. Develop corrective action where necessary.
* Own communication and relationship with countries in respective region

* Collect business/country requirements and understand the business needs
* Act as a liaison for all activities and stakeholders for assigned transition/project
* Manage day-to-day communication for assigned transition/project
* Manage the change and assess the risks and be able to implement proper mitigation plan where required.
* Coordinate and facilitate the process of documenting project/transition related policies and procedures, if required.
* Identify and document additional process improvements opportunities for possible implementation after the Transition and/or Projects closure.
* Coordinate the training/workshops of local personnel in the respected countries/regions or/and Shared Service Center employees
* Ensure seamless transfer of business processes from local sites to the Shared Services incl. service level agreements (in cooperation with GBS Service Management)
* Manage all stages of the migration process are successfully complete

**Qualifications:**

* Academic degree or equivalent experience in relevant subject matter
* Project Management certification is preferred
* Experience in transitioning complex projects
* Extended knowledge of service transition methodology, tools and templates. Has strong implementation experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in transition project management
* Good understanding of change management
* Background in business processes in BPO or Shared Service Center environment
* Knowledge of process improvement methodology a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills paired with persuasiveness and self-confidence with strong intercultural skills and understanding.
* Team Player with a strong drive to create positive work environment, able to motivate and empower employees. Ability to work effectively across team.
* Passion for continuous learning, ability to solid comprehension and fast familiarization with new and complex tasks
* Solution-oriented, proactive and out of the box thinking personality
* Excellent skills to set priorities and self-manage high volume workload
* Ability to take the lead and proactively work on solving the issues or potential risks
* Very good planning and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently in ambiguous, dynamic environment.
* Very structured way of working with focus on efficient and effective processes even under pressure

**Key Skills**

* Communication - Able to clearly present information through the spoken or written word; read and interpret complex information; talk with customers or clients; listen well.
* Customer Focus - Able to demonstrate a high level of service delivery; do what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; deal with service failures and prioritize customer needs.
* Flexibility - Able to remain open-minded and change opinions on the basis of new information; perform a wide variety of tasks and change focus quickly as demands change; manage transitions effectively from task to task; adapt to varying customer needs.

title: Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
description:
**Description**
Amazon builds for everyone. TCI's Inclusive Experience charter exists to make sure the products and experiences we ship work for the full range of people who use them, so that no customer is left behind by how a product is designed. We move inclusivity upstream into how products are built, hold it as a bar products meet before they launch, and turn it into experiences customers can feel.
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that make this happen. You will own cross-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, design, and science teams. You will build and manage the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will use that credibility to keep partner teams accountable to shared commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns inclusivity from a set of individual commitments into experiences that ship on time and serve every customer.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. * Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities

* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

**What You Will Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

**What You Will Bring**

* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

**About the team:**
The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.

As Associate Project Manager in GBS Consulting, you will help drive the strategic initiatives that shape how GBS supports Novo. You will support projects, lead some of your own, and turn ambiguous problems into clear recommendations that senior stakeholders can act on. Working across research, development, regulatory, commercial and corporate areas, you will help GBS move with clarity and pace, so colleagues can focus on work that creates progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

* Flexibility, and the ability to take on additional workload when projects need it.

* The ability to own and drive cross-functional initiatives with limited guidance from your manager.

**Useful, but not essential:**

Experience with change management, or with the evolution and transformation of global business services.

  

**What you’ll do**

You will work alongside GBS Consulting project managers on the initiatives that matter most to GBS management and the affiliates, from supporting workstreams to leading projects as the need arises.

* Partner with global stakeholders, GBS colleagues and functional leaders on consulting projects across areas such as research, drug development, regulatory, medical affairs, safety, quality, supply chain, commercial and marketing.

* Plan and track projects from scoping and design through validation and implementation: monitor progress, raise risks in the right forums and keep project documentation, such as agendas, minutes, memos and case studies, in order.

* Design solutions with stakeholders and build the tools, templates and governance cadence that help the team reach project milestones.

* Support General Management with GBS management meetings, including presentations, agendas and ad hoc analyses.

* Stay current on industry practice in change management and GBS transformation, and bring it into your projects, including through external meeting preparation and visits to peer companies where relevant.

  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join GBS Consulting, an internal management consulting team within Finance, Legal & Global Solutions. The team works on strategic initiatives for GBS management and the affiliates, and offers high visibility and direct exposure to senior GBS leadership.

Your closest partners will be the other GBS Consulting project managers. You will also work with global stakeholders, including International Operations and HQ colleagues, the wider GBS organisation and functional leaders across the value chain. Many projects cross functions, so you will help bring different perspectives together, create clarity on priorities and keep decisions moving.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and work with limited guidance as you grow into the role. Working across functions gives you a broad view of how Novo operates, and the chance to build new skills on real projects alongside experienced colleagues. Clear expectations and a culture that rewards results mean your best work gets noticed.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex problems into clear decisions for GBS, apply for the Associate Project Manager role by November 6, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Chief Of Staff And Strategic PMO - S And T
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: 22 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752995

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Chief of Staff & Strategic PMO**

  

**The opportunity**

  

As part of the GDS Strategy & Transformation function, the Chief of Staff & Strategic PMO will work closely with the GDS Strategy & Transformation Leader to translate strategic priorities into a focused and executable leadership agenda. The role will provide structured oversight across strategic priorities, transformation initiatives, leadership commitments and critical decision points, ensuring that the S&T Leader has the information, insights and follow-through required to drive the agenda effectively.

**The role**

  

We are looking for a seasoned Associate Director with 15+ years of experience who can operate at the intersection of strategy, executive leadership and execution. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibility.

  

The individual will act as a force multiplier to the GDS Strategy & Transformation Leader by bringing structure to complex priorities, anticipating leadership requirements, connecting interdependent initiatives and maintaining visibility of critical decisions, actions and risks. The successful candidate will be expected to understand business issues, challenge and synthesize information, and translate multiple workstreams into a coherent leadership view.

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Partner closely with the GDS Strategy & Transformation Leader to structure and advance the function’s strategic and transformation agenda.
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to the GDS Strategy & Transformation Leader, helping shape leadership narratives, challenge assumptions, evaluate strategic alternatives and prepare for critical leadership discussions and decisions.
* Translate leadership priorities into clear workstreams, milestones, accountabilities, decision points and follow-through mechanisms.
* Maintain an integrated view of strategic priorities, leadership commitments and matters requiring intervention or decision.
* Anticipate upcoming leadership requirements and coordinate the analysis, materials and stakeholder inputs required for effective decision-making.
* Prepare executive briefings, leadership presentations, talking points, meeting materials and decision papers.
* Synthesize complex information from multiple teams into concise, leadership-ready narratives that highlight implications, risks, trade-offs, decisions required and next steps.
* Support preparation for critical leadership forums, ensuring consistency of storyline, facts and messages.
* Design and maintain the operating rhythm for the Strategy & Transformation function, including leadership reviews, portfolio and priority discussions, strategic planning cycles and executive decision forums. Define the purpose, cadence, participants, inputs and expected outcomes for each forum; coordinate agendas and pre-reads; ensure decisions, actions and accountabilities are clearly captured; and monitor follow-through, interdependencies and matters requiring escalation.
* Maintain an integrated portfolio view of strategic and transformation initiatives, including outcomes, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions.
* Monitor execution against agreed priorities and proactively surface exceptions or areas requiring leadership attention.
* Drive disciplined closure of leadership actions and commitments across stakeholders.
* Identify dependencies and potential conflicts across workstreams and facilitate resolution with the relevant stakeholders.
* Develop concise dashboards and executive reporting focused on outcomes, exceptions and decisions rather than activity tracking.
* Assess whether strategic initiatives are progressing toward intended outcomes and surface emerging execution risks or opportunities.
* Act as a central coordination point across Strategy & Transformation and key GDS stakeholders, connecting teams where priorities are interdependent.
* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across Service Lines and enabling functions and facilitate alignment where ownership spans multiple teams.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Strong strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to understand enterprise-level priorities and their implications.
* Excellent executive communication and advanced PowerPoint skills, including the ability to convert complex issues into crisp leadership narratives.
* Strong analytical capability and proficiency in Excel, with the ability to interrogate data and identify decision-relevant insights.
* Exceptional ability to connect the dots across multiple priorities, stakeholders and workstreams.
* Ability to distinguish matters requiring leadership attention from those that can be resolved at the working level.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly when working with senior leaders without direct authority.
* Ability to challenge constructively while maintaining trusted relationships.
* High degree of ownership, judgement, discretion and confidentiality.
* Strong organizational discipline and ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of strategic outcomes.
* Comfort working through ambiguity and changing leadership priorities with limited supervision.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

* A minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience, with significant exposure to strategy, transformation, business management, enterprise PMO, consulting, operations or leadership-office roles.
* An MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in business, strategy, finance, management or a related discipline
* Demonstrated experience working directly with or supporting senior executives and leadership teams.
* Experience coordinating complex, cross-functional strategic or transformation agendas.
* Strong experience developing executive presentations, leadership briefings and decision materials.
* Proven ability to drive outcomes through influence across stakeholders without direct reporting relationships.
* Strong analytical capabilities and advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel.
* Experience overseeing governance, leadership actions, risks, dependencies and decision points across a portfolio of priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to move seamlessly between strategic thinking and execution discipline.

  

**Ideally, you will also have**

  

* Prior experience in a Chief of Staff, Strategy, Transformation, CEO/CXO Office, Business Management or enterprise PMO role.
* Experience within a large global professional services, consulting, shared services or global delivery organization.
* Exposure to enterprise transformation, operating-model change, workforce strategy, technology transformation or large-scale strategic programs.
* Experience working across multiple geographies, functions and senior stakeholder groups.

  

**What we look for**

  

A seasoned professional who combines the strategic perspective of a Chief of Staff with the execution discipline of a strong PMO leader. The individual should be comfortable operating behind the scenes while having sufficient executive presence to engage senior stakeholders directly. They should be capable of moving from a leadership discussion to a structured set of priorities, from fragmented updates to an enterprise view, and from a complex issue to a clear articulation of what matters, what requires a decision and what needs to happen next.

**What working at EY GDS offers**

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that works with EY teams across service lines, geographies and sectors. The role offers direct exposure to strategic leadership priorities and the opportunity to strengthen the translation of enterprise strategy into coordinated execution.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – PROJECT MANAGER

**Project:** Residential Building Construction  
**Experience Required:** 8–10 Years  
**Department:** Projects / Construction  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Project Director  
**Location:** Project Site

1. Job Purpose

To take overall responsibility for planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of residential building projects, ensuring delivery within the approved budget, committed schedule, quality standards, and safety requirements. The Project Manager shall lead site execution, coordinate with consultants and subcontractors, control project costs, and ensure client satisfaction.

2. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning and Execution

* Take overall responsibility for the execution and successful completion of residential building projects.
* Prepare project execution plans, construction schedules, manpower plans, and resource requirements.
* Plan and monitor all construction activities, including excavation, foundations, RCC works, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, painting, plumbing, electrical, and finishing works.
* Ensure construction activities are carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly progress against project targets and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues.

B. Site Management and Team Leadership

* Lead and supervise site engineers, supervisors, surveyors, safety personnel, and other project staff.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor the performance of the site execution team.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure timely execution of work.
* Conduct regular site meetings and review progress, quality, safety, and resource requirements.
* Ensure proper manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and material availability at the project site.

C. Commercial and Cost Control

* Monitor project expenditure against the approved budget and maintain effective cost control.
* Review BOQs, quantities, subcontractor quotations, work orders, and material requirements.
* Control wastage of materials and optimize manpower, equipment, and other project resources.
* Verify subcontractor bills, measurement sheets, and work completion statements before approval.
* Monitor variations, extra items, and additional works, ensuring proper documentation and approval.
* Coordinate with the commercial and procurement teams to achieve project cost and profitability targets.

D. Quality Control

* Ensure construction work complies with approved drawings, technical specifications, and applicable building standards.
* Implement quality control procedures for concrete, reinforcement, masonry, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP works.
* Coordinate material inspections, field tests, laboratory tests, and quality inspections.
* Ensure defects and non-conformities are identified, documented, and rectified promptly.
* Maintain inspection records, test reports, and other project quality documentation.

E. Safety and Compliance

* Ensure compliance with site safety rules and applicable statutory requirements.
* Implement safe working procedures and conduct regular site safety inspections.
* Ensure workers and subcontractors follow appropriate PPE and safety practices.
* Coordinate with safety personnel to prevent accidents and unsafe working conditions.

F. Procurement and Material Management

* Prepare and review material procurement schedules based on the construction programme.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of construction materials.
* Verify material quality, quantities, specifications, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor stock levels, material consumption, and wastage at the site.

G. Client Coordination and Reporting

* Act as the primary point of contact for project-related coordination with the client, consultants, and management.
* Review project progress with the client and management at regular intervals.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Communicate project risks, delays, cost variations, and technical issues to senior management.
* Maintain proper project documentation, including drawings, approvals, work orders, and progress records.

H. Project Handover and Closure

* Plan and supervise finishing works, testing, commissioning, and snag rectification.
* Ensure completion of all works according to the approved specifications and agreed scope.
* Coordinate final inspections, statutory approvals, and client handover requirements.
* Ensure preparation of as-built drawings, warranties, operation manuals, and completion documents, as applicable.
* Complete project closure activities within the agreed timeline.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering.
* Additional qualifications in construction or project management will be an advantage.

4. Experience and Technical Requirements

* 8–10 years of overall experience in civil construction.
* Strong experience in residential building projects, including apartments, villas, and multi-storey buildings.
* Proven experience in managing end-to-end construction execution.
* Good knowledge of RCC structures, finishing works, waterproofing, and MEP coordination.
* Experience in project planning, budgeting, BOQ, billing, procurement, and subcontractor management.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Excel; knowledge of MS Project or other planning software is preferred.
* Good understanding of quality control, construction safety, and applicable building regulations.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Completion of the project within the approved schedule.
* Control of construction costs within the approved budget.
* Achievement of project quality standards with minimal rework.
* Effective control of material wastage and labour productivity.
* Timely completion of construction milestones.
* Effective management of subcontractors and project resources.
* Timely resolution of site issues and client complaints.
* Successful project completion and handover within the committed timeline.

6. Required Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management.
* Excellent planning, organizing, and execution skills.
* Commercial awareness and cost-control capability.
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.

7. Overall Accountability

The Project Manager shall be accountable for the overall planning, execution, commercial control, quality, safety, and timely completion of the assigned residential building project, in line with the company's objectives and commitments made to the client

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Project & Creative Operations Lead
description:
**About TripleDart**
--------------------

TripleDart Digital is an AI-native, full-funnel growth agency built for B2B SaaS. We run paid media, ABM, SEO/GEO, creative, web/CRO and RevOps for 100+ SaaS brands scaling from $5M to $100M+ ARR across the US, Europe and APAC. Clients measure us on qualified pipeline and revenue influenced, and we hold Google Premier, HubSpot Platinum and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status.

Our paid media and ABM programs generate a steady stream of creative work — ad concepts, static and video assets, landing pages, ABM personalization, reporting dashboards. Delivering that at scale, to a US client's expectations, is an operations problem. This role owns it.

**Role Summary**
----------------

You are accountable for the entire paid media and creative operations layer: intake, scoping, scheduling, capacity, SLAs, QC and delivery across the portfolio. Account managers own the client relationship and strategy; you own that what we committed gets built correctly and ships on time.

This is a run-the-system-and-make-it-better role. You've managed delivery at scale before, you know what a healthy ClickUp board looks like, and you don't wait for a miss to find out a process is broken.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

### **Project management across the portfolio**

* Own intake to delivery for every paid media, ABM and creative request across ~15 accounts: scoping, briefs, estimates, scheduling, dependencies and sign-off.
* Run the weekly delivery rhythm — sprint planning, daily stand-ups with pods and creative, and a Friday portfolio review of what shipped, what slipped and why.
* Maintain a single, current view of every account's open work, due dates and blockers that an account manager or founder can read in 30 seconds.

### **SLAs and quality control**

* Define and enforce SLAs by deliverable type (ad copy, statics, video, landing pages, dashboards, campaign builds) and report adherence weekly.
* Build and run the QC layer: checklists, review gates and sign-off before anything reaches a client. Brand, copy, spec, tracking and link checks are non-negotiable.
* Track rework and client-reported misses as a defect rate, root-cause them and close the loop with the function that caused them.

### **Creative operations**

* Own the creative pipeline end to end: briefing standards, asset specs per channel (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, CTV), versioning, approvals and asset handoff to paid media.
* Balance load across copy, design, video and web/dev; forecast creative demand from the media plan and staff or reprioritise ahead of the crunch.
* Maintain the creative library, naming conventions and templates so nothing ships off-brand or off-spec.

### **Capacity planning and ClickUp hygiene**

* ClickUp is the source of truth and you keep it that way: every task scoped, owned, estimated, dated and in the right status. No work outside the system.
* Run capacity planning per pod and per function against the retainer scope; flag over-servicing and under-utilisation to leadership monthly.
* Own time-tracking discipline and the utilisation and SLA dashboards leadership uses to run the BU.

### **Client communication**

* Be the delivery voice on client accounts alongside the account manager: status updates, timelines, revision rounds and expectation-setting on what ships when.
* Handle client-facing delivery escalations directly and proactively — before the client raises them.

### **Cross-functional problem solving**

* Sit between account management, paid media pods, copy, design, dev and analytics. When something is stuck, you unblock it, and you fix the process so it doesn't stick again.
* Document and improve SOPs for recurring work; bring AI and automation (ClickUp automations, n8n, Claude) into intake, QC and reporting to cut manual effort.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

Delivery is under control when the client never has to ask where something is.

KPI

Target

What it measures

  

On-time delivery

95%+ of deliverables shipped by committed date

Scheduling and dependency control across the portfolio

  

SLA adherence

95%+ by deliverable type, reported weekly

Turnaround commitments kept per account

  

QC pass rate

98%+ first-pass; zero client-reported brand, spec or tracking errors

Quality gates working before work reaches the client

  

Rework rate

Under 10% of creative deliverables needing a second revision round

Briefing quality and QC discipline

  

ClickUp hygiene

100% of active work scoped, owned, estimated and dated; weekly audit score

The system reflects reality

  

Capacity utilisation

Pods and creative functions within 90–95% planned utilisation; over-servicing flagged monthly

Retainer scope matched to effort

  

Client delivery satisfaction

4.5+ / 5 on delivery and communication in QBR feedback

Clients trust the process, not just the people

  

Process improvement

At least one SOP or automation shipped per month with measured time saved

The system gets better, not just maintained

Targets are reviewed quarterly with the Head of Paid Media and feed the BU's business review.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Non-negotiables**

* 5–8 years in project, delivery or operations management, with at least 3 years running delivery at scale — 10+ concurrent client accounts or 50+ live deliverables a month — at a marketing agency, creative studio or SaaS marketing team.
* A recognized PM certification: PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM/PSM or equivalent. Google Project Management or ClickUp certifications are a plus on top, not a substitute.
* Expert in ClickUp or an equivalent (Asana, Monday, Jira) — you've designed the workspace, the custom fields, the automations and the dashboards, not just used them.
* Hands-on experience running creative operations: briefing, asset specs across paid channels, review and approval cycles, and managing designers, copywriters and video editors' load.
* Working knowledge of paid media and ABM delivery — what a campaign build, a landing page or a reporting dashboard needs before it can ship — enough to QC it and estimate it.
* Accountability as a reflex. You have owned delivery outcomes personally, carried the miss, and fixed the process after.
* Clear, direct written and spoken English; you write client status updates and run calls with US stakeholders.
* Comfortable with US-overlap hours (2:00–11:00 PM IST) and a fully remote, cross-functional team.

### **Strong plusses**

* Six Sigma, Lean or ITIL exposure; you think in defect rates and cycle times.
* Experience with capacity planning and utilisation reporting against retainer scopes.
* Familiarity with Figma, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4 and Looker Studio.
* Experience building ClickUp or n8n automations, or using Claude/ChatGPT to speed up intake, QC and reporting.
* Prior ownership of SOP libraries, onboarding playbooks or delivery handbooks.

### **How you work**

You are organized to the point of being predictable, and the team relies on that. You communicate early, especially bad news. You solve the problem in front of you and then remove the cause. You hold a standard without needing to be the loudest person on the call.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **Own the whole system.** Paid media and creative operations across the portfolio report into you — not a slice of one account.
* **Scale that matters.** 15 accounts, six delivery pods and a creative team shipping for US SaaS brands scaling to $100M+ ARR.
* **Build with AI.** We use Claude, n8n and ClickUp automations in delivery today; you'll have the mandate and budget to push that further.
* **A direct line to leadership.** You report to the Co-Founder running the BU; your dashboards are the ones the business is run on.
* **A clear path.** This role grows into Head of Delivery / Operations as the BU scales.

**Working setup and benefits**
------------------------------

* Fully remote. Work from anywhere in India.
* Fixed US-overlap shift: 2:00–11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday, so you cover the India afternoon handoff and the full US morning.
* Learning and development budget — PM and platform certifications, courses and conferences.
* Full access to TripleDart's AI-native tooling stack (Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, n8n and internal platforms).
* Health insurance and wellbeing support [confirm plan details with HR].

**How to apply**
----------------

**Apply through Keka, or email your resume and cover letter to mailto:sabari@tripledart.com.**

title: Finance Project Manager
description:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're
  
more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros,
  
trams, maintenance services and integrated systems.

  

Could you be the full-time **Finance Project Manager** in **Bangalore, India** we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your project finance expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll report to Finance Controller - Services PL India, and work alongside passionate, motivated and dedicated teammates.

  

You'll leads finances for projects to improve the project overall performance. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with Project Manager and teams across the business as a key member of the project to provides financial analysis, advice and guidance to support the project team in making the best business decisions for the project and much more.

  

You’ll specifically take care of financial strategy success of the project, supports Project Manager in risks and opportunities process and sign-off contingencies or committed savings, but also part of the finance organization and covers the entire project lifecycle, i.e. acquisition, bidding and execution.

  

**We’ll look to you for:**

* Participate in overall Project Management process jointly with Project Manager.
* Main partner for the Financial Strategy success of the project.
* Business partnering by providing finance advise and tutoring to the project team.
* Supervision, analysis and support for overall finance topics of the project.
* Control the financial performance of the project and propose action plans to improve contract margin and cash profile as well as corrective action plans to mitigate identified risks.
* Raised "Early Warnings" when necessary to increase management attention.
* Add insight and accuracy to project financial information (Improve accuracy on forecasts, revenue, cash, cost, etc.).
* Challenge and approve Project Financials (cash, competitiveness) as per DoA.
* Provide confirmation of Internal Transfer Pricing policies to procurement for the issuance of internal purchase orders.
* Control the interflows of Internal purchased orders.
* Ensure compliance with local regulations, especially for tax and statutory accounts purposes.
* Liaise with other finance expert functions (e.g. Tax and Customs, Treasury and Financing, Internal Audit & Risk Management, Accounting and Finance efficiency, etc.).
* Cooperate with other expert functions (e.g. legal, platforms, Operational Excellence, etc.).
* Establish strategic network with external financial players involved in the project.
* Contribute in negotiation processes to secure project success (customer and / or partner).
* Support PM in risks and opportunities process and sign-off contingencies/committed savings.
* Partner with PM and CM in Contract & Claim Management (focus on finance topics & risks profile).
* For partnership (consortium or JV), ensure follow up of the financial aspects in compliance with the partner agreements and alert in case of any deviation or risk profile for Alstom.
* Know and understand businesses portfolio and the operation of every business function.
  

**All about you**

  

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Chartered Accountant or equivalant educational qualification.
* 5 to 8 years’ of experience in Finance with 3 to 4 years of relevant experience.
* An auditing and/or project operational background would be an advantage.
* Solid organizational skills and ability to prioritize.
* Excellent knowledge in MS Excel, knowledge of SAP .
  

**Things you’ll enjoy**

  

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical).
  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. title: IT Strategist
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Strategist
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL Cardif IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40.5 billion in 2025.
  
  
BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The
**IT Strategist**
is the strategic architect and operational orchestrator for the IT leadership team. This role is responsible for defining the department's strategic direction and ensuring its successful execution through rigorous governance, transformation management, and high-level communication. You will act as the bridge between strategic intent (CTO/CIO vision) and operational reality (Production/Delivery), ensuring that the organization’s transformation—specifically the India sourcing initiative—is seamless, data-driven, and delivers maximum value to our business beneficiaries.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Definition & Roadmap Orchestration
* Strategy Formulation: Actively contribute to the definition and promotion of the IT industrialization and production strategy, ensuring alignment with the BNP Paribas Group’s global technological policy.
* Transformation Roadmap: Design and manage the multi-year transformation roadmap, translating long-term vision into actionable milestones for the India transition and other strategic shifts.
* Decision Support: Provide the COO/Head of IT with high-level synthesis, risk opinions, and "decision-ready" intelligence to facilitate complex strategic choices.
* Executive Communication & Visual Storytelling
* Strategic Narrative Design: Lead the creation of sophisticated, executive-level presentations (PowerPoint) for Steering Committees, Board reviews, and Group-level reporting.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Develop and execute communication plans that translate technical and operational complexities into clear, compelling business value for Onshore Beneficiaries and Group leadership.
* Transparency & Reporting: Establish a culture of transparency by designing high-level reporting frameworks that provide a consolidated view of strategy, budget, and transformation progress.
* Governance, Performance & Business Alignment
* Governance Frameworks: Implement and lead governance bodies to facilitate decision-making processes, trajectory monitoring, and stakeholder alignment.
* KPI & Performance Architecture: Define and oversee the deployment of relevant performance indicators (KPIs/SLOs) to monitor the quality, stability, and ROI of the new operational setup.
* Business Relationship Liaison: Act as the ultimate escalation point for "business irritants," ensuring that the interests of Onshore Beneficiaries are represented in the design and implementation of new IT solutions.
* Operational & Financial Oversight
* Transformation Monitoring: Oversee the "Build, Run, Improve" cycle of the transformation, ensuring that the transition to India delivers expected efficiency and cost-control targets.
* Budget & Cost Governance: Monitor the departmental strategic budget, ensuring that investments in transformation and production are based on a clear business rationale (ROI/Efficiency).
* Risk & Continuity Oversight: Ensure that the transformation strategy integrates IT Risk, Cybersecurity, and Business Continuity (BCP) requirements from the design phase.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategy & Transformation: Proven ability to define, promote, and implement large-scale organizational change and IT industrialization strategies.
* Business / IT Relationship Management: Expertise in managing complex stakeholder ecosystems and aligning IT capabilities with business needs.
* Financial & Budget Steering: Ability to manage strategic budgets, monitor cost evolution, and ensure the financial viability of the transformation roadmap.
* Risk & Governance: Deep understanding of IT Risk, Cybersecurity governance, and the ability to provide informed "Risk Opinions" on strategic decisions.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Visual Storytelling: Mastery of PowerPoint to create high-impact, executive-level visual narratives.
* Analytical Ability: Superior ability to synthesize vast amounts of data into actionable strategic insights.
* Project/Program Management: Advanced knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and ITIL methodologies to oversee complex, multi-threaded programs.
* Change Management: Ability to understand, explain, and support large-scale organizational change.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Impact & Influence: Exceptional ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive commitment toward a shared strategic vision.
* Decision Making: Ability to make high-pressure decisions based on incomplete or complex information.
* Resilience: High capacity to maintain focus and leadership stability in a fast-paced, transformative, and often ambiguous environment.
* Creativity & Problem Solving: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in the transformation and designing innovative solutions.
* Communication Excellence: Mastery of both oral and written communication in English, tailored for executive audiences.

**Education Level:**
Master’s Degree

10–15+ years

Chennai

title: ERP Implementation Executive
description:
**ERP Implementation Executive – BOS**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About BOS**

**BOS is a next-generation Business Operating System designed to help companies manage and connect their operations across areas such as sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, finance, workforce management and other business functions.**

**BOS goes beyond traditional ERP software by adapting to the operational processes of each organisation rather than forcing every business into a rigid, predefined system.**

**We are currently implementing BOS with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an ERP Implementation Executive to work directly with customers and our product and development teams.**

**About the Role**

**As an ERP Implementation Executive, you will help businesses successfully adopt and implement BOS.**

**This is not primarily a software development role. You will work closely with business owners, department heads and operational users to understand how their business works, configure BOS around their processes, coordinate data migration, train users, support testing and take departments through go-live.**

**You will act as the bridge between the customer and the BOS product/development team**
.

The role provides significant exposure to real business operations and is suited to someone who wants to develop a career in ERP implementation, business analysis and enterprise technology consulting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meet customers, department heads and operational users to understand their existing business processes.
* Study how departments currently operate using ERP systems, Excel, documents and manual processes.
* Document business processes, requirements, approval flows, user roles and operational rules.
* Map existing customer processes to BOS and identify configuration or product requirements.
* Work with the BOS product and development teams to translate business requirements into system requirements.
* Configure customers, users, roles, permissions, departments, workflows and other implementation settings within BOS.
* Assist with collection, cleaning, validation and migration of master and transactional data.
* Coordinate implementation activities across departments such as Commercial, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Finance and HR/Workforce.
* Conduct product demonstrations and user training for department heads and end users.
* Prepare test scenarios and coordinate functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Record issues, gaps and enhancement requirements identified during implementation.
* Work with developers to verify that issues have been correctly resolved.
* Support customers during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Monitor adoption after go-live and help users transition from their existing processes to BOS.
* Maintain implementation documentation, meeting notes, action items and implementation status.
* Visit customer offices and operational locations when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who combines business understanding, communication skills and technology aptitude**
.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, managers and operational staff.
* Be curious about how businesses actually operate.
* Be able to understand a business process and translate it into a software workflow.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Be organised and capable of following multiple implementation activities simultaneously.
* Be comfortable working with Excel and business data.
* Have good written and verbal communication skills.
* Be comfortable learning complex enterprise software.
* Be willing to visit customer locations and work closely with customers during implementations.
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing requirements between the customer and development team.

**Preferred Experience**

**Candidates with 1–4 years of experience**
in any of the following would be particularly suitable:

* ERP implementation
* ERP functional consulting
* Business analysis
* Software implementation
* Customer onboarding for enterprise software
* Manufacturing ERP
* Inventory or warehouse systems
* Procurement systems
* HRMS / payroll implementation
* Accounting or finance software implementation

Experience with systems such as
**SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Tally, ERPNext or similar ERP/business applications**
would be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Candidates who have worked inside manufacturing or other operational businesses and have strong systems knowledge may also be considered.

**Educational Background**

**Relevant qualifications may include:**

* B.Com / M.Com
* BBA / MBA
* BCA / MCA
* BE / B.Tech
* Information Systems
* Operations / Supply Chain
* Finance / Accounting
* or another relevant discipline

We value practical ability and willingness to learn more than a specific degree.

**Skills That Will Be Valuable**

* ERP implementation
* Business process mapping
* Requirements gathering
* Functional documentation
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Data migration
* Microsoft Excel
* User training
* Customer communication
* Project coordination
* SQL knowledge – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of APIs/integrations – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of AI and modern business software – advantageous

**Why Join BOS?**

**BOS is being built as an alternative to the traditional approach to enterprise software.**

**Rather than joining an organisation where you repeatedly implement the same predefined ERP modules, you will have the opportunity to understand different businesses and help shape how their operations are represented within a new generation of business software.**

**You will work closely with the BOS leadership, product and engineering teams and gain exposure to:**

* Enterprise software implementation
* Business process design
* Manufacturing and operational businesses
* Product development
* Business analysis
* AI-enabled enterprise software
* Customer consulting
* Implementation project management

As BOS grows, this role can develop into
**Implementation Consultant, Senior Implementation Consultant, Implementation Manager and Implementation/Operations leadership roles**
.

From site mobilisation to final handover, you will drive execution, contractor management, finish quality and timely project delivery while ensuring design intent is translated into high-quality workspaces.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead on-site civil and interior execution, including partitions, ceilings, flooring, glazing, joinery, painting and furniture installation.
* Review architectural and detailed drawings, coordinate with design teams and resolve site-level technical issues.
* Plan and monitor site progress, manpower deployment and material deliveries against project schedules.
* Manage contractors and subcontractors to ensure quality, productivity, safety and timely completion.
* Review mock-ups, approve materials as per project processes, and maintain high standards of finish quality.
* Verify site measurements, BOQs and contractor bills against approved scope.
* Coordinate with MEP teams to sequence services and interior finishes and minimise rework.
* Conduct snagging, resolve defects and ensure timely handover with complete project documentation.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 8–12 years of experience in civil and interior execution, preferably in corporate office fit-outs, commercial interiors or turnkey contracting.
* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a degree in Architecture; diploma holders with strong relevant experience may also be considered.
* Strong technical knowledge of interior finishes, joinery, ceilings, flooring and glazing details.
* Good understanding of BOQs, quantity measurements, rate analysis and contractor billing.
* Proven experience managing multiple contractors and live project sites with tight timelines.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Project or Primavera, and construction safety standards.
* Strong site execution, coordination, problem-solving and team management skills.

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

* Competitive compensation.
* Flexi Benefits Plan covering eligible components such as fuel, gadgets, telephone and internet, health club, professional development, leave travel, children's education and hostel allowances, along with festive gift vouchers.
* Company-leased car for eligible employees.
* Support for professional courses, certifications and books.
* Opportunity to work on large-scale, award-winning corporate workplace projects.

The CAS Audit Project Manager is primarily responsible for completing internal audit engagement assignments with minimal supervision from audit team management. **Key accountabilities:**

* Performing control testing and/or supervising staff auditors performing control testing based on audit program directions.
