* Partnering with the assigned line of business, other Risk/Compliance/Audit (RCA) professionals and managers, and RCA Managers to, depending on their function, create, implement, maintain, review or oversee an effective risk management framework.
* Participating in projects and/or activities ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
* Identifying gaps and informing solutions that minimize losses resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human errors.
* Identifying, responding to, or escalating risks, as appropriate.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Typically more than ten years of applicable experience

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Considerable knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact bank operations, including cash servicing, money movement, deposit processing, legal order processing, treasury client servicing, claims/disputes and complaint handling, card operations, and print services. Candidate should also understand the evolving use of artificial intelligence and process automation to create efficiencies and streamline processes.
* Relevant internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including SOX, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
* Considerable understanding of the business line’s operations, services, systems, and associated risks and controls.
* Considerable knowledge of Risk/Compliance/Audit competencies and the ability to hold others accountable on individual projects.
* Advanced process facilitation, project management, and analytical skills for complex processes.
* Thorough understanding of The Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and the common definition of internal controls.
* Business acumen and credibility to help business lines proactively identify and address the evolving risk landscape and changing workforce needs.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Proven adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to successfully coordinate with multiple groups to complete projects.
* Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Microsoft applications.
* Relevant professional certifications, such as CIA, CFE, CISA, Accredited Payments Risk Professional, etc.

**Role Overview**

The role requires a strong understanding of end-to-end book production, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal production, editorial, composition, quality, and technology teams.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with a publishing house or a publishing services company, understand the complete book production lifecycle, and be capable of managing customer expectations, delivery schedules, quality standards, and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.     End-to-End Book Production Management**

* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the complete book production lifecycle, from manuscript receipt to final deliverables.
* Manage and monitor production stages, including:
* Manuscript assessment, pre-editing, and content preparation.
* Copyediting, language editing, and proofreading.
* Typesetting and composition, including print and digital formats.
* Artwork, tables, figures, permissions, and reference management.
* Author queries, corrections, and review cycles.
* Page proofing, quality checks, and final file validation.
* Indexing, where applicable, and preparation of print-ready PDFs and eBook outputs.
* Final delivery, archival, and project closure.
* Ensure adherence to client-specific workflows, production schedules, quality benchmarks, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and rework.

**2.     Production Coordination & Delivery**

* Coordinate with production managers, editors, typesetters, proofreaders, quality teams, and other stakeholders.
* Track multiple titles and projects simultaneously, ensuring visibility into milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Monitor production volumes, turnaround times (TAT), quality metrics, and pending activities.
* Ensure that project teams have clear briefs, specifications, and priorities.
* Escalate risks in advance and drive timely resolution of production issues.
* Ensure compliance with publishing standards, customer specifications, and internal quality processes.

**3. Quality & Process Improvement**

* Maintain high standards of editorial, compositional, and final-delivery quality.
* Analyse recurring errors, customer feedback, rework, and production delays to identify root causes.
* Work with internal teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and reduce production costs without compromising quality.
* Support the adoption of workflow automation, digital publishing solutions, and AI-enabled tools wherever relevant.
* Monitor account-level performance against agreed SLAs, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Support workload planning, resource coordination, and production forecasting.
* Track relevant operational metrics, including productivity, turnaround time, error rates, rework, and customer satisfaction.
* Support estimates, production planning, scope discussions, and change requests in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
* Identify potential opportunities to expand the scope of services offered to existing customers.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

·        5–7 years of relevant experience in book publishing, book production, or publishing services.

·        Candidates from publishing houses, academic publishers, STM publishers, trade publishers, or publishing services companies are preferred.

·        Strong practical knowledge of book production stages, workflows, terminology, and deliverables.

·        Postgraduate qualification preferred.

·        Strong academic background, preferably from a reputed institution, with English-medium education.

·        Excellent spoken and written English

·        Strong email-writing, meeting-management, presentation, and reporting skills.

·        Ability to explain production issues, risks, and corrective actions clearly and professionally.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, strategists, designers, solution architects, other product owners, and developers with an emphasis on strengthening the client centric service delivery for the related business areas, within the context of best practices in enterprise architecture, modern sourcing techniques, modular design of solutions, and appropriate integration of IT services and platforms.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders to fully understand their needs and challenges and translate them into viable product requirements and features.
* Create product vision, product roadmap and maintain and prioritize product backlog and user stories based on the requirements.
* Drive the product execution to bring the product vision to life in collaboration with solution architects, developers, designers, and other cross-functional teams when applicable.
* Manage relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment on product direction.
* Deliver regular status updates to clients, identify and address risks, and reflect changes in requirements and priorities.
* Plan and execute updates and future releases through a data driven and agile approach.
* Prepare estimates and communicate costs, oversee all stages of the product development, and lead the user acceptance testing process.
* Actively engage with the Design and the Digital Acceleration teams to monitor and incorporate various needs and requirements, industry trends, and user feedback into the product.
* Assess impact to end users and need for change management.
* Develop product KPIs that are measurable, actionable, and aligned with business goals and users’ objectives.

title: Lead Electrical/Project Engineer-EPC
description:

title: Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Business Analysis Leadership: Apply business analysis techniques and lead delivery within a global S/4HANA Finance transformation, ensuring solutions align with clear business objectives.
* Finance Capability Design: Be responsible for the design of Finance capabilities, enable seamless delivery across releases, and lead solution remediation to protect process integrity and performance.
* SAP Best Practice and Architecture: Ensure compliance with SAP best practices, maintain integrated architecture standards, and implement robust, compliant data designs that endure.
* Planning and Risk Management: Assist in project planning, proactively handle risks and interdependencies, and keep delivery on time and on budget.
* Delivery Methodologies: Organise and implement project activities using Agile or Waterfall approaches, including SAP Activate, selecting the right tool for the outcome.
* Multi-functional Solution Design: Partner with the IT Design Team to produce solution designs that meet business and multi-functional requirements without fragmenting standards.
* Global Process Alignment: Engage with Enterprise Process Owners to define IT solutions that align to standardised global processes and deliver consistent outcomes.
* Finance Process Design and Integration: Lead Finance process design during global definition, ensuring deep integration with SAP solutions and related data objects.
* Standards Development and Testing: Develop and test global standard solutions, and bring designs through governance forums and frameworks to ensure adoption and quality.
* Product and Design Integration: Work with IT Business Analysts, Product Managers, and design experts to ensure global designs are coherent, scalable, and integrated.
* Innovation with External Experts: Collaborate with partner SME to bring the best of technology and standard approaches into our solutions.
* Strategic Design Forums: Participate in cross-functional design forums to align global designs with strategic business goals and system architecture.
* Localisation within Standards: Address localisation needs during deployment while safeguarding global standardisation and maintainability.
* Documentation and Enablement: Create clear solution designs, maintain high-quality project documentation, and deliver training on relevant tools and technologies.
* Coupa Solution and Process Expertise: Apply hands-on Coupa experience to analyse, design, and support Coupa-enabled procurement and invoicing capabilities integrated with SAP S/4HANA.
* P2P and Accounts Payable Process Leadership: Bring strong end-to-end business process understanding across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP), including requisitioning, purchasing, goods receipt, invoicing, matching, approvals, and payment-related dependencies.
* Coupa-to-SAP Data Mapping and Validation: Define, review, and validate Coupa versus SAP field mappings for master and transactional data; establish mapping rules, identify data gaps, reconcile interface outputs, and support defect resolution through SIT and UAT.

**Essential For The Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study or equivalent experience
* Experience applying business analysis tools, techniques, and concepts (e.g., requirements management, user-centered design, business process/product design) to deliver business change
* Experience collaborating with business partners to identify and address process/product requirements and IT needs
* Experience leading discussions, identifying and documenting business IT problem statements, business process/product design, and report requirements
* Experience working with third-party suppliers/vendors and supplier solutions/products
* Experience planning and handling resources and budgets within assigned areas
* Demonstrable hands-on experience working with Coupa, including procurement and invoicing processes and integration touchpoints with SAP.
* Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP) business processes, controls, and data flows.
* Prior experience mapping Coupa fields to SAP fields for master and transactional data, with responsibility for data validation, reconciliation, interface testing, and defect analysis during SIT and UAT.

**Desirable for the Role**

* Certification in business analysis practice (preferred)
* Experience in advising business partners across one or more functional domains within the pharmaceutical industry;
* Experience in effectively communicating with and influencing individuals at various levels (e.g., peers, managers, team members)
* Experience working within a global matrix organization, including geographically dispersed teams and partners.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
**So, what’s next?**

* Are you already imaging yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
* Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and hope its yours
* If you’re curious to know more then we welcome your application. Apply now!

**Where can I find out more?**

description:

Head of Onboarding & Event Management India ( Investment Banking)
  
  
Overview of Role

Data Management,
  
  
Third party setup,
  
  
Derivative Onboarding and Broker Management.
  
  
The team is tasked with delivering all onboarding activities required to bring a Client or Client Fund to life on our Investment platform.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: Manufacturing Optimization Engineer
description:
**Summary**
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
  
  
**Description**
Manufacturing Optimization Engineers (MOEs) own the continuous improvement strategy and operational excellence initiatives at Apple’s contract manufacturing (CM) partner factories in India. MOEs are responsible for driving breakthrough performance across safety, quality, productivity and cost by leading lean transformation programs and embedding best-in-class manufacturing practices. MOEs sit at the intersection of Apple’s engineering and operations communities, working cross-functionally to assess current-state performance, develop future-state visions and execute scalable improvement plans. They work in concert with supplier operations, quality and industrial engineering teams, as well as Apple's Product Design and Manufacturing Design organizations. Together, these teams implement and sustain new and existing manufacturing processes, workflows, materials and technologies across Apple's supply base in India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Target Setting & Planning - collaborate cross-functionally to assess the current state of the plant’s operations and assist in continuous improvement target setting, develop future state vision and implementation plans to drive operational excellence across CM partner factories in India.
* Project Implementation - work as a site DRI to implement and monitor continuous improvement
* projects at CM factories. Facilitate cross-functional expert teams to drive breakthrough or best-in-class performance in equipment, people, quality, material flow, and cost.
* Project Tracking & Reporting - use standard tracking and reporting systems to drive project performance and ensure timely completion of process, quality and cost-saving goals. Prepare and present status reports, key issues, and mitigation plans to Apple leadership teams.
* Sustaining Improvement - perform analysis on equipment and workforce utilization, line balancing, WIP levels, and shop floor management for maximum efficiency and operational excellence. Lead sustainability index improvement projects to conserve natural resources and reduce operational waste.
* Strategic Program - form a Lean strategy for selected major vendors and lead programs of benchmarking and Value Stream Mapping (VSM) to drive systemic improvement across projects and vendors. Study critical areas impacting productivity and yield such as man-machine coordination, robot efficiency, and container design.

title: Engineering Leader
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the
*St. Louis Business Journal*
list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
Our culture is built on:
  
  

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Engineering Leader provides leadership oversight for the GCC Engineering flex pool, ensuring engineering resources are deployed effectively across multiple global divisions while maintaining the agreed scope, operating intent, and stakeholder commitments of the flex team model. Day-to-day technical challenge resolution, deliverable quality, and output management will be owned by front-line leaders within the flex team.
  
  
Reporting to the Director, GCC Engineering, the Flex Team Leader enables GCC scalability, cross-platform collaboration, and shared-services identity by establishing the right governance, cadence, role clarity, and stakeholder engagement mechanisms for the flex team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Resource Allocation and Delivery
* Oversee flex pool deployment across platforms, ensuring the required Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls Engineering capacity is available and aligned to agreed priorities, while front-line leaders manage day-to-day deliverable execution.
* Establish delivery governance through front-line leaders who are accountable for technical issue resolution, quantity of work completed, quality of outputs, and timely escalation of risks or constraints.
* Bench strength ownership
* Drive a monthly demand-planning cadence with platforms and partner with recruiting to sustain available capacity at all times through proactive team build-out with efficient forecasting and demand planning.
* Partner with engineering leaders to plan the cohort size, composition and deployment to fulfil recruitment needs across the GCC engineering team.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Partner with platform engineering leaders and internal front-line leaders to anticipate flex resource demand, confirm scope and priorities, and provide weekly and monthly updates on capacity, commitments, delivery health, and stakeholder risks.
* Team Leadership and Capability Building
* Build organizational capability by developing front-line leaders, enabling them to coach flex engineers, manage technical readiness, and ensure consistent execution against platform-specific standards.
* Use a skills matrix to maintain visibility to team capability, coverage gaps, readiness levels, and deployment suitability across the flex team.
* Partner with Director, GCC Engineering and People team on recruitment, onboarding, and training.
* Governance and Reporting
* Own allocation governance, billing visibility, stakeholder commitment tracking, monthly reporting, heart count forecasts, and core flex team utilization metrics.
* Contribute to GCC dashboards (utilization, attrition, skills coverage, project allocation).
* Support continuous improvement and standardization of engineering processes by enabling governance, escalation discipline, and consistent execution practices through front-line leaders.
* GCC Integration and Culture
* Role-model GCC identity while ensuring fairness and transparency in cross-platform assignments.
* Encourage knowledge-sharing and collaboration across flex and dedicated teams.

**Technical and Operational Leader Capability**

* Seeking an experienced engineering leader with a strong understanding of mechanical engineering delivery and cross-platform stakeholder management. The role requires sufficient technical breadth to engage credibly with platform leaders and front-line technical leaders, while relying on designated front-line leaders for detailed technical decisions and deliverable ownership.
* The ideal candidate will bring relevant industry experience, proven people leadership, governance discipline, and the ability to manage delivery commitments through front-line leaders while maintaining clear visibility to execution health.
* Working knowledge of discrete machine design, engineering workflows, CAD-based delivery environments, FEA concepts, and global engineering standards is preferred.
* Certifications such as PMP or Six Sigma Black Belt will be considered an advantage, reflecting structured governance, execution discipline, continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to drive predictable delivery through teams.
* Exposure to industrial machinery design, installation, commissioning, and practical engineering constraints is desirable to support informed stakeholder discussions and appropriate escalation management.
* Experience managing distributed teams, external partners, or shared-service delivery models is important to ensure commitments, timelines, escalation paths, and stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.
* A key expectation from this role is to build confidence with BW group companies by ensuring the flex team model delivers reliably against agreed scope, quality expectations, communication cadences, and stakeholder commitments.
* The candidate should demonstrate a strong learning mindset and proven experience developing front-line leaders who can manage technical depth, execution quality, team productivity, mentorship, and performance management within the flex team.

*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

The ideal candidate should possess a strong technical understanding of SaaS platforms, REST APIs, integration workflows, and automation technologies, along with excellent customer communication and project management skills.

The candidate will act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers after their integration projects go live, collaborating with engineering, implementation, and customer stakeholders.

* SaaS Integration Management
* Understand and manage integrations between SaaS applications and third-party platforms.
* Troubleshoot API failures, authentication issues, data synchronization errors, and integration disruptions.
* Analyze integration workflows, field mappings, data transformations, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Support integrations built using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and integration automation platforms.
* Identify integration performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Ensure integrations continue functioning reliably when SaaS platforms or APIs change.
* Technical Project Management
* Independently manage multiple customer integration accounts and post-go-live activities.
* Plan and coordinate bug fixes, enhancements, integration changes, and technical improvements.
* Track customer requests, issues, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively.
* Coordinate with developers, QA engineers, and Technical Leads for issue resolution.
* Provide clear and timely status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to internal delivery processes.

* Take ownership of integration projects after successful production deployment.
* Manage the transition from implementation teams to customer success operations.
* Ensure integration stability, reliability, and successful ongoing operations.
* Conduct periodic customer check-ins and technical health reviews.
* Proactively identify integration risks, failures, and customer concerns.
* Maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and technical guidance.
* Drive issue resolution and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Incident Management & Technical Support
* Take ownership of customer-reported integration incidents.
* Perform initial technical investigation and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident resolution with the appropriate technical teams.
* Manage issue severity, priority, escalation, and communication.
* Ensure critical customer issues receive appropriate attention.
* Document incident findings, resolutions, and preventive actions.
* Work toward reducing recurring production issues.
* Integration Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
* Monitor integration health, API failures, scheduled jobs, and data synchronization processes.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation.
* Recommend improvements to integration architecture and operational workflows.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and integration upgrades.
* Improve monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and support processes.

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Implementation Engineer (SaaS & AI)**
**Company:**
MAKO IT LAB
  
  
**Experience:**
2–5 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai – Work from Office
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a customer-focused and technically capable
**Implementation Engineer**
to join our SaaS Implementation team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, designing practical solutions, configuring SaaS platforms, and delivering successful implementations.
  
  
This role combines
**solution consulting, SaaS implementation, basic Python programming, AI-assisted automation, and customer engagement**
.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable interacting directly with international customers, translating their business requirements into functional solutions, and independently managing implementation activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Discovery & Solution Consulting
* Engage with customers to understand their business requirements, workflows, and implementation objectives.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions and solution discussions.
* Recommend appropriate product features, configurations, and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify technical limitations, dependencies, and potential implementation risks.
* SaaS Product Implementation
* Configure SaaS platforms, including workflows, templates, custom fields, user roles, permissions, dashboards, and automation rules.
* Implement solutions based on approved customer requirements.
* Support data imports, mapping, migration, and validation activities.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues and resolve implementation challenges.
* Manage multiple customer implementations while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.
* Python & Technical Integration
* Write and modify basic Python scripts for data processing, validation, and automation.
* Work with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and webhooks.
* Use Python to support API interactions, data transformations, and implementation utilities.
* Assist integration teams with troubleshooting and technical validation.
* Collaborate with developers on complex customizations and third-party integrations.
* AI & Automation
* Use AI-powered tools to improve implementation efficiency, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Apply AI-assisted coding tools to develop and optimize basic Python scripts.
* Explore opportunities to automate repetitive implementation tasks.
* Understand fundamental AI concepts, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Demonstrate an interest in learning and working with AI-driven implementation platforms.
* Customer Training & Go-Live
* Conduct product demonstrations, configuration walkthroughs, and customer training sessions.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and resolve identified issues.
* Prepare implementation documentation, configuration guides, and handover materials.
* Support go-live activities and post-implementation stabilization.
* Ensure a smooth handover to Customer Success and Support teams.
* Project Ownership & Communication
* Independently own assigned implementation activities and smaller customer projects.
* Provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies.
* Proactively identify blockers and escalate issues when necessary.
* Maintain clear documentation and follow established implementation processes.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* 2–5 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical implementation, or solution consulting.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS product configuration and customer onboarding.
* Basic Python programming knowledge is mandatory, including scripting, data manipulation, and API interactions.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and Postman.
* Familiarity with AI technologies and tools is mandatory, including practical exposure to generative AI or AI-assisted development.
* Strong business requirement analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to independently interact with customers and recommend suitable solutions.
* Willingness to work from the Chennai office during the 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST shift.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with CRM, PSA, project management, or customer onboarding platforms.
* Exposure to Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, Monday.com, or similar SaaS products.
* Knowledge of SQL, data migration, and data transformation.
* Experience with Workato, Zapier, Make, or similar integration platforms.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Understanding of LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI workflow automation.
* Experience working with US-based customers.

What We Expect
  
  

* Strong ownership of customer implementations from discovery to go-live.
* A solution-oriented mindset rather than a task-execution approach.
* Ability to combine business understanding with technical capabilities.
* Willingness to continuously learn new SaaS products, Python, AI technologies, and automation tools.
* Strong communication, documentation, and customer management skills.
* Proactive identification of risks and timely escalation of blockers.
* Commitment to implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines.

**Required Skills**
Communication Solution Consulting Customer Onboarding ETL Basics Process Improvement Quick learner SaaS Implementation

title: Senior Technical Lead BIM - Structural - "High-rise & Complex Buildings" - Chennai
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll India is part of Ramboll Group owned by the Ramboll Foundation, with strong corporate values and long-term thinking. In India we have major offices in Gurugram, Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai and Mumbai. Here, you can apply your professional passion for high quality and delivering innovative solutions within Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future, working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.
  
  
We invite you to bring your passion, curiosity, positive energy, and technical expertise to develop sustainable solutions for industry projects worldwide. To succeed in this role, you must possess a strong technical background in industry engineering (Process, Chemical, Petrochemical, etc.), extensive experience as a Piping and Layout specialist, and the ability to lead project teams across Ramboll’s offices and geographies within the Plant Design discipline.
  
  
**You will join our High-Rise Buildings**
**Department**
As our new
**Senior Technical Lead BIM - High Rise Structure**
, you will be part of our global High-Rise department, Ramboll’s dedicated team of Highrise experts which have designed over 150 tall building projects globally, including some of the most technically challenging. You would be responsible to coordinate with project managers and/or engineers for Analysis and Design work in the Highrise department in Chennai to support the global department which also has offices in Copenhagen, UK, Middle East, and Singapore.
  
  
**The BIM Lead owns day-to-day resourcing and quality performance of the BIM function, which sits entirely within REC. The role gives the BIM function a single point of accountability for resource allocation, output quality and staff development.**
**Job Description**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Allocate BIM staff across active projects in line with project delivery plans and the Department's resourcing methodology.
* Identify resourcing gaps or conflicts early and raise them to the Head of Department and the relevant Project Lead before they affect delivery, in line with the Project Delivery and Governance Guideline.
* Own overall BIM output quality and drawing presentation standards across REC.
* Set and monitor productivity and quality standards for the BIM team, distinct from the project-level quality checks performed by the BIM Quality Lead and Senior BIM Coordinator(s).
* Escalate any resourcing decision beyond the Department's established methodology, and any matter that cannot be resolved through coordination with the Quality function or the relevant Project Lead, to the Head of Department.
* Maintain visibility of BIM team capacity and utilisation across REC.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver a structured training scheme for the BIM team, covering software proficiency, modelling standards and productivity.
* Assign team members to the training scheme and track completion and resulting quality/productivity improvement.
* Identify individual skill gaps and provide or arrange targeted training as needed.
* Coordinate with Project Leads and Project BIM Leads on project-specific BIM resourcing and delivery needs.
* Report resourcing status, training progress and quality trends to the Head of Department on a regular basis.

**Ideal Character Type**

* Hands-on and detail-focused: comfortable reviewing models and drawings directly, not managing purely at a distance.
* Owns resourcing and quality outcomes; escalates early rather than explaining late.
* Calm and structured under multiple concurrent project deadlines.
* Coaching mindset: builds capability in the team through training rather than working around gaps.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in a relevant BIM, architectural technology or engineering discipline.
* Minimum 25 years of relevant BIM experience, including substantial experience in a managerial or lead capacity with direct responsibility for team and resource management, ideally within a multi-disciplinary structural or MEP design environment.
* Proven track record with top-tier engineering consultancies in the region.
* Relevant professional accreditations required.
* Demonstrated experience designing or delivering structured training programmes for technical teams.
* Strong working knowledge of BIM standards, modelling software (e.g. Revit) and quality/productivity benchmarking.

**Why This Role May Interest You**

* Genuine ownership of the BIM function's resourcing, quality standards and training programme.
* A newly defined role with a direct hand in shaping how BIM is structured across REC.
* Group backing for the tools and training the function needs.

**Additional Information**
**Working at Ramboll**
To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. Thus, the possibilities at Ramboll are many and diverse –we invest a lot in the development of people and offer career paths tailored for each individual.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are interested in applying, please send your application through our online recruitment system by clicking the link ‘apply’ below. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager  - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)**

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Manufacturing Engineering (Vehicle Assembly) is responsible for driving line balancing, process optimization, layout designing, and facility commissioning across vehicle assembly operations. Sitting at the intersection of process engineering and Industry 4.0, this role leads the procurement and integration of tooling, jigs, fixtures, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) testing facilities, and Low-Cost Automation (LCA) solutions. The incumbent executes line trials, implements ergonomic improvements (REBA/RULA), drives PFMEA and quality non-conformance root cause analysis, and embeds MES/IIoT traceability (Vehicle Genealogy) to ensure high-efficiency, safe, and cost-effective assembly operations up to final handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Line Balancing & Process Optimization:**
  Conduct time studies and workflow analyses to eliminate Non-Value-Added (NVA) activities, balancing assembly lines to boost efficiency and operational productivity.
* **Facility & Tooling Development:**
  Design plant layouts for expansions and handle end-to-end procurement (RFQ to DAP trials, site installation, and commissioning) for tools, jigs, fixtures, Poka-Yokes, and ABS testing facilities.
* **Industry 4.0 & Digital Manufacturing:**
  Integrate Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), IIoT networks, and Vehicle Genealogy tracking while executing Low-Cost Automation (LCA) and ergonomic upgrades (REBA/RULA).
* **Quality Governance & PFMEA:**
  Collaborate with Quality to resolve process non-conformances using 8D/A3 tools, update PFMEAs and Control Plans, and create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Cross-Functional & Packaging Support:**
  Provide daily shop-floor engineering support, resolve line bottlenecks, drive VAVE/cost-reduction projects, and oversee CKD packaging standards and material handling systems.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Mechatronics Engineering
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering / process engineering within automotive vehicle assembly environments (OEMs or major Tier-1 system integrators)
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end RFQ-to-commissioning execution, MES/IIoT integration, ABS facility testing, line balancing, and ergonomic workstation design

title: Audit Project Manager - Operations
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The CAS Audit Project Manager is primarily responsible for completing internal audit engagement assignments with minimal supervision from audit team management. The Audit Project Manager is expected to understand risk and risk management techniques, identify and analyze business processes, key risks and critical controls, and evaluate control design adequacy; perform or supervise control testing; and document work performed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures. This individual may also be involved in other side projects, department initiatives, and other administrative audit activities. The ideal candidate has internal audit experience in the financial services industry specifically bank operations.

The primary focus of this role over the next 36 months includes completing annual key SOX financial statement control testing for internal audit and other audit support work specific to bank operations. Internal audit performs SOX testing on behalf of management to ensure strong reliance by external auditors. The role may directly or indirectly lead team members.

**Key accountabilities:**

* Performing control testing and/or supervising staff auditors performing control testing based on audit program directions. Includes using appropriate sampling and control testing techniques; identifying and assessing the relevance of possible issues; and documenting work performed to support audit scope and conclusions, to facilitate an efficient review, and to meet internal audit policies and procedures.
* Drafting audit issues under the supervision of audit team management. Includes drafting potential exposures and significance, identifying appropriate root causes, and developing operationally effective and cost-effective recommendations.
* Assisting audit team management in the reporting and wrap-up phases of audits. Includes assisting with drafting audit reports.
* Learning from and applying coaching received.
* Serving as a subject matter expert in a particular topic, helping drive strategy, and may support multiple audit engagements covering the related topics.
* Handling complex tasks autonomously and being able to influence business line understanding of risk mitigation.
* Performing other duties as requested by audit team management.
* Assisting audit team management in planning audit engagements. Includes understanding risk and risk management techniques; identifying and analyzing business processes, key risks, and critical controls; interviewing auditees; and evaluating control design adequacy.
* Providing coaching and on-the-job training for team members, as applicable, to ensure engagements are completed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures.
* Partnering with the assigned line of business, other Risk/Compliance/Audit (RCA) professionals and managers, and RCA Managers to, depending on their function, create, implement, maintain, review or oversee an effective risk management framework.
* Participating in projects and/or activities ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
* Identifying gaps and informing solutions that minimize losses resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human errors.
* Identifying, responding to, or escalating risks, as appropriate.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Typically more than ten years of applicable experience

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Considerable knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact bank operations, including cash servicing, money movement, deposit processing, legal order processing, treasury client servicing, claims/disputes and complaint handling, card operations, and print services. Candidate should also understand the evolving use of artificial intelligence and process automation to create efficiencies and streamline processes.
* Relevant internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including SOX, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
* Considerable understanding of the business line’s operations, services, systems, and associated risks and controls.
* Considerable knowledge of Risk/Compliance/Audit competencies and the ability to hold others accountable on individual projects.
* Advanced process facilitation, project management, and analytical skills for complex processes.
* Thorough understanding of The Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and the common definition of internal controls.
* Business acumen and credibility to help business lines proactively identify and address the evolving risk landscape and changing workforce needs.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Proven adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to successfully coordinate with multiple groups to complete projects.
* Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Microsoft applications.
* Relevant professional certifications, such as CIA, CFE, CISA, Accredited Payments Risk Professional, etc.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

description:

A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The CAS Audit Project Manager is primarily responsible for completing internal audit engagement assignments with minimal supervision from audit team management. The Audit Project Manager is expected to understand risk and risk management techniques, identify and analyze business processes, key risks and critical controls, and evaluate control design adequacy; perform or supervise control testing; and document work performed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures. This individual may also be involved in other side projects, department initiatives, and other administrative audit activities. The ideal candidate has internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including Financial Reporting, Accounting, Tax, SOX, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, etc.

The primary focus of this role over the next 36 months includes completing annual key SOX financial statement control testing for internal audit and other audit support work specific to Finance. Internal audit performs SOX testing on behalf of management to ensure strong reliance by external auditors. The role may directly or indirectly lead team members.

**Key accountabilities:**

* Performing control testing and/or supervising staff auditors performing control testing based on audit program directions. Includes using appropriate sampling and control testing techniques; identifying and assessing the relevance of possible issues; and documenting work performed to support audit scope and conclusions, to facilitate an efficient review, and to meet internal audit policies and procedures.
* Drafting audit issues under the supervision of audit team management. Includes drafting potential exposures and significance, identifying appropriate root causes, and developing operationally effective and cost-effective recommendations.
* Assisting audit team management in the reporting and wrap-up phases of audits. Includes assisting with drafting audit reports.
* Learning from and applying coaching received.
* Serving as a subject matter expert in a particular topic, helping drive strategy, and may support multiple audit engagements covering the related topics.
* Handling complex tasks autonomously and being able to influence business line understanding of risk mitigation.
* Performing other duties as requested by audit team management.
* Assisting audit team management in planning audit engagements. Includes understanding risk and risk management techniques; identifying and analyzing business processes, key risks, and critical controls; interviewing auditees; and evaluating control design adequacy.
* Providing coaching and on-the-job training for team members, as applicable, to ensure engagements are completed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures.
* Partnering with the assigned line of business, other Risk/Compliance/Audit (RCA) professionals and managers, and RCA Managers to, depending on their function, create, implement, maintain, review or oversee an effective risk management framework.
* Participating in projects and/or activities ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
* Identifying gaps and informing solutions that minimize losses resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human errors.
* Identifying, responding to, or escalating risks, as appropriate.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Typically more than ten years of applicable experience

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Relevant internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including Global Accounting and Operations, Corporate Finance, Tax, Business Area CFOs, Corporate Accounting, Business Line Controller Group, Financial Reporting, SOX, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management
* Considerable knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact the assigned line of business.
* Considerable understanding of the business line’s operations, services, systems, and associated risks and controls.
* Considerable knowledge of Risk/Compliance/Audit competencies and the ability to hold others accountable on individual projects.
* Advanced process facilitation, project management, and analytical skills for complex processes.
* Thorough understanding of The Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and the common definition of internal controls.
* Business acumen and credibility to help business lines proactively identify and address the evolving risk landscape and changing workforce needs.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Proven adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.

**About The Role**

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Role**

title: Project Manager - Solar
description:
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Project Manager – Solar who can independently visit project sites, assess site conditions, plan execution activities, coordinate manpower and materials, and ensure the successful completion of solar projects.

This is a
**field-based travelling role**
, not a desk job. The candidate will be required to travel regularly to customer locations and project sites, oversee on-ground execution, coordinate with vendors and installation teams, resolve site-level challenges, and ensure projects are completed within the committed timelines and quality standards.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of solar installations, excellent execution and coordination skills, and the ability to take complete ownership of projects from site assessment through commissioning and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Site Visits & Execution Planning**

* Travel regularly to assigned project sites to assess site conditions and plan execution activities.
* Conduct site inspections and evaluate installation feasibility, manpower requirements, material availability, and technical challenges.
* Prepare site-wise execution plans, timelines, resource plans, and project milestones.
* Identify potential execution risks and resolve site-level challenges proactively.
* Coordinate with customers and site stakeholders before commencing installation activities.

**2. End-to-End Solar Project Execution**

* Take ownership of solar projects from site assessment and planning through installation, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
* Supervise on-site installation of solar modules, mounting structures, inverters, cabling, earthing, and associated electrical systems.
* Ensure execution is carried out according to approved designs, technical specifications, and project schedules.
* Monitor daily site progress and ensure activities are completed as planned.
* Take immediate corrective action when execution delays or technical issues arise.

**3. Manpower & Contractor Management**

* Coordinate and manage technicians, installation teams, contractors, subcontractors, and site supervisors.
* Allocate work based on project priorities, manpower availability, and execution schedules.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance, work quality, and completion timelines.
* Ensure the installation team follows the approved execution plan and safety requirements.
* Resolve manpower-related issues that could affect project progress.

**4. Material & Vendor Coordination**

* Plan material requirements before project execution begins.
* Coordinate with procurement, vendors, and warehouse teams to ensure timely availability of solar modules, inverters, structures, cables, and other materials.
* Verify material availability and condition at the site.
* Track material consumption, shortages, wastage, and delivery schedules.
* Prevent project delays caused by inadequate planning or material unavailability.

**5. Project Timeline & Cost Management**

* Prepare and monitor project execution schedules with clear milestones and target completion dates.
* Ensure projects are completed within approved timelines and budgets.
* Track site expenses, contractor costs, material consumption, and resource utilization.
* Identify delays, cost overruns, and execution bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Provide regular progress updates to management.

**6. Quality Control & Safety**

* Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality and adherence to approved drawings.
* Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards and company procedures.
* Monitor the use of PPE and safe working practices by all site personnel.
* Identify installation defects, non-conformities, and rework requirements and ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure proper testing, commissioning, and documentation before project handover.

**7. Customer & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with customers, vendors, contractors, internal teams, and other stakeholders at project sites.
* Provide updates on project progress, execution timelines, and pending activities.
* Resolve site-related customer concerns and technical issues promptly.
* Coordinate required inspections, approvals, net-metering processes, and DISCOM-related activities, as applicable.
* Ensure a smooth customer handover after successful project completion.

**8. Reporting & Documentation**

* Submit daily site progress reports, including work completed, manpower deployed, materials used, and pending activities.
* Maintain site visit records, project trackers, photographs, inspection reports, and execution documentation.
* Report delays, risks, technical issues, and resource requirements to management immediately.
* Maintain records of testing, commissioning, warranties, and final project handover.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
* 5–8 years of experience in solar project execution, preferably in solar EPC or rooftop solar installations.
* Strong hands-on experience in managing site execution and installation teams.
* Good understanding of solar PV systems, inverters, modules, mounting structures, electrical cabling, earthing, and commissioning.
* Proven ability to plan site execution, manpower deployment, material requirements, and project schedules.
* Experience managing contractors, vendors, technicians, and customer-site coordination.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions independently at project sites.
* Good communication, leadership, reporting, and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned regions and stay at project locations when required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of solar projects against approved execution schedules.
* Quality and accuracy of site execution and installation.
* Effective site planning and manpower utilization.
* Timely identification and resolution of site-level issues.
* Availability of materials and resources before execution deadlines.
* Compliance with safety standards and reduction in rework.
* Accuracy and timeliness of daily site reports.
* Customer satisfaction and successful project handover.

description:

Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Technical Program Manager – AI-Enabled Engineering Pods
  
  
Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud & AI Engineering
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Experience Required: Minimum 14+ years of experience
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned
**Technical Program Manager**
to lead and manage multiple cross-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive-level reporting.
  
  
This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI-enabled delivery practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud-native, and enterprise-grade digital applications.
* Own end-to-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.

**Technical Program Management**

* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.

**AI & Gen AI Enablement**

* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.

**Agile, DevSecOps & Release Governance**

* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.

**Stakeholder & Executive Communication**

* Provide clear, concise, and data-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business-relevant insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 14+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.

**Preferred Technical Capabilities**

* Prior hands-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.

**AI Platform Expectations**
The candidate should be hands-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
  
  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.

At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. description:
