One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.

Department Overview

McDonald’s has an exciting opportunity for a
**Supervisor, Talent Management Delivery**
based in our India Global Business Services Office. This position also partners across Global People and GBS to support operational consistency, documentation accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient
**Supervisor, Talent Management**
to lead the day-to-day execution and technical coordination of our global talent cycles. In this role, you will be the coordinator for the operational workstreams supporting
**Talent Reviews, Succession Planning,**
and
**High Potential (HiPo) Cohort Management**
.

Working within the McDonald's System, you will act as the primary interface between HRBPs, IT/HRIS, and AMS/Scaled Services. You will ensure that our talent platforms are ready for use, that data is accurate, and that our global talent identification processes run smoothly. This role is ideal for an individual who excels at managing timelines, troubleshooting technical issues, and supporting stakeholders through critical talent milestones.

Duties

**Technical Oversight & Operational Lead**

* **System Readiness Coordination:**
  Supervise the technical readiness of the McDonald's talent platforms, ensuring all configuration elements for
  **Talent Reviews**
  and
  **Succession Planning**
  are tested and functional.
* **Defect Triage & Resolution:**
  Act as the first point of escalation for technical issues. Partner with AMS/Scaled Services to triage defects, prioritize fixes, and ensure issues are resolved before they impact global talent sessions.
* **Data Quality & Validation:**
  Lead the validation of input data to ensure high-quality reporting for succession bench strength and HiPo tracking. Ensure all outputs for the GPLT and leadership readouts are accurate.
* **HiPo Cohort Tracking:**
  Maintain the technical backlog for
  **High Potential cohort management**
  tools. Capture enhancement requests and ensure the system effectively tracks development and movement for these critical talent groups.
* **Live Session Support:**
  Provide "on-the-call" technical assistance during Talent and Succession Review meetings, resolving access issues and workflow questions in real-time.
* **Content & Link Management:**
  Facilitate the upload of McDonald’s + Me Talent and Succession content and links, specifically supporting countries during new wave onboarding.

**Project Coordination & Execution**

* **Cycle Timeline Management:**
  Maintain and drive the integrated project plan for the Talent and Succession cycles, ensuring all preparation, calibration, and closeout tasks are completed on schedule.
* **HiPo Process Coordination:**
  Facilitate the operational timeline for
  **HiPo Cohort Management**
  , ensuring that participant lists are updated and that selection/tracking milestones are met.
* **Governance Support:**
  Lead weekly status meetings and stakeholder check-ins; manage the documentation of agendas, action items, and the RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
* **Stakeholder Liaison:**

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Release Manager to manage end-to-end software release planning, coordination, scheduling, deployment, and governance. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Release Management, Change Management, ITIL processes, and coordination across Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Business teams to ensure smooth and reliable production releases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle, from planning and scheduling to deployment and post-release validation.
* Develop and maintain release calendars, deployment plans, release notes, checklists, and implementation documentation.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Business teams to ensure release readiness.
* Manage change requests, conduct impact and risk assessments, and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
* Coordinate Go/No-Go meetings and obtain the necessary approvals before production deployments.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, release governance, organizational policies, and compliance requirements.
* Track release dependencies, risks, issues, milestones, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate production deployments, rollback plans, hotfixes, emergency releases, and post-release validation.
* Monitor release KPIs, including deployment success rate, change failure rate, rollback frequency, and on-time delivery.
* Manage release communications and provide timely updates to stakeholders and senior management.
* Conduct post-release reviews and drive continuous improvement in release processes.
* Support incident reviews and root cause analysis related to release failures or production issues.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in IT, with significant hands-on experience in Release Management.
* Strong knowledge of end-to-end release planning, deployment coordination, and release governance.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, particularly Release, Change, Incident, and Problem Management.
* Experience managing CAB meetings, change approvals, release readiness, and Go/No-Go decisions.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and risk management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple releases, competing priorities, and tight deployment timelines.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in enterprise IT environments.

title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.
  
  
The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Autonomously manage global primary market research (qualitative and quantitative) of all levels of complexity, incorporating diverse stakeholder perspectives to ensure organizational alignment and buy-in. Strength in applying advanced statistical analyses and leveraging business intelligence to support strategic, tactical and operational initiatives as well as planning and implementation of new and potential USP products and programs is essential.
* Steward projects to generate actionable and meaningful insights. Develop research plans to meet business needs, consult with internal business partners, establish and manage schedules, monitor progress, and compellingly communicate the results
* Acquire and manage market research vendors to ensure quality work is provided on-time, on-budget, and that it is reported with a suitable degree of professionalism
* Proactively serve as a thought partner with USP leadership. Participate in corporate planning and new product development processes to identify opportunities, address needs, and support the development of business and marketing plans
* Proactively bring external perspectives and insight into business planning for the organization, accomplished through:
* Monitor trends in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food and other related industries to assess their implications for USP business lines
* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Basic Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Preferred majors in market research, marketing, science, business, or related social science discipline.
* 7 or more years of experience in applying Market Research to solve broad strategic business problems.
* Strong business writing skills – evidence of succinct, distilled reports and attention to detail through thoroughness and accuracy
* Strong verbal and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to present statistical information to non-statistically oriented audiences
* Widespread knowledge of advanced primary market research methodology.
* Business acumen and strong analytical skills
* Advanced Intermediate skills with the following programs:
* MS Excel
* MS PowerPoint
* MS Word
* Online survey tools, bulletin boards and focus group platforms (Qualtrics preferred)
* Statistical software packages – R, SPSS, etc.
* Has the ability to navigate through ambiguity with courage and leadership.
* Must be self-motivated and customer-focused.
* Excellent time and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to concurrently prioritize multiple tasks with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Prior experience in global market research, pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food or related, regulated industries is highly desired.
* Experience working in a not-for-profit organization.
* Experience working in a scientific organization.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Sales & Marketing

Full-Time

title: Go To Market Project Lead
description:
We are building a team of trailblazers, who embody growth, impact, and excellence.
  
  
**Job Description**
Our Vision
  
  
At Pinnacle, our vision is to make the world reliable, one customer at a time. Reliability, to us, means customers can trust that their facilities operate when and how they are supposed to — safely, efficiently, and continuously improving.
  
  
We help our customers increase safety, efficiency, and performance by deeply understanding their goals, solving real problems, executing with discipline, and staying aligned every step of the way. This is not abstract — it is how we work, every day.
  
  
How We Work: The Pinnacle Way
  
  
Every role at Pinnacle operates within The Pinnacle Way (TPW). This is not a set of values on a wall — it is the standard by which we hire, work, and measure our success.
  
  
We Understand
  
  
We seek to understand the real goals, constraints, people, and dynamics at play — not just what is said out loud. We listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, and adjust when our assumptions are wrong.
  
  
We Solve
  
  
We take ownership of problems. We collaborate, think creatively, and build thoughtful solutions — especially when the path forward is not obvious.
  
  
We Execute
  
  
We value disciplined execution. Our work is organized, intentional, high-quality, and delivered with consistency. We follow through and hold ourselves accountable.
  
  
We Align
  
  
We communicate clearly and proactively. We keep each other and customers informed, aligned, and never surprised by outcomes or progress.
  
  
Who Thrives at Pinnacle
  
  
Across every function, level, and role, successful Pinnacle team members consistently demonstrate these behaviors:
  
  

* Hungry – You are driven, self-motivated, and energized by meaningful work. You look for ways to contribute beyond what is asked.
* Humble – You prioritize team and customer success over personal recognition. You give credit, accept feedback, and own mistakes.
* Smart – You learn quickly, think critically, and navigate complexity with curiosity rather than intimidation.
* No Fear – You are comfortable with ambiguity, willing to take thoughtful risks, and resilient when things don’t go as planned.

These are not “nice to have” behaviors; they are essential.
  
  
Position
  
  
Go To Market Project Lead
  
  
**Job Summary**
You will be a hands‑on marketing project manager to run execution, delivery and reporting for Pinnacle’s Go-to-Market team. You will translate strategy into detailed plans, coordinate cross‑functional work, own the project board and weekly delivery rhythms, and produce the regular Excel / Power BI reports leadership uses. This is an execution and program management role.
  
  
**Job Duties**

* Plan and maintain the marketing program roadmap: convert quarterly campaign briefs into prioritized workstreams, milestones and a weekly Gantt/kanban cadence in Asana.
* Run end‑to‑end production for campaign assets: create briefs, track progress through content → design → review → QA → publish, enforce deadlines and handoffs.
* Coordinate external partners and fractional consultants: manage scope, deliverables, timelines and acceptance criteria for agencies, HubSpot consultants, designers and contractors.
* Build, maintain and operate recurring reporting: maintain funnel and campaign spreadsheets, refresh Power BI / Excel dashboards, prepare the weekly executive summary and slide exports for board/LT.
* HubSpot project coordination: coordinate HubSpot builds and validate workflows in collaboration with our existing team.
* Meeting facilitation and stakeholder communications: run weekly marketing standups, prepare agendas, clear action owners and follow up; synthesize SME inputs into clear task lists.
* Risk management and escalation: identify bottlenecks early (SME delays, dependencies), propose mitigation, and escalate to leadership with clear options.
* Process documentation and continuous improvement: maintain playbooks (campaign, webinar, newsletter, landing page), capture lessons learned and streamline standard operating procedures.
* Hands‑on Excel and light Power BI work: create pivots, formulas, and charts to answer strategic question

**Accountabilities/Results/Success For This Role**

* Campaigns and launches delivered on time and on brief.
* Weekly dashboard and executive summary published on schedule with accurate, validated data and clear insights.
* Asana task completion rate meets target S‑curve of 85% of committed tasks completed by planned publish date.
* Reduced review/approval cycle times (time from first draft to publish) by measurable percent within first 90 days.
* Smooth vendor delivery: fractional HubSpot consultant and agency SLAs met; critical milestones hit without rework

**Required Qualifications/Skills/Competencies**

* 5+ years project management or program delivery in B2B SaaS or technical marketing environments (execution focus).
* Tools: Advanced Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas), intermediate Power BI (or Looker/Tableau) experience for dashboarding, Asana admin experience, familiarity with HubSpot marketing flows
* Execution skills: strong task structuring, version control, QA mindset, asset tracking and ability to enforce deadlines while maintaining team morale.
* Communication: excellent written and spoken English for stakeholder briefs, meeting notes and executive summaries.
* Vendor & stakeholder management: proven ability to manage external agencies and fractional consultants and to coordinate SMEs across time zones and functions.
* Personal traits: high urgency, detail orientation, pragmatic problem solver.
* Logistics: Must be able to work primarily from the office.

**What We Expect From Every Pinnacle Employee**
Regardless of role, title, or tenure, you will be expected to:
  
  

* Take ownership of your work and outcomes
* Seek to understand before acting
* Contribute actively to solving challenges, not just identifying them
* Execute with discipline, quality, and reliability
* Communicate clearly to maintain alignment with teammates and customers
* Demonstrate integrity, accountability, and respect in all interactions
* Continuously learn, improve, and grow — personally and professionally

**What This Environment Is Not**
Pinnacle may not be the right fit if you:
  
  

* Prefer rigid structure with narrowly defined responsibilities
* Avoid accountability, feedback, or ownership of outcomes
* Expect problems to be solved for you rather than with you
* Are uncomfortable operating in dynamic, evolving environments
* Prioritize personal recognition over team success

We believe clarity works both ways. Our goal is long-term mutual success — not just filling roles.
  
  
**Benefits**
The Complete You
  
  

* Health, vision, and dental insurance, life insurance, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, 8 hours of volunteer paid time off (VPTO), and maternity and parental leave.

Company Celebrations
  
  

* Quarterly town hall and fellowships, length of service awards where employees receive additional paid time off and bonuses to cover travel expenses for anniversary milestone trips (5, 10, 15 and 20 years).

**Working Environment**

* Conditions may include working inside and/or outside. May work around office machinery with moving parts and moving objects. Working near radiant and electrical energy. Working closely with others or working alone. Working extended or irregular hours and travelling by all possible modes of transportation.

**Physical Job Requirements**

* Ability to walk, stand, sit, kneel, push, stoop, reach above the shoulder, grasp, pull, bend repeatedly, climb stairs, identify colors, hear with aid, see, write, count, read, speak, analyze, lift and carry under 30 lbs., and perceive depth.

**Tools And PPE Requirements**

* Equipment (machines, tools, devices) used in performing the essential job function include but not limited to computers and related equipment, calculators, copiers, fax machines, and telephone.

**Limitations and Disclaimer**
This job description describes the general job duties, accountabilities and physical requirements associates with the position;
**it is not an exhaustive list of all the duties, accountabilities, or skills required for the position.**
The general job duties, accountabilities and physical requirements associated with the position are subject to modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some physical requirements may exclude individuals who pose a threat or risk to the health or safety to themselves or others.
  
  
This job description neither states nor implies that the listed general job duties, accountabilities, and physical requirements associated with the position are the only tasks expected of an employee. An employee is also required to follow any other job-related instructions and perform any other job-related tasks requested by their supervisor and not in violation of any applicable laws, regulations, or rules.
  
  
**Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills, and abilities**
. To perform this job successfully, an employee must possess the abilities and aptitude to perform each duty, accountability, and physical requirement proficiently.

English

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.

McDonald’s has an exciting opportunity for a Supervisor, L&D Delivery (Program Deployment and Learning Technology Support) role based in our India Global Business Services Office. This role is critical in enabling the successful deployment of global learning initiatives, supporting / advising on the use of learning technologies, and ensuring effective project and translation management across markets.

You will develop standards for how projects are successfully planned and executed to ensure resourcing is properly planned to meet timeliness across the organization. Working closely with the local market learning teams and the learning design team, you will advise stakeholders on how to optimize and effectively use the organization's learning systems to support learning and development initiatives. Your role is essential in enabling scalable, high-quality learning experiences that reflect McDonald’s global brand and local market needs.

The ideal candidate will be a systems thinker who enjoys process design, with a passion for learning technologies, collaborating and engaging with stakeholders, operational excellence and the ability to work across global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Duties

**Program Deployment & Project Management**
:

• Collaborate with Global L&D and Markets to lead the deployment of L&D initiatives and priorities.

• Lead end-to-end project management for L&D initiatives, including planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk mitigation.

• Coordinate with IT and platform teams to ensure seamless deployment of learning content.

• Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams across US and global markets.

• Advocate for customer needs by capturing feedback and sharing insights with leadership and product owners.

• Coordinate communication and alignment across markets to ensure consistent user experience.

**Learning Technology Support**
:

• Support stakeholders in leveraging learning platforms (LMS, LXP, Data Warehouse, SharePoint, Brightcove) effectively.

• Effectively communicate and train local market administrators on new functionality across the learning ecosystem.

• Stay informed about new features, updates, and integrations for learning systems and implement them as needed.

• Ensure learning solutions are scalable and aligned with global standards.

• Advise on the end-to-end user experience including options for optimizing the LMS and LXP environments.

• Guide report creation to achieve project goals and reduce manual efforts

• Track and analyze KPIs to assess the effectiveness of learning programs.

• Ensure accurate tracking and reporting for compliance training and audits.

**Translation & Localization**
:

• Manage the translation and localization of global learning content across multiple languages and markets.

• Work with translation providers and internal teams to ensure accuracy, cultural relevance, and timely delivery.

• Follow QA processes for translated materials and maintain glossaries and style guides.

• Collect feedback from end-users to improve translation processes and outputs.

**Stakeholder Engagement**
:

• Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams across US and global markets.

• Advocate for customer needs by capturing feedback and sharing insights with leadership and product owners.

• Coordinate communication and alignment across markets to ensure consistent user experience

Qualifications

• 5 - 7 years of experience and a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in L&D, Project Management, or related field.

• Experience with learning platforms (LMS, LXP), cloud-based solutions, and system implementations.

• Experience with cloud-based solutions and learning platforms, including a learning management system and/or learning experience platform

• Experience with system implementations, enhancements, and documentation

• Proven experience in project management and translation/localization of learning content.

• Experience working in large, multi-national corporations with a matrixed structure.

• Experience working across many countries and cultures

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.

• Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to influence and build strong business cases for people-focused initiatives.

• Knowledge of HR compliance, data privacy, and global learning trends.

• Open to learning new systems and processes; continuous improvement mindset

McDonald’s is the world’s leading global foodservice retailer with over 40,000 locations in over 100 countries. Approximately 95% of McDonald’s restaurants worldwide are owned and operated by independent local business owners. At McDonald’s, we lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community, and family. Here is your chance to get in on something special as we grow our corporate team in India and allow you to grow your career.

title: PMO Program Manager
description:
**Summary**
At Apple, we rely on our employees diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives to champion innovation through extraordinary ideas to surprise and delight our customers. These ideas can come from anywhere. Will that next phenomenal idea come from you?
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
  
  
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.”
  
  
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here
  
  
**Description**
The PMO is a supporting part of the global Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) teams. These BPR teams are the project and business change management function within Apple Sales and Operations.
  
  
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
  
  
You will play a meaningful role within the Project Management Office (PMO) supporting all of Apple's Operations and Sales project teams. In this role you will work across a range of capacities — from shaping strategic planning, through portfolio management and governance, down to supporting individual project requests. You will also play a key role in the delivery of high-profile programs that cut across the normal structure of the project delivery organization.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role for someone who brings structure to ambiguity, sets the standard rather than follows it, and can step into a critical delivery seat when a program demands it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Standards and tooling — setting the standards and tools by which BPR completes its work.
* Strategic alignment — driving multi-year road-mapping and leading the annual capital planning process for Sales and Operations.
* Portfolio execution — owning reporting, cross-portfolio impact assessment, and organizational development for the BPR teams.
* Management system — running the operating cadence the BPR teams use to stay aligned and communicate internally.
* Program management — acting as the program management function for key cross-functional initiatives within Sales and Operations.
* Own ongoing portfolio management processes, including recurring portfolio reporting and the escalation of critical issues and exceptions to the right decision-makers.
* Continuously mature and hone the tools, methods, and techniques the PMO makes available to the BPR teams.
* Plan, schedule, and execute organizational development activities such as training programs, new-joiner inductions, workshops, and team meetings.
* Support the annual capital planning cycle, including business case review, PR/PO creation, and tracking of approved spend against plan.
* Partner closely with the IS&T PMO and adjacent delivery organizations to align governance, intake, and reporting across shared programs.
* Maintain data hygiene and integrity across portfolio systems of record, so reporting and decisions rest on trustworthy data.
* Step into a critical program delivery role under pressure for short windows of time to assure the delivery of highly visible cross-functional programs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in project management, program management, and portfolio planning and delivery — to the level of setting standards, proposing policy, and coaching others.
* Deep understanding of the end-to-end business processes of a manufacturing business, from sales through the supply chain.
* Proven ability to bring structure to your own work and to the work of others.
* Exceptional communication skills — verbal, written, and presentation.
* Solid track record of personally delivering large-scale initiatives under pressure, with high levels of complexity and ambiguity.
* Strong financial acumen, with the ability to partner credibly with Finance on capital planning, budgets, and spend governance.
* Expertise in building and automating portfolio reporting that gives leadership an objective view of program health.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a relevant field required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or Master's degree preferred.
* Background in Finance or a finance-adjacent discipline, with hands-on exposure to capital planning, budget management, and procurement processes (PR/PO lifecycle).
* Advanced proficiency in reporting and analytics tooling, with the ability to design dashboards and metrics from the ground up.
* Prior consulting experience with Big 4 consulting firms is desirable, but not required.
* Flexibility to partner with teams across multiple time zones, including occasional early or late calls during critical program phases.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as program needs require.

title: SAP - BODS - Manager
description:

As a Manager you will guide teams through planning, delivery, and review of client work, using judgment to address issues, coach junior professionals, and manage timelines across multiple priorities. * Analyzing legacy and SAP ECC source data to assess target S/4HANA fit, data quality issues, and cleansing needs

* At least 4 years of experience

* Demonstrating SAP Data Services and SAP LSMW migration delivery across S/4HANA programs
* Utilizing SAP Migration Cockpit LTMC and LTMOM for field extensions
* Building data migration solutions, transformation routines, and validation controls
* Analyzing legacy data profiles, cleansing needs, and source-to-target mappings
* Creating technical specifications for data services jobs and cutover activities
* Leading data migration workstreams and mentoring junior team members

description:
**We are Reckitt**
------------------

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

**About the role**
------------------

Reporting to the IT&D Senior Program Manager – Lab Resilience, this role is responsible for end to end delivery of technical remediation projects across Category and QC laboratories as part of the Lab Resilience Programme. The role focuses on execution of assessment driven remediation, including network segmentation, end of life (EOL) infrastructure replacement, backup deployment, observability tooling rollout, and stabilisation of post implementation operations. The role leads day to day technical delivery, coordinates vendors and site teams, and ensures solutions are implemented securely, compliantly, and sustainably within GxP laboratory environments.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

Deliver multiple concurrent technical remediation projects across laboratory environments, aligned to the Lab Resilience roadmap and governance model.  

* Own delivery of remediation activities, adoption of: Network segmentation controls, Backup and recovery processes, Armis asset visibility and alert workflows.
* Maintain detailed project plans, milestone tracking, and dependency management for all assigned labs and workstreams.
* Ensure technical implementations align with IT&D architecture standards, cyber controls, and program design authority decisions.
* Translate high‑level resilience and cyber requirements into clear site‑level implementation plans.
* Coordinate configuration, cutover, and validation activities in lab environments with minimal disruption to operations.
* Ensure remediation solutions consider lab constraints, equipment lifecycles, vendor dependencies, and validation requirements.
* Support site readiness for audits by ensuring remediation evidence, artefacts, and configuration records are complete and accurate.
* Own post implementation stabilisation, ensuring solutions transition smoothly into BAU support.
* Work with ITSM, cyber operations, and site IT to embed monitoring, alerting, and incident response procedures.
* Identify and remediate early operational issues to prevent regression of resilience improvements.
* Act as the primary delivery interface for lab sites, local IT, cyber teams, and external delivery partners.
* Coordinate third party vendors delivering network, endpoint, backup, or observability solutions.
* Escalate risks, delays, or implementation barriers with clear options and impact assessments.
* Support senior programme governance by providing accurate delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans.

Relationship Management:  

* Work closely with lab SMEs, site leadership, and IT&D platform teams to align delivery activities with operational and regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with cyber security, Architecture, platform teams to ensure remediation activities effectively reduce risk exposure.
* Build effective working relationships with external partners to ensure quality, timely delivery, and controlled handover.

**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------

Essential  

* 8–12+ years of experience delivering infrastructure, network, or cyber remediation projects in complex environments.
* Proven delivery experience across network segmentation, infrastructure refresh, and endpoint modernisation.
* Practical understanding of cyber resilient network designs and secure lab / OT adjacent environments.
* Experience delivering technical change within GxP regulated or highly governed environments.
* Strong project delivery capability across waterfall and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors and site stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong issue resolution, dependency management, and execution focus.

Desirable  

* Experience delivering remediation following cyber or resilience assessments.
* Exposure to laboratory environments, manufacturing, or OT adjacent estates.
* Familiarity with Armis, network visibility, or asset discovery platforms.
* Experience with backup and recovery solutions in industrial or lab contexts.
* Working knowledge of Zero Trust or network segmentation concepts.

Essential  

* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and project reporting tools.
* Networking, infrastructure, or cyber security certifications (vendor neutral or vendor specific) like CCNA, CISM.
* Project management certification or equivalent delivery experience (PRINCE2, PMP, Agile).

Desired  

* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management qualification.
* Understanding of NIST Cybersecurity Framework or similar security frameworks.

**The skills for success**
--------------------------

OT Cyber Security, Cyber remediation, network segmentation, Ability to manage multiple vendors, site stakeholders, understanding of cyber resilient network designs, experience across network segmentation, infrastructure refresh, and endpoint modernisation.

**What we offer**
-----------------

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

**Equality**

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Project Lead

**Job Description: Project Lead – QA/QC (Quality & QMS Auditor)**

Location: Hyderabad  
Department: Quality Control – Third Party Quality Inspection  
Experience Required: 14+ years in both Civil and MEP QA/QC works, preferably across residential high-rise and conventional construction projects

**Role Purpose**

The Project Lead – QA/QC will be responsible for leading and managing quality control and quality management system (QMS) functions across multiple residential Mivan and conventional projects, covering both Civil and MEP works. The role includes strategic QC planning, team deployment, auditing, reporting, client coordination, and ensuring compliance with IS codes, project specifications, and quality standards. The position requires strong QMS auditing expertise and practical site-level knowledge of Civil and MEP quality inspections.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and allocate QA/QC activities across multiple projects, ensuring smooth coordination and effective execution.
* Monitor Civil inspections including shuttering, reinforcement, concreting, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing works, along with MEP inspections covering electrical, plumbing, drainage, fire-fighting, HVAC, and related building services.
* Ensure Civil and MEP works comply with applicable IS codes, approved drawings, project specifications, ITP/MTP requirements, method statements, and quality procedures.
* Review, verify, and consolidate QC reports (daily/weekly/monthly) for internal use and client submission.
* Plan and manage manpower schedules and identify technical support needs for ongoing projects.
* Represent the QA/QC team in client kick-off meetings, technical discussions, and progress reviews.
* Identify quality lapses, raise NCRs, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure.
* Conduct internal quality audits, ensure QMS compliance, and support external audit processes.
* Mentor, train, and develop QC engineers to enhance technical and operational capabilities.
* Ensure adherence to ISO standards, QMS protocols, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client coordination, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution of quality issues.

Review MEP installation and testing records, including electrical systems, plumbing and drainage, fire-fighting systems, HVAC, earthing, and relevant functional tests.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Strong background in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and auditing** with hands-on experience in ISO/QMS compliance.
* Strong technical expertise in Mivan formwork and conventional residential construction.
* **Proven expertise in client coordination and team handling**, with the ability to lead multi-site operations.
* **Must have handled QA/QC operations for civil projects** across high-rise residential developments.
* Excellent knowledge of QA/QC procedures, ITP/MTP, documentation, and NCR handling.
* Strong leadership, analytical, reporting, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to maintain quality standards while managing tight project timelines.

**Mandatory:**

Strong working knowledge of MEP QA/QC practices for residential high-rise projects, including electrical, plumbing, drainage, fire-fighting, and HVAC systems.

Basic MEP knowledge: Ability to read and interpret MEP layouts, shop drawings, coordination drawings, and specifications; identify common installation and workmanship defects.

Understanding of basic electrical checks such as cable/conduit routing, panel installation, earthing, and continuity/insulation testing documentation.

Understanding of plumbing and drainage checks, including pipe routing, slope, supports, pressure/leak testing, and sanitary fixture installation.

Basic awareness of HVAC and fire-fighting installations, testing records, and coordination with Civil works.

**Qualifications**

* BE/B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering (mandatory; relevant engineering qualification with strong Civil and MEP QA/QC exposure).
* Minimum 14+ years of experience in QA/QC covering both Civil and MEP works, preferably on high-rise residential projects (Mivan and conventional construction).
* Prior third-party inspection experience is an added advantage.
* QMS/ISO auditor certification is preferred (if applicable).

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Project Director/ Project Manager - Credit Risk Consulting
description:
**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**

* **Nature of role:**
  Full time
* **Number of years of experience expected:**
* **Project Manager:**
  8–13 years, including at least 5 years hands-on in credit risk modelling, credit analytics, credit policy, or regulatory capital.
* **Project Director:**
  13–20 years, including at least 7 years in the above, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships.
* Candidates without direct credit risk modelling / analytics experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general risk consulting pedigree.
* **Areas of past experience preferred / mandatory:**
* **Credit risk modelling and scorecards:**
  application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards; credit rating and scoring models; PD / LGD / EAD models; scorecard development lifecycle including data preparation, WOE / IV analysis, logistic regression and machine learning models, cut-off setting, calibration, validation, monitoring, and redevelopment.
* **Credit risk policy and framework:**
  credit policy, underwriting and credit appraisal, delegation of authority, credit monitoring, early warning signals (EWS), restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off policy.
* **Regulatory capital and Basel:**
  credit RWA computation, Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches, capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
* **Portfolio analytics:**
  vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency analysis, concentration risk, portfolio ECL, collections and recovery analytics.
* **IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109:**
  impairment model design, staging and SICR logic, ECL computation, macro-economic scenario design, and disclosures.
* **Model risk management:**
  model validation, model governance, model inventory, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity and outcome analysis, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Regulatory frameworks:**
  RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, IRAC, and provisioning; Basel III / IV; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait) preferred.
* Consulting or in-house risk analytics experience with banks, NBFCs, insurers, or corporates.
* **Educational qualification expected:**
  Graduate / Postgraduate
* **Additional qualifications / certifications required:**
  None
* **Preferable additional certifications:**
  CA / FRM / Actuarial / CQF / PRM / CFA
* **Preferred geography of previous work experience:**
  India / Europe / APAC / US / Middle East
* **Language requirements:**
  Ability to write and speak fluently in English
* **Application experience preferable:**
  MS Excel, VBA, Python, R, SAS, SQL

**Key responsibility areas:**

A. Engagement delivery and project leadership

* Independently lead and manage consulting engagements with leading banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, insurance companies, and corporates across credit risk modelling, credit policy, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, and model risk management.
* Own end-to-end delivery: scoping, project planning, resourcing, risk identification, mitigation, stakeholder coordination, and sign-off.
* Lead client conversations on methodology, assumptions, model design, policy interpretation, regulatory expectations, and business impact.
* Drive day-to-day execution of assigned client projects and produce regular status reporting for management on progress, challenges, and key milestones.
* Manage audit, internal review, and regulator interactions related to models, credit policy, capital computation, ECL, and provisioning.

B. Credit risk modelling and scorecards

* Lead development, review, and redevelopment of credit scorecards across the customer lifecycle: application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards.
* Lead development and review of credit rating and scoring models, including PD, LGD, and EAD models for retail and wholesale portfolios.
* Own the full model development lifecycle: data preparation, treatment of missing values and outliers, WOE / IV analysis, variable selection, segmentation, model building (logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting, and other ML techniques), scaling, cut-off setting, and calibration.
* Define and implement model monitoring frameworks: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis, and trigger-based redevelopment.
* Support credit strategy design, including approval / rejection / limit assignment strategies and risk-based pricing inputs.
* Produce clear, defensible model documentation and validation-ready model development reports.

C. Credit risk policy, framework, and regulatory capital

* Review, design, and draft credit risk policies covering credit appraisal, underwriting, delegation of authority, collateral management, credit monitoring, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.
* Assess policy effectiveness against regulatory requirements and internal risk appetite, and recommend enhancements.
* Lead credit RWA computation under Standardized and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches.
* Support capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing exercises.
* Build and review stress testing and scenario analysis frameworks for credit risk, including portfolio-level impact assessment.
* Interpret and apply RBI, Basel III / IV, and Middle East regulatory expectations on credit risk, capital, and provisioning.

D. Portfolio analytics

* Lead portfolio analytics covering vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency and bucket movement, concentration risk, and portfolio ECL.
* Build collections and recovery analytics, including recovery rate modelling and prepayment behaviour analysis.
* Develop portfolio dashboards and MIS for risk committees, boards, and regulators.
* Identify emerging risk trends and recommend corrective actions at portfolio level.

E. IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment

* Lead IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment workstreams covering staging, SICR assessment, ECL computation, and enhancement of ECL and provisioning approaches.
* Design and review macro-economic scenario design, satellite models, and forward-looking overlay adjustments.
* Support IFRS 9 transition and implementation, including parallel run, impact assessment, and disclosure requirements.
* Align IFRS 9 ECL with credit policy, provisioning policy, and regulatory capital frameworks.

F. Model risk management

* Lead model validation and independent review: conceptual soundness, data quality, methodology review, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.
* Design and strengthen model risk management frameworks, including model governance, model inventory, model tiering, validation standards, and ongoing monitoring.
* Define model risk appetite, model risk reporting, and escalation protocols.
* Support regulatory and audit reviews on model risk management practices.

G. Practice, people, and business (Project Director emphasis)

* Lead and be responsible for team mentoring, project management, and client delivery.
* Own project revenue, margin, and resource utilization for assigned engagements.
* Generate business from existing clients and support pre-sales, proposals, and solutioning for new clients.
* Build and scale the credit risk consulting practice, including hiring, capability building, and reusable methodologies, scorecard templates, and accelerators.
* Represent Acies in client leadership forums and industry discussions on credit risk, IFRS 9, capital, and model risk.

**Other important information:**

* **Work permit requirements:**
  Either Indian Citizen or having valid works in India
* **Period of engagement:**
  Full time
* **Probation period:**
  6 months
* **Compensation:**
  Compensation varies depending on the skill, fitment and role played by the person. Compensation discussions will take place post the selection process.
* **Performance incentives:**
  Typically, all roles at Acies have a performance incentive. Specific aspects will be discussed during the compensation discussion
* **Leave:**
  19 working days a year. Additional leaves for national holidays, sick leaves, maternity and paternity, bereavement and studies vary based on the city and country of engagement.
* **Other benefits:**
  Other employment benefits including medical insurance will be informed during the compensation discussion.
* **Career growth for full-time roles:**
  Acies believes in a transparent and data-based performance evaluation system. You are encouraged to clarify any questions you have with respect to career growth with Acies personnel you interact with during the selection process.
* **Career opportunities for part-time roles:**
  Conversion of part-time roles to full-time roles depends on both performance of the individual and business needs. You are encouraged to ask about the prospects as you interact with Acies personnel during the selection process.
* **Global mobility:**
  Acies encourages mobility across our offices. Such mobility is, however, subject to business needs and regulations governing immigration and employment in various countries.

**Selection process:**

We seek to be transparent during the selection process. While the actual process may vary from the process indicated below, the key steps involved are as follows:

1. **Technical and modelling interview:**
   Deep-dive assessment of scorecard and rating model development, PD / LGD / EAD modelling, model validation, and credit policy experience.
2. **Case study / modelling round:**
   Practical scenario covering scorecard development, staging and ECL computation, capital computation, or model validation findings.
3. **Delivery and leadership interview:**
   Project ownership, stakeholder management, team leadership, and commercial acumen.
4. **Final discussion on career and compensation:**
   Post final selection, a separate discussion will be set up to discuss compensation and career growth.

The number of interview rounds may increase depending on the criticality and seniority of the role involved.

**Preparation required:**

It is recommended that you prepare on the following aspects before the selection process:

* Understanding of products and exposures in the financial services industry (Banks / NBFC / Insurance).
* Credit risk modelling concepts: PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, default rates, credit scores, recovery rates, and prepayment behaviour.
* Scorecard development lifecycle: data preparation, WOE / IV, segmentation, model building, scaling, cut-off setting, validation, and monitoring.
* Model monitoring metrics: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis.
* Credit risk policy and framework: underwriting, credit appraisal, delegation of authority, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.
* Regulatory capital: credit RWA, Standardised and IRB approaches, CRAR, capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
* IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standard requirements, including staging, SICR assessment, forward-looking information, and disclosure requirements.
* Model validation techniques: back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.
* Model risk management frameworks, model governance, and regulatory expectations.
* Regulatory frameworks: Basel III / IV, RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, and provisioning; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait).
* Tools: SQL, Python, R, SAS, VBA, and advanced Excel.

For any additional queries you may have, you can send a LinkedIn InMail to us, connect with us at https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html or e-mail us at careers@acies.holdings.

**How to reach us:**

Should you wish to apply for this job, please reach out to us directly through LinkedIn or apply on our website career page - https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html

description:
**Job Title: Sr. Product & Automation Lead**

Mumbai (Work from Office)

Ranging from ₹12 LPA to 20 LPA (Fixed + Variable) + ESOPs + milestone-based compensation growth

**About Scale100x.ai**

Scale100x.ai is the world's first AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner expansion. Built by the founders of Expertrons, we are serial entrepreneurs and IIT Bombay alumni who have built and exited ventures and scaled 300+ franchise networks across industries.

We partner with high-potential brands to:

* Build 100+ offline outlets/partners per year
* Use AI agents to supercharge sales and marketing execution
* Improve profitability through data-driven operations
* Support fundraising, investor relations and IPO readiness

In the last year we've driven scale for brands across EV, F&B, Salon, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more, including helping one brand close a $5.4M Series A. Our sales engine runs on high-volume, WhatsApp-first lead flow, and we are rebuilding it to be AI-native.

**The Role**

We are moving from LeadSquared to an AI-native CRM and want to put AI agents at the center of how we sell, follow up, onboard and report. You will own that transformation end to end: choosing the platform, migrating without losing a single lead, and building the agents and automations that run on top of it, across our different verticals.

This is a builder's role. You will work directly with the founders, and you should be as comfortable in a CRM admin panel or an n8n workflow as in a leadership review.

**What You'll Own**

**1. CRM selection and migration (LeadSquared → AI-native CRM)**

* Evaluate AI-native CRM options against our needs (cost, WhatsApp and telephony support, agent capabilities, integrations) and make a clear recommendation.
* Plan and run the migration: data cleanup and mapping, pipeline redesign, integrations, cutover and parallel run.
* Drive team adoption so that data quality and usage improve after the switch, not just the tooling.

**2. AI agents and automation across verticals**

* Map the lead-to-onboarding journey (enquiry, qualification, commercials, agreement, onboarding) and identify what agents can own and where a human must stay in the loop.
* Build and deploy agents and automations for lead qualification, follow-ups, call summaries, CRM updates, reminders and reporting.
* Adapt and reuse these workflows across verticals such as EV, F&B, Salon, Retail and EdTech, and over time package them for client brands.
* Measure every automation on time saved, response time and conversion impact.

**3. Integrations and systems**

* Connect the CRM with WhatsApp Business API, telephony/IVR, e-sign, email, finance and internal tools using APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms.
* Own reliability: monitoring, fallbacks and documentation.

**4. Analytics and ROI**

* Build dashboards for pipeline health, leakage by stage, agent performance and revenue outcomes.
* Build the business case for each initiative and report results to the founders.

**5. Ownership and execution**

* Run projects from problem definition to rollout with clear milestones and accountability.
* Work with sales, operations, product and tech teams, and flag risks and dependencies early.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years in CRM implementation, business systems, revenue operations, product operations or automation-led roles.
* Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CRM (LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), including at least one full data migration and cutover.
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-based automations in production. Please share a workflow you built and its outcome.
* Fluency with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar).
* Experience integrating WhatsApp Business API and telephony/IVR into a sales workflow.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define metrics, build dashboards and quantify ROI.
* Ability to work independently with founders and cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI-native CRM platforms.
* Background in high-volume, lead-driven businesses such as franchising, edtech, real estate or D2C.
* Exposure to product strategy or product operations, and to financial modelling.
* Startup, consulting or SaaS experience.

**What We Expect**

* **Ownership:**
  you drive initiatives without continuous supervision.
* **Execution:**
  you move from recommendation to live implementation.
* **Business sense:**
  you connect every system and automation to a measurable outcome.
* **Structured problem-solving:**
  you frame the problem, test quickly and iterate.

**Who Should Apply**

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

title: Manager – Customer Experience
description:
* Customer Experience Strategy & Economics
* Build and own the CX scorecard beyond NPS: OTIF (on-time-in-full), CPKO, resolution speed, escalation

rate, repeat-purchase behavior by customer tier — and tie every one of them to a revenue or retention
  
  
number leadership can act on.
  
  

* Quantify the cost and reorder impact of every major CX failure mode (damaged/missing items, delivery

issues, refund delays) and use it to prioritize fixes by rupee impact, not by ticket volume.
  
  

* Own resolution-policy decisions (e.g., redispatch vs. refund) with hard data on which choice actually

keeps a customer.
  
  
Data-Driven Program Management
  
  

* Be comfortable pulling and validating your own data (SQL, BigQuery or equivalent) rather than waiting

on a dashboard someone else maintains.
  
  

* Run root-cause analysis that survives scrutiny — right-sized samples, corrected logic, honest callouts

when two systems disagree, and a clear line between “verified” and “a model.”
  
  

* Segment customers by lifetime value and behavior (tiers, first-time vs. repeat, state/geography) to find

where the highest-leverage interventions are, not just the loudest complaints.
  
  

* AI &Automation
* Own the chatbot/IVR stack end to end: containment rate, cost per conversation, and — critically —

instrument what today isn't measured (does “closed” actually mean “resolved”?).
  
  

* Identify and build the next generation of AI-driven CX: proactive delivery-risk alerts, automated win-

back campaigns for lapsing customers, smarter self-serve flows — always backed by a quantified
  
  
opportunity size.
  
  

* Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (chat, IVR, call-scoring platforms) on total cost and actual

capability, not the sales deck.
  
  
Team & Operating Model
  
  

* Build and lead a small, accountable team across three areas: CX Tools & Vendor Management, CX

Metrics & Voice of Customer, and Data & Automation.
  
  

* Replace informal, single-point-of-failure ownership with clear RACI, documented processes, and a team

that can operate without you in the room.
  
  

* Run structured win-back and retention initiatives (e.g., outbound campaigns for customers who've gone

quiet at 90/180 days) with proper reason-code diagnosis, not just reminder blasts.
  
  

* Voice of the Customer
* Personally read and act on customer feedback — the good, the near-miss, and the genuinely angry.

Every customer who takes the time to write in is a free, high-signal data point; treat it that way.
  
  

* Turn qualitative complaints into structured, quantified problems the business can prioritize.

title: Technical Team Leader – Electrical Commissioning (CxA)-Datacenter
description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment.

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an Electrical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to spearhead the commissioning delivery team for hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects.

This role will provide strategic technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0–L6, with particular emphasis on L3 Energization, L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Spearhead and mentor a team of 15–20+ commissioning leads and engineers, fostering technical excellence and professional development.
* Establish and own the electrical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance framework.
* Champion L3/L4/L5 commissioning delivery, including energization, FPT, IST and failure-mode testing protocols.
* Provide comprehensive technical oversight across HV/MV/LV systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, ATS/STS, busway, PDU/PMDC and EPMS/SCADA infrastructure.
* Review and validate SLDs, protection schemes, coordination studies, load-flow/short-circuit/arc-flash studies, SOO and commissioning test scripts for technical accuracy and compliance.
* Lead and oversee FAT/SAT, primary and secondary injection testing, protection verification, load-bank testing and integrated systems testing activities.
* Validate seamless electrical integration with BMS, EPMS, mechanical and fire/life-safety systems to ensure operational coherence.
* Drive resolution of commissioning issues through rigorous RCA, maintain risk registers, manage punch lists and ensure technical close-out compliance.
* Serve as the senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, consultants, contractors, OEMs and utilities, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder alignment.
* Champion electrical safety culture, LOTO protocols, energization and switching procedures throughout the commissioning lifecycle.

**Requirements**

* 15+ years overall electrical engineering/commissioning experience.
* 8+ years data-center or mission-critical electrical commissioning experience.
* Proven leadership of at least 3-4 complete L3/L4/L5 commissioning cycles.
* Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs in hyperscale projects.
* Experience managing 15–20+ engineers/technicians.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of HV/MV/LV, protection, generators, UPS, EPMS/SCADA and integrated testing.
* Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, TIA-942, IEC, IEEE, NETA, NFPA 70/70E/110 and applicable local codes.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills

**Qualifications**

Preferred Certifications

NETA III/IV | CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD or equivalent

Ideal background: Hyperscale/colocation data centers, substations, power generation, semiconductor, pharmaceutical/life sciences, or other mission-critical facilities.

**Location: New Mumbai**

**Additional Information**

At FPC, we’re not just a company—we’re a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that:

* Shapes the Future: Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and bold ambition.

* Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard—while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance.

title: Project Manager Construction, BOM
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
  
  
Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
  
  
At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Data Center CM Will Be Responsible For**

* Assist in project management and oversight of construction-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.

A day in the life
  
  
At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in vendor management
* Experience in a data center or other critical environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of construction or project management experience
* Experience in construction or project management
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment

* Familiarity with cloud-based data warehousing solutions and integration techniques.
* Excellent skills in coordinating cross-functional teams and managing project timelines.
* Snowflake: warehouse sizing/cost optimization, Snowpipe, RBAC/security model, query performance tuning
