title: Senior Manager - NPI
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Own the end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from design transfer to stable commercial production. Lead cross-functional stage-gate reviews, ensuring products progress only when readiness criteria for cost, quality, supply, and operational execution are met, delivering successful launches on time and in full.
  
  
This role provides leadership and governance for the NPI portfolio, owning launch outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and stage-gate decisions. While the NPI Planner manages operational execution across materials, capacity, builds, and inventory, this role is accountable for overall NPI success and commercialization readiness.
  
  
**Key Tasks**
NPI process ownership
  
  

* Define, run and continuously improve the stage-gate NPI process (concept, design, prototype, pilot, ramp, release to mass production), including gate criteria, templates and governance.
* Run the NPI portfolio: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
* Own the handover from Technology to Operations and the transition to steady-state manufacturing.

Cross-functional evaluation and gate decisions
  
  

* Chair NPI gate reviews with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing Engineering, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial.
* Assess each product for manufacturability, test and quality readiness, supplier readiness, compliance, cost and launch risk.
* Make or escalate go / no-go / conditional-go recommendations with documented risks and mitigations.

NPI delivery
  
  

* Own schedule, budget, scope and risk for each project; maintain the master NPI plan and critical path.
* Drive risk management and resolve cross-functional conflicts quickly.
* Manage contract manufacturers and key suppliers for pilot builds and ramp, where applicable.

Cost, quality and supply readiness
  
  

* Agree target cost, yield and first-pass quality with Finance, Quality and Manufacturing; track the gap to target at every gate.
* Ensure the NPI Planner’s material, capacity and build plans support each gate date and launch volume.
* Ensure change control, BOM and documentation are complete and released before production.

Lead NPI Portfolio & Performance Management
  
  

* Maintain the consolidated NPI roadmap and publish dashboards covering project health, milestone adherence, launch readiness, action closure, and post-launch performance.

Lead Export Readiness for NPI PLanning
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment and close coordination with Export teams to establish inventory strategies, distribution networks, capacity plans, and market-specific supply requirements for successful export launches.
* Govern the transition of NPI projects into business-as-usual export operations, ensuring seamless handover, supply continuity, and service reliability across all destination markets.

Leadership and stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the NPI team; set objectives and manage performance.
* Report on project status, risks and decisions to senior leadership and the executive team.
* Capture lessons learned after each launch and feed them back into the process.

**Experience Required**

* Graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage
* 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience with strong exposure to NPI, Planning, Product Lifecycle Management, Project Management, or Supply Chain Transformation.
* Proven experience in leading cross-functional NPI, commercialization, innovation, or product-transition programs.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, S&OP, and phase-in/phase-out processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Strong project management, risk management, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent launches.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. **Crude, Refined Products or Petrochemicals Markets,**
demonstrating strong leadership capabilities to guide project teams. A background in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or an MBA qualification is highly preferred.

Companies in 140 countries as well as multilaterals like the International Energy Agency (IEA) use Argus data to index physical trade and as benchmarks in financial derivative markets as well as for analysis and planning purposes.
* We also have a burgeoning commodities markets consulting division that offers clients insights into the evolving markets and the opportunities that these changes present. This division uses industry best practices, expert knowledge and Argus’ proprietary data to provide its clients with in-depth market analysis, the development of business strategies, evaluation of capital projects and advise on operations across a wide range of commodities and geographies. The division counts the biggest names in energy, petrochemicals, fertilizers and metals as well as governments as its clients.
* Given that our consulting business has been growing significantly over the last few years and we are currently looking for a Senior Consultant to join our consulting projects team in Mumbai that would focus on a broad range of energy markets. The specifics of the job are laid out below.
* Lead and execute bespoke consulting projects for Crude, refined Products & Petrochemicals market together with consultants in a project team.
* Steer client engagements, discussions during project executions and results presentations.
* Playing pivotal role in development of proposals and marketing materials on specific consulting opportunities. Taking the accountability and working collaboratively with Argus’ sales representative to win consulting projects.
* Assist research & analytics teams in the development of in-house consulting tools, forecast modelling tools and analytics to empower projects with data driven solutions and emerging market trends.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and growth by nurturing and developing consultants, equipping them with the product knowledge and analytics research skills needed to excel in their roles and contribute to the success of our team.

**Skills And Experience**
**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical or mechanical engineering or an MBA (preferred).

**Consulting Expertise**

* Minimum 3 years of consulting experience in Crude, Refined Products, or Petrochemicals markets.
* Proven ability to lead and execute bespoke consulting projects and manage client engagements.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Strong leadership skills to guide project teams and foster a culture of learning and growth.
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and engage with stakeholders at all levels.

**Analytical & Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience in developing methodologies, forecast modeling tools, and conducting market research.
* Familiarity with databases and data-driven solutions.

**Communication & Presentation**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to craft compelling presentations and confidently present findings to senior leadership.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of energy markets, including crude, refined products, and petrochemicals.

* Monitoring programme health metrics and turning them into insight, spotting trends in training completion, readiness, and risk areas
* Spotting programme risks early, assessing them, and escalating with clear context and a recommendation rather than just a flag
* Acting as the point of escalation for operational issues, driving them to resolution across teams and vendors
* Managing day-to-day relationships with vendor partners and holding them to quality and delivery standards
* Partnering with the Learning Director on continuous improvement work, including AI, automation, and process optimisation pilots.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience within training operations, enablement, program operations, or operational excellence, ideally in a global or enterprise environment
* Proven ability to own a program end to end, including making and defending prioritization calls
* Comfort operating in a fast-changing, still-developing program rather than a fully settled one
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions without formal authority
* Demonstrated experience identifying, managing, and mitigating operational and program-level risks
* Demonstrated experience in operationalising processes using AI at a Claude, Copilot or GPT interface rather than bought specialist tools
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage complex, parallel workstreams with minimal oversight
* Strong analytical mindset, comfortable turning data into clear insights and narratives
* Clear, concise, and professional written and verbal communication skills in English, including with senior stakeholders
* Comfort operating in a global, matrixed environment across time zones and cultures
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity

* Experience with learning systems, training platforms, readiness models, or governance frameworks
* Experience with AI-enabled operations, automation, or process optimization pilots
* Background in large client environments
* Experience with vendor management
* Familiarity with vendor skilling, readiness, or enablement programmes at scale.

title: Sr. Project Construction Manager , AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD)
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Sr. Project Manager is a strategically significant role on the Data Center Construction team dedicated to leading projects for construction of Data centers. You will lead the Electricals Substation and transmission Project and construction management for our projects in Hyderabad.
  
  
Our Data Center Construction team owns and drives the construction life cycle from pre-construction, through procurement, to managing the onsite construction work. The Project manager will be expected to dive deep and know construction management; inspire and think big about the construction management program; and support, related stakeholders within AWS to deliver electrical supply capacity and capability to our customers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Manage the project delivery across multiple sites including developing managing and reporting on safety, quality scope, schedule and budget ensuring predictable delivery within the business, cost and schedule expectations.
* Strategic and tactical management of construction capacity delivery within Hyderabad
* Communicate and provide guidance to Finance during the development and execution of capital budgets.
* Work with Energy team of AWS to partner on delivering the electrical supply capability and capacity to the Data centers being constructed.
* Coordinate with various teams supporting the data center development and launch.
* Develop and manage metrics quantifying performance within the region.

A day in the life
  
  
AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent, or 6+ years of project management and implementation experience
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems
* Which option best describes your total electrical or mechanical engineering experience?
* 10+ years of construction management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) plants experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
* Knowledge of both mechanical and electrical equipment or design related to data center electrical and mechanical topology
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures

title: Events Marketing Manager
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a high-energy, exceptionally organized
**Events Marketing Manager**
to take end-to-end ownership of Third Bridge’s global event programs. Given the global scope of this role, flexibility for non-standard working hours across time zones will be required at times.
  
  
In this role, you will design, produce, and execute a dynamic calendar of client and prospect events, including exclusive networking dinners, sponsorships of flagship industry summits, bespoke roundtables, webinars, and partner activations. You will act as the operational engine behind our physical and virtual event strategy, bringing creative concepts to life while ensuring flawless execution across our key international markets.
  
  
This is a hands-on position requiring a naturally resourceful event professional with strong project management capabilities, robust budget management expertise, a sharp commercial mindset, and a proven track record in stakeholder management. Working across global business units, you will collaborate with senior executives, commercial leaders, and external partners to represent the Third Bridge brand at the highest level, while maintaining meticulous tracking to measure and communicate event impact.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* End-to-end event execution
* Plan, manage, and execute the full lifecycle of Third Bridge’s event strategy across key markets (UK, Europe, APAC, US), spanning owned events, sponsored industry conferences, virtual webinars, and hybrid experiences.
* Take full ownership of physical, hybrid, and digital event production, including on-site operations, virtual platform management, run-of-show logistics, venue sourcing, and vendor coordination to ensure seamless attendee experiences.
* Develop detailed event production schedules, workback timelines, and operational checklists to maintain absolute rigor across concurrent projects.
* Stakeholder & Relationship management
* Act as a trusted partner to internal leadership, commercial teams, and senior executives, aligning event concepts with business development and client retention goals.
* Manage high-touch external relationships, including industry partners, venue teams, production agencies, and suppliers.
* Brief internal executive speakers and host prep sessions prior to live engagements e.g. for panel discussions, webinars.
* Budget & resource ownership
* Manage global event budgets with strict financial discipline, negotiating contracts, tracking purchase orders, and optimizing spend across regions.
* Oversee agency and vendor procurement, ensuring quality, cost efficiency, and global service-level agreements.
* Campaigns, tracking performance & ROI
* Partner with the wider Marketing team to build pre- and post-event communication workflows (invitations, landing pages, forms, attendee follow-up, and feedback loops).
* Drive robust data tracking: Own end-to-end event analytics—monitoring registration conversion, attendance rates, engagement, and sales pipeline attribution (sourced and influenced revenue).
* Build and maintain global event reporting dashboards to present post-event analysis, ROI assessments, and actionable recommendations directly to senior marketing and business leadership.

**About You**

* Proven experience: You bring 5+ years of hands-on event planning and production experience, ideally within professional services, financial services, tech, or high-touch B2B environments.
* Proactive & Resourceful: You have a "roll-up-your-sleeves" mindset. You stay composed under pressure, think fast on your feet, and naturally find solutions when unexpected challenges arise.
* Masterful communicator: You possess exceptional interpersonal skills with a natural knack for managing diverse internal and external stakeholders, from external vendors to C-suite executives.
* Data-driven & Commercial mindset: You understand that events are business-critical growth drivers. You are fluent in event metrics, lead tracking, CRM/marketing automation tools, and demonstrating tangible ROI to business leaders.
* Relentlessly organized: You have exceptional project management skills and an eagle eye for detail. You live for detailed timelines, run-of-show schedules, accurate attendee tracking, and clear action items.
* Flexibility & Global mindset: Comfortable working in a matrixed global environment; given the global reach of this role, flexible and non-standard working hours will be required to coordinate across time zones, conduct meetings, and manage live event executions.

**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading SharePoint projects end-to-end, managing a technical team, coordinating with stakeholders, and delivering scalable, secure, and efficient SharePoint solutions. * Allocate tasks, monitor productivity, and ensure timely delivery of assigned work.
* Conduct code reviews, technical discussions, performance reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support team members in resolving technical challenges and improving development practices.

* Conduct client meetings, requirement workshops, and solution demonstrations.
* Present technical solutions, project status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Build strong client relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and other technology specialists.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum **7+ years of overall experience** in SharePoint development, implementation, consulting, or administration.

* Experience with SharePoint architecture, site collections, lists, libraries, permissions, workflows, and content management.
* Proficiency in SharePoint Framework (SPFx), JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, and REST APIs, as applicable to project requirements.
* Experience with Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation and business process solutions.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Graph API, Azure, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365 integrations.
* Experience in SharePoint migration, customization, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint governance, security, access control, and information architecture.
* Demonstrated experience in project planning, estimation, execution, and delivery management.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a technical team.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft certifications related to SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or Azure.
* Experience with SharePoint migration tools and third-party migration solutions.
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, and enterprise document management.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Experience managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously.
* Experience in client-facing consulting or IT services organizations.

Key Competencies

* Technical leadership and solution design
* Project planning and delivery management
* Team leadership, mentoring, and resource management
* Client communication and stakeholder coordination
* Risk management and problem resolution
* Quality assurance and process improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and decision-making

* Effective management and utilization of technical resources.
* High client satisfaction and successful stakeholder engagement.
* Adherence to technical standards, security, and governance requirements.
* Improved team productivity, delivery predictability, and solution quality.

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Technical Lead - OpenBlue CUPO Systems Specialist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Johnson Controls is shaping a future that is more productive, secure, and sustainable by applying cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and Design Thinking to intelligent buildings.
  
  
In this role, you will help deliver OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions that support reliable, efficient central utilities for critical environments such as universities, hospitals, airports, office towers, and data centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**

* Based in Pune, this position leads the engineering, integration, commissioning, and optimization of OpenBlue CUP solutions for district energy and chiller plants globally. You will serve as the technical lead for project execution, aligning delivery with customer objectives, schedules, and performance goals while helping drive energy savings, reduced water use, and lower carbon impact.
* Key Responsibilities
* Lead the engineering and project execution of OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions from design through closeout.
* Analyze site and operational data to build accurate energy models using CUPO software and identify optimization opportunities.
* Prepare drawings, scopes of work, and recommissioning requirements for sensors, meters, and controls needed to make a plant CUP-ready.
* Oversee system design, programming, installation coordination, commissioning, performance validation, and project closeout activities.
* Create and execute integration test plans with controls service contractors to verify bidirectional data and command flow between CPO and the plant automation system.
* Oversee point mapping and local plant automation programming to support smooth transitions between operating modes.
* Validate system functionality, analyze command dispatch results, and resolve issues throughout commissioning and startup.
* Collaborate with customers, plant operators, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance outcomes.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineering team members, and train operators and end users on OpenBlue CUP solutions.
* Maintain strong ethics, quality, safety, and compliance with Johnson Controls policies and applicable regulations.
* How You Will Do It
* Own project outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping delivery aligned to scope, schedule, and customer expectations.
* Stay close to the work by reviewing plant data, point maps, and field results to identify practical optimization actions and remove obstacles quickly.
* Improve every day through structured test plans, candid troubleshooting, and continuous refinement of engineering standards and methods.
* Win as one team by working closely with controls contractors, project managers, operators, and other engineering disciplines.
* Lead regular progress meetings, document decisions clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of risks, changes, and commissioning status.
* Use Microsoft Project or similar tools to support planning, coordination, and milestone tracking.
* Translate technical findings into clear training and support so plant teams can confidently operate the CUP solution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in building automation controls engineering, programming, and commissioning.
* Strong expertise in integrating building systems using industry-standard protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks.
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and commissioning central utility plant control systems, including automation startup and commissioning for at least five live critical facility projects.
* Hands-on experience in energy modeling, chiller plant optimization, data analytics, and performance assessment using software tools.
* Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards and provide technical leadership to engineering teams.
* Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills, with experience using Microsoft Project or similar tools.
* Prior experience supervising and mentoring technical or engineering staff.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international assignments.

**Nice to Have**

* Master’s degree or Professional Engineer registration.
* Strong understanding of energy modeling and data analytics.
* Strong background in the Metasys suite of tools.
* Programming capability for multiple makes and models of building automation systems and PLC systems.

**Why Join Us**
You will contribute to meaningful work that helps customers reduce operating costs, lower energy consumption, and improve the performance of critical central plants. This is an opportunity to apply your technical leadership in a collaborative environment focused on intelligent buildings, sustainability, and reliable outcomes.
  
  
If this sounds like the right next step for you, we invite you to apply and help shape the future of OpenBlue CUP solutions.

title: Sr Pharmacovigilance Data Migration Consultant – Oracle Argus Safety
description:

Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
* Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
* Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
* Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
* Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
* Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
* Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
* Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Experience with PostgreSQL-to-Oracle schema conversion, including tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, views, triggers, stored procedures, and functions.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills.
* Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.

title: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) Lead
description:
**Job Title**
: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Pune, India (VE3 Pune office; hybrid)
  
  
**Position Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience Level:**
10-14 years
  
  
**Working Pattern:**
Offshore delivery with overlap into UK business hours to align with the onshore team and client
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) Lead to own the EC solution on a large-scale SuccessFactors and Employee Central Payroll (ECP) transformation. The programme migrates a complex UK public sector payroll and HR estate from SAP HCM on S/4HANA into the SAP SuccessFactors landscape, covering approximately 65,000 employee and pensioner records, 17 payrolls, multiple public sector pension schemes (LGPS, Teachers, NHS), external employers paid on the client's payroll, and a significant multiple-employment population.
  
  
This role is based in VE3's Pune office as part of an onshore-offshore delivery model, working with a daily overlap into UK business hours alongside the onshore team. Employee Central is the system of record for the programme. It goes live first, alongside Recruiting and Onboarding, and then becomes the source of employee data for Employee Central Payroll. For several months between those go-lives EC runs alongside the existing SAP payroll, so the EC design has to work for both. The EC Lead owns the EC design and build, leads the offshore EC configuration team, and runs remote design sessions with client stakeholders, covering the organisation structure, position management, job and pay data, employee lifecycle events, custom data objects, role-based permissions and data retention.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**
**EC solution ownership**
. Own the Employee Central solution end to end, from fit-to-standard and detailed design through configuration workbooks, build, testing and go-live, and take accountability for EC design sign-off at each programme milestone.
  
  
**Client design leadership.**
Lead EC design workshops with HR, payroll, finance and IT stakeholders, present options with a clear recommendation, record decisions, and drive open questions to closure with named owners and dates.
  
  
**Foundation and organisation structure**
. Design legal entities, business units, divisions, departments, locations, cost centres, pay groups and pay structures, including the UK legal entity fields (for example PAYE reference and Accounts Office reference) that SAP does not deliver as standard. The client is redesigning its organisation in parallel, so the structure must absorb change without rework.
  
  
**Position management.**
Design position management and the reporting hierarchy, including how the hierarchy is built during migration where the legacy system holds little position-to-position reporting.
  
  
**Employee data and lifecycle**
. Design job information, compensation and pay components, and the employee lifecycle (hire, rehire, transfer, job and pay change, termination), with event reasons, workflows and business rules.
  
  
**Complex populations**
. Design how EC handles:
  
  

* Multiple and concurrent employments
* External employers paid on the client's payroll
* Pensioner populations held in EC without an active position
* Employees moving between payrolls and employers

**Extensibility**
. Design custom MDF objects for client-specific data held today in custom infotypes (for example teacher qualifications and status), and agree with the client what is carried forward and what is retired.
  
  
**Permissions and data protection**
. Design role-based permissions with the client, and the data retention and purge approach (DRTM) that meets UK GDPR and the client's statutory retention rules.
  
  
**Payroll and integration alignment.**
Agree with the ECP Lead and the integration team the EC data that payroll depends on, and the EC to payroll replication approach, including the period when EC is live but payroll still runs on the existing SAP system.
  
  
**Data migration.**
Work with the data migration team on EC load templates, field mapping, transformation rules and reconciliation across each data cycle, and confirm EC data quality before each load.
  
  
**Recruiting and Onboarding fit**
. Make sure the EC design supports the Recruiting and Onboarding modules going live alongside it, including position, job and new hire data flowing into EC.
  
  
**Testing, cutover and hypercare.**
Support system integration testing and UAT, own EC defect resolution, prepare and run the EC cutover activities, and lead EC through hypercare and stabilisation.
  
  
**Team leadership.**
Lead and quality-assure the work of the EC configuration consultants, set configuration and documentation standards, and review all EC build before it goes into test.
  
  
**Onshore-offshore collaboration**
. Work closely with the onshore UK-based programme, functional and client leads, maintaining a daily overlap with UK business hours and joining client design sessions remotely throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Technical Skills & Experience**

* Deep hands-on Employee Central configuration: foundation objects, Corporate and Succession data models, country-specific fields, picklists, MDF and generic objects, Business Rules and workflows
* Position management, including position hierarchy design, Position Org Chart, and the rules that keep positions and employee job data in step.
* Role-based permissions design, including permission groups, target populations and field-level access.
* EC data loads and validation using Import Employee Data, MDF import and export, Integration Center and the OData API.
* Data Retention Management (DRTM) and UK GDPR design in SuccessFactors.
* Understanding of how EC feeds Employee Central Payroll, and the EC data payroll relies on (pay components, cost assignment, multiple employments).
* Working knowledge of SAP HCM (PA and OM infotypes) to map the legacy design and data into EC.
* SAP Activate, configuration workbooks, and managing the twice-yearly SuccessFactors release cycle.

**Essential Experience**

* At least two full-lifecycle Employee Central implementations in a lead or solution architect role
* Leading client-facing design workshops and owning design sign-off
* Position management and complex organisation structure design
* Role-based permissions and data protection design
* Migration from SAP HCM on-premise to Employee Central
* Leading and reviewing the work of a configuration team

**Desirable Experience**

* UK public sector or local government HR (for example councils, schools and academies, pension funds)
* Employee Central integrated with Employee Central Payroll
* Multiple and concurrent employment design
* Recruiting and Onboarding integration with EC
* People Analytics (Stories) reporting on EC data
* Organisation redesign delivered during a live implementation

**Certifications**

* Essential: Current SAP certification in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Core, kept up to date through SAP Learning Hub.
* Desirable: SAP SuccessFactors certification in a second module, for example Recruiting, Onboarding or Employee Central Payroll.

**Soft Skills**

* Confident with senior client stakeholders, and able to challenge and hold a design position
* Clear decision-making and the ability to explain trade-offs in plain language
* Strong written communication for design documents and decision records
* Coaching and quality review of less experienced consultants
* Attention to detail appropriate to data that drives payroll
* Ability to manage competing priorities across parallel workstreams

title: Cyber Threat Exposure Management Lead
description:
**About Gruve**
Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are looking for an experienced CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management) Expert to lead the design, implementation, and continuous operation of exposure management programs for our clients. This role sits at the intersection of vulnerability management, attack surface management, threat intelligence, and risk-based remediation helping clients move from periodic point-in-time assessments to a continuous, adversary-informed exposure reduction program aligned with 5-stage CTEM framework (Scoping, Discovery, Prioritization, Validation, and Mobilization).
  
  
You will work directly with client CISOs, security operations teams, and IT owners to build programs that identify, prioritize, validate, and reduce cyber exposure across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments and demonstrate measurable reduction in exploitable risk over time.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of CTEM engagements across the five stages: Scoping, Discovery, Prioritization, Validation, and Mobilization
* Design and operationalize continuous exposure management programs tailored to client risk appetite, industry, and regulatory context
* Integrate and correlate data across vulnerability management, attack surface management (ASM), cloud security posture management (CSPM), threat intelligence, and breach & attack simulation (BAS) tools to build a unified exposure view
* Translate technical findings (CVEs, misconfigurations, exposed assets, identity risks) into business-risk-prioritized remediation plans using exploitability, asset criticality, and threat context (e.g., KEV, EPSS, active exploitation campaigns)
* Drive adversarial validation of exposures through coordination with red/purple teams, pentesters, or automated validation platforms to confirm real-world exploitability
* Own exposure reduction metrics and reporting and present progress to client stakeholders and leadership
* Coordinate remediation and patch/mitigation execution with client asset owners, IT, and SOC teams; manage emergency response for zero-days and actively exploited vulnerabilities
* Build and refine CTEM playbooks, runbooks, and governance frameworks; establish exception and risk-acceptance processes
* Support pre-sales activities — scoping calls, proposals, PoCs, and CTEM maturity assessments for prospective clients
* Mentor junior consultants/analysts and contribute to practice capability building, including tool evaluation and methodology development
* Stay current on the threat landscape, emerging attack techniques, and CTEM tooling ecosystem.

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* BE/BTech (CS/IT/E&TC) or equivalent.
* 5–10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with 3+ years in exposure management, vulnerability management, attack surface management, or red team/adversary simulation
* Strong hands-on experience with CTEM/exposure management platforms such as Tenable (Exposure Management/One), Qualys VMDR/ETM, CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management, or similar
* Practical experience with attack surface management (ASM) tools and breach & attack simulation (BAS) platforms
* Solid understanding of vulnerability prioritization frameworks: CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit maturity, and asset-criticality-based risk scoring
* Experience integrating exposure data with SIEM/SOAR, ticketing (ServiceNow, Jira), and patch management tools.
* Familiarity with cloud security posture (AWS, Azure, GCP) and CSPM tools, and how cloud exposures fit into a unified CTEM program
* Strong grasp of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how attack-path/graph analysis supports validation and prioritization
* Experience defining and reporting exposure/remediation KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, MTRER, risk reduction trend lines) to executive and client audiences
* Working knowledge of relevant compliance/regulatory frameworks
* Excellent client-facing communication skills — able to translate technical exposure data into business risk narratives for CISOs and boards

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, Tenable/Qualys certifications
* Experience building or scaling a CTEM-as-a-Service offering within an MSSP/consulting practice
* Experience with pre-sales, proposal writing, and CTEM maturity/readiness assessments
* Prior experience mentoring teams or leading a practice/pod within a cybersecurity consulting or MSSP environment

**Why Gruve**
At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: ME - New Product Introduction Lead
description:
* SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the New Product Manufacturing industrialization and readiness of all new products from concept/design stage through pilot build, Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR), production launch, ramp-up and final handover to Operations.
  
  
The role ensures that every new product is manufacturable and can be launched safely and consistently while meeting quality, delivery, cost, capacity and productivity objectives. The position leads and coordinates Manufacturing Engineering (ME) and Industrial Engineering (IE) deliverables across the NPI process and supports VAVE industrialization activities.
  
  

* PRIMARY DUTIES

**Compliance, Quality & EHS:**
Ensure compliance with company policies, Code of Ethics, quality systems, and EHS requirements, including identification and mitigation of manufacturing safety and environmental risks.
  
  
**New Product & VAVE Industrialization:**
Lead the manufacturing industrialization of
**all new products and projects**
from early product development through production launch, ensuring Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Capacity, and Productivity targets are achieved.
  
  
**Manufacturing Feasibility & DFMA:**
Drive early manufacturing feasibility and DFMA reviews covering process capability, equipment, tooling, fixtures, testing, utilities, material flow, manpower, floor space, ergonomics, and capacity requirements.
  
  
**Manufacturing Process Development:**
Define and validate the complete manufacturing process, including process flow, routing, workstation design, assembly methods, tooling, fixtures, testing, inspection requirements, Standard Work, Work Instructions, and process parameters.
  
  
**Industrial Engineering & Capacity Planning:**
Lead cycle-time studies, takt-time analysis, capacity planning, manpower optimization, line balancing, layout, material flow, and bottleneck elimination to ensure efficient and scalable production.
  
  
**Process Quality & Risk Management:**
Lead/review Process Flow, PFMEA, PTPR, Control Plan, process capability, part qualification, and manufacturing risk mitigation to ensure robust processes and product quality before production release.
  
  
**Equipment, Tooling & Supplier Readiness:**
Ensure timely readiness, qualification, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, tooling, fixtures, gauges, test equipment, and supplier processes required for successful product launch.
  
  
**Prototype, Pilot Build & Manufacturing Readiness:**
Lead manufacturing activities for prototype, pilot, and pre-production builds; validate process, quality, cycle time, equipment, manpower, material, documentation, and training readiness prior to
**Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR)**
and production release.
  
  
**NPI Gate Approval, Launch & Ramp-Up:**
Represent Manufacturing in NPI gate reviews, approve manufacturing readiness, and drive production launch, ramp-up, and stabilization until required safety, quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and productivity targets are consistently achieved.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Operations Handover:**
Drive VAVE, Lean, productivity, automation, cycle-time and cost improvements; capture lessons learned and ensure structured handover to Operations, including documentation, training, process validation, capacity confirmation, and closure of launch actions.
  
  
**Performance Focus**
On-time manufacturing readiness and product launch
  
  
Safety and EHS compliance at launch
  
  
First-pass yield / quality performance during launch and ramp-up
  
  
Achievement of target cycle time, capacity and productivity
  
  
Closure of manufacturing risks and launch actions
  
  
Tooling/equipment readiness to project timing
  
  
Scrap, rework and manufacturing cost performance
  
  
Stable handover to Operations and sustained process capability
  
  

* EDUCATION

Engineering degree/diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline with relevant Experience of 6-8 Years in HVAC Domain
  
  

* Technical Skills, knowledge and experience

Strong working knowledge of manufacturing industrialization, NPI, process development and production ramp-up.
  
  
Practical knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, process flow, standard work, cycle-time study, capacity planning, line balancing, layout and Lean manufacturing.
  
  
Ability to lead cross-functional problem solving, risk closure and manufacturing readiness reviews.
  
  
Strong communication, project coordination, data analysis and structured problem-solving skills.
  
  
Experience with chiller/HVAC, fabrication, assembly, brazing/welding, testing, supplier industrialization or similar manufacturing environments is preferred.

description:
DeepIntent is the leading healthcare marketing platform, purpose-built to help marketers plan, activate, and optimize data-driven campaigns with speed and precision. Trusted by the world’s top healthcare brands and their agencies, DeepIntent uniquely unites media, identity, and real-world clinical data to power privacy-safe, omnichannel marketing across every screen. **About The Delivery Amplification Office**
The Delivery Amplification Office (DAO) is not a traditional PMO. We are an AI-native delivery function that makes engineering faster, clearer and easier to steer.
  
  
We run on the following two foundations.
  
  
**Amplified Squads**
is our AI-native operating model. Small, goal-aligned squads with AI built into how they plan, track, report and ship. Agents and automation handle intake, hygiene and status, so people spend their time on decisions and delivery.
  
  
Our

The Senior Delivery Operations Manager owns the operating system of one or more Business Lines (BLs): the data, cadence, tooling and automation that Amplified Squads run on. Paired with a Senior Delivery Lead as daily working partner and growth-path mentor, you move from keeping the system accurate to redesigning it — on a deliberate path toward Delivery Lead.
  
  

* Operating Model Stewardship

+ Own Amplified Squads health for 1–2 BLs: lifecycle adherence, goal coverage, squad lifespan and dissolution postponements.
+ Set and enforce operating conventions (naming, release versions, mandatory fields, dissolution checks), and document them in the DAO playbook.

+ Drive adoption so squads, EMs and PMs work from the platform, not from side spreadsheets.

* Automation and AI Agents

+ Design and tune AI delivery agents for hygiene, summarisation and follow-up, with clear checks on their accuracy.

* Tooling and Workflow Governance

+ Own Jira configuration standards across your BLs: workflows, issue types, fields and boards.
+ Assess the impact of every workflow change request, align stakeholders on edge cases, and roll changes out without breaking reporting.

* DAO-wide Ops Domain

+ Own one operations domain for the whole DAO, such as release and change management, cadence design, or the reporting data layer.
+ Define the standard other Delivery Operations follow in that domain, and spot-check their output.

* Enablement and Team Leverage

+ Own the playbooks and onboarding that teach teams the Amplified Squads model and our tooling.
+ Review and coach the work of Delivery Operations peers.
+ Work against explicit Lead-readiness milestones agreed with your Senior Delivery Lead: run a BL review solo, lead a stakeholder alignment, own an escalation end to end with a recommendation.
+ Act as Delivery Lead backup for your BL during leave or peak load.

* 4+ years in delivery operations, PMO, program coordination or Atlassian administration in a fast-moving technology company, including 1+ year owning operations for a team or BL rather than executing tasks.
* Expert in Jira: advanced JQL, dashboards, workflow and automation rules, and how field and screen configuration drive data quality.

Roha, Raigad.

* Ability to review engineering drawings, utility layouts, technical specifications, construction methodologies, and contractor submissions.

* Good communication skills in English and Hindi/Marathi.

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in construction, testing, and commissioning of utility infrastructure.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior role with a PMC, Owner's Engineer or EPC Contractor on large infrastructure or industrial development projects.
* Demonstrated experience in construction and supervision of water distribution systems, sewerage networks, stormwater drainage systems, power distribution infrastructure, and utility corridors. Also, in GLSRs, ESRs, pump houses, substations, utility buildings, and reinforced concrete structures.

* Experience in an employee friendly work culture

* Social Security

description:
**Company Description**
Chamber for Promotion and Facilitation of Innovative Business (CPFIB) is dedicated to empowering micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and innovative startups to scale globally through trade opportunities, technology exchange, and facilitation of government schemes. The Chamber focuses on increasing awareness of innovative industry practices, support programs, and export incentives offered by relevant government agencies. CPFIB works to promote financial inclusion for innovative MSMEs by encouraging adoption of progressive financial models that reward innovation. The organization also provides mentoring and expert guidance across sectors, and facilitates buyer–seller meets to support sector-wise adoption of innovative practices within MSMEs.

**Role Description**
This is a part-time, hybrid Management role based in Delhi, India, with flexibility for some work from home. The individual in this role will oversee programs and initiatives that support MSMEs and startups, including planning and coordinating trade promotion activities, technology exchange initiatives, and government scheme awareness sessions. Daily responsibilities include stakeholder engagement with entrepreneurs, industry experts, and government bodies, organizing events such as buyer–seller meets, and managing communication and reporting on key projects. The role involves supervising outreach campaigns, ensuring timely delivery of program objectives, and monitoring the impact of CPFIB’s initiatives on member organizations. The manager will also contribute to strategic planning, process improvement, and documentation to strengthen CPFIB’s mission and operations.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in program or project management, including planning, coordination, and monitoring of initiatives supporting MSMEs or startups.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with entrepreneurs, industry partners, and government agencies.
* Background in business development, trade facilitation, or economic development, ideally with exposure to innovative business practices or financial inclusion.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to deliver presentations, conduct workshops, and prepare clear reports and proposals.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a hybrid environment, managing priorities and meeting deadlines in a part-time schedule.
* Understanding of Indian government schemes, export incentives, and support mechanisms for MSMEs and startups is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Management, Economics, Public Policy, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in chambers of commerce, industry associations, incubators, or innovation-focused organizations is an advantage.

The Project Engineer (PE) is part of the hierarchical organization, reporting directly to the Head of Department as direct discipline superior. Senior Project Engineer is the Lead of the Engineering part of the project and responsible in a project for:
  
  

* Engineering scope and change management;
* Control of engineering schedule;
* Engineering interface management (customer, supplier, internal disciplines, external engineering company, site)
* Inputs to the Project Manager for project managementGeneral
* Possesses multi-disciplines engineering knowledge, good coordination skills and decision taking capability, cost conscious, proactive, schedule conscious.
* Able to challenge disciplines on quantities and quality inconsistencies w.r.t to ITB requirements, can foresee well in advance the risks both cost and schedule wise, and take proactive measures for mitigation, should have drive towards effective change order management
* Contributes to optimization of engineering practices, workflows and procedures based on collected KPIs.
* Solves technical problems of various degrees of complexity.

Project Setup:
  
  
PE is responsible to organize the technical setup of the project
  
  

* Preparation of Technical Document Management plan for the project
* Working together with scheduler and related discipline engineer to baseline master project schedule
* Project Documentation Management setup ( ALAIR, SAP technical setup, documentation numbering system, etc)
* Preparation of Project Design Validation in Plan and implementing the same in execution with due approval of the overall design authority
* Setup of MOC tool to capture the changes during execution phase

Internal engineering coordination:
  
  

* Ensure Project Design Basis and GDSR compliance list is followed
* Site information / site datasheet is aligned with all stakeholders and finalized
* Follow-up engineering progress and manage deviation with support of scheduler & project manager
* Organize/attend/support project design review Meeting, follow up MOM status, meeting action follow up and close out.
* Follow up the changes on P&IDs after freeze review (before freeze review, PID/System Engineer is in charge of follow-up).
* Ensure implementation of Governance Check and capture the technical HOLDs in Engineering , HOLDs register
* Ensure capturing the changes during execution phase in MOC tool
* Follow up any change (engineering / customer / vendor) and propose resolution of solution with related lead engineer/DA and make sure the change is closed properly
* Participate in Hazop meeting and close the action points with the help of Engineering disciplines
* Provide technical support to PM for external change orders
* Coordinating with discipline Leads , Design Authorities and Overall Design Authority for timely closure of the PDVP
* Coordinating for As Built documentation
* Prepare engineering close out and associated actions list

Technical interface with customer:
  
  

* Organize, conduct necessary technical review meeting with customer
* As the interface with the customer, leading the technical clarification with the customer, track all technical requirements and questions between E&C and customer.
* Make sure the technical input/output documents exchanges between E&C & customers follows contract requirements
* Tracking of client deliverable status and reporting to the management
* Obtain the necessary inputs from clients required for engineering completion in a timely manner

Engineering outsourcing Coordination:
  
  

* Coordinate internally with respective disciplines in order to certify the work completion against invoices raised by the engineering subcontractor
* Organizing Kickoff meeting with engineering subcontractor and Air Liquide discipline leads
* Conducting weekly review meetings with engineering subcontractors through telecon/ webex/ hangout.
* Responsible to manage and settle technical change order claims with engineering subcontractor with close coordination of Project Manager
* Capitalization with the engineering subcontractor

title: Client Services Manager(Publishing Industry experience)
description:
**Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent

**Experience:**
8–15 years

**Location:**
Remote – Delhi NCR

**Industry Requirement:**
Candidates must have exclusive experience in the
**Publishing Industry**
, preferably in academic, scholarly, scientific, technical, or digital publishing.

Job Description

The overall purpose of this position is to develop and implement programs and events that build customer relationships and drive usage, engagement, and awareness of digital publishing platforms, publications, and related products across multiple communities, including librarians, engineers, R&D management, researchers, students, and faculty.

The position will share accountability with sales and marketing management to:

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers across India, the Middle East, Africa, CIS countries, and Bangladesh.
* Encourage usage and educate researchers, authors, librarians, administrators, and other stakeholders about digital publications, online libraries, authorship tools, and publishing platforms.
* Develop customer engagement initiatives that increase awareness, adoption, and usage of publishing products and platforms.
* Demonstrate strong resourcefulness and a solutions-oriented approach while managing multiple priorities, timelines, and customer requirements.

The position will be remote, based in the Delhi NCR area. This position has no direct reports.

Specific Duties Include, but Are Not Limited To

* Plan, organize, and lead awareness, training, and customer support programs through online, hybrid, and in-person formats.
* Develop and implement workshops, seminars, webinars, and events that educate customers and build long-term relationships with librarians, authors, researchers, engineers, students, engineering management, and faculty.
* Collaborate with sales management, client services teams, and regional sales representatives to prioritize activities and plan efficient travel itineraries across academic, corporate, and government customers.
* Educate administrators and authors on Open Access publishing workflows, author tools, and related publishing processes.
* Assist with the introduction and adoption of new publishing products, digital platforms, and services.
* Support customers during the rollout of new subscriptions and monitor usage to encourage adoption and engagement with new content and platforms.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback to product development and design teams through regular reports, updates, and customer request tracking.
* Identify and report issues that affect customer access, usage, or overall experience and coordinate with relevant product and technical teams for resolution.
* Create client-specific training and promotional materials, including video tutorials, presentations, flyers, user guides, and other educational content.
* Monitor emerging trends in library outreach, Open Access, scholarly communication, academic publishing, and digital content platforms.
* Manage university partnership programs, customer engagement initiatives, and events across the assigned territory.
* Travel as required to meet customers, conduct training programs, and support events across the assigned region.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from an accredited university or college.
* **8–15 years of relevant professional experience, with exclusive experience in the Publishing Industry.**
* Experience in academic, scholarly, scientific, technical, educational, or digital publishing will be highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of digital publishing platforms, online content, subscriptions, Open Access, scholarly communication, or library services.
* Excellent customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Strong presentation, training, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to engage effectively with librarians, researchers, authors, faculty, students, administrators, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory as required.
* Strong proficiency in written and verbal English.
