**About Binariq**

At Binariq, we navigate the dynamic digital landscape with a blend of innovation and practicality, driving smart, fast, and resilient digital transformation for our clients. Our comprehensive services include Technology Solutions, Consulting, and User/Customer Experience enhancement, all tailored to your unique needs. With a team of over 70+ skilled engineers, we deliver precise and rapid solutions in digital transformation, enterprise cloud, mobility, security, and application development.

**What You’ll Do**

Working directly with the co-founders in the Founder’s Office, you will own:

* **Proposals and RFPs:**
  Proposal and RFP decks, pricing inputs and submission tracking.
* **Research:**
  Target accounts, competitors and new markets.
* **Business development:**
  Lead lists, LinkedIn outreach, CRM hygiene, meeting prep, follow-ups.
* **Partnerships:**
  Partner evaluation and next-step tracking.
* **Delivery coordination:**
  Engineer onboarding, client access and status reporting.
* **Founder’s Office cadence:**
  MIS, review packs, meeting notes and action tracking.
* **Collateral:**
  One-pagers, case studies and content.
* **Hiring:**
  JDs, candidate screening and interview scheduling.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3-5+ years of experience
* Prior experience in a Founder’s Office or account management role at an IT services company
* Hands-on exposure to IT services deal cycles: RFPs, proposals, SOWs and pricing inputs
* Experience managing client accounts: relationships, account plans, renewals and upsell
* Experience bridging clients and delivery teams: onboarding, status reporting and escalations
* Clear, confident communication with founders, clients and partners
* Ownership: you take work end to end and close loops without being chased
* Structured thinking and close attention to detail
* Discretion with confidential information
* Ability to prioritise across multiple workstreams
* Curious, quick to learn and comfortable with ambiguity
* PowerPoint or Google Slides: clean, well-structured decks
* Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, analysis and reports
* Business writing: crisp emails, meeting notes and documents

**Education**

* Postgraduate degree preferred: MBA or MTech

**Good to have**

* Exposure to the IT services industry

**Your First 90 Days**

**By day 30**

* Learn Binariq’s services, active clients, delivery model and Founder’s Office cadence.
* Take ownership of the CRM, proposal tracker and MIS.

**By day 60**

* Own at least one RFP or proposal end to end, from kick-off to submission.
* Run the weekly Founder’s Office review pack and action tracking.
* Build a target-account list and outreach plan, agreed with the co-founders.

**By day 90**

* Run business development, partnerships and proposals from a single pipeline tracker.
* Refresh core collateral: the company one-pager and at least two case studies.
* Propose one improvement to how the Founder’s Office runs, with its expected impact.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Work directly with the co-founders on how an IT services business is built and run
* Ownership across proposals, business development, partnerships, delivery and hiring
* Direct involvement in founder-level priorities and decisions
* Visible impact on how the company wins work and operates
* Room to grow your scope as the business grows

**How to Apply**

In your resume, include a link to a short video introducing yourself and highlighting why you stand out for this role.

title: Senior Manager – Operations (FM & Security)
description:
Easy Source is a tech-enabled workforce solutions company with 10,000+ deployed staff across 180+ client locations, and a fast-growing security business.

**About the role**

You’ll lead manned guarding operations across multiple client sites. That covers guard deployment, discipline, compliance, client relationships, and procurement of uniforms and kit. You’ll also oversee a smaller set of housekeeping and facility services at some of these sites. We need someone who has run security operations hands-on, from night checks to client reviews.

**What you’ll do**

***Security operations***

* Run day-to-day manned guarding operations across multiple client sites
* Deploy guards and supervisors, plan shifts and rotations, and ensure every post is covered
* Prepare and enforce post orders, site SOPs, and access-control procedures
* Conduct surprise checks, night rounds, and periodic site security audits
* Handle incident reporting, investigations, and emergency response coordination
* Maintain guard grooming, uniform, and conduct standards at every site

*Guard management & training*

* Oversee guard hiring, police verification, onboarding, and training
* Manage attendance, discipline, absenteeism, replacements, and grievances
* Coordinate with recruitment, HR, and payroll teams on staffing and payouts

*Compliance*

* Ensure PSARA compliance, including licensing, guard training, and verification records
* Ensure statutory labour-law compliance across all security deployments

***Procurement & vendor management***

* **Own procurement of guard uniforms, winter kit, shoes, belts, caps, badges, and accessories**
* **Source security equipment such as torches, batons, whistles, and registers as needed**
* **Identify vendors, negotiate terms, compare quotations, and manage purchase orders**
* **Track kit issuance, inventory, and procurement budgets**

*Client relationships*

* Conduct regular operational reviews with clients and resolve escalations quickly
* Ensure service delivery meets SLAs, and maintain reports and documentation

*Facility services*

* Oversee housekeeping teams and facility support staff at select client sites
* Procure housekeeping uniforms, chemicals, cleaning equipment, and PPE

*Cost control & reporting*

* Monitor site-level costs and profitability
* Prepare MIS reports on deployment, attendance, incidents, procurement, and service performance

**What we’re looking for**

* 10+ years in security services or manned guarding, ideally with a security agency
* Experience managing multiple client sites and large guard forces
* Working knowledge of PSARA and security-agency compliance
* Hands-on experience procuring security uniforms and guard kit (essential)
* Exposure to housekeeping or facility management is a plus
* Strong leadership, discipline management, and client handling skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MIS reporting
* Currently based in Delhi, and willing to travel across Delhi NCR, including night site visits
* Available to join immediately

**Education**

Graduate in any discipline. Ex-servicemen or ex-paramilitary candidates are welcome. A diploma in Security Management, Operations, or Facility Management is a plus.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Math
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mathematics expert to lead a pod of 5–10 trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science.
* You will review trainer-created tasks for mathematical correctness, reproducibility, challenge, and grader reliability. You will also mentor trainers, manage quality and throughput, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mathematical research and computational workflows.
* The role covers numerical and applied mathematics, scientific computing, optimization, statistics, mathematical modeling, computational algebra, and formal verification.

**What you’ll do:**

* Review tasks end to end, including problem statements, datasets, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Verify mathematical correctness, well-posedness, convergence, stability, conditioning, discretization error, and edge-case handling.
* Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step reasoning rather than lookup or a single library call.
* Validate that exact, symbolic, arbitrary-precision, or floating-point computation is used appropriately.
* Check that tolerances are suitable for the problem’s numerical conditioning.
* Design and review graders based on mathematical properties such as residuals, feasibility, optimality certificates, invariants, error bounds, or proof checking.
* Ensure tasks are reproducible through pinned tools, libraries, solver versions, and dependencies.
* Identify and prevent hard-coded solutions, test-file leakage, and other methods of bypassing the intended computation.
* Provide precise, actionable feedback and track trainer revisions through closure.
* Mentor and onboard trainers on mathematical rigor, task design, coding practices, and evaluation standards.
* Allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, and escalate blockers.
* Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.
* Collaborate with the Mathematics Team Lead and other technical stakeholders to improve benchmark quality.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, MATLAB/Octave, or a computer algebra system.
* Strong Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on experience with numerical methods, scientific computing, symbolic computation, optimization, computational statistics, or mathematical modeling.
* Ability to rigorously evaluate mathematical derivations, algorithms, proofs, and computational results.
* Experience reviewing research outputs, code, mathematical work, or scientific workflows.
* Experience mentoring or leading small technical or research teams.
* Strong written communication and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback.
* Ability to assess reproducibility, test reliability, and the scientific validity of computational tasks.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, mpmath, SageMath, PARI/GP, GAP, Macaulay2, or Mathematica-like workflows.
* Experience with FEniCS, Firedrake, DifferentialEquations.jl, PETSc, or similar ODE/PDE tools.
* Experience with CVXPY, JuMP, Pyomo, HiGHS, or other optimization frameworks.
* Familiarity with Lean/mathlib, Coq/Rocq, Isabelle, or other proof assistants.
* Experience with Docker, Git, CI systems, and automated testing.
* Experience designing benchmarks, competition problems, or computational evaluations.
* Experience evaluating AI coding, reasoning, or terminal agents.
* Experience setting or judging mathematics olympiad or competition problems.
* Publications or open-source contributions in computational mathematics, numerical software, or formalized mathematics.
* Prior experience in AI training, data generation, or model evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Strategy Associate- Himalayan Systems Change
description:
**Company Description:**
Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.
  
  
As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.
  
  
**Strategy Associate | Himalayan Systems Change**
**Location:**
India, with regular travel, including to the Himalayan region
  
  
**Level:**
Associate
  
  
**The opportunity**
Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to support our growing portfolio of work in the Himalayan region, building on our recently launched report,
*Prosperous and Resilient Himalayas*
.
  
  
The report sets out an agenda for sustainable economic growth and resilience, protecting natural systems while creating new opportunities for mountain communities. Our work aims to translate this vision into practical programmes, partnerships and financing solutions.
  
  
You will contribute to projects spanning water security, climate and disaster resilience, sustainable tourism, mountain products, enterprise development and policy. Working with colleagues across Systemiq's global network, you will help develop solutions that address the connections between environmental, economic and social challenges.
  
  
We are looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound economic and financial understanding, and an interest in translating strategy into practical action. You will take ownership of defined workstreams, support engagement with a diverse range of stakeholders and contribute to an evolving portfolio of high-impact work across India and the wider Himalayan region.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**

* **Deliver research and strategic analysis.**
  Conduct research, interviews and quantitative analysis to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* **Support programme development.**
  Help design projects, pilots and implementation approaches, including concept notes, workplans, delivery models and assessments of costs, risks and scalability.
* **Apply economic and financial analysis.**
  Build and adapt financial models, assess project economics and business cases, and identify potential financing approaches.
* **Support enterprise and investment opportunities.**
  Assess businesses, innovations and projects for commercial viability, market potential and impact, contributing to strategies for growth and investment.
* **Engage stakeholders and partners.**
  Support relationships with government, businesses, research institutions, funders and local communities, including meetings, workshops and field visits.
* **Contribute to project delivery.**
  Produce high-quality presentations, reports and proposals, coordinate project activities and help monitor progress, budgets and risks.
* **Collaborate across disciplines.**
  Draw on expertise across Systemiq's global teams to develop solutions that connect policy, business, finance, environmental resilience and local economic development.

**The experience and capabilities we are looking for**
**Strategy and analytical capabilities**

* Typically 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy advisory, economic or financial analysis, public policy, international development or related fields.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex questions and translate evidence into practical recommendations.
* Confidence working with Excel, including financial modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise written materials and engage effectively with different audiences.
* Experience managing workstreams, coordinating activities and delivering high-quality outputs against deadlines.

**Relevant sector and regional experience**

* An understanding of sustainable development challenges in India, ideally including climate resilience, natural resources, rural livelihoods, enterprise development or sustainable finance.
* Experience working with government, businesses, investors, development organisations or local institutions in India or comparable emerging markets.
* Exposure to the Himalayan region, mountain economies or related sectors such as water, sustainable tourism and agricultural value chains would be an advantage.
* Familiarity with project finance, grants, investment assessment or blended finance would be beneficial.
* A strong academic background in economics, finance, business, public policy, engineering, environmental science or a related discipline.

**Leadership and personal attributes**

* Curious and intellectually rigorous, with an interest in understanding how economic, environmental and social systems interact.
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of tasks while working collaboratively with colleagues and external partners.
* Adaptable and pragmatic, with the ability to work across different topics and navigate an evolving project portfolio.
* Motivated to translate research and strategic thinking into practical solutions that create lasting economic and environmental impact.
* Committed to Systemiq's mission and to supporting sustainable, inclusive development in the Himalayan region.

**Languages and travel**

* Fluent English is essential. Hindi and/or another relevant Indian or Himalayan language would be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel regularly, including field visits across the Himalayan region, is essential.

**What we offer**

* **Meaningful impact:**
  Contribute to work that supports economic prosperity, environmental resilience and sustainable livelihoods across the Himalayan region.
* **Diverse project experience:**
  Work across strategy, finance, policy, enterprise development and implementation.
* **Global collaboration:**
  Work with international colleagues and draw on expertise across Systemiq's global network.
* **Learning and development:**
  Build your analytical, consulting and stakeholder engagement capabilities through challenging projects and experienced colleagues.
* **A purpose-driven culture:**
  Join a collaborative team guided by our values of creativity, challenge, collaboration, change and care.

**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

title: Associate, Creative Producer
description:
**Who we are:**

Roundglass is a wholistic wellbeing company working to empower healthier lives, stronger communities, and a more sustainable world. That w in wholistic is intentional: We believe true wellbeing spans the whole human experience, from how we care for ourselves to our connections with others and the planet.

This philosophy shapes both what we build and how we work. We’ve created an environment where supporting people’s whole selves fuels their most meaningful work.

Roundglass creates real-world impact through two core pillars:

Roundglass Giving is our nonprofit arm that drives philanthropic work in youth development, women's equity, and environmental sustainability. Our mission is to transform communities by tackling systemic challenges and unlocking human potential through Roundglass Sports, Roundglass Sustain, the Roundglass Foundation, and the Global India Institute (GIC). These efforts have reached millions of people, creating scalable models of community-led change.

Through the Roundglass Living platform, we deliver personalized wellbeing guidance rooted in science. The Roundglass Living app helps people develop habits that last through breathwork, meditation, movement, nutrition, music, and more.

We built Roundglass on the belief that people thrive when they’re supported wholistically, and we apply this philosophy to how we work together as a team. If you're passionate about transforming communities and creating systemic change and want to contribute to a culture that embodies the impact we're creating, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**

Roundglass Creative Studio is looking for a detail-oriented Associate with a strong interest in non-fiction storytelling, a grounding in documentary research and production processes, and the ability to work confidently in fast-paced, real-world environments.

The ideal candidate will work closely with the Creative Lead and support the development and production of films across the Studio. The role involves coordinating with internal teams, programme teams, community members, contributors, and external production crews through every stage of the filmmaking process — from story discovery, research and validation to pre-production, field shoots, post-production, and final delivery.

We are looking for someone who understands that a strong documentary film begins long before the camera starts rolling. It requires curiosity, thorough research, careful validation, an understanding of context, and detailed preparation. It means finding the layers within a story - understanding not only what happened, but why it matters, whose perspective needs to be represented, and what will make the story meaningful to an audience.

The role requires someone who is comfortable going across Punjab, comfortable meeting people and communities, listening closely, and asking the right questions. The candidate should be able to observe and identify the impact of different programmes and help translate that into strong, research-backed pre-production material.

The Associate will help ensure that research, contributors, production requirements, references, footage, feedback, and post-production workflows are organized and followed through carefully.

**What you’ll do:**

**End-to-End Project Coordination | Development to Post-Production**

* Conduct in-depth online and field research to support story discovery, development, and validation.
* Support the Creative Lead in identifying strong case studies and contributors and ensuring that research and narrative choices remain aligned with the film’s creative objective.
* Develop and organise research notes, contributor profiles, beat sheets, step outlines, visual references, and shot breakdowns in line with the creative direction.
* Coordinate with writers on scripts, revisions, feedback, and timely submissions.
* Support pre-production planning and crew coordination, ensuring clarity and alignment on schedules, requirements, deliverables, and expectations across departments.
* Coordinate closely with internal programme teams, contributors, communities, and external production partners to ensure information and production requirements are communicated accurately and on time.
* Across all productions, ensure adherence to Roundglass standards, design guidelines, science and factual accuracy, safety protocols, compliances, and ethical storytelling practices.

**On-Ground Shoot Coordination**

* Act as a key bridge between the creative team, production crew, programme teams, and contributors during shoots.
* Help ensure contributors, locations, scenes, and production requirements are ready and coordinated according to the shooting plan.
* Track shot sequences and coverage requirements, helping the team stay aligned with the creative brief while responding to the realities of the field.
* Maintain detailed shoot logs, contributor notes, coverage records, and production documentation to ensure continuity from production into post-production.
* Manage on-ground flow and troubleshoot coordination challenges as they arise, supporting the crew in making informed decisions within real-time constraints.

**Post-Production Support**

* Work closely with the post-production team to ensure that creative briefs, footage, research, contributor context, and production notes are clearly organised and handed over.
* Provide editorial support through shoot logs, story notes, contributor and character context, transcripts, research material, and visual references.
* Coordinate across different stages of post-production, including editing, graphics, sound, colour, reviews, feedback, and final delivery, as required.
* Track post-production schedules, review rounds, feedback, approval gateways, and deliverables to ensure projects move efficiently through each stage.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between creative, programme, and external teams, ensuring feedback is consolidated, communicated clearly, and followed through.
* Maintain organised project documentation and ensure that final masters, project files, assets, and supporting material are properly managed, handed over and archived.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in documentary or non-fiction filmmaking as Researcher, Assistant Director or in a related role.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling and narrative structures.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills– ability to navigate ground realities and communicate across departments and communities.
* Fluency in English (spoken and written).Conversational Hindi and Punjabi.
* Willingness to travel and work on location in rural and semi-urban areas of Punjab.
* Prior experience in filmmaking, being on the set, scheduling, field research and production management is a must.

About Antal:

Antal International, East Patel Nagar Delhi, is a leading recruitment consultancy having expertise in connecting top talent across IT, Manufacturing and FMCG industries with leading organizations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

About the role:

Turn every confirmed employer requirement into workers who arrive on time, fully documented, fully compliant and well supported – through a team and process that work without the founder in the loop.

Where it sits: the Business Head brings employer requirements; the Head – Candidate Acquisition builds the worker pool; the Head of Operations converts both into deployed, settled workers. Sourcing candidates is not this role's primary job, but it sets the quality bar for every candidate handed over.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Delivery planning - Turn each confirmed employer order into a plan – numbers, timelines, documents, owners. Flag feasibility risks before work begins.

• Final eligibility & deployment-readiness check - Verify that candidates handed over by Candidate Acquisition meet employer, documentation and deployment requirements before the employer interview. Schedule employer interviews; keep selected / rejected / waitlisted records.

• Documentation & compliance check - Own the document-control system: every file checked before submission. Ensure operational adherence to applicable MEA / eMigrate, recruiting-agent and destination-country requirements, in coordination with authorised legal / immigration professionals wherever required, and to VGIL's ethical recruitment policy – contract terms explained to the worker, transparent payments with receipts, truthful embassy preparation.

• Visa & work permits - Coordinate visa and work-permit steps with the embassy / visa centre in New Delhi and with authorised legal / immigration professionals and representatives abroad; track every application to closure.

• Pre-departure & deployment - Orientation on job, wages, hours, accommodation and rights; tickets; airport readiness; track each worker until handover to the employer.

• Post-arrival support & troubleshooting - Single escalation point for workers and employers after arrival. Coordinate and track residence-permit filings with the overseas partner, and resolve issues such as accommodation, wage or contract mismatches, health issues, disputes and early-exit risks. Resolve or escalate within agreed timelines; log every case.

• Team management, reviews & team building - Hire, train and lead the operations team. Set clear individual ownership and targets; run daily stand-ups, weekly reviews and monthly performance reviews. Build a second line so operations never depend on one person.

• Systems, SOPs & reporting - One master tracker / CRM for every live case; SOPs, checklists, turnaround-time standards and an escalation matrix for each stage; weekly operations dashboard to the MD.

• Partners & vendors - Manage medical centres, travel agents, document vendors and overseas representatives on quality, cost and speed.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

IDEAL CANDIDATE

Must have

• 8+ years in overseas recruitment / deployment operations, including 3+ years leading an operations team.

• Personally run the full cycle – screening, employer interviews, documentation, medicals, visa / work-permit coordination, travel, deployment and post-arrival issues – for bulk blue-collar or semi-skilled requirements (50–300+ workers).

• Working knowledge of Indian emigration rules (MEA / eMigrate, recruiting-agent obligations) and of European work-permit processes.

• Has hired, trained and reviewed a team, and can show trackers or SOPs they built.

• High integrity on worker welfare and compliance. Strong Hindi and English; Punjabi is an advantage.

Good to have

• Greece or other European deployment experience; agriculture, food-processing, construction or hospitality workforces.

• Has built an operations function in a growing, founder-led firm; strong Excel / CRM discipline.

Not a fit: Domestic-only recruiters, HR generalists, IT / white-collar recruiters, visa counsellors without bulk deployment experience, people who have only sourced candidates, operations managers from unrelated industries, or anyone who cannot walk us through an end-to-end deployment they personally managed.

EDUCATION

• Bachelor's degree preferred (B.Com / BBA / BA / HR / Operations or equivalent).

• MBA / PGDM in Operations or HR is an advantage, not a requirement.

• Actual overseas recruitment and deployment experience matters far more than academic qualification

Job Description – Project Manager

**Project Manager – Construction**

Department

Projects / Operations

Reporting To

Project Director / Head of Projects / Management

Project Site / Delhi-NCR

Experience

**8–15 years** of relevant construction experience, including experience managing complete projects.

Qualification

* B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering preferred
* Diploma in Civil Engineering may be considered with substantial relevant experience
* PMP / project management certification is an advantage

Job Purpose

To plan, execute, monitor and successfully complete construction projects within the approved **time, cost, quality and safety requirements**, while effectively managing manpower, subcontractors, materials and client coordination.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Planning & Execution

* Develop project execution plans, schedules and milestones.
* Plan manpower, materials, equipment and subcontractor requirements.
* Monitor daily and weekly progress against the project schedule.
* Identify delays and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure timely completion of project activities.

2. Site & Construction Management

* Supervise overall construction activities at the project site.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Supervisors, Foremen and subcontractors.
* Ensure work is executed according to approved drawings, specifications and method statements.
* Resolve technical and execution-related issues.
* Coordinate multiple activities to avoid delays and rework.

3. Cost & Commercial Management

* Monitor project expenditure against the approved budget.
* Control material wastage, labour costs and equipment costs.
* Review subcontractor bills and work measurements.
* Coordinate with the QS/Commercial team regarding measurements, variations and billing.
* Identify potential cost overruns and take corrective action.

4. Manpower Management

* Plan project manpower requirements.
* Coordinate with HR and recruitment teams for workforce mobilisation.
* Monitor productivity and deployment of labour.
* Ensure adequate skilled and unskilled manpower is available at the site.
* Manage site supervisors, engineers, foremen and subcontractor teams.

5. Material & Equipment Management

* Coordinate material requirements with the Purchase/Stores team.
* Ensure materials are available according to the construction schedule.
* Monitor material consumption and wastage.
* Plan equipment and machinery requirements.
* Ensure proper utilisation of construction equipment.

6. Quality Control

* Ensure construction work meets approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Coordinate with the QA/QC team.
* Review inspection and testing requirements.
* Minimise rework and construction defects.
* Ensure proper documentation of quality records.

7. Safety & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with company safety policies and applicable statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the Safety Officer/Manager.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**Role purpose**

The Senior Programme Manager – Finance Systems will provide permanent, enterprise-level leadership for the Finance Systems & Transformation portfolio. The role combines programme delivery leadership with hands-on portfolio management, governance and PMO discipline, ensuring that strategic initiatives move from concept and approval through controlled execution, adoption and benefits realisation.

The role will maintain an integrated view across Finance transformation initiatives, including finance systems, planning and forecasting, reporting and analytics, controls improvement, process transformation and operating-model change. It will give Finance leadership clear visibility of priorities, delivery status, risks, dependencies, resources, costs and decisions, while holding workstream owners and delivery partners accountable for outcomes.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Programme leadership and execution:**
  Translate the Finance Transformation strategy and roadmap into executable programmes, workstreams, milestones and outcomes. Drive delivery across multiple initiatives and intervene early where progress, ownership or quality is at risk.
* **Integrated portfolio planning:**
  Own the consolidated transformation roadmap, integrated plan, critical path and cross-workstream dependencies. Maintain a clear view of sequencing, capacity, funding and business availability.
* **Governance and decision support:**
  Operate the programme governance rhythm, including Steering Committee preparation, decision papers, status reporting, action tracking and follow-through. Ensure forums focus on decisions, outcomes and value rather than activity reporting.
* **PMO and delivery discipline:**
  Establish and maintain consistent planning, RAID, dependency, decision, change-control, financial tracking and document-management standards across the portfolio.
* **Risk, issue and escalation management:**
  Maintain an enterprise view of delivery risks and issues, ensure mitigations have accountable owners and dates, and escalate material matters with clear options and recommendations.
* **Workstream assurance:**
  Challenge plans, assumptions, RAG status, estimates and recovery actions. Confirm that scope, requirements, testing, readiness, controls, documentation and handover are adequate before stage-gate decisions.
* **Stakeholder alignment:**
  Build strong relationships across Finance, Finance Systems, Technology, Operations, Risk, Internal Audit and regional teams. Translate complex delivery information into concise, decision-ready messages for senior leaders.
* **Supplier and resource coordination:**
  Coordinate internal teams, contractors and delivery partners; monitor commitments, deliverables, costs and knowledge transfer; support mobilisation, onboarding and transition to permanent capability.
* **Change, readiness and adoption:**
  Ensure each initiative has a proportionate change approach covering communications, training, business readiness, operating procedures, ownership and transition into BAU.
* **Benefits and continuous improvement:**
  Define measurable outcomes and benefits, track realisation after implementation and ensure lessons learned are reflected in future delivery standards.

**Key working relationships**

Finance Transformation sponsors and Steering Committee; Head of Finance Systems; Global and Regional Finance leadership; Finance process owners; Technology and data teams; Risk, Controls, Internal Audit and external audit stakeholders; programme and project managers; business analysts; implementation partners and specialist suppliers.

**Key deliverables**

* Integrated Finance Systems Transformation roadmap and portfolio plan with milestones, dependencies, resources and critical path.
* Clear executive reporting, programme dashboards, decision papers and Steering Committee materials.
* Current RAID, decision, action, dependency, change and benefits registers with accountable ownership.
* Consistent delivery methodology, templates, stage gates and evidence standards across workstreams.
* Recovery plans for red or amber initiatives, with measurable actions and dates.
* Controlled programme financial and resource view covering budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and capacity.
* Business readiness, transition and BAU handover plans for each material initiative.
* Portfolio-level benefits tracking and post-implementation review.

**Skills and experience**

**Essential**

* Significant experience leading complex, multi-workstream Finance Systems or enterprise transformation programmes.
* Strong programme and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, governance, RAID, dependencies, change control and benefits realisation.
* Experience preparing executive and Steering Committee reporting and converting complex information into clear decisions and recommendations.
* Proven ability to coordinate Finance, Technology, Operations and external delivery partners in a matrix environment.
* Experience challenging delivery plans, driving recovery activity and holding senior workstream owners accountable.
* Understanding of Finance processes, systems implementation, controls, testing, readiness and BAU transition.
* Commercial and financial discipline covering budgets, forecasts, resource plans and supplier commitments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate hands-on, manage competing priorities and deliver through ambiguity.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Financial Services or another regulated, control-focused environment.
* Experience with Finance ERP, EPM, reporting, data, controls or operating-model transformation.
* Exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Anaplan, Power BI, Qlik or Azure DevOps.
* Experience establishing or maturing a transformation office, portfolio office or enterprise PMO.
* Experience working across global teams and delivery partners, including India-based delivery models.
* Recognised programme or project management qualification, such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent.
* Finance, accounting, technology or transformation-related professional qualification.

**Personal attributes**

* Outcome-oriented, structured and able to combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery.
* Calm and credible with senior stakeholders, while willing to challenge constructively.
* Highly organised, analytical and rigorous about ownership, evidence and follow-through.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information.
* Collaborative across cultures, functions and locations, with a strong commitment to building internal capability.

**Success measures**

* Transformation initiatives delivered to agreed outcomes, quality, cost and key milestones.
* Leadership has a reliable, single view of programme status, decisions, risks, resources and dependencies.
* Material risks and slippage are identified early, with timely recovery action and escalation.
* Governance forums result in clear decisions, accountable actions and measurable follow-through.
* Improved consistency and maturity of programme planning, reporting and delivery controls.
* Successful business adoption, BAU transition and measurable benefits realisation.
* Reduced reliance on external programme leadership through sustainable permanent capability in India.

**Role positioning**

This is not a reporting-only PMO role. It is a senior, hands-on programme leadership position accountable for joining up the Finance Transformation portfolio, driving execution and maintaining the governance discipline required to deliver sustainable business outcomes. Individual workstream leads remain accountable for their solutions and deliverables; this role provides the integration, challenge, visibility and leadership that connect them into one controlled programme.

title: Program Operations (Senior Associate)
description:
If you like being the person students turn to, and the person who makes sure their program actually works, read on. You’ll own the student experience for Kraftshala’s live programs: answering questions, fixing problems, keeping trainers and mentors in sync, and getting every learner to the finish line.

Delhi, on-site | 0 to 3 years | ₹6 to ₹8 LPA

You’d fit well if you’ve worked in EdTech ops, student success, customer success, or any role with lots of people and lots of deadlines.

**The short version**

**Who we’re looking for:**
Someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving operational problems, communicates clearly under pressure, and genuinely cares about creating exceptional student experiences. If you naturally take ownership, bring structure to chaos, and enjoy making systems work better every day, you’ll fit right in here.

**What this role is about:**
You’ll manage learning programs end-to-end - ensuring students stay on track, stakeholders stay aligned, and execution happens smoothly across multiple moving parts. The role combines program management, operations, stakeholder coordination, student support, and process improvement.

**Why you should apply:**
This is a strong fit for someone with 0-3 years of experience who wants rapid ownership, steep learning, and exposure to real operational complexity early in their career. You’ll work in a fast-moving, high-trust environment where strong execution, responsiveness, initiative, and problem-solving are deeply valued.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The detailed version**

As a Program Operations (Senior Associate) at Kraftshala, you’ll coordinate live sessions, manage stakeholders, improve processes, and ensure our programs run smoothly at scale. You will own operational execution across multiple moving parts. This role requires someone who can combine strong operational thinking with empathy, responsiveness, attention to detail, and excellent execution discipline.

Specific responsibilities will include:

**Program Management & Student Operations**

* Taking charge of the entire learning journey for assigned student cohorts and ensuring smooth end-to-end program delivery.
  *Metric to Measure: % of students achieving key learning milestones; cohort completion metrics*
* Being the first point of contact for students, solving queries promptly, empathetically, and with strong ownership.
  *Metric to Measure: Average response/resolution time; student satisfaction scores*
* Coordinating and executing live sessions, schedules, assessments, and operational workflows seamlessly across batches.
  *Metric to Measure: % of sessions conducted without operational issues or reschedules*
* Managing student escalations effectively and ensuring timely closure while maintaining a strong student experience.
  *Metric to Measure: Escalation turnaround time; escalation satisfaction scores*
* Tracking student engagement, participation, and progress using internal systems and operational dashboards.
  *Metric to Measure: % of students receiving timely nudges/support; engagement metrics*

**Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Liaising with trainers, mentors, evaluators, operations teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure aligned execution.
  *Metric to Measure: Timeliness and quality of stakeholder coordination; stakeholder feedback*
* Managing communication across multiple stakeholders while ensuring clarity, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  *Metric to Measure: Task completion timelines; communication effectiveness*

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identifying inefficiencies in workflows and proactively improving operational systems and processes.
  *Metric to Measure: Number of process improvements implemented; measurable impact on delivery quality*
* Leveraging tools and automation platforms (Notion, Google Sheets, Zapier, etc.) to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort.
  *Metric to Measure: Reduction in manual interventions; automation coverage across workflows*

**Monthly Outcomes**

**Month 1:**
Learn the ropes - understand our program delivery workflows, student journey, systems, tools, communication practices, and operational processes while shadowing ongoing cohorts.

**Month 2-3:**
Take ownership of one or more student cohorts end-to-end, independently manage student communication and operational workflows, and identify at least one meaningful process improvement opportunity.

**Month 4:**
Own multiple cohorts independently, handle stakeholder coordination smoothly, drive operational execution with minimal supervision, and consistently hit key program delivery metrics.

**Top Grading**

* **Ownership & Accountability:**
  An A-Player takes complete ownership of outcomes, follows through consistently, and proactively solves problems before they escalate, whereas a B-Player requires reminders and reacts only after issues surface.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  An A-Player brings structure to complexity, manages multiple moving parts effectively, and executes reliably under pressure, whereas a B-Player struggles with prioritization and consistency.
* **Student Obsession:**
  An A-Player genuinely cares about student experience and looks for ways to improve it proactively, whereas a B-Player focuses only on task completion.
* **Process Thinking:**
  An A-Player continuously improves systems and workflows to make operations more scalable and efficient, whereas a B-Player sticks to existing processes without questioning or optimizing them.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  An A-Player catches small issues early and maintains high execution accuracy, whereas a B-Player misses details that create operational friction or delays.
* **Communication & Coordination:**
  An A-Player communicates clearly, promptly, and with context across stakeholders, whereas a B-Player’s communication is inconsistent, delayed, or incomplete.
* **Learning Agility:**
  An A-Player adapts quickly, absorbs feedback well, and improves continuously, whereas a B-Player struggles with change or repeated feedback.

**Must Haves**

* 0-3 years of experience in operations, program management, customer success, student operations, stakeholder management, or coordination-heavy roles
  *(We are not too fussed about the number of years. Experience is simply a proxy for capability, which is what we really care for)*
* Strong execution discipline and the ability to manage work independently in fast-paced environments
* Experience handling multiple stakeholders, timelines, and operational workflows simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort with ambiguity, problem-solving, and operational firefighting when needed
* Hands-on proficiency with tools like Google Sheets, MS Excel, Zoom, Notion, or similar workflow/project management tools
* High responsiveness, reliability, and attention to detail

**Selection Process**

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes and will be a mix of online and in-person interactions.

* **Conversation 1:**
  A virtual conversation with the HR team to understand your profile briefly and share details of the selection process
* **Technical Exercise:**
  A practical assessment designed to evaluate your fit for the role
* **Conversation 2:**
  A detailed assessment review conversation with the Operations team to discuss your submission and problem-solving approach
* **Conversation 3:**
  A deeper conversation focused on evaluating the competencies required for the role
* **Conversation 4:**
  A final conversation with leadership to evaluate overall fit with the team and the Kraftshala Kode
* **Extending an offer:**
  If all goes well, we will extend an offer with the relevant details

**Location**

Delhi

title: Senior Onboarding Specialist
description:
**About the role**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own**

Onboarding Delivery and Governance

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

Cross Functional Partnership

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

Process, Tooling and Reporting

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

Merchant Experience and Retention

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

Team Leadership and Capacity

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

﻿

What we are looking for

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Actuarial Program Strategist -UNDP-Milliman Global Actuarial Initiative (GAIN)
description:
**About Milliman**
Independent for 75 years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world's most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
  
  
Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
  
  
**About GAIN**
GAIN is strengthening financial resilience worldwide by building up the actuarial profession and deepening local insurance markets. Launched in 2022 by the UNDP and Milliman, GAIN addresses the urgent need for actuarial expertise to quantify and manage risks, fostering more resilient economies and communities. In many low and middle-income countries, the actuarial profession is emerging, with few qualified national experts. GAIN is driving change in this landscape by delivering targeted capacity-building, mentorship, and policy support. Through collaborative action, driven by local stakeholders, GAIN empowers countries to develop homegrown actuarial talent and implement robust insurance frameworks, laying the foundation for sustainable growth and climate resilience around the world. Greater information on the program can be found on the LinkedIn page.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Actuarial Program Strategist will drive and manage country activities as well as contributing to thought leadership research whilst working closely with volunteers for the UNDP-Milliman Global Actuarial Initiative (GAIN), a joint initiative between Milliman Inc. and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to build the actuarial profession and expertise in low-middle income countries.
  
  
The Actuarial Program Strategist will be responsible for supporting, driving, and overseeing active engagement across 3-4 countries, working closely with ambassadors and volunteers who serve as country leads. This includes managing relationships and continued engagement with stakeholders as well as overseeing the delivery and coordination of key interventions across priority markets. The position will also contribute to and drive the development of ongoing thought leadership initiatives, including papers and insights on topics such as climate, data, capacity building, and regulatory considerations.
  
  
**Key Roles and Responsibilities (expected workload %)**

* Support, drive and oversee 3-4 active country activities and work closely with leading ambassadors and volunteers as country leads (50%)
* Management of ongoing support for GAIN countries and their activities (25%)
* Drive ongoing thought leadership papers (e.g. climate, data, capacity building regulatory) and interventions (25%)

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong interest in the initiative's mission to strengthen the actuarial profession in developing and emerging countries to advance risk management and economic development
* Keen to develop new capacity building tools and training programs and be flexible to make adjustments given local implementation requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Enthusiastic and effective leader who will work with other professionals on specific activities towards the satisfaction of the objectives
* Comfortable working with external stakeholders and managing ongoing relationships
* Highly organized with the ability to effectively manage and track multiple tasks, issues, and projects simultaneously, and adjust priorities to meet changing circumstances
* Works well with a wide variety of professionals with diverse backgrounds, skill levels, and personalities
* Motivated professional who takes initiative to drive projects and diversify the team's skillset
* Confident working in a remote environment and across different time zones

**Skills And Qualifications Required**

* 5-10 years of working experience in the actuarial profession, inclusive of experience working in low- and middle-income countries
* Associate or Fellow (or equivalent) of one of the actuarial professional bodies
* Experience in volunteering with local actuarial society or international actuarial associations
* Experience managing multiple projects and coordinating outsourced or external partners
* Bachelor's Degree or higher
* English fluency is required

**Skills And Qualifications Preferred**

* Work experience in low-middle income countries is a must
* Experience working in an insurance-related environment
* Experience developing thought leadership research
* Degree in a relevant field (actuarial science, economics, business or finance)
* Strong communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a multitude of stakeholders and teams/departments

**Location**

* Position will be placed in Gurgaon, India with the option of hybrid work
* GAIN operational team is centered in APAC time zone. Flexible working with different time zones and willingness to participate in conference calls before or after normal business hours to accommodate business hours in a different country
* Occasional travel may be required for meetings, conferences, or visits to stakeholder locations. Travel expectations will vary based on business needs.

description:

title: Program Manager, TA Business Operations
description:

We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
  
  
The Program Manager, TA Business Operations serves as the operating backbone of Ciena's global Talent Acquisition function, enabling programmes, projects, and commitments to remain on track across North America, EMEA, APAC, and India. This individual contributor role partners closely with the Senior Director, Talent Acquisition & HRBP, EMEA to establish operating discipline, identify risk early, strengthen accountability, and provide recommendations that support effective decision-making. The role applies business operations, programme management, recruiting data, and technology inputs to improve execution across the global function.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of cross-functional Talent Acquisition initiatives, including process redesign, organisational changes, and systems rollouts, with defined owners, milestones, and risk logs.

**The Must Haves**

* Experience: 8+ years in business operations, programme or project management, or chief-of-staff-type roles; recruiting or HR domain experience is a plus.

* Certifications: Project or programme management credential, including PMP, PgMP, Six Sigma, or equivalent experience.

title: Founder's Office - Fulfillment Lead
description:
Every company knows how to generate pipelines. Very few know how to deliver consistently at scale.

At SalesMonk, we're building AI-native GTM systems that help customers turn events and outbound into predictable revenue. As we grow, the biggest challenge isn't shipping more work- it's building the operating system that ensures every customer engagement is executed consistently, efficiently, and repeatedly.

That's where this role comes in.

**Why This Role Exists**

Today, our delivery works because smart people are solving problems every day.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

We're looking for someone who can build the processes, operating rhythms, and delivery playbooks that allow us to scale without adding operational chaos.

This isn't a project management role, this is a systems-building role.

You'll work directly with the founders to create the delivery engine that supports the next stage of the company.

**What You Will Own**

**Build the Delivery Operating System**

Design how delivery should work- from customer kickoff to successful execution.

Build repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, governance, and playbooks that reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

Own delivery health across all customer engagements.

Identify bottlenecks, eliminate operational friction, and continuously improve execution quality.

Ensure delivery standards remain high as the team scales.

**Cross-functional Execution**

Work closely with Product, GTM Engineers, Customer Success, and the founders to ensure priorities move quickly.

Bring structure, accountability, and visibility across teams.

**Process & Automation**

Identify manual workflows that should be standardized or automated.

Help build scalable systems that improve speed, quality, and consistency.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Define what great delivery looks like.

Build dashboards and operating metrics around delivery quality, turnaround time, customer outcomes, and execution efficiency.

Use data to continuously improve the way we operate.

**Brownie Points**

* Exposure to customer delivery, implementation, or GTM operations.
* Experience building operational dashboards and business metrics.
* Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Airtable, or similar tools.

**Why This Seat**

You'll build the operating backbone of an AI-native GTM company.

Instead of maintaining existing processes, you'll design them.

If you enjoy building systems, simplifying complexity, and creating leverage across teams, you'll have an outsized impact here.

title: Senior Project Manager (UK Shift)
description:
Job Description: Senior Project Manager

**Company:**
QBS Learning

**Location:**
Noida, Sector 3

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office; work-from-home arrangements will be discussed

**Shift:**
UK Shift

**Experience:**
8+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Preferred Certification:**
PMP

About QBS Learning:

QBS Learning is a global education solutions partner with over 35 years of experience supporting educational publishers, EdTech companies, and learning organisations. We specialise in K-12 curriculum and content development, educational publishing, digital learning solutions, accessibility, and technology-enabled content production.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a senior, experienced Project Manager with a strong background in K-12 EdTech, educational publishing, ELT (English Language Teaching), or digital learning content production.

The ideal candidate must have proven experience managing complex projects, including
**POC (Proof of Concept) projects**
, with multiple stakeholders, long production schedules, and strict quality and delivery requirements.

The candidate will establish project management processes at project kick-off and ensure they are followed throughout the project lifecycle. This includes maintaining centralised documentation of project plans, design decisions, client comments, feedback, revisions, approvals, risks, and status updates to ensure transparency, accountability, and smooth project execution.

Experience managing large-scale ELT programmes or similar educational content projects will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities:1. End-to-End Project Management:

* Lead projects from initiation and kick-off through planning, execution, quality review, delivery, and closure.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, timelines, deliverables, resource requirements, and dependencies.
* Develop project plans and establish clear workflows, review cycles, approval processes, and communication protocols.
* Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Identify risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies proactively and implement mitigation plans.

2. POC (Proof of Concept) Project Management:

* Manage POC projects from initial requirements and planning through execution, evaluation, client review, and final recommendations.
* Define POC objectives, scope, timelines, deliverables, success criteria, and evaluation metrics.
* Coordinate with clients and cross-functional teams to develop and validate sample content, workflows, features, or solutions.
* Track progress, dependencies, risks, issues, and feedback throughout the POC lifecycle.
* Maintain centralised documentation of requirements, design decisions, client comments, revisions, testing outcomes, and approvals.
* Evaluate POC results against agreed success criteria and present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Coordinate the transition from an approved POC to full-scale implementation or production, where applicable.

3. Project Governance & Documentation

* Establish project governance, documentation standards, and communication protocols at project kick-off.
* Ensure agreed processes are consistently followed by internal teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
* Maintain centralised records of project plans, design decisions, feedback, change requests, revisions, approvals, and action items.
* Ensure all decisions and updates are documented, traceable, and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain version control, decision logs, issue trackers, risk registers, and change-control documentation.
* Use
  **Smartsheet**
  for project planning, tracking, dashboards, reporting, and workflow management.

4. K-12 Educational Publishing & ELT Projects

* Manage complex educational content and publishing programmes involving multiple grade levels, content components, deliverables, and long production schedules.
* Coordinate editorial, curriculum, instructional design, content development, design, production, technology, and quality assurance teams.
* Monitor content development, design reviews, feedback incorporation, revisions, approvals, and final production.
* Ensure consistency across project levels, content formats, and deliverables while maintaining quality and curriculum alignment.
* Manage client feedback and design decisions systematically to minimise rework and conflicting instructions.

5. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders.
* Lead kick-off meetings, POC reviews, project progress meetings, and delivery discussions.
* Translate client requirements into actionable project plans and measurable milestones.
* Communicate progress, risks, delays, dependencies, and corrective actions proactively.
* Manage expectations, resolve escalations, and ensure timely decisions and approvals.
* Build strong relationships with international clients, particularly those operating in the UK and other global markets.

6. Resource Management & Continuous Improvement

* Coordinate internal teams, vendors, and production partners to ensure effective resource utilisation.
* Track team capacity, workloads, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Facilitate collaboration between editorial, content, design, production, QA, and technology teams.
* Prepare dashboards, status reports, milestone trackers, risk reports, and management updates.
* Monitor project performance against scope, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and KPIs.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce rework, and enhance project efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 8+ years of project management experience, preferably in K-12 EdTech, educational publishing, ELT, e-learning, or digital content production.
* **Mandatory hands-on experience managing POC (Proof of Concept) projects**
  , preferably within EdTech, educational publishing, digital learning, or technology-enabled content solutions.
* Proven ability to define POC scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, success criteria, and evaluation metrics.
* Experience coordinating POC execution, client feedback, testing, documentation, stakeholder reviews, and outcome presentations.
* Strong expertise in project planning, scheduling, milestone tracking, risk management, change control, and delivery governance.
* **Hands-on experience with Smartsheet**
  for project planning, tracking, dashboards, reporting, and workflow management.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects with multiple deliverables and long production schedules.
* Strong understanding of educational publishing, K-12 content production, or ELT workflows.
* Experience maintaining decision logs, feedback trackers, change requests, approval records, and version histories.
* Excellent client communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Ability to establish processes at kick-off and ensure compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Willingness to work the UK shift and attend the Noida Sector 3 office, with any work-from-home arrangement to be discussed.
