title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG**
is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day in the life:**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.
  
  

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.
  
  

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.
  
  

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

#FCMIN
  
  
**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**
FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
  
  
**Market Aligned remuneration structure**
and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
  
  
**Wellbeing Focus**
- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
  
  
**Paternity Leave:**
We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
  
  
**Travel perks**
: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
  
  
**A career, not a job**
: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
  
  
**Reward & Recognition**
: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  
  
**Love for travel**
: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  
  
**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
  
  
As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
  
  
We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
**Brightness of Future.**
We encourage you to
**DREAM BIG**
through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
  
  
**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
*Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.*

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**

Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.

description:

**About Arts to Hearts Project**

Arts to Hearts Project is a global platform for artists, bringing together books, magazines, creative

projects, and opportunities that connect artists with a wider audience.

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Book Production & Project Coordinator to

manage the end-to-end coordination of our book projects.

● Follow up with concerned team members to ensure deadlines are met.

footers, QR codes, and other book elements.

requirements.

● Maintain standard checklists for different stages of book production.

● Ensure team members follow agreed processes and timelines.

● Document recurring issues, dependencies, and process improvements.

● Maintain central project documentation and trackers.

**Team Coordination**

● Work closely with Designers, Editors, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders.

● Clearly communicate tasks, deadlines, feedback, and changes.

● Ensure feedback is consolidated before sharing it with the concerned team member.

● Maintain clear ownership and reporting within the book team.

**Quality & Final Review**

● Conduct pre-final checks for layouts, content placement, page numbering, QR codes, headers,

footers, links, and other required elements.

● Ensure all required components are included before final approval.

● Coordinate final review and approval with the concerned stakeholders.

● Ensure final files are properly organised and ready for publishing/distribution.

**Key Skills**

● Strong project coordination and organisational skills.

● Good understanding of book design and publishing workflows.

● Strong attention to detail.

● Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

● Good communication and follow-up skills.

● Experience working with creative/design teams.

● Ability to create and maintain SOPs and trackers.

● Good understanding of Adobe InDesign and other relevant design tools is preferred.

● Strong documentation and file-management skills.

● Ability to identify gaps and proactively solve problems.

**What We’re Looking For**

● Someone who can independently take ownership of book projects.

● Someone who is comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

● Someone who can balance creativity with process and timelines.

● Someone who notices small details and ensures work is production-ready.

● Someone who can build structure around creative workflows rather than simply following tasks.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in publishing, book production, editorial production, creative project management, or working

with design teams will be preferred.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

* Understanding of pricing, revenue optimization, or demand forecasting in travel
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven products (recommendations, dynamic pricing, personalization)

Equal Opportunity Employer

**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.

Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Your tasks will also include coordinating meetings such as project kick-off meetings and leadership calls, holding meetings, brainstorming sessions, and sprints, as well as managing project timelines in collaboration with Global Production, Expert Networks, Global Information Procurement and Access, Design Studios and affiliated Leadership and Management.

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Team:**
The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems.
  
  
You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance.
  
  
You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations.
  
  
**Key Tasks:**
Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels.
  
  

* Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces.
* Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR.
* Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices.
* Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture.
* Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures.
* Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover.
* Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value.
* Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets.
* Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting.
* Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant.

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards.
  
  
The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract.
  
  
The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification.
  
  

* Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility.
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks.
* Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers.
* Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage.
* Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation.
* Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings.
* Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination.
* Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable.

The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
**owning, governing, and continuously improving the technical integration landscape**
supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides
**hands-on Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) expertise**
from day one, translating integration requirements into reliable, supportable, and scalable data flows across o9 and upstream or downstream enterprise systems.
  
  
This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

**Candidate Evidence Expected**
Candidates should be prepared to provide concrete examples from recent o9 engagements, including:
  
  

* Their exact role, duration, and ownership in each o9 project.
* INT3.0 interfaces designed or delivered, source and target systems, data volumes or cadence, and production responsibilities.
* Examples of complex incidents diagnosed and permanently resolved.
* Examples of integration design documents, runbooks, monitoring approaches, or error-management practices they created.
* Python solutions personally developed and the business or operational problem addressed.
* Current o9 certifications and evidence of relevant o9 training completion.

title: Project Specialist II
description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Title:**
**Project Specialist II**
**Job Location:**
India (Remote)
  
  
**Job Overview:**
The Project Specialist II will work alongside the Project Manager, or equivalent, to provide expertise and coordination to ensure the delivery of the contracted tasks and responsibilities, as outlined in the project’s scope of work and contract. The Project Specialist II will ensure the Project Management activities are delivered in a timely and consistent manner The Project Specialist II may support mentoring and training for other Project Specialists.
  
  
**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**
**Systems/Reporting**

* Owns system access administration (system access, ongoing access surveillance, and access revocation).
* Supports the PM/PD with set up and maintenance of the MSP study timeline and reporting timelines to the team.
* Supports the PM/PD with creation of study projections (site feasibility, selection, activation, patient enrolment, etc.), as required.
* Creates and deploys study specific training matrix and ensures team compliance with assigned trainings, including proper documentation and escalation of non-compliance.
* Coordinates and provides support with creating the Executive Monthly Report and obtains and maintains study progress reports and trackers.
* Reviews the analytics and reports from Clarity Insight to identify any trends, missing data, and follow-up actions.
* Supports PM and works directly with project team in keeping source systems current.
* Maintains project server and portal where applicable.

**Meetings**

* Organizes and is actively involved in the Kickoff Meetings for the internal and sponsor study teams, as applicable.
* Supports with project team and departmental meetings, coordinating the creation of agendas and taking minutes, decision and/or action items, if applicable, for the study sponsor and internal meetings.
* Organizes/finalizes meeting materials for presentations (e.g. Investigator meetings, internal and client meetings, departmental meetings, etc.).
* Ensures all outstanding actions as discussed in project meetings, are tracked until completion.

**Finance**

* Coordinates cross functional financial units and milestones reporting.
* Maintains out of scope (OOS) tracker.
* Supports site payments and associated tracking, as needed. May work with Grants Administration to process investigator/site payments and draft amended site budget templates.
* At study closure, supports the PM/PD in doing final reconciliation of sponsor, vendors, and site payments, as applicable.

**Coordination**

* Acts as first point of contact for other team members on the project as needed
* Supports and coordinates the set up and maintenance of functional plans and project-specific procedures, guidelines, documents, and forms with the project team.
* Develops /distributes time sheet guidelines for Project Teams and supports the project team training in these.
* Maintains the list of SOPs implemented on the project, if applicable.
* Sets up and maintains the study working files with the core study specific templates.
* Supports the project team in managing audits and Corrective Action Plan Agreement (CAPA) resolutions, as applicable.
* Supports PM/PD with general administrative requests (e.g. formatting support, slide compilation, circulate documents for review etc.)
* Follow-up, track and transcribe Lab Normal Ranges as outlined in CMG-436-GL.
* Performs other duties as required by the department or delegated by the PM/PD.
* Ensure all work is conducted in accordance with SOPs, policies and practices, good clinical practices and applicable regulatory requirements and meets quality and timeline metrics.

**End of Study**

* At study closure, supports Medical Writing and PM with collation of Clinical Study Report appendices, where applicable.
* At study closure, supports the PM/PD in ensuring CTMS system is closed out according to requirements.

Performs other duties as assigned by Project Management to support department needs. May be required to mentor and oversee other Project Specialists.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
No supervisory responsibilities
  
  
**Job Requirements:**

* Education

+ University graduate preferred, healthcare or life science degree a plus.
+ Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience considered (minimum 3 years work experience in absence of a degree).

* Experience

+ 3 years’ experience in the Clinical Research industry required.
+ Prior relevant work experience in clinical systems (e.g., CTMS, eTMF, EDC) required.

* Skills/Competencies

+ Demonstrated ability to conduct activities effectively and efficiently.
+ Experience of the clinical research process and terminology.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, both in English and local language.
+ Strong interpersonal skills.
+ Team-oriented and a strong team player.
+ Comprehensive knowledge of ICH/GCP guidelines.
+ Problem-solving skills.
+ Good computer literacy with working knowledge of PCs, Windows and Microsoft Office applications, with advanced excel skills.
+ Able to work in a dynamic, changing environment.
+ Demonstrates honesty, trust, fairness, cooperation, self- control, and flexibility.
+ Demonstrated ability to conduct activities effectively, efficiently and with the minimum of supervision.
+ Able to exercise judgment within defined procedures and practices and to determine appropriate action independently.
+ Highly organized.

* Capabilities

+ Ability to work remotely.
+ Minimal travel may be required 10%

V1
  
  
The company will not accept unsolicited resumes from third party vendors.

title: TMF Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
JOB TITLE: TMF Lead
  
  
LOCATION: India (Remote)
  
  
**Job Overview**
The TMF Lead is responsible for day-to-day TMF leadership for assigned clinical studies. The role coordinates study TMF activities, provides status and risk information to stakeholders, and directs the work of supporting TMF Specialists and Associates. The TMF Lead creates and maintains the TMF Plan, leads or creates the TMF build, and coordinates periodic TMF quality control and remediation with oversight from TMF management.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Coordinates TMF activities across the lifecycle of assigned studies and serves as the routine TMF contact for the study team.
* Creates, maintains, and implements the study-specific TMF Plan and associated records with review and approval from the Project Manager and Sponsor.
* Leads the initial TMF build for assigned studies, including structure, expected document packages and ad hoc placeholder creation in accordance with approved standards.
* Maintains TMF expectations as study scope, milestones, countries, sites, vendors, or responsibilities change.
* Plans and coordinates periodic TMF QC in accordance with the TMF Plan and procedures, including assignment, completion tracking, documentation, and follow-up.
* Reviews periodic QC findings, coordinates remediation, verifies completion, identifies repeat issues, and escalates significant trends or unresolved actions.
* Monitors TMF completeness, quality, and timeliness and provides regular status reports to study and functional stakeholders.
* Coordinates document collection, review, indexing, filing, reconciliation, and issue resolution across internal and external contributors.
* Identifies and investigates missing, incomplete, inconsistent, late, or misfiled documents and assigns or escalates corrective actions.
* Provides task direction, priorities, and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates supporting assigned studies.
* Participates in study meetings and communicates TMF requirements, status, risks, actions, and upcoming milestones.
* Interacts directly with sponsors to provide TMF status updates, discuss risks and actions, confirm expectations, and support study decisions within delegated authority.
* Supports audit and regulatory inspection readiness, document retrieval, response preparation, and remediation.
* Coordinates final TMF review, reconciliation, closeout, transfer, archival, and sponsor return activities.
* Provides TMF training and eTMF system support to TMF Specialists and Associates, study team members, sponsors, and other users and escalates system issues when required.
* Escalates material risks, recurring quality issues, resource concerns, and decisions outside delegated authority.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by departmental management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No routine direct supervisory responsibility. Provides study-level task direction and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates assigned to the study.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
EDUCATION
  
  

* College or university degree. A healthcare, life science, information management, or related degree is a plus.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Typically minimum of six years of experience in TMF, records management, clinical operations, or a related regulated function.
* Experience coordinating TMF activities and working with cross-functional study teams.
* Experience creating or maintaining TMF Plans, supporting or leading TMF builds, and coordinating periodic TMF QC is preferred.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with global internal and external study teams
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and electronic Trial Master File systems
* Knowledge of the clinical trial lifecycle, essential documents, and applicable TMF requirements
* Knowledge of ICH Good Clinical Practice and applicable regulatory requirements
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent focus on document quality
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and timelines
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and changing environment
* Demonstrates honesty, trust, fairness, cooperation, self-control, and flexibility
* Strong working knowledge of TMF structure, essential documents, metadata, and records lifecycle activities
* Strong coordination, facilitation, problem-solving, and escalation skills
* Ability to interpret reports and QC findings and coordinate appropriate remediation
* Ability to work independently within approved plans, procedures, and delegated authority

**Capabilities**

* Able to work flexible hours to accommodate study team and sponsor requirements
* Able to travel based on study and business need
* Able to perform office-based or remote work as assigned
* Minor lifting of less than 30 pounds may be required

title: Head of Electrical Engineering
description:
**\*Purpose/Objective:**

Lead the Electrical Engineering function for Adani WTG Manufacturing with end-to-end technical ownership of electrical systems across the WTG platform. The role will drive electrical architecture, component engineering, system integration, verification & validation, grid compliance, certification, reliability improvement, localization and technology development. The incumbent will work closely with Mechanical, Loads, Controls, SCADA, Blade, Nacelle, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Project Engineering and Service teams to deliver reliable, cost-competitive and certifiable WTG platforms.

**About Business:**

**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG):**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.

**Job Purpose:**

The Lead Grid Compliance leads the development and implementation of strategies to ensure wind turbines meet regulatory requirements for grid connection, power quality, and dynamic grid support. This role oversees the design and integration of SCADA systems, focusing on real-time monitoring, control, and data acquisition to optimize turbine performance. The Lead manages testing and validation processes, including power quality assessments and grid support simulations, and prepares compliance reports for regulatory bodies. This position also addresses cybersecurity risks within SCADA systems, drives continuous improvement in grid interaction technologies, and mentors a team of engineers to enhance their expertise in grid compliance and SCADA operations.

**\***
Key Responsibilities of Role

1. WTG Electrical System Architecture

* Own the overall electrical architecture of wind turbine platforms from concept through serial production.
* Define system/sub-system requirements, technical specifications, interfaces and design criteria.
* Lead engineering of:
* Generator and generator interfaces
* Power converters
* Main and auxiliary transformers
* Pitch electrical system
* Low-voltage and medium-voltage systems
* Switchgear and protection systems
* UPS and auxiliary power systems
* Cable and harness systems
* Earthing and lightning protection interfaces
* Electrical panels and power distribution systems
* Ensure robust electrical interfaces across converter, generator, controls, transformer, switchgear and grid connection systems.

2. Generator & Power Conversion

* Provide technical leadership for generator selection, specification, integration and validation.
* Lead converter architecture, sizing and performance requirements, including thermal and electrical interfaces.
* Drive system-level optimization between generator, converter, transformer and turbine control.
* Review component design margins, losses, efficiency, temperature rise and operating envelopes.

3. Grid Integration & Compliance

* Lead WTG electrical engineering support for grid-code compliance and turbine-grid integration.
* Guide power quality, reactive power, voltage/frequency response and protection philosophy.
* Coordinate engineering inputs for electrical modelling, grid studies and compliance verification.
* Ensure electrical design supports applicable project and market-specific grid requirements.

4. Controls, SCADA & Electrical Interfaces

* Work closely with Controls and SCADA engineering teams to ensure complete integration of electrical equipment into the turbine control architecture.
* Define sensors, measurements, alarms, protections, interlocks and operational sequences.
* Lead interface management among electrical hardware, turbine controller, converter controller and SCADA.
* Support troubleshooting of turbine-level electrical and control interactions.

5. Design Verification & Validation

* Establish electrical DVP&R / verification and validation plans for components and turbine systems.
* Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and engineering sign-offs.
* Define prototype, laboratory, bench and turbine-level validation requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis for electrical failures using structured methodologies such as
  **8D, FMEA/FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis and RCA**
  .
* Drive corrective and preventive engineering actions based on field and test observations.

6. Reliability & Product Performance

* Own electrical reliability improvement across the WTG lifecycle.
* Analyse recurring failures involving converters, generators, transformers, pitch electrical systems and other electrical components.
* Drive improvements in thermal management, electrical protection, component life and system robustness.
* Develop design improvements based on testing, manufacturing and field-performance feedback.

7. Certification & Engineering Compliance

* Ensure electrical designs are compliant with applicable wind turbine certification and electrical engineering requirements.
* Coordinate engineering activities with certification bodies and external technical agencies where required.
* Maintain design documentation, calculations, specifications, compliance evidence and engineering change records.
* Support WTG type certification and platform upgrades from an electrical engineering perspective.

8. Localization & Supplier Engineering

* Drive localization and alternate-source development for critical electrical components.
* Develop technical specifications and qualification criteria for suppliers.
* Participate in supplier capability assessment, technical reviews and component qualification.
* Work with Supply Chain and Quality teams on technical closure of supplier deviations and engineering changes.
* Drive design-to-cost and value-engineering initiatives without compromising reliability or compliance.

9. Manufacturing & Service Support

* Provide engineering support for manufacturing ramp-up and serial production.
* Address electrical non-conformities and recurring manufacturing issues through permanent engineering solutions.
* Support commissioning and service teams on complex turbine electrical failures and field issues.
* Translate field lessons learned into product/design improvements.

10. Engineering Leadership

* Build and lead a strong Electrical Engineering organization covering core electrical systems and relevant specialist competencies.
* Establish engineering processes, design standards, review mechanisms and technical governance.
* Mentor engineers and develop technical competency in WTG electrical technology.
* Manage engineering priorities across new-product development, localization, cost reduction, field issues and platform improvements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and international engineering partners on technology development.

**\***
Qualifications and Experience

* **Qualification:**

title: Head - Plant Operations - Packaging
description:
My client is a multi-location manufacturing enterprise in the packaging/converting sector. They operate a multi-plant network and are seeking a business-minded operational leader to run our manufacturing operations as profit centers.

The VP Operations / Head of Plant Operations will own the plant network P&L, focusing on EBITDA margin improvement, capacity utilization, and conversion costs. This role requires a business operator rather than a hands-on technical engineer. -

title: Project Coordinator (Delivery Enablement & Cross-Pod Coordination)
description:
**Job Role**
We are in need of an experienced Project Coordinator to serve as the connective tissue across multiple pods. This role sits at the intersection of planning, execution, and people—enabling every pod to deliver predictably, removing obstacles before they become blockers, and keeping the entire delivery engine running in sync.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in high-velocity, multi-team environments, has a natural instinct for process, and brings a collaborative energy that makes every pod they touch more effective.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cross-Pod/Business units Roadmap Chase & Delivery Tracking
* Maintain a consolidated view of roadmap items across all pods, tracking progress against committed timelines.
* Proactively chase open action items, pending decisions, and deliverables with pod leads and team members.
* Ensure roadmap milestones are visible, understood, and actively worked towards at all times.
* Flag slippages early and escalate with context to the right stakeholders.
* Jira + Other tools -Collaborative Hygiene & Delivery Practice Adherence
* Champion and enforce Jira usage standards—ensuring tickets are created, updated, estimated, and closed per agreed delivery practices.
* Audit sprint boards across pods regularly to identify stale tickets, missing acceptance criteria, unlinked dependencies, and velocity anomalies.
* Run regular hygiene drives and provide guidance to pod members on correct Jira workflows.
* Generate and distribute sprint/delivery health reports from Jira to keep leadership informed.
* Blocker Identification & Resolution Follow-up
* Maintain a live blockers register across all pods—tracking each blocker's owner, age, and resolution status.
* Facilitate cross-pod and cross-functional conversations needed to unblock teams (engineering, product, design, QA, infra).
* Escalate unresolved blockers to the appropriate level with clear context and a proposed path forward.
* Track recurrence patterns of blockers and recommend systemic improvements to reduce repeat issues.
* On-time Delivery Facilitation
* Drive release readiness checklists and pre-delivery coordination across pods.
* Coordinate go/no-go discussions, ensuring all dependencies are met before delivery milestones.
* Maintain a forward-looking calendar of planned deliveries, releases, and key ceremonies.
* Work closely with QA, DevOps, and product teams to align on delivery gates and ensure smooth handoffs.
* Pod-level Delivery Practice Coaching
* Observe pod ceremonies (standups, planning, retrospectives) and provide lightweight coaching on best practices.
* Help pods adopt and consistently follow agile/scrum delivery practices as defined by the delivery framework.
* Identify pods that need extra support and proactively engage with their leads.
* Create and maintain delivery playbooks and reference guides for pods to self-serve.
* Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
* Produce weekly delivery health dashboards summarising pod-level status, upcoming deliveries, and risk flags.
* Serve as the escalation point of contact for delivery-related queries from product owners and leadership.
* Facilitate cross-pod syncs and dependency reviews to ensure alignment on shared timelines.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 5+ years in a project coordination, delivery management role
* Proven experience working with multiple parallel teams or pods
* Strong hands-on Jira expertise—including board configuration, reporting, and workflow management
* Excellent written and verbal communication for cross-functional stakeholder management
* Demonstrated ability to manage blockers and drive accountability without direct authority
* Comfort working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments
* Structured approach to tracking and follow-ups with attention to detail

Good to Have
  
  

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM) or equivalent agile training
* Prior experience in a software product or technology delivery organisation
* Familiarity with Confluence or similar documentation platforms
* Experience producing delivery dashboards using Jira filters/reports or BI tools
* Understanding of SDLC and release management practices
* Exposure to OKR or outcome-based planning frameworks

title: Oracle Fusion Financial Consultant
description:
**About the Company**

Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials services for a multi-entity international group operating across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across multiple legal entities and ledgers, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion Financials to banking partners, intercompany systems, and external platforms.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant to strengthen the Finance practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands-on functional delivery role. You will support the configuration and delivery of Oracle Fusion Financials across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets, working under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants. You will contribute to design workshops, execute configuration, prepare functional documentation, and support testing across a multi-entity international environment. This is an opportunity to broaden your Oracle Fusion Financials experience across multiple modules and geographies while building depth in a specialist Finance capability.

**Responsibilities**

**Solution Design and Configuration**

* Participate in discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with Finance business stakeholders across multiple legal entities and geographies.
* Contribute to the functional design of Oracle Fusion Financials, including Chart of Accounts structure, ledger setup, SLA accounting rules, tax determination, and period-close processes.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, and gap-fit analyses under the guidance of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Perform configuration across GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets in line with agreed design decisions and Oracle best-practice standards.
* Support the setup of intercompany accounting, netting arrangements, and consolidation hierarchies for a multi-entity international group structure.

**General Ledger (GL)**

* Support Chart of Accounts configuration across multiple legal entities covering US, UK, Mexico, China, and India reporting requirements.
* Configure ledgers, accounting calendars, currencies, and intercompany balancing rules under direction.
* Assist with configuration and validation of Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules to ensure accurate accounting distributions from subledgers into the GL.
* Support period-end close activities including subledger close, revaluation, translation, and intercompany elimination runs.

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Configure AP functionality covering invoice management, three-way PO matching, payment processing, supplier setup, and BPM approval workflows.
* Configure and test multi-country electronic payment formats (SEPA, BACS, SWIFT, ACH, NEFT/RTGS) and payment process profiles aligned to each entity's banking arrangements.
* Support AP-to-GL accounting configuration including liability accounts, prepayments, withholding tax, and intercompany payables.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Configure AR functionality covering customer billing, AutoInvoice rule setup, multi-currency receipts, lockbox processing, and deductions management.
* Support the configuration of receipt application rules, aging bucket setups, and bad debt provisioning.
* Support AR-to-GL accounting distributions including revenue recognition and intercompany receivables setups.

**Cash Management**

* Support bank account structure setup and bank statement reconciliation configuration across group entities and banking relationships.
* Configure automated reconciliation rules, tolerance thresholds, and exception handling for multi-currency bank statement matching.
* Support testing of OIC-delivered bank interface integrations, including statement import formats, reconciliation mapping, and error handling.

**Tax, Oracle Tax**

* Configure Oracle Fusion Tax across applicable regimes including GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, and China VAT/Fapiao, under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Support the setup of tax determination rules, tax condition sets, and tax registration configurations, including scenarios such as intercompany transactions, imports and exports, reverse charge, and withholding tax.
* Support indirect tax compliance activities and help ensure Oracle tax outputs meet local statutory reporting requirements.

**Fixed Assets (FA)**

* Configure Fixed Assets functionality including corporate and tax asset books, depreciation methods, prorate conventions, and mass addition rules.
* Support CIP-to-asset capitalization workflows, asset retirement processes, and revaluation setups across operating jurisdictions.
* Support FA period-end close activities including depreciation runs and FA-to-GL reconciliation.

**Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work with Finance business users to clarify requirements and resolve day-to-day functional queries.
* Contribute to the Finance workstream across project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, and Deploy, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed on time and to quality.
* Prepare test scripts, execute SIT and UAT cycles, and log and track defects to closure.
* Collaborate with Oracle Fusion technical teams on RICEW deliverables, providing functional input on Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, and Workflows.
* Support OIC integration testing connecting Oracle Fusion Financials to banking, intercompany, and external systems.
* Continuously build product knowledge across Oracle Fusion Financials modules and work towards relevant Oracle certifications.

**Qualifications and Skills**

***Required***

* 3 or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials functional experience, including at least one full-cycle implementation or a major rollout, upgrade, or support engagement.
* Practical configuration experience across at least three of the core modules: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets.
* Working knowledge of core Financials concepts including Chart of Accounts structures, ledger and accounting calendar setup, and Subledger Accounting (SLA).
* Experience preparing functional documentation such as configuration workbooks, functional specifications, and test scripts.
* Experience executing SIT and UAT cycles, logging defects, and tracking them to closure.
* Understanding of the period-end close process across subledgers and GL.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with Finance business users to clarify requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

***Preferred***

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency, or multi-ledger environments.
* Experience with Oracle Tax configuration for one or more of GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, or China VAT.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) delivered interfaces, particularly bank and intercompany integrations, from a functional testing perspective.
* Working knowledge of BPM approval workflow configuration.
* Exposure to RICEW deliverables and collaboration with technical teams.
* A professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or part-qualified) is an advantage.
