title: SEO Team Lead (Saleshandy)
description:
**About Saleshandy**
Saleshandy is a cold email outreach platform used by thousands of sales teams, agencies and founders worldwide to book more meetings. Our stack spans outreach, B2B lead data, email infrastructure and deliverability, and organic search is one of our largest acquisition channels.
  
  
We compete in one of the most contested SERPs in SaaS: cold email, sales engagement and lead generation, against well-funded players like Apollo, Instantly and Lemlist.
**We're hiring an SEO Team Lead to own that battle end to end**
: set the strategy, do the hard work yourself, and build a team that compounds organic pipeline quarter after quarter.
  
  
Role snapshot
  
  

* Title: SEO Team Lead
* Reports to: VP, Marketing & Demand Generation
* Team: Lead the SEO team (Senior SEO Executive, SEO Executives), grow headcount as results compound
* Split: ~70% hands-on execution, ~30% strategy and people leadership
* Scope: Technical, on-page, content strategy, off-page/link building, AI search visibility (AI Overviews, LLMs)
* Location: Ahmedabad, India (on-site)
* Experience: 3-5 years in SEO, 2+ years in B2B SaaS, 1+ year leading a team
* Type: Full-time

What you'll own
  
  
You own organic search as a revenue channel, from the keyword universe to the signup.
  
  

* SEO strategy & roadmap
* Build and own the quarterly SEO roadmap tied to signups, trials and MQLs, not vanity traffic
* Map the full keyword universe and topic clusters across BOFU (alternatives, comparisons, pricing, use cases), MOFU and TOFU
* Prioritise ruthlessly by impact × effort; report progress to marketing leadership monthly
* Technical SEO (hands-on)
* Run and fix site audits: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, canonicals, redirects, hreflang, schema, internal linking
* Work directly with developers on site architecture, templates and programmatic SEO pages
* Own Google Search Console, sitemaps, log-file analysis and migration safety
* On-page & content SEO
* Write SEO briefs and optimise existing pages: product, feature, comparison, integration, blog and landing pages
* Run content refresh and pruning programs to recover decaying rankings
* Partner with content writers on search intent, E-E-A-T and conversion-focused page structure
* Off-page & authority building
* Own the link-building strategy: digital PR, data-led assets, guest posts, partnerships, broken-link and unlinked-mention outreach
* Grow high-quality referring domains in our niche while keeping the backlink profile clean
* Use Saleshandy itself to run outreach at scale
* AI search visibility (GEO/AEO)
* Grow Saleshandy's presence in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other LLM answers
* Track brand mentions, citations and share of voice versus competitors; act on the gaps
* Team leadership
* Lead, coach and grow the SEO team; set weekly goals, review work and raise the quality bar
* Hire as the channel scales; build SOPs and playbooks so execution doesn't depend on one person
* Analytics & reporting
* Own SEO dashboards in GA4, GSC, Ahrefs and PostHog: rankings, traffic, conversions and assisted pipeline
* Turn data into the next sprint's priorities, not just a monthly report

Your first 90 days
  
  
By day 90 you'll have a funded roadmap, shipped quick wins and a team running on a weekly cadence.
  
  
**Days 1-30**

* Focus: Full technical, content and backlink audit; competitor gap analysis; meet the team and set working rhythm
* Outcome: Audit + prioritised backlog presented to leadership

**Days 31-60**

* Focus: Ship technical fixes and top-20 page optimisations; launch BOFU cluster and link-building engine
* Outcome: First ranking and CTR gains on money pages; link pipeline live

**Days 61-90**

* Focus: Scale content and programmatic pages; AI-visibility tracking; SOPs and team KPIs
* Outcome: Quarterly roadmap with targets; team owning clear goals

**How We'll Measure Success**

* Organic signups, trials and MQLs (primary)
* Non-brand organic traffic and top-3 rankings for commercial keywords
* Quality referring domains gained per month
* Share of voice in AI Overviews and LLM answers vs competitors
* Technical health score and Core Web Vitals pass rate
* Team output, quality and growth

What you bring
  
  
**Must-haves**

* 3-5 years of hands-on SEO, with 2+ years in B2B SaaS or a competitive tech niche
* 1+ year leading SEO people; you've coached executives into strong specialists
* Proven, quantified wins: you can show traffic, rankings and signup growth you personally drove
* Deep technical SEO: you can read a crawl, diagnose indexation issues and spec fixes for developers without hand-holding
* Strong on-page and content SEO: search intent, briefs, topic clusters, internal linking, CRO basics
* A link-building track record built on outreach, PR and assets, not paid link farms
* Current with AI search: Google AI Overviews, LLM citations and how they change SEO
* Data fluency across GA4, GSC and Ahrefs/Semrush; comfortable in Excel/Sheets and Looker Studio
* Clear written English and the ownership to run with ambiguity

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in sales tech, martech or outreach/cold email SaaS
* Programmatic SEO at scale (hundreds to thousands of pages)
* Basic HTML/CSS/JS, WordPress or headless CMS, and Python or Screaming Frog custom extraction
* International SEO (US, UK, EU markets)
* Experience using AI tools to speed up research, briefs and audits

Tools you'll use
  
  
Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4, PostHog, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio, WordPress, Saleshandy (for outreach), and AI tools of your choice.
  
  
Why you'll love it here
  
  

* Full ownership of a channel that directly moves revenue, and leadership that backs you
* A real budget for tools, content and links
* A fast, founder-led team where good ideas ship in days, not quarters
* Room to grow into Head of SEO as the team scales

Hiring process
  
  

* Application review (share 2-3 SEO case studies with numbers)
* 10-min intro call with Talent
* Screening assignment
* Assignment walkthrough with the VP, Marketing & Demand Generation
* Culture and leadership round with a co-founder
* Offer

title: Senior Software Engineer (Saleshandy)
description:
**Experience:**
5–7 years
  
  
**About Saleshandy**
Saleshandy is how thousands of sales teams around the world find their next customer and reach them. A lead database of
**850+ million contacts**
. Email sequences and mailbox warmup running continuously across tens of thousands of inboxes. Analytics that has to be correct the moment someone looks at it.
  
  
Every one of those is a systems problem before it's a product problem, and that's where the interesting work is. Searching hundreds of millions of records in under a second. Processing event streams that can't lose or double-count a message. Building interfaces that stay fast when the dataset behind them only ever grows.
  
  
We're hiring a Tech Lead to own a significant part of that surface, and the engineers who build it.
  
  
**What's The Role About**
You'll lead a team of engineers working across the stack, and you'll still be one of the
**strongest engineers**
on it. You take the hardest problem of the quarter yourself, you're in the design reviews catching what everyone else missed, and you own the architectural direction for everything your team touches.
  
  
You'll also own something less visible and worth more: that there is
**one right way**
to do the things that have to be correct. One approach to retries and failure recovery. One source of truth for the numbers customers see. Defined once and inherited, instead of five engineers each arriving at a slightly different, slightly wrong version of it.
  
  
Three things matter more than the title you held before:
  
  

* Technical direction. You can hold the whole system in your head and say where it's going. You make the call between queue and stream, between a new service and a boundary in an existing one, and you can defend it on trade-offs rather than preference.
* Force multiplication. Your result isn't what you shipped, it's what the team shipped and how much better they got doing it. You know where every engineer stands, you deal with a performance problem when you see it rather than when the calendar says to, and you're the reason the strong ones stay and people grows.
* High agency. You act when the spec is unclear instead of waiting for someone to decide for you. Work doesn't stall on your side waiting on another team, you go and unblock it. You stay on the hook for what you ship until it actually works in production, not until it's merged.

What You'll Do
  
  

* Own the architectural direction across your surfaces, and the trade-offs behind every call
* Design and ship the hardest work yourself, you stay a builder
* Run design reviews that catch races, partial failures, and everything that only breaks at volume
* Define the shared patterns your team inherits, and consolidate the ones that got built twice
* Own operability: what you ship is observable, alerted, and runnable by more than one person
* Grow the engineers on your team, and give leadership an honest, evidence-backed read on each of them
* Run interview loops and make the call on who joins
* Own a customer-facing metric, and cut the work that isn't moving it
* Use AI coding agents as a core part of the workflow, and own the quality bar that keeps their output honest

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Distributed systems experience that's real. Services that stay correct when they fail halfway and get retried. Event pipelines that don't lose or duplicate work. You can defend your choice of queue, stream, or store instead of reaching for whichever is fashionable.
* Data at volume. MySQL that holds up under genuine load, schema, indexing, and finding the query that's quietly costing you. Search and analytics at scale with OpenSearch or ClickHouse. Caching as a deliberate decision, not a reflex.
* Credibility across the stack. You review a data-heavy React surface's state architecture as seriously as you review a service boundary. You don't need to out-build your specialists; you do need to recognise the design that will hurt in six months.
* You can run what you ship. Containerised deploys, CI/CD, and production observability. When something is intermittently timing out, you find it in traces and metrics rather than guessing.
* AI fluency with judgment. You use coding agents daily, and you've thought about what breaks when an entire team does and put something in place for it.
* A track record with people. Engineers you've led who got measurably better, and who you can talk about specifically.

**Our stack**
**:**
Node.js, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, OpenSearch, React, Docker, AWS, Grafana/Tempo/Loki.
  
  
**Nice to have, not required:**
ClickHouse, MongoDB, Terraform. You'll pick these up here if you haven't used them.
  
  
https://stackshare.io/saleshandy/saleshandy
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  

* Purpose: You'll own a core part of a product used every working day by thousands of sales teams, at a scale, 850 million records, continuous delivery infrastructure, real-time analytics, you can't get at most companies.
* Growth: This is the seat that leads to Staff Engineer or Engineering Manager here, depending on which half of it you find you love. You'll find out which one you are.
* Leverage: We're serious about AI-first engineering. You'll set how an entire team works with coding agents, not just how you do.
* Ownership: Architectural direction, a customer metric, and the team. Not a ticket-routing role with a senior title.

Culture Fit, Are You One of Us
  
  

* You still write code :)
* You use AI as a multiplier.
* You don't wait for permission on the calls you can reverse, you make them, write down why, and keep moving.
* You get genuine satisfaction out of someone else levelling up.
* You'll tell someone their design is wrong, or that they aren't growing, in a way they can actually hear.
* You raise a "yellow" early, and you thank the people who do the same.
* You debug with traces, logs, and metrics, never with guesswork.
* You'd rather define the right pattern once than personally fix the same bug five times.

title: Analyst I - Global Project Management
description:

-------------------

The role partners closely with project managers, functional teams, business stakeholders, and global operations leaders to drive project excellence, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.

* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and action items.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project activities.
* Maintain project schedules and update progress against defined plans.

### **PMO Governance & Reporting**

* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and governance presentations.
* Monitor project health indicators, risks, issues, and dependencies.

### **Risk & Issue Management**

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with cross-functional teams including Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT, HR, and Transformation teams.
* Facilitate communication between global stakeholders and project teams.
* Support project communication plans and executive updates.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to standardize project management processes.
* Support implementation of PMO best practices and operational efficiencies.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across project delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, Technology, or a related field.

### **Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Operations, Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience supporting cross-functional projects in a fast-paced environment preferred.
* Exposure to project management methodologies and governance processes is desirable.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Jira, or similar project management/reporting tools preferred.
* Ability to manage and analyze project-related data effectively.
* Familiarity with project planning and tracking tools.

### **Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.

**Success Measures**
====================

* Timely completion of project deliverables and milestones.
* Accuracy and quality of project reporting and dashboards.
* Effective tracking and resolution of project risks and issues.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement.
* Adoption of PMO standards and governance processes.
* Contribution to operational efficiency and project success metrics.

title: BIM Coordinator
description:
**Company Description**
Mepography is a global BIM and Digital Engineering company delivering high-performance MEP, Architectural, Structural, and Construction Engineering solutions for complex projects worldwide. The organization specializes in services such as MEP BIM Modeling, Revit Engineering, Clash Detection, Shop Drawings, Scan to BIM, Point Cloud Modeling, and advanced LOD and 4D/5D BIM solutions across multiple sectors including residential, commercial, industrial, healthcare, infrastructure, power plants, airports, and mission-critical facilities. Mepography supports contractors, consultants, developers, and EPC organizations with technically accurate and execution-focused BIM workflows that enhance coordination, reduce project risks, accelerate delivery timelines, and improve construction efficiency. Operating across India, Singapore, the Middle East, Europe, and the United States, the company is committed to world-class digital engineering standards, innovation-driven project execution, and long-term value creation for the global AEC industry.
  
**Role Description**
The BIM Coordinator is a full-time on-site role based in Coimbatore, responsible for managing and coordinating BIM workflows across multidisciplinary project teams. This role includes setting up and maintaining BIM models, enforcing project standards, and ensuring model accuracy and consistency for MEP, architectural, structural, and construction deliverables. The BIM Coordinator will facilitate clash detection and issue resolution, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and support the production of shop drawings and other project documentation. Daily activities also involve working closely with engineers and designers to optimize model efficiency, preparing progress reports, and contributing to continuous improvement of BIM processes and tools.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong BIM coordination skills, including experience with Revit, Navisworks, and other industry-standard BIM tools.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in model management and quality control, including clash detection, model auditing, and adherence to BIM standards and protocols.
* Candidates should possess practical knowledge of MEP, architectural, and structural systems, with the ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and construction documentation.
* Candidates should possess skills in project collaboration and communication, including coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholder inputs, and documenting issues and resolutions.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to identify and mitigate design and coordination risks.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering / architecture fields, or proven experience in BIM coordination within the AEC industry.
* Experience with LOD development, 4D/5D BIM, and large-scale or international projects will be considered an added advantage.

**Role Overview**
We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.

* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

**What We Require**
***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

title: Specialist, Engineering Services
description:
Being the go-to MEP/CIVIL person
  
  
Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
  
  
Making visions come true
  
  
You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
  
  
While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
  
  
Building strong teams and business reputation
  
  
One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
  
  
Keeping risks at bay
  
  
How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
An MEP/CIVIL pro
  
  
You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
  
  
A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
  
  
You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
  
  
You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
  
  
A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
  
  
Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!

title: Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)
description:
**Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)**
**About The Company**
Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award-winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks. They are a Kochi-based deep-tech company building underwater robots for places people can’t safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are expanding our product portfolio, and we need a hands-on product leader to take the next generation of robots from idea to field-ready product.
  
  
**The role**
You will own the new product development pipeline and report to the CTO. This is not a pure research role, and it is not a sustaining-engineering role for existing products. You will turn emerging customer and mission needs into new, reliable, manufacturable robotic products. You will lead a multi-disciplinary team through concept, prototype, field trials and handover to production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the new-product roadmap with the CTO and CEO, based on customer needs, market gaps and technology feasibility.
* Run new-product programs end to end: requirements, architecture, prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Lead and mentor a multi-disciplinary team across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Run proof-of-concept and prototype cycles quickly, with clear go/no-go gates so that experiments don’t drift into commitments.
* Set up disciplined testing: lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Feed every failure back into the design.
* Keep production handovers clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales and customers on feasibility, estimates and early pilots for new products, and manage scope on custom requests.
* Manage program budgets, vendors, partners and component choices, including obsolescence and single-source risks.
* Contribute to IP creation and protection (patents, design records, documentation).
* Work closely with the existing product, production and field teams so that new products build on proven platforms.

**You might be a fit if you have**

* 8–12 years of experience in engineering and R&D, including 3+ years leading teams or programs.
* Experience at a robotics or drone company (UAV, UGV, marine or other autonomous systems), with new products taken from concept to field deployment.
* Hands-on depth in at least one core discipline (mechanical, electronics, embedded, controls or software) and enough breadth to lead across all of them.
* Experience with prototyping, validation, field trials and the move to manufacturing.
* Familiarity with sensors, navigation, communications and autonomy stacks (a strong plus).
* Exposure to defence, government or other high-reliability product requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, aerospace, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.

**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**

* You have reviewed the current new-product pipeline, team capacity, technical risks and key-person dependencies.
* A prioritised new-product portfolio is agreed, with owners, milestones and go/no-go gates.
* At least one priority program has a validated architecture and a working prototype in test.
* A repeatable prototype-to-field-trial-to-handover process is in place.
* A regular review cadence surfaces risks early for the CTO and leadership.

**What This Role Is Not**
It isn’t research detached from delivery, a role where every design decision runs through you, a pure project coordination role without technical ownership, or a firefighting role for existing products.
  
  
**Why join**
You will build the next generation of robotics for some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders and CTO, and own new products from first sketch to the field.
  
  
**Location**
Kochi, Kerala. Full-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

title: Corporate Innovation Lab Leader
description:
At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time-to-value on federal client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and consultants, building a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Partner with business development and capture teams to shape technical solutions, proposals, and win strategies for federal opportunities.
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI-enabled solutions.

**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.
* Track record of standing up new practice areas or capability centers from the ground up.

**About Reply**
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**
The Senior Associate Engineer is responsible for a full spectrum of assignments related to determining, maintaining, and improving the efficiency, utilization, productivity, and quality of the assigned manufacturing work unit(s). They perform engineering activities ensuring the accomplishments of production, quality, and cost related objectives, and the compliance with Hubbell quality product certifications.
  
  
A Day In The Life
  
  
Every Day At Hubbell Is Different And You’ll Contribute In Many Ways. On Any Given Day, You’ll Make a Difference By
  
  
Receiving, reviewing, and evaluating project requests and planning general activities for project completion.
  
  
Analyzing customer technical requirements and provides recommendations to satisfy their needs which may include generating new products through our NPD system or engineer-to-order (ETO) process to ensure customer application requirements are met.
  
  
Researching and interpreting industry standards and technical information and applying knowledge to satisfy product design inputs and/or maintaining assigned product line(s).
  
  
Designing or developing work as planned, performs simulation tests and analysis, selects materials, and generates product specifications to meet project goals.
  
  
Participating in cross-functional teams to ensure completion of all tasks associated with project requirements.
  
  
Requesting, performing analysis, and evaluating laboratory tests.
  
  
Conducting engineering investigations (such as product failures, customer complaints, variation notices, rejects, and deviations), summarizing findings, preparing & distributing appropriate solutions.
  
  
Initiating drawings orders, engineering changes, sample & prototype requests, purchase requisitions, and other necessary paperwork to complete project assignments and/or maintain assigned product line(s).
  
  
Reporting the status and progress of projects and performing additional duties to complete projects and assignments.
  
  
Interacting with other departmental groups to complete project tasks, such as design for manufacturing (DFM), cost reductions, and internal improvements to ensure design integrity with process improvements.
  
  
Attending trade shows, supplier visits, seminars, industry standard meetings, and conferences as required to support sales and project needs.
  
  
What will help you thrive in this role?
  
  
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering and/or Computer Science or equivalent technical degree or advanced degree; no experience (required)
  
  
**Minimum Of 1-3 Years Relevant Experience (required)**
Must possess strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and strong verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Desired demonstrated knowledge in the interpretation of design, performance, and standards relevant to the electrical industry in the form of product designs released to production in manufacturing settings
  
  
Effective project management skills
  
  
Ability to interact and work effectively to achieve common goals with other departments including supply chain, operations, manufacturing, sales, and marketing

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

* Consult on technical (IFRS) questions coming from reporting units.

* Set up of Attributes, Breakdown Categories, Sub item & sub item categories.
* Set up of hierarchies for FS item, consolidation units/groups and other dimensions.
* Configuration of Balance carry forwards and Currency translation methods.
* Experience in configuring inter-unit eliminations/reclassification and Manual eliminations.
* Purchase / Equity Methods of Consolidation.
* Able to set up Data monitor and Consolidation monitor.
* Experience in “activity-based” consolidation of investments.
* Experience in handling new acquisitions, divestures or any changes to the consolidation group.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* implementing the Consolidation Projects on BPC / BCS / ECCS / BOFC and 2 years on Group Reporting.
* Good understanding on IFRS & local GAAP accounting standards.
* SAP Consolidation experience is must. The candidate must have experience on BPC, SEM-BCS, EC-CS, FI-LC, as well as ECC with a solid accounting and finance background.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Configuration of Balance carry forwards and Currency translation methods.
* Experience in configuring inter-unit eliminations/reclassification and Manual eliminations.

**What We Look For**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant
* Should have more than 3-7 years of relevant experience in managing and implementing the Consolidation Projects on BPC / BCS / ECCS / BOFC and 2 years on Group Reporting.
* Consolidation Assist in monthly, quarterly and annual reporting for Group and its subsidiaries.
* Good understanding on IFRS & local GAAP accounting standards.
* Understand client requirements, provide solutions, functional specifications and configure the group reporting system accordingly.
* Strong configuration hands on experience along with sound functional knowledge in performing the legal consolidation.
* Manage the process for consolidating the submissions entities across the Group to produce a single set of consolidated financial results for the Group.
* Assist in the mentoring and development of graduates within the Group Financial team.
* SAP Consolidation experience is must. The candidate must have experience on BPC, SEM-BCS, EC-CS, FI-LC, as well as ECC with a solid accounting and finance background.
* Knowledge/Hands on experience for configuring various objects in SAP FICO (at least one project).
* Ability to configure SAP S / 4 HANA Group Reporting on premise / cloud and deliver work products / packages meeting the client's standards and requirements.
* Experience in configuring /defining the Following in the S / 4 HANA Group.

The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
* Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
* Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
* Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
* Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.

**Advanced Incident and Problem Management**

* Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
* Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
* Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
* Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.

**Service Reliability and Monitoring**

* Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
* Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
* Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
* Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.

**Device Lifecycle Operations**

* Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
* Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
* Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
* Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management**

* Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
* Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
* Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
* Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.

**Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
* Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
* Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
* Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.

**Technology and Service Environment**
**Area Indicative Environment**
**Meeting-room platforms :**
Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
  
  
**Operations tooling :**
ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
  
  
**Technical domains :**
Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
  
  
**Service practices**
: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
**Required Experience And Knowledge**

* Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
* Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
* Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
* Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
* Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
* Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.

Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Project Manager to oversee home finishing projects from start to finish. This role requires a strong understanding of residential construction, interior design, and finishing techniques, as well as the ability to manage budgets, timelines, and client relationships. The Project Manager will coordinate all aspects of the project, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

- Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.

- Coordinate with internal teams (designers, contractors, suppliers) and external vendors to ensure project goals are achieved.

- Review and assess client specifications, requirements, and expectations.

2. Budget & Cost Management:

- Manage project budgets, track expenses, and ensure projects are delivered within the allocated financial scope.

- Obtain estimates from vendors and contractors, negotiate pricing, and secure the best value.

- Monitor project expenses and handle any necessary adjustments.

3. Team & Resource Management:

- Assign tasks to various teams (e.g., carpenters, painters, electricians, flooring specialists) and ensure proper coordination between all parties.

- Oversee daily operations on the job site and ensure all workers are following safety standards and regulations.

- Resolve conflicts and mitigate any issues that arise during the project lifecycle.

4. Client Communication:

- Serve as the main point of contact for clients throughout the project.

- Provide regular updates on project progress, milestones, and any potential delays.

- Ensure client satisfaction through quality control and timely completion of work.

5. Quality Control & Inspection:

- Monitor the quality of work to ensure it meets company standards and client expectations.

- Conduct site inspections to ensure all home finishing work (e.g., cabinetry, painting, flooring, trim) is completed to high standards.

- Ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and industry standards.

6. Scheduling & Time Management:

- Develop project schedules and track progress against milestones.

- Ensure all tasks are completed on time and coordinate subcontractors to avoid delays.

- Identify potential schedule conflicts and proactively resolve them.

7. Documentation & Reporting:

- Maintain detailed project documentation, including contracts, change orders, progress reports, and inspections.

- Provide regular status reports to senior management and clients.

- Prepare post-project evaluations and performance reviews to improve future projects.

Qualifications:

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field (preferred).

- Technical Skills: Familiarity with project management software (e.g., Procore, Buildertrend, MS Project) and Microsoft Office Suite.

- Problem-Solving: Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to adapt to changes or unforeseen issues on the job site.

- Leadership: Ability to manage and motivate a team of professionals and subcontractors to achieve project goals.

- Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail to ensure quality standards are met and the client’s expectations are exceeded.

The candidate will be responsible for designing comprehensive test strategies, creating high-quality test cases, defining automation approaches, and ensuring end-to-end product quality across the UI, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, security, performance, and infrastructure. The Test Architect will work closely with Product, Development, DevOps, Architecture, and Business teams to establish quality engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy & Architecture Define the overall test strategy, test architecture, and quality engineering framework for full-stack applications.
* Develop test plans covering functional, integration, system, regression, API, database, performance, security, and end-to-end testing.
* Define the appropriate test pyramid and testing levels across UI, API, services, and database layers.
* Establish testing standards, processes, templates, and best practices.
* Identify test risks, dependencies, and quality gaps early in the development lifecycle.
* Test Case Design Analyze business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and technical architecture.
* Create detailed and comprehensive test scenarios and test cases for web applications.
* Develop positive, negative, boundary, exploratory, and edge-case scenarios.
* Ensure complete requirements-to-test-case traceability.
* Web/UI Testing Define testing approaches for modern web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, Vue, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Validate cross-browser and cross-platform behavior.
* Test responsive web applications across different screen sizes and devices.
* Validate usability, accessibility, navigation, forms, workflows, and client-side validations.
* API & Backend Testing Design and execute comprehensive API and service-level test cases.
* Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication, authorization, error handling, and data consistency.
* Test microservices, service-to-service communication, asynchronous workflows, queues, and event-driven architectures.
* Validate backend business logic independently of the UI.
* Database Testing Design test cases for relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Validate data integrity, data transformation, CRUD operations, stored procedures, queries, and transactions.
* Perform backend-to-database and UI-to-database validation.

* Analyze failures, identify product and framework defects, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.

* Define automation strategy, coding standards, review practices, quality metrics, and technical roadmaps.
* Review code, mentor engineers, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide technical leadership within the automation team.
* Collaborate with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation stakeholders to understand requirements and improve testability.
* Translate suitable manual test scenarios into maintainable automated coverage, while documenting justified manual-only coverage and associated risks.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, execution reports, dashboards, traceability, and evidence required for releases.
* Evaluate tools and technologies, lead proof-of-concept activities, and continuously improve automation efficiency, reliability, and coverage.
* Follow secure coding, credential-management, data-protection, and cybersecurity best practices throughout the automation lifecycle.

**Qualifications**
Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in software testing and test automation, with demonstrated delivery in roles primarily focused on automation and supported by hands-on manual testing.
* Demonstrated experience as a core contributor or technical lead for automation solutions supporting cloud-based or web-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, data structures, design patterns, debugging, and source-control practices.
* Practical experience in test design, exploratory testing, defect reporting, regression testing, and release validation, with the ability to determine which scenarios should remain manual and which should be automated.
* Experience working in Agile product-development environments and collaborating with geographically distributed teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* The following skills and experience are mandatory for this role:
* Advanced proficiency in at least one automation-oriented programming language as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with web automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Strong experience in API automation and validation using REST clients, libraries, or frameworks.
* Experience with unit and test frameworks such as PyTest, JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including services, identity, networking, logging, and deployment concepts.
* Experience in integrating automation into CI/CD systems such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Proficiency with Git-based workflows, code reviews, branching strategies, and build pipelines.
* Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Good understanding of web technologies, authentication and authorization mechanisms, certificates, APIs, databases, and distributed-system fundamentals.
* Ability to diagnose failures using logs, traces, monitoring data, and systematic debugging techniques.
* Understanding of secure software-development practices and common cybersecurity concepts relevant to cloud and web applications.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience automating cybersecurity products, security platforms, connected systems, or enterprise software.
* Knowledge of security testing concepts, including vulnerability management, identity and access management, encryption, audit logging, and role-based access control.
* Experience with performance, reliability, resilience, or security-focused automation.
* Experience designing automation for multi-tenant SaaS platforms or microservices-based applications.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Software Development Manager, PV Sports and Linear Tech / Live Events Publishing
description:
**Description**
Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties — including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers.
  
  
We are a team of builders — from new graduates to seasoned architects — who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on.
  
  
**Who Are We**
The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact.
  
  
About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog — enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline
  
  
Define and communicate your team's roadmap and technical strategy to management, principal stakeholders, and partner teams, aligning priorities with customer needs
  
  
Facilitate systems design, architecture, and scaling discussions, making sound trade-offs across reliability, latency, and maintainability for the live sports catalog
  
  
Partner with product management and peer engineering managers to scope work, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality software that improves the live sports viewing experience worldwide
  
  
Champion operational excellence by establishing metrics, monitoring practices, and automation that keep your team's services healthy and your customers well-served
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Prime Video Sports Publishing (LEP) team is the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog — enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device.
  
  
We are a team that values inclusiveness, respect, and mentorship. Our technology choices and designs are driven by engineers, not handed down from above. We have a strong voice in shaping the product, pitching ideas up the chain rather than the other way around.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Engineering Manager (Agent)
description:
**Description**
**Trintech**
is the leader in AI Financial Close Management, helping finance and accounting teams transform the way they work by eliminating manual burdens, strengthening controls, and empowering strategic decision-making.
  
  
We are looking for an
**Engineering Manager**
to lead the
**Agent Stream**
at Trintech’s AI Platform. You will own delivery across multiple Agent Development Squads, each building AI agents that power the Autonomous Financial Close. This is a leadership role that requires equal technical depth and people leadership.
  
  
You are the
**Direct Responsible Individual (DRI)**
for the Agent Stream — when delivery is off track, you own identifying it, communicating it, and resolving it. You work closely with the Software Architect on technical direction, with Product Owners on backlog sequencing, and with the Director of Engineering on stream strategy and hiring. The right person has strong engineering instincts, is comfortable working within a Human-led Agentic SDLC, and has the credibility to lead a team of senior engineers building production-grade AI agent systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Own end-to-end delivery across all Agent Stream squads — sprint cadence, dependency management, release readiness, and cross-squad coordination.
* Be the DRI for Agent Stream outcomes — identify risks early, communicate clearly to the Director of Engineering, and resolve blockers before they affect delivery.
* Partner with the Software Architect on technical direction — ratify architecture decisions and ensure squads build on solid foundations.
* Work with Agent Stream Product Owners to sequence backlog priorities — bring engineering judgement to product trade-off conversations and own the Agent Stream engineering roadmap in alignment with the platform product roadmap.

**People Leadership**

* Hire, onboard, and develop engineers across the Agent Stream — FTEs and contractors, across all seniority levels.
* Build and sustain a high-performance engineering culture. Conduct regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and career development discussions.
* Manage performance proactively — recognise high performers, course-correct early, and make hard calls when needed.
* Foster collaboration across squads and streams — Agent, Platform, Data, and Intelligence streams share dependencies and require active coordination.

**Technical Oversight**

* Maintain sufficient technical depth to engage credibly in architecture reviews, design discussions, and trade-off decisions. Able to step into code when needed — primary mode is technical oversight, not production delivery.
* Review and challenge technical proposals from squad Tech Leads — raise the right questions, identify risks, and validate proposals rather than simply approve them.
* Ensure engineering standards are maintained across squads — code review practices, test coverage, observability standards, and production-readiness gates.
* Stay current on the AI and agent engineering landscape — bring informed perspectives on tooling, practices, and the Human-led Agentic SDLC.

**Who You Are**
**People Leadership & Delivery Ownership — Primary Gate**

* Proven people leadership across multiple squads or teams — hiring, coaching, performance management, and building high-performance engineering culture at scale.
* Delivery ownership with DRI accountability — experience owning stream or programme-level outcomes end-to-end, including risk identification, stakeholder communication, and resolution.

**Technical Depth**

* System design and distributed systems — working knowledge sufficient to review, challenge, and validate architecture decisions made by the Architect and Tech Leads. Not required to design; required to govern.
* Engineering quality governance — managing technical debt, balancing quality against velocity, enforcing definition of done, and ensuring production-readiness gates across squads.
* OAuth 2.0 and one IDP — production experience sufficient to govern security delivery and validate implementation decisions made by the team.
* Programming experience in at least one language, Python preferred — sufficient to step in, review code, and contribute when needed. Not required to be a primary coder.
* Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm — deploy, release, and manage containerised applications in production, including CI/CD pipeline ownership in a cloud-native context.

**Awareness**

* API design and gateway concepts — OpenAPI contracts, versioning, and service boundary decisions sufficient to govern API delivery across squads.
* Event emission and observability standards — what agents emit, how services are traced, and what healthy looks like from a delivery governance lens.
* Multi-tenant SaaS architecture — delivery and governance implications. Security and IAM concepts beyond OAuth sufficient to validate decisions; Platform Architect owns depth.

**Nice to Have**

* Agent and workflow orchestration patterns — cross-agent handover, Temporal, event bus patterns. Learnable on the job; directional awareness is sufficient for this role.
* AI-native SDLC — familiarity with Human-led Agentic SDLC practices and how they differ from traditional software delivery in planning, testing, and release cadence.
* Azure certification demonstrating cloud platform depth. Financial close or R2R domain experience to accelerate ramp-up on the business context the platform serves.

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering | Kubernetes Platform
description:

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Are you passionate about leading teams that operate infrastructure at scale? Do you thrive on overseeing Kubernetes clusters and microservices? Here is an exciting opportunity for you!

  
  

Our team provides Kubernetes platform-as-a-service to other teams building microservices at Salesforce. Over the next year, we will expand our Kubernetes footprint by thousands of clusters, and you could play a pivotal role in this transformation. As a manager, you will guide your team in working with open-source technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo, and Spinnaker, shaping the future of these technologies while fostering a culture of innovation.

We manage one of the largest Kubernetes fleets in the industry and have been early adopters of this technology. Our mission is to empower service owners to focus on the unique value of their services, enhancing developer agility while reducing operational costs and complexity. The FKP team is critical to the company’s strategy to move to Hyperforce, providing the underlying infrastructure for key services such as Sales, Service, Commerce, Mulesoft, and Tableau.

  
  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

As the FKP Manager, you will be responsible for leading the design and implementation of software for managing Kubernetes clusters at scale. Your role will involve:

* Overseeing the creation of design documents and facilitating presentations to stakeholders.
* Managing the integration and evaluation of open-source technologies into the FKP software stack.
* Leading and mentoring a team of engineers, ensuring high-quality deliverables and fostering professional growth.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align goals and strategies.
  

  

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* A related technical degree required
* Proven track record leading software engineering teams with a distinguished track record on technically fast paced projects
* Experience leading large scale distributed systems, working with microservices and/or distributed architecture
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
* Ability to be flexible, proactive, comfortable working with minimal specifications
* Experience with short release cycles, the full software lifecycle, and experience working on a product that’s been released for public consumption
* Experience in hiring, mentoring and leading engineers
* Working experience of software engineering best practices including coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience with Agile development methodologies. Scrum Master experience required
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
  

  

**Preferred Requirements**
--------------------------

* Experience with one or more public cloud substrates e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP
* Experience with container orchestration systems Kubernetes, Docker
* Experience with open source projects like Kubernetes, Karpenter, Argo, Spinnaker, Terraform

**Why Should You Join the FKP Team?**
-------------------------------------

* Opportunity for Impact: Lead initiatives that significantly enhance our platform, positively impacting service teams across Salesforce.
* Innovative Technology: Work with and shape the future of growing open-source technologies like Kubernetes.
* Creative Freedom: Tackle complex issues at scale within distributed systems.
* Thought Leadership: Opportunity to write blogs and share the team’s success stories at conferences and open-source forums, such as:How Salesforce uses ArgoWorkflows for provisioning add-onsOperationalizing Kubernetes Sidecars in Production at SalesforceManaging Kubernetes Multitenant Clusters in Public Cloud at ScaleDeveloping a Synthetic Testing Framework for Continuous Monitoring of Kubernetes Mutating Webhooks

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, strategists, designers, solution architects, other product owners, and developers with an emphasis on strengthening the client centric service delivery for the related business areas, within the context of best practices in enterprise architecture, modern sourcing techniques, modular design of solutions, and appropriate integration of IT services and platforms.

* Develop product KPIs that are measurable, actionable, and aligned with business goals and users’ objectives.
* Actively monitor client needs, industry trends, Bank priorities, KPIs, and user feedback.

* Strong understanding of business goals and the ability to translate them into product requirements.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in developing and operationalizing product strategies and managing the full product lifecycle.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and strong understanding of Agile planning tracking tools such as Azure DevOps.
* Proven track record of successfully developing and launching technology products in large-scale environments.
* Solid understanding of IT development lifecycles and methodologies.
* Proven ability to collaborate with other team members across boundaries and contribute productively to the team's work and output, demonstrating respect for different points of view.
* Able to use strong interpersonal and teamwork skills to cultivate effective and productive relationships and partnerships across organizational boundaries.
* Proven ability to define and track key performance indicators relevant to the product and the business goals.
