title: Senior Java Lead Engineer
description:
Business / Organization Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and visionary
**Java Technical Lead (C12)**
to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards.
* Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance).

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery
  
  

* Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs.
* Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using Apache Kafka and IBM MQ / JMS.
* Architect and tune high-volume data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL document stores (MongoDB).
* Drive containerization and deployment strategies targeting modern enterprise cloud platforms (ECS / Red Hat OpenShift).

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship
  
  

* Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce unit/integration test coverage standards, and eliminate technical debt.
* Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks.

Agile & DevOps Collaboration
  
  

* Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity.

**Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies**

* Core Java & Frameworks: Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning.
* Spring Ecosystem: Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* API & Integration: Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns.
* Messaging & Event Streaming: Strong hands-on implementation experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (IBM MQ / JMS).
* Database Engineering: Relational: Oracle DB (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: MongoDB (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning).
* Design Patterns & Clean Code: Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns.

Secondary Skills & Familiarity (Highly Desirable)
  
  

* Containerization & Platforms: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as ECS / Red Hat OpenShift.
* Frontend / Full-Stack Exposure: Familiarity with modern frontend development using Angular, React JS.
* Business Process Management: Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM.
* Application Servers & Middleware: Understanding of legacy or hybrid runtime environments including IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS / Liberty).
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk).

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a proven track record of resolving complex distributed systems challenges.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business partners.
* Ownership & Drive: Demonstrated ability to independently lead engineering initiatives from ideation to production rollout.
* Collaboration: High team spirit and emotional intelligence to work across globally distributed engineering teams.

description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Business / Organization Overview**
------------------------------------

We are seeking an experienced and visionary **Java Technical Lead (C12)** to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms.

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery.

------------------------

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards.
* Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance).

**Hands-on Engineering & Delivery**
-----------------------------------

* Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using **Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs**.

**Engineering Excellence & Mentorship**
---------------------------------------

* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks.

**Agile & DevOps Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments.

* **10+ years** of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity.

----------------------------------------

* **Core Java & Frameworks:** Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning.
* **Spring Ecosystem:** Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* **API & Integration:** Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns.

* **Design Patterns & Clean Code:** Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns.

* **Containerization & Platforms:** Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as **ECS / Red Hat OpenShift**.

* **Business Process Management:** Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as **IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM**.

* **CI/CD & DevOps:** Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk).

----------------------------------------

* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.

**AI & Gen AI Enablement**

* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem-solving.

* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.

**Agile, DevSecOps & Release Governance**

* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.

* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.

* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.

**Stakeholder & Executive Communication**

* Provide clear, concise, and data-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business-relevant insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 14+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.

**Preferred Technical Capabilities**

* Prior hands-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.

**AI Platform Expectations**
The candidate should be hands-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
  
  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.

title: Lead, Tech (QTE)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a Lead, Tech to join the Quality and Test Engineering group based in the firm’s office in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The Quality and Test Engineering (QTE) team manages the entire firm’s quality mandate and delivers quality product releases with deep integration in the software development cycle, focusing on functional correctness, scalability, and performance. Our prime motivation is to mature the software development cycle by bringing robust test-engineering practices, automation, tooling, and quality product releases.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this position, you will be responsible for developing automation tools/frameworks, understanding the domain, testing and automating complex projects, managing and mentoring a small group of test engineers, and driving innovation by improving on or introducing new tools/processes to improve efficiency and quality. Additionally, you will also collaborate closely with our business domain from a testing perspective. This includes involvement with various asset classes that the firm trades in, working with our state-of-the-art trading systems, exchange connectivity, pricing/forecasting models, and ensuring that our business-critical processes and workflows function exactly as intended. To elaborate further, you will focus on productivity through automation and tooling, developing end-to-end functional and integration test-case scenarios with an exceptional emphasis on the business domain, owning end-to-end QTE processes, and release planning. Furthermore, you will also have to exhibit leadership in test-case development, coordinate test-plan reviews, and generate repeatable test procedures.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* 6 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* The ability to rapidly learn complex domains and model workflows; translate requirements into test strategy
* Experience in building and improving test processes with an increased focus on business context
* Experience validating distributed/microservices systems and event driven workflows
* Experience working with a high-level, object-oriented programming language like Java/C++
* Exposure to scripting languages like Bash/Python
* Knowledge of unit testing frameworks like jUnit, TestNG, and API test automation
* Exposure to UI stacks like React/Redux
* Working experience in UNIX or one of its flavors
* Familiarity with performance/reliability testing and basic observability

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Linkedin/LeasTechSDEMay24
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Release Manager to manage end-to-end software release planning, coordination, scheduling, deployment, and governance. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Release Management, Change Management, ITIL processes, and coordination across Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Business teams to ensure smooth and reliable production releases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle, from planning and scheduling to deployment and post-release validation.
* Develop and maintain release calendars, deployment plans, release notes, checklists, and implementation documentation.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Business teams to ensure release readiness.
* Manage change requests, conduct impact and risk assessments, and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
* Coordinate Go/No-Go meetings and obtain the necessary approvals before production deployments.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, release governance, organizational policies, and compliance requirements.
* Track release dependencies, risks, issues, milestones, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate production deployments, rollback plans, hotfixes, emergency releases, and post-release validation.
* Monitor release KPIs, including deployment success rate, change failure rate, rollback frequency, and on-time delivery.
* Manage release communications and provide timely updates to stakeholders and senior management.
* Conduct post-release reviews and drive continuous improvement in release processes.
* Support incident reviews and root cause analysis related to release failures or production issues.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in IT, with significant hands-on experience in Release Management.
* Strong knowledge of end-to-end release planning, deployment coordination, and release governance.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, particularly Release, Change, Incident, and Problem Management.
* Experience managing CAB meetings, change approvals, release readiness, and Go/No-Go decisions.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and risk management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple releases, competing priorities, and tight deployment timelines.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in enterprise IT environments.

3+ years of experience

* Hands-on technical experience with building enterprise-scale SaaS products, preferably around Identity and Access Management.
* Very strong software engineering – design, development experience.
* Proven track record to grow and manage an engineering team of 10+ with an ability to provide leadership vision for further expansion.
* Deep understanding of Agile development practices and other engineering processes.
* Hands-on technical knowledge of Software Security, Multi-tenancy, Scalability, and High Availability.

* Proficient in Python/Go/Node/Ruby/Java (spring boot, spring batch)/C# (.Net Core)/C++. Experience with modern CI/CD tools is preferable.
* Proficient and seasoned in handling SCRUM teams involving Devs and QA.
* Prior experience with driving continuous improvement and the ability to implement creative ideas to significantly improve the overall performance of the team.
* Experience working at a high growth, fast-paced technology company.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, UnifiedAuth
description:
**Description**
Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
  
  
You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
  
  
As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.
  
  
**About The Team**
Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

* Strong backend development experience in C# and .NET (ASP.NET, WebAPI, MVC) including API design and service patterns.

* Azure certifications and/or Microsoft certifications.
* Experience with event-based and distributed systems including messaging and asynchronous workflows.
* Data and persistence experience with SQL Server and ORMs (Entity Framework, Hibernate) plus caching strategies.
* Strong testing discipline including TDD and BDD, xUnit, Jest or Mocha, CI/CD automation, and quality gates.
* Experience building analytics and reporting with BI and data visualization tools and domain-specific reporting.
* Exposure to mobile ecosystems (iOS and Android) and API design supporting mobile clients.
* Experience with prompt engineering patterns, RAG architectures, vector databases, or AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Services).
* Familiarity with AI code generation and review workflows, including evaluating and curating AI-generated code for production readiness.
* Experience contributing to or building AI-augmented internal tools, developer experience tooling, or intelligent automation within engineering workflows.

Technical Skills We Value
  
  

* Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SPA architecture, performance and accessibility
* Backend: C#, ASP.NET, WebAPI, RESTful design, authentication and authorization patterns
* Cloud: Azure PaaS services, observability, secure networking, identity, deployment automation
* Engineering practices: Git-based workflows, secure SDLC, spec-driven development, AI-assisted code reviews, automated testing, documentation
* AI-enabled delivery: agentic development using Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents; spec-driven development workflows; prompt engineering; LLM API integration; RAG patterns; AI orchestration frameworks; responsible AI practices and observability

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Delivers complex features end-to-end with high quality, predictable timelines, and production readiness.
* Produces clean, maintainable code—whether hand-written or AI-generated—with strong test coverage and clear documentation.
* Identifies and resolves performance, reliability, and security issues before they reach production.
* Contributes meaningfully to architecture and raises standards through code reviews and technical leadership.
* Communicates clearly, flags risks early, and collaborates effectively across teams.
* Effectively leverages agentic development tools and AI-augmented workflows to increase velocity while maintaining quality and security standards.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required.
* Master’s degree preferred.

This is an opportunity to work on an innovative money movement platform while building reliable, scalable, and advanced solutions to help our clients take ownership of their financial futures. The Scrum Master will provide effective collaboration, coordination, facilitation, leadership, and coaching skills supporting the agile development process and delivery of our applications. As an agile expert, the Scrum Master will be responsible for enforcing the agile tenants as interpreted by our team, removing impediments, and promoting empowerment. The Scrum Master position is highly responsible and accountable and will challenge the teams and strive to improve agile best practices. This position requires technical understanding of software development and technology and experience with complex project coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

Act as a Scrum Master for 1-2 Agile teams simultaneously.
  
Provide leadership, direction and coaching to the team by encouraging them to adopt and mature good Scrum processes according to the Scrum Guide.
  
Create an environment whereby the team is motivated, self-organizing and self-sufficient.
  
Organize and facilitate effective Scrum meetings: backlog grooming, Sprint planning, daily Scrum, Sprint review, and Sprint retrospective.
  
Encourage your teams to routinely inspect and adapt.
  
Assist the team in establishing a consistent and predictable team level cadence (predictable velocity)
  
Identify and facilitate the removal of team impediments and escalate as appropriate.
  
Work with and coach Product Owners to develop, manage, and continuously groom the team’s product backlog.
  
In partnership with the Product Owner, track and communicate to Stakeholders information such as team velocity, Sprint/release progress, impediments, team successes, etc.
  
In coordination with Project Managers, facilitate cross-team coordination and collaboration when projects require it.
  
Assist Product Owners and Project Managers with planning and grooming activities.
  
Be a servant leader where you receive as much satisfaction from facilitating others’ success as your own.
  
Foster an environment where creativity and empowerment can flourish.
  
Improve the team’s engineering practices and tools as needed to help them succeed.

**Required Qualification-**

Servant Leadership – Able to garner respect from your teams, lead and demonstrate value-add principles, and willing and able to get your hands dirty to get the job done.
  
Communicative and social skills – Able to communicate well with your Teams.
  
Working experience with Schwab systems and processes
  
Enthusiasm and high-energy.
  
Continual improvement - Constantly learning new tools and techniques to grow your craft, yourself, and your Teams.
  
Attitude of transparency – Desire and ability to bring disclosure and transparency to the business about development and grow trust between the business and development.
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related field, or related experience.
  
Fully educated and conversant on the Scrum process according to the Scrum Guide.
  
A thorough understanding and appreciation for Agile values and principles.
  
Thorough understanding of:
  
Backlog grooming and relative estimating.
  
Release planning.
  
Sprint planning
  
Scrum metrics such as Sprint burndown, release burnup, & velocity, to name a few
  
Sprint review best practices and techniques
  
A variety of retrospective techniques
  
Prior experience as a Scrum Master.
  
5+ years of experience in a software development environment preferably involving cross-team dependencies.
  
5+ years of experience owning and managing customer expectations, project schedules, status and reporting and change management.
  
Have led teams in a large, complex enterprise environment where successful projects potentially involve more than 1 Scrum team.
  
Ability to a wide variety of patterns and techniques to enable the team to achieve success.
  
Knowledge of project management fundamentals.
  
Conflict resolution: Able to facilitate discussion of issues and different approaches and alternatives and effectively resolve issues in a timely manner. Facilitate: Able to lead and demonstrate value-add principles to a team.
  
Assertive: Able to ensure Agile and Scrum concepts and principles are adhered to, be a voice of reason and authority, and make the tough calls.
  
Situationally aware: Be the first to notice differences and issues as they arise and elevate them as appropriate.
  
Attitude of empowerment: Able to lead a team to self-organization.
  
Strong grasp of software development and technology.

**Preferred Qualification**

Scrum Master certification.
  
Experience with SAFe Agile frameworks.
  
DevOps experience: continuous integration, continuous build, continuous delivery tools and techniques.
  
ATDD, BDD, TDD, and pair programming, and other eXtreme Programming (XP) practices.
  
Prior experience using Jira.
  
Experience working in a highly regulated environment.
  
Experience working in a financial services organization.
  
Previous Schwab experience.

  

**What’s in it for you**

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, AIA Activation to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI & Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant team.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's in technology / bachelor's in science in a related field is required; Preferably in Business, Finance, Economics, Applied Math or related fields with quantitative training
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5-6 Years
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross-functional D&T teams.
* Technical Skillset - AI / Automation Activation, Adoption & Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization,
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy·
* Strong understanding of AI and automation activation in at least one business or functional domain.
* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.
* Creates stories and translates needs into executable work.
* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.
* Supports creation and management of feature or activation roadmaps with manager guidance
* Demonstrates learning agility and applies new ideas to improve work
* Adopts and scales practical innovations that improve AI activation and business adoption
* Contributes to playbooks, standards, and ways of working across the activation community.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience with GenAI and LLM-enabled workflows is preferred.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Engineering Manager – Platform Engineering
description:

Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. **Position Summary**
The Engineering Manager will lead the India engineering team building PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform. This is a hands-on role: you will balance day-to-day delivery and people management with real technical involvement — reviewing designs and code, and unblocking engineers — while working closely with the Lead Architect / Product Owner to turn technical designs and JIRA backlogs into shipped, quality-tested increments. You will also grow a high-performing engineering team.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers delivering PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform
* Own day-to-day engineering delivery: sprint planning, work breakdown, estimation, and tracking progress against roadmap commitments in partnership with the Product Owner and architecture team
* Stay hands-on — review designs, participate in architecture discussions, read and review code, and unblock engineers on FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, and RKE2/OpenShift deployment issues
* Translate technical design documents and JIRA stories into clear, sequenced execution plans for the India engineering team
* Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers; run performance conversations, set growth plans, and build a strong engineering culture within the team
* Coordinate closely with the external development vendor and internal architecture leadership to align delivery timelines, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain quality standards
* Drive engineering best practices: code review discipline, CI/CD hygiene, test coverage, and consistent frontend routing and coding standards across the team
* Partner with QA to plan release readiness, support UAT cycles, and ensure milestone sign-off criteria are met before delivery
* Manage risk and dependency tracking across concurrent workstreams (Model Deployment, Observability & Metrics, Secrets Management, GPU Quota/Billing) and escalate blockers early
* Contribute to technical decision-making on multi-tenant isolation, GPU resource quota enforcement, and identity/SSO federation as the platform evolves
* Report on team velocity, delivery risk, and capacity to the Lead Architect / Product Owner and other stakeholders

**Basic Qualifications**

* Education: B.E / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline
* Experience: 10-15 years in software engineering, with at least 2-3 years in a engineering manager/ tech-lead capacity leading a team of 5-10 engineers
* Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in at least one backend stack (Python/FastAPI or equivalent) and one frontend stack (React or equivalent), with the ability to review code and unblock engineers directly
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes-native application development and deployment (RKE2, OpenShift, or vanilla K8s)
* Experience managing delivery for complex, multi-service platforms (preferably virtualisation and control planes)
* Well versed with Agile methodology including sprint planning, estimation, prioritisation, governance and reporting
* Proven experience hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, including performance management
* Comfort working across India/US team structures and coordinating with external delivery vendors or partners
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical design detail and delivery status for architecture and product stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GPU-based infrastructure management and control platform, AI/ML inference platforms, or LLM serving stacks will be an solid added advantage
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, RBAC models, and quota/billing systems will be an added advantage
* Experience with PostgreSQL schema-per-service architectures and event-driven or workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n) will be an added advantage
* Exposure to Prometheus/Grafana-based observability stacks will be an added advantage
* Prior experience managing or coordinating with offshore/nearshore development vendors will be an added advantage
* Certifications such as CKA/CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes credentials are a plus

**Why Gruve**
At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Scrum Master_2940

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Development Team Manager to lead our Active Integration R&D team in Pune. Your mission is to build and manage a high-performing team of engineers—including UI/UX & AI experts, Cloud Lead Developers, and Teamcenter specialists—to deliver the next generation of Siemens Xcelerator solutions.
  
  
The Active Integration platform features smart and ready to use gateways for SAP Business Suite, Oracle EBS, Opcenter, Product Cost Management and other Enterprise Applications.
  
  
As the Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a highly multi-functional, agile team comprising both local and external/contractor developers. In this role, you will act as a key bridge, collaborating closely with Product Management and the Software Operations team to orchestrate seamless software delivery. You will cultivate a collaborative culture that balances operational excellence with rapid innovation, ensuring our engineering efforts align directly with business and product objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management & Leadership: Partner closely with the Software Engineering Manager to supervise, hire, train, appraise, reward, motivate, and discipline engineering staff, including recommending termination when necessary.
* Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Act as the technical lead and mentor for junior engineers, offering high-level technical expertise, problem resolution, and leadership to the development group.
* System Design & Architecture: Create, document, and implement robust software designs, which includes spearheading the significant re-architecting of critical internal systems.
* Drive the adoption of AI-based development approaches within the team, ensuring AI is used as a core competency to accelerate engineering productivity.
* Functional Quality Assurance: Be responsible for and ensure the overall functional quality of all released software products, focusing on high-quality, on-time delivery that exceeds customer expectations.
* Product Direction & Innovation: Influence the technical roadmap for a specific product area and actively promote innovation by introducing new technologies and advanced knowledge to the team and product.
* Complex Programming & Analysis: Perform in-depth, highly complex software systems programming and analysis, working independently with complete latitude for judgment on advanced projects.
* Customer Collaboration & Advisory: Regularly collaborate with customers regarding future product upgrades, using a broad knowledge of internal operating systems, application implications, and customer environments.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the development process, driving permanent corrective actions and operational efficiency.

* Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.
* Experience:

+ 15+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management, leading R&D teams, or directing technical organizations.
+ 8+ years of Hands-on experience in C++/Full Stack/Cloud/AI Technologies
+ Demonstrated professional experience with Teamcenter is required.
+ Proven experience scaling enterprise-level software ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale digital transformation environments.
+ Enterprise Data & Migration Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on or leadership experience architecting and delivering large-scale data migration initiatives, enterprise data integration pipelines, and modern data lake / data warehouse architectures across heterogeneous systems (e.g., migrating legacy ERP/PLM data stores to cloud data platforms).

* Demonstrated success managing and orchestrating multi-functional, cross-cultural teams across international time zones (e.g., Europe and India).
* AI, Data Lakes & Analytics Mastery:

+ Strong conceptual and practical understanding of AI/ML ecosystems (LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and AI tooling).
+ Deep proficiency in enterprise data management, including structuring and querying data lakes, managing massive data migration projects, and establishing reliable ETL/ELT pipelines.

* Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization/orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) crucial for modern AIG infrastructure.
* Extensive experience with complex system integrations (Siemens Active Integration, SAP, PLM/ERP systems, event-driven architectures, and API gateways).
* Mastery of Agile methodologies, software lifecycle (SLC) governance, quality assurance, and fostering developer productivity through modern AI-assisted coding tools.
* Exceptional communication skills; ability to align executive leadership, product management, and hands-on engineering teams around a unified AI-first vision.

**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

NA

15-year full-time education is required.

title: Associate, Creative Producer
description:
**Who we are:**

Roundglass is a wholistic wellbeing company working to empower healthier lives, stronger communities, and a more sustainable world. That w in wholistic is intentional: We believe true wellbeing spans the whole human experience, from how we care for ourselves to our connections with others and the planet.

This philosophy shapes both what we build and how we work. We’ve created an environment where supporting people’s whole selves fuels their most meaningful work.

Roundglass creates real-world impact through two core pillars:

Roundglass Giving is our nonprofit arm that drives philanthropic work in youth development, women's equity, and environmental sustainability. Our mission is to transform communities by tackling systemic challenges and unlocking human potential through Roundglass Sports, Roundglass Sustain, the Roundglass Foundation, and the Global India Institute (GIC). These efforts have reached millions of people, creating scalable models of community-led change.

Through the Roundglass Living platform, we deliver personalized wellbeing guidance rooted in science. The Roundglass Living app helps people develop habits that last through breathwork, meditation, movement, nutrition, music, and more.

We built Roundglass on the belief that people thrive when they’re supported wholistically, and we apply this philosophy to how we work together as a team. If you're passionate about transforming communities and creating systemic change and want to contribute to a culture that embodies the impact we're creating, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**

Roundglass Creative Studio is looking for a detail-oriented Associate with a strong interest in non-fiction storytelling, a grounding in documentary research and production processes, and the ability to work confidently in fast-paced, real-world environments.

The ideal candidate will work closely with the Creative Lead and support the development and production of films across the Studio. The role involves coordinating with internal teams, programme teams, community members, contributors, and external production crews through every stage of the filmmaking process — from story discovery, research and validation to pre-production, field shoots, post-production, and final delivery.

We are looking for someone who understands that a strong documentary film begins long before the camera starts rolling. It requires curiosity, thorough research, careful validation, an understanding of context, and detailed preparation. It means finding the layers within a story - understanding not only what happened, but why it matters, whose perspective needs to be represented, and what will make the story meaningful to an audience.

The role requires someone who is comfortable going across Punjab, comfortable meeting people and communities, listening closely, and asking the right questions. The candidate should be able to observe and identify the impact of different programmes and help translate that into strong, research-backed pre-production material.

The Associate will help ensure that research, contributors, production requirements, references, footage, feedback, and post-production workflows are organized and followed through carefully.

**What you’ll do:**

**End-to-End Project Coordination | Development to Post-Production**

* Conduct in-depth online and field research to support story discovery, development, and validation.
* Support the Creative Lead in identifying strong case studies and contributors and ensuring that research and narrative choices remain aligned with the film’s creative objective.
* Develop and organise research notes, contributor profiles, beat sheets, step outlines, visual references, and shot breakdowns in line with the creative direction.
* Coordinate with writers on scripts, revisions, feedback, and timely submissions.
* Support pre-production planning and crew coordination, ensuring clarity and alignment on schedules, requirements, deliverables, and expectations across departments.
* Coordinate closely with internal programme teams, contributors, communities, and external production partners to ensure information and production requirements are communicated accurately and on time.
* Across all productions, ensure adherence to Roundglass standards, design guidelines, science and factual accuracy, safety protocols, compliances, and ethical storytelling practices.

**On-Ground Shoot Coordination**

* Act as a key bridge between the creative team, production crew, programme teams, and contributors during shoots.
* Help ensure contributors, locations, scenes, and production requirements are ready and coordinated according to the shooting plan.
* Track shot sequences and coverage requirements, helping the team stay aligned with the creative brief while responding to the realities of the field.
* Maintain detailed shoot logs, contributor notes, coverage records, and production documentation to ensure continuity from production into post-production.
* Manage on-ground flow and troubleshoot coordination challenges as they arise, supporting the crew in making informed decisions within real-time constraints.

**Post-Production Support**

* Work closely with the post-production team to ensure that creative briefs, footage, research, contributor context, and production notes are clearly organised and handed over.
* Provide editorial support through shoot logs, story notes, contributor and character context, transcripts, research material, and visual references.
* Coordinate across different stages of post-production, including editing, graphics, sound, colour, reviews, feedback, and final delivery, as required.
* Track post-production schedules, review rounds, feedback, approval gateways, and deliverables to ensure projects move efficiently through each stage.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between creative, programme, and external teams, ensuring feedback is consolidated, communicated clearly, and followed through.
* Maintain organised project documentation and ensure that final masters, project files, assets, and supporting material are properly managed, handed over and archived.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in documentary or non-fiction filmmaking as Researcher, Assistant Director or in a related role.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling and narrative structures.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills– ability to navigate ground realities and communicate across departments and communities.
* Fluency in English (spoken and written).Conversational Hindi and Punjabi.
* Willingness to travel and work on location in rural and semi-urban areas of Punjab.
* Prior experience in filmmaking, being on the set, scheduling, field research and production management is a must.
