title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG**
is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day in the life:**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.
  
  

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.
  
  

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.
  
  

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

#FCMIN
  
  
**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**
FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
  
  
**Market Aligned remuneration structure**
and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
  
  
**Wellbeing Focus**
- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
  
  
**Paternity Leave:**
We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
  
  
**Travel perks**
: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
  
  
**A career, not a job**
: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
  
  
**Reward & Recognition**
: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  
  
**Love for travel**
: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  
  
**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
  
  
As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
  
  
We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
**Brightness of Future.**
We encourage you to
**DREAM BIG**
through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
  
  
**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

description:

As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership to improve testing processes, tools and methodologies. title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**
The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Backend Architecture and Hands-on Development: - Own the design and development of Ripik's backend platform built on Java 21+ and Spring Boot 4 x, including RESTful and gRPC APIs, microservices decomposition, event-driven pipelines, and integration layers that connect AI inference engines with factory-floor systems. - Architect for scale, reliability, and low latency: design services that handle high-throughput streams from industrial IoT sensors and vision cameras, process them through message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and persist results across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and time-series stores (TimescaleDB / InfluxDB). - Make key technology and design decisions: Spring Security and OAuth 2.0 / JWT for multi-tenant authentication, Spring Data for repository abstractions, Spring Cloud for service discovery and configuration, and Hibernate / JPA for ORM while keeping the codebase clean, testable, and well-documented. - Drive API design standards (OpenAPI / Swagger), enforce contract-first development, and ensure backend services expose well-versioned, idempotent, and backward-compatible interfaces consumed by the frontend and external integrations. - Champion production engineering: build observability into every service with structured logging (ELK/Loki), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger), metrics (Prometheus/Grafana), and own SLAs and incident response for the backend stack. Full-Stack Product Delivery: - Lead end-to-end product builds from the ground up, translate product requirements into technical architecture, break them into epics and stories, and ship complete features spanning backend APIs, database schemas, and frontend UIs. - Collaborate closely with frontend engineers building operator dashboards and configuration portals (React/Next.js, TypeScript) to review UI/UX implementation, ensure performant API integration, and maintain a cohesive full-stack development workflow. - Own the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes on AWS / Azure / GCP), automate testing (unit, integration, E2E), and enforce quality gates so that every merge to main is production-ready. - Coordinate with the AI/Data Science teams to integrate ML model outputs (computer vision inferences, LLM responses) into the platform, designing the serving layer, result-caching strategy, and feedback loops that connect model predictions with user-facing features. - Manage cloud infrastructure decisions across Ripik's multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises installations at customer factory sites, balancing cost, compliance, and latency requirements. Team Leadership and Scrum Management: - Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of backend and frontend engineers; set clear expectations, conduct regular 1:1s, drive career development, and foster a culture of ownership and technical excellence. - Run Scrum ceremonies end-to-end: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring the team delivers predictably while staying agile enough to respond to shifting priorities in a fast-moving start-up. - Conduct thorough code reviews and architecture reviews; enforce engineering best practices around testing (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers), code quality (SonarQube), and secure coding standards. - Hire and onboard strong engineers; raise the technical bar continuously through pairing, tech talks, design-document culture, and a bias toward building reusable, well-abstracted components. - Act as the primary engineering interface with Product, Design, AI, Field Engineering, and Customer - Success translating business needs into well-scoped engineering work and communicating trade-offs, timelines, and risks transparently to leadership. Requirements: - B. Tech / M. Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. - 6-10 years of total software engineering experience with a strong backend focus, of which at least 2 years in a tech lead, engineering lead, or engineering manager role. - Deep hands-on expertise in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot 3 x / 4 x, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, and Spring WebFlux (reactive)). Ability to write production-grade code, not just review it. - Strong experience designing and building microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, event-driven systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and database layers (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis). - Proven track record of building applications from the ground up, greenfield product development in a SaaS or product-company context, and taking features from whiteboard to production. - Experience leading and managing teams of both backend and frontend engineers, comfortable reviewing React/TypeScript code, guiding frontend architecture decisions, and maintaining full-stack delivery velocity. - Hands-on experience running Scrum / Agile processes: sprint planning, backlog management, velocity tracking, and retrospectives with a practical, outcome-driven approach (not ceremony for ceremony's sake). - Strong DevOps and deployment experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins), and at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure / GCP also valued). - Solid understanding of system design fundamentals: caching strategies, load balancing, rate limiting, database indexing, horizontal scaling, and high-availability patterns. - Experience in a high-growth start-up or similarly fast-paced environment where shipping speed, scrappiness, and wearing multiple hats are the norm. - Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical trade-offs to product and business stakeholders, write clear RFCs and design documents, and present to leadership. Company Summary We are building an AI platform to make manufacturing more competitive. We enable the shop-floor managers and plant teams to take better decisions via an AI-ML-based DIY platform where they can run analytics and get recommendations. Our beta product is life at several leading Indian companies. We are the provider of an AI-based platform for production analytics. We transform how people operate factories across the world. Our mission is to make manufacturing operations more efficient, productive, and sustainable. We build deep tech solutions such as digital twin which are easy to use. Our solutions have helped clients improve their throughput, quality, yield, and energy efficiency. Our products deliver real value - moving KPIs that matter in manufacturing and industrial companies. Why Join Us

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Gurugram/Noida.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance & optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance & optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance & optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.

* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

title: Engineering Manager (UI)
description:
**UI Lead/Engineering Manager**

**Company: Unicommerce**

**Function: Engineering / Technology**

**Experience: 7–12 years**

**Core Technology: Angular/React, TypeScript, JavaScript**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on UI Lead to drive frontend engineering across UniCommerce’s product ecosystem. The role involves leading the development of scalable, high-performance, and maintainable user interfaces for complex e-commerce and SaaS products.

**The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Angular/React, strong frontend architecture capabilities, and proven experience leading engineers. You will work closely with Product, Backend Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into reliable, scalable, and intuitive frontend solutions.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Frontend Architecture & Engineering**

\* Lead the design and development of scalable frontend applications using Angular/React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

\* Define frontend architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and best practices across products.

\* Build modular, maintainable applications using Angular modules, components, services, routing, and reactive programming patterns.

\* Drive the adoption of appropriate state management solutions such as NgRx or RxJS-based patterns.

**2. Technical Leadership**

\* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of frontend engineers.

\* Conduct code reviews, establish engineering standards, and ensure adherence to best practices.

\* Own technical decisions, conduct design reviews, and resolve complex frontend engineering challenges.

\* Promote clean code, testability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.

**3. Performance & Scalability**

\* Optimise application performance, load times, rendering, and responsiveness across complex product workflows.

\* Identify and resolve frontend bottlenecks, memory leaks, and performance issues.

\* Ensure applications work reliably across browsers, devices, and different screen sizes.

\* Drive accessibility, usability, and frontend security best practices.

**4. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

\* Partner with Product Managers, Backend Engineers, QA, and UX teams to deliver end-to-end product features.

\* Translate business requirements into technical solutions and implementation plans.

\* Work with REST APIs and backend services to deliver seamless product integrations.

\* Contribute to sprint planning, effort estimation, technical documentation, and release readiness.

**5. Engineering Excellence**

\* Establish unit testing, integration testing, and frontend quality standards using tools such as Jasmine, Karma, or Jest, as appropriate.

\* Improve build pipelines, CI/CD processes, and frontend release practices.

\* Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and engineering approaches that improve developer productivity.

\* Drive technical debt reduction and ensure long-term sustainability of the frontend codebase.

**Required Skills & Experience**

\* 7–12 years of experience in frontend development, with substantial hands-on experience in Angular.

\* Strong proficiency in Angular/React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development.

\* Deep understanding of Angular architecture, component lifecycle, dependency injection, RxJS, routing, forms, and reusable component design.

\* Experience building and maintaining large-scale, enterprise-grade web applications.

\* Experience with state management, API integration, frontend performance optimisation, and browser debugging.

\* Familiarity with Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern frontend build tools.

\* Proven experience mentoring engineers, reviewing code, and leading technical delivery.

\* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance architectural quality with product delivery timelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

\* Experience working on SaaS, e-commerce, order management, inventory management, warehouse management, or supply-chain technology products.

\* Exposure to micro-frontend architecture and shared component libraries.

\* Experience with design systems, accessibility standards, and frontend security.

\* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and cross-functional product engineering.

**Success Measures**

\* Scalable and maintainable Angular architecture across product modules.

\* Improved frontend performance, reliability, and code quality.

\* Predictable delivery of product features with reduced production defects.

\* Effective mentoring and improved productivity of the frontend engineering team.

\* Reduced technical debt and increased reuse of frontend components.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A hands-on Angular/React expert who combines strong frontend architecture with people leadership, takes ownership of engineering quality, and can scale complex enterprise product interfaces without compromising performance or maintainability.

title: Founder's Office - Fulfillment Lead
description:
Every company knows how to generate pipelines. Very few know how to deliver consistently at scale.

At SalesMonk, we're building AI-native GTM systems that help customers turn events and outbound into predictable revenue. As we grow, the biggest challenge isn't shipping more work- it's building the operating system that ensures every customer engagement is executed consistently, efficiently, and repeatedly.

That's where this role comes in.

**Why This Role Exists**

Today, our delivery works because smart people are solving problems every day.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

We're looking for someone who can build the processes, operating rhythms, and delivery playbooks that allow us to scale without adding operational chaos.

This isn't a project management role, this is a systems-building role.

You'll work directly with the founders to create the delivery engine that supports the next stage of the company.

**What You Will Own**

**Build the Delivery Operating System**

Design how delivery should work- from customer kickoff to successful execution.

Build repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, governance, and playbooks that reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

Own delivery health across all customer engagements.

Identify bottlenecks, eliminate operational friction, and continuously improve execution quality.

Ensure delivery standards remain high as the team scales.

**Cross-functional Execution**

Work closely with Product, GTM Engineers, Customer Success, and the founders to ensure priorities move quickly.

Bring structure, accountability, and visibility across teams.

**Process & Automation**

Identify manual workflows that should be standardized or automated.

Help build scalable systems that improve speed, quality, and consistency.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Define what great delivery looks like.

Build dashboards and operating metrics around delivery quality, turnaround time, customer outcomes, and execution efficiency.

Use data to continuously improve the way we operate.

**What We're Looking For**

* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 3-4 years of post-MBA experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Transformation, or Operations Consulting.
* Experience designing operating models, improving business processes, or leading transformation initiatives.
* Strong structured problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure from scratch.
* High ownership with a bias towards execution.

**Brownie Points**

* Experience in a B2B SaaS or AI startup.
* Exposure to customer delivery, implementation, or GTM operations.
* Experience building operational dashboards and business metrics.
* Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Airtable, or similar tools.
* Experience driving automation using AI or no-code workflows.

**Why This Seat**

You'll build the operating backbone of an AI-native GTM company.

Instead of maintaining existing processes, you'll design them.

You'll work directly with the founders, influence how the company scales, and solve problems that don't have predefined answers.

If you enjoy building systems, simplifying complexity, and creating leverage across teams, you'll have an outsized impact here.

Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
The Enterprise Digital Product Office (EDPO) at Optum is a centralized organization focused on accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies-including cloud platforms, data, and AI-the organization supports the development of scalable, user-centered solutions that help advance Optum's mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.
  
  
As a Senior Product Designer, you'll lead the design of complex digital experiences across responsive web and mobile applications while helping shape product direction and customer outcomes. You'll drive discovery, facilitate cross-functional collaboration, mentor fellow designers, and influence product strategy through thoughtful design, research, and data-informed decision making. This role balances strategic thinking with hands-on design execution.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end design of complex product initiatives, from discovery and concept development through delivery and continuous improvement
* Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, and business stakeholders to define problems, identify opportunities, and create user-centered solutions
* Facilitate discovery activities, including stakeholder workshops, journey mapping, concept exploration, and experience visioning to inform product direction
* Translate user research, analytics, and business insights into design strategies that balance user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility
* Explore multiple design concepts, iterate based on user feedback and testing, and continuously refine experiences throughout the product lifecycle
* Define and communicate design concepts through user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and compelling design presentations
* Champion user-centered design, accessibility, and inclusive design principles while advocating for the needs of diverse users throughout the product lifecycle
* Drive consistency by contributing to and evolving the design system, reusable patterns, and design best practices across products
* Build alignment across cross-functional teams by communicating design rationale, facilitating discussions, and influencing product decisions
* Leverage AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve research, ideation, documentation, and design workflows while helping identify opportunities to increase team effectiveness
* Partner closely with engineering throughout implementation to ensure high-quality execution through design reviews and quality assurance
* Mentor and provide constructive feedback to other designers, helping elevate design quality and foster a collaborative learning culture
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams, including partners across multiple time zones, while communicating design decisions clearly and confidently
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). * Expert proficiency with Figma for interface design, prototyping, design systems, and design documentation
* Proven solid portfolio demonstrating expertise in leading end-to-end product design for complex digital experiences
* Demonstrated solid communication, facilitation, and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

title: Director of Product Experience & Design - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**The role**
  

Every organization now runs on identities, devices and, increasingly, AI agents. Someone has to decide who and what gets access to what, and keep it secure. At JumpCloud, that is often a small IT team responsible for an entire workforce across Mac, Windows, Linux and mobile, using one platform in place of several. For them, the experience is the product. When it is clear, a lean team runs what once took a stack of tools and a much larger staff. When it is not, people get locked out and risks go unseen.

  

That experience will change more in the next two years than in the last ten. Admins will ask an assistant instead of opening a console. AI agents will need identities, permissions and oversight of their own. Some of our most important experiences will have no screen at all.

  

We are looking for the
**design leader**
who will define what comes next. You will set the experience vision for the platform, decide where design invests across the interface, AI and headless experiences, and build a team known for its craft and its judgment. You will sit with Product and Engineering leadership as an equal partner, and your measure will be simple: how much easier, safer and faster our customers' work becomes.

**What we're looking for:**
  

  
* **Ownership of outcomes.**
  You hold design to outcomes for customers and the business. You write down your plans, make decisions with Product and Engineering partners, and follow the work through to adoption.
  
* **A clear view of where experience is going.**
  Users increasingly work through AI assistants, agents and APIs as well as through our interface. You can turn that shift into priorities: what to improve in the UI, what to make AI-assisted, and what to make headless, backed by data.
  
* **Craft and a high bar.**
  You model the quality bar yourself, give specific and candid feedback, and build the standards and systems that keep quality consistent across a broad product.
  
* **Hands-on with AI.**
  In the last two to three years you have changed how a design team works with AI, in practice, from prototyping in code to research synthesis. You can show what worked and what did not.
  
* **A leader who builds teams.**
  You grow designers and managers across locations, hire well, and build shared ownership with Product and Engineering. You run the critiques and skillshares that sharpen the craft, add strength in end-to-end experience design, and build a team designers want to join.
  
  

  
**What you'll own:**
  

  
* **Experience vision:**
  a multi-year vision for the platform and the priorities that follow from it, across the admin console, the end-user experience, and AI-assisted and agent-driven workflows, in partnership with Product owners.
  
* **Core workflows:**
  with Product partners, our most important end-to-end workflows, held to one bar: consistent, intuitive, self-service, and reliable on both the success and failure paths.
  
* **Trust and security in every flow:**
  permissions, policies, sign-in, recovery and alerts, designed so admins act with confidence and employees stay secure without friction.
  
* **Adoption and onboarding:**
  how customers discover, learn and adopt what we build, through in-product guidance, announcements and onboarding, measured by adoption of key workflows.
  
* **Measuring experience:**
  a clear measure of user satisfaction that brings together NPS, product feedback, support and research, and the actions the team takes on it.
  
* **Research practice:**
  discovery, usability testing and post-launch measurement that shape decisions before they are made and show what changed after.
  
* **Quality and craft:**
  design reviews that hold a clear bar, accessibility standards, and the strategy and governance of our design system, including how it carries through from Figma to code.
  
* **Team and capacity:**
  how the team is organized, where its time goes, and the design operations (documentation, standards and workflows) that help a distributed team move fast, so design investment follows company priorities.
  
* **AI-enabled design practice:**
  how the whole team uses AI, from discovery and synthesis to prototyping in code, made practical and repeatable.
  
  

  
**What you bring:**
  

  
* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading design managers and multi-disciplinary teams in B2B SaaS.
  
* A track record of experience improvements with measurable results, such as adoption, task success, support volume or NPS.
  
* Experience shaping AI-powered or agent-driven product experiences, with a point of view on where they are heading.
  
* Experience designing complex, technical or security-critical products. Identity, security, device management, IT or developer tools experience is a strong plus.
  
* Hands-on building and prototyping in code with AI tools such as Claude or Cursor, plus advanced Figma fluency: components, variables, tokens and design systems at scale.
  
* Clear, confident communication with senior leaders, including when the answer is no.
  
  

  
**Good to have:**
  

  
* Experience leading distributed teams across time zones (US, India, & Turkey are where our designers are).
  
* A portfolio with two or three case studies that show your work from problem to shipped outcome, including how you use AI.

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  
  

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  
  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  
  

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

  
  

#BI-Remote

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: UI/UX Designer (Product/Visual Design)
description:
**Hiring a full-time UI/UX Designer for a product-led pet healthcare company for its Bengaluru office.**

**Role at a Glance:**

**Company**

Confidential (a product-led pet healthcare company)

**Hiring partner**

Beyond Craft

**Job type**

Full-Time

**Location**

Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Work mode**

Work from office, 5 days a week

Founder

20-24 LPA

Up to 30 days

**About the Company**

We are hiring for a product-led pet healthcare company for its Bengaluru office who is building a continuous health monitoring infrastructure for pets. They are at an early and pivotal moment: the product works, the data is real, and we're making it legible and trustworthy for the people who love their animals most.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a UI/UX Designer with a strong visual design sensibility to define how the brand looks and feels. You'll work directly with the CEO and co-founders to shape a premium, calm, and scientifically refined visual language, and bring it to life across our App, Web, and Brand touchpoints so that complex pet-health data feels clear, elegant, and reassuring.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the visual design of the Mobile App (iOS/Android) and companion web experience, from dashboards and health insights to onboarding and device setup.

* Build and maintain a scalable UI component library and visual guidelines to keep every screen consistent.
* Design micro-interactions and motion details that make health data feel alive, warm, and human rather than clinical.

* UX research
* App UI design
* Web UI design
* Brand visual identity design
* Illustration
* Motion graphics

* You have 3-6+ years of UI/UX or visual design experience across mobile apps and web platforms.

* You're highly proficient in Figma (auto-layout, components, variants, prototyping); Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects) is a strong plus.
* You have an expert eye for typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy, and you know how to make dense information feel light and luxurious.
* You're skilled at data visualization and can turn numbers and trends into visuals that are both beautiful and meaningful.
* You understand iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, and know when to follow or thoughtfully break them.
* You have a solid grasp of UX fundamentals and usability, so your visuals work as well as they look.

Motion design skills (Lottie, After Effects, ProtoPie), illustration or 3D skills, or experience designing for hardware/IoT, connected wellness, or consumer electronics brands.

Immediate joiners preferred. Maximum notice period accepted: 30 days.

**Why Join?**

* Join a team of 15+ moving fast on a product with real technical depth and a real mission.
* Work directly with the founders; you'll present your work to and debate with the CEO weekly.

title: Senior UX Designer, Marketplace & CX
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
An eBay subsidiary, TCGplayer is on a quest to be the most trusted trading card game (TCG) platform — connecting and empowering the hobby community. Trading card games are a $25B global market that creates community connection through in-person games (Pokémon; Magic: The Gathering; Yu-Gi-Oh!; etc.). Founded by TCG enthusiasts, we operate a global marketplace, and create tools, technologies and solutions that help individuals and small businesses profitably sell TCGs at scale.
  
  
As a Senior User Experience Designer, you will apply your domain expertise and knowledge of UX best-practices to drive high-impact product improvements across our TCGplayer ecosystem including our mobile and desktop marketplace, seller tools and customer service representative workflows. You will join us as we explore emerging design-to-code workflows and AI-augmented design tools, helping to shape how we work. In this design role, you will partner with cross-functional peers to design and deliver user-centered solutions for both buyers and sellers.
  
  
Our User Experience Design team prides itself on creating a culture that fosters camaraderie, embraces diversity, and exudes passion. We value curiosity, craft, and a desire to directly interact with the real world. You don’t have to be a hobbyist or gamer to love working in TCGplayer’s UX Design organization, but you should be comfortable with ambiguity and eager to amplify our steadfast commitment to making hobbies and games accessible, fun, and rewarding for everyone. If you’re equal parts “empathy” and “ambition,” this is an opportunity to take risks and stretch yourself, surrounded by teammates who will support you along the way.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Create UX deliverables throughout the design process, evolving designs from early concepts, wireframes, and prototypes to final specifications
* Deliver high-value features across multiple projects, ensuring design solutions support user needs, align with business goals, and positively impact key performance metrics
* Apply advanced knowledge of Figma to create, iterate, and hand off design assets while working within an established design system
* Demonstrate fluency with modern AI tools and methods, applying them thoughtfully across the design process and broader workflow to accelerate exploration, iteration, collaboration, and delivery
* Collaborate with product and engineering teammates to deliver high-quality solutions that drive value, inform product strategy, and support data-driven decision-making
* Participate in user testing, workshops, and research efforts to gather insights and validate design decisions
* Obtain leadership approval and team alignment through compelling storytelling that clearly communicates your ideas and design rationale

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in a dedicated User Experience Design role, with a bachelor’s degree in Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), or equivalent practical experience
* Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end, user-centered design solutions with measurable impact across both mobile applications and desktop web experiences
* Demonstrated experience designing intuitive mobile experiences for iOS and/or Android, including understanding of Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design
* Demonstrated experience designing desktop web experiences, including responsive layouts, complex interactions, information-dense interfaces, and multi-step workflows
* Experience designing for both consumer-facing and enterprise products is strongly preferred, with an understanding of how user needs, behaviors, and design approaches differ across these contexts
* Demonstrated understanding of accessible and inclusive design principles, including WCAG guidelines and platform-specific accessibility standards
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience creating, iterating, documenting, and handing off design assets within an established design language system
* Fluency with modern AI tools and methods, demonstrated through active, thoughtful application of AI across the design workflow
* Comfort working in technical environments and alongside engineering tools, emerging technologies, and AI-augmented product-development workflows
* Extensive experience using research, usability testing, and quantitative and qualitative data to inform design decisions across mobile and desktop experiences
* Extensive experience working in an agile, multidisciplinary environment alongside designers, product managers, software engineers, researchers, and stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead all aspects of a design project within a software-development environment, from strategy and discovery through execution, launch, measurement, and ongoing iteration
* Excellent interpersonal, collaboration, presentation, and communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the gaming, hobby, or collectibles community — particularly trading card games
* Experience designing products for a North American markets
* Experience designing internal tools such as customer support interfaces

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.
