title: Senior Associate Creative Design O&O Ecommerce
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
**Position Summary:**
Own the design and creative execution for Puma.com, India's direct-to-consumer digital channel. This covers the website and app experience, sale and product-drop communication, CRM, and performance marketing creatives. The role turns business priorities (launches, exclusives, sale events, competitive responses) into fast, on-brand creatives that drive traffic, click-through and conversion, while staying within the global PUMA design language.
  
  
**Key Objectives**

* Design homepage, category and campaign banners, landing pages and PDP support assets for Puma.com and the Puma app, in line with global guidelines and localised for India.
* Deliver creatives at speed for sale events, product launches and competitive-response moments (e.g. limited-window sale plays and hero product drops) with quick turnarounds, without compromising quality.
* Create CRM assets (email, push, WhatsApp, in-app) and performance marketing creatives (static, carousel, short video/animation) for Meta, Google and other paid channels.
* Build reusable templates and a modular design system for banners and communication so recurring work scales faster.
* Support the case for Puma.com's differentiated positioning (exclusives, full-price and brand-heat products) with premium, product-first visual storytelling.
* Stay current on e-commerce UX and design trends, fashion and sneaker culture, and Instagram and short-form content trends, and apply them where they lift performance.
* Test and iterate: work with Growth and Performance teams on creative variants, and learn from results.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Creative performance: banner and campaign CTR, landing-page conversion, and ad-creative CTR / CVR / ROAS.
* Turnaround time and on-time delivery against the campaign calendar.
* Volume and range delivered across site, app, CRM and paid formats.
* Brand compliance and quality (minimal rework and revision cycles).
* Newness and creative testing: number of variants tested and learnings applied.

**Organizational Relationships**

* Internal: Puma.com Growth Managers (Performance and Lifestyle), Site Merchandisers, Content Deployment Manager, Performance Marketing, CRM, and the Marketing and Creative team.
* Global/India stakeholders: Global brand and digital teams for guidelines and asset approvals; India Marketing for campaign alignment.

* 3–5 years of experience in graphic or digital design, preferably in e-commerce, D2C, fashion or a lifestyle brand.
* Strong portfolio showing web banners, campaign creatives and performance ad creatives (not only social or brand work).
* Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma; InDesign is good to have.
* Working knowledge of motion and animation (After Effects, Premiere Pro or similar) for ad cuts, animated banners and stories/reels.
* Understanding of e-commerce UX, including mobile-first layouts, hierarchy and PDP/PLP design, and how design affects conversion.
* Awareness of how creative is measured (CTR, CVR, A/B testing), with a data-informed approach to design.
* Knowledge of current fashion, sneaker and streetwear trends, and of Instagram and short-form video as platforms.
* Ability to multi-task and work in fast, deadline-driven cycles, including sale-event peaks.
* Vendor interaction and development skills are a plus.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to take feedback from business stakeholders.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. title: Creative Designer
description:
**Your impact begins here**
As Creative Designer, you will turn ideas, data and complex messages into clear, engaging visuals that help Global Corporate Affairs connect with leaders, colleagues and stakeholders around the world. You will shape leadership presentations, campaigns, events, newsletters and SharePoint sites, keeping every output consistent with the Novo brand and accessible to its audience. Your work helps people understand what matters, and act on it, faster.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* A degree in creative and design, or a graduate or post-graduate degree from a recognised university with documented experience in creative and design.
* At least 6–7 years of creative and design experience in a global organisation or an agency, with a proven ability to take projects from brief to finished product.
* Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, InDesign).
* Proficiency in UI design and prototyping tools such as Sketch, InVision and Lunacy.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and SharePoint, and good knowledge of content management and digital asset management systems.
* Experience working with AI platforms such as Copilot and ChatGPT.
* Strong experience working with internal stakeholders and creative agencies.
* Knowledge and understanding of data privacy and GDPR.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, and the ability to listen well, communicate clearly and manage feedback.
* A creative, proactive, detail-oriented and service-minded approach, and the flexibility to work both independently and as part of a team.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with Figma.
* Experience working with visual identity in a corporate brand context.
* Experience in the pharma or healthcare industry.

**What You’ll Do**
You will be the creative hand behind many of Global Corporate Affairs’ most visible materials, balancing planned initiatives with ad hoc requests while keeping quality high.
  
  

* Interpret stakeholder briefs, objectives and content, and turn them into practical, purpose-driven designs delivered on time, even when priorities shift.
* Design and elevate leadership presentations and communication materials for important meetings and business initiatives.
* Create presentations, newsletters (using Microsoft Word and Dot Digital), icons, templates, motion graphics and video support for social media, suited to different audiences, platforms and formats.
* Convert dense information and data into clear, accessible visual stories, and enhance the design of SharePoint sites and pages to improve user experience.
* Build intuitive templates, master designs and adaptable visual frameworks that help teams create consistent, brand-aligned materials.
* Keep stakeholders informed on scope, progress, timelines and dependencies, and look for ways to streamline workflows, including responsible use of AI-enabled tools.
* Act as a sparring partner for design colleagues, stakeholders and agencies, and run training and knowledge-sharing sessions on creative and design best practice.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will join Global Corporate Affairs, part of People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs, where colleagues help create an engaging, inclusive workplace and attract and develop the talent needed to support Novo’s purpose.
  
  
Your closest partners will be GCA stakeholders and senior leaders, who rely on you for clear, polished materials, alongside internal teams, creative and design colleagues and external agencies. You will work with them to clarify requirements, agree on creative direction and bring feedback into the final result. The scope of the role is global, so the work you deliver will be seen across Novo.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will be trusted to take ownership of your work and make your voice heard on creative direction. The role gives you room to grow your skills, from motion graphics and UI design to the responsible use of AI-enabled tools, and to share what you know through training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  
You will be supported to perform at your best, in a team where clarity, collaboration and pace help good ideas reach the people who need them.
  
  
**Start now**
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex messages into design that moves people to act, apply for the Creative Designer role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Work collaboratively with our Product teams to deliver great UX that will revolutionize workplace collaboration and productivity for some of the largest companies in the world
* Directly lead and manage 8-10 designers and/or managers
* Change the way people work through design thinking and develop experiences using AI, Machine Learning and Mobile technology
* Oversee a portfolio of products, while acting as a mentor & manager to subordinates.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the Product Roadmaps
* Work with your peers to ensure a unified and cohesive experience across the ServiceNow ecosystem
* Lead user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others
* Rapidly iterate theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state-transition diagrams to document design decisions
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Ensure a consistent experience across the mobile and desktop platforms
* Participate in the development and maintenance of the company Design system to provide examples of core platform components and best practices
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years of enterprise product design experience
* An inspiring portfolio representing the process you follow to build insanely great experiences
* Demonstrated experience in defining and/or working with robust design systems
* Demonstration of any accessible projects you have built
* At least 8 years of visual and interaction design, with 5 years of Experience Design or equivalent.
* At least 3+ years of experience managing design teams
* Expert with Sketch, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions.
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem-solving skills to contribute within a multi-functional and multi-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Must be able to travel up to 20% of the year
* Expertise in one or more of the following product spaces: IT Security Management, IT Operations Management, Security Operations, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management (CSM), or Finance & Legal
* Experience in creating content and/or designing with compliance to WCAG 2.0/2.1 AA guidelines is a plus

Additional Information

**About the role**

Our technology initiatives serve micro-enterprises—small retail shop owners, local vendors, and home-based producers. These users operate on thin margins, in patchy network conditions, often with limited digital literacy, and almost exclusively in regional languages. Very little off-the-shelf software fits their unique context and operational realities.

We are looking for an individual to own that technology stack end-to-end:

* **Field Data Collection:**
  Supporting our frontline community partner network.
* **User Delivery:**
  WhatsApp-first interfaces and workflows built directly for micro-business owners.
* **Localization:**
  Voice-enabled and vernacular user interfaces.
* **Data Architecture:**
  The underlying data layer driving core impact measurement and analytics.
* **Production AI:**
  Deploying and scaling AI systems into active production workflows.

This is a hands-on technology role. You will work on setting the product and engineering roadmap alongside program leadership, help decide what to build, estimate technical scope, and deliver high-quality outcomes.

**What you'll own**

* Design and build web and mobile applications that hold up in low-bandwidth and intermittently connected areas — offline-first, low-data, low-end Android
* Build voice-first and vernacular interfaces for users with low digital literacy
* Identify where AI meaningfully improves field operations including evaluation, guardrails, and inference cost control
* Build the data layer that powers impact measurement and funder reporting: pipelines from Saathi field collection through to defined metrics, with data quality and lineage
* Do code reviews, testing, documentation & incident response

*Team and partners*

* Hire, mentor, and grow the engineering team
* Manage external technology partners, vendors, and other engineering collaborations
* Set engineering practice — review, testing, documentation, incident response — proportionate to a small team rather than ceremony for its own sake

*Data responsibility*

Own privacy and consent design for data, including obligations under India's DPDP Act and the data commitments we make in grant agreements

**Skills and experience**

*Essential*

* 4 - 7 years building software, with strong programming fundamentals and real problem-solving depth — able to go deep in at least one language and pick up others quickly
* Solid database work: schema design, query design and performance, and modelling for
* Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to ship quality code at high velocity
* Good grasp of web application design — APIs, authentication, state, caching, failure modes
* Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to explain a technical tradeoffs

*Nice to have*

* Built for low-bandwidth, rural, or offline-first contexts in India
* Production experience with AI-native applications — systems real users depend on
* WhatsApp Business API or comparable messaging platforms at scale
* Speech technology (ASR/TTS) or Indic-language NLP
* Data engineering and analytics pipeline ownership
* Cloud infrastructure ownership on AWS or GCP, infrastructure-as-code, and cost management

*Mindsets we're looking for*

* A genuine pull towards social impact — one that shows up in the tradeoffs you make, not only in your interest in the sector
* Comfort with ambiguous and shifting requirements, and a habit of helping set the requirements rather than waiting to receive them
* Appetite for field immersion. You will spend time in markets with Saathis and Vyapaaris. This is not optional color — it is how you will know what to build

**Tools required: AZURE, AWS, GCP.**

**Experience in Cloud and DevOps and languages required in website and platforms/products development.**

description:

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Senior UI Developer with 3 to 5 years of professional experience specializing in React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. In this role, you will be responsible for building modern, highly responsive, performant, and user-friendly web applications. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional product, design, and backend engineering teams to transform creative concepts into seamless digital products.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Application Development:**

* **Component Architecture:**

  Design and build reusable, highly accessible, and scalable UI components to maintain consistency across design systems.
* **Design Conversion:**

  Translate Figma / Adobe XD prototypes into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces with precise layout structure and smooth interactions.
* **Performance & SEO:**

  Optimize web applications for maximum speed, web vitals, dynamic rendering, and search engine optimization (SEO).
* **API & State Management:**

  Implement robust REST API integrations and manage application state efficiently across complex user workflows.
* **Code Quality & Standards:**

  Conduct thorough code reviews, enforce best practices in UI development, maintain clean documentation, and mentor junior developers.
* **Cross-Browser & Device Testing:**

  Ensure seamless performance and visual consistency across modern browsers, desktop views, and mobile viewports.
* **Troubleshooting & Refactoring:**

  Diagnose, debug, and resolve UI issues, runtime errors, and layout glitches promptly.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

  Work side-by-side with product managers, UI/UX designers, and backend engineering teams to deliver high-quality digital solutions.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Must Have:**

* **Experience:**

  3–5 years of hands-on professional UI development experience in modern web environments.
* **React.js & Next.js:**

  Strong hands-on mastery of React.js concepts (Hooks, Context, Lifecycle, SSR/SSG/ISR with Next.js).
* **JavaScript & TypeScript:**

  Solid proficiency in ES6+ JavaScript and production-level TypeScript for type-safe applications.
* **Core Web Tech:**

  Extensive experience with HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, modern CSS layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid), and responsive design patterns.
* **API Integration:**

  Proven experience integrating RESTful APIs, handling asynchronous operations, data fetch strategies, and error handling.
* **Version Control:**

  Strong proficiency with Git version control workflows (branching, merging, pull requests, code reviews).
* **Cross-Browser Development:**

  Proven track record in optimizing responsiveness and debugging UI across all primary browsers and screen sizes.

**Good to Have:**

* **State Management:**

  Experience with Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or advanced Context API architectures.
* **UI Frameworks:**

  Hands-on experience with Tailwind CSS, Material UI (MUI), Ant Design, or Styled Components.
* **Testing & Quality:**

  Familiarity with unit and integration testing using Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
* **Performance Tuning:**

  Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, code splitting, lazy loading, and bundle size reduction techniques.
* **SEO Concepts:**

  Understanding of metadata management, structured data, dynamic rendering, and SEO best practices in Next.js.
* **Agile Methodology:**

  Experience working in Agile/Scrum development sprints and using project management tools like Jira/Linear.

**Soft Skills:**

* **Communication:**

  Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical ideas clearly.
* **Attention to Detail:**

  Keen eye for aesthetic precision, alignment, typography, and polished UI component details.

title: Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal Member Engagement
description:
**1. Position overview**

**Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal and Member Engagement**
is accountable for the IC3 membership portal, the primary channel through which members receive their membership value. The role owns the portal's technology, information architecture, content program, operational upkeep and member engagement, serving schools and counsellors, universities, and organisations (NGOs, NFPs & corporates in education/ career counseling)

**2. Key responsibilities Indicative time allocation is shown against each area. Member engagement carries the largest share, reflecting its priority.**

**2.1 Platform and technology management (20%)**

* Serve as product owner for the membership portal, maintaining a prioritised feature backlog and a quarterly release plan.
* Manage the technology vendor or internal developers against agreed service levels, including uptime, defect resolution and change requests.
* Oversee integrations with payments, email, CRM etc.

**2.2 Information architecture and user experience (15%)**

* Define and maintain the portal structure, navigation and dedicated areas for each stakeholder group.
* Ensure a mobile-first experience, with pages that load reliably on lower-bandwidth connections (if applicable).
* Apply accessibility and brand standards consistently across all pages and templates.
* Use analytics and member feedback to run at least one usability improvement per quarter.

**2.3 Content quality (25%)**

* Own a 12-month content calendar covering all three stakeholder groups, reviewed monthly.
* Publish new content at least weekly, including resources, toolkits, webinar recordings, event updates, research and member news.
* Source content from IC3 programs, conferences, partner universities, member institutions, and the content committee and manage approvals and attributions.
* Maintain a content governance policy covering ownership, review dates, archiving and quality standards.

**2.4 Operations and maintenance (10%)**

* Monitor portal health weekly, including broken links, login issues, page performance and security updates.
* Maintain accurate member records, renewal dates and access rights in coordination.
* Manage the member helpdesk for portal queries, responding within two business days.
* Ensure compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and IC3 data policies, including consent and data retention.
* Retire or refresh outdated content in a quarterly content audit.

**2.5 Member engagement (25%)**

* Design structured onboarding journeys so that every new member activates core benefits within 30 days.
* Run a recurring engagement programme of newsletters, webinars, discussion forums, polls, member spotlights and recognition.
* Segment members by type, tier and activity, and tailor communication accordingly.
* Identify inactive members through usage data and run re-engagement campaigns ahead of renewal.
* Collect member feedback through surveys at least twice a year and report findings with recommended actions.
* Build communities of practice, for example among counsellors in the same city or universities recruiting from India.

**2.6 Contribution to membership growth (5%, secondary)**

Outreach and conversion are not primary responsibilities of this role. The incumbent will support the membership team by:

* Providing portal content, case studies and demo access for outreach campaigns.
* Sharing engagement and usage insights that inform renewal and acquisition strategy.

**3. Strategic priorities for the first 12 months**

The incumbent is expected to advance the following priorities.

* **Run the portal on data.**
   Establish an engagement dashboard within the first 90 days and use it to steer content, renewals and upgrades.
* **Build for scale.**
   Prepare processes, content and support to serve approximately 4,000 member institutions, the 12-month target in the membership plan.

4.
**Qualifications and competencies**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; a qualification in instructional design, educational content design, or career & college counseling is an advantage.
* 4 to 7 years of experience managing a learning portal or online community, including at least 2 years in an ownership role.
* Hands-on proficiency with content management or membership platforms (for example WordPress, a membership plugin, or a learning management system). Coding is not required.
* Experience managing technology vendors, defining requirements and running user acceptance testing.
* Working knowledge of web analytics, email platforms and CRM tools.
* Excellent written English and strong editorial judgement.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver a content calendar on schedule.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the education sector, particularly school counseling, university admissions or international education.
* Familiarity with K-12 and the higher education landscape.

**Core competencies**

* Member-centric mindset and a service orientation.
* Analytical thinking and data-informed decision making.
* Attention to detail and quality.
* Stakeholder management across internal teams and external partners.
* Initiative, ownership and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

**5. Key performance indicators**

* Member onboarding
* Engagments
* Content quality & stakeholder relevance
* Member satisfaction & Renewals
* Service

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.

title: Front-End Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To The Team**
Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
  
  
The Login Experience team is responsible for building and maintaining the traveler sign-in, registration, and account-access experiences across brands like Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, Orbitz, Travelocity and more. As the front door to every traveler's journey, our work directly shapes first impressions and trust — ensuring travelers can sign in and access their accounts quickly, securely, and consistently, no matter which brand or surface they land on. This Frontend/UI Engineer role directly supports execution of committed engineering work, reduces delivery risk, and ensures we can meet key customer, partner, and business objectives within the planned timeline.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and implement high-quality user interfaces and interaction patterns that align with product requirements, design systems, accessibility standards, and performance goals across multiple surfaces and devices.
* Implement robust client-side application architecture, including component composition, state management, routing, and API integration patterns that are scalable and maintainable across multiple product surfaces.
* Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to refine requirements, validate technical feasibility, identify tradeoffs, and deliver incremental, testable UX improvements backed by data and experimentation.
* Apply strong front-end engineering practices including automated testing, code reviews, performance optimization, security-conscious coding, and observability for web applications at scale.
* Contribute to and consume shared UI component libraries, design systems, and tooling to enable reuse and consistency across teams and projects, ensuring solutions can be adapted for multiple domains.
* Demonstrate familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, and safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve user experience, personalization, and content relevance.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional experience developing production-grade web applications using React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, including integration with RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
* Proven experience owning user-facing features end-to-end within a web application, including low-level UI design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated skills in front-end system design, including component-level low-level design (LLD), API consumption patterns, and data modeling for view-layer state and client-side data management, within modern engineering ecosystems and tooling (such as package managers, build systems, testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving complex React architectures at scale, including patterns for state management, performance tuning, and modularization across multiple products or domains.
* Background in building and extending shared UI component libraries or design systems, and driving adoption of best practices for accessibility, localization, and responsive design across teams.
* Track record of using data and experimentation (A/B tests, analytics, user behavior insights) to inform UX decisions and iteratively improve customer-facing experiences.
* Hands-on experience with AI-augmented developer or UX workflows (for example, code generation assistance, design optimization, or personalized UI experiences), with the ability to safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled capabilities in web applications.
* Experience collaborating with AI/ML and backend teams to design front-end APIs, interaction patterns, and data flows that surface AI-driven personalization, recommendations, or automation in a transparent, responsible, and performant way, including role-specific application of AI/ML concepts to enhance user experience.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

title: Senior Associate, Business Analysis
description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
  
  
Senior Associate, Business Analysis
  
  
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting-edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.
  
  
As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.
  
  
**Team Description**
Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise-wide customer resolution, serving as the one-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).
  
  
We are not just improving processes; we are completely re-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.
  
  
**Role Description**
General responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Bridge Business and Data: Partner with cross-functional teams (Tech, Lines of Business, Product) to translate complex data requirements into actionable product features for the Customer Navigator platform.
* Analytical Problem Solving: Support the business strategy by analyzing data to identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI for predicting, understanding, and resolving complaints before they escalate.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a liaison between business users and the product team; gather feedback, understand processes, uncover opportunities to improve decision-making, and drive continuous improvement in workflows.
* Data Translation: Interpret and translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that inform complaint resolution strategies.
* Communication: Communicate technical concepts and research results effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and non-specialist colleagues, through structured presentations and storytelling.
* Execution Focus: Display an intense focus on achieving both short- and long-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.

**The ideal candidate is:**

* Inquisitive: You thrive on solving big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* Technical: You’re comfortable navigating complex analytical solutions and have hands-on experience conducting business analyses using modern data tools.
* Innovative: You continually are on the lookout for novel approaches, solutions, and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to solve business problems and improve the customer experience.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, Econometrics, Finance or Operations Research).
* At least 2 years of professional work experience in analytics, business analysis or data-driven product management.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience with Python, R, SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in the financial services industry, specifically dealing with cross-LOB operations, customer experience or complaint resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy, and proficiency in key econometric and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, regression modeling, etc.).
* Experience translating ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and tangible product features.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About Eloelo Group**

Eloelo Group is one of India’s fastest-growing consumer technology companies, building category-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group’s flagship products, Story TV in micro-drama and Master in micro-learning, have together placed two Eloelo apps in India’s Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short-form vertical content every day.

Story TV is India’s leading micro-drama platform, with 10M+ users and 500+ original titles produced in partnership with studios like Balaji Telefilms and Applause Entertainment.

Master is India’s #1 micro-learning app, scaling to 5M+ users in 50 days with 1,000+ bite-sized courses across AI, finance, English, and life skills.

**Role: Product Analyst**

We are looking for a curious, data-driven Product Analyst to join our analytics team. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and marketing teams to track product performance, understand user behaviour, and turn data into insights that shape how millions of Indians watch and learn on our apps.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Write SQL queries to analyse user data on content consumption, feature usage, and engagement.
* Track and report key product metrics such as DAU, MAU, retention, churn, watch time, and conversion.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports in BI tools to give teams clear visibility into performance.
* Support A/B tests by setting up tracking, monitoring results, and sharing findings, working with senior analysts.
* Run deep dives into metric changes and funnel drop-offs to find root causes.
* Validate event tracking and data quality for new feature launches, working with engineering.
* Turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business teams.
* Support competitor analysis and track trends in short-form content and app usage.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or Business Analyst, preferably at a consumer tech company.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, and window functions.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, and basic Python or R.
* Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase, or similar.
* Basic understanding of statistics and A/B testing.
* Clear communication, with the ability to explain data simply to non-technical teams.
* Interest in entertainment, media, or digital content apps.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with consumer apps such as streaming, gaming, social, or edtech.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or Google Analytics.
* Exposure to agile teams and tools like JIRA and Confluence.

title: Staff Analyst
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an ambitious, highly analytical self-starter to step into a high-visibility role within our Agent (Partnerships) business. Partnerships is our high-velocity business line that provides insurance agents with a digital-first platform, automated underwriting infrastructure, insurance products, and specialized services to help them sell more life insurance, faster.
  
  
Working as an elite individual contributor, you will sit squarely at the intersection of product mechanics, data science, and operational strategy. You will partner directly with our business leaders to solve unstructured data puzzles, proactively flag macro financial risks, and define the behavioral milestones that turn new agents into long-term platform advocates. If you are a big-picture thinker who loves digging into the data weeds to write the strategic story of enterprise growth, let's talk.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Data Democratization & Infrastructure: Collaborate with data engineers and broader analytics teams to maintain scalable business logic, deploy clean tracking dashboards, and enable self-service analytics across the organization.
* Tooling Innovation: Actively build, test, and integrate advanced generative AI tools to automate internal analytics processes and maximize delivery speed.
* Team Mentorship: Provide ongoing guidance, peer code reviews, and tactical leadership training to distributed junior analytics resources across our global offices.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Experience Baseline: 5 to 8 years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, data science, or analytically intensive individual contributor roles at high-growth tech startups or well-established firms.
* Technical Mastery: Non-negotiable expert knowledge of SQL. Strong foundational knowledge of statistics and predictive data modeling is highly desired. Familiarity with scripting languages (Python or R) is a major plus.
* AI-Native Workflow Fluency: Proven history of actively leveraging modern Large Language Models (like ChatGPT or Claude) inside your day-to-day workflow to streamline writing, debug calculations, and automate personal efficiency. Must rank in the top 10% of AI-fluent analysts.
* Analytics Stack Exposure: Experience utilizing advanced visualization, dashboarding, and AI-enabled analytics environments (such as Hex, Tableau, Mode, or Excel).
* Unstructured Problem Solving: Exceptional talent for entering highly ambiguous situations, slicing past data records proactively to expose root causes, and organizing disparate facts into clear corporate narratives.
* Executive Presentation Agility: Superior written and verbal communication skills; comfortable defending high-stakes analytical summaries to the corporate C-suite and Board of Directors.
* Education: Advanced degree in a quantitative domain (Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math) or equivalent practical technical background.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Work collaboratively with our Product teams to deliver great UX that will revolutionize workplace collaboration and productivity for some of the largest companies in the world
* Directly lead and manage 8-10 designers and/or managers
* Change the way people work through design thinking and develop experiences using AI, Machine Learning and Mobile technology
* Oversee a portfolio of products, while acting as a mentor & manager to subordinates.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the Product Roadmaps
* Work with your peers to ensure a unified and cohesive experience across the ServiceNow ecosystem
* Lead user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others
* Rapidly iterate theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state-transition diagrams to document design decisions
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Ensure a consistent experience across the mobile and desktop platforms
* Participate in the development and maintenance of the company Design system to provide examples of core platform components and best practices
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years of enterprise product design experience
* An inspiring portfolio representing the process you follow to build insanely great experiences
* Demonstrated experience in defining and/or working with robust design systems
* Demonstration of any accessible projects you have built
* At least 8 years of visual and interaction design, with 5 years of Experience Design or equivalent.
* At least 3+ years of experience managing design teams
* Expert with Sketch, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions.
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem-solving skills to contribute within a multi-functional and multi-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Must be able to travel up to 20% of the year

title: Senior Specialist - Technology
description:
**Role name: Senior Specialist - Technology, Bangalore**

**Experience: 4 to 7 years**

**Salary: 10 to 12 LPA**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**About the role**

Our technology initiatives serve micro-enterprises—small retail shop owners, local vendors, and home-based producers. These users operate on thin margins, in patchy network conditions, often with limited digital literacy, and almost exclusively in regional languages. Very little off-the-shelf software fits their unique context and operational realities.

We are looking for an individual to own that technology stack end-to-end:

* **Field Data Collection:**
  Supporting our frontline community partner network.
* **User Delivery:**
  WhatsApp-first interfaces and workflows built directly for micro-business owners.
* **Localization:**
  Voice-enabled and vernacular user interfaces.
* **Data Architecture:**
  The underlying data layer driving core impact measurement and analytics.
* **Production AI:**
  Deploying and scaling AI systems into active production workflows.

This is a hands-on technology role. You will work on setting the product and engineering roadmap alongside program leadership, help decide what to build, estimate technical scope, and deliver high-quality outcomes.

**What you'll own**

* Design and build web and mobile applications that hold up in low-bandwidth and intermittently connected areas — offline-first, low-data, low-end Android
* Build voice-first and vernacular interfaces for users with low digital literacy
* Identify where AI meaningfully improves field operations including evaluation, guardrails, and inference cost control
* Build the data layer that powers impact measurement and funder reporting: pipelines from Saathi field collection through to defined metrics, with data quality and lineage
* Do code reviews, testing, documentation & incident response

*Team and partners*

* Hire, mentor, and grow the engineering team
* Manage external technology partners, vendors, and other engineering collaborations
* Set engineering practice — review, testing, documentation, incident response — proportionate to a small team rather than ceremony for its own sake

*Data responsibility*

Own privacy and consent design for data, including obligations under India's DPDP Act and the data commitments we make in grant agreements

**Skills and experience**

*Essential*

* 4 - 7 years building software, with strong programming fundamentals and real problem-solving depth — able to go deep in at least one language and pick up others quickly
* Solid database work: schema design, query design and performance, and modelling for
* Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to ship quality code at high velocity
* Good grasp of web application design — APIs, authentication, state, caching, failure modes
* Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to explain a technical tradeoffs

*Nice to have*

* Built for low-bandwidth, rural, or offline-first contexts in India
* Production experience with AI-native applications — systems real users depend on
* WhatsApp Business API or comparable messaging platforms at scale
* Speech technology (ASR/TTS) or Indic-language NLP
* Data engineering and analytics pipeline ownership
* Cloud infrastructure ownership on AWS or GCP, infrastructure-as-code, and cost management

*Mindsets we're looking for*

* A genuine pull towards social impact — one that shows up in the tradeoffs you make, not only in your interest in the sector
* Comfort with ambiguous and shifting requirements, and a habit of helping set the requirements rather than waiting to receive them
* Appetite for field immersion. You will spend time in markets with Saathis and Vyapaaris. This is not optional color — it is how you will know what to build

**Tools required: AZURE, AWS, GCP.**

**Experience in Cloud and DevOps and languages required in website and platforms/products development.**

More details: https://groundzero.community/

title: Product Designer
description:
**About the team**

Salvador Dali once famously said
*“Have no fear of perfection -- you’ll never reach it*
”. We love you Dali, but you kinda don’t know the design team at slice. Meticulousness, attention to detail, creativity - 3 strong pillars that make every design ever created at slice perfection. Check out our website and you know we ain’t lying.

**About the role**

If creating elegant and customer-focused designs that make people talk about it is your thing, and you’re as comfortable designing products with AI tools as you are designing on Figma, then this role is for you. Such products come out of working in close collaboration with business, product, technology teams, and fellow designers. You would also be presenting design propositions and solutions to stakeholders using wireframes, mock-ups, or high-fidelity prototypes. Feedback is breakfast of champions, and we'd ensure you'd get as much as you need to iterate and improve to reach our mutual goal of building a world-class product.

**What you’ll do**

* Ideate and implement solutions that overlap customer needs, design and technology.
* Gather requirements from stakeholders, derive problem statements and plan design engagements. Also, proactively launch efforts to improve different aspects of the product.
* Be the owner & decision-maker of design for one or more major features in the consumer app.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and content strategists to oversee the user experience of a product from conception until its launch.
* Ensuring design quality, consistency, and coherence within the product.
* Design flows and experiences that are incredibly simple and elegant. Give and solicit feedback from other designers to continually raise our bar for quality.
* Comfortably build out experiences on design tools as well as AI/vibe-coding interfaces.
* Conceptualise original ideas that bring simplicity and user-friendliness to complex design roadblocks.
* Collaborate and conduct user research and evaluate user feedback on designs and do iterations according to feedback.
* Research, learn and implement design guidelines, best practices and design standards. Experiment and validate design ideas and opinions.

**What you'll need**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in design.
* 1-3 years of experience designing in consumer-focused product companies.
* Expertise in design tools like Figma, Sketch, Principle etc.
* Experience designing using AI/vibe-coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Google Stitch, Figma Make, Lovable etc. We don’t need you to know/use all of them, but we’d like you to be proficient in at least one of them.
* Exceptional analytical skills, with an ability to quickly translate both qualitative and quantitative data-driven insights into actions.
* Excellent visual design skills, experience in illustration & motion design is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills & attention to detail.

**About us**

slice

A new bank for a new India

slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us.

Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

title: Business Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Business Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be a critical thinker with exceptional communication and problem solving skills, capable of translating complex business requirements into clear, actionable solutions. You will work closely with various stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and end users, to drive successful project delivery and contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes and systems.

Key Responsibilities:

• Requirements Elicitation and Analysis:

◦ Conduct in-depth interviews, workshops, surveys, and other techniques to gather, analyze, and

validate business requirements from diverse stakeholders.

◦ Translate high-level business needs into detailed functional and non-functional requirements, user

stories, use cases, and process flows.

◦ Analyze existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for optimization.

◦ Perform cost-benefit analysis and feasibility studies for proposed solutions.

• Documentation and Modeling:

◦ Create comprehensive documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs),

Functional Specifications Documents (FSDs), process maps (e.g., BPMN), data flow diagrams, and

wireframes/prototypes.

◦ Maintain and manage requirements throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring traceability and

alignment with business objectives.

• Solution Design and Recommendation:

◦ Collaborate with technical teams (developers, architects, QAs) to design and propose effective and

scalable solutions that meet defined business requirements.

◦ Evaluate various solutions, considering technical feasibility, budget, timeline, and impact on existing

systems.

◦ Contribute to the development of business cases to justify proposed initiatives.

• Stakeholder Communication and Management:

◦ Act as a liaison between business units and technical teams, facilitating clear and consistent

communication.

◦ Manage stakeholder expectations and build strong, collaborative relationships.

◦ Present findings, recommendations, and project progress to various audiences, including senior

management.

• Testing and Implementation Support:

◦ Support the quality assurance (QA) and testing phases, including reviewing test plans, assisting with

user acceptance testing (UAT), and resolving issues.

◦ Monitor the implementation of solutions and ensure they align with business goals and deliver

expected value.

◦ Provide training and support to end-users as needed.

• Process Improvement and Data Analysis:

◦ Continuously identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest innovative solutions.

◦ Utilize data analysis techniques to derive actionable insights from various data sources.

◦ Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure project success and business

impact.

• 2-5 years of full-time experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role.

• Proven ability to gather, analyze, and document complex business requirements.

• Strong understanding of various business analysis methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

• Exceptional communication (written and verbal), presentation, and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in creating clear and concise documentation.

• Experience with project management principles and tools.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Confluence, Jira.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
