title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.
  
  
The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Autonomously manage global primary market research (qualitative and quantitative) of all levels of complexity, incorporating diverse stakeholder perspectives to ensure organizational alignment and buy-in. Strength in applying advanced statistical analyses and leveraging business intelligence to support strategic, tactical and operational initiatives as well as planning and implementation of new and potential USP products and programs is essential.
* Steward projects to generate actionable and meaningful insights. Develop research plans to meet business needs, consult with internal business partners, establish and manage schedules, monitor progress, and compellingly communicate the results
* Acquire and manage market research vendors to ensure quality work is provided on-time, on-budget, and that it is reported with a suitable degree of professionalism
* Proactively serve as a thought partner with USP leadership. Participate in corporate planning and new product development processes to identify opportunities, address needs, and support the development of business and marketing plans
* Proactively bring external perspectives and insight into business planning for the organization, accomplished through:
* Monitor trends in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food and other related industries to assess their implications for USP business lines
* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Basic Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Preferred majors in market research, marketing, science, business, or related social science discipline.
* 7 or more years of experience in applying Market Research to solve broad strategic business problems.
* Strong business writing skills – evidence of succinct, distilled reports and attention to detail through thoroughness and accuracy
* Strong verbal and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to present statistical information to non-statistically oriented audiences
* Widespread knowledge of advanced primary market research methodology.
* Business acumen and strong analytical skills
* Advanced Intermediate skills with the following programs:
* MS Excel
* MS PowerPoint
* MS Word
* Online survey tools, bulletin boards and focus group platforms (Qualtrics preferred)
* Statistical software packages – R, SPSS, etc.
* Has the ability to navigate through ambiguity with courage and leadership.
* Must be self-motivated and customer-focused.
* Excellent time and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to concurrently prioritize multiple tasks with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Prior experience in global market research, pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food or related, regulated industries is highly desired.
* Experience working in a not-for-profit organization.
* Experience working in a scientific organization.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Sales & Marketing
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**About The Job**
Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.
  
  
As a Scaled Abuse Analyst, you will have experience with analyzing large-scale data and scaled systems of review. You will thrive in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will be a key contributor to the strategy for reducing network badness on YouTube. You will be an independent, critical thinker with sound metrics judgment who has a passion for coaching others, solving technological challenges and setting scalable standards. You will balance the short term requirements we face while demonstrating the ability to see the big picture and make quantitatively based long-term recommendations accordingly. You will require on-call work at weekends on a rotational basis. You will be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform fraud and spam investigations using various data sources, identify product vulnerabilities and drive anti-abuse experiments to prevent abuse. Work with engineers and interact cross-functionally with stakeholders to improve workflows via process improvements, automation and anti-abuse system creation.
* Design and refine prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their accuracy in identifying and classifying abusive content and behavior which may include prompt engineering, data labeling, and performance analysis.
* Apply advanced statistical methods to large complex data sets to understand the impact of abuse to the YouTube ecosystem. Contribute strategy and development of new workflows against additional known vectors of abuse.
* Learn complex and technical concepts and systems and deliver meaningful results using them.
* Maintain, foster and promote quality by providing regular feedback metrics to the Global team. Manage technological solutions for streamlining quality assurance.

title: Manager – Customer Experience
description:
* Customer Experience Strategy & Economics
* Build and own the CX scorecard beyond NPS: OTIF (on-time-in-full), CPKO, resolution speed, escalation

rate, repeat-purchase behavior by customer tier — and tie every one of them to a revenue or retention
  
  
number leadership can act on.
  
  

* Quantify the cost and reorder impact of every major CX failure mode (damaged/missing items, delivery

issues, refund delays) and use it to prioritize fixes by rupee impact, not by ticket volume.
  
  

* Own resolution-policy decisions (e.g., redispatch vs. refund) with hard data on which choice actually

keeps a customer.
  
  
Data-Driven Program Management
  
  

* Be comfortable pulling and validating your own data (SQL, BigQuery or equivalent) rather than waiting

on a dashboard someone else maintains.
  
  

* Run root-cause analysis that survives scrutiny — right-sized samples, corrected logic, honest callouts

when two systems disagree, and a clear line between “verified” and “a model.”
  
  

* Segment customers by lifetime value and behavior (tiers, first-time vs. repeat, state/geography) to find

where the highest-leverage interventions are, not just the loudest complaints.
  
  

* AI &Automation
* Own the chatbot/IVR stack end to end: containment rate, cost per conversation, and — critically —

instrument what today isn't measured (does “closed” actually mean “resolved”?).
  
  

* Identify and build the next generation of AI-driven CX: proactive delivery-risk alerts, automated win-

back campaigns for lapsing customers, smarter self-serve flows — always backed by a quantified
  
  
opportunity size.
  
  

* Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (chat, IVR, call-scoring platforms) on total cost and actual

capability, not the sales deck.
  
  
Team & Operating Model
  
  

* Build and lead a small, accountable team across three areas: CX Tools & Vendor Management, CX

Metrics & Voice of Customer, and Data & Automation.
  
  

* Replace informal, single-point-of-failure ownership with clear RACI, documented processes, and a team

that can operate without you in the room.
  
  

* Run structured win-back and retention initiatives (e.g., outbound campaigns for customers who've gone

quiet at 90/180 days) with proper reason-code diagnosis, not just reminder blasts.
  
  

* Voice of the Customer
* Personally read and act on customer feedback — the good, the near-miss, and the genuinely angry.

Every customer who takes the time to write in is a free, high-signal data point; treat it that way.
  
  

* Turn qualitative complaints into structured, quantified problems the business can prioritize.

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.
* Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis.
* Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs.
* Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Behavioral Research / Behavioral Insights / Consumer Behavior Research Profiles
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of experience in Behavioral Research, Consumer Behavior Analysis, Behavioral Science, or Market Research, focusing on understanding user motivations, decision patterns, and digital behavior
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience conducting primary and secondary research, including qualitative and quantitative research methods such as interviews, ethnographic studies, surveys, behavioral experiments, and observational research
* Mandatory (Experience 3) : Experience analyzing user behavior patterns, engagement trends, and digital interaction journeys to generate insights that influence product design, feature development, or platform experience improvements
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have exposure to data analysis or data mining of user behavior datasets, combining research insights with behavioral data to identify patterns, anomalies, or opportunities for product innovation
* Mandatory (Skills 1): Strong understanding of Behavioral Science principles such as Cognitive Bias, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & System 2 Thinking, Decision Science, or Consumer Psychology
* Mandatory (Skills 2): Experience in testing concepts, prototypes, or product ideas through usability testing, concept validation, or behavioral experimentation to evaluate user response and product effectiveness
* Mandatory (Skills 3): Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable insights, hypotheses, and recommendations for Product, Design, or Business teams
* Mandatory (Skills 4): Basic understanding of UI/UX and digital product journeys, including how users interact with mobile apps or web platforms, though this is not a design role
* Candidates from institutes with strong behavioral research exposure are preferred
* Mandatory (Company): Candidates from B2C consumer product organizations where user behavior is closely tracked and analyzed, such as consumer tech, fintech, e-commerce, or digital platforms
* Mandatory (Note):This is not a pure UX Researcher or Data Analyst role. The client is looking for Design Thinking–oriented Behavioral Researchers who combine behavioral science, research methodologies, and behavioral data analysis to generate insights
* Preferred (Skills): Exposure to behavioral experimentation, usability testing, journey analysis, or consumer psychology frameworks used to improve digital product experience
* Preferred (Education): Background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Ethnography, Cognitive Science, or related fields (BA/MA/MSc/BSc)
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years

Experience: 2–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Qual Research Manager/ Senior Qual Research Manager
description:
**Qual Research Manager / Senior Qual Research Manager**

India

**ABOUT TOLUNA**

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions – faster. We partner with the world’s leading brands, delivering impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, global first-party panel, and world-class team of research experts. We are making investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding. Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn more at www.tolunacorporate.com.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Senior Research Manager – Qualitative Research will lead end-to-end qualitative research engagements, from understanding the client’s business challenge and designing the research approach through moderation, analysis, storytelling and final delivery. This is a senior client-facing role requiring strong qualitative craft, commercial awareness, team leadership and the ability to turn consumer understanding into clear, actionable business recommendations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead end-to-end qualitative research projects across a range of clients, categories and business challenges.
* Translate client business questions into sharp research objectives and recommend the most appropriate qualitative approach.
* Design and deliver qualitative studies using focus groups, in-depth interviews, ethnography, immersions, online communities and other exploratory techniques.
* Develop high-quality discussion guides and research materials, and moderate confidently across different consumer and stakeholder audiences.
* Lead analysis and synthesis, moving beyond observations to identify underlying motivations, tensions, opportunities and implications for clients.
* Create compelling stories and presentations that connect consumer insight with clear strategic and business recommendations.
* Build strong client relationships, lead senior client conversations and act as a trusted research partner throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to proposals, pitches and business development, developing strong qualitative solutions that balance research rigour, timelines and commercial considerations.
* Mentor junior and mid-level researchers and collaborate closely with Commercial, Operations and other Research teams to ensure consistently high-quality delivery.

**Your Profile**

* 7+ years of hands-on experience in qualitative market research, preferably within a research agency, insights or consulting environment.
* Strong experience independently designing and delivering qualitative research studies from brief through final presentation.
* Excellent moderation skills across focus groups, in-depth interviews and other qualitative methodologies.
* Strong analytical ability with the capacity to move from consumer observations to deeper insights and clear business implications.
* Excellent storytelling, report-writing and presentation skills, with confidence presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* Strong client-management skills and experience building trusted, long-term relationships.
* Experience developing proposals and contributing to pitches, account growth and new business opportunities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, stakeholders, scope and budgets while maintaining high standards of quality.
* Experience coaching or mentoring researchers; excellent written and spoken English, with proficiency in additional Indian languages an advantage.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE – FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* Consistently high-quality qualitative research, analysis, storytelling and client delivery.
* Strong client relationships, positive feedback and contribution to repeat business and account growth.
* Effective leadership of complex projects, with strong ownership of timelines, scope, quality and commercial performance.
* Visible contribution to developing junior researchers and strengthening Toluna’s qualitative research capability in India.

**Our Values**
:

* Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
* Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
* Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
* Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
* Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caring

**What we Offer:**

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.

Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher and language class subsidy.

Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
description:
**Role:**
Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
  
  
**About Us**
**:**
Scrubsy is India’s #1 foam-based household cleaner - trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We’re a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality and we’re building the team that is passionate!
  
  
**Brief:**
Scrubsy is building out a dedicated Consumer & Market Insights function to put the consumer at the centre of everything we launch, from formulations to fragrance to packaging to campaigns.
  
  
As
**Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer and Market Insights**
, you will be a core member of that team, working closely with the Senior Manager - Consumer and Market Insights. You will run the day-to-day research: Coordinating fieldwork with agency partners, Supporting Qualitative and Quantitative studies, Analysing Consumer and Market Data and turning them into clear, well-told and actionable findings.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end research. Help plan and run Qualitative and Quantitative studies from Brief to Final Report.
* Coordinate agency and field partners. Share briefs, discussion guides and questionnaires, track timelines and fieldwork quality, and keep projects moving on schedule.
* Analyse and synthesise. Work through transcripts, verbatims, surveys and market data to pull out trends, themes, need states and clear takeaways.
* Build the story. Prepare clean, insight-led presentations and toplines for the Leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Track the consumer after launch. Monitor reviews, ratings, feedback and repeat signals from our D2C website and marketplaces, and flag what needs attention.
* Do desk research. Scan Category, Competitor and Trend information to support study design and brand, R&D and marketing questions.
* Keep the insights engine organised. Maintain trackers, a library of past studies and learnings, and research budget and timeline records.
* Use modern tools. Use GenAI and analysis tools to speed up synthesis and reporting without losing rigour.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Mandatory Requirement**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in consumer insights or market research, in an agency, a brand or a D2C company.
* Hands-on exposure to Qualitative research and Quantitative research.
* Hands-on knowledge of Research Methodology: you know which approach fits which questions work and can design and run studies accordingly.
* Hands-on data interpretation: You can work through surveys and tracking data and turn them into clear, actionable insights.
* Experience with Consumer interactions and insights, from speaking with consumers to drawing out what matters.
* Qualitative experience, particularly exploratory research (FGDs, IDIs or immersions), and the ability to summarise them into themes.
* Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree, ideally MBA / PGDM (Marketing) or equivalent.

**Additional Requirement**

* Exposure to AI-driven insight tools, social listening platforms, or e-commerce/quick-commerce analytics
* Exposure to FMCG (Home care, Personal care) industry.
* Experience supporting NPD launches from exploratory research through to post-launch evaluation.
* Brand health tracking experience.
* Concept testing experience.
* Pre and Post Campaign evaluation experience.
* Familiarity with syndicated data and brand tracking platforms.

**Who You Are**

* Proactive - You don't wait to be told a metric or perception is slipping; before marketing asks "what happened," and you come with the why, not just the what
* Ownership Driven - You own the research question end-to-end — from writing the brief to fieldwork to the final recommendation that actually gets used
* Data Conscious - You validate every insight or "consumer said" claim across segments, methodologies, and sample sizes before it goes to leadership
* Organized - you run a busy, always-on calendar of trackers, ad-hoc studies, and agency deliverables across multiple categories without a wave, deadline, or stakeholder slipping through the cracks.
* Progressive Learner - You understand that Learning is a continuous process and are willing to learn new methodologies and ways of working, while being unafraid to think outside the box and putting across your PoV.

**About Airtel Finance**

Airtel is building one of India’s most ambitious consumer financial services franchises under the Airtel Finance brand. Airtel already reaches hundreds of millions of customers across the country; the task now is to turn that reach into a financial relationship spanning a customer’s whole financial life across save, pay, borrow, invest and insure use cases. * Own and continuously monitor the product funnels across the app and assisted channels, from journey start to KYC completion, account activation and repeat transactions.

* Track daily, weekly and monthly KPIs for the product scorecard and flag deviations early.
* Identify and quantify funnel leakage and conversion bottlenecks, including KYC failures and partner-side drop-offs.

* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Company:**
UltraCare PRO (Zealmax Innovations Pvt. Ltd.)

**Experience:**
5-7 years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Why this role exists-**

UltraCare PRO already sells across marketplaces, quick commerce and our own website. The next step is to become a brand people look for by name and recommend to others.

Your mandate is to grow the brand organically, in both brand equity and revenue. We want growth that lasts: demand that compounds through search, content, community and word of mouth, not revenue that only grows when ad spend does.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the direction for four teams and stay close enough to the work to write a brief yourself, give sharp feedback on a design, or work out why a page lost its ranking.

**What you'll own**

**Brand strategy**

•        Build and run a 12-month brand and organic growth plan, with targets for brand demand and organic revenue.

•        Define what UltraCare PRO stands for and how it looks and sounds, in a brand system every team works from.

•        Set a clear architecture for the master brand and its sub-brands, so each has a job and the core brand gets stronger.

•        Keep the brand consistent wherever customers meet it: website, marketplace listings, quick commerce, packaging, social and ads.

**SEO**

•        Own SEO for our website end to end, from technical health to content and backlinks, and judge it on revenue, not just traffic.

•        Grow branded search on Google and the marketplaces, and track our share of search against competitors.

**Content**

•        Build an education-led content engine. Many people still don't know what a TENS machine does or which device is right for them, so clear explainers do a lot of the selling.

•        Turn reviews, customer stories and expert voices such as physiotherapists into content people trust.

**Social media**

•        Own organic social: strategy, calendar, formats and community management.

•        Run creator partnerships that build credibility and drive sales, and measure them properly.

**Design**

•        Lead the design team and raise the bar on quality and turnaround.

•        Keep performance marketing, marketplace and quick commerce teams supplied with on-brand creative, and feed back what's working.

**Team and collaboration**

•        Hire, coach and grow your teams, with clear goals and regular reviews.

•        Work closely with performance marketing, ecommerce, quick commerce and D2C so brand and performance pull in the same direction.

•        Brief and manage agencies and freelancers where they add speed or skill.

**Measurement**

•        Report monthly on branded search, share of search, organic traffic and revenue, social engagement, and ratings and reviews.

•        Show how organic growth improves blended MER over time, so each rupee we spend brings back more revenue.

**What success looks like**

We'll judge this role on organic revenue and brand demand, not on how much content goes out

•        Organic channels bring in a clearly larger share of revenue.

•        Branded search is up on Google and on the marketplaces.

•        Our website ranks for the searches that matter in our categories, and that traffic converts.

•        UltraCare PRO looks and sounds like one brand wherever customers find it.

•        The team is stronger than when you joined.

**What you'll bring**

**Must have**

•        5 to 7 years in brand, content or growth marketing, working on consumer brands.

•        Hands-on experience scaling a brand. You can walk us through what you did yourself, what changed and which numbers moved.

•        Working knowledge of design, content, social media and SEO.

•        Experience leading a team, and you enjoy developing people.

•        Comfort with data. You set targets, track them in tools like GA4, Search Console and marketplace dashboards, and act on what they show.

•        Strong taste in design and writing, and the ability to explain your feedback.

•        You think about revenue as well as reach.

**Good to have**

•        D2C experience. It's a strong plus but not a requirement, so if you've scaled a brand in another setting, we'd still like to hear from you.

•        Experience in health, wellness, personal care or consumer electronics.

•        Comfort communicating health benefits responsibly, within ASCI and regulatory guidelines.

•        An understanding of how brand strength shows up in marketplace and quick commerce sales.

**Why join us**

•        
**Real ownership.**
Four teams, a clear mandate and a direct say in how the brand grows.

•        
**Demand to build on.**
Our products already sell on India's biggest marketplaces and quick commerce apps, so you're not starting from zero.

•        
**Room to lead the category.**
Many customers are still learning what these devices can do. The brand that explains best and earns the most trust can pull ahead.

•   
**Work that matters.**
Our products help people with aches and pains they deal with every day.

title: Intelligence Engineer
description:
Intelligence Engineer

The Opportunity

Robosoft is embedding AI into how every business function operates and as a core part of how work gets done. To make that real, each function needs someone who helps drive the AI layer: the workflows, the context, the prompts, the templates, and the day-to-day adoption that turns AI tooling into operational capability.

The Intelligence Engineer is that person. You sit embedded within a business function (Sales/Bid Management or broader Business Functions such as HR, Legal, and Finance) and drive how AI is designed, documented, deployed, and used within that function. You are the AI authority to support your function, responsible for ensuring that AI workflows are structured, documented, adopted, and continuously improved.

This role sits at the intersection of business operations and AI tooling. You are a business-facing lead who understands the function deeply, designs how AI fits into its processes, documents those process flows, and ensures the team is equipped to work with AI effectively. Where technical builds are required, you work with the AI Solutions Engineer to translate your requirements into engineered solutions.

What You'll Do

1. AI Workflow Design, Ownership, and Process Documentation

* Structure how AI engages with work within your function, from intake through to output
* Design, create, and maintain shared AI configurations: context layers, prompts, templates, commands, and skills that the team uses day to day
* Document the end-to-end AI process flows for your function, creating a clear, visible map of how AI operates within each key workflow
* Maintain and evolve these process flow documents as workflows mature, ensuring they remain accurate and referenceable
* Own the function's AI workflow library, ensuring all configurations are versioned, documented, and discoverable

2. Function-Level Embedding and Adoption

* Work alongside your function on a day-to-day basis, becoming deeply familiar with how the team operates
* Identify where AI can remove friction, improve output quality, or accelerate delivery within the function
* Be the AI process owner within your function, the person the team turns to for guidance on how to use AI effectively
* Translate functional knowledge into AI-friendly structures: turning tacit knowledge, processes, and expertise into reusable AI assets

3. Content and Context Management

* Ingest artifacts (meeting transcripts, documents, notes, templates) into structured, reusable context that AI tools can leverage
* Maintain the function's master context, ensuring it stays current as the business evolves
* Extract and contextualise engagement-specific information, for example extracting requirements from a new sales opportunity and publishing them as discoverable commands for the team
* Build and maintain the function's prompt and template library as a living, growing resource

4. Opportunity Identification and Requirements

* Stay close to day-to-day operations to spot where AI could make a meaningful difference
* Prioritise opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and alignment with function goals
* Define requirements for technical builds and work with the AI Solutions Engineer to deliver them
* Feed functional requirements and use cases into the broader AI capability roadmap

5. Training and Enablement

* Guide colleagues on how to engage with AI workflows, running training sessions and providing hands-on support
* Surface patterns and learnings across the function, sharing what works and what does not
* Document processes and best practices so they can be scaled across the function and potentially to other functions
* Run AI enablement sessions as part of the broader organisational AI programme

Who You Are

Behavioural Traits

* Deeply embedded: You build trust by working alongside the function, not by parachuting in with recommendations
* Process-minded: You see how work flows through a function and instinctively look for ways to structure and improve it
* Clear communicator: You can document a process flow, write a prompt, and explain an AI workflow to a non-technical colleague with equal clarity
* Proactive: You do not wait for people to come to you with problems. You spot opportunities and drive them forward
* Adaptable: You are comfortable working across different types of work and adjusting your approach as the function's needs evolve

If you are passionate about technical illustration and eager to contribute to a leading engineering company’s success, we encourage you to apply. Join Epiroc and leverage your skills to impact global mining and infrastructure projects while building a rewarding career.

title: Copilot Studio SME
description:
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Data & AI practice is looking for an Agentic AI & Copilot Studio SME to lead client enablement and adoption for agent-based AI solutions built on Microsoft Copilot Studio and the wider Microsoft agent ecosystem. This is a training-led, client-facing role: the primary focus is designing and delivering structured skilling — instructor-led workshops, hands-on labs, train-the-trainer programmes and champion communities — for large organisations building and scaling agents.
  
  
What distinguishes this role from a platform-training role is agentic depth. You are expected to understand how agents actually work — orchestration and reasoning loops, tool and function calling, grounding and retrieval, memory and context handling, multi-agent patterns, evaluation and guardrails — and to teach Copilot Studio in that context rather than as a feature tour. You will build reference agents yourself, advise on live engagements, and be the person client teams escalate hard agent-design questions to.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the design and delivery of agentic AI and Copilot Studio skilling programmes for large enterprise audiences — curriculum design, instructor-led sessions, hands-on labs, self-paced content, assessments and certification pathways.
* Run train-the-trainer and champion-enablement programmes so client teams can sustain and scale agent development independently after the engagement.
* Teach agent design as a discipline, not a tool walkthrough — task decomposition, orchestration and reasoning patterns, tool/action design, grounding strategy, memory and context, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, failure modes and cost/latency trade-offs.
* Tailor content and depth to distinct audiences — business makers, pro-code engineering teams, and business and IT leadership.
* Build reference and demo agents in Copilot Studio — topics, generative answers, actions and connectors, agent flows, knowledge sources and multi-agent handoffs — to anchor training and seed client use cases.
* Design and maintain lab environments, sandbox tenants and exercise sets, keeping them current with the fast-moving agent-platform roadmap.
* Provide hands-on advisory on live engagements: agent design reviews, grounding and knowledge-source guidance, action/connector patterns, prompt and instruction design, testing and evaluation approaches, and go-live readiness.
* Advise on when to build in Copilot Studio versus a pro-code approach on Azure AI Foundry or an agent framework — and how the two coexist in a single client landscape.
* Establish evaluation and Responsible AI practice for agents: test sets and regression suites, groundedness and quality measurement, content safety, guardrails, human oversight and monitoring in production.
* Advise clients on agent governance and operating models — environment strategy, DLP policies, maker onboarding, publishing and approval workflows, agent lifecycle management, licensing considerations and usage analytics.
* Support use-case discovery workshops — identifying, qualifying and prioritising agent scenarios, and setting realistic expectations on what agents can and cannot do reliably.
* Act as the practice reference point for agentic AI enablement: build reusable training assets, playbooks, agent templates and accelerators, and mentor consultants joining the capability.
* Contribute to presales as the subject-matter expert — enablement approach, effort and duration estimates, demos and client-facing solution walkthroughs.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 9–12 years of overall experience in software engineering, automation, data or AI roles, with a recent and substantial focus on generative and agentic AI.
* Hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI solutions — multi-step orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval and grounding, memory and context management, and multi-agent collaboration patterns.
* Up to 2 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, covering both building agents and delivering training on the platform.
* Practical Copilot Studio depth: topics and trigger design, generative answers and knowledge sources, actions and connectors, agent flows, publishing across channels (Teams, web, M365 Copilot), and testing and troubleshooting agents.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering technical training to large organisations — instructor-led workshops, hands-on labs, train-the-trainer and champion programmes, for both business and technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of the wider Microsoft AI stack: Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search for retrieval, and how these complement low-code agents.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols — Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP or similar — sufficient to position and compare approaches credibly.
* Understanding of prompt and instruction design, RAG patterns, and agent evaluation — groundedness, task success, regression testing and quality measurement.
* Understanding of Responsible AI in practice: content safety and filtering, guardrails, data boundaries, auditability and human oversight.
* Working knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) and of Microsoft 365 data sources as grounding and action surfaces for agents.
* Comfort with code — Python or C#, plus REST APIs and integration patterns — enough to build custom actions, explain pro-code extensions and debug integrations.
* Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the confidence to hold a room of senior stakeholders as well as a lab of hands-on makers.
* Ability to produce enablement collateral independently — decks, lab guides, quick-reference material and recorded walkthroughs.

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900) or Developer (PL-400), or Copilot/agent-related Microsoft credentials.
* Experience with declarative agents, the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit, Graph connectors or custom engine agents for deeper extensibility scenarios.
* Experience taking agents to production — observability, cost and latency optimisation, versioning and lifecycle management.
* Exposure to non-Microsoft agent platforms (AWS Bedrock Agents, Google Vertex AI Agents, open-source frameworks) for comparative positioning.
* Experience across multiple industry domains (manufacturing, BFSI, consumer goods, energy, healthcare, or others).
* Experience in a global delivery / SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar) working with distributed teams across geographies.
* Prior contribution to reusable training assets, agent accelerators or practice-building initiatives.

title: Proposal Associate
description:

* Champion and lead the implementation of our Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) methodology - especially in Middle Game and End Game for Tier 1 & 2 pursuits. - Apply best practice RBS process to pursuits.

* Jacobs’ Brand Representative
* Lead by example, be proactive in ensuring health and safety of opportunity team throughout.
* Be an advocate of our BeyondZero culture and company values.
* Lead compliance with our Corporate Identity Program and client confidentiality requirements for all sales documents relating to the opportunity/proposals.
* Provide support to Global Sales e.g., timely preparation of press releases, providing input to our Annual Report, and support of Global Sales initiatives as appropriate.
* Champion Jacobs brand, including working within Brand Guidelines for visual identity and brand voice.
* Opening Game/ Market & Account Strategy - Partner with Market Sales Director, Head of Sector and S&T in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor & market research, development of Market Roadmaps.
* Support Sales Leads and Client Account Managers (CAMs) in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor and market research, development of documented Core Client Strategies, participation in 101s, development of Executive Summaries and White Papers.
* For the industry sectors pursued by your team, develop an understanding of our corporate, regional, and office qualifications including technical, managerial, commercial and competitive strengths that differentiate Jacobs in the marketplace.
* Leverage global network to identify & convey Jacobs’ unique capabilities & resources. Collaborate with S&T and Outside Sales to develop Capability Statements and White Papers. -
* Client Go / No Go and Account Reviews and Focus Windows as required.
* Conduct/ facilitate 101 meetings for key accounts, in partnership with outside Sales. Middle Game (Opportunities)
* Organise, direct, and motivate a multidiscipline opportunity team to develop Middle Game win plans and strategic sales actions and deliverables, or stimulate the assignment of teams for assigned opportunities.
* Actively initiate and partner with sales leads, CAMs and Capture Managers to develop and implement Middle Game action plan, e.g. document due diligence in project brief, develop Win Plan (G to VP), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary, conduct initiate Go/No Go and strategy review, and identify delivery team.
* Actively work with Sales and Operations to develop, implement and monitor Middle Game actions, using Client Success Platform (CSP) [Salesforce] & SharePoint. - Conduct Opportunity Go/No Go and strategy reviews in CSP. - Develop Win Plan (Gaps to Value Proposition), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary.
* Identify execution/delivery teams, coach and support them in the win strategy.
* Challenge concepts, solutions and assumptions in constructive ways to truly differentiate and develop unique value propositions. End Game (Bids & Proposals)
* Arrange or lead the planning and of all elements of End Game, e.g. analyse client request, develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance check-list, response outline, schedule), initiate Go/No Go, conduct Pink Team, conduct kick-off meeting, manage and work with team to develop response sections, refine Executive Summary, conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, schedule Pricing Reviews, ensure on-time delivery of response
* Champion use of Client Success Platform (CSP) for approvals & linked SharePoint for End Game document collaboration.
* Analyse client requests & develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance checklist, writing plan, response outline, schedule).
* When leading an opportunity; initiate Opportunity Bid/No-Bid meetings, conduct Pink Teams, conduct kick-off meetings and record all approvals in CSP, or else check compliance of opportunities assigned to you.
* When leading an opportunity, manage and work with team to develop response sections, especially value propositions and Executive Summaries or else check compliance of opportunities.
* When leading an opportunity conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, Schedule Pricing Reviews. Conduct and record approvals in CSP or else check compliance of opportunities /proposals.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any relevant Degree with around 9+ years of experience. \* Solution-selling strategy development
* Writing skills
* Marketing/sales coordination
* Facilitation, influencing and group process

* Business acumen
* Time management and task coordination

If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Enterprise Support Specialist (Bengaluru, India)

title: SDS Author
description:
Business Unit: ESI HQ & Other
  
  
Division: Legal - Business
  
  
**Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future!**
MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions, a business segment of Element Solutions Inc (NYSE: ESI), is renowned worldwide for its commitment to revolutionizing the electronics industry. With a legacy spanning over a century, we have continually set new benchmarks for excellence, reliability and sustainability in electronic materials.
  
  
  

* Wafer Level Packaging - Revolutionizing wafer fabrication processes for enhanced efficiency and performance
* Circuitry Solutions - Tailored solutions to meet the dynamic demands of modern circuitry
* Electronics Assembly Solutions - Innovating semiconductor, surface mount technology, and power electronics assembly for unparalleled reliability
* Advanced Materials and Joining - Engineering polymer and metal joining solutions for optimally performing circuits
* Film & Smart Surface Solutions - Transforming electronics with cutting-edge materials and technologies for enhanced functionality and reliability
* Micromax – Elevating electronics through high-performing, specialized inks and pastes

Across diverse sectors including automotive, consumer electronics, mobile devices, telecom, data storage, infrastructure, and AI, MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions has earned the trust of manufacturers worldwide. Our comprehensive range of high-quality solutions and technical services enables the entire electronics supply chain, empowering businesses to thrive in today's competitive landscape.
  
  
We embody the 'Elements of our Culture'- our 5C's; Challenge, Commit, Collaborate, Choose, and Care. These core values are the foundation of our organization which our employees embrace in their interactions with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders, to drive financial performance and create a rewarding work environment.
  
  
**Who are we looking for?**
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented SDS Author with 3–5 years of hands-on experience at Bangalore office who can independently author complete Safety Data Sheets (SDS) in compliance with Japan and other applicable Asia regional regulatory requirements.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-sufficient SDS author with strong knowledge of Japan and Asia GHS requirements, chemical regulations, and transport classifications, and proven ability to translate complex chemical, hazard and regulatory data into accurate and compliant SDS documents.
  
  
This role requires an individual who can take full ownership of the SDS authoring process - from data evaluation and hazard classification to final document completion in SAP (or equivalent SDS authoring software) - while ensuring regulatory accuracy, consistency, and high quality across all SDS sections.
  
  
The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with Asia and global cross-functional teams to maintain compliance with evolving chemical regulations across Japan and the Asia region.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Independently author, review, update, and maintain Japanese and other Asia regional GHS SDSs in compliance with applicable country-specific regulatory requirements.
* Author and maintain SDSs for other Asian countries, ensuring compliance with applicable:
* Country-specific GHS requirements
* Chemical inventory and substance control requirements
* Hazard communication requirements
* Other relevant local chemical regulations
* Evaluate chemical composition, physical and chemical properties, toxicological and ecotoxicological data, and other relevant technical information to determine appropriate hazard classifications and SDS content.
* Ensure appropriate transport classifications, including UN, IMDG, IATA, ADR, and other applicable regional transport requirements, and ensure alignment between transport classifications and SDS content.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, completeness, and quality of SDS content across the assigned product portfolio.
* Monitor regulatory changes in Japan and other Asia countries and proactively implement mandatory updates to SDSs and related hazard communication documentation.
* Support the preparation of development product SDSs for R&D and new product development projects.
* Work closely with Regulatory, R&D, Product Management, Commercial, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to obtain and evaluate the information required for SDS authoring.
* Provide technical and regulatory support by responding to inquiries related to SDS content.
* Collaborate with Asia and global regulatory colleagues to resolve complex SDS, hazard classification, chemical regulatory, and product compliance issues.
* Support continuous improvement of SDS authoring processes, templates, data quality, and regulatory compliance practices.

**Who are You?**

* Bachelor’s degree in scientific or technical discipline, such as Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant hands-on experience in SDS authoring product stewardship, chemical regulatory compliance, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of Japanese and Asian chemical regulations.
* Good understanding of GHS and hazard communication requirements in Japan and other Asia countries.
* Good understanding of chemical classification principles, including physical, health, and environmental hazards.
* Knowledge of transport classification requirements, including UN, IMDG, IATA, ADR, and other applicable transport regulations.
* Proven ability to interpret complex chemical, toxicological, physical, and regulatory information and translate it into accurate and compliant SDSs.
* Experience using SAP or other SDS authoring and chemical regulatory management systems is preferred.

**What competencies will you need?**

* Proficiency in reading, writing, and communicating in English.
* Strong knowledge of SDS authoring principles and the ability to independently prepare complete and accurate SDSs.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to regulatory accuracy and document quality.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple SDS projects and priorities.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams across Asia and global organizations.

**We are Offering...**

* Competitive gross salary with an attractive performance-based bonus.
* Group Medical Insurance coverage of INR 5 lakhs for self, spouse, and up to two dependent children.
* Group Personal Accident Insurance.
* Group Term Life Insurance.
* Two complimentary meals on all working days.
* A professional work environment with opportunities for learning and career development.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category applicable under federal, state and local laws.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

title: Learning Operations Specialist
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is reimagining the future of e-commerce by building a trusted marketplace and empowering global teams with high-impact talent development. The Global Finance Learning & Development team supports finance professionals across all stages of their careers through innovative, scalable learning programs and operational excellence.
  
  
In this role, you will partner directly with business leaders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to design engaging learning solutions, oversee global learning management system (LMS) operations, facilitate high-touch onboarding experiences, and maintain internal digital content platforms. Combining instructional design expertise with operational rigor, you will play a central role in driving talent development across the Finance organization—including new hire onboarding, early career technical curriculum, networking circles, and other ad hoc learning projects.
  
  
What You Will Accomplish
  
  
As the Instructional Designer and Learning Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for end-to-end learning solution design, global LMS system management, program facilitation, and content governance across the Global Finance organization.
  
  
Instructional Design & Content Development
  
  

* Apply instructional design and design thinking principles to build engaging, learner-centered functional and technical training programs.
* Develop and maintain end-to-end courseware, including e-learning modules, facilitator guides, participant workbooks, presentations, visual assets, and knowledge assessments.
* Partner with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to design and update finance technical curricula and onboarding materials.
* Build assessment tools and end-of-class exams for structured career development pathways, including the multi-tier Finance Future Professionals (FFP) curriculum.
* LMS Administration & Learning Operations
* Own end-to-end LMS operations in Workday Learn across the Global Finance organization, overseeing asset loading, offering creation, and course enrollments.
* Track and report L&D metrics, pulling learning enrollment, attendance, and assessment analytics to monitor program impact and engagement.
* Serve as ad-hoc registrar and operational point of contact, handling ad-hoc requests, registration tracking, and learner comms across teams.

Program Management & Facilitation
  
  

* Facilitate engaging virtual and in-person sessions, including new hire programs and networking circles.
* Coordinate program logistics, including conference room bookings in key hubs (San Jose, Austin, Bangalore), calendar holds, and executive speaker alignment with leadership.
* Support Finance Networking Circles (FNC) by aligning strategy, coordinating host schedules, managing calendar holds, publishing communications, and co-hosting live sessions.
* Develop and distribute onboarding materials (e.g., Director & Above Playbook) and tailored Welcome Letters for new hires, direct managers, and directors.
* Distribute post-session collateral, sharing training recordings, AI Zoom summaries, and updated course decks with participants.

Content Curation & Digital Governance
  
  

* Manage site governance and user permissions across internal SharePoint / Hub sites and external portals to maintain seamless navigation.
* Lead quarterly site content reviews with page owners to update featured tools, initiatives, and leadership development resources.
* Maintain shared collaborative spaces, preserve learning design artifacts and final versions of learning materials, assessments and results, evaluation feedback and other core deliverables.

What You Will Bring
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in instructional design, content development, and facilitation, with a strong portfolio of learner-centered deliverables.
* 3+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent instructional design and L&D projects in complex organizations.
* Proven technical proficiency in LMS administration (e.g., Workday Learn) and e-learning authoring platforms (e.g., Articulate Rise, Adobe product suite).
* Strong operational proficiency in session scheduling, attendance tracking, Zoom integrations, and data reporting/analytics.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and consulting skills, with a track record of building trust with SMEs, Executive Assistants, and senior executive leaders.
* High degree of agility and execution mindset, with demonstrated ability to consistently meet tight deadlines and adapt to evolving strategic priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Instructional Design, Organizational Development or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience within Finance or tech/e-commerce environments is preferred.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. title: Automation Expert & BA, Agentic Solutions, Relay Product and Tech
description:
**Description**
Relay Product Excellence's mission is to monitor Transaction Integrity for products supporting Identity Verification, Account Support, and Compliance across Carrier and Driver processes. We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Business Analyst to join the Relay Product Excellence team. In this role, you will support the analysis of complex operational data, help define business requirements, and contribute to continuous improvement across compliance and verification workflows. You'll work closely with stakeholders across operations and product to identify gaps, measure performance, and support automation and process improvement initiatives. Our team monitors Transaction Integrity for products supporting Identity Verification, Account Support, and Compliance across Carrier and Driver processes- partnering with product and technology teams to ensure the integrity and reliability of processes at scale.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Deliver Agentic AI and Data Driven Automation solutions for a 200+ member team, conducting more than 2MM investigations a year
* Opportunity to collaborate with product/program/operations teams to identify customer pain points and build innovative solutions
* Shape the future of identity verification by developing processes, tools, and leadership talent that reduce waste & abuse while ensuring compliance
* Drive automation and AI initiatives to scale verification capabilities, adapting to emerging business needs and launching automation solutions with measurable impact

You'll work in a fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges—from evolving regulatory requirements to emerging fraud patterns. If you're a strategic leader who thrives on solving complex problems with data and technology, this role offers an unparalleled opportunity to make your mark on Amazon's transportation future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve business processes and data methodologies; build automated, scalable solutions for recurring analytical needs
* Extract, analyze, and interpret datasets using SQL, Python, and AI tools to generate actionable insights
* Perform root cause analysis, variance analysis, and pattern identification with guidance from senior analysts
* Apply data transformations and basic statistical techniques to support diagnostic analysis
* Support the design and maintenance of automated reporting systems, dashboards, and KPI visuals to track metrics
* Validate data quality, flag upstream issues, and help maintain data integrity across workflows
* Solve defined business problems using structured analytical approaches; escalate ambiguous or complex issues while proposing initial solutions
* Support comprehensive analysis for business cases, product pilots, and strategic initiatives that contribute to measurable business impact
* Communicate findings clearly to immediate team and stakeholders up to two levels above, translating analytical results into clear formats for technical and non-technical audiences
* Proactively communicate project status, risks, and roadblocks; participate in requirements gathering and help clarify success criteria
* Scope and deliver analytical projects within defined timelines, incorporating best practices and quality checks in all work
* Partner with Product, Tech, Operations, and data engineering teams on assigned workstreams to support process automation and data quality efforts
* Contribute to business requirements reviews, documentation, and team-level process improvements

**About The Team**
Relay Product Excellence's (RPE) mission is to monitor Transaction Integrity for products supporting (a) Identity Verification, (b) Account Support, and (c) Compliance. We do this at a larger scale for Carrier and Driver processes, by collaborating with product teams like Carrier Identity and Continuous Compliance (CICC), Relay Safety and Trust (RST), and Relay Mobile. We supplement these products to help create programs where automation is yet to be launched, or cannot be developed. We are committed to enhancing the experience for carriers, drivers and product partners by adapting to emerging needs of the business, and launching programs that have a measurable impact in reducing waste & abuse, and ensuring compliance.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in Amazon Redshift and other AWS technologies
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with industry standard tools and scripting languages (Python or Perl) for automation
* Experience in AgentCore, QuickAutomate, Selenium and GenAI tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Experience creating complex SQL queries joining multiple datasets, ETL DW concepts
* Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
* Experience using very large datasets

title: Consultant - Project Controls
description:

WSP India is seeking to onboard dynamic and versatile Project management Expert with comprehensive experience across Document Control, Project Control, Scheduling, and Procurement to support our growing portfolio of complex engineering projects in Earth and Environment team.

**Document Control:**

* Oversee creation, organization, and maintenance of project documentation; ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with WSP’s internal audit and quality assurance procedures.
* Work closely with departments, regional leads, and subject matter experts to gather information, manage document workflows, and ensure timely delivery and distribution of project documents.

* Manage physical and digital document storage systems; upload documents to EDMS; monitor and improve documentation workflows and processes.
* Conduct regular audits, check document quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and project procedures.
* Be in continuous touch with the PM to be on top of any internal or external documentation.

**Project Cost Control:**

* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines while coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.
* Manage project setup, budgeting, task assignments, and closeout activities in Oracle Horizon, including maintaining WBS, time transfers, and compliance checks.
* Able to create Opportunity in Oracle based Horizon during proposal/ pre-proposal and update status based on directions from PM.
* Ensure necessary Risk Assessment procedures are followed while creating the opportunity in Horizon as well as help in preparing RMIS document.
* Support financial analysis and reporting by using financial systems [excel based Project Cost (PC) Control/ Financial Analysis Report (FAR) tools] to track project performance metrics, generate monthly accruals, and assess impacts of scope changes and forecast deviations.
* Collaborate with design teams to collect engineering progress data for Earned Value (EV) analysis and maintain accurate tracking of planned value, actual cost, and schedule.
* Act as liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the E&E PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation including lessons-learned databases and meeting records.
* Should have extensive knowledge of working with ERP for project creation and maintenance.
* Should be able to create and track change order and identify, quantify and mitigate risk acting as a buddy to the PM.

* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.
* Assess and report impacts of changes to baseline schedules and milestones, ensuring timely updates and resolution tracking.
* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems to analyze and report project performance and KPIs.
* Maintain accurate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and integrate project schedules under an Enterprise Project Structure (EPS).
