:
  
  

* Draft and prepare supplier and subcontractor contracts in alignment with prime contract requirements, ensuring all necessary terms are accurately flowed down; support the US team in contract finalization and negotiation.
* Track contract performance, manage renewals and extensions, and maintain organized contract documentation and repository.
* Creation and renewal of Work Orders (WOs) and timely vendor invoice updates in Oracle Horizon ERP.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, and Finance to monitor project expenses, resolve contract-related queries, and ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate procurement requests from project teams, provide operational support, and assist in internal procurement audits and training.
* Utilize analytics and forecasting tools to support procurement planning, maintain accurate procurement records in Oracle, and contribute to continuous improvement through industry best practices.

**Key Competencies / Skills:**

* Proficient in MS Office Suite, especially Advanced Excel; experience with Oracle ERP (Horizon/NetSuite), Power BI is a plus.
* Skilled in project scheduling tools like Primavera P6, Microsoft Project (MSP), and SmartSheets.
* Familiar with documentation control platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk, ProjectWise.
* Strong understanding of Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems related to project control.
* Combined minimum 4 years of experience in project scheduling, cost control, documentation, and procurement.
* Experience supporting procurement functions, including vendor coordination and invoice tracking.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities; capable of handling multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
* Skilled in forecasting, reporting, and maintaining accurate project records and WBS structures.
* Strong coordination and problem-solving abilities; able to work independently and in teams. Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and open to new challenges.
* Adopts a “Best for WSP” approach in daily activities.
* Flexible with work timings to support US-based project teams across time zones.

**Qualifications**

* Engineering degree with project management experience or master’s degree in construction management or project management is preferred.
* Minimum of 4 to Maximum 8 years of experience project management with Engineering / professional services consultants.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* CAPM-PMI / PMP certifications would be an added advantage.

* Conduct routine platform-health and content-quality audits; identify gaps and coordinate remediation with publishers and content owners.
* Support content owners and publishers with training, guidance, and practical assistance in using Highspot and following governance requirements.
* Produce recurring reporting on content health, metadata completion, publishing activity, aging content, platform usage, and publisher compliance.
* Help translate reporting insights into clear action lists for content owners, business groups, and governance reviews.
* Coordinate platform change requests, integrations, and technical issues with IT, Digital Transformation, and platform support teams.

* Maintain operational continuity and document key decisions, risks, and outstanding actions.
* Interface with Highspot including vendor relationship and contract

* 4+ years of experience in sales enablement, content operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, digital platforms, or a related field.
* Experience working with a content-management, knowledge-management, sales enablement, or digital experience platform.
* Experience managing operational processes involving content publishing, metadata, taxonomy, approvals, or content lifecycle management.
* Strong organizational and project-coordination skills, with the ability to manage detailed work across multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to quality control, documentation, and follow-through.
* Comfortable using reports and data to identify issues, track progress, and communicate operational performance.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.

* Experience with Highspot or a similar sales enablement platform.
* Experience supporting global sales, marketing, or enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with CRM, learning platforms, digital content systems, or enterprise collaboration tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Qlik, Excel, or similar reporting tools.

title: Junior Systems Engineer - OpenText
description:
**WHO YOU ARE**

Are you passionate about Enterprise Content Management, solution engineering, and building reliable digital platforms? Do you enjoy learning new technologies, solving technical challenges, and enabling HR digital transformation through technology?
  
We are looking for a Junior Systems Engineer to join our People Platform team supporting OpenText xECM for SAP SuccessFactors. You will contribute to configuring, developing, integrating, testing, and supporting our enterprise document management platform. Working with experienced engineers and platform specialists, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions across the employee lifecycle while developing your technical expertise.
  
  
We believe you bring
  
  
• At least 3+ years of relevant experience in enterprise content management or enterprise application engineering, with hands-on exposure to OpenText xECM and/or Content Server. Experience with SAP SuccessFactors integrations is desirable.
  
• Experience contributing to an OpenText xECM implementation, enhancement, or rollout is desirable; exposure to SAP SuccessFactors integrations is an advantage.
  
• Ability to understand business requirements and user stories, clarify technical questions, and break assigned work into manageable development and configuration tasks with guidance.
  
• Ability to collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams, communicate progress and blockers, and learn established development and support practices.
  
• Working knowledge of, or hands-on experience configuring, Business Workspaces, workspace hierarchies, document types, categories, metadata, permissions, and business rules in OpenText Content Server.
  
• Experience developing or maintaining OpenText WebReports, LiveReports, Content Server Workflows, Event Scripts, or workflow automation, with willingness to follow established coding and configuration standards.
  
• Basic to intermediate exposure to Content Server user interface configuration, Smart View, perspectives, forms, widgets, or UI extensions is an advantage.
  
• Understanding of REST APIs, basic integration concepts, authentication, and troubleshooting of API requests; familiarity with OpenText Content Server APIs is an advantage.
  
• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), API-based integrations, and enterprise application connectivity is desirable.
  
• Good analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate application issues, gather relevant logs and evidence, and resolve assigned incidents with appropriate guidance.
  
• Experience supporting testing, deployment, documentation, or production support activities for enterprise applications is desirable.
  
• Exposure to OpenText PowerDocs, document generation, template development, or document automation is an advantage.
  
  
This is our wish list
  
  
The key skills we look for in this role are:
  
• Hands-on experience or working knowledge of OpenText xECM and/or OpenText Content Server, with an interest in developing deeper platform expertise.
  
• Understanding of document management concepts, metadata, document types, workflows, Business Workspaces, and security.
  
• Exposure to WebReports, LiveReports, workflows, or Content Server customizations; ability to develop skills through practical assignments.
  
• Basic understanding of REST APIs and enterprise integrations; experience with cloud platforms is desirable.
  
• Awareness of SAP SuccessFactors and HR document management concepts is desirable.
  
• Exposure to PowerDocs, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, Google Cloud Platform, DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, or monitoring tools is an advantage.

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US**

You’ll contribute to IKEA’s digital transformation by configuring, developing, testing, integrating, and supporting the OpenText xECM for SAP SuccessFactors platform. Working closely with senior engineers and the Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will deliver assigned changes, maintain clear documentation, and help ensure platform reliability, security, and operational excellence.
  
This means that you will:
  
  
• Configure and support OpenText xECM for SAP SuccessFactors solutions under established technical guidance and standards.
  
• Configure Business Workspaces, workspace hierarchies, document types, metadata, permissions, and business rules based on approved designs.
  
• Develop, test, and maintain WebReports, LiveReports, workflows, Event Scripts, and automation solutions, following coding standards and peer-review feedback.
  
• Support configuration and maintenance of Content Server user interfaces, Smart View extensions, perspectives, forms, and widgets where required.
  
• Assist with developing, testing, and supporting integrations between OpenText xECM, SAP SuccessFactors, PowerDocs, DocuSign, and other enterprise applications.
  
• Work with REST APIs and assist in troubleshooting integration issues by validating requests, responses, logs, and data flows.
  
• Support testing, deployments, upgrades, migrations, and implementation activities, including preparing evidence and updating technical documentation.
  
• Investigate assigned incidents, identify likely causes, document findings, and collaborate with senior engineers to resolve production issues and maintain platform stability.
  
• Collaborate with senior engineers, Product Owners, Product Specialists, Architects, and Engineering teams to clarify requirements and deliver assigned work.
  
• Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting recurring issues, suggesting automation opportunities, improving technical documentation, and supporting platform performance and reliability initiatives.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will work within the Group Function Digital Area, supporting People & Culture platforms across IKEA's global organization.
  
Our engineering team is responsible for delivering and supporting OpenText xECM for SAP SuccessFactors, enabling secure, compliant, and efficient document management throughout the employee lifecycle.
  
We collaborate closely with Product Owners, Product Specialists, Enterprise Architects, Security, Service Delivery, SAP teams, and external technology partners to continuously improve our platform.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
• Engineering excellence through high-quality, maintainable solutions.
  
• Collaboration across business and technology teams.
  
• Continuous learning and innovation.
  
• Automation and operational efficiency.
  
• Ownership, accountability, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.
  
  
We can offer you:
  
  
• Work on some very interesting problems as described above, building reports, integrations, automation and document management solutions.
  
• Opportunities to have a global impact with your work.
  
• A team of great colleagues to learn with and from (with world-class experience across all aspects of Technology)
  
• Flexible and friendly working environment.

.

title: ERP Implementation Executive
description:
**ERP Implementation Executive – BOS**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About BOS**

**BOS is a next-generation Business Operating System designed to help companies manage and connect their operations across areas such as sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, finance, workforce management and other business functions.**

**BOS goes beyond traditional ERP software by adapting to the operational processes of each organisation rather than forcing every business into a rigid, predefined system.**

**We are currently implementing BOS with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an ERP Implementation Executive to work directly with customers and our product and development teams.**

**About the Role**

**As an ERP Implementation Executive, you will help businesses successfully adopt and implement BOS.**

**This is not primarily a software development role. You will work closely with business owners, department heads and operational users to understand how their business works, configure BOS around their processes, coordinate data migration, train users, support testing and take departments through go-live.**

**You will act as the bridge between the customer and the BOS product/development team**
.

The role provides significant exposure to real business operations and is suited to someone who wants to develop a career in ERP implementation, business analysis and enterprise technology consulting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meet customers, department heads and operational users to understand their existing business processes.
* Study how departments currently operate using ERP systems, Excel, documents and manual processes.
* Document business processes, requirements, approval flows, user roles and operational rules.
* Map existing customer processes to BOS and identify configuration or product requirements.
* Work with the BOS product and development teams to translate business requirements into system requirements.
* Configure customers, users, roles, permissions, departments, workflows and other implementation settings within BOS.
* Assist with collection, cleaning, validation and migration of master and transactional data.
* Coordinate implementation activities across departments such as Commercial, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Finance and HR/Workforce.
* Conduct product demonstrations and user training for department heads and end users.
* Prepare test scenarios and coordinate functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Record issues, gaps and enhancement requirements identified during implementation.
* Work with developers to verify that issues have been correctly resolved.
* Support customers during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Monitor adoption after go-live and help users transition from their existing processes to BOS.
* Maintain implementation documentation, meeting notes, action items and implementation status.
* Visit customer offices and operational locations when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who combines business understanding, communication skills and technology aptitude**
.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, managers and operational staff.
* Be curious about how businesses actually operate.
* Be able to understand a business process and translate it into a software workflow.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Be organised and capable of following multiple implementation activities simultaneously.
* Be comfortable working with Excel and business data.
* Have good written and verbal communication skills.
* Be comfortable learning complex enterprise software.
* Be willing to visit customer locations and work closely with customers during implementations.
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing requirements between the customer and development team.

**Preferred Experience**

**Candidates with 1–4 years of experience**
in any of the following would be particularly suitable:

* ERP implementation
* ERP functional consulting
* Business analysis
* Software implementation
* Customer onboarding for enterprise software
* Manufacturing ERP
* Inventory or warehouse systems
* Procurement systems
* HRMS / payroll implementation
* Accounting or finance software implementation

Experience with systems such as
**SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Tally, ERPNext or similar ERP/business applications**
would be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Candidates who have worked inside manufacturing or other operational businesses and have strong systems knowledge may also be considered.

**Educational Background**

**Relevant qualifications may include:**

* B.Com / M.Com
* BBA / MBA
* BCA / MCA
* BE / B.Tech
* Information Systems
* Operations / Supply Chain
* Finance / Accounting
* or another relevant discipline

We value practical ability and willingness to learn more than a specific degree.

**Skills That Will Be Valuable**

* ERP implementation
* Business process mapping
* Requirements gathering
* Functional documentation
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Data migration
* Microsoft Excel
* User training
* Customer communication
* Project coordination
* SQL knowledge – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of APIs/integrations – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of AI and modern business software – advantageous

**Why Join BOS?**

**BOS is being built as an alternative to the traditional approach to enterprise software.**

**Rather than joining an organisation where you repeatedly implement the same predefined ERP modules, you will have the opportunity to understand different businesses and help shape how their operations are represented within a new generation of business software.**

**You will work closely with the BOS leadership, product and engineering teams and gain exposure to:**

* Enterprise software implementation
* Business process design
* Manufacturing and operational businesses
* Product development
* Business analysis
* AI-enabled enterprise software
* Customer consulting
* Implementation project management

As BOS grows, this role can develop into
**Implementation Consultant, Senior Implementation Consultant, Implementation Manager and Implementation/Operations leadership roles**
.

title: Product Technical Engineer
Subject Matter Expert (SME) / Technical Consultant – Lithium-Ion Battery Effluent Treatment
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) will provide specialized technical guidance for the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) being executed for a large-scale Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing Facility. The consultant will support process review, technology validation, optimization of treatment schemes, commissioning support, troubleshooting, and customer engagement activities with a focus on battery manufacturing wastewater and NMP-containing streams.

The role will ensure that the proposed treatment systems meet performance guarantees, regulatory requirements, operational reliability standards, and project objectives.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES***

**Process & Design Review**

Review Process Design Basis, Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), P&IDs, mass balances, and engineering documents.

Validate process selection and treatment philosophy for battery manufacturing effluent streams.

Recommend process optimization, risk mitigation, and performance improvement measures.

Review equipment sizing, hydraulic loading, oxidation systems, biological treatment, sludge management, and tertiary treatment systems.

Support design validation of NMP wastewater treatment and advanced oxidation systems.

**Technical Advisory**

Provide technical guidance during detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and plant stabilization.

Evaluate complex wastewater characteristics and recommend suitable treatment strategies.

Develop troubleshooting procedures and corrective action plans for critical process upsets.

Optimize treatment processes to achieve treated water quality standards and operational efficiency.

**Commissioning Support**

Provide pre-commissioning and commissioning support.

Review commissioning procedures and startup plans.

Analyze operational performance data and recommend process adjustments.

Support achievement of performance guarantees during trial runs and plant stabilization.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

Participate in technical discussions with Reliance and other project stakeholders.

Present technical evaluations, recommendations, and performance improvement initiatives.

Resolve customer technical concerns and process-related queries.

Represent WABAG as the Subject Matter Expert during key project reviews.

**Knowledge Transfer**

Conduct technical workshops and training programs for engineering, commissioning, and operations teams.

Develop process manuals, troubleshooting guides, and operational recommendations.

Share industry best practices in battery manufacturing and advanced wastewater treatment.

**DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS**

Strong expertise in Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing wastewater treatment.

Practical experience in NMP Oxidation Process and treatment technologies.

Proven experience with Advanced Oxidation Processes (AOP), UV/H₂O₂, Fenton, Chemical Oxidation, and related systems.

Strong understanding of industrial wastewater characterization and treatability studies.

Experience in pilot plant evaluation, process optimization, and technology commercialization.

Ability to provide practical, site-oriented solutions during commissioning and operations.

Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.

Experience in EPC and industrial wastewater projects is preferred.

**COMPETENCY – TECHNICAL**

Lithium-Ion Battery Industry Effluent Treatment.

NMP Recovery and Oxidation Processes.

Industrial Wastewater Treatment Technologies.

Advanced Oxidation Processes (AOP).

Chemical Treatment Systems.

Biological Treatment Processes.

Process Design Review.

PFD & P&ID Evaluation.

Treatability Studies.

Process Troubleshooting.

Commissioning & Startup Support.

Water Reuse & Resource Recovery.

Performance Testing & Optimization.

Environmental Compliance.

COMPETENCY – GENERAL

Strategic Thinking.

Technical Leadership.

Stakeholder Management.

Customer Orientation.

Communication & Presentation Skills.

Problem Solving.

Decision Making.

Collaboration & Teamwork.

Project Execution Excellence.

Safety & Compliance Focus.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are specifically interested in experts who have direct experience in:

Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing Facilities.

NMP Wastewater Treatment/Oxidation Systems.

Semiconductor Wastewater Treatment Projects.

Advanced Oxidation Technologies for refractory industrial effluents.

description:

**What You Will Do**

* Coordinate projects on behalf of clients with associated factories in South-east Asia (key priority India and Bangladesh), focusing on energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, and similar decarbonization opportunities.
* Engage with suppliers’ technical and leadership teams to receive proposal signoffs and maintain a strong pulse on the sentiment at the industrial facility, designing engagement ideas to achieve project outcomes.

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across diverse teams and geographies.

description:

The
**Technical Consultant - ERP**
is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives.
  
The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes.
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions.
* Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management.
* Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology.
* Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues.
* Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases.
* Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation.
* Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues.
* Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment.
* Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications.
* Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll.
* Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization.
* Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities.
* Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities.
* Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures.
* Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success.
* Build strong relationships and trust with business users, IT stakeholders, vendors, and management.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members and end users as appropriate.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on SAP HR/Payroll experience, including configuration and production support.
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6.
* Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration, and Financial Postings.
* Demonstrated experience supporting payroll tax processing and tax-related configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Rimini Street Rsite Tax Engine, including implementation, configuration/support, testing, and application of tax updates. Other tax engine experience will be considered.
* Experience working with Rimini Street and coordinating the implementation and testing of vendor-provided tax and payroll updates is a plus.
* Understanding of integrations between SAP HR/Payroll and external HR, payroll, tax, and other applications.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working within a formal SDLC/change management process, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with end users, IT staff, business stakeholders, and management.
* Excellent communication, documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-transfer skills.
* Proactive self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies and business processes and utilize available resources effectively.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors.
* Experience with Kronos Workforce Management version 8 or higher.
* Experience with Rsite, BSI TaxFactory/TUBs, and/or other SAP payroll tax solutions.
* Experience with SaaS HR/payroll solutions and enterprise application integrations.
* Experience coordinating with third-party application and managed-service providers.
* Experience with payroll tax compliance, year-end processing, and tax update testing.
* Experience leading SAP HR/Payroll projects, enhancements, or major production initiatives.

title: Manufacturing Specialist - Operation Management
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The VAT & Protection Testing Engineer is responsible for ensuring the end-to-end quality validation of protection and control panels before dispatch through the Verification After Test (VAT) process.
  
  
This role involves performing IED configuration, secondary injection testing, functional verification, and documentation, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, customer specifications, and internal quality standards.
  
  
The engineer also contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, defect reduction, and cross-functional technical coordination to enhance product quality and testing efficiency.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**VAT Execution and Panel Validation**

* Perform Verification After Test (VAT) for all manufactured panels to confirm correct wiring, logic functionality, and performance as per engineering drawings and customer requirements.
* Conduct functional testing of protection, interlock, and control circuits to ensure operational integrity
* Validate panel performance under simulated field conditions and record results in standardized formats.
* Identify and document deviations, discrepancies, or rework requirements during testing.
* Ensure VAT checklists, reports, and test records are properly completed and archived.

**IED Configuration and Testing**

* Perform configuration and parameterization of Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) including protection relays, meters, and communication units.
* Carry out secondary injection testing to verify relay operation, tripping logic, and scheme correctness.
* Creating the MCL & ICD files for integration with scada systems.
* Maintain configuration templates and settings files for traceability and repeatability
* Ensure all test instruments and software tools are used as per calibration and procedure requirements.
* Quality Improvement and FPY Enhancement
* Support initiatives aimed at improving First Pass Yield (FPY) and reducing Defects per Panel (DPP).
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of test failures or repetitive issues.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Production teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Track testing trends and provide feedback for design and process improvement.

**Technical Coordination and Support**

* Act as a technical interface between Testing and Engineering teams for all protection-scheme-related discussions.
* Provide on-floor feedback on design errors, wiring deviations, and testing difficulties.
* Assist in reviewing engineering drawings, protection logic diagrams, and control schemes for accuracy and completeness.
* Support customer FATs (Factory Acceptance Tests) and technical audits as & when required

**Who are V?**
As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Overall Purpose of The Job**

* The Technical Compliance Specialist is responsible for supporting the effective monitoring of technical compliance across managed vessels within the Operations Support Centre (OSC).
* The role ensures vessels maintain high standards of technical reliability, preventive maintenance, and regulatory compliance through structured monitoring of defects, maintenance routines, inspection findings, vessel certification, and technical reporting. In addition to compliance oversight, the role supports ship management teams in coordinating key class surveys, statutory services, and class-related compliance matters to ensure vessels remain fully compliant with classification society requirements, statutory regulations, and company standards.
* Through proactive monitoring, analysis, and coordination with ship management teams, the Technical Compliance Specialist contributes to maintaining fleet technical readiness and reducing operational and regulatory risks.

**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Technical Compliance Monitoring**

* Monitor defect management across assigned vessels and highlight critical or overdue defects to the Ship Management team for timely resolution.
* Monitor compliance with critical spare parts requirements to ensure vessel reliability and operational readiness.
* Monitor adherence to critical planned maintenance routines and ensure timely execution onboard.
* Conduct oversight of routine planned maintenance activities to ensure maintenance schedules are followed.

**Inspection & Findings Monitoring**

* Monitor Vessel Inspection Reports (VIR) and track progress on corrective actions.
* Monitor findings raised by Inspection Managers and ensure timely follow-up and closure.
* Identify overdue or recurring findings and escalate where required.

**Certification & Regulatory Compliance**

* Monitor the validity and compliance status of vessel trading certificates.
* Monitor PMS-related certification to ensure system compliance with company and statutory requirements.
* Track and monitor outstanding Conditions of Class (CoC) and support timely closure.

**Survey & Class Compliance Coordination**

* In addition to monitoring responsibilities, the Technical Compliance Specialist supports ship management teams in coordinating key class and statutory compliance activities, including:
* Supporting the planning and coordination of Class Annual Surveys.
* Assisting with the planning and arrangement of Underwater Inspections (UWI).
* Assisting in the application and follow-up of Conditions of Class (CoC) and dispensation requests where required.
* Supporting the planning and coordination of statutory services and inspections to ensure vessels maintain regulatory compliance.

**Technical Monitoring & Analysis**

* Monitor and review Fuel Oil Analysis reports and highlight abnormal trends where identified.
* Monitor and review Lube Oil Analysis reports and escalate potential technical risks.
* Monitor annual sample analysis for systems including Ballast Water, OWS, Sewage Treatment Plant, Potable Water, and Scrubber Water (EGCS).

**Technical Documentation & Reporting**

* Review Technical Month-End Returns submitted by vessels to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Review and circulate the Monthly Lube Oil (LO) Report to Accounts (TECH 06) in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate technical compliance records within company systems.

**Compliance Oversight & Verification**

* Conduct random reviews of Bunker Plans to verify compliance with company procedures.
* Conduct random reviews of Oil Record Book (Part I) entries to ensure proper documentation and regulatory compliance.

**Systems, Risk & Escalation**

* Utilize company systems including ShipSure, Technical Dashboards, Operational Risk Analysers, and VVP to monitor vessel compliance and identify potential technical risks.
* Escalate critical technical compliance gaps or statutory issues that may impact vessel safety, inspection outcomes, or regulatory compliance.
* Maintain records of monitoring activities and follow-up actions.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Support initiatives aimed at improving technical compliance, vessel reliability, and operational performance within the OSC.
* Promote consistent adherence to company procedures and technical standards across vessels.

**Additional Skills for Survey & Class Compliance Coordination (Specialist supporting AFSI Task)**

* Understanding of classification society survey cycles and statutory service requirements.
* Ability to coordinate with classification societies, surveyors, service providers, and ship management teams.
* Experience in tracking and planning vessel surveys, statutory inspections, and class compliance matters.
* Strong follow-up and documentation discipline to ensure timely closure of Conditions of Class (CoC) and survey-related actions.

**Key Interfaces**

* The Technical Compliance Specialist works closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure vessels maintain technical compliance and operational readiness.

**Internal Interfaces**

* Ship Managers / Fleet Managers
* Technical Superintendents
* Operations Support Centre (OSC) teams
* HSSEQ Department
* Marine Operations Team
* Accounts / Finance (for technical reporting such as LO reports)

**External Interfaces**

* Vessel Masters and Chief Engineers
* Classification Societies
* Oil analysis laboratories and technical service providers
* Surveyors and inspection bodies
* Equipment manufacturers and service technicians (where required)

**What can I expect in return?**
V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
  
  
**Essential**

* Relevant maritime technical or marine background with experience in ship operations, marine engineering, or technical fleet management with more than 2 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of planned maintenance systems (PMS) and vessel technical management processes.
* Familiarity with statutory, class, and regulatory requirements related to vessel operations.
* Ability to analyse technical reports and identify potential compliance gaps or operational risks.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple monitoring tasks simultaneously.
* Effective communication and coordination skills when working with ship management teams and internal stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications and technical reporting systems.

**Desirable**

* Sailing experience as a Marine Engineer (Class 3 COC & above) or Deck Officers (2nd Officer & above) with more than 1 year of experience.
* Prior experience in technical compliance monitoring, fleet technical support, or technical management offices.
* Familiarity with ShipSure or similar fleet management systems.
* Experience supporting class surveys, statutory inspections, and technical audits.

title: Social Media Marketing Executive - SEO
description:
Job Description: Social Media Marketing & SEO Executive

**Job Title:** Social Media Marketing & SEO Executive  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Salary:** As per industry standards and candidate experience

Position Summary

We are looking for a creative, analytical, and results-driven Social Media Marketing & SEO Executive to manage our social media presence, improve website search engine rankings, and generate organic traffic and leads. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in social media management, SEO optimization, content planning, keyword research, and digital performance analysis.

Roles & Responsibilities1. Social Media Marketing

* Plan, create, schedule, and publish engaging content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant social media platforms.

* Create engaging captions, hashtags, creatives, reels, stories, and campaign content.
* Monitor audience engagement, respond to comments and messages, and maintain brand consistency.
* Track social media performance, reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, and lead generation.
* Identify relevant trends, competitor activities, and opportunities to improve social media visibility.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors, and content creators to produce high-quality content.
* Support paid social media campaigns when required.

2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

* Conduct keyword research to identify relevant, high-performing keywords and search opportunities.
* Implement on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, image optimization, and URL structure.
* Perform off-page SEO activities, including ethical link-building and backlink analysis.
* Monitor website rankings, organic traffic, click-through rates, and keyword performance.
* Conduct SEO audits to identify technical issues, broken links, indexing problems, and website optimization opportunities.
* Optimize website pages and blog content to improve search visibility and organic lead generation.

* Work with website developers and content teams to implement SEO recommendations.

3. Content & Performance Analytics

* Collaborate with content writers to develop SEO-friendly blogs, articles, landing pages, and website content.
* Use analytics tools to monitor campaign performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering social media growth, SEO performance, website traffic, and leads generated.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, content optimization, and social media algorithms.
* Excellent written communication and content coordination skills.
* Ability to analyze campaign data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Basic knowledge of WordPress or other content management systems.
* Familiarity with Canva and basic creative content editing.
* Understanding of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
* Experience in lead-generation campaigns and conversion optimization.
* Knowledge of AI tools for content ideation, research, and marketing workflow efficiency.

* Growth in organic website traffic and keyword rankings.
* Improvement in social media reach, engagement, and audience growth.
* Number and quality of leads generated through organic channels.
* Website content optimization and SEO audit completion.
* Improvement in website click-through rates and search visibility.

title: Graduate Apprentice Trainee - Data Science
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**About The NATS Program**
This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an enthusiastic and analytical Graduate Apprentice Trainee (GAT) – Data Science to join our Data Science and Analytics team.
  
  
This entry-level role provides fresh graduates with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data preparation, analytics, visualisation, statistical modelling, Machine Learning and AI. The selected candidate will work under the guidance of experienced Data Scientists and collaborate with business and technical teams to understand business challenges and support data-driven decision-making.
  
  
We value curiosity, logical thinking and a willingness to learn. Prior work experience is not required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming and validating data from different sources.
* Prepare and analyse datasets using Python, SQL and tools such as Databricks.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends and useful insights.
* Support the development and testing of basic analytical and Machine Learning models for forecasting, prediction and classification.
* Assist in building dashboards, reports and visualisations using Power BI or similar tools.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists and business teams to understand requirements and support data-driven solutions.
* Document data sources, assumptions, analysis and key findings.
* Contribute to data-quality improvements and identify opportunities to apply Data Science, Machine Learning and AI to business challenges.
* Communicate findings clearly through reports, dashboards and presentations.

**What You'll Gain**

* Hands-on experience solving real-world business challenges.
* Guidance and mentorship from experienced Data Scientists and analytics professionals.
* Exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, AI and business analytics projects.
* Opportunities to develop technical, analytical and communication skills.
* A supportive environment for continuous learning and professional growth.

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical and Logical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Innovation and Curiosity
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Continuous Learning
* Effective Communication

**Required Behavioral Competencies**

* Curiosity and willingness to learn new concepts and technologies.
* Structured approach to problem-solving.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical findings in simple language.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance.
* Willingness to collaborate, receive feedback and continuously improve.
* Good time-management skills and a sense of responsibility.
* Responsible handling of data and confidential information.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Basic understanding of statistics, probability and data analysis concepts.
* Basic programming knowledge in Python.
* Familiarity with SQL and fundamental database concepts.
* Introductory understanding of Machine Learning and its applications.
* Strong logical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn new tools and technologies and apply analytical thinking to practical business problems.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

description:

title: QA( Manual + Automation )
description:
**What's the work?**

Love finding bugs before they cause trouble? Passionate about making software smooth and reliable? Then this role is for you!

At Saleshandy, we're on a mission to achieve 100% automation by the end of the year - and we need you to help us get there! As our Junior QA Engineer, you'll test features, automate workflows, and work with developers to keep our products running flawlessly.

**Who Are We Looking For? - SDET 1**  
  

* 1-2 years of hands-on experience in QA / SDET role
* Strong understanding of web application testing, REST API testing, and API workflows
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, Agile methodologies, and test design techniques
* 1-2 years of hands-on experience with Playwright for test automation.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Experience in building and maintaining automation frameworks using:
* BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) approach (e.g., Cucumber with Playwright)
* Page Object Model (POM)
* Ability to write clean, scalable, and maintainable automation scripts
* Experience integrating automation tests with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
* Hands-on experience in API testing using Postman
* Comfortable writing and validating SQL queries (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.)
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Exposure to AI-powered testing tools and practices, such as:
* Using ChatGPT / GitHub Copilot for test generation
* Self-healing automation and intelligent locators
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Good communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to take ownership and work in a fast-paced environment

  
**Nice to have:**  

* Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter)
* Knowledge of security testing (OWASP Top 10)
